inthap parisuththamaana theavanaagiya karththarukku munbaaga ni'rkaththakkavan yaar? petti nammidaththilirunthu yaaridaththukkup poagum en'ru bethshimeasin manushar solli,

keeriyaathyaareemin kudiga'lukku aadka'lai anuppi: pelisthar karththarudaiya pettiyaith thirumba anuppinaarga'l; neengga'l vanthu, athai ungga'lidaththukku eduththukko'ndu poangga'l en'ru sollachsonnaarga'l.

appadiyea keeriyaathyaareemin manushar vanthu, karththarudaiya pettiyai eduththu, meattinmealirukki'ra abinathaabin veettilea ko'nduvanthu vaiththu, karththarudaiya pettiyaik kaakkumpadikku, avan kumaaranaagiya eleyaasaaraip parisuththappaduththinaarga'l.
petti keeriyaathyaareemilea aneaganaa'l thanggiyirunthathu; irubathu varusham anggeayea irunthathu; israveal kudumbaththaarellaarum karththarai ninaiththu, pulambikko'ndirunthaarga'l.

appozhuthu saamuveal israveal kudumbaththaar yaavaraiyum noakki: neengga'l ungga'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum karththaridaththil thirumbugi'ravarga'laanaal, anniya theavarga'laiyum astharoaththaiyum ungga'l naduvilirunthu vilakki, ungga'l iruthayaththaik karththarukku nearaakki, avar oruvarukkea aaraathanaiseyyungga'l; appozhuthu avar ungga'laip pelistharudaiya kaikku neenggalaakki viduvaar en'raan.
appozhuthu israveal puththirar baagaalga'laiyum astharoaththaiyum vilakkivittu, karththar oruvarukkea aaraathanaiseythaarga'l.
pinbu saamuveal: naan ungga'lukkaagak karththarai man'raadumpadikku, isravealar ellaaraiyum mispaavilea koottungga'l en'raan.

avarga'l appadiyea mispaavilea koodivanthu tha'n'neer mo'ndu, karththarudaiya sannithiyil oot'ri, an'raiyathinam ubavaasampa'n'ni, karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythoam en'ru anggea sonnaarga'l; mispaavilea saamuveal israveal puththirarai niyaayam visaariththukko'ndirunthaan.

israveal puththirar mispaavilea koodivanthathaip pelisthar kea'lvippattapoathu, pelistharin athibathiga'l isravealukku viroathamaaga ethirththu vanthaarga'l; athai israveal puththirar keattu, pelistharinimiththam bayappattu,
saamuvealai noakki: nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththar engga'laip pelistharin kaikku neenggalaakki radchikkumpadikku, engga'lukkaaga avarai noakki oayaamal vea'ndikko'l'lum en'raarga'l.

appozhuthu saamuveal paalkudikki'ra oru aattukkuttiyaip pidiththu, athaik karththarukkuch sarvaangga thaganabaliyaagach seluththi, isravealukkaagak karththarai noakki vea'ndikko'ndaan; karththar avanukku ma'rumozhi aru'lichseythaar.

saamuveal sarvaangga thaganabaliyaich seluththugaiyil, pelisthar isravealinmeal yuththampa'n'na nerungginaarga'l; karththar mahaa periya idimuzhakkangga'laip pelistharmeal annaa'lilea muzhanggappa'n'ni, avarga'laik kalanggadiththathinaal, avarga'l isravealukku munbaagap pattu vizhunthaarga'l.
appozhuthu isravealar mispaavilirunthu pelistharaip pinthodarnthupoay, bethkaareem pa'l'laththaakkumattum avarga'lai mu'riya adiththaarga'l.
appozhuthu saamuveal oru kallai eduththu, mispaavukkum sea'nukkum naduvaaga ni'ruththi, immattum karththar engga'lukku uthaviseythaar en'ru solli, atha'rku ebeneasar en'ru pearittaan.
inthappiragaaram pelisthar appu'ram isravealin ellaiyilea varaathapadikkuth thaazhththappattaarga'l; saamuvealin naa'lellaam karththarudaiya kai pelistharukku viroathamaay irunthathu.

pelisthar israveal kaiyilirunthu pidiththiruntha ekroan thuvakkik kaathmattumu'l'la patta'nangga'lum isravealukkuth thirumbak kidaiththathu; avaiga'laiyum avaiga'lin ellaiga'laiyum isravealar pelisthar kaiyilea iraathapadikku, viduviththuk ko'ndaarga'l; isravealukkum emoariyarukkum samaathaanam u'ndaayirunthathu.
saamuveal uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam isravealai niyaayam visaariththaan.
avan varushaavarusham pu'rappattu, beththealaiyum kilgaalaiyum mispaavaiyum sut'rippoay, avvidangga'lilellaam isravealai niyaayam visaariththa pinbu,
avan raamaavukkuth thirumbivaruvaan, avanudaiya veedu anggea irunthathu; anggea isravealai niyaayam visaariththu, avvidaththil karththarukku oru balipeedaththaik kattinaan.
saamuveal muthirvayathaanapoathu, than kumaararai isravealinmeal niyaayaathibathiga'laaga vaiththaan.
avanudaiya mooththakumaaranukkup peyar yoaveal, i'laiyavanukkup peyar abiyaa; avarga'l beyersebaavilea niyaayaathibathiga'laayirunthaarga'l.
aanaalum avanudaiya kumaarar avan vazhiga'lil nadavaamal, poru'laasaikkuch saaynthu, parithaanam vaanggi, niyaayaththaip purattinaarga'l.
appozhuthu isravealin mooppar ellaarum koottangkoodi, raamaaviliruntha saamuvealinidaththil vanthu:

ithoa, neer muthirvayathu'l'lavaraaneer; ummudaiya kumaarar ummudaiya vazhiga'lil nadakki'rathillai; aagaiyaal sagala jaathiga'lukku'l'lum irukki'rapadi, engga'lai niyaayam visaarikki'ratha'rku, oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththavea'ndum en'raarga'l.

engga'lai niyaayam visaarikka oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththum en'ru avarga'l sonna vaarththai saamuvealukkuth thagaathathaayk kaa'nappattathu; aagaiyaal saamuveal karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu karththar saamuvealai noakki: janangga'l unnidaththil solvathellaavat'rilum avarga'l sollaik kea'l; avarga'l unnaith tha'l'lavillai, naan avarga'lai aa'laathapadikku, ennaiththaan tha'l'linaarga'l.

naan avarga'lai egipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina naa'lmuthal innaa'lmattum avarga'l ennaivittu, vea'rea theavarga'laich seaviththuvantha thangga'l ellaach seygaiga'linpadiyum seythathupoala, avarga'l unakkum seygi'raarga'l.
ippoathum avarga'l sollaik kea'l; aanaalum un abippiraayaththaik kaattumpadi avarga'lai aa'lum raajaavin kaariyam innathu en'ru avarga'lukkuth thidasaadchiyaayth theriyappaduththu en'raar.
appozhuthu saamuveal, oru raajaa vea'ndum en'ru thannidaththil keatta janangga'lukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththaiga'laiyellaam solli:
ungga'lai aa'lum raajaavin kaariyam ennaven'raal, than rathaththi'rkumun oadumpadi avan ungga'l kumaararai eduththu, than rathasaarathiga'laagavum than kuthiraiveeraraagavum vaiththukko'l'luvaan.

aayirampearukkum aimbathupearukkum thalaivaraagavum, than nilaththai uzhugi'ravarga'laagavum, than vi'laichchalai a'rukki'ravarga'laagavum, than yuththaaayuthangga'laiyum than rathangga'lin pa'nimuttuga'laiyum pa'n'nugi'ravarga'laagavum, avarga'lai vaiththukko'l'luvaan.
ungga'l kumaaraththiga'laip parima'lathailam seygi'ravarga'laagavum, samaiyal pa'n'nugi'ravarga'laagavum, appam sudugi'ravarga'laagavum vaiththukko'l'luvaan.
ungga'l vayalga'lilum, ungga'l thiraadchaththoattangga'lilum, ungga'l olivaththoappuga'lilum, nallavaiga'lai eduththukko'ndu, than oozhiyakkaararukkuk koduppaan.
ungga'l thaaniyaththilum ungga'l thiraadchappalanilum thasamapaagam vaanggi, than pirathaaniga'lukkum than seavagarga'lukkum koduppaan.
ungga'l vealaikkaararaiyum, ungga'l vealaikkaariga'laiyum, ungga'lil thi'ramaiyaana vaalibaraiyum, ungga'l kazhuthaiga'laiyum eduththu thannudaiya vealaikku vaiththukko'l'luvaan.
ungga'l aaduga'lilea paththil on'ru eduththukko'l'luvaan; neengga'l avanukku vealaiyaadka'laaveerga'l.
neengga'l therinthuko'nda ungga'l raajaavinimiththam annaa'lilea mu'raiyiduveerga'l; aanaalum karththar annaa'lilea ungga'lukkuch sevikodukkamaattaar en'raan.
janangga'l saamuvealin sollaik keadka manathillaamal: appadiyalla, engga'lukku oru raajaa irukkaththaan vea'ndum.
sagala jaathiga'laiyumpoala naangga'lum iruppoam; engga'l raajaa engga'lai niyaayam visaariththu, engga'lukku munbaagap pu'rappattu, engga'l yuththangga'lai nadaththavea'ndum en'raarga'l.
saamuveal janangga'lin vaarththaiga'laiyellaam keattu, avaiga'laik karththaridaththil theriyappaduththinaan.

karththar saamuvealai noakki: nee avarga'l sollaik keattu, avarga'lai aa'la oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththu en'raar; appozhuthu saamuveal israveal janangga'laip paarththu: avaravar thangga'l oorga'lukkup poagalaam en'raan.

benyameen koaththiraththaaril kees ennum pearu'l'la mahaa baraakkiramasaaliyaana oru manushan irunthaan; avan benyameen koaththiraththaanaagiya apiyaavin maganaana bekoaraaththi'rkup pi'rantha searoarin puththiranaagiya abeeyealin kumaaran.

avanukkuch savul ennum pearu'l'la savunthariyamaana vaalibanaagiya oru kumaaran irunthaan; israveal puththiraril avanaippaarkkilum savunthariyavaan illai; ellaa janangga'lum avan thoa'lukkuk keezhaayirukkaththakka uyaramu'l'lavanaayirunthaan.

savulin thagappanaagiya keesudaiya kazhuthaiga'l kaa'naama'rpoayit'ru; aagaiyaal kees than kumaaranaagiya savulai noakki: nee vealaikkaararil oruvanaik koottikko'ndu, kazhuthaiga'laith theada, pu'rappattuppoa en'raan.

appadiyea avan eppiraayeem malaiga'laiyum saleeshaa naattaiyum kadanthupoanaan; anggea avaiga'laik kaa'naamal saaleem naattaikkadanthaarga'l. anggeayum kaa'navillai; benyameen naattai uruvakkadanthum avaiga'laik kaa'navillai.

avarga'l soop ennum naatti'rku vanthapoathu, savul thannoadiruntha vealaikkaaranai noakki: en thagappan, kazhuthaiga'linmealu'l'la kavalaiyai vittu, namakkaagak kavalaippadaathapadikkuth thirumbippoavoam vaa en'raan.

atha'rku avan: ithoa, inthap patta'naththilea theavanudaiya manushan oruvar irukki'raar; avar periyavar; avar sollugi'rathellaam thappaamal nadakkum; anggea poavoam; oruvea'lai avar naam poagavea'ndiya nammudaiya vazhiyai namakkuth therivippaar en'raan.

appozhuthu savul than vealaikkaaranaip paarththu: naam poanaalum antha manushanukku ennaththaik ko'ndupoavoam; nammudaiya paiga'lil iruntha thinpa'ndangga'l selavazhinthupoayit'ru; theavanudaiya manushanaagiya avarukkuk ko'ndu poagaththakka kaa'nikkai nammidaththil on'rum illaiyea en'raan.

antha vealaikkaaran pinnum savulaip paarththu: ithoa, en kaiyil innum kaalseakkal ve'l'liyirukki'rathu; theavanudaiya manushan namakku nammudaiya vazhiyai a'rivikkumpadikku, athai avarukkuk koduppean en'raan.

mu'rkaalaththil isravealil yaathoruvar theavanidaththil visaarikkappoanaal, gnaanathirushdikkaaranidaththi'rkup poavoam vaarungga'l enbaarga'l; innaa'lilea theerkkatharisi ennappadugi'ravan mu'rkaalaththil gnaanathirushdikkaaran ennappaduvaan.
appozhuthu savul than vealaikkaaranai noakki: nallakaariyam sonnaay, poavoam vaa en'raan; appadiyea theavanudaiya manushan iruntha anthap patta'naththi'rkup poanaarga'l.
avarga'l patta'naththu meattin vazhiyaay ea'rugi'rapoathu, tha'n'neer edukkavantha pe'nga'laik ka'ndu: gnaanathirushdikkaaran inggea irukki'raaraa en'ru avarga'laik keattaarga'l.
atha'rku avarga'l: irukki'raar; ithoa, ungga'lukku ethirea irukki'raar; theeviramaayp poangga'l; in'raikku janangga'l meadaiyil baliyidugi'rapadiyinaal, in'raiyathinam patta'naththi'rku vanthaar.

neengga'l patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasiththavudanea, avar meadaiyinmeal poajanam pa'n'nappoagi'ratha'rku munnea avaraik kaa'nbeerga'l; avar varumattum janangga'l poajanam pa'n'namaattaarga'l; baliyittathai avar aaseervathippaar; pinbu azhaikkappattavarga'l poajanampa'n'nuvaarga'l; udanea poangga'l; innearaththilea avaraik ka'nduko'l'lalaam en'raarga'l.
avarga'l patta'naththi'rkup poay, patta'naththin naduvea searnthapoathu, ithoa, saamuveal meadaiyinmeal ea'rippoagi'ratha'rkaaga, avarga'lukku ethirea pu'rappattuvanthaan.
savul vara orunaa'lukku munnea karththar saamuvealin kaathukeadka:

naa'lai innearaththi'rkup benyameen naattaanaagiya oru manushanai unnidaththil anuppuvean; avanai en janamaagiya isravealinmeal athibathiyaaga abisheagampa'n'nakkadavaay; avan en janaththaip pelistharin kaikku neenggalaakki radchippaan; en janaththin mu'raiyiduthal ennidaththil vanthu ettinapadiyinaal, naan avarga'laik kadaadchiththean en'ru ve'lippaduththiyirunthaar.
saamuveal savulaik ka'ndapoathu, karththar avanidaththil: ithoa, naan unakkuch solliyiruntha manushan ivanea; ivanthaan en janaththai aa'luvaan en'raar.
savul naduvaasalilea saamuvealidaththil vanthu: gnaanathirushdikkaaran veedu enggea, sollum en'ru keattaan.

saamuveal savulukkup pirathiyuththaramaaga: gnaanathirushdikkaaran naanthaan; nee enakku munnea meadaiyinmeal ea'rippoa; neengga'l in'raikku ennoadea poajanampa'n'navea'ndum; naa'laikkaalamea naan un iruthayaththil u'l'lathu ellaavat'raiyum unakku a'riviththu, unnai anuppividuvean.

moon'runaa'laikku munnea kaa'naama'rpoana kazhuthaiga'laippat'rik kavalaippadavea'ndaam; avaiga'l agappattathu; ithallaamal sagala isravealin abeadchaiyum yaarai naadugi'rathu? unnaiyum un veettaar anaivaraiyum allavaa? en'raan.

appozhuthu savul pirathiyuththaramaaga: naan israveal koaththirangga'lilea si'rithaana benyameen koaththiraththaan allavaa? benyameen koaththiraththuk kudumbangga'lilellaam en kudumbam a'rpamaanathu allavaa? neer ippadippatta vaarththaiyai ennidaththil solvaanean en'raan.

saamuveal savulaiyum avan vealaikkaaranaiyum poajanasaalaikku'l azhaiththukko'ndupoay, avarga'lai azhaikkappattavarga'lukku'l'lea thalaimaiyaana idaththilea vaiththaan; azhaikkappattavarga'l ea'rakku'raiya muppathupearaayirunthaarga'l.
pinbu saamuveal samaiya'rkaaranaip paarththu: naan un kaiyilea oru panggaik koduththuvaiththeanea, athaik ko'nduvanthu vai en'raan.

appozhuthu samaiya'rkaaran, oru munnanthodaiyaiyum, athanoadirunthathaiyum eduththukko'nduvanthu, athai savulukkumun vaiththaan; appozhuthu saamuveal: ithoa, ithu unakken'ru vaikkappattathu, ithai unakku munbaaga vaiththuch saappidu; naan janangga'lai virunthukku azhaiththathumuthal, ithuvaraikkum ithu unakkaaga vaikkappattirunthathu en'raan; appadiyea savul an'raiyathinam saamuvealoadea saappittaan.
avarga'l meadaiyilirunthu patta'naththi'rku i'ranggivanthapinbu, avan mealveettilea savuloadea peasikko'ndirunthaan.

avarga'l athikaalamea kizhakku ve'lukki'ra nearaththil ezhunthirunthapoathu, saamuveal savulai mealveettinmeal azhaiththu: naan unnai anuppividumpadikku aayaththappadu en'raan; savul aayaththappattapoathu, avanum saamuvealum iruvarumaaga ve'liyea pu'rappattaarga'l.

avarga'l patta'naththin kadaisimattum i'ranggi vanthapoathu, saamuveal savulaip paarththu: vealaikkaaranai namakku munnea nadanthupoagach sol en'raan; appadiyea avan nadanthu poanaan; ippozhuthu naan theavanudaiya vaarththaiyai unakkuth therivikkumpadikku, nee sat'rea thariththunil en'raan.
appozhuthu saamuveal thailakkuppiyai eduththu, avan thalaiyinmeal vaarththu, avanai muththagnseythu: karththar unnaith thammudaiya suthantharaththinmeal thalaivanaaga abisheagam pa'n'ninaar allavaa?

nee in'raikku ennaivittup poagi'rapoathu, benyameen ellaiyaagiya selsaakil raakealin kalla'raiya'ndaiyil ira'ndu manusharaik kaa'nbaay; avarga'l unnaip paarththu: nee theadappoana kazhuthaiga'l agappattathu; ithoa, un thagappan kazhuthaiga'linmealiruntha kavalaiyai vittu, ungga'lukkaaga visaarappattu, en maganukkaaga ennaseyvean? engi'raan en'ru solluvaarga'l.

nee avvidaththai vittu appu'ram kadanthupoay, thaaboarilu'l'la samaboomiyil searumpoathu, theavanaip pa'niyumpadi beththealukkup poagi'ra moon'ru manushar anggea unnaik ka'ndu santhippaarga'l; oruvan moon'ru aattukkuttiga'laiyum, innoruvan moon'ru appangga'laiyum, vea'roruvan thiraadcharasamu'l'la oru thuruththiyaiyum ko'nduvanthu,
unnudaiya sugaseythiyai visaariththu, unakku ira'ndu appangga'laik koduppaarga'l; avaiga'lai nee avarga'l kaiyilea vaanggavea'ndum.

pinbu pelistharin thaa'naiyam irukki'ra theavanudaiya malaikkup poavaay; anggea nee patta'naththi'rku'l piraveasikkaiyil, meadaiyilirunthu i'ranggivarugi'ra theerkkatharisiga'lin koottaththi'rku ethirppaduvaay; avarga'lukku munbaagath thamburum mea'lamum naagasuramum surama'ndalamum poagum; avarga'l theerkkatharisanam solluvaarga'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya aavi unmeal i'rangguvaar; nee avarga'loadeakoodath theerkkatharisanam solli, vea'ru manushanaavaay.
intha adaiyaa'langga'l unakku nearidumpoathu, samayaththukku eat'rapadi nee sey; theavan unnoadea irukki'raar.

nee enakku munnea kilgaalukku i'ranggippoa; sarvaangga thaganabaliga'laiyum samaathaanabaliga'laiyum seluththumpadikku, naan unnidaththil varuvean; naan unnidaththil vanthu, nee seyya vea'ndiyathai unakku a'rivikkumattum, eazhunaa'l kaaththiru en'raan.
avan saamuvealai vittup poagumpadi thirumbinapoathu, theavan avanukku vea'rea iruthayaththaik koduththaar; antha adaiyaa'langga'l ellaam an'raiyathinamea nearittathu.

avarga'l antha malaikku vanthapoathu, ithoa, theerkkatharisiga'lin koottam avanukku ethiraaga vanthathu; appozhuthu theavanudaiya aavi avanmeal i'rangginathinaal, avanum avarga'lukku'l'lea theerkkatharisanam sonnaan.

atha'rku munnea avanai a'rinthavarga'l ellaarum avan theerkkatharisiga'loadirunthu, theerkkatharisanam sollugi'rathaik ka'ndapoathu: keesin kumaaranukku vanthathu enna? savulum theerkkatharisiga'lil oruvanoa? en'ru antha janangga'l oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndaarga'l.
atha'rku anggea irukki'ravarga'lil oruvan: ivarga'lukkuth thagappan yaar en'raan; aathalaal savulum theerkkatharisiga'lil oruvanoa? enbathu pazhamozhiyaayit'ru.
avan theerkkatharisanam solli mudinthapinbu, meadaiyinmeal vanthaan.

appozhuthu savuludaiya si'riya thagappan: neengga'l enggea poaneerga'l en'ru avanaiyum avan vealaikkaaranaiyum keattaan. atha'rku avan: naangga'l kazhuthaiga'laith theadappoay, avaiga'lai enggung kaa'naathapadiyinaal, saamuvealidaththukkup poanoam en'raan.
appozhuthu savulin si'riyathagappan: saamuveal ungga'lukkuch sonnathu enna? athaich sol en'raan.

savul than si'riyathagappanaip paarththu: kazhuthaiga'l agappattathu en'ru engga'lukkuth theermaanamaaych sonnaar en'raan; aanaalum raajyabaaraththaippat'rich saamuveal sonnathai avanukku a'rivikkavillai.
saamuveal janangga'lai mispaavilea karththaridaththil varavazhaiththu,

israveal puththirarai noakki: isravealin theavanaagiya karththar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal, naan isravealai egipthilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, ungga'lai egipthiyar kaikkum, ungga'lai i'rugappidiththa ellaa raajyaththaarin kaikkum neenggalaakkivittean.

neengga'loa ungga'ludaiya ellaath theengguga'lukkum nerukkangga'lukkum ungga'lai neenggalaakki radchiththa ungga'l theavanai innaa'lilea pu'rakka'niththu, oru raajaavai engga'lmeal ea'rpaduththum en'ru avaridaththil keattukko'ndeerga'l; ippozhuthu karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungga'l vamsangga'linpadiyeayum, aayirangga'laana ungga'l searvaiga'linpadiyeayum, vanthu nillungga'l en'raan.
saamuveal isravealin koaththirangga'laiyellaam searappa'n'ninapinbu benyameen koaththiraththinmeal seettu vizhunthathu.

avan benyameen koaththiraththai athinudaiya kudumbangga'linpadiyea searappa'n'ninapinbu, maaththiri kudumbaththinmealum, athilea keesin kumaaranaagiya savulinmealum, seettu vizhunthathu; avanaith theadinapoathu, avan agappadavillai.
avan ini inggea varuvaanaa en'ru avarga'l thirumbak karththaridaththil visaariththapoathu: ithoa, avan tha'lavaadangga'lirukki'ra idaththilea o'liththukko'ndirukki'raan en'ru karththar sonnaar.

appozhuthu avarga'l oadi, anggeayirunthu avanai azhaiththukko'nduvanthaarga'l; avan janangga'l naduvea vanthu nin'rapoathu, ellaa janangga'lum avan thoa'lukkuk keezhaayirukkaththakka uyaramu'l'lavanaayirunthaan.

appozhuthu saamuveal ellaa janangga'laiyum noakki: karththar therinthuko'ndavanaip paarungga'l, samastha janangga'lukku'l'lum avanukkuch samaanamaanavan illai en'raan; appozhuthu janangga'l ellaarum aarppariththu: raajaa vaazhga en'raarga'l.
saamuveal raajaanggaththin mu'raiyai janangga'lukkuth theriviththu, athai oru pusthagaththil ezhuthi, karththarudaiya sannithiyil vaiththu, janangga'laiyellaam avaravar veettukku anuppivittaan.
savulum kibiyaavilirukki'ra than veettukkup poanaan; iraa'nuvaththil theavan evarga'l manathai eavinaaroa, avarga'lum avanoadeakoodap poanaarga'l.
aanaalum bealiyaa'lin makka'l: ivanaa nammai radchikkappoagi'ravan en'ru solli, avanukkuk kaa'nikkai ko'nduvaraamal avanai asattaipa'n'ninaarga'l; avanoa kaathukea'laathavanpoala irunthaan.

akkaalaththil naagaas ennum ammoaniyan vanthu, keeleayaaththilirukki'ra yaabeasai mut'rikkaipoattaan; appozhuthu yaabeasin manushar ellaarum naagaasai noakki: engga'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'num; appozhuthu ummaich seavippoam en'raarga'l.

atha'rku ammoaniyanaagiya naagaas: naan ungga'l ovvoruvarudaiya valathu ka'n'naiyum pidunggi, ithinaalea israveal ellaavat'rinmealum ninthaivarappa'n'nuvathea naan ungga'loadea pa'n'num udanpadikkai en'raan.

atha'rku yaabeasin moopparga'l: naangga'l israveal naadenggum sthaanaabathiga'lai anuppumpadi, eazhunaa'l engga'lukkuth thava'naikodum, engga'lai radchippaar illaavittaal, appozhuthu ummidaththil varuvoam en'raarga'l.
antha sthaanaabathiga'l savulin ooraagiya kibiyaavilea vanthu, janangga'lin kaathukeadka anthach seythiga'laich sonnaarga'l; appozhuthu janangga'lellaarum saththamittu azhuthaarga'l.
ithoa, savul maaduga'lin pinnaalea vayalilirunthu vanthu, janangga'l azhugi'ra mugaantharam enna en'ru keattaan; yaabeasin manushar solliya seythiga'lai avanukkuth theriviththaarga'l.
savul inthach seythiga'laik keattavudanea, theavanudaiya aavi avanmeal i'rangginathinaal avan migavum koabam moo'ndavanaagi,

oari'naimaattaip pidiththu, thu'ndiththu, antha sthaanaabathiga'l kaiyilea koduththu, isravealin naaduga'lukkellaam anuppi: savulin pinnaaleayum, saamuvealin pinnaaleayum pu'rappadaathavan evanoa, avanudaiya maaduga'lukku ippadich seyyappadum en'ru solliyanuppinaan; appozhuthu karththaraal u'ndaana bayanggaram janaththinmeal vanthathinaal, orumanappattup pu'rappattu vanthaarga'l.
avarga'laip beaseakkilea ilakkampaarththaan; israveal puththiraril moon'ruladchampearum, yoothaa manusharil muppathinaayirampearum irunthaarga'l.

vantha sthaanaabathiga'lai avarga'l noakki: naa'laikku veyil ea'rugi'ratha'rku munnea ungga'lukku radchippuk kidaikkum en'ru keeleayaaththilirukki'ra yaabeasin manusharukkuch sollungga'l en'raarga'l; sthaanaabathiga'l vanthu yaabeasin manusharidaththil athai a'riviththaarga'l; atha'rku avarga'l santhoashappattaarga'l.
pinbu yaabeasin manushar: naa'laikku ungga'lidaththil varuvoam, appozhuthu ungga'l ishdappadiyellaam engga'lukkuch seyyungga'l en'raarga'l.

ma'runaa'lilea savul janangga'lai moon'ru padaiyaaga vaguththu, kizhakku ve'luththuvarum jaamaththil paa'layaththi'rku'l vanthu veyil ea'rumvaraikkum ammoaniyarai mu'riya adiththaan; thappinavarga'lil ira'ndupearaagilum searnthu oadippoagaathapadi ellaarum sitha'rippoanaarga'l.
appozhuthu janangga'l saamuvealai noakki: savulaa namakku raajaavaayirukkappoagi'ravan en'ru sonnavarga'l yaar? antha manusharai naangga'l kon'rupoadumpadikku oppukkodungga'l en'raarga'l.
atha'rkuch savul: in'raiyathinam oruvarum kollappadalaagaathu; in'ru karththar isravealukku iradchippai aru'linaar en'raan.
appozhuthu saamuveal janangga'lai noakki: naam kilgaalukkup poay, anggea raajyabaaraththai sthirappaduththuvoam vaarungga'l en'raan.

appadiyea janangga'l ellaarum kilgaalukkup poay, avvidaththilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil savulai raajaavaaga ea'rpaduththi, anggea karththarudaiya sannithiyil samaathaanabaliga'laich seluththi, anggea savulum israveal manushar yaavarum migavum santhoashangko'ndaadinaarga'l.
appozhuthu saamuveal isravealar anaivaraiyum noakki: ithoa, neengga'l enakkuch sonnapadiyellaam ungga'l so'rkeattu ungga'lukku oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththinean.

ippoathum ithoa, raajaavaanavar ungga'lukku munbaagach sagnchariththuvarugi'raar; naanoa kizhavanum naraiththavanumaanean; en kumaarar ungga'loadiruppaarga'l; naan en si'ruvayathumuthal innaa'lvaraikkum ungga'lukku munbaagach sagnchariththuvanthean.

ithoa, irukki'rean; karththarin sannithiyilum avar abisheagampa'n'ni vaiththavarukku munbaagavum ennaikku'riththuch saadchi sollungga'l; naan yaarudaiya eruthai eduththukko'ndean? yaarudaiya kazhuthaiyai eduththukko'ndean? yaarukku aniyaayagnseythean? yaarukku idukka'nseythean? yaar kaiyil parithaanam vaanggikko'ndu ka'nsaadaiyaayirunthean? sollungga'l; appadiyu'ndaanaal athai ungga'lukkuth thirumbak koduppean en'raan.
atha'rku avarga'l: neer engga'lukku aniyaayagn seyyavum illai; engga'lukku idukka'n seyyavum illai; oruvar kaiyilum on'rum vaanggavum illai en'raarga'l.

atha'rku avan: neengga'l en kaiyil on'rum ka'ndupidikkavillai enbatha'rkuk karththar ungga'lukku ethiraagach saadchiyaayirukki'raar; avar abisheagampa'n'ninavarum in'ru atha'rkuch saadchi en'raan; atha'rku avarga'l: avar saadchithaan en'raarga'l.
appu'ram saamuveal janangga'lai noakki: moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum ea'rpaduththinavarum, ungga'l pithaakka'lai egipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninavarum karththarea.

ippoathum karththar ungga'lukkum ungga'l pithaakka'lukkum seythuvantha ellaa neethiyaana kiriyaiga'laikku'riththum, naan karththarudaiya sannithiyil ungga'loadea niyaayam peasumpadikku neengga'l nillungga'l.

yaakkoabu egipthilea poayirukkumpoathu, ungga'l pithaakka'l karththarai noakki mu'raiyittaarga'l, appozhuthu karththar moaseayaiyum aaroanaiyum anuppinaar; avarga'l ungga'l pithaakka'lai egipthilirunthu azhaiththuvanthu, avarga'lai intha sthalaththilea kudiyirukkappa'n'ninaarga'l.

avarga'l thangga'l theavanaagiya karththarai ma'ranthupoagi'rapoathu, avar avarga'lai aathsoarin seanaabathiyaagiya siseraavin kaiyilum, pelistharin kaiyilum, moavaabiya raajaavin kaiyilum vit'ruppoattaar; ivarga'l avarga'lukku viroathamaaga yuththampa'n'ninaarga'l.

aagaiyaal avarga'l karththarai noakki mu'raiyittu: naangga'l karththarai vittup baagaalga'laiyum astharoaththaiyum seaviththathinaalea, paavagnseythoam; ippoathum engga'l saththurukka'lin kaikku engga'lai neenggalaakki radchiyum; ini ummaich seavippoam en'raarga'l.

appozhuthu karththar erubaagaalaiyum beathaanaiyum yepthaavaiyum saamuvealaiyum anuppi, neengga'l bayamillaamal kudiyirukkumpadikkuch sut'rilum iruntha ungga'l saththurukka'lin kaikkum ungga'lai neenggalaakki radchiththaar.

ammoan puththirarin raajaavaagiya naagaas ungga'lukku viroathamaay varugi'rathai neengga'l ka'ndapoathu, ungga'l theavanaagiya karththarea ungga'lukku raajaavaayirunthum, neengga'l ennai noakki: appadiyalla, oru raajaa engga'lmeal aa'lavea'ndum en'reerga'l.
ippoathum neengga'l vea'ndum en'ru virumbith therinthuko'nda raajaa, ithoa, irukki'raar; ithoa, karththar ungga'lukku oru raajaavai ea'rpaduththinaar.

neengga'l karththarudaiya vaakkukku viroathamaayk kalagampa'n'naamal karththarukkup bayanthu, avaraich seaviththu, avarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadinthaal, neengga'lum ungga'lai aa'lugi'ra raajaavum ungga'l theavanaagiya karththaraip pinpat'rugi'ravarga'laayiruppeerga'l.

neengga'l karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaamal, karththarudaiya vaakkukku viroathamaayk kalagampa'n'nineerga'laanaal, karththarudaiya kai ungga'l pithaakka'lukku viroathamaayirunthathu poala ungga'lukkum viroathamaayirukkum.
ippozhuthu karththar ungga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaagach seyyum periya kaariyaththai nin'ru paarungga'l.

in'ru koathumai a'ruppin naa'l allavaa? neengga'l ungga'lukku oru raajaavaik keattathinaal, karththarin paarvaikkuch seytha ungga'ludaiya pollaappup periyathen'ru neengga'l ka'ndu u'narumpadikku, naan karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu idimuzhakkangga'laiyum mazhaiyaiyum katta'laiyiduvaar en'ru solli,

saamuveal karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan; an'raiyathinamea karththar idimuzhakkangga'laiyum mazhaiyaiyum katta'laiyittaar; appozhuthu janangga'l ellaarum karththarukkum saamuvealukkum migavum bayanthu;

saamuvealaip paarththu: naangga'l saagaathapadikku ummudaiya theavanaagiya karththaridaththil ummudaiya adiyaarukkaaga vi'n'nappam seyyum; naangga'l seytha ellaap paavangga'loadum engga'lukku oru raajaa vea'ndum en'ru keatta inthap paavaththaiyum koottikko'ndoam en'ru janangga'l ellaarum sonnaarga'l.

appozhuthu saamuveal janangga'lai noakki: bayappadaatheayungga'l; neengga'l inthap pollaappaiyellaam seytheerga'l; aagilum karththarai vittup pinvaanggaamal karththarai ungga'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum seaviyungga'l.
vilagippoagaathirungga'l; mat'rappadi pirayoajanamat'rathum radchikkamaattaathathumaayirukki'ra vee'naanavaiga'laip pinpat'ruveerga'l; avaiga'l vee'naanavaiga'lea.
karththar ungga'laith thamakku janamaakkikko'l'lap piriyamaanapadiyinaal, karththar thammudaiya magaththuvamaana naamaththinimiththam thamathu janaththaik kaividamaattaar.

naanum ungga'lukkaaga vi'n'nappam seyyaathiruppeanaagil karththarukku viroathamaagap paavagnseygi'ravanaayiruppean; athu enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaga; nanmaiyum sevvaiyumaana vazhiyai naan ungga'lukkup poathippean.

neengga'l eppadiyum karththarukkup bayanthu, ungga'l muzhu iruthayaththoadum u'nmaiyaay avaraich seavikkakkadaveerga'l; avar ungga'lidaththil evva'lavu magimaiyaana kaariyangga'laich seythaar enbathaich sinthiththuppaarungga'l.
neengga'l innum pollaappaich seyyavea seyveerga'laanaal, neengga'lum ungga'l raajaavum naasamadaiveerga'l en'raan.
savul raajyabaarampa'n'ni, oru varushamaayit'ru; avan isravealai ira'ndaam varusham arasaa'ndapoathu,

isravealil moovaayirampearaith thanakkuth therinthuko'ndaan; avarga'lil ira'ndaayirampear savuloadeakooda mikmaasilum beththeal malaiyilum, aayirampear yoanaththaanoadeakoodap benyameen naattilu'l'la kibiyaavilum irunthaarga'l; mat'ra janangga'lai avaravar koodaarangga'lukku anuppivittaan.

yoanaththaan keabaavilea thaa'naiyam iruntha pelistharai mu'riya adiththaan; pelisthar athaik kea'lvippattaarga'l; aagaiyinaal ithai ebireyar keadkakkadavarga'l en'ru savul theasamenggum ekkaa'lam oothuviththaan.

thaa'naiyam iruntha pelistharaich savul mu'riya adiththaan en'rum, isravealar pelistharukku aruvaruppaanaarga'l en'rum, isravealellaam kea'lvippattapoathu, janangga'l savulukkup pinsellumpadi kilgaalukku varavazhaikkappattaarga'l.

pelisthar isravealoadu yuththampa'n'numpadi muppathinaayiram irathangga'loadum, aa'raayiram kuthiraiveeraroadum, kada'rkarai ma'nalaththanai janangga'loadum koodikko'nduvanthu, beththaavealukkuk kizhakkaana mikmaasilea paa'layami'rangginaarga'l.

appozhuthu isravealar thangga'lukku u'ndaana ikkattaik ka'ndapoathu, janangga'l thangga'lukku u'ndaana nerukkaththinaalea kebiga'lilum, mudkaaduga'lilum, kanmalaiga'lilum, thurukkangga'lilum, kugaiga'lilum o'liththukko'ndaarga'l.
ebireyaril silar yoarthaanaiyum kadanthu, kaath naatti'rkum keeleayaath theasaththi'rkum poanaarga'l; savuloa innum kilgaalil irunthaan; sagala janangga'lum bayanthuko'ndu avanukkup pinsen'raarga'l.
avan thanakkuch saamuveal ku'riththa kaalaththinpadi eazhunaa'lmattum kaaththirunthaan; saamuveal kilgaalukku varavillai, janangga'l avanai vittuch sitha'rippoanaarga'l.
appozhuthu savul: sarvaangga thaganabaliyaiyum samaathaanabaliga'laiyum ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungga'l en'ru solli, sarvaangga thaganabaliyaich seluththinaan.
avan sarvaangga thaganabaliyittu mudigi'rapoathu, ithoa, saamuveal vanthaan; savul avanaich santhiththu vanthanagnseyya avanukku ethirko'ndupoanaan.

neer seythathu enna en'ru saamuveal keattatha'rku, savul: janangga'l ennaivittuch sitha'rippoagi'rathaiyum, ku'riththa naadka'lin thittaththilea neer varaathathaiyum, pelisthar mikmaasilea koodivanthirukki'rathaiyum, naan ka'ndapadiyinaalea,

kilgaalil pelisthar enakku viroathamaay vanthuviduvaarga'l en'rum, naan innum karththarudaiya samugaththai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'navillai en'rum, e'n'nith thu'ninthu, sarvaangga thaganabaliyaich seluththinean en'raan.

saamuveal savulaip paarththu: buththiyeenamaaych seytheer; ummudaiya theavanaagiya karththar umakku vithiththa katta'laiyaik kaikko'l'laama'rpoaneer; mat'rappadi karththar isravealinmeal ummudaiya raajyabaaraththai en'raikkum sthirappaduththuvaar.

ippoathoa ummudaiya raajyabaaram nilaini'rkaathu; karththar thammudaiya iruthayaththi'rku eat'ra oru manushanaith thamakkuth theadi, avanaik karththar thammudaiya janangga'lmeal thalaivanaayirukkak katta'laiyittaar; karththar umakku vithiththa katta'laiyai neer kaikko'l'lavillaiyea en'ru sonnaan.

saamuveal ezhunthirunthu, kilgaalai vittu, benyameen naattilu'l'la kibiyaavukkup poanaan; savul thannoadeakooda irukki'ra janaththaith thogaipaarkki'rapoathu, ea'rakku'raiya a'runoo'rupear irunthaarga'l.
savulum avan kumaaranaagiya yoanaththaanum avarga'loadeakooda irukki'ra janangga'lum benyameen naattilu'l'la kibiyaavil irunthuvittaarga'l; pelistharoa mikmaasilea paa'layami'ranggiyirunthaarga'l.
ko'l'laikkaarar pelistharin paa'layaththilirunthu moon'ru padaiyaayp pu'rappattuvanthaarga'l; oru padai opraavazhiyaaych soovaal naatti'rku nearaagap poayit'ru.
vea'roru padai beththoroan vazhiyaayp poayit'ru; vea'rorupadai vanaantharaththil irukki'ra seboayeemin pa'l'laththaakkukku ethiraana ellaivazhiyaayp poayit'ru.
ebireyar pattayangga'laiyaagilum eettiga'laiyaagilum u'ndupa'n'naathapadikkup paarththukko'l'lavea'ndum en'ru pelisthar solliyirunthapadiyaal, israveal theasaththil enggum oru kollan agappadavillai.

isravealar yaavarum avaravar thangga'l kozhuvirumbuga'laiyum, thangga'l ma'nvettiga'laiyum, thangga'l koadariga'laiyum, thangga'l kadappaaraiga'laiyum theettik koormaiyaakkugi'ratha'rku, pelistharidaththukkup poagavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
kadappaaraiga'laiyum, ma'nvettiga'laiyum, mukkooru'l'la aayuthangga'laiyum, koadariga'laiyum, thaat'rukkoalga'laiyum koormaiyaakkugi'ratha'rku arangga'l maaththiram avarga'lidaththil irunthathu.
yuththanaa'l vanthapoathu, savulukkum avan kumaaranaagiya yoanaththaanukkumeayan'ri, savuloadum yoanaththaanoadum irukki'ra janangga'lil oruvar kaiyilum pattayamum eettiyum illaathirunthathu.
pelistharin paa'layam mikmaasilirunthu poagi'ra vazhimattum parambiyirunthathu.

orunaa'l savulin kumaaranaagiya yoanaththaan than aayuthathaariyaagiya vaalibanai noakki: namakku ethiraaga anthap pakkaththil irukki'ra pelistharin thaa'naiyaththi'rkup poavoam vaa en'ru sonnaan; athai avan than thagappanukku a'rivikkavillai.
savul kibiyaavin kadaisimunaiyaagiya mikroanilea oru maatha'lamaraththinkeezh irunthaan; avanoadeakooda iruntha janangga'l ea'rakku'raiya a'runoo'rupearaayirunthaarga'l.

seeloavilea karththarudaiya aasaariyanaayiruntha ealiyin kumaaranaagiya pinegaasukkup pi'rantha ikkaboaththin sagoatharanum agithoobin kumaaranumaagiya agiyaa enbavan eaboaththaith thariththavanaayirunthaan; yoanaththaan poanathai janangga'l a'riyaathirunthaarga'l.

yoanaththaan pelistharin thaa'naiyaththi'rkup poagappaarththa vazhiga'lin naduvea, inthappakkam oru sengguththaana paa'raiyum, anthappakkam oru sengguththaana paa'raiyum irunthathu; on'rukkup boaseas en'ru pear, mat'ron'rukkuch seanea en'ru pear.
anthap paa'raiga'lil on'ru vadakkea mikmaasukku ethiraagavum, mat'ron'ru the'rkea kibiyaavukku ethiraagavum irunthathu.

yoanaththaan than aayuthathaariyaagiya vaalibanai noakki: viruththaseathanam illaathavarga'ludaiya anthath thaa'naiyaththi'rkup poavoam vaa; oruvea'lai karththar namakkaaga oru kaariyam seyvaar; aneagampearaik ko'ndaagilum, kognchampearaik ko'ndaagilum, radchikkak karththarukkuth thadaiyillai en'raan.
appozhuthu avan aayuthathaari avanaip paarththu: ummudaiya iruthayaththil irukki'rapadiyellaam seyyum; appadiyea poam; ithoa, ummudaiya manathukku eat'rapadi naanum ummoadeakooda varugi'rean en'raan.
atha'rku yoanaththaan: ithoa, naam kadanthu, antha manusharidaththi'rkup poagi'ravarga'lpoala avarga'lukku nammaik kaa'nbippoam.
naangga'l ungga'lidaththukku varumattum nillungga'l en'ru nammoadea solvaarga'laanaal, naam avarga'lidaththukku ea'rippoagaamal, nammudaiya nilaiyilea ni'rpoam.
engga'lidaththukku ea'rivaarungga'l en'ru solvaarga'laanaal, ea'rippoavoam; karththar avarga'lai nammudaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; ithu namakku adaiyaa'lam en'raan.

appadiyea avarga'l iruvarum pelistharin thaa'naiyaththi'rmun thangga'laik kaa'nbiththaarga'l; appozhuthu pelisthar: ithoa, ebireyar o'liththukko'ndiruntha va'laiga'laivittup pu'rappadugi'raarga'l en'ru solli,

thaa'naiyam irukki'ra manushar yoanaththaanaiyum avan aayuthathaariyaiyum paarththu: engga'lidaththukku ea'rivaarungga'l, ungga'lukkup buththi ka'rpippoam en'raarga'l; appozhuthu yoanaththaan than aayuthathaariyai noakki: en pinnaalea ea'rivaa; karththar avarga'lai isravealin kaiyil oppukkoduththaar en'ru solli,

yoanaththaan than kaiga'laalum than kaalga'laalum thavazhnthu ea'rinaan; avan aayuthathaari avan pinnaalea ea'rinaan; appozhuthu avarga'l yoanaththaanukku munbaaga madinthu vizhunthaarga'l; avan aayuthathaariyum avan pinnaalea vettikko'ndea poanaan.
yoanaththaanum avan aayuthathaariyum adiththa antha munthina adiyilea ea'rakku'raiya irubathupear araiyear nilamaana visaalaththilea vizhunthaarga'l.

appozhuthu paa'layaththilum ve'liyilum, sagala janangga'lilum, bayanggaram u'ndaagi, thaa'naiyam irunthavarga'lum ko'l'laiyidappoana tha'ndilu'l'lavarga'lungkoodath thigil adainthaarga'l; boomiyum athirnthathu; athu theavanaal u'ndaana bayanggaramaayirunthathu.
benyameen naattilu'l'la kibiyaavilea savulukku iruntha jaamakkaarar paarththu: ithoa, antha earaa'lamaana koottam kalainthu, oruvarmeal oruvar vizhugi'rathaik ka'ndaarga'l.

appozhuthu savul thannoadeakooda irukki'ra janangga'lai noakki: nammidaththilirunthu poanavarga'l yaar en'ru ilakkampaarungga'l en'raan; avarga'l ilakkam paarkki'rapoathu, ithoa, yoanaththaanum avan aayuthathaariyum anggea illai en'ru ka'ndaarga'l.
appozhuthu savul ageeyaavai noakki: theavanudaiya pettiyaik ko'nduvaa en'raan; theavanudaiya petti annaadka'lil israveal puththiraridaththil irunthathu.
ippadich savul aasaariyanoadea peasugaiyil, pelistharin paa'layaththil u'ndaana kalagam varavara athigariththathu; appozhuthu savul aasaariyanaip paarththu: irukkattum en'raan.
savulum avanoadiruntha janangga'lum koottangkoodip poarkka'laththi'rkup poanaarga'l; oruvar pattayam oruvarukku viroathamaayirunthapadiyaal mahaa ama'liyu'ndaayit'ru.
itha'rkumun pelistharudan koodi avarga'loadeakoodap paa'layaththilea thirinthu vantha ebireyarum, savuloadum yoanaththaanoadum irukki'ra isravealaroadea koodikko'ndaarga'l.
eppiraayeem malaiga'lil o'liththukko'ndiruntha sagala isravealarum pelisthar mu'rinthoadugi'rathaik kea'lvippattapoathu, yuththaththilea avarga'lai nerunggith thodarnthaarga'l.
ippadik karththar an'raiyathinam isravealai radchiththaar; antha yuththam beththaaveanmattum nadanthathu.

isravealar an'raiyathinam miguntha varuththam adainthaarga'l: naan en saththurukka'l kaiyilea pazhivaanggavea'ndum, saayanggaalamattum po'rukkaamal evan poajanam seygi'raanoa, avan sabikkappattavan en'ru savul janangga'lukku aa'naiyittuch solliyirunthapadiyaal, janangga'lil oruvarum evva'laveanum poajanampa'n'naathirunthaarga'l.
theasaththu janangga'l ellaarum oru kaattilea vanthaarga'l; anggea ve'liyilea theankoodu kattiyirunthathu.

janangga'l kaattilea vanthapoathu, ithoa, thean ozhugikko'ndirunthathu; aanaalum oruvanum athaith than kaiyinaalea thottuth than vaayil vaikkavillai; janangga'l antha aa'naiyinimiththam bayappattaarga'l.

yoanaththaan than thagappan janangga'lukku aa'naiyittathaik kea'lvippadavillai; avan than kaiyiliruntha koalai neetti, athin nuniyinaalea theankoottaik kuththi, athai eduththuth than vaayilea poattukko'ndaan; athinaal avan ka'nga'l the'linthathu.

appozhuthu janangga'lil oruvan: in'raikku poajanam saappidugi'ravan sabikkappattavan en'ru ummudaiya thagappanaar janangga'lukku u'ruthiyaay aa'naiyittirukki'raar; aagaiyinaal janangga'l vidaayththirukki'raarga'l en'raan.
appozhuthu yoanaththaan: en thagappan theasaththin janangga'laik kalakkappaduththinaar; naan inthath theanilea kogncham rusipaarththathinaalea, en ka'nga'l the'linthathaip paarungga'l.

in'raiyathinam janangga'l thangga'lukku agappatta thangga'l saththurukka'lin ko'l'laiyilea eathaagilum pusiththirunthaal, eththanai nalamaayirukkum; pelistharukku'l u'ndaana sanggaaram migavum athigamaayirukkumea en'raan.
avarga'l an'raiyathinam mikmaasilirunthu aayaloanmattum pelistharai mu'riya adiththapoathu, janangga'l migavum vidaayththirunthaarga'l.
appozhuthu janangga'l ko'l'laiyinmeal paaynthu, aaduga'laiyum maaduga'laiyum kan'rukkuttiga'laiyum pidiththu, tharaiyilea poattu adiththu, iraththaththoadum pusiththaarga'l.

appozhuthu: ithoa, iraththaththoadirukki'rathaip pusikki'rathinaal janangga'l karththarukku ealaatha paavam seygi'raarga'l en'ru savulukku a'riviththaarga'l; avan: neengga'l thuroagampa'n'nineerga'l; ippoathea oru periya kallai ennidaththil uruttikko'nduvaarungga'l.

neengga'l janaththi'rku'l'lea poay, iraththaththoadirukki'rathaich saappidugi'rathinaalea, karththarukku ealaatha paavam seyyaathapadikku, avaravar thangga'l maattaiyum avaravar thangga'l aattaiyum ennidaththil ko'nduvanthu, inggea adiththu, pinbu saappidavea'ndum en'ru avarga'lukkuch sollungga'l en'ru katta'laiyittaan; aagaiyaal janangga'l ellaarum avaravar thangga'l maaduga'lai an'ru iraaththiri thaangga'lea ko'nduvanthu, anggea adiththaarga'l.
pinbu savul karththarukku oru balipeedaththaik kattinaan; athu avan karththarukkuk kattina muthalaavathu balipeedam.

atha'rkuppinbu savul: naam intha iraaththiriyilea pelistharaith thodarnthupoay, vidiya'rkaala ve'lichchamaagumattum avarga'laik ko'l'laiyittu, avarga'lil oruvaraiyum meethiyaaga vaikkaathiruppoamaaga en'raan. atha'rku avarga'l: ummudaiya ka'nga'lukku nalamaanapadiyellaam seyyum en'raarga'l. aasaariyanoa: naam inggea theavasannithiyil searakkadavoam en'raan.
appadiyea: pelistharaith thodarnthupoagalaamaa? avarga'lai isravealin kaiyil oppukkoduppeeraa? en'ru savul theavanidaththil visaariththaan; avar antha naa'lilea avanukku ma'ruuththaravu aru'lavillai.
appozhuthu savul: janaththin thalaivarga'lea, neengga'l ellaarum inggea searnthuvanthu, in'ru inthap paavam ethinaalea u'ndaayit'ru en'ru paarththa'riyungga'l.

athu en kumaaranaagiya yoanaththaanidaththil kaa'nappattaalum, avan saagavea saagavea'ndum en'ru isravealai radchikki'ra karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean en'raan; sagala janangga'lukku'l'lum oruvanum avanukkup pirathiyuththaram sollavillai.

atha'rkuppin avan isravealar ellaaraiyum noakki: neengga'l anthappakkaththilea irungga'l; naanum en kumaaranaagiya yoanaththaanum inthappakkaththil iruppoam en'raan; janangga'l savulaip paarththu: ummudaiya ka'nga'lukku nalamaanapadi seyyum en'raarga'l.

appozhuthu savul isravealin theavanaagiya karththarai noakki: nithaanamaayk katta'laiyittu yathaarththaththai vi'langgappa'n'num en'raan; appozhuthu yoanaththaanmealum savulinmealum seettu vizhunthathu, janangga'loa thappinaarga'l.
enakkum en kumaaranaagiya yoanaththaanukkum seettuppoadungga'l en'ru savul sonnapoathu, yoanaththaanmeal seettu vizhunthathu.

appozhuthu savul yoanaththaanaip paarththu: nee seythathu enna? enakkuch sol en'ru keattaan. atha'rku yoanaththaan: en kaiyil irukki'ra koalin nuniyinaalea kogncham thean eduththu rusipaarththean; atha'rkaaga naan saagavea'ndum en'raan.
appozhuthu savul: yoanaththaanea, nee saagaththaanvea'ndum; illaavittaal theavan enakku atha'rkuch sariyaagavum atha'rku athigamaagavum seyyakkadavar en'raan.

janangga'loa savulai noakki: isravealilea inthap periya iradchippaich seytha yoanaththaan kolaiseyyappadalaamaa? athu koodaathu; avan thalaiyil irukki'ra oru mayirum tharaiyilea vizhappoagi'rathillai en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyittuch sollugi'roam; theavan thu'nai ni'rka avan in'ru kaariyaththai nadappiththaan en'raarga'l; appadiyea yoanaththaan saagaathapadikku, janangga'l avanaith thappuviththaarga'l.
savul pelistharaith thodaraamal thirumbivittaan; pelistharum thangga'l sthalaththi'rkup poayvittaarga'l.

ippadich savul isravealai aa'lugi'ra raajyabaaraththaip pet'rukko'ndu, sut'rilum irukki'ra thannudaiya ellaach saththurukka'lumaagiya moavaabiyarukkum, ammoan puththirarukkum, eathoamiyarukkum, soabaavin raajaakka'lukkum, pelistharukkum viroathamaaga yuththampa'n'ni, evarga'lmeal padaiyeduththaanoa, avarga'laiyellaam adakkinaan.
avan balaththu, amaleakkiyarai mu'riya adiththu, isravealaraik ko'l'laiyidugi'ra yaavar kaikkum avarga'lai neenggalaakki iradchiththaan.
savulukku iruntha kumaarar: yoanaththaan, isvi, malkisoovaa enbavarga'l; avanudaiya ira'ndu kumaaraththiga'lil, mooththava'l pear mearab, i'laiyava'l pear meekaa'l.
savuludaiya manaiviyin pear aginoavaam, ava'l agimaasin kumaaraththi; avanudaiya seanaabathiyin pear abnear, avan savuludaiya si'riyathagappanaagiya nearin kumaaran.
kees savulin thagappan; abnearin thagappanaagiya near aabiyealin kumaaran.

savul iruntha naa'lellaam pelistharinmeal kadinamaana yuththam nadanthathu; savul oru baraakkiramasaaliyaiyaagilum oru balasaaliyaiyaagilum kaa'numpoathu, avarga'l ellaaraiyum thannidamaagach searththukko'l'luvaan.

pinbu saamuveal savulai noakki: isravealaraagiya thammudaiya janangga'lmeal ummai raajaavaaga abisheagam pa'n'nugi'ratha'rkuk karththar ennai anuppinaarea; ippoathum karththarudaiya vaarththaiga'lin saththaththaik kea'lum:
seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal, isravealar egipthilirunthu vanthapoathu, amaleakku avarga'lukku vazhima'riththa seygaiyai manathilea vaiththirukki'rean.

ippoathum nee poay, amaleakkai madanggadiththu, avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum sanggariththu, avanmeal irakkam vaikkaamal, purusharaiyum, sthireega'laiyum, pi'l'laiga'laiyum, kuzhanthaiga'laiyum, maaduga'laiyum, aaduga'laiyum, ottagangga'laiyum, kazhuthaiga'laiyum kon'rupoadakkadavaay engi'raar en'ru sonnaan.
appozhuthu savul: ithai janangga'lukku a'riyappaduththi, thelaayimilea avarga'laith thogaipaarththaan; avarga'l ira'ndu ladcham kaalaadka'lum, yoothaa janangga'l pathinaayirampearumaayirunthaarga'l.
savul amaleakkudaiya patta'namattum vanthu, pa'l'laththaakkilea oru pathividaiyai vaiththaan.

savul keaniyarai noakki: naan amaleakkiyaroadeakooda ungga'laiyum vaarikko'l'laathapadikku, neengga'l avarga'l naduvilirunthu pu'rappattu vilagippoangga'l; israveal egipthilirunthu vanthapoathu, neengga'l avarga'l ellaarukkum thayavuseytheerga'l en'raan; appadiyea keaniyar amaleakkiyarin naduvilirunthu vilagippoanaarga'l.
appozhuthu savul: aavilaa thuvakki egipthi'rku ethireayirukki'ra soorukkup poagum ellaimattum iruntha amaleakkiyarai madanggadiththu,
amaleakkiyarin raajaavaagiya aagaakai uyiroadea pidiththaan; janangga'l yaavaraiyum pattayak karukkinaalea sanggaarampa'n'ninaan.

savulum janangga'lum aagaakaiyum, aadumaaduga'lil muthaltharamaanavaiga'laiyum, ira'ndaantharamaanavaiga'laiyum, aattukkuttiga'laiyum, nalamaana ellaavat'raiyum, azhiththuppoada manathillaamal thappavaiththu, a'rpamaanavaiga'lum uthavaathavaiga'lumaana sagala vasthukka'laiyum mut'rilum azhiththuppoattaarga'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai saamuvealukku u'ndaagi, avar sonnathu:

naan savulai raajaavaakkinathu enakku manasthaabamaayirukki'rathu; avan ennaivittuth thirumbi, en vaarththaiga'lai ni'raiveat'raama'rpoanaan en'raar; appozhuthu saamuveal manam nonthu, iraamuzhuthum karththarai noakkik kooppittaan.

ma'runaa'l athikaalamea saamuveal savulaich santhikkappoanaan; appozhuthu savul karmealukku vanthu, thanakku oru jeyasthambam naatti, pinbu pala idangga'lil sen'ru kilgaalukkup poanaan en'ru, saamuvealukku a'rivikkappattathu.
saamuveal savulinidaththil poanaan; savul avanai noakki: neer karththaraal aaseervathikkappattavar; karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai ni'raiveat'rinean en'raan.
atha'rkuch saamuveal: appadiyaanaal en kaathuga'lil vizhugi'ra aaduga'lin saththamum, enakkuk keadki'ra maaduga'lin saththamum enna en'raan.

atha'rkuch savul: amaleakkiyaridaththilirunthu avaiga'laik ko'nduvanthaarga'l; janangga'l aadumaaduga'lil nalamaanavaiga'lai ummudaiya theavanaagiya karththarukkup baliyidumpadikkuth thappavaiththaarga'l; mat'ravaiga'lai mut'rilum azhiththuppoattoam en'raan.
appozhuthu saamuveal: anthap peachchai vidum, karththar intha iraaththiriyilea enakkuch sonnathai umakku a'rivikki'rean en'ru savuloadea sonnaan. avan: sollum en'raan.

appozhuthu saamuveal: neer ummudaiya paarvaikkuch si'riyavaraayirunthapoathu allavoa israveal koaththirangga'lukkuth thalaivaraaneer; karththar ummai isravealinmeal raajaavaaga abisheagam pa'n'nuviththaarea.

ippoathum karththar: nee poay amaleakkiyaraagiya anthap paaviga'laich sanggariththu, avarga'lai nirmoolamaakkith theerumattum, avarga'loadu yuththampa'n'nu en'ru solli, ummai antha vazhiyaay anuppinaar.
ippadiyirukka, neer karththarudaiya sollaikkea'laamal, ko'l'laiyinmeal pa'ranthu, karththarudaiya paarvaikkup pollaappaanathaich seythathu enna en'raan.
savul saamuvealai noakki: naan karththarudaiya sollaik keattu, karththar ennai anuppina vazhiyaayp poay, amaleakkin raajaavaagiya aagaakaik ko'nduvanthu, amaleakkiyaraich sanggaaram pa'n'ninean.

janangga'loa ummudaiya theavanaagiya karththarukkuk kilgaalilea baliyidugi'ratha'rkaaga, ko'l'laiyilea saabaththeedaagum aadumaaduga'lilea pirathaanamaanavaiga'laip pidiththukko'ndu vanthaarga'l en'raan.

atha'rkuch saamuveal: karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuk keezhppadigi'rathaippaarkkilum, sarvaangga thaganangga'lum baliga'lum karththarukkup piriyamaayirukkumoa? baliyaippaarkkilum keezhppadithalum, aattukkadaakka'lin ni'naththaippaarkkilum sevikoduththalum uththamam.

ira'ndagampa'n'nuthal pillisooniya paavaththi'rkum, murattaattampa'n'nuthal avabakthikkum vikkiragaaraathanaikkum sariyaay irukki'rathu; neer karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pu'rakka'niththapadiyinaalea, avar ummai raajaavaayiraathapadikkup pu'rakka'niththuth tha'l'linaar en'raan.
appozhuthu savul saamuvealai noakki: naan karththarudaiya katta'laiyaiyum ummudaiya vaarththaiga'laiyum mee'rinathinaalea paavagnseythean; naan janangga'lukkup bayanthu, avarga'l sollaik keattean.
ippoathum neer en paavaththai manniththu, naan karththaraip pa'ninthuko'l'lumpadikku, ennoadeakoodath thirumbivaarum en'raan.

saamuveal savulaip paarththu: naan ummoadeakoodath thirumbivaruvathillai; karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pu'rakka'niththeer; neer isravealinmeal raajaavaayiraathapadikku, karththar ummaiyum pu'rakka'niththuth tha'l'linaar en'raan.
poagumpadi saamuveal thirumbugi'rapoathu, savul, avan saalvaiyin thonggalaip pidiththukko'ndaan, athu kizhinthupoayit'ru.
appozhuthu saamuveal avanai noakki: karththar in'ru ummidaththiliruntha isravealin raajyaththaik kizhiththuppoattu; ummaippaarkkilum uththamanaayirukki'ra ummudaiya thoazhanukku athaik koduththaar.
isravealin jeyabalamaanavar poysollugi'rathum illai; thaam sonnathaippat'ri manasthaabappadugi'rathum illai; manammaa'ra avar manushan alla en'raan.

atha'rku avan: naan paavagnseythean; ippoathu en janaththin moopparukku munbaagavum, isravealukku munbaagavum neer ennaik kanampa'n'ni, naan ummudaiya theavanaagiya karththaraip pa'ninthuko'l'lumpadikku, ennoadeakoodath thirumbivaarum en'raan.
appozhuthu saamuveal thirumbich savulukkup pinsen'raan; savul karththaraip pa'ninthuko'ndaan.
pinbu saamuveal: amaleakkin raajaavaagiya aagaakai ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungga'l en'raan; aagaak santhoashamaay avanidaththil vanthu, mara'naththin kasappu at'ruppoanathu nichchayam en'raan.

saamuveal: un pattayam sthireega'laip pi'l'laiyat'ravarga'laakkinathupoala, sthireega'lukku'l'lea un thaayum pi'l'laiyat'rava'laavaa'l en'ru solli; saamuveal kilgaalilea karththarukku munbaaga aagaakaith thu'ndiththuppoattaan.
pinbu saamuveal raamaavukkup poanaan; savuloa than ooraagiya kibiyaavilirukki'ra than veettukkup poayvittaan.

savul mara'namadaiyum naa'lmattum saamuveal appu'ram avanaik ka'ndu peasavillai; isravealinmeal savulai raajaavaakkinatha'rkaagak karththar manasthaabappattathinimiththam, saamuveal savulukkaagath thukkiththukko'ndirunthaan.

karththar saamuvealai noakki: isravealinmeal raajaavaayiraathapadikku, naan pu'rakka'niththuth tha'l'lina savulukkaaga nee enthamattum thukkiththukko'ndiruppaay; nee un kombai thailaththaal nirappikko'nduvaa; bethleheamiyanaagiya eesaayinidaththukku unnai anuppuvean; avan kumaararil oruvanai naan raajaavaagath therinthuko'ndean en'raar.

atha'rkuch saamuveal: naan eppadip poavean; savul ithaik kea'lvippattaal, ennaik kon'rupoaduvaanea en'raan; appozhuthu karththar: nee oru kaa'laiyaik kaiyoadea ko'ndupoay, karththarukkup baliyidavanthean en'ru solli,
eesaayaip balivirunthukku azhaippaayaaga; appozhuthu nee seyyavea'ndiyathai naan unakku a'rivippean; naan unakkuch sollugi'ravanai enakkaaga abisheagampa'n'nuvaayaaga en'raar.
karththar sonnapadiyea saamuveal seythu, bethleheamukkup poanaan; appozhuthu avvoorin mooppar thaththa'lippoadea avanukku ethirko'nduvanthu, neer varugi'rathu samaathaanamaa en'raarga'l.

atha'rku avan: samaathaananthaan; karththarukkup baliyidavanthean; neengga'l ungga'laip parisuththampa'n'nikko'ndu, ennudaneakoodap balivirunthukku vaarungga'l en'raan; mealum eesaayaiyum avan kumaararaiyum parisuththampa'n'ni, avarga'laip balivirunthukku azhaiththaan.
avarga'l vanthapoathu, avan eliyaabaip paarththavudanea: karththaraal abisheagampa'n'nappadupavan ivanthaanaakkum en'raan.

karththar saamuvealai noakki: nee ivanudaiya mugaththaiyum, ivanudaiya sareerava'larchchiyaiyum paarkkavea'ndaam; naan ivanaip pu'rakka'niththean; manushan paarkki'rapadi naan paarean; manushan mugaththaip paarppaan; karththaroa iruthayaththaip paarkki'raar en'raar.
appozhuthu eesaay abinathaabai azhaiththu, avanaich saamuvealukku munbaagak kadanthupoagappa'n'ninaan; avan: ivanaiyum karththar therinthuko'l'lavillai en'raan.
eesaay sammaavaiyum kadanthupoagappa'n'ninaan; avan: ivanaiyum karththar therinthuko'l'lavillai en'raan.
ippadi eesaay than kumaararil eazhupearai saamuvealukku munbaagak kadanthu poagappa'n'ninaan; pinbu saamuveal eesaayaip paarththu: karththar ivarga'lil oruvanaiyum therinthuko'l'lavillai en'ru solli;

un pi'l'laiga'l ivva'lavuthaanaa en'ru eesaayaik keattaan. atha'rku avan: innum ellaarukkum i'laiyavan oruvan irukki'raan; avan aaduga'lai meayththukko'ndirukki'raan en'raan; appozhuthu saamuveal eesaayai noakki: aa'l anuppi avanai azhaippi; avan inggea varumattum naan panthiyirukkamaattean en'raan.
aa'l anuppi avanai azhaippiththaan; avan sivanthameaniyum, azhagiya ka'nga'lum, nalla roobamumu'l'lavanaayirunthaan; appozhuthu karththar: ivanthaan, nee ezhunthu ivanai abisheagampa'n'nu en'raar.

appozhuthu saamuveal: thailakkombai eduththu, avanai avan sagoatharar naduvilea abisheagampa'n'ninaan; annaa'lmutha'rko'ndu, karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar thaaveethinmeal vanthu i'ranggiyirunthaar; saamuveal ezhunthu raamaavukkup poayvittaan.
karththarudaiya aavi savulai vittu neengginaar; karththaraal varavidappatta oru pollaatha aavi avanaik kalanggappa'n'nikko'ndirunthathu.
appozhuthu savulin oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: ithoa, theavanaal vidappatta oru pollaatha aavi ummaik kalanggappa'n'nugi'rathea.

surama'ndalam vaasikki'rathil thea'rina oruvanaith theadumpadikku, engga'l aa'ndavanaagiya neer umakku munbaaga ni'rki'ra ummudaiya adiyaarukkuk katta'laiyidum; appozhuthu theavanaal vidappatta pollaatha aavi ummeal i'ranggugaiyil, avan than kaiyinaal athai vaasiththaal umakkuch savukkiyamu'ndaagum en'raarga'l.
savul than oozhiyakkaararaip paarththu: nan'raay vaasikkaththakka oruvanaith theadi, ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungga'l en'raan.

appozhuthu antha vealaikkaararil oruvan pirathiyuththaramaaga: ithoa, bethleheamiyanaagiya eesaayin kumaaran oruvanaik ka'ndirukki'rean; avan vaasippathil thea'rinavan, avan baraakkiramasaali, yuththaveeran, kaariyasamarththan, savunthariyamu'l'lavan; karththar avanoadeakooda irukki'raar en'raan.
appozhuthu savul: eesaayinidaththil aadka'lai anuppi, aattumanthaiyil irukki'ra un kumaaranaagiya thaaveethai ennidaththil anuppu en'ru sollachsonnaan.
appozhuthu eesaay: appaththaiyum, oru thuruththi thiraadcharasaththaiyum, oru ve'l'laattukkuttiyaiyum kazhuthaiyinmeal eat'ri, than kumaaranaagiya thaaveethin vasamaay savulukku anuppinaan.
appadiyea thaaveethu savulidaththil vanthu, avanukku munbaaga nin'raan; avan ivanai migavum sineagiththaan; avanukku ivan aayuthathaariyaanaan.
savul eesaayinidaththil aa'l anuppi, thaaveethu enakku munbaaga ni'rkattum; en ka'nga'lil avanukkuth thayavukidaiththathu en'ru sollachsonnaan.

appadiyea theavanaal vidappatta aavi savulaip pidikkumpoathu, thaaveethu surama'ndalaththai eduththu, than kaiyinaal vaasippaan; athinaalea pollaatha aavi avanaivittu neengga, savul aa'ruthaladainthu, sosthamaavaan.

pelisthar yuththampa'n'nugi'ratha'rkuth thangga'l seanaiga'laich searththu, yoothaavilu'l'la soakkoavilea orumiththuk koodi, soakkoavukkum asekkaavukkum naduvea irukki'ra epeasthammeemilea paa'layami'rangginaarga'l.
savulum israveal manusharum orumiththuk koodi, ealaa pa'l'laththaakkilea paa'layami'ranggi, pelistharukku ethiraaga yuththaththi'rku a'nivaguththu nin'raarga'l.
pelisthar anthappakkaththil oru malaiyinmealum, isravealar inthappakkaththil oru malaiyinmealum nin'raarga'l; avarga'lukku naduvea pa'l'laththaakku irunthathu.
appozhuthu kaath ooraanaagiya koaliyaath ennum pearu'l'la oru veeran pelistharin paa'layaththilirunthu pu'rappattuvanthu naduvea ni'rpaan; avan uyaram aa'rumuzhamum oru jaa'numaam.
avan than thalaiyinmeal ve'ngalach seeraavaip poattu, oru poarkkavasam thariththukko'ndiruppaan; anthak kavasaththin ni'rai aiyaayiram seakkalaana ve'ngalamaayirukkum.
avan than kaalga'lilea ve'ngalak kavasaththaiyum than thoa'lga'linmeal ve'ngalak keadagaththaiyum thariththiruppaan.
avanudaiya eettiththaanggu nesavukkaararin padaimaraththin kanathiyum avan eettiyin alagu a'runoo'ruseakkal irumbumaayirukkum; parisaipidikki'ravan avanukku munnaaga nadappaan.

avan vanthunin'ru, israveal seanaiga'laip paarththuch saththamittu, neengga'l yuththaththi'rku a'nivaguththu ni'rki'rathu enna? naan pelisthan allavaa? neengga'l savulin seavagar allavaa? ungga'lil oruvanaith therinthuko'l'lungga'l; avan ennidaththil varattum.

avan ennoadu yuththampa'n'navum ennaik kollavum samarththanaanaal, naangga'l ungga'lukku vealaikkaararaayiruppoam; naan avanai jeyiththu avanaik kolveanaanaal, neengga'l engga'lukku vealaikkaararaayirunthu, engga'laich seavikkavea'ndum en'ru solli,
pinnum anthap pelisthan: naan in'raiyathinam isravealudaiya seanaiga'lai ninthiththean; naam oruvaroadu oruvar yuththampa'n'na oruvanai vidungga'l en'ru sollikko'nduvaruvaan.
savulum isravealar anaivarum anthap pelisthanudaiya vaarththaiga'laik keattu, kalanggi migavum bayappattaarga'l.

thaaveethu enbavan yoothaavilu'l'la bethleheam ooraanaagiya eesaay ennum pearu'l'la eppiraaththiya manushanudaiya kumaaranaayirunthaan; eesaayukku ettuk kumaarar irunthaarga'l; ivan savulin naadka'lilea mat'ra janangga'lukku'l'lea vayathusen'ra kizhavanaay mathikkappattaan.

eesaayinudaiya moon'ru mooththa kumaarar savuloadeakooda yuththaththi'rkup poayirunthaarga'l; yuththaththi'rkup poayiruntha avanudaiya moon'ru kumaararil mooththavanukku eliyaab en'rum, ira'ndaangkumaaranukku abinathaab en'rum, moon'raangkumaaranukkuch sammaa en'rum pear.
thaaveethu ellaarukkum i'laiyavan; mooththavarga'laagiya antha moon'rupearum savuloadeakoodap poayirunthaarga'l.
thaaveethu savulaivittuth thirumbip poay bethleheamilirukki'ra than thagappanudaiya aaduga'lai meayththukko'ndirunthaan.
anthap pelisthan kaalaiyilum maalaiyilum naa'rpathunaa'l vanthuvanthu ni'rpaan.

eesaay than kumaaranaagiya thaaveethai noakki: un sagoathararukku intha oru marakkaal va'ruththa payat'raiyum, inthap paththu appangga'laiyum eduththukko'ndu, paa'layaththilirukki'ra un sagoathararidaththil oattamaayp poay,

inthap paththup paalkattiga'lai aayirampearukku athibathiyaanavanidaththil koduththu, un sagoatharar sugamaayirukki'raarga'laa en'ru visaariththu, avarga'lidaththil adaiyaa'lam vaanggik ko'nduvaa en'raan.
appozhuthu savulum, avarga'lum, isravealar ellaarum, ealaa pa'l'laththaakkilea pelistharoadu yuththampa'n'nikko'ndirunthaarga'l.

thaaveethu athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, aaduga'laik kaavalaa'li vasamaay vittu, eesaay thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea eduththukko'ndupoay, irathangga'l irukki'ra idaththilea vanthaan; seanaiga'l a'nivaguththu nin'ru, yuththaththi'rken'ru aarppariththaarga'l.
isravealarum pelistharum oruvarukku ethiraaga oruvar a'nivaguththukko'ndirunthaarga'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: thaan ko'nduvanthavaiga'lai i'rakki, rasthukka'laik kaakki'ravan vasamaaga vaiththuvittu, seanaikku'l oadi, than sagoathararaip paarththu: sugamaayirukki'reerga'laa en'ru keattaan.

avan ivarga'loadea peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, ithoa, kaath ooraanaagiya koaliyaath ennum pearu'l'la anthap pelistha veeran pelistharin seanaiga'lilirunthu ezhumbivanthu nin'ru, mun sonna vaarththaiga'laiyea sonnaan; athaith thaaveethu keattaan.
isravealar ellaarum antha manushanaik kaa'numpoathu migavum bayappattu, avan mugaththukku vilagi oadippoavaarga'l.

annearaththilea isravealar: vanthu ni'rki'ra antha manushanaik ka'ndeerga'laa, isravealai ninthikka vanthu ni'rki'raan; ivanaik kollugi'ravan evanoa, avanai raajaa migavum aisuvariyavaanaakki, avanukkuth thammudaiya kumaaraththiyaith thanthu, avan thagappan veettaarukku isravealilea sarvamaaniyam koduppaar en'raarga'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu thanna'ndaiyilea ni'rki'ravarga'laip paarththu, inthap pelisthanaik kon'ru isravealukku nearitta ninthaiyai neekkugi'ravanukku enna seyyappadum; jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya seanaiga'lai ninthikki'ratha'rku viruththaseathanam illaatha intha pelisthan emmaaththiram en'raan.
atha'rku janangga'l: avanaik kollugi'ravanukku inna innapadi seyyappadum en'ru mun sonna vaarththaiga'laiyea avanukkuch sonnaarga'l.

antha manusharoadea avan peasikko'ndirukki'rathai avan mooththa sagoatharanaagiya eliyaab keattapoathu, avan thaaveethinmeal koabangko'ndu: nee inggea vanthathu enna? vanaantharaththilu'l'la anthak kogncha aaduga'lai nee yaar vasaththil vittaay? yuththaththaip paarkka allavaa vanthaay? un thu'nigaraththaiyum, un iruthayaththin aganggaaraththaiyum naan a'rivean en'raan.
atha'rkuth thaaveethu: naan ippozhuthu seythathu enna? naan vanthatha'rku mugaantharam illaiyaa en'ru solli,
avanai vittu, vea'roruvanidaththil thirumbi, anthappiragaaramaagavea keattaan; janangga'l munpoalavea uththaravu sonnaarga'l.
thaaveethu sonna vaarththaiga'lai avarga'l keattu, athaich savulin samugaththil a'riviththaarga'l; appozhuthu avan avanai azhaippiththaan.
thaaveethu savulai noakki: ivanimiththam oruvanudaiya iruthayamum kalangga vea'ndiyathillai; ummudaiya adiyaanaagiya naan poay, inthap pelisthanoadea yuththampa'n'nuvean en'raan.
appozhuthu savul thaaveethai noakki: nee inthap pelisthanoadea ethirththu yuththampa'n'na unnaal aagaathu; nee i'laignan, avanoa than si'ruvayathumuthal yuththaveeran en'raan.

thaaveethu savulaippaarththu: ummudaiya adiyaan en thagappanudaiya aaduga'lai meayththukko'ndirukki'rapoathu, oruvisai oru singgamum, oruvisai oru karadiyum vanthu, manthaiyilirukki'ra oru aattaip pidiththukko'ndathu.
naan athaith thodarnthupoay, athai adiththu, athai athin vaaykkuth thappuviththean; athu enmeal paaynthapoathu, naan athin thaadiyaip pidiththu, athai adiththuk kon'rupoattean.

anthach singgaththaiyum anthak karadiyaiyum ummudaiya adiyaanaagiya naan kon'rean; viruththaseathanamillaatha inthap pelisthanum avaiga'lil on'raippoala iruppaan; avan jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya seanaiga'lai ninthiththaanea en'raan.

pinnum thaaveethu: ennaich singgaththin kaikkum karadiyin kaikkum thappuviththa karththar inthap pelisthanudaiya kaikkum thappuvippaar en'raan; appozhuthu savul thaaveethaip paarththu: poa, karththar unnudaneakooda iruppaaraaga en'raan.
savul thaaveethukkuth than vasthirangga'lai uduththuviththu ve'ngalamaana oru seeraavai avan thalaiyinmeal poattu, oru kavasaththaiyum avanukkuth tharippiththaan.

avanudaiya pattayaththai thaaveethu than vasthirangga'lmeal kattikko'ndu, athilea avanukkup pazhakkamillaathathinaal nadanthupaarththaan; appozhuthu thaaveethu savulai noakki: naan ivaiga'laip poattukko'ndu poagakkoodaathu; intha appiyaasam enakku illai en'ru solli, avaiga'laik ka'lainthupoattu,

than thadiyaik kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu, aat'rilirukki'ra ainthu koozhaangkalluga'laith therintheduththu, avaiga'lai meaypparukkuriya thannudaiya adaippappaiyilea poattu, than kava'naith than kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndu, anthap pelisthana'ndaiyilea poanaan.
pelisthanum nadanthu, thaaveetha'ndaikkuk kittivanthaan; parisaiyaip pidikki'ravan avanukku munnaaga nadanthaan.
pelisthan sut'rippaarththu: thaaveethaik ka'ndu, avan i'laignanum savunthariya roobamaana sivantha meaniyu'l'lavanumaayirunthapadiyinaal, avanai asattaipa'n'ninaan.
pelisthan thaaveethaip paarththu: nee thadiga'loadea ennidaththil vara naan naayaa en'ru solli, avan than theavarga'laikko'ndu thaaveethaich sabiththaan.
pinnum anthap pelisthan thaaveethaip paarththu: ennidaththil vaa; naan un maamsaththai aagaayaththup pa'ravaiga'lukkum kaattu mirugangga'lukkum koduppean en'raan.

atha'rkuth thaaveethu: pelisthanai noakki: nee pattayaththoadum, eettiyoadum, keadagaththoadum ennidaththil varugi'raay; naanoa nee ninthiththa isravealudaiya iraa'nuvangga'lin theavanaagiya seanaiga'ludaiya karththarin naamaththilea unnidaththil varugi'rean.

in'raiyathinam karththar unnai en kaiyil oppukkoduppaar; naan unnaik kon'ru, un thalaiyai unnai vittu vaanggi, pelistharudaiya paa'layaththin pi'nangga'lai in'raiyathinam aagaayaththup pa'ravaiga'lukkum, boomiyin kaattu mirugangga'lukkum koduppean; athanaal isravealil theavan oruvar u'ndu en'ru booloagaththaar ellaarum a'rinthuko'l'luvaarga'l.
karththar pattayaththinaalum eettiyinaalum radchikki'ravar alla en'ru intha janakkoottamellaam a'rinthuko'l'lum; yuththam karththarudaiyathu; avar ungga'lai engga'l kaiyil oppukkoduppaar en'raan.
appozhuthu anthap pelisthan ezhumbi, thaaveethukku ethiraagak kittivarugaiyil, thaaveethu theeviramaay anthach seanaikkum anthap pelisthanukkum ethiraaga oadi,

than kaiyai adaippaththilea poattu, athilirunthu oru kallai eduththu, kava'nilea vaiththuch suzhat'ri, pelisthanudaiya net'riyilea pada e'rinthaan; anthak kal avan net'riyil pathinthu poanathinaal, avan tharaiyilea mugangkuppu'ra vizhunthaan.
ivvithamaagath thaaveethu oru kava'ninaalum oru kallinaalum pelisthanai mea'rko'ndu, avanai madanggadiththu, avanaik kon'rupoattaan; thaaveethin kaiyil pattayam illaathirunthathu.

aagaiyaal thaaveethu pelisthana'ndaiyil oadi avanmeal nin'ru, avan pattayaththai eduththu, athai athin u'raiyilirunthu uruvi, avanaik kon'ru, athinaalea avan thalaiyai vettippoattaan; appozhuthu thangga'l veeran seththuppoanaan en'ru pelisthar ka'ndu, oadippoanaarga'l.

appozhuthu isravealarum yoothaa manusharum ezhumbi, aarppariththu, pa'l'laththaakkin ellaimattum, ekroanin vaasalga'lmattum, pelistharaith thuraththinaarga'l; saaraayeemin vazhiyilum, kaathpatta'namattum, ekroan patta'namattum, pelisthar vettu'ndu vizhunthaarga'l.
israveal puththirar pelistharai moorkkamaayth thuraththinapi'rpaadu, thirumbivanthu, avarga'ludaiya paa'layangga'laik ko'l'laiyittaarga'l.
thaaveethu pelisthanudaiya thalaiyai eduththu, athai erusaleamukkuk ko'ndu vanthaan; avan aayuthangga'laiyoa than koodaaraththilea vaiththaan.

thaaveethu pelisthanukku ethiraagap pu'rappattuppoagi'rathaich savul ka'ndapoathu, avan seanaabathiyaagiya abnearaip paarththu: abnearea, intha vaaliban yaarudaiya magan en'ru keattaan; atha'rku abnear: raajaavea, enakkuth theriyaathu en'ru ummudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaa: anthap pi'l'laiyaa'ndaan yaarudaiya magan en'ru visaari en'raan.
thaaveethu pelisthanaik kon'ru thirumbugaiyil, abnear avanaich savulukku munbaaga azhaiththukko'ndu poayvittaan; pelisthanudaiya thalai avan kaiyil irunthathu.
appozhuthu savul: vaalibanea, nee yaarudaiya magan en'ru avanaik keattatha'rku, thaaveethu: naan bethleheam ooraanaayirukki'ra ummudaiya adiyaanaagiya eesaayin magan en'raan.
avan savuloadea peasi mudinthapinbu, yoanaththaanudaiya aaththumaa thaaveethin aaththumaavoadea on'raay isainthirunthathu; yoanaththaan avanaith than uyiraippoalach sineagiththaan.
savul avanai avan thagappan veettukkuth thirumbippoaga ottaamal, an'rumuthal thannidaththil vaiththukko'ndaan.
yoanaththaan thaaveethaith than aaththumaavaippoalach sineagiththathinaal, avanum ivanum udanpadikkai pa'n'nikko'ndaarga'l.
yoanaththaan poarththukko'ndiruntha saalvaiyaik kazhat'ri, athaiyum, than vasthiraththaiyum, than pattayaththaiyum, than villaiyum, than kachchaiyaiyumkoodath thaaveethukkuk koduththaan.

thaaveethu savul thannai anuppugi'ra evvidaththi'rkum poay, buththiyaayk kaariyaththai nadappiththathinaal, savul avanai yuththamanusharinmeal athigaariyaakkinaan; avan ellaa janaththin ka'nga'lukkum, savuludaiya oozhiyakkaararin ka'nga'lukkumkoodap piriyamaayirunthaan.

thaaveethu pelisthanaik kon'ru thirumbivanthapinbu, janangga'l thirumba varumpoathum, sthireega'l isravealin sagala patta'nangga'lilumirunthu, aadalpaadaludan pu'rappattu, mea'langga'loadum keethavaaththiyangga'loadum santhoashamaay raajaavaagiya savulukku ethirko'nduvanthaarga'l.
antha sthireega'l aadippaadugaiyil: savul kon'rathu aayiram, thaaveethu kon'rathu pathinaayiram en'ru mu'raimu'raiyaagap paadinaarga'l.

antha vaarththai savulukku visanamaayirunthathu; avan miguntha erichchaladainthu, thaaveethukkup pathinaayiram, enakkoa aayiram koduththaarga'l; innum raajaanggamaaththiram avanukkuk ku'raivaayirukki'rathu en'ru solli,
annaa'lmutha'rko'ndu savul thaaveethaik kaaymagaaramaayp paarththaan.

ma'runaa'lilea theavanaal vidappatta pollaatha aavi savulinmeal i'ranggit'ru; avan veetti'rku'l'lea theerkkatharisanam sollikko'ndirunthaan; appozhuthu thaaveethu thinanthoa'rum seygi'rapadi, than kaiyinaal surama'ndalaththai vaasiththukko'ndirunthaan; savulin kaiyilea eettiyirunthathu.
appozhuthu savul thaaveethaich suvaroadea searththu uruvak kuththippoaduvean en'ru eettiyai avanmeal e'rinthaan; aanaalum thaaveethu vilagi ira'ndutharam avanukkuth thappinaan.
karththar thaaveethoadeakooda irukki'raar en'rum thannai vittu vilagippoanaar en'rum, savul ka'ndu, thaaveethukkup bayanthu,
avanaith thannaivittu appu'rappaduththi, avanai aayirampearukku athibathiyaaga vaiththaan; appadiyea avan janaththi'rku munbaagap poakkum varaththumaayirunthaan.
thaaveethu than seygaiga'lilellaam buththimaanaay nadanthaan; karththar avanoadeakooda irunthaar.
avan mahaa buththimaanaay nadakki'rathaich savul ka'ndu, avanukkup bayanthirunthaan.
isravealarum yoothaa janangga'lumaagiya yaavarum thaaveethaich sineagiththaarga'l; avarga'lukku munbaaga avan poakkum varaththumaayirunthaan.

en kai alla, pelistharin kaiyea avanmeal vizhattum en'ru savul ninaiththukko'ndu, savul thaaveethai noakki: ithoa, en mooththa kumaaraththiyaagiya mearaavai unakku manaiviyaagak koduppean; nee enakku nalla seavaganaaymaaththiram irunthu, karththarudaiya yuththangga'lai nadaththu en'raan.
appozhuthu thaaveethu savulaip paarththu: raajaavukku marumaganaagi'ratha'rku naan emmaaththiram, en jeevan emmaaththiram, isravealilea en thagappan vamsamum emmaaththiram en'raan.
savulin kumaaraththiyaagiya mearaab thaaveethukkuk kodukkappadung kaalam vanthapoathu, ava'l meagoalaaththiyanaagiya aathariyealukku manaiviyaagak kodukkappattaa'l.
savulin kumaaraththiyaagiya meekaa'l thaaveethai neasiththaa'l; athu savulukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, athu avanukkuch santhoashamaayirunthathu.

ava'l avanukkuk ka'n'niyaayirukkavum, pelistharin kai avanmeal vizhavum, ava'lai avanukkuk koduppean en'ru savul e'n'ni, thaaveethai noakki: nee ennudaiya ira'ndaam kumaaraththiyinaal in'ru enakku marumaganaavaay en'raan.

pinbu savul than oozhiyakkaararaip paarththu: neengga'l thaaveethoadea iragasiyamaayp peasi: ithoa, raajaa unmeal piriyamaayirukki'raar; avarudaiya oozhiyakkaarar ellaarum ummaich sineagikki'raarga'l; ippoathum neer raajaavukku marumaganaanaal nalam en'ru sollungga'l en'ru ka'rpiththaan.

savulin oozhiyakkaarar intha vaarththaiga'laith thaaveethin seviga'l keadkap peasinaarga'l; appozhuthu thaaveethu, naan raajaavukku marumaganaagi'rathu leasaana kaariyamaa? naan e'liyavanum, a'rpamaay e'n'nappattavanumaayirukki'rean en'raan.
thaaveethu inna innapadi sonnaan en'ru savulin oozhiyakkaarar avanukku a'riviththaarga'l.

appozhuthu savul: raajaa parisaththai virumbaamal, pelistharin noo'ru nuniththoalga'linaal raajaavin saththurukka'lidaththil pazhivaangga viruppamaayirukki'raar en'ru thaaveethukkuch sollungga'l en'raan; thaaveethai pelistharin kaiyinaal vizhappa'n'nuvathea savuludaiya e'n'namaayirunthathu.
avan oozhiyakkaarar thaaveethukku intha vaarththaiga'laich sonnapoathu, raajaavukku marumaganaagi'rathu thaaveethukkup piriyamaayirunthathu.

atha'rkuk ku'riththa naadka'l ni'raivea'rumunnea, thaaveethu ezhunthu, than manusharaik koottikko'ndupoay, pelistharil irunoo'rupearai vetti, avarga'l nuniththoalga'laik ko'nduvanthu, thaan raajaavukku marumaganaagumpadikku, avaiga'lai raajaavukku e'n'nich seluththinaan; appozhuthu savul than kumaaraththiyaagiya meekaa'lai avanukku manaiviyaagak koduththaan.
karththar thaaveethoadirukki'raar en'ru savul ka'nda'rinthuko'ndaan; savulin kumaaraththiyaagiya meekaa'lum avanai neasiththaa'l.
aagaiyaal savul innum athigamaayth thaaveethukkup bayanthu, thaan uyiroadiruntha naa'lellaam thaaveethukkuch saththuruvaayirunthaan.
pelistharudaiya pirabukka'l pu'rappadugi'rapoathellaam thaaveethu savuludaiya oozhiyakkaarar ellaaraippaarkkilum buththimaanaay nadanthuko'ndaan; avan pear migavum kanampet'rathu.
thaaveethaik kon'rupoadumpadikku, savul than kumaaranaagiya yoanaththaanoadum than oozhiyakkaarar ellaaroadum peasinaan.

savulin kumaaranaagiya yoanaththaanoa, thaaveethinmeal migavum piriyamaayirunthaan; athanaal yoanaththaan thaaveethukku athai a'riviththu: en thagappanaagiya savul ummaik kon'rupoada vagaitheadugi'raar; ippoathum naa'laikkaalamea neer echcharikkaiyaayirunthu, ma'raivaana idaththil o'liththukko'ndirum.
naan pu'rappattuvanthu, neer ve'liyilirukkum idaththil en thagappan pakkaththilea nin'ru, umakkaaga en thagappanoadea peasi, nadakkum kaariyaththaik ka'ndu, umakku a'rivippean en'raan.

appadiyea yoanaththaan than thagappanaagiya savuloadea thaaveethukkaaga nalamaayp peasi, raajaa thammudaiya adiyaanaagiya thaaveethukku viroathamaayp paavagnseyyaathiruppaaraaga; avan umakku viroathamaagap paavagnseyyavillai; avan seygaiga'l umakku meththa ubayoagamaayirukki'rathea.

avan than piraa'nanaith than kaiyilea vaiththukko'ndu, anthap pelisthanaik kon'rathinaalea, karththar isravealukkellaam periya iradchippaik katta'laiyittathai neer ka'ndu, santhoashappatteerea; ippoathum mugaantharamillaamal thaaveethaik kollugi'rathinaal, kut'ramillaatha iraththaththi'rku viroathamaaga neer paavagnseyvaanean en'raan.
savul yoanaththaanudaiya sollaik keattu: avan kolaiseyyappaduvathillai en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu aa'naiyittaan.

pinbu yoanaththaan thaaveethai azhaiththu, antha vaarththaiga'laiyellaam avanukku a'riviththu, avanaich savula'ndaiyilea koottikko'ndupoay vittaan; appadiyea avan munpoalavea avanudaiya samugaththil irunthaan.

ma'rupadiyum oru yuththam u'ndaayit'ru; appozhuthu thaaveethu pu'rappattuppoay, pelistharoadea yuththampa'n'ni, avarga'lukku'l mahaa sanggaarampa'n'ninathinaal avarga'l avanukku munbaaga mu'rinthoadippoanaarga'l.
karththaraal vidappatta pollaatha aavi savulinmeal vanthathu; avan than veettil udkaarnthu, than eettiyaik kaiyilea pidiththukko'ndirunthaan; thaaveethu than kaiyinaalea surama'ndalam vaasiththaan.

appozhuthu savul: thaaveethai eettiyinaalea suvaroadea searththu uruvak kuththippoadap paarththaan; aanaalum ivan savulukku vilaginathinaalea, avan e'rintha eetti suvarilea pattathu; thaaveethoa an'ru iraaththiri oadippoay, thannaith thappuviththukko'ndaan.

thaaveethaik kaavalpa'n'ni, ma'runaa'l kaalamea avanaik kon'rupoadumpadikku, savul avan veetti'rkuch seavagarai anuppinaan; ithaith thaaveethukku avan manaiviyaagiya meekaa'l a'riviththu: neer in'ru iraaththiriyil ummudaiya piraa'nanaith thappuviththukko'l'laavittaal, naa'laikku neer kon'rupoadappaduveer en'ru solli,
meekaa'l thaaveethai jannalvazhiyaay i'rakkivittaa'l; avan thappi oadippoanaan.
meekaa'loa oru suroobaththai eduththu, kattilinmeal vaiththu, athin thalaimaattilea oru ve'l'laattuththoalaippoattu, thuppattiyinaal moodivaiththaa'l.
thaaveethaik ko'nduvarach savul seavagarai anuppinapoathu, avar viyaathiyaayirukki'raar en'raa'l.
appozhuthu thaaveethaip paarkki'ratha'rkuch savul seavagarai anuppi, avanaik kon'rupoadumpadikku, kattiloadea avanai ennidaththi'rku eduththukko'nduvaarungga'l en'raan.
seavagar vanthapoathu, ithoa, suroobam kattilinmealum, ve'l'laattuththoal athin thalaimaattilum kidakkak ka'ndaarga'l.

appozhuthu savul: nee ippadi ennai eayththu, en pagaignanaith thappavittu anuppinathu enna en'ru meekaa'lidaththil keattaan. meekaa'l savulai noakki: ennaip poagavidu, naan unnai ean kollavea'ndum en'ru avar ennidaththil sonnaar en'raa'l.
thaaveethu thappi, raamaaviliruntha saamuvealidaththi'rkup poay, savul thanakkuch seythathu ellaavat'raiyum avanukku a'riviththaan; pinbu avanum saamuvealum poay, naayoathilea thanggiyirunthaarga'l.
thaaveethu raamaavukkaduththa naayoathilea irukki'raan en'ru savulukku a'rivikkappattathu.

appozhuthu savul: thaaveethaik ko'nduvarach seavagarai anuppinaan; avarga'l theerkkatharisanam sollugi'ra theerkkatharisiga'lin koottaththaiyum, saamuveal avarga'lin thalaivanaaga ni'rki'rathaiyum ka'ndaarga'l; appozhuthu savulinudaiya seavagarinmeal theavanudaiya aavi i'rangginathinaal avarga'lum theerkkatharisanam sonnaarga'l.

ithu savulukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, avan vea'rea seavagarai anuppinaan; avarga'lum theerkkatharisanam sonnaarga'l; moon'raantharamum savul seavagarai anuppinaan; avarga'lum theerkkatharisanam sonnaarga'l.

appozhuthu avanum raamaavukkup poay, seakkuvilirukki'ra periya ki'nat'ra'ndaiyilea vanthu, saamuvealum thaaveethum enggea en'ru keattaan; athoa raamaavukkaduththa naayoathilea irukki'raarga'l en'ru sollappattathu.

appozhuthu raamaavukkaduththa naayoathi'rkup poanaan; avanmealum theavanudaiya aavi i'rangginathinaal avan raamaavukkaduththa naayoathilea searumattum, theerkkatharisanam sollikko'ndea nadanthuvanthu,

thaanum than vasthirangga'laik kazhat'rippoattu, saamuvealukku munbaagath theerkkatharisanam solli, an'ru pagal muzhuvathum iraamuzhuvathum vasthiram illaamal vizhunthukidanthaan; aagaiyinaalea savulum theerkkatharisiga'lil oruvanoa enbaarga'l.

thaaveethu raamaavukkaduththa naayoathilirunthu oadippoay, yoanaththaan munbaaga vanthu: ummudaiya thagappan en piraa'nanai vaanggaththeadugi'raarea, naan seythathu enna? en akkiramam enna? naan avarukkuch seytha thuroagam enna? en'raan.

atha'rku avan: appadi orukkaalum vaaraathu; neer saavathillai, ithoa, enakku a'rivikkaamal en thagappan periya kaariyamaanaalum si'riya kaariyamaanaalum on'rum seygi'rathillai; inthak kaariyaththai en thagappan enakku ma'raippaanean? appadi irukkamaattaathu en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: ummudaiya ka'nga'lil enakkuth thayaikidaiththathu en'ru ummudaiya thagappan nan'raay a'rivaar; aagaiyaal yoanaththaanukku mananoavu u'ndaagaathapadikku avan ithai a'riyappoagaathu enbaar; mara'naththi'rkum enakkum oru adi thooramaaththiram irukki'rathu en'ru karththarudaiya jeevanaiyum ummudaiya jeevanaiyum ko'ndu nichchayamaaych sollugi'rean en'ru ma'rumozhi solli aa'naiyittaan.
appozhuthu yoanaththaan thaaveethaip paarththu: umathu manaviruppam innathu en'ru sollum, athinpadi umakkuch seyvean en'raan.

thaaveethu yoanaththaanai noakki: ithoa, naa'laikku amaavaasi, naan raajaavoadea panthiyirunthu saappidavea'ndiyathaayirukkum; aanaalum naan moon'raam naa'l saayanggaalamattum ve'liyilea o'liththirukkumpadi enakku uththaravu kodum.

ummudaiya thagappan ennaikku'riththu visaariththaal, than ooraagiya bethleheamilea than kudumbaththaar yaavarum varushaththukku orutharam baliyida varugi'rapadiyaal thaaveethu avvidaththi'rkuppoaga ennidaththil varunthik keattaan en'ru neer sollum.
atha'rku avar nallathu en'raal, ummudaiya adiyaanukkuch samaathaanam irukkum; avarukku erichchalu'ndaanaal, avaraalea pollaapputh theermaanappattirukki'rathu en'ru a'rinthuko'lveer.

aagaiyaal ummudaiya adiyaanukkuth thayaiseyyavea'ndum; karththarukku munbaaga ummudaiya adiyaanoadea udanpadikkai pa'n'niyirukki'reerea; ennil oru akkiramam irunthatheayaanaal, neerea ennaik kon'rupoadum; neer ennai ummudaiya thagappanidaththukkuk ko'ndupoagavea'ndiyathu enna en'raan.

appozhuthu yoanaththaan: appadi umakku varaathiruppathaaga; umakkup pollaappuch seyya en thagappanaalea theermaaniththirukki'rathu en'ru naan nichchayamaay a'rintheanaanaal naan athai umakku a'rivikkaathiruppeanaa en'raan.
thaaveethu yoanaththaanai noakki: ummudaiya thagappan kadinamaana uththaram sonnaal athai yaar enakku a'rivippaar en'raan.
appozhuthu yoanaththaan thaaveethaip paarththu: oorukku ve'liyea poavoam vaarum en'raan; iruvarum ve'liyea pu'rappattuppoanaarga'l.

appozhuthu yoanaththaan isravealin theavanaagiya karththarai munnittuth thaaveethai noakki: naan naa'laiyaavathu ma'runaa'lilaavathu en thagappanudaiya manathai a'rinthuko'ndu, avar thaaveethinmeal thayavaayirukki'raar en'ru ka'ndum, athai appoathu umathu seviga'lukku ve'lippaduththumpadikku, umakkuch solliyanuppaathirunthaal,

isravealin theavanaagiya karththar yoanaththaanukku atha'rkuch sariyaagavum atha'rku athigamaagavum seyyakkadavar; aanaalum umakkuth theenggu seyya en thagappanukkup piriyamaayirunthaal, athai umathu seviga'lukku ve'lippaduththi, neer samaathaanaththoadea poagumpadikku ummai anuppividuvean; karththar en thagappanoadu irunthathupoal, ummoadum iruppaaraaga.
