pi'rpaadu avan nagaraththai milloa thodanggich sut'rilum kattinaan; yoavaab nagaraththin mat'ra idangga'laip pazhuthupaarththaan.
thaaveethu naa'lukkunaa'l viruththiyadainthaan; seanaiga'ludaiya karththar avanoadeakooda irunthaar.

karththar isravealukkaagach sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea, thaaveethai raajaavaakkumpadi avan vasamaayirunthu raajyabaarampa'n'nugi'ra avanidaththilum, sagala isravealaridaththilum, veerathaththuvaththaip paaraattina pirathaana baraakkiramasaaliga'lum,

thaaveethukku iruntha anthap baraakkiramasaaliga'lin ilakkamumaavathu: akmoaniyin kumaaranaagiya yaashoabiyaam ennum searvaikkaararin thalaivan; ivan munnoo'rupearga'linmeal than eettiyai oanggi avarga'lai orumikkakkon'rupoattaan.
ivanukku ira'ndaavathu agoayin kumaaranaagiya thoathoavin magan eleyaasaar; ivan moon'ru baraakkiramasaaliga'lil oruvan.
pelisthar paasthammeemilirukki'ra vaa'rkoathumai ni'raintha vayalnilaththil yuththaththi'rkuk koodivanthapoathum, janam pelistharaik ka'ndu oadinapoathum ivan thaaveethoadea anggea irunthaan.
appozhuthu avarga'l antha nilaththin naduvilea nin'ru athaik kaappaat'rip pelistharai madanggadiththaarga'l; athinaalea karththar periya radchippai nadappiththaar.
muppathu thalaivaril moon'rupear athullaam ennum kanmalaik kebiyilirukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil poayirunthaarga'l; pelistharin paa'layam reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkil i'ranggugi'rapoathu,
thaaveethu ara'naana oru idaththilirunthaan; appozhuthu pelistharin thaa'naiyam bethleheamil irunthathu.
thaaveethu bethleheamin olimugavaasalilirukki'ra ki'nat'rin tha'n'neermeal aavalko'ndu, en thaagaththi'rkuk kogncham tha'n'neer ko'nduvarugi'ravan yaar en'raan.

appozhuthu antha moon'rupear pelistharin paa'layaththi'rku'l thu'ninthu pugunthupoay, bethleheamin olimuga vaasalilirukki'ra ki'nat'rilea tha'n'neer mo'ndu, thaaveethinidaththil ko'nduvanthaarga'l; aanaalum avan athaik kudikka manathillaamal athaik karththarukken'ru oot'rippoattu:

naan ithaich seyyaathapadikku, en theavan ennaik kaaththukko'l'lakkadavar; thangga'l piraa'nanai e'n'naamal poay athaik ko'nduvantha intha manusharin raththaththaik kudippeanoa en'ru solli athaik kudikkamaattean en'raan. ippadi intha moon'ru baraakkiramasaaliga'lum seythaarga'l.
yoavaabin sagoatharanaagiya abisaay antha moon'rupearil pirathaanamaanavan; avan than eettiyai oanggi, munnoo'rupearai madanggadiththathinaal intha moon'rupearil pearpet'ravanaanaan.
intha moon'rupearil avan mat'ra ira'ndupearilum meanmaiyu'l'lavanaanathinaal, avarga'lil thalaivanaanaan; aanaalum antha munthina moon'rupearukku avan samaanamaanavanalla.

baraakkiramasaaliyaagiya yoaythaavin kumaaranum, kabseayeal ooraanumaagiya benaayaavum seygaiga'lil vallavanaayirunthaan; avan moavaab theasaththin ira'ndu valumaiyaana singgangga'laik kon'rathumallaamal, u'raintha mazhaipeytha naa'lil avan oru kebikku'l'lea i'ranggippoay, oru singgaththaik kon'raan.

ainthumuzha uyaramaana oru egipthiyanaiyum avan kon'rupoattaan; antha egipthiyan kaiyil neygi'ravarga'lin padaimarak kanathiyaana oru eetti irukkaiyil, ivan oru thadiyaip pidiththu, avanidaththil poay, antha egipthiyan kaiyiliruntha eettiyaip pa'riththu, avan eettiyinaalea avanaik kon'rupoattaan.
ivaiga'lai yoaythaavin kumaaranaana benaayaa seythapadiyinaal, moon'ru baraakkiramasaaliga'lukku'l'lea pearpet'ravanaay irunthaan.
muppathupearilum ivan meanmaiyu'l'lavan; aanaalum antha munthina moon'rupearukkum ivan samaanamaanavanalla; avanaith thaaveethu than meykkaavalarukkuth thalaivanaaga vaiththaan.
iraa'nuvaththiliruntha mat'rap baraakkiramasaaliga'l: yoavaabin thambi aasakeal, bethleheam ooraanaagiya thoathoavin kumaaran elkkaanaan,
aaroathiyanaagiya sammoath, peloaniyanaagiya eales,
thekkoaviyanaagiya ikkeasin kumaaran eeraa, aanathoaththiyanaagiya abiyeasar,
oosaaththiyanaagiya sibekkaay, agoagiyanaagiya eelaay,
neththoapaaththiyanaagiya magaraayi, neththoapaaththiyanaagiya baanaavin kumaaran ealeath,
benyameen puththirarin kibeayaa ooraanaagiya ribaayin kumaaran iththaayi, piraththoaniyanaagiya benaayaa,
kaagaas neeroadaith theasaththaanaagiya ooraayi, arbaaththiyanaagiya abiyeal,
bagaroomiyanaagiya asmaaveath, saalboaniyanaagiya eliyaabaa,
keesoaniyanaagiya aaseamin kumaarar, aaraariyanaagiya saagiyin kumaaran yoanaththaan.
aaraariyanaagiya saakkaarin kumaaran agiyaam, oorin kumaaran elipaal,
mekaraaththiyanaagiya eppear, peloaniyanaagiya agiyaa,
karmealiyanaagiya esroa, esbaayin kumaaran naaraayi,
naaththaanin sagoatharan yoaveal, agariyin kumaaran mibkaar,
ammoaniyanaagiya sealeak, seruyaavin kumaaranaagiya yoavaabin aayuthathaariyaana beroaththiyanaagiya naaraayi,
iththariyanaagiya eeraa, iththariyanaagiya kaareb,
eaththiyanaagiya uriyaa, aklaayin kumaaran saabaath,
roobaniyarin thalaivanaagiya seesaavin kumaaran athinaa ennum roobaniyan; avanoadea muppathupear irunthaarga'l.
maakaavin kumaaran aanaan, mithiniyanaagiya yoasapaath,
asthareaththiyanaagiya usiyaa, aaroaveariyanaagiya oaththaamin kumaarar samaavum, yeagiyealum,
simriyin kumaaran ethiyaayeal, thithsiyanaagiya avan sagoatharan yoagaa,
maagaaviyarin puththiran eliyeal, elnaamin kumaarar eribaayum, yosaviyaavum, moavaabiyanaana ithmaavum,
mesoabaayaa ooraaraagiya eliyealum, oabeathum, yaaseeyealumea.
thaaveethu keesin kumaaranaagiya savulinimiththam innum ma'raivaayirukkaiyil, siklaakilirukki'ra avanidaththi'rku vanthu,

yuththaththi'rku oththaasai seytha vilveerarum, kava'nkal e'rigi'ratha'rkum villinaal ambu eygi'ratha'rkum valathu idathu kaivaattamaana baraakkiramasaaliga'laana mat'ra manusharumaanavarga'l: savulin sagoathararaagiya benyameen koaththiraththil,
kibeayaa ooraanaagiya seamaavin kumaarar agiyeasar ennum thalaivanum, yoavaasum, asmaaveaththin kumaararaagiya esiyealum, pealeaththum, beraakkaa, aanathoaththiyanaana eagoo enbavarga'lum,
muppathupearil baraakkiramanum muppathupearukkup periyavanumaana ismaayaa ennum kibiyoaniyanum, ereamiyaa, yagaasiyeal, yoaganaan, kethearooraanaana yoasabaath,
elusaayi, erimoath, bigaliyaa, semariyaa, aruppiyanaana seppaththiyaa,
elkkaanaa, eshiyaa, asaariyeal, yoveasear, yasobeyaam ennum koareagiyarum,
yovealaa, sebathiyaa ennum keathoar ooraanaana eroagaamin kumaararumea.

kaaththiyaril parisaiyum eettiyum pidiththu, singgamugampoan'ra mugamum, malaiga'lilirukki'ra ve'limaan veagampoan'ra veagamumu'l'lavarga'laayirunthu, yuththaseavagaraana baraakkiramasaaliga'l silarum vanaantharaththilu'l'la ara'naana idaththil irukki'ra thaaveethu padchamaaych searnthaarga'l.
yaaren'raal, ethsear ennum thalaivan, avanukku ira'ndaavathu obathiyaa; moon'raavathu eliyaab,
naalaavathu mismannaa, ainthaavathu ereamiyaa,
aa'raavathu aththaayi, eazhaavathu eliyeal,
ettaavathu yoaganaan, onbathaavathu elsabaath,
paththaavathu ereamiyaa, pathinoaraavathu makbannaayi;
kaath puththiraraana ivarga'l iraa'nuvaththalaivaraayirunthaarga'l; avarga'lil si'riyavan noo'rupearukkum periyavan aayirampearukkum searvaikkaararaayirunthaarga'l.
yoarthaan karaipura'ndupoayirukki'ra muthalaam maathaththil athaik kadanthu, kizhakkeayum mea'rkeayum pa'l'laththaakkuga'lil irukki'ra yaavaraiyum thuraththivittavarga'l ivarga'lea.
pinnum benyameen puththirarilum yoothaapuththirarilum silar ara'naana sthalaththil irukki'ra thaaveethinidaththil vanthaarga'l.

thaaveethu pu'rappattu, avarga'lukku ethirko'ndupoay, avarga'lukku uththaravukoduththu: neengga'l enakku uthavi seyyach samaathaanamaay ennidaththil vantheerga'laanaal, en iruthayam ungga'loadu isainthirukkum; en kaiga'lil kodumai illaathirukka, ennai en saththurukka'lukkuk kaattikkodukka vantheerga'leayaagil, nammudaiya pithaakka'lin theavan athaip paarththuk ka'ndippaaraaga en'raan.

appozhuthu athibathiga'lukkuth thalaivanaana amaasaayinmeal aavi i'rangginathinaal, avan: thaaveethea, naangga'l ummudaiyavarga'l; eesaayin kumaaranea, umathu padchamaayiruppoam; umakkuch samaathaanam, samaathaanam; umakku uthaviseygi'ravarga'lukkum samaathaanam; ummudaiya theavan umakkuth thu'nai ni'rki'raar en'raan; appozhuthu thaaveethu avarga'laich searththukko'ndu, avarga'laith tha'ndukkuth thalaivaraakkinaan.

savulinmeal yuththampa'n'nappoagi'ra pelistharudaneakoodath thaaveethu varugi'rapoathu, manaaseayilum silar avan padchamaaych searnthaarga'l; pelistharin pirabukka'l yoasanaipa'n'ni, avan nammudaiya thalaiga'lukku moasamaayth than aa'ndavanaagiya savulin padchamaayp poavaan en'ru avanai anuppivittaarga'l; athanaal avarga'l ivarga'lukku uthaviseyyavillai.

appadiyea avan siklaagukkuth thirumbippoagaiyil, manaaseayil athnaak, yoasabaath, ethiyaaveal, migaayeal, yoasabaath, eligoo, silththaayi ennum manaasea koaththiraththaarin aayiraththuch searvaikkaarar avan padchamaay vanthaarga'l.
anthath tha'ndukku viroathamaay ivarga'l thaaveethukku uthaviseythaarga'l; ivarga'lellaarum baraakkiramasaaliga'lum iraa'nuvaththil searvaikkaararumaayirunthaarga'l.
akkaalaththilea naa'lukkunaa'l thaaveethukku uthaviseyyum manushar avanidaththil vanthu searnthapadiyaal, avarga'l theavaseanaiyaippoala mahaa seanaiyaanaarga'l.
karththarudaiya vaakkinpadiyea, savulin raajyabaaraththaith thaaveethinidamaayth thiruppa, ebroanilirukki'ra avanidaththukku vantha yuththasannaththaraana thalaivarin ilakkamaavana:
yoothaapuththiraril parisaiyum eettiyum pidiththu, yuththasannaththaraanavarga'l aa'raayiraththu e'n'noo'rupear.
simiyoan puththiraril baraakkiramasaaliga'laagiya yuththaveerar eazhaayiraththu noo'rupear.
leavi puththiraril naalaayiraththu a'runoo'rupear.
aaroan santhathiyaarin athibathiyaagiya yoaythaavum, avanoadiruntha moovaayiraththu ezhunoo'rupearum,
baraakkiramasaaliyaana saathoak ennum vaalibanum, avan thagappan vamsaththaaraana irubaththira'ndu thalaivarumea.
benyameen puththiraraana savulin sagoathararil moovaayirampear; athuvaraikkum avarga'lil michchamaanavarga'l savulin kudumbaththaik kaappaat'rap paarththaarga'l.
eppiraayeem puththiraril thangga'l pithaakka'lin vamsaththil pearpet'ra manusharaana baraakkiramasaaliga'l irubathinaayiraththu e'n'noo'rupear.
manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththil thaaveethai raajaavaakkugi'ratha'rku varumpadi, pearpearaagak ku'rikkappattavarga'l pathine'n'naayirampear.

isakkaar puththiraril, isravealar seyyavea'ndiyathu innathen'ru a'rinthu kaalaakaalangga'lukkuth thaguntha yoasanai sollaththakka thalaivarga'l irunoo'rupearum, ivarga'l vaakkukkuch sevikoduththa ivarga'ludaiya ellaach sagoathararumea.

sebuloan puththiraril sagalavitha yuththa aayuthangga'laalum yuththam seygi'ratha'rkum, thangga'l a'niyaik kaaththuni'rki'ratha'rkum pazhagi, vagnchanaiseyyaamal yuththaththi'rkup poagaththakkavarga'l aimbathinaayirampear.
napthali puththiraril aayiram thalaivarga'l parisaiyum eettiyum pidiththa avarga'loadeakooda irunthavarga'l muppaththeazhaayirampear.
thaa'n puththiraril yuththaththi'rkuth thea'rinavarga'l irubaththu e'n'naayiraththu a'runoo'rupear.
aasear puththiraril yuththaththi'rkuth thea'rinavarga'laaych seavagampa'n'nap poagaththakkavarga'l naa'rpathinaayirampear.
yoarthaanukku akkaraiyaana roobaniyarilum, kaaththiyarilum, manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththaarilum, yuththampa'n'nach sagalavitha aayuthangga'laiyum thariththavarga'l noot'rirubathinaayirampear.

thaaveethai isravealinmeal raajaavaakkugi'ratha'rku, intha yuththamanushar ellaarum a'ni a'niyaay vaikkappattavarga'laaga, uththama iruthayaththoadea ebroanukku vanthaarga'l; isravealil mat'ra yaavarum thaaveethai raajaavaakkugi'ratha'rku orumanappattirunthaarga'l.
avarga'l anggea thaaveethoadeakooda moon'runaa'l irunthu, poajanabaanampa'n'ninaarga'l; avarga'l sagoatharar avarga'lukkaagach sagalaththaiyum aayaththampa'n'niyirunthaarga'l.

isakkaar, sebuloan, napthaliyin ellaimattum avarga'lukkuch sameebamaayirunthavarga'lum, kazhuthaiga'lmealum ottagangga'lmealum koavea'ru kazhuthaiga'lmealum maaduga'lmealum, thinpa'ndangga'laagiya maa, aththippazha adaiga'l, vat'ralaana thiraadchappazhangga'l, thiraadcharasam, e'n'ney, aadumaaduga'l aagiya ivaiga'lai vea'ndiyamattum eat'rikko'nduvanthaarga'l; isravealilea magizhchchiyu'ndaayit'ru.
thaaveethu aayirampearukkuth thalaivaroadum noo'rupearukkuth thalaivaroadum sagala athibathiga'loadum aaloasanaipa'n'ni,

israveal sabaiyaiyellaam noakki: ungga'lukkuch sammathiyum nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththarukkuch siththamumaayirunthaal, isravealin theasangga'lilellaam irukki'ra nammudaiya mat'rach sagoathararum, avarga'loadea thangga'l ve'linilangga'lil irukki'ra aasaariyarum leaviyarum nammoadea koodumpadikku naam seekkiramaay avarga'lidaththukku aa'l anuppi,
namathu theavanudaiya pettiyaith thirumba nammidaththukkuk ko'nduvaruvoamaaga; savulin naadka'lil athaith theadaatheapoanoam en'raan.
inthak kaariyam sagala janaththin paarvaikkum semmaiyaayirunthapadiyaal, sabaiyaar ellaarum appadiyea seyvoam en'raarga'l.
appadiyea theavanudaiya pettiyaik keeriyaathyaareemilirunthu ko'nduvarumpadi, thaaveethu egipthaichsearntha seegoar nathithuvakki aamaaththin ellaimattumu'l'la isravealaiyellaangkootti,

kearubeenga'lin naduvea vaasampa'n'nugi'ra karththaraagiya theavanudaiya naamam thozhuthuko'l'lappadugi'ra avarudaiya pettiyai yoothaavilirukki'ra keeriyaathyaareemukkaduththa baalaavilirunthu ko'nduvarumpadikku, avanum isravealar anaivarum avvidaththi'rkuppoanaarga'l.
avarga'l theavanudaiya pettiyai abinathaabin veettilirunthu oru puthurathaththinmeal eat'rikko'ndu vanthaarga'l; oosaavum agiyoavum rathaththai nadaththinaarga'l.

thaaveethum sagala isravealarum thangga'l muzhup balaththoadum theavanukkumunbaagach surama'ndalangga'laiyum thamburuga'laiyum mea'langga'laiyum kaiththaa'langga'laiyum poorigaiga'laiyum seaviththu magizhchchiyaay aadippaadinaarga'l.
avarga'l keethoanin ka'lamattum vanthapoathu, maaduga'l ida'rinapadiyinaal, oosaa pettiyaip pidikkath than kaiyai neettinaan.
appozhuthu karththar oosaavinmeal koabam moo'ndavaraagi, avan thankaiyai pettiya'ndaikku neettinathinimiththam avanai adiththaar; anggea avan theavasamugaththil seththaan.
appozhuthu karththar oosaavai adiththathinimiththam thaaveethu visanappattu, antha sthalaththi'rku innaa'lmattum vazhanggivarugi'ra peareas oosaa ennum pearittu,
an'raiyathinam theavanukkupbayanthu: theavanudaiya pettiyai naan ennidaththukkuk ko'nduvaruvathu eppadiyen'ru solli,
pettiyaith thannidaththil thaaveethin nagaraththilea ko'nduvaraamal, athaik kiththiyanaagiya oabeatheathoamin veettilea searththaan.
theavanudaiya petti oabeatheathoamin veettilea avanidaththil moon'rumaatham irukkaiyil, karththar oabeatheathoamin veettaiyum avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum aaseervathiththaar.
theeruvin raajaavaagiya eeraam thaaveethinidaththil sthaanaabathiga'laiyum, avanukku oru veettaik kattugi'ratha'rkuk keathurumarangga'laiyum, thachcharaiyum, kalthachcharaiyum anuppinaan.
karththar thannai isravealinmeal raajaavaagath thidappaduththi, israveal ennum thammudaiya janaththinimiththam thannudaiya raajyaththai migavum uyarththinaar en'ru thaaveethu a'rinthuko'ndaan.
erusaleamilea thaaveethu pinnum aneaga sthireega'lai vivaagampa'n'ni, pinnum kumaararaiyum kumaaraththiga'laiyum pet'raan.
erusaleamilea avanukkup pi'rantha kumaararin naamangga'laavana: sammuvaa, soabaab, naaththaan, saalomoan,
ibkaar, elisoovaa, elpeleath,
noagaa, neppeak, yappiyaa,
elishaamaa, beliyaathaa, elippeleath enbavaiga'l.

thaaveethu samastha isravealinmealum raajaavaaga abisheagampa'n'nappattathaip pelisthar kea'lvippattapoathu, pelisthar ellaarum thaaveethaith theadumpadi vanthaarga'l; athaith thaaveethu keattapoathu avarga'lukku viroathamaagap pu'rappattaan.
pelisthar vanthu reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkilea paraviyirunthaarga'l.
pelistharukku viroathamaagap poagalaamaa, avarga'lai en kaiyil oppukkoduppeeraa en'ru thaaveethu theavanaik keattapoathu, karththar: poa, avarga'lai un kaiyil oppukkoduppean en'raar.

avarga'l baagaalpiraaseemukku vanthapoathu, thaaveethu anggea avarga'lai mu'riya adiththu: tha'n'neerga'l udainthoadugi'rathupoala, theavan en kaiyinaal en saththurukka'lai udainthoadappa'n'ninaar en'raan; athinimiththam antha sthalaththi'rkup baagaalpiraaseem ennum pearittaarga'l.
anggea avarga'l thangga'l theyvangga'laivittu oadippoanaarga'l; thaaveethu ka'rpiththapadi avaiga'l akkiniyaalea sutterikkappattana.
pelisthar ma'rupadiyum vanthu anthap pa'l'laththaakkilea i'rangginaarga'l.

appozhuthu thaaveethu thirumbath theavanidaththil visaariththatha'rku, theavan nee avarga'lukkup pinnaalea poagaamal, avarga'lukkup pakkamaaych sut'ri, musukkattaich sediga'lukku ethireayirunthu, avarga'lmeal paaynthu,

musukkattaich sediga'lin nuniga'lilea sellugi'ra iraichchalai nee keadkumpoathu, yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadu; pelistharin paa'layaththai mu'riya adikka, theavan unakku munnea pu'rappattiruppaar en'raar.
theavan thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea thaaveethu seythapoathu, pelistharin iraa'nuvaththaik kibiyoan thuvakkik kaasearmattum mu'riya adiththaarga'l.
appadiyea thaaveethin keerththi sagala theasangga'lilum pirasiththamaagi, avanukkup bayappadugi'ra bayaththaik karththar sagala jaathiga'linmealum varappa'n'ninaar.
avan thanakkuth thaaveethin nagaraththil veeduga'lai u'ndaakki, theavanudaiya pettikku oru sthalaththai aayaththappaduththi, atha'rku oru koodaaraththaip poattaan.

pi'rpaadu thaaveethu: leaviyar ozhiya vea'roruvarum theavanudaiya pettiyai edukkalaagaathu; theavanudaiya pettiyai edukkavum, en'raikkum avarukkup pa'nividaiseyyavum, avarga'laiyea karththar therinthuko'ndaar en'raan.
appadiyea karththarudaiya pettikkuth thaan aayaththappaduththina athin sthalaththi'rku athaik ko'nduvarumpadi, thaaveethu isravealaiyellaam erusaleamilea koodivarachseythaan.
aaroanin puththiraraiyum,
leaviyaraagiya koagaath puththiraril pirabuvaagiya ooriyealaiyum, avan sagoathararaagiya noot'rirubathupearaiyum,
meraariyin puththiraril pirabuvaagiya asaayaavaiyum, avan sagoathararaagiya irunoot'rirubathupearaiyum,
kersoan puththiraril pirabuvaagiya yoavealaiyum, avan sagoathararaagiya noot'rumuppathupearaiyum,
elisaappaan puththiraril pirabuvaagiya semaayaavaiyum, avan sagoathararaagiya irunoo'rupearaiyum,
ebroan puththiraril pirabuvaagiya eliyealaiyum, avan sagoathararaagiya e'nbathupearaiyum,
oosiyeal puththiraril pirabuvaagiya amminathaabaiyum, avan sagoathararaagiya noot'rup pannira'ndupearaiyum thaaveethu koodivarappa'n'ninaan.
pinbu thaaveethu aasaariyaraagiya saathoakkaiyum, abiyaththaaraiyum, leaviyaraagiya ooriyeal, asaayaa, yoaveal, semaayaa, eliyeal, amminathaab enbavarga'laiyum azhaiththu,

avarga'lai noakki: leaviyaril neengga'l pithaakka'ludaiya santhathiga'lin thalaivar, neengga'l isravealin theavanaagiya karththarin pettiyai atha'rku naan aayaththampa'n'nina sthalaththi'rkuk ko'nduvarumpadi, ungga'laiyum ungga'l sagoathararaiyum parisuththampa'n'nikko'l'lungga'l.
muthalil neengga'l athaich sumakkaathapadiyinaalum, naam nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththarai niyaayamaanapadiyea theadaatheapoanapadiyinaalum, avar namakku'l'lea adivizhappa'n'ninaar en'raan.
appadiyea aasaariyarum leaviyarum isravealin theavanaagiya karththarin pettiyaik ko'nduvarath thangga'laich suththampa'n'nikko'ndaarga'l.
pinbu leavi puththirar karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea, moasea ka'rpiththapiragaaram theavanudaiya pettiyai athin tha'nduga'linaalea thangga'l thoa'lmeal eduththukko'nduvanthaarga'l.

thaaveethu leaviyarin pirabukka'lai noakki: neengga'l ungga'l sagoathararaagiya paadagaraith thamburu surama'ndalam kaiththaa'la muthaliya keethavaaththiyangga'l muzhangga, thangga'l saththaththai uyarththi, santhoasham u'ndaagap paadumpadi ni'ruththavea'ndum en'ru sonnaan.

appadiyea leaviyar yoavealin kumaaranaagiya eamaanaiyum, avan sagoathararil berakiyaavin kumaaranaagiya aasaappaiyum, meraariyin puththiraraana thangga'l sagoathararil kushaayaavin kumaaranaagiya eaththaanaiyum,

ivarga'loadungkooda ira'ndaavathu varisaiyaagath thangga'l sagoathararaagiya sagariyaa, bean, yaasiyeal, semiramoath, yegiyeal, unni, eliyaab, benaayaa, maaseyaa, maththiththiyaa, elippeleagu, mikneayaa, oabeatheathoam, eayel ennum vaasal kaavalaa'laraiyum ni'ruththinaarga'l.
paadagaraagiya eamaanum, aasaappum, eaththaanum, pagnchaloagak kaiththaa'langga'laith thonikkappa'n'nip paadinaarga'l.
sagariyaa, aasiyeal, semiramoath, yegiyeal, unni, eliyaab, maaseyaa, benaayaa enbavarga'l almoath ennum isaiyil paadi, thamburuga'lai vaasiththaarga'l.
maththiththiyaa, elippeleagu, mikneayaa, oabeatheathoam, eayel, asasiyaa enbavarga'l semaneeth ennum isaiyil paadi, surama'ndalangga'lai nearththiyaay vaasiththaarga'l.
leaviyarukku'l'lea kenaaniyaa enbavan sanggeethaththalaivanaayirunthaan; avan nibu'nanaanapadiyaal, keethaviththaiyaip padippiththaan.
berakiyaavum elkkaanaavum pettikku munbaagak kaavalkaaththuvanthaarga'l.

sebaniyaa, yoasapaath, nethaneyeal, amaasaayi, sagariyaa, benaayaa, eliyeasar ennum aasaariyar theavanudaiya pettikku munbaagap poorigaiga'lai oothinaarga'l; oabeatheathoamum, egiyaavum pettikku vaasal kaavalaa'laraayirunthaarga'l.
ippadith thaaveethum, isravealin moopparum, aayiraththuch searvaikkaararum karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyai oabeatheathoamin veettilirunthu magizhchchiyoadea ko'nduvarappoanaarga'l.
karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippettiyaich sumakki'ra leaviyarukkuth theavan anukkiragampa'n'ninapadiyaal, avarga'l eazhu kaa'laiga'laiyum eazhu aattukkadaakka'laiyum baliyittaarga'l.

thaaveethum, pettiyaich sumakki'ra sagala leaviyarum, paadagarum, paadagarin vealaiyai visaarikki'ra thalaivanaagiya kenaaniyaavum, melliya pudavaiyaana saalvaiga'laith thariththirunthaarga'l; thaaveethu sa'nalnool eaboaththaith thariththirunthaan.

appadiyea isravealanaiththum karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaik kembeeraththoadum, ekkaa'langga'l poorigaiga'l kaiththaa'langga'lin thoniyoadum, thamburuga'laiyum surama'ndalangga'laiyum vaasikki'ra saththaththoadum ko'nduvanthaarga'l.

karththarudaiya udanpadikkaippetti thaaveethin nagaramattum vanthapoathu, savulin kumaaraththiyaagiya meekaa'l palaga'nivazhiyaayp paarththu, thaaveethu raajaa aadippaadi varugi'rathaik ka'ndu, avanaith than iruthayaththilea avamathiththaa'l.

avarga'l theavanudaiya pettiyai u'l'lea ko'nduvanthapoathu, thaaveethu atha'rkup poatta koodaaraththin naduvea avarga'l athai vaiththu, theavanudaiya sannithiyil sarvaangga thaganabaliga'laiyum samaathaanabaliga'laiyum seluththinaarga'l.
thaaveethu sarvaangga thaganabaliga'laiyum samaathaanabaliga'laiyum seluththith theernthapinbu, avan janaththaik karththarudaiya naamaththilea aaseervathiththu,
purushar thodanggi sthireega'lmattum, isravealaraagiya anaivarukkum avaravarukku ovvoru appaththaiyum, ovvoru i'raichchith thu'ndaiyum, ovvorupadi thiraadcharasaththaiyum panggittuk koduththaan.
isravealin theavanaagiya karththaraip pirasthaabampa'n'nith thuthiththup pugazhugi'ratha'rku karththarudaiya pettikku munbaagach seavikkaththakka leaviyaril silarai niyamiththaan.

avarga'lil aasaap thalaivanum, sagariyaa avanukku ira'ndaavathumaayirunthaan; eayel, semiramoath, yegiyeal, maththiththiyaa, eliyaab, benaayaa, oabeatheathoam, eayel enbavarga'l thamburu surama'ndalam ennum keethavaaththiyangga'lai vaasikkavum, aasaap kaiththaa'langga'laik kottavum,
benaayaa, yaagaasiyeal ennum aasaariyar eppoathum theavanudaiya udanpadikkaip pettikku munbaagap poorigaiga'lai oothavum niyamikkappattaarga'l.
appadi aarambiththa annaa'lileathaanea karththarukkuth thuthiyaagap paadumpadi thaaveethu aasaappidaththilum avan sagoathararidaththilum koduththa sanggeethamaavathu:
karththaraith thuthiththu, avarudaiya naamaththaip pirasthaabamaakkungga'l; avarudaiya seygaiga'lai janangga'lukku'l'lea pirasiththappaduththungga'l.
avaraip paadi, avaraik keerththanampa'n'ni, avarudaiya athisayangga'laiyellaam thiyaaniththup peasungga'l.
avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththaikku'riththu meanmaipaaraattungga'l; karththaraith theadugi'ravarga'lin iruthayam magizhvathaaga.
karththaraiyum avar vallamaiyaiyum naadungga'l; avar samugaththai niththamum theadungga'l.
avarudaiya thaasanaagiya isravealin santhathiyea! avaraal therinthuko'l'lappattavarga'laagiya yaakkoabin puththirarea!
avar seytha athisayangga'laiyum avarudaiya a'rputhangga'laiyum, avar vaakkin niyaayaththeerppuga'laiyum ninaivukoorungga'l.
avarea nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththar; avarudaiya niyaayaththeerppuga'l boomiyenggum vi'langgum.
aayiranthalaimu'raikken'ru avar katta'laiyitta vaakkaiyum, aabirahaamoadea avar pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyaiyum,
avar eesaakkukku itta aa'naiyaiyum en'ren'raikkum ninaiththirungga'l.
athai yaakkoabukkup piramaa'namaagavum, isravealukku niththiya udanpadikkaiyaagavum u'ruthippaduththi:
ungga'l suthantharapaagamaaga kaanaan theasaththai unakkuth tharuvean en'raar.
akkaalaththil avarga'l kognchaththogaikkudpatta so'rpajanangga'lum paratheasiga'lumaayirunthaarga'l.
avarga'l oru janaththai vittu ma'ru janaththa'ndaikkum, oru raajyaththaivittu ma'ru theasaththaara'ndaikkum poanaarga'l.
avarga'lai yodukkumpadi oruvarukkum idangkodaamal, avarga'l nimiththam raajaakka'laik kadinthuko'ndu:
naan abisheagampa'n'ninavarga'lai neengga'l thodaamalum, ennudaiya theerkkatharisiga'lukkuth theengguseyyaamalum irungga'l en'raar.
boomiyin sagala kudiga'lea, karththaraip paadi, naa'lukkunaa'l avarudaiya radchippaich suviseashamaay a'riviyungga'l.
jaathiga'lukku'l avarudaiya magimaiyaiyum, sagala janangga'lukku'l'lum avarudaiya athisayangga'laiyum vivariththuch sollungga'l.
karththar periyavarum migavum thuthikkappadaththakkavarumaayirukki'raar; ellaa theavarga'lilum bayappadaththakkavar avarea.
sagala janangga'ludaiya theavarga'lum vikkiragangga'lthaanea; karththaroa vaanangga'lai u'ndaakkinavar.
magimaiyum kanamum avar samugaththil irukki'rathu; vallamaiyum magizhchchiyum avar sthalaththil irukki'rathu.
janangga'lin vamsangga'lea, karththarukku magimaiyaiyum vallamaiyaiyum seluththungga'l; karththarukkea athaich seluththungga'l.

karththarukku avarudaiya naamaththi'rkuriya magimaiyaich seluththi, kaa'nikkaiga'laik ko'nduvanthu, avarudaiya sannithiyil piraveasiyungga'l; parisuththa alanggaaraththudanea karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'lungga'l.
booloagaththaarea, neengga'l yaavarum avarukku munbaaga nadunggungga'l; avar poochchakkaraththai asaiyaathapadikku u'ruthippaduththugi'ravar.
vaanangga'l magizhnthu, boomi poorippathaaga; karththar raajarigampa'n'nugi'raar en'ru jaathiga'lukku'l'lea sollappaduvathaaga.
samuththiramum athin ni'raivum muzhanggi, naadum athilu'l'la yaavum ka'likooruvathaaga.
appozhuthu karththarukku munbaagak kaattuvirudchangga'lum kembeerikkum; avar boomiyai niyaayantheerkka varugi'raar.
karththaraith thuthiyungga'l, avar nallavar, avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.

engga'l radchippin theavanea, naangga'l umathu parisuththa naamaththaip poat'ri, ummaith thuthikki'rathinaal meanmaipaaraattumpadikku, engga'lai radchiththu, engga'laich searththukko'ndu, jaathiga'lukku engga'lai neenggalaakkiyaru'lum en'ru sollungga'l.
isravealin theavanaagiya karththarukkuch sathaakaalangga'lilum sthoaththiram u'ndaavathaaga; atha'rku janangga'lellaarum aamen en'ru sollik karththaraith thuthiththaarga'l.

pinbu pettikku munbaaga niththam an'raadaga mu'raiyaaych seavikkumpadi, avan anggea karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettikku munbaaga aasaappaiyum, avan sagoathararaiyum, oabeatheathoamaiyum, avarga'ludaiya sagoathararaagiya a'rubaththettuppearaiyum vaiththu,
ethiththoonin kumaaranaagiya intha oabeatheathoamaiyum oasaavaiyum vaasalkaakki'ravarga'laaga vaiththaan.

kibiyoanilu'l'la meattinmealirukki'ra karththarudaiya vaasasthalaththi'rku munbaaga irukki'ra sarvaangga thaganabalipeedaththinmeal sarvaangga thaganangga'lai niththamum, anthisanthiyil, karththar isravealukkuk ka'rpiththa niyaayappiramaa'naththil ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyellaam karththarukkuch seluththuvatha'rkaaga,
anggea avan aasaariyanaagiya saathoakkaiyum, avan sagoathararaagiya aasaariyaraiyum vaiththu,
ivarga'loadungkooda eamaanaiyum, ethiththoonaiyum, pearpearaagak ku'riththuth therinthuko'l'lappatta mat'rach silaraiyum: karththarudaiya kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu en'ru avaraith thuthikkavum,

poorigaiga'laiyum kaiththaa'langga'laiyum theavanaip paadugi'ratha'rkuriya keethavaaththiyangga'laiyum thonikkachseyyavum avarga'ludan eamaanaiyum ethiththoonaiyum vaiththu, ethiththoonin kumaararai vaasalkaakki'ravarga'laagak katta'laiyittaan.
pinbu janangga'l ellaarum avaravar thangga'l veetti'rkup poanaarga'l; thaaveethum than veettaarai aaseervathikkaththirumbinaan.

thaaveethu than veettilea vaasamaayirukki'rapoathu, avan theerkkatharisiyaagiya naaththaanai noakki: paarum, naan keathurumaraveettilea vaasampa'n'nugi'rean; karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyoa thiraiga'linkeezh irukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu naaththaan thaaveethai noakki: ummudaiya iruthayaththil irukki'rathaiyellaam seyyum; theavan ummoadu irukki'raar en'raan.
an'ru raaththiriyilea, theavanudaiya vaarththai naaththaanukku u'ndaagi, avar:
nee poay, en thaasanaagiya thaaveethai noakki: karththar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: naan vaasamaayirukka nee enakku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndaam.

naan isravealai varappa'n'nina naa'lmutha'rko'ndu innaa'lvaraikkum naan oru aalayaththilea vaasampa'n'naamal, oru koodaaraththilirunthu ma'ru koodaaraththukkum, oru vaasasthalaththilirunthu ma'ru vaasasthalaththukkum poanean.

naan sagala isravealoadum ulaavi vantha evvidaththilaagilum, naan en janaththai meaykkak ka'rpiththa isravealin niyaayaathibathiga'lil yaathoruvanai noakki: neengga'l enakkuk keathurumaraththaal seyyappatta aalayaththaik kattaathirukki'rathu enna en'ru yaathoru vaarththai sonnathu u'ndoa?

ippoathum, nee en thaasanaagiya thaaveethai noakki: seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: nee en janamaagiya isravealinmeal athibathiyaayirukkumpadi, aaduga'lin pinnea nadantha unnai aattumanthaiyai vittu eduththu,
nee poana idamellaam unnoadea irunthu, un saththurukka'laiyellaam unakku munbaaga nirmoolamaakki, boomiyilirukki'ra periyoarga'lin naamaththi'rku oththa naamaththai unakku u'ndaakkinean.

naan en janamaagiya isravealukku oru idaththaiyum ea'rpaduththi, avarga'l thangga'l sthaanaththilea kudiyirukkavum, ini avarga'l alaiyaamalum, munpoalum, naan en janamaagiya isravealinmeal niyaayaathibathiga'laik katta'laiyitta naa'lmuthal nadanthathupoalum, niyaayakkeattin makka'laal inich si'rumaippadaamalum irukkavum avarga'lai naattinean.
un saththurukka'laiyellaam keezhppaduththinean. ippoathum karththar unakku oru veettaik kattuvaar enbathai unakku a'rivikki'rean.
nee un pithaakka'lidaththilea poaga, un naadka'l ni'raivea'rumpoathu, naan unakkuppinbu un puththiraril oruvanaagiya un santhathiyai ezhumbappa'n'ni, avan raajyaththai nilaippaduththuvean.
avan enakku oru aalayaththaik kattuvaan; avan singgaasanaththai en'raikkum nilaikkappa'n'nuvean.
naan avanukkup pithaavaayiruppean, avan enakkuk kumaaranaayiruppaan; unakku munnirunthavanai vittu en kirubaiyai naan vilagappa'n'ninathupoala, avanai vittu vilagappa'n'naamal,
avanai en aalayaththilum en raajyaththilum en'ren'raikkum nilaikkappa'n'nuvean; avanudaiya raajaasanam en'ren'raikkum nilaipet'rirukkum en'ru sol en'raar.
naaththaan intha ellaa vaarththaiga'linpadiyum intha ellaath tharisanaththinpadiyum thaaveethukkuch sonnaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethuraajaa udpiraveasiththu, karththarudaiya samugaththilirunthu: theavanaagiya karththaavea, theavareer ennai ithuvaraikkum ko'nduvanthatha'rku naan emmaaththiram? en veedum emmaaththiram?

theavanea, ithu innum ummudaiya paarvaikkuk kognchakkaariyamaayirukki'rathu en'ru theavanaana karththaraayirukki'ra neer umathu adiyaanudaiya veettaikku'riththu veguthooramaayirukkum kaalaththuch seythiyaiyum solli, ennai mahaa meanmaiyaana santhathiyin manushanaagap paarththeer.
umathu adiyaanukku u'ndaagum kanaththaippat'ri, thaaveethu appu'ram ummoadea solvathu enna? theavareer umathu adiyaanai a'riveer.
karththaavea, umathu adiyaanin nimiththamum, umathu iruthayaththinpadiyum, inthap periya kaariyangga'laiyellaam a'riyappa'n'numpadikku, inthap periya kaariyaththaiyellaam seytheer.
karththaavea, naangga'l engga'l kaathuga'laal keatta ellaavat'rinpadiyum theavareerukku nigaraanavar illai; ummaiththavira vea'rea theavanum illai.

umathu janamaagiya isravealukku nigaraana janamum u'ndoa? booloagaththil intha orea jaathiyaith theavanaagiya neer umakku janamaaga meedkumpadi, bayanggaramaana periya kaariyangga'linaal umakkuk keerththiyai u'ndaakki, neer egipthi'rku neenggalaakki meetta umathu janaththi'rkumunbaaga jaathiga'laith thuraththi,
umathu janamaagiya isravealar en'raikkum umathu janamaayiruppatha'rku avarga'lai nilaippaduththi, karththaraagiya neerthaamea avarga'lukkuth theavanaaneer.
ippoathum karththaavea, theavareer adiyaanaiyum avan veettaiyum ku'riththuch sonna vaarththai en'ren'raikkum nilaivarappattiruppathaaga; theavareer sonnapadiyea seytharu'lum.

aam, athu nilaivarappattirukkavum, isravealin theavanaagiya seanaiga'lin karththar isravealukkuth theavan en'rum, umathu adiyaanaagiya thaaveethin veedu umakku munbaagath thidamaanathen'rum sollappaduvathinaal, umathu naamam en'raikkum magimaippadavumkadavathu.
unakku veedu kattuvean en'ru en theavanaagiya neer umathu adiyaan sevikeadka ve'lippaduththineer; aagaiyaal umakku munbaaga vi'n'nappampa'n'na, umathu adiyaanukku manaththairiyam kidaiththathu.
ippoathum karththaavea, neerea theavan; neer umathu adiyaanaikku'riththu intha nalla viseashaththaich sonneer.

ippoathum umathu adiyaanin veedu en'raikkum umakku munbaaga irukkumpadikku, athai aaseervathiththaru'lineer; karththaraagiya theavareer athai aaseervathiththapadiyinaal, athu en'raikkum aaseervathikkappattirukkum en'raan.
itha'rkuppinbu, thaaveethu pelistharai mu'riya adiththu, avarga'laik keezhppaduththi, kaathpatta'naththaiyum athin kiraamangga'laiyum pelistharin kaiyilirunthu pidiththukko'ndaan.
avan moavaabiyaraiyum mu'riya adiththathinaal, moavaabiyar thaaveethaich seaviththu avanukkuk kaa'nikkaiga'laich seluththinaarga'l.
soabaavin raajaavaagiya aathaareasar aipiraath nathiya'ndaiyil than iraa'nuvaththai ni'ruththappoagi'rapoathu, thaaveethu avanaiyum aamaaththin kittea mu'riya adiththaan.

avanukku iruntha aayiram irathangga'laiyum eazhaayiram kuthiraiveeraraiyum irubathinaayiram kaalaadka'laiyum pidiththu, irathangga'lil noo'ru irathangga'lai vaiththukko'ndu, mat'ravaiga'laiyellaam thu'ndaadippoattaan.
soabaavin raajaavaagiya aathaareasarukku uthaviseyyath thamaskupatta'naththaaraagiya seeriyar vanthaarga'l; thaaveethu seeriyaril irubaththeeraayirampearai vettippoattu,

thamaskuvukkaduththa seeriyaavilea thaa'naiyangga'lai vaiththaan; seeriyar thaaveethaich seaviththu avanukkuk kaa'nikkaiga'laich seluththinaarga'l; thaaveethu poana idaththilellaam karththar avanaik kaappaat'rinaar.
aathaareasarin seavagarukku iruntha pon parisaiga'laith thaaveethu eduththu, avaiga'lai erusaleamukkuk ko'nduvanthaan.

aathaareasarin patta'nangga'laagiya thibgaaththilum koonilumirunthu thaaveethu vegu thira'laana ve'ngalaththaiyum eduththukko'nduvanthaan; athinaalea saalomoan ve'ngalak kadalthottiyaiyum thoo'nga'laiyum ve'ngalath thattumuttuga'laiyum u'ndaakkinaan.
thaaveethu soabaavin raajaavaagiya aathaareasarin iraa'nuvaththaiyellaam mu'riya adiththa seythiyai aamaaththin raajaavaagiya thoayoo keattapoathu,

avan thaaveethu raajaavin sugaseythiyai visaarikkavum, avan aathaareasaroadu yuththampa'n'ni, avanai mu'riya adiththatha'rkaaga avanukku vinavuthal sollavum, than kumaaranaagiya athoaraamaiyum, ponnum ve'l'liyum ve'ngalamumaana sagalavithath thattumuttuga'laiyum, avanidaththukku anuppinaan; aathaareasar thoayoovinmeal yuththampa'n'nugi'ravanaayirunthaan.

anthath thattumuttuga'laiyum, thaan eathoamiyar, moavaabiyar, ammoan puththirar, pelisthar, amaleakkiyar ennum sagala jaathiga'lin kaiyilum vaanggina ve'l'liyaiyum, ponnaiyumkoodath thaaveethuraajaa karththarukkup parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'ndaan.
seruyaavin kumaaran abisaayi uppup pa'l'laththaakkilea pathine'n'naayiram eathoamiyarai mu'riya adiththaan.
aagaiyaal thaaveethu eathoamilea thaa'naiyam poattaan; eathoamiyar ellaarum avanaich seavikki'ravarga'laanaarga'l; thaaveethu poana idaththilellaam karththar avanaik kaappaat'rinaar.
thaaveethu isravealaiyellaam aa'ndu, thannudaiya janaththi'rkellaam niyaayamum neethiyum seythaan.
seruyaavin kumaaran yoavaab iraa'nuvaththalaivanaayirunthaan; aagiloothin kumaaranaagiya yoasapaath manthiriyaayirunthaan.
agithoobin kumaaran saathoakkum, abiyaththaarin kumaaran abimeleakkum aasaariyaraayirunthaarga'l; savishaa sambirathiyaayirunthaan.
yoaythaavin kumaaran benaayaa kireaththiyarukkum pileaththiyarukkum thalaivanaayirunthaan; thaaveethin puththirar raajaavinidaththil pirathaaniga'laayirunthaarga'l.
athanpinbu, ammoan puththirarin raajaavaagiya naagaas mariththu, avan kumaaran avan sthaanaththil raajaavaanaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu: aanoonin thagappanaagiya naagaas enakkuth thayavuseythathupoala, naanum avan kumaaranaagiya ivanukkuth thayavuseyvean en'ru solli, avan thagappanukkaaga avanukku aa'ruthalsolla sthaanaabathiga'lai anuppinaan; thaaveethin oozhiyakkaarar aanoonukku aa'ruthalsolla ammoan puththirarin theasaththilea vanthapoathu,

ammoan puththirarin pirabukka'l aanoonaip paarththu: thaaveethu aa'ruthal sollugi'ravarga'lai ummidaththil anuppinathu, ummudaiya thagappanaik kanampa'n'nugi'rathaay umakkuth thoan'rugi'rathoa? theasaththai aaraayavum, athaik kavizhththuppoadavum, u'lavupaarkkavum allavoa, avan oozhiyakkaarar ummidaththil vanthaarga'l en'ru sonnaarga'l.

appozhuthu aanoon: thaaveethin oozhiyakkaararaip pidiththu, avarga'l thaadiyaich siraiththu, avarga'ludaiya vasthirangga'lai iruppidamattum vaiththuvittu, mat'rap paathiyaik kaththariththuppoattu, avarga'lai anuppivittaan.

antha manushar varugaiyil, avarga'l seythi thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattathu; appozhuthu antha manushar migavum vedkappattapadiyinaal, avarga'lukku ethiraaga raajaa aadka'lai anuppi: ungga'l thaadi va'larumattum neengga'l erigoavilirunthu, pi'rpaadu vaarungga'l en'ru sollachsonnaan.

ammoan puththirar thaangga'l thaaveethukku aruvaruppaanathaik ka'ndapoathu, aanoonum ammoan puththirarum mesoppoththaamiyaavilum maakkaa soabaa ennum seeriyarin theasaththilumirunthu thangga'lukku irathangga'lum kuthiraiveerarum koolikku varumpadi aayiramthaalanthu ve'l'li anuppi,

muppaththeeraayiram irathangga'laiyum, maakkaavin raajaavaiyum, avan janaththaiyum koolippadaiyaaga azhaippiththaan; ivarga'l vanthu, meatheabaavukku munpu'raththilea paa'layami'rangginaarga'l; ammoan puththirarum thangga'l patta'nangga'lilirunthu koodikko'ndu yuththampa'n'navanthaarga'l.
athaith thaaveethu keattapoathu, yoavaabaiyum balasaaliga'lin iraa'nuvam muzhuvathaiyum anuppinaan.
ammoan puththirar pu'rappattuvanthu, patta'naththu vaasala'ndaiyil a'nivaguththaarga'l; vantha raajaakka'l thaniththu ve'liyilea poarukku aayaththamaay nin'raarga'l.

yuththa iraa'nuvangga'lin mugapputh thanakku munnum pinnum irukki'rathai yoavaab ka'ndu, avan isravealilea therinthuko'l'lappatta anaivarilum oru panggaip piriththeduththu, athaich seeriyarukku ethiraaga ni'ruththi,
mat'ra janaththai ammoan puththirarukku ethiraagap poarukku aayaththappaduththi, than sagoatharanaagiya abisaayikku oppuviththu, avanai noakki:
ennaippaarkkilum seeriyar balangko'ndaal nee enakkuth thu'nainil; unnaippaarkkilum ammoan puththirar balangko'ndaal naan unakkuth thu'naini'rpean.
thairiyamaayiru; naam nammudaiya janaththi'rkaagavum, namathu theavanudaiya patta'nangga'lukkaagavum thidanko'ndirukkakkadavoam; karththar thamathu paarvaikku nalamaanathaich seyvaaraaga en'raan.
pinbu yoavaabum avanoadiruntha janamum seeriyaroadu yuththampa'n'nach searnthaarga'l; avarga'l avanukku munbaaga mu'rinthoadinaarga'l.

seeriyar mu'rinthoadugi'rathai ammoan puththirar ka'ndapoathu, avarga'lum avan sagoatharanaagiya abisaayikku munbaaga mu'rinthoadip patta'naththi'rku udpattaarga'l; yoavaab thirumba erusaleamukku vanthaan.

thaangga'l isravealukku munbaaga mu'riya adikkappattathaik ka'ndapoathu, avarga'l nathikku appu'raththilirukki'ra seeriyarai varavazhaiththaarga'l; aathaareasarin padaiththalaivanaagiya soappaak avarga'lukku munnaalea nadanthupoanaan.

athu thaaveethukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, avan isravealaiyellaam koottikko'ndu, yoarthaanaik kadanthu, avarga'lukkuch sameebamaay vanthapoathu, avarga'lukku ethiraaga iraa'nuvangga'lai ni'ruththinaan; thaaveethu seeriyarukku ethiraaga iraa'nuvangga'laip poarukku aayaththappaduththinapin avanoadu yuththampa'n'ninaarga'l.

seeriyar isravealukku munbaaga mu'rinthoadinaarga'l; thaaveethu seeriyaril eazhaayiram irathangga'lin manusharaiyum, naa'rpathinaayiram kaalaadka'laiyum kon'ru, padaiththalaivanaagiya soappaakkaiyum kon'raan.

thaangga'l isravealukku munbaaga mu'riya adikkappattathai aathaareasarin seavagar ka'ndapoathu, avarga'l thaaveethoadea samaathaanampa'n'ni, avanaich seaviththaarga'l; appu'ram ammoan puththirarukku uthaviseyya seeriyar manathillaathirunthaarga'l.

ma'ruvarusham, raajaakka'l yuththaththi'rkup pu'rappadum kaalam vanthapoathu, yoavaab iraa'nuvabalaththaik koottikko'ndupoay, ammoan puththirarin theasaththaip paazhkkadiththu rabbaavukku vanthu athai mut'rikkaipoattaan; thaaveethoa erusaleamil irunthuvittaan; yoavaab rabbaavai adiththuch sanggariththaan.

thaaveethu vanthu, avarga'l raajaavudaiya thalaiyinmeal iruntha kireedaththai eduththukko'ndaan; athu oru thaalanthu ponni'raiyum raththinangga'l pathiththathumaayirunthathu; athu thaaveethin thalaiyil vaikkappattathu; patta'naththilirunthu earaa'lamaana ko'l'laiyaiyum ko'ndupoanaan.

pinbu athiliruntha janangga'lai avan ve'liyea ko'ndupoay, avarga'lai vaa'lga'lukkum, iruppuppaaraiga'lukkum, koadariga'lukkum udpaduththi; ippadi ammoan puththirarin patta'nangga'lukkellaam thaaveethu seythu, ellaa janaththoadungkooda erusaleamukkuth thirumbinaan.

atha'rkuppinbu keasearilea pelistharoadu yuththam u'ndaayit'ru; appozhuthu oosaaththiyanaagiya sibekkaay iraadchatha puththiraril oruvanaana sippaayi enbavanaik kon'raan; athinaal avarga'l vasappaduththappattaarga'l.

thirumbap pelistharoadu yuththam u'ndaagi'rapoathu, yaaveerin kumaaranaagiya elkkaanaan kaaththooraanaagiya koaliyaaththin sagoatharanaana laageamiyaik kon'raan; avan eettith thaanggu neygi'ravarga'lin padaimaram avva'lavu perithaayirunthathu.

ma'rupadiyum oru yuththam kaaththilea nadanthapoathu, anggea nettaiyanaana oru manushan irunthaan; avanukku avvaa'ru viralaaga irubaththunaalu viralga'l irunthathu, avanum iraadchatha santhathiyaayirunthu,
isravealai ninthiththaan; thaaveethin sagoatharanaagiya simeayaavin kumaaran yoanaththaan avanaik kon'raan.
kaaththooriliruntha iraadchathanukkup pi'rantha ivarga'l thaaveethin kaiyinaalum avan seavagarin kaiyinaalum madinthaarga'l.
saaththaan isravealukku viroathamaay ezhumbi, isravealaith thogaiyidugi'ratha'rkuth thaaveethai eavivittathu.

appadiyea thaaveethu yoavaabaiyum, janaththin searvaikkaararaiyum noakki: neengga'l poay, beyersebaathodanggith thaa'nmattum irukki'ra isravealai e'n'ni, avarga'l ilakkaththai naan a'riyumpadikku, ennidaththil ko'nduvaarungga'l en'raan.

appozhuthu yoavaab: karththarudaiya janangga'l ippoathu irukki'rathaippaarkkilum noo'raththanaiyaay avar varththikkappa'n'nuvaaraaga; aanaalum raajaavaagiya en aa'ndavanea, avarga'lellaarum en aa'ndavanin seavagarallavaa? en aa'ndavan ithai visaarippaanean? isravealinmeal kut'ramu'ndaaga ithu nadakkavea'ndiyathu enna en'raan.
yoavaab appadich solliyum, raajaavin vaarththai mealittapadiyinaal, yoavaab pu'rappattu, israveal enggum sut'riththirinthu erusaleamukku vanthu,

janaththai ilakkampaarththu, thogaiyaith thaaveethidaththil koduththaan; isravealilellaam pattayam uruvaththakkavarga'l pathinoruladchampearum, yoothaavil pattayam uruvaththakkavarga'l naaluladchaththu ezhubathinaayirampearum irunthaarga'l.
aanaalum raajaavin vaarththai yoavaabukku aruvaruppaayirunthapadiyinaal, leavi benyameen koaththirangga'lil u'l'lavarga'lai avarga'ludaiya ilakkaththi'rkudpada e'n'naatheapoanaan.
inthak kaariyam theavanudaiya paarvaikku aagaathathaanapadiyinaal avar isravealai vaathiththaar.
thaaveethu theavanai noakki: naan inthak kaariyaththaich seythathinaal migavum paavagnseythean; ippoathum ummudaiya adiyeanin akkiramaththai neekkividum; vegu buththiyeenamaaych seythean en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar, thaaveethin gnaanathirushdikkaaranaagiya kaaththudanea peasi,

nee thaaveethinidaththil poay: moon'ru kaariyangga'lai unakku munbaaga vaikki'rean; avaiga'lil oru kaariyaththaith therinthuko'l; athai naan unakkuch seyvean en'ru karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
appadiyea kaath thaaveethinidaththil vanthu, avanai noakki:

moon'ru varushaththup pagnchamoa? allathu un pagaignarin pattayam unnaip pinthodara nee un saththurukka'lukku munbaaga mu'rinthoadippoagach seyyum moon'rumaathach sanggaaramoa? allathu moon'runaa'l karththarudaiya thoothan isravealudaiya ellaiyenggum sanggaaram u'ndaagumpadi theasaththil ni'rkum karththarudaiya pattayamaagiya ko'l'lai noayoa? ivaiga'lil on'raith therinthuko'l en'ru karththar uraikki'raar. ippoathum ennai anuppinavarukku naan enna ma'ruuththaravu ko'ndupoagavea'ndum enbathai yoasiththuppaarum en'raan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu kaaththai noakki: kodiya idukka'nil agappattirukki'rean; ippoathu naan karththarudaiya kaiyilea vizhuveanaaga; avarudaiya irakkangga'l mahaa periyathu; manushar kaiyilea vizhaathiruppeanaaga en'raan.
aagaiyaal karththar isravealilea ko'l'lainoayai varappa'n'ninaar; athinaal isravealil ezhubathinaayirampear madinthaarga'l.

erusaleamaiyum azhikkath theavan oru thoothanai anuppinaar; aanaalum avan azhikkaiyil karththar paarththu, anthath theenggukku manasthaabappattu, sanggarikki'ra thoothanai noakki: poathum; ippoathu un kaiyai ni'ruththu en'raar; karththarudaiya thoothan eboosiyanaagiya ornaanin ka'laththa'ndaiyilea nin'raan.

thaaveethu than ka'nga'lai ea'reduththu, boomikkum vaanaththi'rkum naduvea ni'rki'ra karththarudaiya thoothan uruvina pattayaththaith than kaiyil pidiththu, athai erusaleaminmeal neettiyirukkak ka'ndaan; appozhuthu thaaveethum moopparga'lum irattup poarththukko'ndu mugangkuppu'ra vizhunthaarga'l.

thaaveethu theavanai noakki: janaththai e'n'nachsonnavan naan allavoa? naanthaan paavagnseythean; pollaappu nadappiththean; intha aaduga'l ennaseythathu? en theavanaagiya karththaavea, vaathikkumpadi ummudaiya karam ummudaiya janaththi'rku viroathamaayiraamal, enakkum en thagappan veetti'rkum viroathamaayiruppathaaga en'raan.

appozhuthu eboosiyanaagiya ornaanin ka'laththilea karththarukku oru balipeedaththai u'ndaakkumpadi, thaaveethu anggea poagavea'ndumen'ru thaaveethukkuch sol en'ru karththarudaiya thoothan kaaththukkuk katta'laiyittaan.
appadiyea thaaveethu karththarin naamaththilea kaath sonna vaarththaiyinpadiyea poanaan.
ornaan thirumbippaarththaan; avanum avanoadirukki'ra avanudaiya naalu kumaararum antha theavathoothanaik ka'ndu o'liththukko'ndaarga'l; ornaanoa poaradiththukko'ndirunthaan.
thaaveethu ornaanidaththil vanthapoathu, ornaan kavaniththuth thaaveethaip paarththu, avan ka'laththilirunthu pu'rappattuvanthu, tharaimattum kuninthu thaaveethai va'nangginaan.

appozhuthu thaaveethu ornaanai noakki: inthak ka'laththin nilaththilea naan karththarukku oru balipeedaththaik kattumpadikku athai enakkuk kodu; vaathai janaththaivittu ni'ruththappada, enakku athaip pe'rum vilaikkuk kodu en'raan.

ornaan thaaveethai noakki: raajaavaagiya en aa'ndavan athai vaanggikko'ndu, thammudaiya paarvaikku nalamaanapadi seyvaaraaga; ithoa, sarvaanggathaganangga'lukku maaduga'lum, vi'ragukkup poaradikki'ra uru'laiga'lum, poajanabalikkuk koathumaiyum aagiya yaavaiyum kodukki'rean en'raan.

atha'rkuth thaaveethuraajaa ornaanai noakki: appadiyalla, naan unnudaiyathai ilavasamaay vaanggi, karththarukkuch sarvaangga thaganaththaip baliyidaamal, athaip pe'rum vilaikku vaangguvean en'ru solli,
thaaveethu antha nilaththi'rku a'runoo'ru seakkal ni'raiponnai ornaanukkuk koduththu,

anggea karththarukku oru balipeedaththaik katti, sarvaangga thaganabaliga'laiyum samaathaana baliga'laiyum seluththi, karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaan; appozhuthu avar vaanaththilirunthu sarvaangga thaganabalipeedaththinmeal i'ranggina akkiniyinaal avanukku ma'ruuththaravu koduththathumallaamal,
theavathoothan thannudaiya pattayaththai u'raiyilea thirumbap poadavea'ndum en'ru karththar avanukkuch sonnaar.
eboosiyanaagiya ornaanin ka'laththilea karththar thanakku uththaravu aru'linathaith thaaveethu akkaalaththilea ka'ndu anggeathaanea baliyittaan.
moasea vanaantharaththil u'ndaakkina karththarudaiya vaasasthalamum sarvaangga thaganabalipeedamum akkaalaththilea kibiyoanin meattil irunthathu.
thaaveethu karththarudaiya thoothanin pattayaththi'rkup bayanthirunthapadiyaal, avan theavasannithiyil poay visaarikkakkoodaathirunthathu.
appozhuthu thaaveethu: theavanaagiya karththarudaiya aalayam irukkum sthalam ithuvea; israveal baliyidum sarvaangga thaganabalipeedam irukkum sthalamum ithuvea en'raan.

pinbu thaaveethu israveal theasaththilirukki'ra anniyajaathiyaaraik koodivarachseythu, theavanudaiya aalayaththaik kattugi'ratha'rkaana kalluga'lai vettip pa'nippaduththum kalthachcharai ea'rpaduththinaan.
thaaveethu vaasalga'lin kathavuga'lukku vea'ndiya aa'niga'lukkum keelga'lukkum miguthiyaana irumbaiyum, ni'ruththu mudiyaatha earaa'lamaana ve'ngalaththaiyum,
e'n'ni'rantha keathurumarangga'laiyum sambaathiththaan; seethoaniyarum theeriyarum thaaveethukkuth thira'laana keathurumarangga'laik ko'nduvanthaarga'l.

thaaveethu: en kumaaranaagiya saalomoan vaalibanum i'laignanumaayirukki'raan; karththarukkuk kattappadum aalayam sagala theasangga'lilum keerththiyum magimaiyum udaiyathaay vi'langgumpadi mahaa periyathaayirukkavea'ndum; aagaiyaal atha'rkaaga vea'ndiyavaiga'lai ippozhuthea seagarampa'n'navea'ndum en'ru solli, thaaveethu than mara'naththi'rku munnea thira'laaych savathariththuvaiththaan.
avan than kumaaranaagiya saalomoanai azhaiththu, isravealin theavanaagiya karththarukku aalayaththaik kattugi'ratha'rkaaga avanukkuk katta'laikoduththu,
saalomoanai noakki: en kumaaranea, naan en theavanaagiya karththarin naamaththi'rku oru aalayaththaik katta en iruthayaththil ninaiththirunthean.

aanaalum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi: nee thira'laana iraththaththaich sinthi, periya yuththangga'laip pa'n'ninaay; nee en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndaam; enakku munbaaga miguthiyaana iraththaththaith tharaiyilea sinthappa'n'ninaay.

ithoa, unakkup pi'rakkappoagi'ra kumaaran amaithiyu'l'la purushanaayiruppaan; sut'rilumirukkum avan saththurukka'laiyellaam vilakki avanai amarnthirukkach seyvean; aagaiyaal avan pear saalomoan ennappadum; avan naadka'lil isravealinmeal samaathaanaththaiyum amarikkaiyaiyum aru'luvean.

avan en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattuvaan; avan enakkuk kumaaranaayiruppaan, naan avanukkup pithaavaayiruppean; isravealai aa'lum avanudaiya raajaanggaththin singgaasanaththai en'ren'raikkum nilaippaduththuvean en'raar.
ippoathum en kumaaranea, nee baakkiyavaanaayirunthu, karththar unnaikku'riththuch sonnapadiyea un theavanaagiya karththarin aalayaththaik kattumpadi, avar unnudaneakooda iruppaaraaga.
karththar unakku gnaanaththaiyum u'narvaiyum aru'lichseythu, un theavanaagiya karththarin niyaayappiramaa'naththaik kaikko'ndu, isravealai aa'lumpadi unakkuk katta'laiyiduvaaraaga.

karththar isravealukkaaga moaseakkuk ka'rpiththa niyamangga'laiyum niyaayangga'laiyum seyya nee kavanamaayirunthaal baakkiyavaanaayiruppaay; nee balangko'ndu thairiyamaayiru, bayappadaamalum kalanggaamalum iru.

ithoa, naan en si'rumaiyilea karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkaaga oru ladcham thaalanthu ponnaiyum, paththuladcham thaalanthu ve'l'liyaiyum, ni'ruththu mudiyaatha thira'laana ve'ngalaththaiyum irumbaiyum savathariththum, marangga'laiyum ka'rka'laiyum savathariththum vaiththean; nee innum avaiga'lukku athigamaaych savatharippaay.
vealaiseyyaththakka thira'laana si'rpaasaariga'lum, thachcharum kalthachcharum, entha vealaiyilum nibu'naraanavarga'lum unnoadirukki'raarga'l.
ponnukkum, ve'l'likkum, ve'ngalaththukkum, irumbukkum ka'nakkillai; nee ezhumbik kaariyaththai nadappi; karththar unnoadea iruppaaraaga en'raan.
than kumaaranaagiya saalomoanukku uthaviseyya, thaaveethu isravealin pirabukka'l anaivarukkum ka'rpiththuch sonnathu:

ungga'l theavanaagiya karththar ungga'loadirunthu naangu thisaiyilum ungga'lukku i'laippaa'ruthalaith thanthaar allavaa? theasaththin kudiga'lai en kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; karththarukku munbaagavum, avarudaiya janaththi'rku munbaagavum theasam keezhppattirukki'rathu.

ippoathum neengga'l ungga'l iruthayaththaiyum, ungga'l aaththumaththaiyum, ungga'l theavanaagiya karththaraith theadugi'ratha'rku nearaakki, karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyaiyum, theavanudaiya parisuththap pa'nimuttuga'laiyum, karththarudaiya naamaththi'rkuk kattappadum antha aalayaththi'rku'l ko'ndupoagumpadikku, neengga'l ezhumbi, theavanaagiya karththarin parisuththa sthalaththaik kattungga'l en'raan.
thaaveethu kizhavanum poora'na vayathu'l'lavanumaanapoathu, than kumaaranaagiya saalomoanai isravealinmeal raajaavaakkinaan.
isravealin ellaap pirabukka'laiyum, aasaariyaraiyum, leaviyaraiyum koodivarumpadi seythaan.
appozhuthu muppathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta leaviyar pearpearaaga e'n'nappattaarga'l; thalaithalaiyaaga e'n'nappatta avarga'ludaiya ilakkam muppaththe'n'naayiram.
avarga'lil irubaththunaalaayirampear karththarudaiya aalayaththin vealaiyai visaarikki'ravarga'lum, aa'raayirampear thalaivarum ma'niyakkaararumaayirukkavea'ndum en'rum,

naalaayirampear vaasal kaakki'ravarga'laayirukkavea'ndum en'rum, thuthiseygi'ratha'rkuth thaan pa'n'nuviththa keethavaaththiyangga'laal naalaayirampear karththaraith thuthikki'ravarga'laayirukkavea'ndum en'rum thaaveethu solli,
avarga'lai leaviyin kumaararaagiya kersoan, koagaath, meraari enbavarga'ludaiya vaguppuga'linpadi vaguththaan.
kersoaniyaril, laathaanum, simeayum irunthaarga'l.
laathaanin kumaarar, yegiyeal, seaththaam, yoaveal ennum moon'rupear; ivarga'lil munthinavan thalaimaiyaayirunthaan.
simeayin kumaarar, seloamith, aasiyeal, aaraan ennum moon'rupear; ivarga'l laathaan vamsap pithaakka'lil thalaimaiyaayirunthaarga'l.
yaagaath, seenaa, eyoosh, bereeyaa ennum naalupearum simeayin kumaararaayirunthaarga'l.

yaagaath thalaimaiyaayirunthaan; seenaa ira'ndaam kumaaranaayirunthaan; eyooshukkum bereeyaavukkum aneagam kumaarar iraathapadiyinaal, avarga'l pithaakka'lin kudumbaththaaril orea vamsamaaga e'n'nappattaarga'l.
koagaaththin kumaarar, amraam, ithsaar, ebroan, oosiyeal ennum naalupear.

amraamin kumaarar, aaroan, moasea enbavarga'l; aaroanum avan kumaararum parisuththaththi'rkup parisuththamaana sthalaththai en'raikkum parisuththamaayk kaakki'ratha'rkum, en'raikkum karththarukku munbaagath thoobangkaattugi'ratha'rkum, avarukku aaraathanai seygi'ratha'rkum, avar naamaththilea aaseervaatham kodukki'ratha'rkum piriththuvaikkappattaarga'l.
theavanudaiya manushanaagiya moaseayin kumaararoavenil, leavikoaththiraththaarukku'l e'n'nappattaarga'l.
moaseayin kumaarar, kersoam, eliyeasar enbavarga'l.
kersoamin kumaararil sebuveal thalaimaiyaayirunthaan.
eliyeasarudaiya kumaararil regabiyaa ennum avan kumaaran thalaimaiyaayirunthaan; eliyeasarukku vea'rea kumaarar illai; regabiyaavin kumaarar aneagaraayirunthaarga'l.
ithsaarin kumaararil seloamith thalaimaiyaayirunthaan.
ebroanin kumaararil eriyaa enbavan thalaimaiyaayirunthaan; ira'ndaavathu amariyaa, moon'raavathu yaagaasiyeal, naalaavathu ekkaamiyaam.
oosiyealin kumaararil meegaa enbavan thalaimaiyaayirunthaan; ira'ndaavathu ishiyaa.
meraariyin kumaarar, mageali, moosi enbavarga'l; magealiyin kumaarar, eleyaasaar, kees enbavarga'l.
eleyaasaar marikki'rapoathu, avanukkuk kumaaraththiga'lea allaamal kumaarar illai; keesin kumaararaagiya ivarga'ludaiya sagoatharar ivarga'lai vivaagampa'n'ninaarga'l.
moosiyin kumaarar, magali, eathear, ereamoath ennum moon'rupear.

thangga'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumbangga'linpadiyea, pithaakka'lil thalaimaiyaayiruntha leavi puththirarin peardaappinpadiyea, thalaithalaiyaaga e'n'nappatta irubathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpatta ivarga'ludaiya santhathiyaar karththarudaiya aalayaththup pa'nividaiyaich seythaarga'l.
isravealin theavanaagiya karththar thamathu janaththai i'laippaa'riyirukkappa'n'ninaar; avar en'ren'raikkum erusaleamil vaasampa'n'nuvaaren'rum,
ini leaviyar vaasasthalaththaiyaagilum athin oozhiyaththi'rkaduththa athin pa'nimuttuga'lil ethaiyaagilum sumakkaththeavaiyillai en'rum,
thaaveethu avarga'laik ku'riththuchsonna kadaisi vaarththaiga'linpadiyea, leavi puththiraril thogaikkudpattavarga'l irubathu vayathumuthal atha'rku mea'rpattavarga'laayirunthaarga'l.

avarga'l aaroanudaiya kumaararinkeezhk karththarudaiya aalayaththin oozhiyamaay nin'ru, piraagaarangga'laiyum, a'raiga'laiyum, sagala parisuththa pa'nimuttuga'lin suththigarippaiyum, theavanudaiya aalayaththin aaraathanaikkaduththa vealaiyaiyum visaarippathum,

samugaththappangga'laiyum, poajanabalikku melliya maavaiyum, pu'lippillaatha athirasangga'laiyum, sattiga'lilea seygi'rathaiyum sudugi'rathaiyum, thittamaana sagala ni'raiyaiyum a'lavaiyum visaarippathum,

naa'lthoa'rum kaalaiyilum maalaiyilum karththaraip poat'rith thuthiththu, oayvunaadka'lilum, amaavaasaiga'lilum, pa'ndigaiga'lilum, karththarukkuch sarvaangga thaganabaliga'l seluththappadugi'ra sagala vea'laiga'lilum,
ilakkaththi'rku'l'laana avarga'l thangga'lukku niyamikkappattapadiyea, eppozhuthum anthap piragaaramaaych seyya, karththarukku munbaaga ni'rpathum,

aasarippuk koodaaraththin kaavalaiyum parisuththa sthalaththin kaavalaiyum thangga'l sagoathararaagiya aaroanudaiya kumaararin kaavalaiyum kaappathum, karththarudaiya aalayaththin pa'nividaiyaich seyvathum, avarga'l vealaiyaayirunthathu.
aaroan puththirarin vaguppuga'laavana: aaroanin kumaarar, naathaab, abiyoo, eleyaasaar, iththaamaar enbavarga'l.
naathaabum abiyoovum kumaarar illaamal thangga'l thagappanukku munnea mariththapadiyinaal, eleyaasaarum iththaamaarum aasaariya oozhiyam seythaarga'l.
thaaveethu saathoakkaikko'ndu eleyaasaarin puththiraraiyum, agimeleakkaikko'ndu iththaamaarin puththiraraiyum avarga'l seyyavea'ndiya oozhiyaththukku mu'raippadi avarga'lai vaguththaan.

avarga'lai vagukki'rapoathu, iththaamaarin puththiraraippaarkkilum eleyaasaarin puththirarukku'l'lea thalaimaiyaanavarga'l athigamaanapear kaa'nappattapadiyinaal, eleyaasaarin puththiraril pathinaa'rupear thangga'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumbaththukkum, iththaamaarin puththiraril ettuppear thangga'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumbaththukkum thalaimaiyaaga vaikkappattaarga'l.

eleyaasaarin puththirarilum iththaamaarin puththirarilum, parisuththa sthalaththukkum, theavanukku aduththa kaariyangga'lil pirabukka'laayirukkumpadikkum, ivarga'lukkum avarga'lukkum viththiyaasampa'n'naamal seettuppoattu avarga'lai vaguththaarga'l.

leaviyaril sambirathiyaagiya semaayaa ennum nethaneyealin kumaaran, raajaavukkum pirabukka'lukkum aasaariyanaagiya saathoakkukkum abiyaththaarin kumaaranaagiya agimeleakkukkum aasaariyarum leaviyarumaana pithaakka'lin thalaivarukkum munbaaga avarga'l naamangga'lai ezhuthinaan; oru pithaavin veettuch seettu eleyaasaarukku vizhunthathu; pinbu anthappadiyea iththaamaarukkum vizhunthathu.
muthalaavathu seettu yoayaareebin pearvazhikkum, ira'ndaavathu yethaayaavin pearvazhikkum,
moon'raavathu aarimin pearvazhikkum, naangaavathu seyoareemin pearvazhikkum,
ainthaavathu malkiyaavin pearvazhikkum, aa'raavathu miyaameenin pearvazhikkum,
eazhaavathu akkoathsin pearvazhikkum, ettaavathu abiyaavin pearvazhikkum,
onbathaavathu yesuvaavin pearvazhikkum, paththaavathu sekkaniyaavin pearvazhikkum,
pathinoaraavathu eliyaaseebin pearvazhikkum, pannira'ndaavathu yaakkeemin pearvazhikkum,
pathinmoon'raavathu uppaavin pearvazhikkum, pathinaangaavathu esebeyaabin pearvazhikkum,
pathinainthaavathu bilkaavin pearvazhikkum, pathinaa'raavathu immearin pearvazhikkum,
pathineazhaavathu easeerin pearvazhikkum, pathinettaavathu apseasin pearvazhikkum,
paththonbathaavathu peththakiyaavin pearvazhikkum, irubathaavathu egesekkiyealin pearvazhikkum,
irubaththoaraavathu yaakinin pearvazhikkum, irubaththira'ndaavathu kaamuvealin pearvazhikkum,
irubaththumoon'raavathu thelaayaavin pearvazhikkum, irubaththunaangaavathu maasiyaavin pearvazhikkum vizhunthathu.

isravealin theavanaagiya karththar avarga'l thagappanaagiya aaroanukkuk ka'rpiththapadiyea, avarga'l avanudaiya katta'laiyinpiragaaram, thangga'l mu'raivarisaiga'lil karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasikkum avarga'ludaiya oozhiyaththi'rkaagap pa'n'nappatta vaguppuga'l ivaiga'lea.
leaviyin mat'rap puththirarukku'l'lea irukki'ra amraamin puththiraril soobavealum, soobavealin kumaararil egeathiyaavum,
regabiyaavin kumaararil mooththavanaagiya ishiyaavum,
ithsaariyaril selemoaththum, selemoaththin kumaararil yaagaaththum,
ebroanin kumaararil mooththavanaagiya eriyaavum, ira'ndaam kumaaranaagiya amriyaavum, moon'raam kumaaranaagiya yaagaasiyealum, naangaam kumaaranaagiya ekkaamiyaamum,
oosiyealin kumaararil meegaavum, meegaavin kumaararil saameerum,
meegaavin sagoatharanaagiya ishiyaavum, ishiyaavin kumaararil sagariyaavum,
meraariyin kumaararaagiya mageali, moosi enbavarga'lum, yaasiyaavin kumaaranaagiya beanoavum,
meraariyin kumaaranaagiya yaasiyaavin kumaararaana beanoa, soagaam, sakkoor, ibri enbavarga'lum,
magealiyin kumaararil puththiranillaatha eleyaasaarum,
keesin puththiraril yeraamiyealum,
moosiyin kumaararaana mageali, eathear, erimoath enbavarga'lumaagiya ivarga'l thangga'l pithaakka'ludaiya kudumbangga'linpadiyea leaviyarin puththiraraanavarga'l.

ivarga'lum raajaavaagiya thaaveethukkum saathoakkukkum agimeleakkukkum aasaariyarilum leaviyarilum pithaakka'laayirukki'ra thalaivarukkum munbaaga, thangga'l sagoathararaagiya aaroanin puththirar seythathupoala, thangga'lilirukki'ra pithaakka'laana thalaivarukkum, avarga'ludaiya si'riya sagoathararukkum, sarisamaanamaaych seettup poattukko'ndaarga'l.

mealum surama'ndalangga'laalum thamburuga'laalum kaiththaa'langga'laalum, theerkkatharisanam sollugi'ra aasaap, eamaan, ethuththoon enbavarga'lin kumaararil silarai, thaaveethum theavaalayach seanaiga'lin pirabukka'lum oozhiyaththi'rken'ru piriththuvaiththaarga'l; thangga'l oozhiyaththin kiriyaikkuk ku'riththuvaikkappatta manusharga'lin thogaiyaavathu:
raajaavudaiya katta'laippiramaa'namaayth theerkkatharisanam sollugi'ra aasaappin vasaththilirukki'ra, aasaappin kumaararil sakkoor, yoaseappu, nethaaniyaa, ashaarealaa enbavarga'lum,

karththaraip poat'rith thuthiththuth theerkkatharisanam sollugi'ra thangga'l thagappanaagiya ethuththoonin vasaththilea surama'ndalangga'lai vaasikka, ethuththoonin kumaararaagiya kethaliyaa, searee, eshaayaa, ashabiyaa, maththiththiyaa ennum aa'rupearum,

kombaith thonikkappa'n'na, theavavishayaththil raajaavukku gnaanathirushdiyu'l'la purushanaagiya eamaanin kumaararaana bukkiyaa, maththaniyaa, oosiyeal, sebuveal, erimoath, ananiyaa, anaani, eliyaaththaa, kithalthi, romanthiyeasar, yoasbekaashaa, maloaththi, oththir, magaasiyoath enbavarga'lumea.
ivarga'lellaarum eamaanin kumaararaayirunthaarga'l; theavan eamaanukkup pathinaalu kumaararaiyum moon'ru kumaaraththiga'laiyum koduththaar.

ivarga'l anaivarum raajaavudaiya katta'laippiramaa'namaayk karththarudaiya aalayaththil thaa'langga'l thamburuga'l surama'ndalangga'laagiya keethavaaththiyam vaasikka, theavanudaiya aalayaththin oozhiyamaaga avaravar thangga'l thangga'l thagappanmaaraagiya aasaap, ethuththoon, eamaan enbavarga'l vasaththil irunthaarga'l.
karththaraip paadum paattuga'laik kat'rukko'ndu, nibu'naraana thangga'l sagoathararoadungkooda avarga'l ilakkaththi'rku irunoot're'nbaththettuppearaayirunthaarga'l.
avarga'lil si'riyavanum periyavanum, aasaanum maa'naakkanum, sarisamaanamaay mu'raivarisaikkaagach seettuppoattukko'ndaarga'l.
muthalaavathu seettu aasaap vamsamaana yoaseappin pearvazhikkum, ira'ndaavathu kethaliyaa, avan sagoatharar, avan kumaararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
moon'raavathu sakkoor, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
naangaavathu isri, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
ainthaavathu neththaniyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
aa'raavathu bukkiyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
eazhaavathu esarealaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
ettaavathu eshaayaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
onbathaavathu maththaneeyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
paththaavathu simeayaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinoaraavathu asaariyeal, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pannira'ndaavathu ashaabiyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinmoon'raavathu subaveal, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinaangaavathu maththiththiyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinainthaavathu ereamoath, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinaa'raavathu ananiyaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathineazhaavathu yoasbeakkaashaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
pathinettaavathu aanaani, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
paththonbathaavathu maloaththi, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irubathaavathu eliyaaththaa, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irubaththoaraavathu oththir, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irubaththira'ndaavathu kithalthi, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irubaththumoon'raavathu magaasiyoath, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum,
irubaththunaangaavathu romanthiyeasar, avan kumaarar, avan sagoathararennum pannira'ndu pearvazhikkum vizhunthathu.
vaasalkaakki'ravarga'lin vaguppuga'laavana: koaraagiyar santhathiyaana aasaapin puththirarilea koareayin kumaaran mesheleamiyaa enbavan,
mesheleamiyaavin kumaarar, mooththavanaagiya sagariyaavum,
ethiyaayeal, sebathiyaa, yathaniyeal, ealaam, yoaganaan, eliyoanaay ennum ira'ndaam moon'raam naangaam ainthaam aa'raam eazhaam kumaararum;
oabeatheathoamin kumaarar, mooththavanaagiya semaayaavum,
yoasabaath, yoavaak, saakkaar, nethaneyeal, ammiyeal, isakkaar, peyu'lthaayi ennum ira'ndaam moon'raam naangaam ainthaam aa'raam eazhaam ettaam kumaararumea; theavan avanai aaseervathiththirunthaar.
avan kumaaranaagiya semaayaavukkum kumaarar pi'ranthu, avarga'l baraakkiramasaaliga'laayirunthu, thangga'l thagappan kudumbaththaarai aa'ndaarga'l.
semaayaavukku iruntha kumaarar othniyum, balasaaliga'laagiya reppaayeal, oabeath, elsaabaath ennum avan sagoathararum, eligoovum semakiyaavumea.
oabeatheathoamin puththirarum avarga'l kumaararum avarga'l sagoathararumaagiya oozhiyaththi'rkup balaththa baraakkiramasaaliga'laana avarga'lellaarum a'rubaththira'ndupear.
mesheleamiyaavin kumaararum sagoathararumaana baraakkiramasaaliga'l pathinettuppear.
meraariyin puththiraril oasaa enbavanudaiya kumaararga'l: simri ennum thalaimaiyaanavan; ivan mooththavanaayiraavittaalum ivan thagappan ivanaith thalaivanaaga vaiththaan.
ilkkiyaa, thebaliyaa, sagariyaa ennum ira'ndaam moon'raam naangaam kumaararaanavarga'l; oasaavin kumaararum sagoathararum ellaam pathinmoon'rupear.
kaavalkaararaana thalaivarinkeezhth thangga'l sagoathararukkoththa mu'raiyaayk karththarudaiya aalayaththil vaasalkaakki'ravarga'laaych seavikka ivarga'l vagukkappattu,
thangga'l pithaakka'lin kudumbaththaaraagiya si'riyavarga'lum periyavarga'lumaay inna vaasalukku innaaren'ru seettuppoattukko'ndaarga'l.

keezhppu'raththi'rkuch seleamiyaavukkuch seettu vizhunthathu; viveagamu'l'la yoasanaikkaaranaagiya sagariyaa ennum avan kumaaranukkuch seettup poattapoathu, avan seettu vadapu'raththi'rken'ru vizhunthathu.
oabeatheathoamukkuth thenpu'raththi'rkum, avan kumaararukku asuppeem veetti'rkum,
sooppeemukkum, oasaavukkum ma'npoattu uyarththappatta vazhiyum kaavalukku ethirkaavalum irukki'ra mea'rpu'ramaana vaasalukkum seettu vizhunthathu.
kizhakkea leaviyaraana aa'rupearum, vadakkea pagalilea naalupearum, the'rkea pagalilea naalupearum, asuppeem veetta'ndaiyil ira'ndira'ndupearum,
ve'lippu'ramaana vaasal a'ndaiyil mea'rkea irukki'ra uyarntha vazhikku naalupearum, ve'lippu'ramaana vazhiyil ira'ndupearum vaikkappattaarga'l.
koaraakin puththirarukku'l'lum, meraariyin puththirarukku'l'lum, vaasalkaakki'ravarga'lin vaguppuga'l ivaiga'lea.
mat'ra leaviyaril agiyaa enbavan theavanudaiya aalayaththup pokkishangga'laiyum, pirathishdaiyaakkappatta poru'lga'lin pokkishangga'laiyum visaarikki'ravanaayirunthaan.
laathaanin kumaarar yaaren'raal, kersoaniyanaana avanudaiya kumaararil thalaimaiyaana pithaakka'laayiruntha yegiyealiyum,
yegiyealiyin kumaararaagiya seaththaamum, avan sagoatharanaagiya yoavealumea; ivarga'l karththarudaiya aalayaththup pokkishangga'lai visaarikki'ravarga'laayirunthaarga'l.
amraameeyarilum, ithsaagaariyarilum, ebroaniyarilum, oosiyeariyarilum silar appadiyea visaarikki'ravarga'laayirunthaarga'l.
moaseayin kumaaranaagiya kersoamin santhathiyaana sebuveal pokkishap pirathaaniyaayirunthaan.
eliyeasar moolamaay avanukku iruntha sagoathararaanavarga'l, ivan kumaaran regabiyaavum, ivan kumaaran eshaayaavum, ivan kumaaran yoaraamum, ivan kumaaran sikkiriyum, ivan kumaaran seloamiththumea.
raajaavaagiya thaaveethum, aayirampearukku athibathiga'lum, noo'rupearukku athibathiga'lumaana pithaakka'lin thalaivarum, seanaabathiga'lum yuththaththil agappatta ko'l'laiga'lil eduththu,
karththarudaiya aalayaththaip paribaalikkumpadikkup parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'nda poru'lga'lin pokkishangga'laiyellaam anthach seloamiththum avanudaiya sagoathararum visaariththaarga'l.

gnaanathirushdikkaaranaagiya saamuvealum, keesin kumaaranaagiya savulum, nearin kumaaranaagiya abnearum, seruyaavin kumaaranaagiya yoavaabum, avaravar parisuththam en'ru nearnthuko'nda anaiththum seloamiththin kaiyinkeezhum avan sagoatharar kaiyinkeezhum irunthathu.
ithsaagaariyaril kenaaniyaavum avan kumaararum theasakaariyangga'laip paarkkumpadi vaikkappattu, isravealinmeal visaarippukkaararum ma'niyakkaararumaayirunthaarga'l.

ebroaniyaril asabiyaavum avan sagoathararumaagiya aayiraththu ezhunoo'ru baraakkiramasaaliga'l yoarthaanukku ippaalea mea'rkea irukki'ra isravealinmeal karththarudaiya ellaa oozhiyaththi'rkum raajaavin vealaikkum vaikkappattaarga'l.

ebroaniyaril eriyaavum irunthaan; avan than pithaakka'lin vamsangga'laana ebroaniyaril thalaimaiyaanavan; thaaveethu arasaa'nda naa'rpathaam varushaththilea avarga'l theadappattapoathu avarga'lukku'l'lea keeleayaaththeasaththu easearilea baraakkirama veerar kaa'nappattaarga'l.

balasaaliga'laagiya avanudaiya sagoatharar ira'ndaayiraththu ezhunoo'ru pirathaana thalaivaraayirunthaarga'l; avarga'laith thaaveethuraajaa theavanukkaduththa sagala kaariyaththi'rkaagavum, raajaavin kaariyaththi'rkaagavum, roobaniyarmealum, kaathiyarmealum, manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththinmealum vaiththaan.

thangga'l ilakkaththinpadi irukki'ra israveal puththirarukku vamsangga'lin thalaivarum, aayiraththukkuch searvaikkaararum, noot'ri'rkuch searvaikkaararum, ivarga'ludaiya thalaivarum vaikkappattirunthaarga'l; ivarga'l varushaththilu'ndaana maathangga'lilellaam maathaththi'rku maatham raajaavaich seavikki'ratha'rku vagukkappatta varisaiga'linpadiyellaam maa'rimaa'ri varuvaarga'l; ovvoru vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
muthalaavathu maathaththukku muthal vaguppinmeal sabthiyealin kumaaran yashobeyaam irunthaan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
avan peareasin santhathiyaaril sagala seanaabathiga'lin thalaivanaayirunthu muthal maatham visaariththaan.
ira'ndaavathu maathaththin vaguppinmeal agoagiyanaana thoathaayi irunthaan; avan vaguppilea mikloath tha'lakarththanaayirunthaan; avan vaguppilea irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
moon'raavathu maathaththin moon'raam seanaabathi yoaythaavin kumaaranaagiya benaayaa ennum thalaimaiyaana pirathaani; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
inthap benaayaa antha muppathu baraakkiramasaaliga'lil oruvanum antha muppathu pearga'lin thalaivanumaayirunthaan; avanudaiya vaguppai avan kumaaranaagiya amisabaath visaariththaan.
naalaavathu maathaththin naalaam seanaabathi yoavaabin sagoatharanaagiya aasakealum, avanukkuppinbu avan kumaaran sebthiyaavumea; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
ainthaavathu maathaththin ainthaam seanaabathi israagiyanaana samgooth enbavan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
aa'raavathu maathaththin aa'raam seanaabathi ikkeasin kumaaran eeraa ennum thekkoaviyan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
eazhaavathu maathaththin eazhaam seanaabathi eppiraayeem puththiraril oruvanaagiya ealeas ennum peloaniyan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
ettaavathu maathaththin ettaam seanaabathi saariyaril oruvanaagiya sibekkaayi ennum ooshaaththiyan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
onbathaavathu maathaththin onbathaam seanaabathi benyameenaril abiyeasar ennum aanathoaththaan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
paththaavathu maathaththin paththaam seanaabathi saariyaril oruvanaagiya makraayi ennum neththoapaaththiyan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
pathinoaraavathu maathaththin pathinoaraam seanaabathi eppiraayeem puththiraril benaayaa ennum piraththoaniyan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
pannira'ndaavathu maathaththin pannira'ndaam seanaabathi othniyeal santhathiyaana elthaayi ennum neththoapaaththiyan; avan vaguppil irubaththunaalaayirampear irunthaarga'l.
israveal koaththirangga'lukkuth thalaivarga'l: roobaniyarukkuth thalaivan sikriyin kumaaran eliyeasar; simiyoaniyarukku maakkaavin kumaaran seppaththiyaa.
leaviyarukkuk keamuvealin kumaaran ashaabiyaa; aaroan santhathikkuch saathoak.
yoothaavukkuth thaaveethin sagoathararil oruvanaagiya eligoo; isakkaarukku migaavealin kumaaran omri.
sebuloanukku obthiyaavin kumaaran ismaayaa; napthalikku asriyealin kumaaran erimoath.
eppiraayeem puththirarukku asasiyaavin kumaaran oaseyaa; manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththi'rkup pethaayaavin kumaaran yoaveal.
keeleayaaththilu'l'la manaaseayin paathikkoaththiraththi'rkuch sagariyaavin kumaaran iththoa; benyameenukku abnearin kumaaran yaasiyeal.
thaa'nukku eroagaamin kumaaran asaariyeal; ivarga'l israveal koaththirangga'lukkuth thalaivaraayirunthaarga'l.

isravealai vaanaththin nadchaththirangga'l aththanaiyaayp perugappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar solliyirunthapadiyaal, thaaveethu irubathu vayathumuthal atha'rkuk keezhppattavarga'lin ilakkaththaith thogaiyeat'ravillai.

seruyaavin kumaaran yoavaab e'n'naththuvakkiyum mudikkaathea poanaan; atha'rkaaga isravealinmeal kadungkoabam vanthathu; aathalaal anthaththogai thaaveethuraajaavin naa'laagamakka'nakkilea ea'ravillai.

raajaavudaiya pokkishangga'linmeal aathiyealin kumaaran asmaaveaththum, patta'nangga'lilum kiraamangga'lilum thurukkangga'lilumu'l'la nilaththin varumaana pa'ndagasaalaiga'linmeal usiyaavin kumaaran yoanaththaanum,
nilaththaip payirida vayalve'liyin vealaiseygi'ravarga'linmeal kealoobbin kumaaran esriyum,
thiraadchaththoattangga'linmeal raamaaththiyanaana seemeayum, thiraadchaththoattangga'lin varaththaagiya thiraadcharasam vaikkum idangga'linmeal sipmiyanaagiya sabthiyum,
pa'l'laththaakkuga'lilu'l'la olivamarangga'linmealum musukkattai virudchangga'linmealum ketheariyanaana baalkaanaanum, e'n'ney kidangguga'linmeal yoavaasum,
saaroanil meaygi'ra maaduga'linmeal saaroaniyanaana sithraayum, pa'l'laththaakkuga'lilu'l'la maaduga'linmeal athlaayin kumaaran saappaaththum,
ottagangga'linmeal ismavealiyanaagiya oabilum, kazhuthaiga'linmeal meroanoaththiyanaagiya egethiyaavum,
aaduga'linmeal aagaariyanaana yaasisum visaarippukkaararaayirunthaarga'l; ivarga'lellaarum thaaveethuraajaavin poru'lga'lukku visaarippukkaararaayirunthaarga'l.
thaaveethin si'riya thagappanaagiya yoanaththaan ennum buththiyum padippumu'l'la manushan aaloasanaikkaaranaayirunthaan; akmoaniyin kumaaran yegiyeal raajaavin kumaararoadirunthaan.
agiththoappeal raajaavukku aaloasanaikkaaranaayirunthaan; arkiyanaana ooshaayi raajaavin thoazhanaayirunthaan.
benaayaavin kumaaran yoaythaavum abiyaththaarum agiththoappealukku uthaviyaayirunthaarga'l; yoavaab raajaavin padaiththalaivanaayirunthaan.

koaththirangga'lin thalaivarum, raajaavaich seavikki'ra vaguppuga'lin thalaivarum, aayirampearukku athibathiga'lum, noo'rupearukku athibathiga'lum, raajaavukkum raajakumaararukkum u'ndaana ellaa aasthiyaiyum mirugajeevanga'laiyum visaarikki'ra thalaivarumaagiya isravealin sagala pirabukka'laiyum, pirathaaniga'laiyum, balasaaliga'laiyum, sagala baraakkiramasaaliga'laiyum thaaveethu erusaleamilea koodivarachseythaan.

appozhuthu raajaavaagiya thaaveethu ezhunthirunthu kaaloon'ri nin'ru: en sagoathararea, en janamea, naan solvathaik kea'lungga'l; karththarudaiya udanpadikkaip pettiyum namathu theavanudaiya paathapadiyum thangguvatha'rku oru aalayaththaik katta naan en manathilea ninaiththu, kattugi'ratha'rku aayaththamum pa'n'ninean.
aanaalum theavan: nee en naamaththi'rku aalayaththaik kattavea'ndaam; nee yuththa manushanaayirunthu, raththaththaich sinthinaay en'raar.

ippoathum israveal anaiththinmealum en'raikkum raajaavaayirukka, isravealin theavanaagiya karththar en thagappanudaiya veettaarilellaam ennaith therinthuko'ndaar; avar yoothaavaiyum yoothaavin vamsaththil en thagappan kudumbaththaiyum thalaimaiyaagath therinthuko'ndu, ennai ellaa isravealinmealum raajaavaakka, en thagappanudaiya kumaararukku'l enmeal piriyam vaiththaar.

karththar enakku aneagam kumaararaith thantharu'linaar; aanaalum isravealai aa'lum karththarudaiya raajyabaaraththin singgaasanaththinmeal udkaarugi'ratha'rku, avar ennudaiya ellaak kumaararilum en kumaaranaagiya saalomoanaith therinthuko'ndu,
avar ennai noakki: un kumaaranaagiya saalomoanea en aalayaththaiyum en piraagaarangga'laiyum kattakkadavan; avanai enakkuk kumaaranaagath therinthuko'ndean; naan avanukkup pithaavaayiruppean.
innaa'lil nadakki'rapadiyea avan en ka'rpanaiga'linpadiyum en niyaayangga'linpadiyum seyya u'ruthiyaayiruppaanaanaal, avan raajyabaaraththai en'ren'raikkum thidappaduththuvean en'raar.

ippoathum neengga'l en'ren'raikkum intha nalla theasaththaich suthantharamaay anubaviththu, ungga'lukkuppi'ragu athai ungga'l pi'l'laiga'lukkuch suthantharamaayp pinvaikkumporuttaaga, neengga'l ungga'l theavanaagiya karththarin ka'rpanaiga'laiyellaam kaikko'ndu visaariyungga'l en'ru karththarin sabaiyaagiya israveal anaiththin ka'nga'lukkumunbaagavum, namathu theavanudaiya sevikeadkavum ungga'lukkup buththisollugi'rean.

en kumaaranaagiya saalomoanea, nee un pithaavin theavanai a'rinthu, avarai uththama iruthayaththoadum u'rchaaga manathoadum seavi; karththar ellaa iruthayangga'laiyum aaraaynthu, ninaivuga'lin thoat'rangga'laiyellaam a'rigi'raar; nee avaraith theadinaal unakkuth thenpaduvaar; nee avarai vittuvittaal avar unnai en'raikkum kaividuvaar.
ippoathum echcharikkaiyaayiru; parisuththa sthalamaaga oru aalayaththaikkattuvatha'rkuk karththar unnaith therinthuko'ndaar; nee thidanko'ndu athai nadappi en'ru sonnaan.

thaaveethu than kumaaranaagiya saalomoanukku ma'ndabamum, athin a'raiga'lum, athin pokkishasaalaiga'lum, athin mealveeduga'lum, athin u'l'la'raiga'lum, kirubaasana sthaanamum irukkavea'ndiya maathiriyaiyum,

aaviyinaal thanakkuk katta'laiyidappattapadiyellaam avan seyyavea'ndiya karththarudaiya aalayappiraagaarangga'lum, theavanudaiya aalayaththup pokkishangga'laiyum, parisuththamaaga nearnthuko'l'lappattavaiga'lin pokkishangga'laiyum vaikkum sagala sut'ra'raiga'lum irukkavea'ndiya maathiriyaiyum,

aasaariyaraiyum leaviyaraiyum varisaiga'laaga vagukki'ratha'rkum, karththarudaiya aalayappa'nividai vealai anaiththi'rkum, karththarudaiya aalayaththu vealaiyin pa'nimuttuga'l anaiththi'rkumuriya katta'laiyaiyum koduththaan.
avan pa'rpala vealaikku vea'ndiya sagala po'rpaaththirangga'lukkaaga ni'raiyinpadi ponnaiyum, pa'rpala vealaikku vea'ndiya sagala ve'l'lippaaththirangga'lukkaaga ni'raiyinpadi ve'l'liyaiyum,

pon vi'lakkuththa'nduga'lukkum avaiga'lin pon vi'lakkuga'lukkum, ovvoru vi'lakkuththa'ndukkum athin vi'lakkuga'lukkum ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiya ponnaiyum, ve'l'li vi'lakkuththa'nduga'lil ovvoru vi'lakkuththa'ndukkum athin vi'lakkuga'lukkum ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiya ve'l'liyaiyum,
samugaththappangga'lai vaikkum ovvoru meajaikkum ni'raiyinpadi vea'ndiya ponnaiyum, ve'l'li meajaiga'lukku vea'ndiya ve'l'liyaiyum,
