aanaalum morthekaayinmealmaaththiram kaipoaduvathu avanukku a'rpakkaariyamaagak ka'ndathu; morthekaayin janangga'l innaaren'ru aamaanukku a'rivikkappattirunthapadiyaal, agaasvearuvin raajyamenggum irukki'ra morthekaayin janamaagiya yootharaiyellaam sanggarikka avan vagaitheadinaan.

raajaavaagiya agaasvearuvin pannira'ndaam varusham nisaan maathamaagiya muthalaam maathaththilea aamaanukku munbaagap poor ennappatta seettu ovvoru naa'laiyum ovvoru maathaththaiyum ku'riththup poadappattu, aathaarmaathamaana pannira'ndaam maathaththinmeal vizhunthathu.

appozhuthu aamaan agaasvearu raajaavai noakki: ummudaiya raajyaththin sagala naaduga'lilumu'l'la janangga'lukku'l'lea oruvitha janangga'l sitha'ru'ndu parambiyirukki'raarga'l; avarga'ludaiya vazhakkangga'l sagala janangga'ludaiya vazhakkangga'lukkum viga'rpamaayirukki'rathu; avarga'l raajaavin sattangga'laik kaikko'l'lugi'rathillai; aagaiyaal avarga'lai ippadi vittirukki'rathu raajaavukku niyaayamalla.

raajaavukkuch sammathiyaanaal, avarga'lai azhikkavea'ndumen'ru ezhuthi anuppavea'ndiyathu; appozhuthu naan raajaavin kajaanaavilea ko'nduvanthu seluththa pathinaayiram thaalanthu ve'l'liyai e'n'nik kaariyakkaarar kaiyil koduppean en'raan.
appozhuthu raajaa than kaiyilirukki'ra than moathiraththaik kazhat'ri, athai aagaakiyanaana ammethaaththaavin kumaaranum yootharin saththuruvumaagiya aamaanidaththil koduththu,
aamaanai noakki: antha ve'l'liyai nee vaiththukko'l; antha janaththukku un ishdappadi seyyalaam en'raan.

muthalaam maatham pathinmoon'raantheathiyilea, raajaavin sambirathiga'l azhaikkappattaarga'l; aamaan ka'rpiththapadiyellaam raajaavin theasaathibathiga'lukkum, ovvoru naattinmeal vaikkappattiruntha thuraiga'lukkum, ovvoru janaththin pirabukka'lukkum, anthantha naattil vazhanggum adcharaththilum, anthantha jaathiyaar peasum baashaiyilum ezhuthappattathu; raajaavaagiya agaasvearuvin pearaal athu ezhuthappattu, raajaavin moathiraththinaal muththirai poadappattathu.

aathaar maathamaana pannira'ndaam maatham pathinmoon'raantheathiyaagiya oreanaa'lilea si'riyoar periyoar kuzhanthaiga'l sthireega'l aagiya sagala yootharaiyum azhiththuk kon'ru nirmoolamaakkavum, avarga'laik ko'l'laiyidavum, agncha'rkaarar kaiyilea raajaavin naaduga'lukkellaam katta'laiga'l anuppappattathu.
antha naa'lukku aayaththappattirukkavea'ndum en'ru sagala janangga'lukkum koo'ri a'rivikki'ratha'rkaagak kodukkappatta katta'laiyin nagal ithuvea, ithu ovvoru naattilum pirasiththampa'n'nappattathu.

antha agncha'rkaarar raajaavin uththaravinaal theeviramaayp pu'rappattuppoanaarga'l; anthak katta'lai soosaan aramanaiyil pi'ranthathu. raajaavum aamaanum kudikkumpadi udkaarnthaarga'l; soosaan nagaram kalanggit'ru.

nadantha yaavat'raiyum morthekaay a'rinthapoathu, morthekaay than vasthirangga'laik kizhiththu, irattuduththi, saambal poattukko'ndu, nagaraththin naduvea pu'rappattuppoay, thuyaramu'l'la mahaa saththaththudanea ala'rikko'ndu,
raajaavin aramanai vaasal mugappumattum vanthaan; irattuduththinavanaay raajaavin aramanai vaasalukku'l piraveasikka oruvanukkum uththaravillai.

raajaavin uththaravum avanudaiya katta'laiyum poaych searntha ovvoru naattilum sthalaththilumu'l'la yootharukku'l'lea mahaa thukkamum, ubavaasamum, azhugaiyum, pulambalum u'ndaay, aneagar irattuduththich saambalil kidanthaarga'l.

appozhuthu estharin thaathimaarga'lum, ava'ludaiya pirathaaniga'lumpoay, athai ava'lukku a'riviththaarga'l; athinaalea raajaaththi migavum thukkappattu, morthekaay uduththiruntha irattai eduththuppoattu, avanai uduththuvikki'ratha'rku vasthirangga'lai anuppinaa'l; avanoa avaiga'lai eat'rukko'l'laathirunthaan.

appozhuthu esthar than pa'nividaikken'ru raajaavinaal niyamiththiruntha avanudaiya pirathaaniga'lil oruvanaagiya aaththaakai azhaippiththu: kaariyam enna? athin mugaantharam enna? en'ru a'riyumpadi, morthekaayinidaththil visaarikka avanukkuk katta'laiyittaa'l.
appadiyea aaththaaku raajaavin aramanai vaasalukku munnaana patta'naveethiyilirukki'ra morthekaayinidaththil pu'rappattuppoanaan.

appozhuthu morthekaay thanakkuch sambaviththa ellaavat'raippat'riyum, yootharai azhikkumpadi aamaan raajaavin kajaanaavukku e'n'nikkoduppean en'ru sonna pa'naththogaiyaippat'riyum avanukku a'riviththathum an'ri,

yootharga'lai azhikkumpadi soosaanil pi'rantha katta'laiyin nagalaiyum avanidaththil koduththu, athai estharukkuk kaa'nbiththuth theriyappaduththavum, ava'l agaththiyamaay raajaavinidaththi'r poay, avanidaththil than janangga'lukkaaga vi'n'nappampa'n'navum man'raadavum vea'ndumen'ru ava'lukkuch sollachsonnaan.
aaththaaku vanthu, morthekaayin vaarththaiga'lai estharukku a'riviththaan.
appozhuthu esthar aaththaakinidaththil morthekaaykkuch solliyanuppinathu:

yaaraavathu azhaippikkappadaamal, u'lmut'raththil raajaavinidaththil piraveasiththaal, purusharaanaalum sthireeyaanaalum sari, avarga'l pizhaikkumpadikku avarga'lukku raajaa po'rsenggoalai neettinaalozhiya mat'rappadi saagavea'ndum engi'ra oru thava'raatha sattamu'ndu, ithu raajaavin sagala oozhiyakkaararukkum, raajaavinudaiya naaduga'lilu'l'la sagala janangga'lukkum theriyum; naan intha muppathunaa'la'lavum raajaavinidaththil varavazhaippikkappadavillai en'ru sollachsonnaa'l.
estharin vaarththaiga'lai morthekaaykkuth theriviththaarga'l.
morthekaay estharukkuth thirumbach sollachsonnathu: nee raajaavin aramanaiyilirukki'rathinaal, mat'ra yoothar thappakkoodaathirukka, nee thappuvaayen'ru un manathilea ninaivuko'l'laathea.

nee inthak kaalaththilea mavunamaayirunthaal, yootharukkuch sagaayamum iradchippum vea'roru idaththilirunthu ezhumbum, appozhuthu neeyum un thagappan kudumbaththaarum azhiveerga'l; nee ippadippatta kaalaththukku uthaviyaayirukkumpadi unakku raajameanmai kidaiththirukkalaamea, yaarukkuth theriyum, en'ru sollachsonnaan.
appozhuthu esthar morthekaaykku ma'rupadiyum sollachsonnathu:

neer poay, soosaanil irukki'ra yootharaiyellaam koodivarachseythu, moon'runaa'l allum pagalum pusiyaamalum kudiyaamalumirunthu, enakkaaga ubavaasampa'n'nungga'l; naanum en thaathimaarum ubavaasampa'n'nuvoam; ivvithamaaga sattaththai mee'ri, raajaavinidaththil piraveasippean; naan seththaalum saagi'rean en'ru sollachsonnaa'l.
appozhuthu morthekaay pu'rappattuppoay, esthar thanakkuk ka'rpiththapadiyellaam seythaan.

moon'raam naa'lilea esthar raajavasthiran thariththukko'ndu, raaja aramanaiyin u'lmut'raththil, raajaa koluvirukkum sthaanaththukku ethiraaga vanthu nin'raa'l; raajaa aramanaivaasalukku ethiraana koluma'ndabaththil raajaasanaththilea veet'rirunthaan.

raajaa raajasthireeyaagiya esthar mut'raththil ni'rki'rathaik ka'ndapoathu, ava'lukku avan ka'nga'lil thayai kidaiththathinaal, raajaa than kaiyilirukki'ra po'rsenggoalai estharidaththi'rku neettinaan; appozhuthu esthar kittavanthu senggoalin nuniyaith thottaa'l.
raajaa ava'lai noakki: esthar raajaaththiyea, unakku ennavea'ndum? nee keadki'ra man'raattu enna? nee raajyaththil paathimattum keattaalum, unakkuk kodukkappadum en'raan.
appozhuthu esthar: raajaavukkuch siththamaanaal, naan thamakkuch seyviththa virunthukku raajaavum aamaanum in'raikku varavea'ndum en'raa'l.
appozhuthu raajaa esthar so'rpadi seyya, aamaanaith theeviriththu varumpadi solli, esthar seytha virunthukku raajaavum aamaanum vanthaarga'l.

virunthilea thiraadcharasam parimaa'rappadugaiyil, raajaa estharaip paarththu: un vea'nduthal enna? athu unakkuk kodukkappadum; nee keadki'rathu enna? nee raajyaththil paathimattum keattaalum kidaikkum en'raan.
atha'rku esthar pirathiyuththaramaaga:

raajaavin ka'nga'lil enakkuk kirubaikidaiththu, en vea'nduthalaik katta'laiyidavum, en vi'n'nappaththinpadi seyyavum, raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthaal, raajaavum aamaanum naan innum thangga'lukkuch seyyappoagi'ra virunthukku varavea'ndum enbathea en vea'nduthalum en vi'n'nappamumaayirukki'rathu; naa'laikku raajaavin so'rpadi seyvean en'raa'l.

an'raiyathinam aamaan santhoashamum manamagizhchchiyumaayp pu'rappattaan; aanaalum raajaavin aramanai vaasalilirukki'ra morthekaay thanakku mun ezhunthiraamalum asaiyaamalum irukki'rathai aamaan ka'ndapoathu, avan morthekaayinmeal ukkiram ni'rainthavanaanaan.
aagilum aamaan athai adakkikko'ndu, than veettukku vanthu, than sineagitharaiyum than manaiviyaagiya sireashaiyum azhaiththu,

than aisuvariyaththin magimaiyaiyum, than pi'l'laiga'lin thiradchiyaiyum, raajaa thannaip periyavanaakki, thannaip pirabukka'lmealum raajaavin oozhiyakkaararmealum uyarththina ellaavat'raiyum aamaan avarga'lukku vivariththuchsonnaan.

pinnaiyum aamaan: raajasthireeyaagiya estharum thaan seytha virunthukku raajaavudaneakooda ennaiththavira vea'roruvaraiyum azhaikkavillai; naa'laikkum raajaavudaneakooda naan virunthukku varavazhaikkappattirukki'rean.
aanaalum antha yoothanaagiya morthekaay raajaavin aramanaivaasalil udkaarnthirukki'rathai naan kaa'numa'lavum avaiyellaam enakku on'rumillaiyen'raan.

appozhuthu avan manaiviyaagiya sireashum avanudaiya sineagithar ellaarum avanaip paarththu: aimbathumuzha uyaramaana oru thookkumaram seyyappadavea'ndum; athilea morthekaayai thookkippoadumpadi naa'laiyaththinam neer raajaavukkuch sollavea'ndum; pinbu santhoashamaay raajaavudaneakooda virunthukkup poagalaam en'raarga'l; inthak kaariyam aamaanukku nan'raayk ka'ndathinaal thookkumaraththaich seyviththaan.
antha raaththiriyilea raajaavukku niththirai varaathapadiyinaal, kaalavarththamaanangga'l ezhuthiyirukki'ra nadapadi pusthagaththaik ko'nduvarachsonnaan; athu raajasamugaththil vaasikkappattathu.

appozhuthu vaasa'r kaavalaa'laril raajaavin ira'ndu pirathaaniga'laagiya bikthaanaavum theareasum, raajaavaagiya agaasvearuvinmeal kaipoadappaarththa seythiyai morthekaay a'riviththaan en'ru ezhuthiyirukki'rathu vaasikkappattathu.
appozhuthu raajaa: itha'rkaaga morthekaaykku kanamum meanmaiyum seyyappattathaa en'ru keattaan. atha'rku raajaavaich seavikki'ra oozhiyakkaarar: avanukku on'rum seyyappadavillai en'ru sonnaarga'l.

aamaan thaan seytha thookkumaraththilea morthekaayaith thookkippoadavea'ndumen'ru, raajaavidaththil peasumpadi raaja aramanaiyin ve'limut'raththilea vanthirunthaan. appozhuthu raajaa: mut'raththilirukki'rathu yaar en'ru keattaan.
raajaavin oozhiyakkaarar avanai noakki: ithoa, aamaan mut'raththilea ni'rki'raan en'raarga'l; raajaa: avan u'l'lea varattum en'raan.

aamaan u'l'lea vanthapoathu, raajaa avanai noakki: raajaa kanampa'n'na virumbugi'ra manushanukku enna seyyappadavea'ndum en'ru keattaan; atha'rku aamaan, ennaiyan'ri, yaarai raajaa kanampa'n'na virumbuvaar en'ru than manathilea ninaiththu,
raajaavai noakki: raajaa kanampa'n'na virumbugi'ra manushanukkuch seyyavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,
raajaa uduththikko'l'lugi'ra raajavasthiramum, raajaa ea'rugi'ra kuthiraiyum, avar sirasilea tharikkappadum raajamudiyum ko'nduvarappadavea'ndum.

antha vasthiramum kuthiraiyum raajaavudaiya pirathaana pirabukka'lil oruvanudaiya kaiyilea kodukkappadavea'ndum; raajaa kanampa'n'na virumbugi'ra manushanai alanggariththapin, avanaik kuthiraiyinmeal eat'ri, nagaraveethiyil ulaavumpadi seythu, raajaa kanampa'n'na virumbugi'ra manushanukku ippadiyea seyyappadum en'ru avanukku munbaagak koo'rappadavea'ndum en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaa aamaanai noakki: seekkiramaay nee sonnapadi vasthiraththaiyum kuthiraiyaiyum ko'ndupoay, raaja aramanaiyin vaasalil udkaarnthirukki'ra yoothanaagiya morthekaaykku anthappiragaaram sey; nee sonna ellaavat'rilum on'rum thava'raathapadi paar en'raan.

appadiyea aamaan vasthiraththaiyum kuthiraiyaiyum ko'ndupoay, morthekaayai alanggariththu, avanaik kuthiraiyinmeal eat'ri, nagaraveethiyil ulaavumpadi seythu, raajaa kanampa'n'na virumbugi'ra manushanukku ippadiyea seyyappadum en'ru avanukku munbaagak koo'rinaan.
pinbu morthekaay raajaavin aramanaivaasalukkuth thirumbivanthaan; aamaanoaven'raal sagnchalappattu mukkaadittukko'ndu than veettukkuth theeviriththuppoanaan.

aamaan thanakku nearitta ellaavat'raiyum than manaiviyaagiya sireashukkum than sineagithar ellaarukkum a'riviththapoathu, avanudaiya aaloasanaikkaararum avan manaiviyaagiya sireashum avanaip paarththu: morthekaaykku munbaaga neer thaazhnthupoagath thodanggineer; avan yoothakulamaanaal, neer avanai mea'rko'l'laamal avanukku munbaagath thaazhnthupoavathu nichchayam en'raarga'l.
avarga'l ippadip peasikko'ndirukkumpoathea, raajaavin pirathaaniga'l vanthu, esthar seytha virunthukku vara aamaanaith thurithappaduththinaarga'l.
raajaaththiyaagiya estharudanea virunthu'n'na, raajaavum aamaanum vanthapoathu,

ira'ndaam naa'l virunthil thiraadcharasam parimaa'rappadumpoathu, raajaa estharai noakki: esthar raajaaththiyea, un vea'nduthal enna? athu unakkuk kodukkappadum; nee keadki'ra man'raattu enna? nee raajyaththil paathimattum keattaalum kidaikkum en'raan.

appozhuthu raajaaththiyaagiya esthar pirathiyuththaramaaga: raajaavea, ummudaiya ka'nga'lil enakkuk kirubai kidaiththu, raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthaal en vea'nduthalukku en jeevanum, en man'raattukku en janangga'lum enakkuk katta'laiyidappaduvathaaga.

engga'lai azhiththuk kon'ru nirmoolamaakkumpadi naanum en janangga'lum vi'rkappattoam; adimaiga'laagavum ve'l'laattiga'laagavum vi'rkappattuppoanaalum naan mavunamaayiruppean; ippozhuthoa raajaavukku u'ndaagum nashdaththukku anthach saththuru uththaravaathampa'n'na mudiyaathu en'raa'l.
appozhuthu raajaavaagiya agaasvearu ma'rumozhiyaaga, raajaaththiyaagiya estharai noakki: ippadich seyyath thu'nigarangko'ndavan yaar? avan enggea? en'raan.
atha'rku esthar: saththuruvum pagaignanumaagiya antha manithan inthath thushda aamaanthaan en'raa'l; appozhuthu raajaavukkum raajaaththikkum munbaaga aamaan thigiladainthaan.

raajaa ukkiraththoadea thiraadcharasappanthiyai vittezhunthu, aramanaith thoattaththi'rkup poanaan; raajaavinaal thanakkup pollaappu nir'nayikkappattathen'ru aamaan ka'ndu, raajaaththiyaagiya estharidaththil than piraa'nanukkaaga vi'n'nappampa'n'na ezhunthunin'raan.

raajaa aramanaith thoattaththilirunthu thiraadcharasam parimaa'rappatta idaththukkuth thirumbivarugaiyil, esthar udkaarnthirukki'ra meththaiyinmeal aamaan vizhunthukidanthaan; appozhuthu raajaa: naan aramanaiyilirukkumpoathea en ka'nmunnea ivan raajaaththiyaip balavantham seyyavea'ndumen'rirukki'raanoa en'raan; intha vaarththai raajaavin vaayilirunthu pi'ranthavudanea aamaanin mugaththai moodippoattaarga'l.

appozhuthu raajasamugaththil irukki'ra pirathaaniga'lil a'rboanaa ennum oruvan: ithoa, raajaavin nanmaikkaagap peasina morthekaaykku aamaan seyviththa aimbathu muzha uyaramaana thookkumaram aamaanin veetta'ndai naattappattirukki'rathu en'raan; appozhuthu raajaa: athilea avanaith thookkippoadungga'l en'raan.
appadiyea aamaan morthekaaykku aayaththampa'n'nina thookkumaraththil aamaanaiyea thookkippoattaarga'l; appozhuthu raajaavin ukkiram tha'ninthathu.

an'raiyathinam agaasvearu raajaa yootharin saththuruvaayiruntha aamaanin veettai raajaaththiyaagiya estharukkuk koduththaan; morthekaay raajasamugaththil vanthaan; avan thanakku inna u'ravu en'ru esthar a'riviththirunthaa'l.
raajaa aamaanin kaiyilirunthu vaanggippoatta thammudaiya moathiraththai eduththu, athai morthekaaykkuk koduththaan; esthar morthekaayai aamaanin aramanaikku athigaariyaaga vaiththaa'l.

pinnum esthar raajasamugaththil peasi, avan paathangga'lil vizhunthu azhuthu, aagaakiyanaana aamaanin theevinaiyaiyum avan yootharukku viroathagnseyya yoasiththa yoasanaiyaiyum parigarikka avanidaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'ninaa'l.
appozhuthu raajaa po'rsenggoalai estharukku neettinaan; esthar ezhunthirunthu raajasamugaththil nin'ru:

raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthu avar samugaththil enakkuk kirubaikidaiththu, raajasamugaththil naan sollum vaarththai sariyen'ru kaa'nappattu, avarudaiya ka'nga'lukku naan piriyamaayirunthaal, raajaavin naaduga'lilellaam irukki'ra yootharai azhikkavea'ndum en'ru ammethaaththaavin kumaaranaagiya aamaan ennum aagaakiyan theevinaiyaay ezhuthina katta'laiga'l sellaama'rpoagappa'n'numpadi ezhuthi anuppappadavea'ndum.
en janaththinmeal varum pollaappai naan eppadip paarkkakkoodum? en kulaththukku varum azhivai naan eppadich sagikkakkoodum? en'raa'l.

appozhuthu agaasvearu raajaa raajaaththiyaagiya estharaiyum yoothanaagiya morthekaayaiyum noakki: ithoa, aamaanin veettai estharukkuk koduththean; avan yootharmeal than kaiyaippoada eththaniththapadiyinaal avanai maraththilea thookkippoattaarga'l.

ippoathum ungga'lukku ishdamaanapadi neengga'l raajaavin naamaththinaal yootharukkaaga ezhuthi, raajaavin moathiraththinaal muththiraipoadungga'l; raajaavinpearaal ezhuthappattu, raajaavin moathiraththinaal muththiraipoadappattathaich sellaama'r poagappa'n'na oruvaraalum koodaathu en'raan.

seevaan maatham ennum moon'raam maatham irubaththumoon'raantheathiyaagiya akkaalaththileathaanea raajaavin sambirathiga'l azhaikkappattaarga'l; morthekaay ka'rpiththapadiyellaam yootharukkum inthutheasammuthal eththiyoappiyaa theasamattumu'l'la noot'rirubaththeazhu naaduga'lin theasaathibathiga'lukkum, athibathiga'lukkum, athigaariga'lukkum, anthantha naattil vazhanggum adcharaththilum, anthantha jaathiyaar peasum baashaiyilum, yootharukkum avarga'l adcharaththilum avarga'l baashaiyilum ezhuthappattathu.

anthak katta'laiga'l agaasvearu raajaavin pearaal ezhuthappattu, raajaavin moathiraththinaal muththirai poadappattapin, kuthiraiga'lmealum veagamaana ottagangga'lmealum, koavea'ru kazhuthaiga'lmealum ea'rippoagi'ra agncha'rkaarar kaiyil anuppappattathu.
avaiga'lil, agaasvearu raajaavudaiya ellaa naaduga'lilum aathaar maatham engi'ra pannira'ndaam maatham pathinmoon'raantheathiyaagiya antha oreanaa'lilea,

anthanthap patta'naththilirukki'ra yoothar on'raaych searnthu, thangga'l piraa'nanaik kaappaat'ravum, thangga'lai viroathikkum saththurukka'laagiya janaththaarum theasaththaarumaana ellaaraiyum, avarga'l kuzhanthaiga'laiyum, sthireega'laiyum azhiththuk kon'ru nirmoolamaakkavum, avarga'l udaimaiga'laik ko'l'laiyidavum, raajaa yootharukkuk katta'laiyittaar en'ru ezhuthiyirunthathu.

yoothar thangga'l pagaignarukkuch sarikkuch sarikkattumpadi niyamiththa an'raiyathinaththil aayaththamaayirukkavea'ndumen'ru anthantha naattilu'l'la sagala janangga'lukkum koo'rappadugi'ratha'rkaagak kodukkappatta katta'laiyin nagal ithuvea; ithu ovvoru naattilum pirasiththampa'n'nappattathu.

appadiyea veagamaana ottagangga'lmealum, koavea'ru kazhuthaiga'lmealum ea'rina agncha'rkaarar raajaavin vaarththaiyinaalea eavappattu, theeviraththoadea pu'rappattuppoanaarga'l; anthak katta'lai soosaan aramanaiyil kodukkappattathu.

appozhuthu morthekaay i'laneelamum ve'l'laiyumaana raajavasthiramum, periya ponmudiyum, pattum iraththaambaramum a'ninthavanaay raajaavinidaththilirunthu pu'rappattaan; soosaan nagaram aarppariththu magizhnthirunthathu.
ivvithamaay yootharukku ve'lichchamum, magizhchchiyum, ka'lippum, kanamum u'ndaayit'ru.

raajaavin vaarththaiyum avanudaiya katta'laiyum poaychsearntha ellaa naaduga'lilum, ellaap patta'nangga'lilum, yootharukku'l'lea athu magizhchchiyum, ka'lippum, virunthu'ndu ko'ndaadum nalla naa'lumaayirunthathu; yootharukkup bayappadugi'ra bayam theasaththu janangga'laip pidiththathinaal, avarga'lil aneagar yoothamaarkkaththil amainthaarga'l.

raajaavin vaarththaiyinpadiyum avanudaiya katta'laiyinpadiyum seyyappadugi'ratha'rku, aathaar maatham engi'ra pannira'ndaam maatham pathinmoon'raan theathiyilea, yootharin pagaignar avarga'lai mea'rko'l'lalaam en'ru nambinaarga'lea; annaa'lileathaanea, yootharaanavarga'l thangga'l pagaignarai mea'rko'l'lumpadikkuk kaariyam maa'ruthalaay mudinthathu.

yoothar agaasvearu raajaavin sagala naaduga'lilumu'l'la patta'nangga'lilea thangga'lukkup pollaappu varappa'n'nap paarththavarga'lmeal kaipoadak koodikko'ndaarga'l; oruvarum avarga'lukku munbaaga ni'rkakkoodaathirunthathu; avarga'laippat'ri sagala janangga'lukkum bayamu'ndaayit'ru.

naaduga'lin sagala athigaariga'lum, theasaathibathiga'lum, thuraiga'lum, raajaavin kaariyangga'lai nadappikki'ravarga'lum, yootharukkuth thu'nainin'raarga'l; morthekaayinaal u'ndaana bayanggaram avarga'laip pidiththathu.
morthekaay raajaavin aramanaiyil periyavanaayirunthaan; avanudaiya keerththi ellaa naaduga'lilum pirasiththamaayit'ru; intha morthekaay enbavan meanmealum periyavanaanaan.
appadiyea yoothar thangga'l saththurukka'laiyellaam pattayaththaal vettik kon'ru nirmoolamaakki, thangga'l ishdappadi thangga'l pagaignarukkuch seythaarga'l.
yoothar soosaan aramanaiyilum ainnoo'rupearaik kon'ru nirmoolamaakkinaarga'l.
ammethaaththaavin kumaaranaagiya aamaan ennum yootharudaiya saththuruvin kumaararaana parsaanthaaththaa, thalpoan, aspaathaa,
poraathaa, athaliyaa, arithaaththaa,
parmashdaa, arisaay, arithaay, vaaysaathaa aagiya paththuppearaiyum kon'rupoattaarga'l.
aanaalum ko'l'laiyidath thangga'l kaiyai neettavillai.
an'raiyathinam soosaan aramanaiyil kon'rupoadappattavarga'lin thogai raajasamugaththil ko'nduvarappattathu.

appozhuthu raajaa, raajaaththiyaagiya estharai noakki: yoothar soosaan aramanaiyil ainnoo'rupearaiyum aamaanin paththuk kumaararaiyum kon'ru nirmoolamaakkinaarga'l; raajaavin mat'ra naaduga'lilum enna seythiruppaarga'loa! ippoathum un vea'nduthal enna? athu unakkuk katta'laiyidappadum; un man'raattu enna? athinpadi seyyappadum en'raan.

appozhuthu esthar: raajaavukkuch siththamaayirunthaal, in'raiyathinaththuk katta'laiyinpadiyea soosaanilirukki'ra yoothar naa'laiyathinamum seyyavum, aamaanin paththuk kumaararin udalaiyum thookkumaraththil thookkippoadavum uththaravaagavea'ndum en'raa'l.
appadiyea seyyumpadikku raajaa uththaravu koduththaan; atha'rkuch soosaanilea katta'lai pi'ranthathu; aamaanin paththuk kumaararudaiya udalaiyum thookkippoattaarga'l.
soosaanilirukki'ra yoothar aathaar maathaththin pathinaalaantheathiyilum koodichsearnthu, soosaanil munnoo'rupearaik kon'rupoattaarga'l; aanaalum ko'l'laiyidath thangga'l kaiyai neettavillai.

raajaavin naaduga'lilu'l'la mat'ra yootharga'l thangga'l piraa'nanaith tha'rkaakkavum, thangga'l pagaignarukku vilagi i'laippaa'ruthal adaiyavum orumikkach searnthu, thangga'l viroathiga'lil ezhubaththaiyaayiram pearaik kon'rupoattaarga'l; aanaalum ko'l'laiyidath thangga'l kaiyai neettavillai.
aathaar maathaththin pathinmoon'raantheathiyilea ippadich seythu, pathinaalaantheathiyilea i'laippaa'ri, athai virunthu'ndu santhoashappadugi'ra pa'ndigai naa'laakkinaarga'l.

soosaanilu'l'la yootharoaven'raal, antha maathaththin pathinmoon'raantheathiyilum pathinaalaantheathiyilum eagamaayk koodi, pathinainthaantheathiyil i'laippaa'ri, athai virunthu'ndu santhoashappadugi'ra pa'ndigai naa'laakkinaarga'l.

aathalaal alanggamillaatha oorga'lil kudiyirukki'ra naattuppu'raththaaraana yootharga'l aathaar maathaththin pathinaalaantheathiyaich santhoashamum, virunthu'ngi'ra poorippumaana naa'lum, oruvarukkoruvar varisaiga'lai anuppugi'ra naa'lumaakkinaarga'l.
morthekaay intha varththamaanangga'lai ezhuthi, sameebaththilum thooraththilum irukki'ra agaasvearu raajaavin sagala naaduga'lilumu'l'la ellaa yootharukkum nirubangga'lai anuppi,

varushanthoa'rum aathaar maathaththin pathinaalaam pathinainthaantheathiga'lai, yoothar thangga'l pagaignarukku neenggalaagi i'laippaa'ruthal adaintha naadka'laagavum, avarga'l sagnchalam santhoashamaagavum, avarga'l thukkam magizhchchiyaagavum maa'rina maathamaagavum aasariththu,
annaadka'lil virunthu'ndu santhoashangko'ndaadavum, oruvarukkoruvar varisaiga'lai anuppavum, e'liyavarga'lukkuth thaanatharmagnseyyavum vea'ndumen'ru thittampa'n'ninaan.
appozhuthu yoothar thaangga'l seyyaththodangginapadiyum morthekaay thangga'lukku ezhuthinapadiyum seyyach sammathiththaarga'l.

ammethaaththaavin kumaaranaagiya aamaan ennum aagaakiyan, yootharukkellaam saththuruvaayirunthu yootharaich sanggarikka ninaiththu, avarga'lai azhikkavum nirmoolamaakkavum, poor ennappatta seettaip poaduviththaan.

aanaalum esthar, raajasamugaththil poay, yootharukku viroathamaay avan ninaiththa avanudaiya pollaatha yoasanai avanudaiya thalaiyinmeal thirumbumpadi katta'lai pi'rappiththathinaalea, avanaiyum avan kumaararaiyum maraththilea thookkippoattaarga'l.

aagaiyinaal antha naadka'l poor ennum pearinaal pooreem ennappattathu; avan antha nirubaththil ezhuthiyiruntha ellaa vaarththaiga'linimiththamum, thaangga'lea intha vishayaththil anubaviththavaiga'linimiththamum, thangga'lukku nearittavaiga'linimiththamum,
yoothar athaith thittappaduththi, antha ira'ndu naadka'laikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rapadiyea, avaiga'lai varushanthoa'rum, avaiga'lin sariyaana kaalaththilea aasariyaamaliruppathillai enbathaiyum,

intha naadka'l ellaath thalaimu'raiga'lilum, vamsangga'lilum, theasangga'lilum, oorga'lilum ninaivukoorappattu aasarikkappadavea'ndum enbathaiyum, inthap pooreem ennum pa'ndigai naadka'l yootharukku'l'lea thava'rippoagaamalum, avaiga'lai ninaivukooruthal thangga'l santhathiyaarukku'l'lea ozhinthupoagaamalum irukkavea'ndum enbathaiyum, thangga'lmealum, thangga'l santhathiyaarmealum, thangga'l maarkkaththil amaiyappoagi'ra mat'ra yaavarmealum kadanaaga niyamiththukko'ndaarga'l.

pooreemaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'ra intha ira'ndaam nirubaththaith thidappaduththumpadikku, abiyaayealin kumaaraththiyaagiya esthar ennum raajaaththiyum, yoothanaagiya morthekaayum, pinnum mahaa u'ruthiyaay ezhuthinaarga'l.

yoothanaagiya morthekaayum, raajaaththiyaagiya estharum yootharukku u'ruthippaadupa'n'ninathum, avarga'lthaanea ubavaasaththoadum ala'ruthaloadum aasarippoam en'ru thangga'lmealum thangga'l santhathiyaarmealum kadanaaga niyamiththukko'ndathumaana, pooreem ennappatta intha naadka'l avaiga'lin sariyaana kaalangga'lil aasarikkappadum kaariyaththai u'ruthiyaakka,
avan agaasvearuvin raajyaththilu'l'la noot'rirubaththeazhu naaduga'lilum irukki'ra ellaa yootharukkum samaathaanamum u'nmaiyumaana vaarththaiga'laiyudaiya nirubangga'lai anuppinaan.
ippadiyea estharin katta'laiyaanathu pooreem naadka'laippat'rina intha varththamaanangga'laith thidappaduththinathu; athu oru pusthagaththil ezhuthappattathu.
raajaavaagiya agaasvearu theasaththinmealum, samuththiraththilu'l'la theevuga'linmealum, paguthi ea'rpaduththinaan.

vallamaiyum baraakkiramamumaana avanudaiya ellaach seygaiga'lum, raajaa periyavanaakkina morthekaayinudaiya meanmaiyin virththaanthamum, meathiyaa persiyaa raajaakka'lin nadapadi pusthagaththil allavoa ezhuthiyirukki'rathu.

yoothanaagiya morthekaay raajaavaagiya agaasvearuvukku ira'ndaavathaanavanum, yootharukku'l periyavanum, than thira'laana sagoathararukkup piriyamaanavanumaayirunthathum an'rith than janangga'ludaiya nanmaiyai naadi, than kulaththaarukkellaam samaathaanamu'ndaagap peasugi'ravanumaayirunthaan.
ooths theasaththilea yoabu ennum pearko'nda oru manushan irunthaan; antha manushan uththamanum sanmaarkkanum, theavanukkup bayanthu, pollaappukku vilagugi'ravanumaayirunthaan.
avanukku eazhu kumaararum, moon'ru kumaaraththiga'lum pi'ranthaarga'l.

avanukku eazhaayiram aaduga'lum, moovaayiram ottagangga'lum, ainnoo'ru earmaaduga'lum, ainnoo'ru kazhuthaiga'lumaagiya mirugajeevanga'l irunthathuman'ri, thira'laana pa'nividaikkaararum irunthaarga'l; athinaal antha manushan kizhakkaththip puththirar ellaarilum periyavanaayirunthaan.
avan kumaarar, avanavan thanthan naa'lilea thanthan veettilea virunthuseythu, thangga'l moon'ru sagoathariga'laiyum thangga'loadea poajanam pa'n'numpadi azhaippaarga'l.

virunthuseygi'ra avaravarudaiya naa'lmu'rai mudigi'rapoathu, yoabu: oruvea'lai en kumaarar paavagnseythu, theavanaith thangga'l iruthayaththilea thooshiththiruppaarga'l en'ru solli, avarga'lai azhaiththanuppi, parisuththappaduththi, athikaalamea ezhunthu, avarga'l ellaarudaiya ilakkaththinpadiyeayum sarvaangga thaganabaliga'laich seluththuvaan; inthappiragaaramaaga yoabu annaadka'lilellaam seythuvaruvaan.
orunaa'l theavapuththirar karththarudaiya sannithiyil vanthu nin'rapoathu, saaththaanum avarga'l naduvilea vanthu nin'raan.
karththar saaththaanaip paarththu: nee enggeayirunthu varugi'raay en'raar. saaththaan karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaga: boomiyenggum ulaavi, athil sut'riththirinthu varugi'rean en'raan.

karththar saaththaanai noakki: en thaasanaagiya yoabinmeal kavanam vaiththaayoa? uththamanum sanmaarkkanum, theavanukkup bayanthu, pollaappukku vilagugi'ravanumaagiya avanaippoalap boomiyil oruvanum illai en'raar.
atha'rkuch saaththaan karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaga: yoabu viruthaavaagavaa theavanukkup bayanthu nadakki'raan?
neer avanaiyum avan veettaiyum avanukku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum sut'ri vealiyadaikkavillaiyoa? avan kaiga'lin kiriyaiyai aaseervathiththeer; avanudaiya sambaththu theasaththil perugit'ru.
aanaalum ummudaiya kaiyai neetti avanukku u'ndaanavaiyellaam thoduveeraanaal, appozhuthu avan umathu mugaththukku ethirea ummaith thooshikkaanoa paarum en'raan.

karththar saaththaanai noakki: ithoa, avanukku u'ndaanavaiyellaam un kaiyilirukki'rathu; avanmealmaaththiram un kaiyai neettaathea en'raar; appozhuthu saaththaan karththarudaiya sannithiyaivittup pu'rappattuppoanaan.
pinbu orunaa'l yoabudaiya kumaararum, avan kumaaraththiga'lum, thangga'l mooththa sagoatharan veettilea pusiththu, thiraadcharasam kudikki'rapoathu,
oru aa'l avanidaththil vanthu: eruthuga'l uzhugi'rapoathu, kazhuthaiga'l avaiga'lin pakkaththilea meaynthuko'ndirukkaiyil,

sabeayar avaiga'lmeal vizhunthu, avaiga'laich saayththukko'ndupoanaarga'l; vealaiyaadka'laiyum pattayakkarukkinaal vettippoattaarga'l; naan oruvanmaaththiram thappi, athai umakku a'rivikkumpadi vanthean en'raan.

ivan ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, vea'roruvan vanthu: vaanaththilirunthu theavanudaiya akkini vizhunthu, aaduga'laiyum vealaiyaadka'laiyum sutteriththuppoattathu; naan oruvanmaaththiram thappi, athai umakku a'rivikkumpadi vanthean en'raan.

ivan ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, vea'roruvan vanthu: kaltheayar moon'ru pavugnchaay vanthu, ottagangga'lmeal vizhunthu, avaiga'lai oattikko'ndupoanaarga'l; vealaiyaadka'laiyum pattayakkarukkinaal vettippoattaarga'l; naan oruvanmaaththiram thappi, athai umakku a'rivikkumpadi vanthean en'raan.
ivan ippadip peasikko'ndirukkaiyil, vea'roruvan vanthu: ummudaiya kumaararum ummudaiya kumaaraththiga'lum, thangga'l mooththa sagoatharan veettilea pusiththuth thiraadcharasam kudikki'rapoathu,

vanaantharavazhiyaayp perungkaat'ru vanthu, antha veettin naalu moolaiyilum adikka, athu pi'l'laiga'linmeal vizhunthathinaal avarga'l i'ranthupoanaarga'l; naan oruvanmaaththiram thappi, athai umakku a'rivikkumpadi vanthean en'raan.
appozhuthu yoabu ezhunthirunthu, than saalvaiyaik kizhiththu, than thalaiyaich siraiththu, tharaiyilea vizhunthu pa'ninthu:
nirvaa'niyaay en thaayin karppaththilirunthu vanthean; nirvaa'niyaay avvidaththukkuth thirumbuvean; karththar koduththaar, karththar eduththaar; karththarudaiya naamaththukku sthoaththiram en'raan.
ivaiyellaavat'rilum yoabu paavagnseyyavumillai, theavanaippat'rik ku'raisollavumillai.
pinnorunaa'lilea theavapuththirar karththarudaiya sannithiyil vanthu nin'rapoathu, saaththaanum avarga'l naduvilea karththarudaiya sannithiyil vanthu nin'raan.
karththar saaththaanaip paarththu: nee enggeayirunthu varugi'raay en'raar; saaththaan karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaga: boomiyenggum ulaavi, athil sut'riththirinthu varugi'rean en'raan.

appozhuthu karththar saaththaanai noakki: nee en thaasanaagiya yoabinmeal kavanam vaiththaayoa? uththamanum sanmaarkkanum, theavanukkup bayanthu, pollaappukku vilagugi'ravanumaana manushanaagiya avanaippoala boomiyil oruvanumillai; mugaantharamillaamal avanai nirmoolamaakkumpadi nee ennai eavinapoathilum, avan innum than uththamaththilea u'ruthiyaay ni'rki'raan en'raar.
saaththaan karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaga: thoalukkup bathilaagath thoalaiyum, than jeevanukkup bathilaagath thanakku u'ndaana ellaavat'raiyum, manushan koduththuviduvaan.
aanaalum neer ummudaiya kaiyai neetti, avan elumbaiyum avan maamsaththaiyum thoduveeraanaal, appozhuthu avan umathu mugaththukku ethirea ummaith thooshikkaanoa paarum en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar saaththaanai noakki: ithoa, avan un kaiyilirukki'raan; aagilum avan piraa'nanaimaaththiram thappavidu en'raar.
appozhuthu saaththaan karththarudaiya sannithiyaivittup pu'rappattu, yoabin u'l'langkaalthodanggi avan uchchanthalaimattum kodiya parukka'laal avanai vaathiththaan.
avan oru oattai eduththu, thannaich su'ra'ndikko'ndu saambalil udkaarnthaan.
appozhuthu avan manaivi avanaip paarththu: neer innum ummudaiya uththamaththil u'ruthiyaay ni'rki'reeroa? theavanaith thooshiththu jeevanai vidum en'raa'l.

atha'rku avan: nee payiththiyakkaari peasugi'rathupoalap peasugi'raay; theavan kaiyilea nanmaiyaip pet'ra naam theemaiyaiyum pe'ravea'ndaamoa en'raan; ivaiga'l ellaavat'rilum yoabu than uthaduga'linaal paavagnseyyavillai.

yoabudaiya moon'ru sineagitharaagiya theamaaniyanaana elippaasum, soogiyanaana bilthaathum, naagamaaththiyanaana soappaarum, yoabukku nearitta theemaiga'l yaavaiyum kea'lvippattapoathu, avanukkaagap parithabikkavum, avanukku aa'ruthalsollavum, oruvaroadoruvar yoasanaipa'n'nikko'ndu, avaravar thangga'l sthalangga'lilirunthu vanthaarga'l.

avarga'l thooraththil varugaiyil thangga'l ka'nga'lai ea'reduththup paarththapoathu, avanai uruththeriyaamal, saththamittu azhuthu, avaravar thangga'l saalvaiyaik kizhiththu, vaanaththaip paarththu: thangga'l thalaiga'lmeal puzhuthiyaith thoot'rikko'ndu,
vanthu, avan thukkam mahaakodiya thukkam en'ru ka'ndu, oruvarum avanoadu oru vaarththaiyaiyum peasaamal, iravupagal eazhunaa'l, avanoadukoodath tharaiyilea udkaarnthirunthaarga'l.
atha'rkuppinbu yoabu than vaayaith thi'ranthu, thaan pi'rantha naa'laich sabiththu,
vasaniththuch sonnathu ennaven'raal:
naan pi'ranthanaa'lum oru aa'npi'l'lai u'rpaththiyaayit'ren'ru sollappatta raaththiriyum azhivathaaga.
antha naa'l anthagaarappaduvathaaga; theavan uyaraththilirunthu athai visaariyaamalum, o'li athinmeal piragaasiyaamalum,
anthagaaramum mara'na iru'lum athaik ka'raippaduththi, mappu athai moodi, manthaaranaa'lin bayanggarangga'l athai arukka'lippaakkuvathaaga.
antha raaththiriyai anthagaaram pidippathaaga; varushaththin naadka'lil athu santhoashappadugi'ra naa'laayiraamalum maathangga'lin ka'nakkilea athu varaamalum poavathaaga.
antha raaththiri thanimaiyaayiruppathaaga; athilea kembeerasaththam illaama'rpoavathaaga.
naa'laich sabikki'ravarga'lum, liviyaathaanai ezhumbappa'n'naththakkavarga'lum, athaich sabippaarga'laaga.
athin asthamanakaalaththil thoan'riya nadchaththirangga'l iru'ndu, athu ethirpaarththiruntha ve'lichcham u'ndaagaamalum, vidiya'rkaalaththu ve'luppai athu kaa'naamalum iruppathaaga.
naan iruntha karppaththin vaasalai athu adaikkaamalum, en ka'nga'l kaa'ngi'ra varuththaththai ma'raiththuvidaamalum irunthathea.
naan karppaththilthaanea azhiyaamalum, karppaththilirunthu pu'rappadugi'rapoathea saagaamalum poanathenna?
ennai eanthikko'l'la madiyum, naan paalu'n'na sthanangga'lum u'ndaayirunthathenna?
appadiyillaathirunthaal, asaiyaamal kidanthu amarnthirunthu,
paazhnilangga'lil thangga'lukku maa'ligaiyaikkattina boomiyin raajaakka'loadum manthirimaarga'loadum,
allathu, ponnai udaiyavarga'lum, thangga'l veeduga'lai ve'l'liyinaal nirappinavarga'lumaana pirabukka'loadungkooda naan ippozhuthu thoonggi i'laippaa'ruveanea.
allathu, ve'lippadaatha muthiraappi'ndampoalavum, ve'lichchaththaik kaa'naatha sisukka'lpoalavum iruppeanea.
thunmaarkkarudaiya thontharavu anggea oaynthirukki'rathu; belanat'ru vidaayththuppoanavarga'l anggea i'laippaa'rugi'raarga'l.
kattu'ndirunthavarga'l anggea eagamaaga amainthirukki'raarga'l; odukkugi'ravanudaiya saththam anggea keadkappadugi'rathillai.
si'riyavanum periyavanum anggea sariyaayirukki'raarga'l; adimai than ejamaanukku neenggalaayirukki'raan.
mara'naththukku aasaiyaayk kaaththirunthu, puthaiyalaith theadugi'rathupoala athaith theadiyum adaiyaama'rpoagi'ravarga'lum,
pireathakkuzhiyaik ka'ndupidiththathinaal migavum ka'likoornthu,
atha'rkaagach santhoashappadugi'ra nirpbaakkiyarumaagiya ivarga'lukku ve'lichchamum, manachsagnchalamu'l'la ivarga'lukku jeevanum kodukkappadugi'rathinaal palan enna?
than vazhiyaik kaa'nakkoodaathapadikku, theavanaal va'lainthuko'l'lappattavanukku ve'lichchaththinaal palan enna?
en poajanaththukku munnea enakkup perumoochchu u'ndaagi'rathu; en katha'ruthal ve'l'lampoal pura'ndupoagi'rathu.
naan bayantha kaariyam enakku nearittathu; naan agnchinathu enakku vanthathu.
enakkuch sugamumillai, i'laippaa'ruthalumillai, amaithalumillai; enakkuth thaththa'lippea nearittathu.
appozhuthu theamaaniyanaagiya elippaas pirathiyuththaramaaga:
naangga'l ummudanea peasaththu'ninthaal, aayaasappaduveeroa? aanaalum peasaamal adakkikko'l'laththakkavan yaar?
ithoa, neer aneagarukkup buththisolli, i'laiththa kaiga'laith thidappaduththineer.
vizhugi'ravanai ummudaiya vaarththaiga'laal ni'rkappa'n'ni, tha'l'laadugi'ra muzhangkaalga'laip balappaduththineer.
ippozhuthoa thunbam umakku nearittapadiyinaal aayaasappadugi'reer; athu ummaith thottathinaal kalanggugi'reer.
ummudaiya theavabakthi ummudaiya u'ruthiyaayum, ummudaiya vazhiga'lin uththamam ummudaiya nambikkaiyaayum irukkavea'ndiyathallavoa?
kut'ramillaamal azhinthavan u'ndoa? sanmaarkkar athampa'n'nappattathu eppoa? ithai ninaiththuppaarum.
naan ka'ndirukki'rapadi, aniyaayaththai uzhuthu, theevinaiyai vithaiththavarga'l, athaiyea a'rukki'raarga'l.
theavanudaiya suvaasaththinaalea avarga'l azhinthu, avarudaiya naasiyin kaat'rinaalea nirmoolamaagi'raarga'l.
singgaththin kerchchippum, thushdasinggaththin muzhakkamum adanggum; baalasinggangga'lin pa'rka'lum thagarnthu poam.
kizhachsinggam iraiyillaamaiyaal maa'ndupoam, baalasinggangga'l sitha'ru'ndupoam.
ippoathum oru vaarththai ennidaththil iragasiyamaay a'rivikkappattathu, athinudaiya melliya oasai en seviyil vizhunthathu.
manusharmeal ayarntha niththirai i'ranggugaiyil, iraaththarisanangga'lil palavitha thoat'rangga'l u'ndaagumpoathu,
thigilum nadukkamum ennaip pidiththathu, en elumbuga'lellaam nadungginathu.
appozhuthu oru aavi en mugaththukku munbaagak kadanthathu, en udalin mayir silirththathu.
athu oru uruppoala en ka'nga'lukkumun nin'rathu, aanaalum athin roobam innathen'ru vi'langgavillai; amaithalu'ndaayit'ru, appozhuthu naan keatta saththamaavathu:
manushan theavanaippaarkkilum neethimaanaayiruppaanoa? manupuththiran thannai u'ndaakkinavaraippaarkkilum suththamaayiruppaanoa?
kea'lum, avar thammudaiya pa'nividaikkaararidaththil nambikkai vaippathillai; thammudaiya thootharinmealum buththiyeenaththaich sumaththugi'raarea,
puzhuthiyil asthibaaram poattu, ma'n veeduga'lil vaasampa'n'ni, pottuppoochchiyaal arikkappadugi'ravarga'lmeal avar nambikkai vaippathu eppadi?
kaalaimuthal maalaivaraikkum madinthu, kavanippaar oruvarumillaamal, niththiya azhivadaigi'raarga'l.
avarga'lilirukki'ra avarga'ludaiya meanmai poayvidumallavoa? gnaanamadaiyaamal saagi'raarga'lea en'ru sonnaan.
ippoathu kooppidum, umakku uththaravu koduppaar u'ndoa paarppoam? parisuththavaanga'lil yaarai noakkip paarppeer?
koabam nirmoodanaik kollum; po'raamai buththiyillaathavanai athampa'n'num.
nirmoodan oruvan vearoon'rugi'rathai naan ka'ndu udanea avan vaasasthalaththaich sabiththean.
avan pi'l'laiga'l iradchippukkuth thooramaagi, thappuvippaarillaamal, vaasalilea no'rukkappattaarga'l.
pasiththavan avan vi'laichchalai mudchediga'lukku'l'lumirunthu pa'riththuth thin'raan; pa'rikaaran avan aasthiyai vizhungginaan.
theenggu puzhuthiyilirunthu u'ndaagi'rathumillai; varuththam ma'n'nilirunthu mu'laikki'rathumillai.
akkinippo'riga'l mealea pa'rakki'rathupoala, manushan varuththam anubavikkap pi'ranthirukki'raan.
aanaalum naan theavanai naadi, en niyaayaththaith theavanidaththil oppuvippean.
aaraaynthu mudiyaatha periya kaariyangga'laiyum, e'n'nimudiyaatha athisayangga'laiyum avar seygi'raar.
thaazhnthavarga'lai uyaraththil vaiththu, thukkikki'ravarga'lai iradchiththu uyarththugi'raar.
avar boomiyinmeal mazhaiyai varushikkappa'n'ni, ve'linilangga'linmeal tha'n'neerga'lai varuvikki'raar.
thanthirakkaararin kaiga'l kaariyaththai mudiya nadaththakkoodaathapadikku, avarga'ludaiya ubaayangga'lai avar abaththamaakkugi'raar.
avar gnaaniga'lai avarga'ludaiya thanthiraththilea pidikki'raar; thiriyaavarakkaararin aaloasanai kavizhkkappadum.
avarga'l paga'rkaalaththilea anthagaaraththukku'l'laagi, maththiyaana vea'laiyilea iravil thadavugi'rathupoalath thadavith thirigi'raarga'l.
aanaalum e'liyavanai avarga'l vaayilirukki'ra pattayaththukkum, belavaanin kaikkum vilakki iradchikki'raar.
athinaal thariththiranukku nambikkai u'ndu; theemaiyaanathu than vaayai moodum.
ithoa, theavan tha'ndikki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan; aagaiyaal sarvavallavarudaiya sidchaiyai a'rpamaaga e'n'naathirum.
avar kaayappaduththik kaayangkattugi'raar; avar adikki'raar, avarudaiya kai aat'rugi'rathu.
aa'ru ikkattuga'lukku ummai neenggalaakkuvaar; eazhaavathilum pollaappu ummaith thodaathu.
pagnchakaalaththilea avar ummai mara'naththukkum, yuththaththilea pattayaththin vettukkum vilakki meedpaar.
naavin savukkukkum ma'raikkappaduveer; paazhaakkuthal varumpoathum bayappadaamaliruppeer.
paazhaakkuthalaiyum pagnchaththaiyum paarththu nagaippeer; kaattumirugangga'lukkum bayappadaamaliruppeer.
ve'liyin kalluga'loadum umakku udanpadikkaiyirukkum; ve'liyin mirugangga'lum ummoadea samaathaanamaayirukkum.
ummudaiya koodaaram samaathaanaththoadirukkak kaa'nbeer; ummudaiya vaasasthalaththai visaarikkumpoathu ku'raivaik kaa'namaatteer.
ummudaiya santhaanam perugi, ummudaiya santhathiyaar boomiyin poo'nduga'laippoala iruppaarga'l enbathai a'rinthuko'lveer.
thaaniyam eat'rakaalaththilea ambaaraththil searugi'rathupoala, muthirvayathilea kalla'raiyil searuveer.
ithoa, naangga'l aaraaynthu a'rinthathu ithuthaan; kaariyam ippadiyirukki'rathu; ithai neer keattu umakku nanmaiyu'ndaaga a'rinthuko'l'lum en'raan.
yoabu pirathiyuththaramaaga:
en sagnchalam ni'rukkappattu, en nirppantham ellaam tharaasilea vaikkappattaal nalamaayirukkum.
appozhuthu athu kada'rkarai ma'nalaippaarkkilum baaramaayirukkum; aagaiyaal en thukkam sollimudiyaathu.
sarvavallavarin ambuga'l enakku'l thaiththirukki'rathu; avaiga'lin visham en uyiraik kudikki'rathu; theavanaal u'ndaagum bayanggarangga'l enakku munbaaga a'niya'niyaay ni'rki'rathu.
pullirukki'ra idaththilea kaattukkazhuthai kaththumoa? thanakkuth theevanamirukki'ra idaththilea eruthu katha'rumoa?
rusiyillaatha pathaarththaththai uppillaamal saappidakkoodumoa? muttaiyin ve'l'laikkaruvil suvai u'ndoa?
ungga'l vaarththaiga'lai en aaththumaa thodamaattean engi'rathu; avaiga'l aroasigamaana poajanampoal irukki'rathu.
aa, en man'raattu enakku aru'lappattu, naan vaagnchippathaith theavan enakkuth thanthu,
theavan ennai no'rukkach siththamaay, thammudaiya kaiyai neetti ennaith thu'ndiththuppoattaal nalamaayirukkum.

appozhuthaavathu enakku aa'ruthal irukkumea; appozhuthu ennaith thappavidaatha noavilea maraththiruppean; parisuththarudaiya vaarththaiga'lai naan ma'raiththuvaikkavillai, avar ennaith thappavidaaraaga.
naan kaaththukko'ndirukka en belan emmaaththiram? en jeevanai neediththirukkappa'n'na en mudivu eppadippattathu?
en belan ka'rka'lin belanoa? en maamsam ve'ngalamoa?
enakku uthaviyaanathu on'rum illaiyallavoa? sagaayam ennaivittu neenggit'rea.
ubaathikkappadugi'ravanukku avanudaiya sineagithanaal thayaikidaikkavea'ndum; avanoa sarvavallavarukkup bayappadaatheapoagi'raan.
en sagoatharar kaattaa'rupoala moasampa'n'nugi'raarga'l; aa'ruga'lin ve'l'laththaippoalak kadanthupoagi'raarga'l.
avaiga'l ku'lirkaalap panikkattiyinaalum, athil vizhunthirukki'ra u'raintha mazhaiyinaalum kalanggalaagi,
ush'nangka'ndavudanea urugi vat'ri, analpattavudanea thangga'l sthalaththil uruvazhinthupoagin'rana.
avaiga'ludaiya vazhiga'lin poakkuga'l inggumanggum piriyum; avaiga'l viruthaavilea paravi on'rum illaama'rpoagum.
theamaavin paya'nakkaarar theadi, seabaavin paya'nakkoottangga'l avaiga'lmeal nambikkai vaiththu,
thaangga'l ippadi nambinathinaalea vedkappadugi'raarga'l; avvidamattum vanthu kalanggippoagi'raarga'l.
appadiyea neengga'lum ippozhuthu on'rukkum uthavaama'rpoaneerga'l; en aabaththaik ka'ndu bayappadugi'reerga'l.
enakku eathaagilum ko'nduvaarungga'l en'rum, ungga'l aasthiyilirunthu enakku yaathoru vegumaanam kodungga'l en'rum;
allathu saththuruvin kaikku ennaith thappuviyungga'l, valladikkaararin kaikku ennai neenggalaakki meettu vidungga'l en'rum naan sonnathu'ndoa?
enakku ubatheasampa'n'nungga'l, naan mavunamaayiruppean; naan ethilea thava'rineanoa athai enakkuth theriyappaduththungga'l.
semmaiyaana vaarththaiga'lil evva'lavu vallamai u'ndu? ungga'l kadinthuko'l'luthalinaal kaariyam enna?
kadinthuko'l'la neengga'l vaarththaiga'lai yoasiththu, nambikkaiyat'ravanudaiya vaarththaiga'laik kaat'rilea vittuvidugi'reerga'loa?
ippadich seythu thikkat'ravanmeal neengga'l vizhunthu, ungga'l sineagithanukkup padukuzhiyai vettugi'reerga'l.
ippoathum ungga'lukkuch siththamaanaal ennai noakkip paarungga'l; appozhuthu naan poysollugi'reanoa en'ru ungga'lukkup piraththiyadchamaay vi'langgum.
neengga'l thirumbungga'l, akkiramam kaa'nappadaathirukkum; thirumbungga'l en neethi athilea vi'langgum.
en naavilea akkiramam u'ndoa? en vaay aagaathavaiga'laip paguththa'riyaathoa?
boomiyilea poaraada manushanukkuk ku'rikkappatta kaalam u'ndallavoa? avan naadka'l oru koolikkaaran naadka'laippoal irukki'rathallavoa?
oru vealaiyaa'l nizhalai vaagnchiththu, oru koolikkaaran than kooliyai varappaarththirukki'rathupoala,
maayaiyaana maathangga'l ennudaiya suthantharamaagi, sagnchalamaana raaththiriga'l enakkuk ku'rikkappattathu.
naan paduththukko'l'lugi'rapoathu, eppozhuthu ezhunthiruppean? iraakkaalam eppozhuthu mudiyum en'ru solli, kizhakku ve'lukkumattum ara'ndu pura'lugi'rathinaal enakkup poathumen'ru poagi'rathu.
en maamsam poochchiga'linaalum, adaipat'rina puzhuthiyinaalum moodappattirukki'rathu; en thoal vediththu aruvaruppaayit'ru.
en naadka'l neygi'ravan e'rigi'ra naadaavilum theeviramaay oadugi'rathu; avaiga'l nambikkaiyillaamal mudinthupoagum.
en piraa'nan kaat'raippoalirukki'rathen'rum, en ka'nga'l ini nanmaiyaik kaa'nappoagi'rathillaiyen'rum ninaiththaru'lum.
ippoathu ennaik kaa'ngi'ravarga'lin ka'nga'l ini ennaik kaa'nbathillai; ummudaiya ka'nga'l enmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu; naanoa illaama'rpoagi'rean.
meagam pa'ranthupoagi'rathupoala, paathaa'laththil i'ranggugi'ravan ini ea'rivaraan.
ini than veettukkuth thirumbaan, avan sthalam ini avanai a'riyaathu.
aagaiyaal naan en vaayai adakkaamal, en aaviyin veathanaiyinaal peasi, en aaththumaththin kasappinaal anggalaayppean.
theavareer enmeal kaaval vaikki'ratha'rku naan samuththiramoa? naan oru thiminggilamoa?
en kattil enakku aa'ruthal kodukkum en'rum, en padukkai en thavippai aat'rum en'rum naan solveanaagil,
neer soppanangga'laal ennaik kalanggappa'n'ni, tharisanangga'laal enakkuth thigilu'ndaakkugi'reer.
athinaal en aaththumaa, nerukku'ndu saagi'rathaiyum, en elumbuga'loadea uyiroadirukki'rathaippaarkkilum, mara'naththaiyum virumbugi'rathu.
ippadiyirukki'rathai aroasikki'rean; ennaa'lum uyiroadirukka virumbean, ennai vittuvidum; en naadka'l maayaithaanea.
manushanai neer oru poruttaaga e'n'nugi'ratha'rkum, avanmeal sinthai vaikki'ratha'rkum,
kaalaithoa'rum avanai visaarikki'ratha'rkum, nimishanthoa'rum avanaich soathikki'ratha'rkum, avan emmaaththiram?
naan en umizhneerai vizhunggaathapadi eththanaikaalam ennai negizhaamalum, ennai vidaamalum iruppeer.
mannuyiraik kaappavarea, paavagnseytheanaanaal umakku naan seyyavea'ndiyathu enna? naan enakkuththaanea baaramaayirukkumpadikku, neer ennai umakku ilakkaaga vaiththathu enna?
en mee'ruthalai neer manniyaamalum, en akkiramaththai neekkaamalum irukki'rathu enna? ippozhuthea ma'n'nil paduththukko'lvean; vidiya'rkaalaththilea ennaith theaduveeraanaal naan irean en'raan.
appozhuthu soogiyanaana bilthaath pirathiyuththaramaaga:
neer enthamattum ippadippattavaiga'laip peasuveer? ethuvaraikkum ummudaiya vaayin vaarththaiga'l balamaana kaat'raippoalirukkum?
theavan niyaayaththaip purattuvaaroa? sarvavallavar neethiyaip purattuvaaroa?
ummudaiya pi'l'laiga'l avarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythirunthaalum avarga'ludaiya paathagaththin aakkinaikku avarga'lai avar oppukkoduththirunthaalum,
neer theavanai ea'rkanavea theadi, sarvavallavarai noakki vi'n'nappagnseythu,
suththamum semmaiyumaay iruntheereayaanaal, appozhuthu avar umakkaaga vizhiththu neethiyu'l'la ummudaiya vaasasthalaththaich saanggoabaanggamaakkuvaar.
ummudaiya thuvakkam a'rpamaayirunthaalum, ummudaiya mudivu sampoora'namaayirukkum.
aagaiyaal, neer munthina thalaimu'raiyaaridaththil visaariththu, avarga'l munnoarga'lin seythiyai aaraaynthupaarum.
naam neat'ru u'ndaanavarga'l, on'rum a'riyoam; boomiyinmeal nammudaiya naadka'l nizhalaippoalirukki'rathu.
avarga'l umakku ubatheasiththu, umakkuth theriviththu, thangga'l iruthayaththilirukkum niyaayangga'lai ve'lippaduththuvaarga'l allavoa?
sea'rillaamal naa'nal oanggi va'larumoa? tha'n'neerillaamal koaraippul mu'laikkumoa?
athu innum pachchaiyaayirukkumpoathea, a'rukkappadaathirunthum mat'ra enthap pullaippaarkkilum seekkiramaay vaadippoam allavoa?
theavanai ma'rakki'ra ellaarudaiya vazhiga'lum appadiyea irukkum; maayakkaararin nambikkai azhinthupoam.
avanudaiya vee'n e'n'nam at'ruppoay, avanudaiya nambikkai silanthippoochchi veedupoalirukkum.
oruvan athin veettinmeal saaynthaal, athu nilaikkamaattaathu, athaip pidiththaal, athu ni'rkaathu.
veyil erikkaathatha'rku munnea avan pachchaichsedi, athin kodiga'l avan thoattaththinmealea padarum;
athin vearga'l ka'rkuviyalil sikki, ka'rpaa'raiyai naadum.
athu athinidaththil iraathapadikku nirmoolamaanapin, athu iruntha idam unnai naan ka'ndathillaiyen'ru ma'ruthalikkum.
ithoa, avan vazhiyin magizhchchi ippadiyea poagi'rathu; aanaalum vea'rea pear ma'n'nilirunthu mu'laippaarga'l.
ithoa, theavan uththamanai ve'rukki'rathumillai, pollaathavarga'lukkuk kaikodukki'rathumillai.
ini avar ummudaiya vaayai nagaippinaalum, ummudaiya uthaduga'laik kembeeraththinaalum nirappuvaar.
ummaip pagaikki'ravarga'l vedkaththaal moodappaduvaarga'l; thunmaarkkarudaiya koodaaram azhinthupoagum en'raan.
atha'rku yoabu pirathiyuththaramaaga:
aam, kaariyam ippadiyirukki'rathu en'ru a'rivean; theavanukku munbaaga manushan neethimaanaayiruppatheppadi?
avar avanoadea vazhakkaadach siththamaayirunthaal, aayiraththil on'rukkaagilum avarukku uththaravu sollamaattaanea.
avar iruthayaththil gnaanamu'l'lavar, belaththil baraakkiramamu'l'lavar; avarukku viroathamaagath thannaik kadinappaduththi vaazhnthavan yaar?
avar parvathangga'laich sadithiyaayp pearkki'raar; thammudaiya koabaththil avaiga'laip purattippoadugi'raar.
boomiyin thoo'nga'l athiraththakkathaay athai athin sthaanaththinin'ru asaiyappa'n'nugi'raar.
avar sooriyanukkuk katta'laiyida athu uthikkaathirukkum; avar nadchaththirangga'lai ma'raiththuppoadugi'raar.
avar oruvarea vaanangga'lai viriththu, samuththira alaiga'linmeal nadakki'ravar.
avar thuruvachchakkara nadchaththirangga'laiyum, mirugaseerishaththaiyum, a'rumeenaiyum, thadcha'na ma'ndalangga'laiyum u'ndaakkinavar.
aaraaynthu mudiyaatha periya kaariyangga'laiyum, e'n'nimudiyaatha athisayangga'laiyum avar seygi'raar.
ithoa, avar en arugil poagi'raar, naan avaraik kaa'nean; avar kadanthupoagi'raar, naan avarai a'riyean.
ithoa, avar pa'riththukko'ndupoagi'raar, avarai ma'rippavan yaar? neer enna seygi'reer en'ru avaraik keadpavan yaar?
theavan thammudaiya koabaththaith thiruppamaattaar; oruvarukkoruvar thu'naini'rki'ra aganggaariga'l avarukku adanggavea'ndum.
ippadiyirukka, avarukku ma'rumozhi kodukkavum, avaroadea vazhakkaadum vaarththaiga'laith therinthuko'l'lavum naan emmaaththiram?
naan neethimaanaayirunthaalum avaroadea vazhakkaadaamal, en niyaayaathibathiyinidaththil irakkaththukkuk kegnchuvean.
naan kegncha, avar enakku uththaravu aru'linaalum, avar en vi'n'nappaththukkuch sevikoduththaar en'ru nambean.
avar pusalinaal ennai mu'rikki'raar; mugaantharamillaamal aneagam kaayangga'lai enakku u'ndaakkugi'raar.
naan moochchuvida enakku idangkodaamal, kasappinaal ennai nirappugi'raar.
belaththaip paarththaal, avarea belaththavar; niyaayaththaip paarththaal, en padchaththil saadchi sollugi'ravan yaar?
naan ennai neethimaanaakkinaalum en vaayea ennaik kut'ravaa'liyaakkum; naan uththaman en'ru sonnaalum, naan maa'rupaadaanavan en'ru athu saadchikodukkum.
naan uththamanen'raalum en u'l'laththai naan a'riyean; en jeevanai aroasippean.
oru kaariyam u'ndu, athaich sollugi'rean; sanmaarkkanaiyum thunmaarkkanaiyum avar azhikki'raar.
savukkaanathu asuppilea vaathiththuk kollumpoathu, avar kut'ramillaathavarga'lin soathanaiyaippaarththu nagaikki'raar.
ulagam thunmaarkkar kaiyil vidappattirukki'rathu; athilirukki'ra niyaayaathibathiga'lin mugaththai moodippoadugi'raar; avar ithaich seygi'rathillaiyen'raal, pinnai yaar ithaich seygi'raar.
en naadka'l agncha'rkaarar oattaththilum theeviramaayirukki'rathu; avaiga'l nanmaiyaik kaa'naamal pa'ranthupoam.
avaiga'l veagamaay oadugi'ra kappalga'laippoalavum, iraiyinmeal paaygi'ra kazhugaippoalavum kadanthupoagi'rathu.
en anggalaayppai naan ma'ranthu, en mugaththin thukkaththai maat'ri, thidanko'lvean en'ru sonnaal,
en varuththangga'laippat'rip bayamaayirukki'rean; ennaik kut'ramillaathavanaaga e'n'namaatteer en'ru a'rivean.
naan pollaathavanaayirunthaal, viruthaavaayp poaraadavea'ndiyathu enna?
naan u'raintha mazhaith tha'n'neeril muzhugi, en kaiga'laich savukkaaraththinaal suththampa'n'ninaalum,
neer ennaich seat'ruppa'l'laththilea amizhththuveer. appozhuthu en vasthiramea ennai aruvarukkum.
naan avarukkup pirathiyuththaram sollugi'ratha'rkum, naangga'l koodi niyaayaththi'rku varugi'ratha'rkum, avar ennaippoala manushan allavea.
engga'l iruvarmealum than kaiyai vaikkaththakka maththiyasthan engga'lukku'l illaiyea.
avar thamathu milaat'rai ennai vittu agat'ruvaaraaga; avarudaiya bayanggaram ennaik kalanggappa'n'naathiruppathaaga.
appozhuthu naan avarukkup bayappadaamal peasuvean; ippozhuthoa appadich seyya idamillai.
en aaththumaa jeevanai aroasikki'rathu, naan en thuyaraththukku enakku'l'lea idangkoduththu, en manachsagnchalaththinaalea peasuvean.
naan theavanai noakki: ennaik kut'ravaa'liyen'ru theerkkaathirum; neer ethinimiththam ennoadea vazhakkaadugi'reer, athai enakkuth theriyappaduththum enbean.
neer ennai odukki, ummudaiya kaiga'lin kiriyaiyai ve'ruththu, thunmaarkkarin yoasanaiyaik kirubaiyaayp paarkki'rathu umakku nan'raayirukkumoa?
maamsak ka'nga'l umakku u'ndoa? manushan paarkki'rapiragaaramaayp paarkki'reeroa?
neer en akkiramaththaik ki'ndikki'lappi, en paavaththai aaraaynthu visaarikki'ratha'rku,
ummudaiya naadka'l oru manushanudaiya naadka'laippoalavum, ummudaiya varushangga'l oru purushanudaiya jeevakaalaththaippoalavum irukki'rathoa?
naan thunmaarkkan alla enbathu umakkuth theriyum; ummudaiya kaikku ennaith thappuvikki'ravan illai.
ummudaiya karangga'l ennaiyum enakkuriya ellaavat'raiyum uruvaakkip padaiththirunthum, ennai nirmoolamaakkugi'reer.
ka'lima'npoala ennai uruvaakkineer enbathaiyum, ennaith thirumbath thoo'laagappoagappa'n'nuveer enbathaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
neer ennaip paalpoal vaarththu, thayirpoal u'raiyappa'n'nineer allavoa?
thoalaiyum sathaiyaiyum enakkuth thariththu, elumbuga'laalum narambuga'laalum ennai isaiththeer.
enakku jeevanaith thanthathum allaamal, thayavaiyum enakkup paaraattineer; ummudaiya paraamarippu en aaviyaik kaappaat'rinathu.
ivaiga'l ummudaiya u'l'laththil ma'rainthirunthaalum, ithu umakku'l irukki'rathu en'ru a'rivean.
naan paavagnseythaal, athai neer ennidaththil visaariththu, en akkiramaththai enmeal sumaththaamal videer.

naan thunmaarkkanaayirunthaal enakku aiyoa! naan neethimaanaayirunthaalum en thalaiyai naan edukkamaattean; avamaanaththaal nirappappattean; neer en si'rumaiyaip paarththaru'lum, athu athigarikki'rathu.
singgaththaippoala ennai veattaiyaadi, enakku viroathamaay umathu athisaya vallamaiyai vi'langgappa'n'nugi'reer.
neer ummudaiya saadchiga'lai enakku viroathamaay irattikkappa'n'nugi'reer; enmeal ummudaiya koabaththai athigarikkappa'n'nugi'reer; poaraattaththinmeal poaraattam athigarikki'rathu.
neer ennaik karppaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ninathu enna? oru ka'n'num ennaik kaa'naathapadi, naan appozhuthea jeeviththuppoanaal nalamaamea.
naan orukkaalum illaathathu poalirunthu, karppaththilirunthu pireathakkuzhikkuk ko'ndupoagappattiruppean.
en naadka'l kognchamallavoa?

kaariru'lum mara'naanthagaaramumaana iru'nda theasamum, iru'lsoozhntha ozhunggillaatha mara'naanthagaaramu'l'la theasamum, o'liyum iru'laagum theasamumaagiya, poanaal thirumbivaraatha theasaththukku, naan poagumunnea,
naan sat'ru i'laippaa'rumpadi neer ennaivittu oaynthirum en'raan.
appozhuthu naagamaaththiyanaagiya soappaar pirathiyuththaramaaga:
earaa'lamaana vaarththaiga'lukku uththaravu sollavea'ndaamoa? vaaychsaalagan neethimaanaay vi'langguvaanoa?
ummudaiya veembuvaarththaiga'lukku manushar mavunamaayiruppaarga'loa? neer pariyaasampa'n'numpoathu, oruvarum ummai vedkappaduththa vea'ndaamoa?
en sol suththam en'rum, naan theavareerudaiya paarvaikkuth thuppuravaanavan en'rum neer sollugi'reer.
aanaalum theavan peasi, umakku viroathamaayth thammudaiya uthaduga'laith thi'ranthu,

umakku gnaanaththin iragasiyangga'lai ve'lippaduththinaal nalamaayirukkum; u'l'lapadi paarththaal, athu irattippu'l'lathaayirukki'rathu; aagaiyaal ummudaiya akkiramaththi'rkeat'rapadi theavan ummaith tha'ndikkavillaiyen'ru a'rinthuko'l'lum.
theavanudaiya antharangga gnaanaththai neer aaraaynthu, sarvavallavarudaiya sampoora'naththai neer a'riyakkoodumoa?
athu vaanapariyantham uyarnthathu; ummaal enna aagum? athu paathaa'laththilum aazhamaanathu, neer a'riyakkoodiyathu enna?
athin a'lavu boomiyaippaarkkilum nee'lamum, samuththiraththaippaarkkilum agalamumaayirukki'rathu.
avar pidiththaalum, avar adaiththaalum, avar niyaayaththil ko'nduvanthu ni'ruththinaalum, avaraith thadaipa'n'nugi'ravan yaar?
manusharudaiya maayaththai avar a'rivaar; akkiramaththai avar ka'ndum, athaik kavaniyaathiruppaaroa?
buththiyillaatha manushan kaattukkazhuthaikkuttikku oppaagap pi'ranthirunthaalum, perunegnchu'l'lavanaayirukki'raan.
neer ummudaiya iruthayaththai aayaththappaduththi, ummudaiya kaiga'lai avarukku nearaaga viriththaal nalamaayirukkum.
ummudaiya kaiyilea akkiramam irunthaal, athaith thooraththil agat'rivittu, aniyaayam ummudaiya koodaarangga'lil vaasamaayirukkavottaathirum.
appozhuthu ummudaiya mugaththai maasillaamal ea'reduththu, bayappadaamal thidanko'ndiruppeer.
appozhuthu neer varuththaththai ma'ranthu, kadanthupoana tha'n'neeraippoala athai ninaippeer.
appozhuthu ummudaiya aayusukaalam pattappagalaippaarkkilum piragaasamaayirukkum; iru'l adaintha neer vidiya'rkaalaththaippoaliruppeer.
nambikkai u'ndaayirukki'rathinaal thidanaayiruppeer; thoa'ndi aaraaynthu sugamaayp paduththukko'lveer.
bayappaduththuvaarillaamal niththirai seyveer; aneagar umathu mugaththai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvaarga'l.
thunmaarkkarudaiya ka'nga'l pooththuppoay, avarga'l adaikkalam avarga'lai vittozhinthu, avarga'l nambikkai saagi'ravan suvaasampoal azhinthupoagum en'raan.
yoabu pirathiyuththaramaaga:
aam, neengga'lea gnaanamu'l'la janangga'l; ungga'ludanea gnaanam saagum.
ungga'laippoala enakkum buththiyu'ndu; ungga'lilum naan thaazhnthavan alla; ippadippattavaiga'lai a'riyaathavan yaar?
en sineagitharaal naan ninthikkappattu, theavanai noakkip piraarththippean; avar enakku ma'ruuththaravu aru'luvaar; uththamanaagiya neethimaan pariyaasampa'n'nappadugi'raan.
aabaththukku'l'laanavan sugamaayirukki'ravanudaiya ninaivil igazhchchiyadaigi'raan; kaalida'rinavarga'lukku ithu nearidum.
ka'l'larudaiya koodaarangga'lil selvamu'ndu; theavanaik koabappaduththugi'ravarga'lukkuch saanggoabaanggamu'ndu; avarga'l kaiyilea theavan ko'nduvanthu kodukki'raar.
ippoathum nee mirugangga'laik keattuppaar, avaiga'l unakkup poathikkum; aagaayaththup pa'ravaiga'laik kea'l, avaiga'l unakku a'rivikkum.
allathu boomiyai visaariththuk kea'l, athu unakku ubatheasikkum; samuththiraththin machchangga'laik kea'l, avaiga'l unakku vivarikkum.
karththarudaiya karam ithaich seythathen'ru ivaiga'lellaavat'rinaalum a'riyaathavan yaar?
sagala piraa'niga'lin jeevanum, maamsamaana sagala manusharin aaviyum avar kaiyilirukki'rathu.
vaayaanathu poajanaththai rusipaarkki'rathupoala, seviyaanathu vaarththaiga'laich soathiththuppaarkki'rathallavaa?
muthiyoaridaththil gnaanamum vayathusen'ravarga'lidaththil buththiyum irukkumea.
avaridaththil gnaanamum vallamaiyum eththanai athigamaay irukkum? avarukkuththaan aaloasanaiyum buththiyum u'ndu.
ithoa, avar idiththaal kattamudiyaathu; avar manushanai adaiththaal viduvikkamudiyaathu.
ithoa, avar tha'n'neerga'lai adakkinaal ellaam ularnthupoam; avar avaiga'lai varavittaal, boomiyaik keezhathumealathaakkum.
avaridaththil belanum gnaanamumu'ndu; moasampoagi'ravanum moasampoakkugi'ravanum, avar kaiyin keezhirukki'raarga'l.
avar aaloasanaikkaararaich si'raipidiththu, niyaayaathibathiga'lai mathimayakkugi'raar.
avar raajaakka'ludaiya kattuga'lai avizhththu, avarga'l iduppuga'laik kachchaikattugi'raar.
avar manthiriga'laich si'raipidiththukko'ndupoay, belavaanga'laik kavizhththuppoadugi'raar.
avar nambikkaiyu'l'lavarga'ludaiya vaakkai vilakki, muthirvayathu'l'lavarga'lin aaloasanaiyai vaanggippoadugi'raar.
avar pirabukka'linmeal igazhchchi varappa'n'nugi'raar; balavaanga'lin kachchaiyaith tha'larnthupoagappa'n'nugi'raar.
avar anthagaaraththilirukki'ra aazhangga'lai ve'liyaranggamaakki, mara'na iru'lai ve'lichchaththil ko'nduvarugi'raar.
avar jaathiga'laip perugavum azhiyavum pa'n'nugi'raar; avar jaathiga'laip paravavum ku'rugavum pa'n'nugi'raar.
avar boomiyilu'l'la janaththinudaiya athibathiga'lin negnchai agat'rippoattu, avarga'lai vazhiyillaatha antharaththilea alaiyappa'n'nugi'raar.
avarga'l ve'lichchamat'ra iru'lilea thadaviththirigi'raarga'l; ve'riththavarga'laippoala avarga'laith thadumaa'rith thiriyappa'n'nugi'raar.
ithoa, ivaiga'lellaavat'raiyum en ka'n ka'ndu, en kaathu keattu a'rinthirukki'rathu.
neengga'l a'rinthirukki'rathai naanum a'rinthirukki'rean; naan ungga'lukkuth thaazhnthavan alla.
sarvavallavaroadea naan peasinaal nallathu; theavanoadea niyaayaththi'rkaaga vazhakkaada virumbuvean.
neengga'l poyyaip pi'naikki'ravarga'l; neengga'l ellaarum kaariyaththukkuthavaatha vaiththiyarga'l.
neengga'l peasaamalirunthaal nalamaagum; athu ungga'lukku gnaanamaayirukkum.
neengga'l en niyaayaththaik keattu, en uthaduga'l sollum viseashangga'laik kavaniyungga'l.
neengga'l theavanukkaaga niyaayakkeadaayp peasi, avarukkaaga vagnchagamaay vasanikkavea'ndumoa?
avarukku mugathaadchi'niyam pa'n'nuveerga'loa? theavanukkaaga vazhakkaaduveerga'loa?
avar ungga'lai aaraaynthupaarththaal athu ungga'lukku nalamaayirukkumoa? manushanaip pariyaasampa'n'nugi'rathupoala avaraip pariyaasampa'n'nuveerga'loa?
neengga'l antharanggamaay mugathaadchi'niyampa'n'ninaal, avar ungga'lai evvithaththilum ka'ndippaar.
avarudaiya magaththuvam ungga'laith thidukkidappa'n'naathoa? avarudaiya bayanggaram ungga'laip pidikkamaattaathoa?
ungga'l pearai ninaikkappa'n'num adaiyaa'langga'l saambalukkuch sari; ungga'l meattimaiga'l seat'rukkuviyalga'lukkuch samaanam.
neengga'l mavunamaayirungga'l, naan peasugi'rean, enakku varugi'rathu varattum.
naan en pa'rka'linaal en sathaiyaip pidunggi, en piraa'nanai en kaiyilea vaippaanean?
avar ennaik kon'rupoattaalum, avarmeal nambikkaiyaayiruppean; aanaalum en vazhiga'lai avarukku munbaaga roobagaarampa'n'nuvean.
avarea en iradchippu; maayakkaaranoa avar sannithiyil searaan.
en vasanaththaiyum, naan sollik kaa'nbikki'rathaiyum, ungga'l seviga'laal kavanamaayk kea'lungga'l.
ithoa, en niyaayangga'lai a'niya'niyaaga vaiththean; en neethi vi'langgum en'ru a'rivean.
ennoadea vazhakkaadavea'ndumen'ru irukki'ravan yaar? naan mavunamaayirunthaal jeeviththuppoaveanea.
ira'ndu kaariyangga'laimaaththiram enakkuch seyyaathiruppeeraaga; appozhuthu umathu mugaththukku munbaaga o'liththukko'l'laathiruppean.
ummudaiya kaiyai ennaivittuth thoorappaduththum; ummudaiya bayanggaram ennaik kalanggappa'n'naathiruppathaaga.
neer kooppidum, naan uththaravu koduppean; allathu naan peasuvean; neer enakku ma'rumozhi sollum.
en akkiramangga'lum paavangga'lum eththanai? en mee'ruthalaiyum en paavaththaiyum enakku u'narththum.
neer umathu mugaththai ma'raiththu, ennai umakkup pagaignanaaga e'n'nuvaanean?
kaat'radiththa sarugai no'rukkuveeroa? kaaynthupoana thurumbaip pinthodaruveeroa?
mahaa kasappaana theerppuga'lai enpearil ezhuthugi'reer; en si'ruvayathin akkiramangga'lai enakkup palikkappa'n'nugi'reer.
en kaalga'laith thozhuvadiththuppoattu, en vazhiga'laiyellaam kaavalpa'n'nugi'reer; en kaaladiga'lil adaiyaa'laththaip poadugi'reer.
ippadippattavan azhugippoagi'ra vasthupoalavum, pottariththa vasthirampoalavum azhinthupoavaan.
sthireeyinidaththil pi'rantha manushan vaazhnaa'l ku'ruginavanum sagnchalam ni'rainthavanumaayirukki'raan.
avan poovaippoalap pooththu a'ruppu'ngi'raan; nizhalaippoala nilaini'rkaamal oadippoagi'raan.
aagilum ippadippattavanmeal neer ummudaiya ka'nga'laith thi'ranthuvaiththu, ummudaiya niyaayaththukku ennaik ko'ndupoaveeroa?
asuththamaanathilirunthu suththamaanathaip pi'rappikkaththakkavan u'ndoa? oruvanumillai.
avanudaiya naadka'l immaaththiram en'ru ku'rikkappattirukkaiyaal, avanudaiya maathangga'lin thogai ummidaththil irukki'rathu; avan kadanthupoagakkoodaatha ellaiyai avanukku ea'rpaduththineer.
avan oru koolikkaaranaippoal than naa'lin vealaiyaayit'ru en'ru rammiyappadumattum avan oaynthirukkumpadi umathu paarvaiyai avanai vittu vilakkum.
oru maraththaikku'riththaavathu nambikkaiyu'ndu; athu vettippoadappattaalum thirumbath thazhaikkum, athin i'langki'laiga'l thu'lirkkum;
athin vear tharaiyilea pazhaiyathaagi, athin adikkattai ma'n'nilea seththaalum,
tha'n'neerin vaasanaiyinaal athu thu'lirththu, i'lamarampoalak ki'laividum.
manushanoaven'raal seththapin ozhinthupoagi'raan, manupuththiran jeeviththuppoanapin avan enggea?
tha'n'neer eariyilirunthu vadinthu, ve'l'lam vat'rich suva'rippoagi'rathupoala,
manushan paduththukkidakki'raan, vaanangga'l ozhinthupoaguma'lavum ezhunthirukki'rathum illai, niththirai the'linthu vizhikki'rathum illai.
neer ennaip paathaa'laththil o'liththu, umathu koabam theerumattum ennai ma'raiththu, ennaith thirumba ninaikkumpadikku enakku oru kaalaththaik ku'riththaal nalamaayirukkum.
manushan seththapin pizhaippaanoa? enakku maa'ruthal eppoathu varumen'ru enakkuk ku'rikkappatta poaraattaththin naa'lellaam naan kaaththirukki'rean.
ennaik kooppidum, appozhuthu naan umakku uththaravu solluvean; umathu kaiga'lin kiriyaiyinmeal viruppam vaippeeraaga.
ippozhuthu en nadaiga'lai e'n'nugi'reer; en paavaththinmealallavoa kavanamaayirukki'reer.
en mee'ruthal oru kattaagak kattappattu muththiraipoadappattirukki'rathu, en akkiramaththai orumikkach searththeer.
malaimuthalaay vizhunthu karainthupoam; kanmalai than idaththaivittup pearnthupoam.
tha'n'neer ka'rka'laik kudaiyum; jalappiravaagam boomiyin thoo'lil mu'laiththathai moodum; appadiyea manushan ko'ndirukkum nambikkaiyai azhikki'reer.
neer en'raikkum avanaip belanaay nerukkugi'rathinaal avan poay vidugi'raan; avan mugaroobaththai maa'rappa'n'ni avanai anuppividugi'reer.
avan pi'l'laiga'l kanamadainthaalum avan u'naraan; avarga'l si'rumaippattaalum avarga'laik kavaniyaan.
avan maamsam avanilirukkuma'lavum atha'rku noavirukkum; avan aaththumaa avanukku'l'lirukkumattum atha'rkuth thukkamu'ndu en'raan.
appozhuthu theamaaniyanaagiya elippaas pirathiyuththaramaaga:
gnaanavaan kaat'raippoan'ra niyaayangga'laich solli, than vayit'raik ko'ndalkaat'rinaal nirappi,
pirayoajanamillaatha vaarththaiga'laalum, ubayoagamillaatha vasanangga'laalum tharkkikkalaamoa?
neer bayabakthiyai vee'nen'ru solli, theavanukku munbaaga jebaththiyaanaththaik ku'raiyappa'n'nugi'reer.
ummudaiya vaay ummudaiya akkiramaththaich sollikkaattugi'rathu; neer thanthiramu'l'lavarga'lin naavaith therinthuko'ndeer.
naan alla, ummudaiya vaayea ummaik kut'ravaa'li en'ru theerkki'rathu; ummudaiya uthaduga'lea umakku viroathamaagach saadchiyidugi'rathu.
manusharil munthip pi'ranthavar neerthaanoa? parvathangga'lukkumunnea uruvaakkappatteeroa?
neer theavanudaiya iragasiya aaloasanaiyaik keattu, gnaanaththai ummidamaaych searththukko'ndeeroa?
naangga'l a'riyaatha enthak kaariyaththai neer a'rinthirukki'reer? engga'lukku vi'langgaatha enthak kaariyamaavathu umakku vi'langgiyirukki'rathoa?
ummudaiya thagappanaippaarkkilum periya vayathu'l'la naraiththoarum viruththaappiyarum engga'lukku'l irukki'raarga'lea.
theavan aru'liya aa'ruthalga'lum, ummoadea sollappadugi'ra miruthuvaana peachchum umakku a'rpakaariyamaayirukki'rathoa?
ummudaiya iruthayam ummai enggea ko'ndupoagi'rathu? ummudaiya ka'nga'l ne'riththuppaarkki'rathu enna?
theavanukku viroathamaaga ummudaiya aaviyai ezhuppi, ummudaiya vaayilirunthu vasanangga'laip pu'rappadappa'n'nugi'reer.
manushanaanavan parisuththamaayirukki'ratha'rkum, sthireeyinidaththil pi'ranthavan neethimaanaayirukki'ratha'rkum, avan emmaaththiram?
ithoa, thammudaiya parisuththavaanga'laiyum avar nambugi'rathillai; vaanangga'lum avar paarvaikkuch suththamaanavaiga'l alla.
aniyaayaththaith tha'n'neeraippoalak kudikki'ra manushan eththanai athigamaay aruvaruppum asuththamumaayirukki'raan?
umakkuk kaariyaththaith theriyappa'n'nuvean, ennaik kea'lum; naan ka'ndathai umakku vivariththuch solluvean.
gnaaniga'l thangga'l pithaakka'l sollak keattu ma'raikkaamal a'riviththathaiyea naan solluvean.
avarga'lukkumaaththiram boomi a'likkappattathu; anniyar avarga'l naduvea kadanthupoaga idamillai.
thunmaarkkan uyiroadirukki'ra naa'lellaam thunbaththaal vaathikkappadugi'raan; balavanthampa'n'nugi'ravanukku avan varushangga'lin thogai ma'raikkappattirukki'rathu.
bayanggaramaana saththam avan kaathuga'lil thonikki'rathu; avan samaathaanamaayirukkaiyil paazhaakki'ravan avanmeal varuvaan.
iru'lilirunthu thirumbivara avanukku nambikkaiyillaamal, pathivirukki'ravarga'lin pattayaththukku avan bayappadugi'raan.
appam enggea kidaikkum en'ru avan alainthu thirigi'raan; anthagaaranaa'l thanakkuch sameebiththirukki'rathai a'rivaan.
ikkattum nerukkamum avanaik kalanggappa'n'ni, yuththasannaththanaana raajaavaippoala avanai mea'rko'l'lum.
avan theavanukku viroathamaagak kai neetti, sarvavallavarukku viroathamaagap baraakkiramam paaraattugi'raan.
kadinakkazhuththoadum, paruththa kumizhu'l'la than keadayangga'loadum avarukku ethiraaga oadugi'raan.
avan mugaththaik kozhuppu moodiyirukki'rathu; adivayi'ru thonthi vittirukki'rathu.
aanaalum paazhaana patta'nangga'lilum, kudipoana ka'rkuviyalaana veeduga'lilum vaasampa'n'nuvaan.
avan aisuvariyavaanaavathumillai, avan aasthi nilaippathumillai; appadippattavarga'lin selvam boomiyil neediththiruppathillai.
iru'lukku avan thappuvathillai; akkinijuvaalai avanudaiya ki'laiyaik kaaynthupoagappa'n'num; avarudaiya vaayin suvaasaththaal at'ruppoavaan.
vazhithappinavan maayaiyai nambaanaaga; nambinaal maayaiyea avan palanaayirukkum.
athu avan naa'l varumunnea avanukkup poora'namaayp palikkum; avanudaiya koppup pachchaiko'lvathillai.
pignchuga'l uthirnthupoagi'ra thiraadchachsediyaippoalavum, pookka'l uthirnthupoagi'ra olivamaraththaippoalavum avan iruppaan.
maayakkaararin koottam ve'rumaiyaayp poam; parithaanam vaangginavarga'lin koodaarangga'lai akkini padchikkum.
appadippattavan aniyaayaththaik karppanthariththu akkiramaththaip pe'rugi'raan; avarga'l karppam maayaiyaip pi'rappikkum en'raan.
atha'rku yoabu pirathiyuththaramaaga:
ippadippatta aneagang kaariyangga'lai naan keattirukki'rean; neengga'l ellaarum alattu'ndaakkugi'ra theat'raravaa'lar.
kaat'raippoan'ra vaarththaiga'lukku mudiviraathoa? ippadi nee uththaravusolla unakkuth thu'nivu u'ndaanathenna?
ungga'laippoala naanum peasakkoodum; naan irukkum nilaimaiyil neengga'l irunthaal, naan ungga'lukku viroathamaaga vaarththaiga'laik koarththu, ungga'lukku ethirea en thalaiyaith thulukkavungkoodum.
aanaalum naan en vaayinaal ungga'lukkuth thidansolluvean, en uthaduga'lin asaivu ungga'l thukkaththai aat'rum.
naan peasinaalum en thukkam aa'raathu; naan peasaamalirunthaalum enakku enna aa'ruthal?
ippoathu avar ennai i'laiththuppoagach seythaar; en koottaththaiyellaam paazhaakkineer.
neer ennaich surunggippoagappa'n'ninathu atha'rkuch saadchi; en melivu ennil aththaadchiyaaga nin'ru, en mugaththukku munbaaga uththaravu sollum.
ennaip pagaikki'ravanudaiya koabam ennaip pee'rugi'rathu, enpearil pa'rkadikki'raan; en saththuru kodiya ka'n'ninaal ennaip paarkki'raan.
enakku viroathamaagath thangga'l vaayai virivaayth thi'ranthaarga'l; ninthaiyaaga ennaik kannaththil adiththaarga'l; enakku viroathamaaga eagamaayk koottangkoodinaarga'l.
theavan ennai aniyaayakkaaran vasamaaga oppuviththu, thunmaarkkarin kaiyil ennai agappadappa'n'ninaar.
naan sugamaay vaazhnthirunthean; avar ennai narukki, en pidariyaip pidiththu, ennai no'rukki, ennaith thamakku ilakkaaga ni'ruththinaar.
avarudaiya villaa'lar ennaich soozhnthuko'ndaarga'l; en eeralaith thappavidaamal pi'lanthaar; en pichchaith tharaiyil oot'rivittaar.
no'rukkuthalinmeal no'rukkuthalai enmeal varappa'n'ninaar; baraakkiramasaaliyaippoala enmeal paaynthaar.
naan irattuchsealaiyaith thaiththu, en thoa'linmeal poarththukko'ndean; en magimaiyaip puzhuthiyilea poattuvittean.
azhugi'rathinaal en mugam azhukkadainthathu; mara'na iru'l en ka'n'nimaiga'linmeal u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
en kaiga'lilea kodumaiyillaathirukkaiyilum, en jebam suththamaayirukkaiyilum, appadiyaayit'ru.
boomiyea, en iraththaththai moodippoadaathea; en ala'ruthalukku ma'raividam u'ndaagaathiruppathaaga.
ippoathum ithoa, en saadchi paraloagaththilirukki'rathu, enakkuch saadchi pagarugi'ravar unnathangga'lil irukki'raar.
en sineagithar ennaip pariyaasampa'n'nugi'raarga'l; en ka'n theavanai noakkik ka'n'neer sorigi'rathu.
oru manupuththiran than sineagithanukkaaga vazhakkaadugi'rathupoala, theavanoadea manushanukkaaga vazhakkaadugi'ravar oruvar u'ndaanaal nalamaayirukkum.
ku'rugina varushangga'lukku mudivu varugi'rathu; naan thirumbivaraatha vazhiyea poavean.
en suvaasam ozhigi'rathu, en naadka'l mudigi'rathu; pireathakkuzhi enakku aayaththamaayirukki'rathu.
pariyaasampa'n'nugi'ravarga'l ennidaththil illaiyoa? avarga'l seyyum aniyaayangga'lai en ka'n paarththukko'ndirukki'rathu.
theavareer en kaariyaththai mealpoattukko'ndu, enakkaagap pi'naippaduveeraaga; vea'rea yaar enakkuk kaikodukkaththakkavar?
neer avarga'l iruthayaththukku gnaanaththai ma'raiththeer; aagaiyaal avarga'lai uyarththaathiruppeer.
evan than sineagitharukkuk keadaagath thuroagam peasugi'raanoa, avan pi'l'laiga'lin ka'nga'lum pooththuppoagum.
janangga'lukku'l'lea avar ennaip pazhamozhiyaaga vaiththaar; avarga'l mugaththukkumun naan aruvaruppaanean.
ithinimiththam en ka'nga'l sagnchalaththinaal iru'ladainthathu; en avayavangga'lellaam nizhalaippoalirukki'rathu.
sanmaarkkar itha'rkaagap piramippaarga'l; kut'ramillaathavan maayakkaaranukku viroathamaaga ezhumbuvaan.
neethimaan than vazhiyai u'ruthiyaayp pidippaan; suththamaana kaiga'lu'l'lavan meanmealum balaththuppoavaan.
ippoathum neengga'l ellaarum poayvaarungga'l; ungga'lil gnaanamu'l'la oruvanaiyum kaa'nean.
en naadka'l poayit'ru; en iruthayaththil enakku u'ndaayiruntha sinthanaiga'l at'ruppoayit'ru.
avaiga'l iravaip pagalaakkit'ru; iru'lai ve'lichcham thodarnthuvarum en'ru e'n'nachseythathu.
appadi naan kaaththukko'ndirunthaalum, paathaa'lam enakku veedaayirukkum; iru'lil en padukkaiyaip poaduvean.
azhivaippaarththu, nee enakkuth thagappan engi'rean; puzhukka'laip paarththu, neengga'l enakkuth thaayum enakkuch sagoathariyum engi'rean.
en nambikkai ippoathu enggea? naan nambiyirunthathaik kaa'nbavan yaar?
athu paathaa'laththin kaavalukku'l i'ranggum; appoathu thoo'lil eagamaay i'laippaa'ruvoam en'raan.
appozhuthu soogiyanaana bilthaath pirathiyuththaramaaga:
neengga'l enthamattum peachchuga'lai mudikkaathiruppeerga'l? buththimaanga'laayirungga'l; naangga'lum peasattum.
naangga'l mirugangga'laippoala e'n'nappattu, ungga'l paarvaikkuth theezhppaanavarga'laayiruppaanean?
koabaththinaal ummaiththaanea pee'rugi'ra umathunimiththam boomi paazhaayppoagumoa? kanmalai thannidaththai vittup pearumoa?
thunmaarkkanudaiya vi'lakku a'nainthupoam; avan aduppin neruppum avinthupoam.
avan koodaaraththil ve'lichcham anthagaarappadum; avan vi'lakku avanudanea a'nainthupoam.
avan belanaay nadantha nadaiga'l ku'rainthupoam; avan aaloasanai avanai vizhappa'n'num.
avan than kaalga'linaal valaiyil agappattu, valaichsikkalilea nadakki'raan.
ka'n'ni avan kuthikaalaip pidikkum; pa'rikaarar avanai mea'rko'lvaarga'l.
avanukkaagach surukku tharaiyilum, avanukkaagak ka'n'ni vazhiyilum vaikkappattirukki'rathu.
sut'rilumirunthu'ndaagum bayanggarangga'l avanaith thidukkidappa'n'ni, avan kaalga'laith thisaitheriyaamal alaiyappa'n'num.
avan belanaip pattini thin'rupoadum; avan pakkaththil keadu aayaththappattu ni'rkum.
athu avan anggaththin balaththaip padchikkum; bayanggaramaana mara'namea avan avayavangga'laip padchikkum.
avan nambikkai avan koodaaraththilirunthu vearoadea pidunggappadum; athu avanaip bayanggara raajaavinidaththil thuraththum.
avanukku on'rumillaama'rpoanathinaal, bayanggaram avan koodaaraththil kudiyirukkum; kanthagam avan vaasasthalaththinmeal the'likkappadum.
keezhea irukki'ra avan vearga'l azhinthupoagum; mealea irukki'ra avan ki'laiga'l pattuppoagum.
avanai ninaikkum ninaippup boomiyilirunthazhiyum, veethiga'lil avan pearillaama'rpoagum.
avan ve'lichchaththilirunthu iru'lil thuraththividappattu, booloagaththilirunthu tha'l'lu'ndupoavaan.
avan janaththukku'l'lea avanukkup puththiranum illai pauththiranum illai; avan veettil meethiyaayirukkaththakkavan oruvanum illai.
avan kaalaththoar avan naa'lukkaagath thidukkittathupoala, pinnadiyaarum piramippaarga'l.
akkiramakkaaran kudiyiruntha sthaanangga'l ivaiga'lthaan; theavanai a'riyaama'rpoanavanudaiya sthalam ithuvea enbaarga'l en'raan.
yoabu pirathiyuththaramaaga:
neengga'l enthamattum en aaththumaavai varuththappaduththi, vaarththaiga'linaal ennai no'rukkuveerga'l?
ippoathu paththutharam ennai ninthiththeerga'l; neengga'l enakkuk kadinamugam kaa'nbikki'rathinaal ungga'lukku vedkamillai.
naan thappinadanthathu meyyaanaalum, en thappitham ennoadeathaan irukki'rathu.
neengga'l enakku viroathamaagap perumaipaaraatti, enakku ninthaiyaaga ennaik kadinthuko'l'lavea'ndum en'riruppeerga'laagil,
theavan ennaik kavizhththu, thammudaiya valaiyai enmeal veesinaar en'ru a'riyungga'l.
ithoa, kodumai en'ru kooppidugi'rean, keadpaar oruvarum illai; kookkuralidugi'rean, niyaayavisaara'nai illai.
naan kadanthupoagakkoodaathapadikku avar en paathaiyai vealiyadaiththu, en vazhiga'lai iru'laakkivittaar.
enniliruntha en magimaiyai avar urinthuko'ndu, en sirasin kireedaththai eduththuppoattaar.
avar ennai naangupu'raththilum naasamaakkinaar, naan at'ruppoagi'rean; en nambikkaiyai oru sediyaippoalap pidunggippoattaar.
avar thamathu koabaththai enmeal eriyappa'n'ninaar; ennaith thammudaiya saththurukka'lil oruvanaaga e'n'nikko'l'lugi'raar.
avarudaiya tha'nduppadaiga'l eagamaay vanthu, enakku viroathamaayth thangga'l vazhiyai uyarththi, en koodaaraththaich sut'rip paa'layami'rangginaarga'l.
en sagoathararai ennaivittuth thoorappaduththinaar; enakku a'rimugamaanavarga'l enakku anniyaraayp poanaarga'l.
en panthujanangga'l vilagippoanaarga'l; en sineagithar ennai ma'ranthuvittaarga'l.
en veettu janangga'lum, en vealaikkaariga'lum, ennai anniyanaaga e'n'nugi'raarga'l; avarga'l paarvaikku naan paratheasiyaanean.
naan en vealaikkaaranaik kooppidugi'rapoathu avan enakku uththaravukodaan; en vaayinaal naan avanaik kegnchavea'ndiyathaayit'ru.
en suvaasam en manaivikku vea'rupattirukki'rathu; en karppaththin pi'l'laiga'lukkaagap parithabikki'rean.
si'rupi'l'laiga'lum ennai asattaipa'n'nugi'raarga'l; naan ezhunthaal, avarga'l enakku viroathamaayp peasugi'raarga'l.
en piraa'nasineagithar ellaarum ennai ve'rukki'raarga'l; naan sineagiththavarga'l enakku viroathiga'laanaarga'l.
en elumbuga'l en thoaloadum en maamsaththoadum ottikko'ndirukki'rathu; en pa'rka'lai moodak kogncham thoalmaaththiram thappinathu.
en sineagitharea, enakku iranggungga'l, enakku iranggungga'l; theavanudaiya kai ennaith thottathu.
theavanaippoala neengga'lum ennaith thunbappaduththuvaanean? en maamsam padchikkappattaalum neengga'l thirupthiyat'rirukki'rathenna?
aa, naan ippozhuthu sollum vaarththaiga'l ezhuthappattaal nalamaayirukkum; avaiga'l oru pusthagaththil varaiyappattu,
allathu en'raikkum nilaikka avaiga'l karungkallilea u'livettaagavum eeya ezhuththaagavum pathinthaal nalamaayirukkum.
en meedpar uyiroadirukki'raar en'rum, avar kadaisinaa'lil boomiyinmeal ni'rpaar en'rum naan a'rinthirukki'rean.
intha en thoalmuthalaanavai azhugippoanapinbu, naan en maamsaththil irunthu theavanaip paarppean.
avarai naanea paarppean; anniya ka'nga'l alla, en ka'nga'lea avaraik kaa'num; intha vaagnchaiyaal en u'l'linthiriyangga'l enakku'l soarnthupoagi'rathu.
kaariyaththin moolam enakku'l ka'ndupidikkappadugaiyil, naam ean avanaith thunbappaduththugi'roam en'ru neengga'l sollavea'ndiyathaamea.
