pattayaththukkup bayappadungga'l; niyaayaththeerppu u'ndengi'rathai neengga'l a'riyumporuttu, moorkkamaanathu pattayaththinaal u'ndaagum aakkinaiyai varappa'n'num en'raan.
appozhuthu naagamaaththiyanaana soappaar pirathiyuththaramaaga:
itha'rkaaga ma'ruuththaravu kodukka en sinthanaiga'l ennai eavugi'rapadiyaal naan theeviriththuch sollugi'rean.
ninthiththean en'ru naan kadinthuko'l'lappattathaik keattean; aanaalum u'narvinaal en aavi pirathiyuththaram solla ennai eavugi'rathu.
thunmaarkkanin kembeeram ku'ruginathu enbathaiyum, maayakkaaranin santhoasham oru nimishammaaththiram ni'rkum enbathaiyum,
avar manushanaip boomiyil vaiththa aathikaalamuthal ippadiyirukki'rathu enbathaiyum neer a'riyeeroa?
avanudaiya meanmai vaanapariyantham uyarnthaalum, avanudaiya thalai meagangga'lmattum ettinaalum,
avan than malaththaippoala en'raikkum azhinthupoavaan; avanaik ka'ndavarga'l, avan enggea? enbaarga'l.
avan oru soppanaththaippoal pa'ranthupoayk kaa'nappadaathavanaavaan; iravil thoan'rum tharisanaththaippoal pa'rakkadikkappaduvaan.
avanaip paarththa ka'n ini avanaip paarppathillai; avan iruntha sthalam ini avanaik kaa'nbathillai.
avan pi'l'laiga'l e'limaiyaanavarga'lin sagaayaththaith theaduvaarga'l; avan pa'riththathai avan kaiga'l thirumbak kodukkavea'ndiyathaagum.
avan elumbuga'l avanudaiya vaalavayathin paavangga'linaal ni'rainthirunthu, avanoadeakooda ma'n'nilea paduththukko'l'lum.
pollaappu avan vaayilea inimaiyaayiruppathaal, avan athaith than naavinkeezh adakki,
athai vidaamal pathanampa'n'ni, than vaaykku'l'lea vaiththukko'ndirunthaalum,
avan poajanam avan kudalga'lil maa'ri, avanukku'l viriyanpaambuga'lin pichchaayppoagum.
avan vizhunggina aasthiyaik kakkuvaan; theavan athai avan vayit'rilirunthu ve'liyea tha'l'lividuvaar.
avan viriyan paambuga'lin vishaththai u'rignchuvaan; viriyanin naakku avanaik kollum.
theanum neyyum oadum vaaykkaalga'laiyum aa'ruga'laiyum avan kaa'nbathillai.
thaan pirayaasappattuth theadinathai avan vizhunggaamal thirumbak koduppaan; avan thirumbakkodukki'rathu avan aasthikkuch sariyaayirukkum; avan ka'likooraathiruppaan.
avan odukki, eazhaiga'laik kaivittu, thaan kattaatha veettaip pa'riththapadiyinaalum,
than vayi'ru thirupthiyat'rirunthapadiyinaalum, avan ichchiththa kaariyangga'lil avanukku on'rum iruppathillai.
avan poajanaththil on'rum meethiyaavathillai; aagaiyaal avan aasthi nilaini'rpathillai.
avan vea'ndumengi'ra paripoora'nam avanukku vanthapin, avanukku viyaagulam u'ndaagum; si'rumaippadugi'ra ovvoruvarudaiya kaiyum avanmeal varum.
than vayit'rai nirappaththakkathu innum avanukku irunthaalum, avar avanmeal thamathu koabaththin ukkiraththai varavittu, avan poajanampa'n'nugaiyil, athai avanmeal soriyappa'n'nuvaar.
iruppu aayuthaththukku avan thappiyoadinaalum urukkuvil avanai uruva eyyum.
uruvina pattayam avan sareeraththaiyum, minnugi'ra ambu avan pichchaiyum uruvippoagum; bayanggarangga'l avanmeal varum.
avan o'likkum idangga'lil kaariru'l adanggiyirukkum; aviyaatha akkini avanaip padchikkum; avan koodaaraththil meethiyaayirukki'ravan theenggu anubavippaan.
vaanangga'l avan akkiramaththai ve'lippaduththi, boomi avanukku viroathamaaga ezhumbum.
avan veettin sambaththup poayvidum; avarudaiya koabaththin naa'lilea avaiga'l karainthupoagum.
ithuvea theavanaal thunmaarkkanukkuk kidaikkum panggum, avan seygaikkuth theavanaal avanukku varum suthantharamumaam en'raan.
yoabu pirathiyuththaramaaga:
en vasanaththaik kavanamaayk kea'lungga'l; ithu neengga'l ennaith theat'raravupa'n'nuvathupoala irukkum.
naan peasappoagi'rean, sagiththirungga'l; naan peasinapinbu pariyaasampa'n'nungga'l.
naan manushanaippaarththaa anggalaaykki'rean? appadiyaanaalum en aavi visanappadaathirukkumaa?
ennaik kavaniththuppaarungga'l, appozhuthu neengga'l piramiththu, ungga'l vaayaik kaiyaal poththikko'lveerga'l.
ithai naan ninaikkaiyil kalanggugi'rean; nadukkam en maamsaththaip pidikkum.
thunmaarkkar jeeviththu viruththaraagi, vallavaraavaanean?
avarga'loadungkooda avarga'l santhathiyaar avarga'lukku munbaagavum, avarga'l pi'l'laiga'l avarga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaagavum thidappadugi'raarga'l.
avarga'l veeduga'l bayamillaamal paththirappattirukkum; theavanudaiya milaa'ru avarga'lmeal varugi'rathillai.
avarga'ludaiya eruthu polinthaal, vee'naayppoagaathu; avarga'ludaiya pasu sinai azhiyaamal eenugi'rathu.
avarga'l thangga'l kuzhanthaiga'lai oru manthaiyaippoala ve'liyea poagavidugi'raarga'l; avarga'l pi'l'laiga'l kuthiththu vi'laiyaadugi'raarga'l.
avarga'l thamburaiyum surama'ndalaththaiyum eduththup paadi, kinnaraththin oasaikkuch santhoashappadugi'raarga'l.
avarga'l selvavaanga'laayth thangga'l naadka'laip poakki, oru ksha'nappozhuthilea paathaa'laththil i'ranggugi'raarga'l.
avarga'l theavanai noakki: engga'laivittu vilagiyirum, ummudaiya vazhiga'lai a'riya virumboam;
sarvavallavarai naam seavikka avar yaar? avarai noakki jebampa'n'nuvathinaal namakkup pirayoajanam enna engi'raarga'l.
aanaalum avarga'l vaazhvu avarga'l kaiyiliraathu; thunmaarkkarin aaloasanai enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaga.
eththanaich saduthiyil thunmaarkkarin vi'lakku a'nainthupoam; avar thamathu koabaththinaal veathanaiga'laip pagirnthukodukkaiyil, avarga'l aabaththu avarga'lmeal varum.
avarga'l kaat'rumugaththilirukki'ra thurumbaippoalavum, perungkaat'ru pa'rakkadikki'ra patharaippoalavum irukki'raarga'l.
theavan avanudaiya akkiramaththai avan pi'l'laiga'lukku vaiththu vaikki'raar; avan u'naraththakkavithamaay athai avanukkup palikkappa'n'nugi'raar.
avanudaiya azhivai avanudaiya ka'nga'l kaa'num, sarvavallavarudaiya ukkiraththaik kudippaan.
avan maathangga'lin thogai ku'rukkappadumpoathu, avanukkup pi'rpaadu avan veettaippat'ri avanukku irukkum viruppamenna?
uyarnthoarai niyaayantheerkki'ra theavanukku a'rivai u'narththa yaaraalaagum?
oruvan nirvaagaththoadum sugaththoadum vaazhnthu ku'raiyat'ra belanu'l'lavanaaych saagi'raan.
avanudaiya paalpaaththirangga'l paalaal nirambiyirukki'rathu, avan elumbuga'lil oon pushdiyaayirukki'rathu.
vea'roruvan oru naa'laavathu santhoashaththoadea saappidaamal, manakkileasaththoadea saagi'raan.
iruvarum samamaay ma'n'nilea paduththukko'l'lugi'raarga'l; puzhukka'l avarga'lai moodum.
ithoa, naan ungga'l ninaivuga'laiyum, neengga'l ennaippat'ri aniyaayamaayk ko'ndirukkum aaloasanaiga'laiyum a'rivean.
pirabuvinudaiya veedu enggea? thunmaarkkarudaiya koodaaram enggea? en'ru sollugi'reerga'l.
vazhinadanthupoagi'ravarga'lai neengga'l keadkavillaiyaa, avarga'l sollum ku'rippuga'lai neengga'l a'riyavillaiyaa?
thunmaarkkan aabaththunaa'lukken'ru vaikkappadugi'raan; avan koabaakkinaiyin naa'lukken'ru ko'nduvarappadugi'raan.
avan vazhiyai avan mugaththukku munbaagath thoo'ndik kaa'nbikki'ravan yaar? avan seygaikkuththakka palanai avanukkuch sarikkattugi'ravan yaar?
avan kalla'raikkuk ko'nduvarappadugi'raan; avan koari kaakkappattirukkum.
pa'l'laththaakkin pulpaththaiga'l avanukku inbamaayirukkum; avanukku munnaaga e'n'ni'rantha janangga'l poanathupoala, avanukkup pinnaaga ovvoruvarum avvidaththukkuch selluvaarga'l.
neengga'l vee'naana aa'ruthalai enakkuch sollugi'rathu enna? ungga'l ma'rumozhiga'lil u'nmaikkeadu irukki'rathu en'raan.
appozhuthu theamaaniyanaana elippaas pirathiyuththaramaaga:
oru manushan viveagiyaayirunthu, thanakkuththaan pirayoajanamaayirukki'rathinaal theavanukkup pirayoajanamaayiruppaanoa?
neer neethimaanaayiruppathinaal sarvavallavarukku nanmaiyu'ndaagumoa? neer ummudaiya vazhiga'lai uththamamaakkugi'rathu avarukku aathaayamaayirukkumoa?
avar umakkup bayanthu ummoadea vazhakkaadi, ummoadea niyaayaththukku varuvaaroa?
ummudaiya pollaappup periyathum, ummudaiya akkiramangga'l mudivillaathavaiga'lumaay irukki'rathallavoa?
mugaantharamillaamal ummudaiya sagoatharar kaiyil adaguvaanggi, eazhaiga'lin vasthirangga'laip pa'riththukko'ndeer.
vidaayththavanukkuth thaagaththukkuth tha'n'neer kodaamalum, pasiththavanukkup poajanam kodaamalum poaneer.
balavaanukkea theasaththil idamu'ndaayit'ru; kanavaan athil kudiyea'rinaan.
vithavaiga'lai ve'rumaiyaay anuppivitteer; thaaythagappan illaathavarga'lin puyangga'l mu'rikkappattathu.
aagaiyaal ka'n'niga'l ummaich soozhnthirukki'rathu; asuppilea umakku vantha bayanggaram ummaik kalanggappa'n'nugi'rathu.
neer paarkkakkoodaathapadikku iru'l vanthathu, jalappiravaagam ummai moodugi'rathu.
theavan paraloagaththin unnathangga'lilirukki'raar allavoa? nadchaththirangga'lin uyaraththaip paarum, avaiga'l eththanai uyaramaayirukki'rathu.
neer: theavan eppadi a'rivaar, anthagaaraththukku appu'raththilirukki'ravar niyaayam visaarikkakkoodumoa?
avar paaraathapadikku meagangga'l avarukku ma'raivaayirukki'rathu; parama'ndalangga'lin sakkaraththilea avar ulaavugi'raar en'ru sollugi'reer.
akkirama maanthar poorvaththil nadantha maarkkaththaik kavaniththup paarththeeroa?
kaalam varumunnea avarga'l vaadippoanaarga'l; avarga'ludaiya asthibaaraththinmeal ve'l'lam pura'ndathu.
theavan avarga'l veeduga'lai nanmaiyaal nirappiyirunthaalum, avarga'l avarai noakki: engga'laivittu vilagum, sarvavallavaraalea engga'lukku enna aagum en'raarga'l.
aagaiyaal thunmaarkkarin aaloasanai enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaga.
engga'l nilaimai nirmoolamaagaamal, avarga'lukku meethiyaanathaiyoa akkini padchiththathenbathai neethimaanga'l ka'ndu santhoashappadugi'raarga'l.
kut'ramillaathavan avarga'laip paarththu nagaikki'raan.
neer avaroadea pazhagich samaathaanamaayirum; athinaal umakku nanmai varum.
avar vaayinin'ru pi'rantha veathappiramaa'naththai eat'rukko'ndu, avar vaarththaiga'lai ummudaiya iruthayaththil vaiththukko'l'lavea'ndugi'rean.
neer sarvavallavaridaththil mananthirumbinaal, thirumbak kattappaduveer; akkiramaththai umathu koodaaraththukkuth thooramaakkuveer.
appozhuthu thoo'laippoal ponnaiyum, aat'ruk ka'rka'laippoal oappeerin thanggaththaiyum searththu vaippeer.
appozhuthu sarvavallavar thaamea umakkup pasumponnum, umakkuch sokkave'l'liyumaayiruppaar.
appozhuthu sarvavallavarmeal manamagizhchchiyaayirunthu, theavanukku nearaaga ummudaiya mugaththai ea'reduppeer.
neer avarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'na, avar umakkuch sevikoduppaar; appozhuthu neer ummudaiya poruththanaiga'laich seluththuveer.
neer oru kaariyaththai niru'nayampa'n'ninaal, athu umakku nilaivarappadum; ummudaiya paathaiga'lil ve'lichcham piragaasikkum.
manushar odukkappadumpoathu thidappadakkadavarga'l en'ru neer solla, thaazhnthoar radchikkappaduvaarga'l.
kut'ramat'riraathavanaiyungkoodath thappuvippaar; ummudaiya kaiga'lin suththaththinimiththam avan thappippoavaan en'raan.
yoabu pirathiyuththaramaaga:
in'raiyathinamum en anggalaayppu mura'nduththanamaaga e'n'nappadugi'rathu; en thavippaippaarkkilum en vaathai kadinamaanathu.
naan avarai enggea ka'ndu santhikkalaam enbathai a'rinthaal nalamaayirukkum; appozhuthu naan avar aasanaththukku munbaaga vanthusearnthu,
en niyaayaththai avarukku munbaaga varisaiyaay vaiththu, kaariyaththai roobikkum vaarththaiga'laal en vaayai nirappuvean.
avarudaiya ma'rumozhiga'lai naan a'rinthu, avar enakkuch solvathai u'narnthuko'l'luvean.
avar thammudaiya mahaa vallamaiyinpadiyea ennoadea vazhakkaaduvaaroa? avar appadich seyyaamal enmeal thayai vaippaar.
anggea sanmaarkkan avaroadea vazhakkaadalaam; appozhuthu ennai niyaayantheerkki'ravarin kaikku en'raikkum neenggalaayth thappuviththukko'lvean.
ithoa, naan munnaagappoanaalum avar illai; pinnaagappoanaalum avaraik kaa'nean.
idathupu'raththil avar kiriyai seythum avaraik kaa'nean; valathupu'raththilum naan avaraik kaa'naathapadikku o'liththirukki'raar.
aanaalum naan poagum vazhiyai avar a'rivaar; avar ennaich soathiththapin naan ponnaaga vi'langguvean.
en kaalga'l avar adiga'laip pat'rippidiththathu; avarudaiya ne'riyaivittu naan saayaamal athaik kaikko'ndean.
avar uthaduga'lin ka'rpanaiga'lai vittu naan pinvaangguvathillai; avarudaiya vaayin vaarththaiga'lai enakku vea'ndiya aagaaraththaippaarkkilum athigamaayk kaaththukko'ndean.
avaroaven'raal orea manamaayirukki'raar; avaraith thiruppaththakkavar yaar? avarudaiya siththaththinpadiyellaam seyvaar.
enakkuk ku'riththirukki'rathai avar ni'raiveat'ruvaar; ippadippattavaiga'l innum aneagam avaridaththil u'ndu.
aagaiyaal avarukku munbaagak kalanggugi'rean; naan sinthikki'rapoathu, avarukkup bayappadugi'rean.
theavan en iruthayaththai i'lakkarikkappa'n'ninaar; sarvavallavar ennaik kalanggappa'n'ninaar.
anthagaaram varaathatha'rku munnea naan sanggarikkappadaamalum, iru'lai avar enakku ma'raikkaamalumpoanathinaal ippadiyirukki'rean.
sarvavallavarukkuk kaalangga'l ma'raikkappadaathirukka, avarai a'rinthavarga'l avar niyamiththa naadka'lai a'riyaathirukki'rathenna?
silar ellaikku'rippuga'lai ot'ri, manthaiga'laip balaathkaaramaaych saayththukko'ndupoayp padchikki'raarga'l.
thaay thagappan illaathavarga'lin kazhuthaiyai oattikko'ndupoay, vithavaiyin maattai eedaaga eduththukko'l'lugi'raarga'l.
theasaththil si'rumaippattavarga'l eagamaay o'liththukko'l'laththakkathaaga, e'limaiyaanavarga'lai vazhiyaivittu vilakkugi'raarga'l.

ithoa, avarga'l kaattukkazhuthaiga'laippoala iraitheada athikaalamea thangga'l vealaikkup pu'rappadugi'raarga'l; vanaantharave'lithaan avarga'lukkum avarga'l pi'l'laiga'lukkum aagaaram kodukkavea'ndum.
thunmaarkkanudaiya vayalil avarga'l avanukkaaga a'ruppu a'ruththu, avanudaiya thiraadchaththoattaththin pazhangga'laich searkki'raarga'l.
ku'lirilea poarththukko'l'lugi'ratha'rku on'rum illaathathinaal, vasthiramillaamal iraaththanggi,
malaiga'lilirunthuvarum mazhaiga'lilea nanainthu, othukkidamillaathathinaal kanmalaiyilea a'ndikko'l'lugi'raarga'l.
avarga'loa thagappanillaatha pi'l'laiyai mulaiyaivittup pa'riththu, thariththiran poarththukko'ndirukki'rathai adaguvaanggugi'raarga'l.
avanai vasthiramillaamal nadakkavum, pattiniyaay arikkattuga'laich sumakkavum,
thangga'l mathilga'lukku'l'lea sekkaattavum, thaagaththavanamaay aalaiyaattavum pa'n'nugi'raarga'l.
ooril manushar thavikki'raarga'l, kut'ruyiraayk kidakki'ravarga'lin aaththumaa kooppidugi'rathu; en'raalum, theavan athaik kut'ramaaga avarga'lmeal sumaththugi'rathillai.
avarga'l ve'lichchaththukku viroathamaay nadakki'ravarga'lin koottaththaar; avarga'l avarudaiya vazhiga'lai a'riyaamalum, avarudaiya paathaiga'lil tharikkaamalum irukki'raarga'l.
kolaipaathagan pozhuthu vidigi'rapoathu ezhunthu, si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanaik kon'ru, iraakkaalaththilea thirudanaippoal thirigi'raan.
vibasaaranudaiya ka'n maalai mayanggugi'ra vea'laikkuk kaaththirunthu: ennai oru ka'n'num kaa'namaattaathen'ru mugaththai moodikko'l'lugi'raan.
avarga'l pagalil adaiyaa'lam paarththa veeduga'lai iruttilea kannamidugi'raarga'l; avarga'l ve'lichchaththai a'riyaarga'l.
vidiyungkaalamum avarga'lukku mara'na iru'lpoal irukki'rathu; appadippattavan mara'na iru'lin bayanggaraththoadu pazhagiyirukki'raan.
neeroattaththaippoal theeviramaayp poavaan; theasaththil avan panggu sabikkappattup poagi'rathinaal, avan thiraadchaththoattangga'lin vazhiyai inik kaa'nbathillai.
va'radchiyum ush'namum u'raintha mazhaiyaip padchikkum; appadiyea paathaa'lamaanathu paaviga'laip padchikkum.
avanaip pet'ra karppam avanai ma'rakkum; puzhu thirupthigaramaay avanaith thinnum; avan appu'ram ninaikkappaduvathillai; akkiramamaanathu pattamaraththaippoala mu'rinthuvizhum.
pi'l'laipe'raatha maladiyin aasthiyaip padchiththuvittu, vithavaikku nanmai seyyaatheapoagi'raan.
than balaththinaalea vallavarga'laith than paarisamaakkugi'raan; avan ezhumbugi'rapoathu oruvanukkum piraa'nanaippat'ri nichchayamillai.
theavan avanukkuch sugavaazhvaik katta'laiyittaal, athinmeal u'ruthiyaay nambikkai vaikki'raan; aanaalum avarudaiya ka'nga'l appadippattavarga'lin vazhiga'lukku viroathamaayirukki'rathu.
avarga'l kognchakkaalam uyarnthirunthu, kaa'naama'rpoay, thaazhththappattu, mat'ra ellaaraippoalum adakkappadugi'raarga'l; kathirga'lin nuniyaippoala a'rukkappadugi'raarga'l.
appadiyillaiyen'ru ennaip poyyanaakki, en vaarththaiga'lai viyarththamaakkaththakkavan yaar en'raan.
appozhuthu soogiyanaana bilthaath pirathiyuththaramaaga:
athigaaramum bayanggaramum avaridaththil irukki'rathu; avar thamathu unnathamaana sthalangga'lil samaathaanaththai u'ndaakkugi'raar.
avarudaiya seanaiga'lukkuth thogaiyu'ndoa? avarudaiya ve'lichcham yaarmeal uthikkaamalirukki'rathu?
ippadiyirukka, manushan theavanukku munbaaga neethimaanaayiruppathu eppadi? sthireeyinidaththil pi'ranthavan suththamaayiruppathu eppadi?
santhiranai a'n'naanthupaarum, athuvum piragaasiyaamalirukki'rathu; nadchaththirangga'lum avar paarvaikkuch suththamaanavaiga'l alla.
puzhuvaayirukki'ra manithanum, poochchiyaayirukki'ra manupuththiranum emmaaththiram en'raan.
yoabu ma'rumozhiyaaga:
thidanillaathavanukku nee eppadi oththaasaipa'n'ninaay? belanat'ra kaiyai nee eppadi aathariththaay?
nee gnaanamillaathavanukku eppadi usaavuthu'naiyaayirunthu, meypporu'laik ku'raiva'ra a'riviththaay?
yaarukku a'rivaip poathiththaay? unnidaththilirunthu pu'rappatta aavi yaarudaiyathu?
jalaththin keezh madinthavarga'lukkum, avarga'loadea thanggugi'ravarga'lukkum thaththa'lippu u'ndu.
avarukku munbaagap paathaa'lam ve'liyaayth thi'ranthirukki'rathu; naragam moodappadaathirukki'rathu.
avar uththarama'ndalaththai vettave'liyilea viriththu, boomiyai antharaththilea thonggavaikki'raar.
avar tha'n'neerga'laith thammudaiya kaarmeagangga'lil kattivaikki'raar; athin baaraththinaal meagam kizhigi'rathillai.
avar thamathu singgaasanam ni'rkum aagaasaththai sthirappaduththi, athinmeal thamathu meagaththai virikki'raar.
avar tha'n'neerga'lmeal sakkaravattam theerththaar; ve'lichchamum iru'lum mudiyumattum appadiyea irukkum.
avarudaiya ka'ndithaththaal vaanaththin thoo'nga'l athirnthu thaththa'likkum.
avar thamathu vallamaiyinaal samuththirak kontha'lippai amarappa'n'ni, thamathu gnaanaththinaal athin moorkkaththai adakkugi'raar.
thamathu aaviyinaal vaanaththai alanggariththaar; avarudaiya karam ne'livaana sarppa nadchaththiraththai uruvaakkit'ru.
ithoa, ivaiga'l avarudaiya kiriyaiyil kadaikoadiyaanavaiga'l, avaraikku'riththu naangga'l keattathu evva'lavu kogncham; avarudaiya vallamaiyin idimuzhakkaththai a'rinthavan yaar en'raan.
yoabu pinnum than pirasanggavaakkiyaththaith thodarnthu sonnathu:
en suvaasam ennilum, theavan thantha aavi en naasiyilum irukkumattum,
en uthaduga'l theemaiyaich solvathumillai; en naakku kabadam peasuvathumillaiyen'ru,
en niyaayaththaith tha'l'lividugi'ra theavanum, en aaththumaavaik kasappaakkugi'ra sarvavallavarumaanavarudaiya jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean.
neengga'l peasugi'rathu neethiyen'ru naan oththukko'lvathu enakkuth thooramaayiruppathaaga; en aavi piriyumattum en uththamaththai ennaivittu vilakkean.
en neethiyaik kettiyaayp pidiththirukki'rean; athai naan vittuvidean; naan uyiroadirukkuma'lavum en iruthayam ennai ninthikkaathu.
en pagaignan aagaathavanaippoalum, enakku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'ravan akkiramakkaaranaippoalum iruppaanaaga.
maayakkaaran poru'laith theadi vaiththirunthaalum, theavan avan aaththumaavai eduththukko'l'lumpoathu, avan nambikkai enna?
aabaththu avanmeal varumpoathu, theavan avan kooppiduthalaik keadpaaroa?
avan sarvavallavarmeal manamagizhchchiyaayiruppaanoa? avan eppozhuthum theavanaith thozhuthuko'ndiruppaanoa?
theavanudaiya karaththin kiriyaiyaik ku'riththu ungga'lukku ubatheasippean; sarvavallavaridaththil irukki'rathai naan ma'raikkamaattean.
ithoa, neengga'l ellaarum athaik ka'ndirunthum, neengga'l iththanai vee'n e'n'nangko'ndirukki'rathu enna?
pollaatha manushanukkuth theavanidaththilirunthu varugi'ra panggum, kodoorakkaarar sarvavallavaraal adaigi'ra suthantharamum ennavenil,
avanudaiya kumaarar peruginaal pattayaththukku iraiyaavaarga'l; avan karppappi'rappuga'l aagaaraththinaal thirupthiyaavathillai.
avanukku meethiyaanavarga'l seththup puthaikkappaduvaarga'l; avanudaiya vithavaiga'l pulambuvathillai.
avan puzhuthiyaippoalap pa'naththaik kuviththukko'ndaalum, ma'n'naippoala vasthirangga'laich savathariththaalum,
avan savathariththathai neethimaan uduththikko'ndu, kut'ramillaathavan avan pa'naththaip pagirnthuko'l'luvaan.
avanudaiya veedu pottuppoochchi kattina veettaippoalum, kaavalkaakki'ravan poatta kudisaiyaippoalumaagum.
avan aisuvariyavaanaayth thoonggik kidanthu, on'rum pa'rikodaatheapoanaalum, avan than ka'nga'laith thi'rakkumpoathu on'rumillaathirukkum.
ve'l'laththaippoalath thigilga'l avanai vaarikko'ndupoagum; iraakkaalaththil perungkaat'ru avanai adiththukko'ndupoagum.
ko'ndalkaat'ru avanaith thookkikko'ndupoaga, avan poayviduvaan; athu avanai avan sthalaththilirunthu tha'l'likko'ndupoagum.
avar ivaiga'lai avanmeal varappa'n'ni avanaith thappavidaathiruppaar; avarudaiya kaikkuth thappiyoadap paarppaan.
janangga'l avanaip paarththuk kaikotti, avanai avan sthalaththaivittu veruttividuvaarga'l.
ve'l'likku vi'laividam u'ndu, ponnukkup pudamidum sthalamumu'ndu.
irumbu ma'n'nilirunthu edukkappadum; sembu ka'rka'lil urukki edukkappadum.
manithan anthagaaraththilum mara'na iru'lilum irukki'ra ka'rka'laik kadaiyaantharamattum aaraaynthu theadi, iru'lukkum anggea mudivu'ndaakkugi'raan.
kadakkakkoodaathathum nilaiyaathathumaana aa'ru ezhumbinaalum, uzhaippaa'liyaanavan athai manusharaal vat'rippoagappa'n'nich sellugi'raan.
boomiyinmeal aagaaram vi'laiyum; athin keezhidangga'lilirukki'ravaiga'loa, akkiniyaal maa'rinathupoalirukkum.
athin kalluga'lil inthiraneelam vi'laiyum; athin podiyil ponpodiga'lum u'ndaayirukkum.
oru vazhiyu'ndu, athu oru padchikkum theriyaathu; valloo'rin ka'n'num athaik ka'ndathillai;
thushdamirugangga'lin kaal athil padavillai; singgam athaik kadanthathillai.
avan than kaiga'laik ka'rpaa'raiyinmeal neetti, malaiga'lai vearoadea purattugi'raan.
kanmalaiga'lukku'l'lum neerkkaalga'lai vettugi'raan; avan ka'n vilaiyuyarntha ellaavat'raiyum kaa'num.
oru thu'liyum kasiyaathapadi aa'ruga'lai adaikki'raan; ma'raividaththilirukki'rathai ve'lichchaththilea ko'nduvarugi'raan.
aanaalum gnaanam ka'ndedukkappaduvathu enggea? buththi vi'laigi'ra idam ethu?
athin vilai manushanukkuth theriyaathu; athu jeevanu'l'loarudaiya theasaththilea agappadugi'rathillai.
aazhamaanathu: athu ennidaththil illaiyengi'rathu; samuththiramaanathum, athu ennidaththil illaiyengi'rathu.
atha'rku eedaagath thanggaththaik kodukkavum, atha'rkuk kirayamaaga ve'l'liyai ni'rukkavum koodaathu.
oappeerin thanggamum, vilaiyea'rappet'ra koameathagamum, inthira neelakkallum atha'rku eedalla.
ponnum pa'linggum atha'rku oppalla; pasumponnaabara'nangga'lukku athai maat'rakkoodaathu.
pava'laththaiyum spadigaththaiyum aththoadea oppittup peasalaagaathu; muththukka'laippaarkkilum gnaanaththin vilai uyarnthathu.
eththiyoappiyaavin pushparaagam atha'rku nigaralla; pasumponnum atha'rkuch sariyalla.
ippadiyirukka, gnaanam enggeayirunthu varum; buththi thanggum idam enggea?
athu jeevanu'l'la sagalarudaiya ka'nga'lukkum o'liththum, aagaasaththup pa'ravaiga'lukku ma'rainthum irukki'rathu.
naasamum mara'namum, naangga'l engga'l kaathuga'linaaleamaaththiram athin keerththiyaik keattoam engi'rathu.
theavanoa athin vazhiyai a'rivaar, athin sthaanam avarukkea theriyum.
avar boomiyin kadaiyaantharangga'laip paarththu, vaanangga'linkeezh irukki'rathaiyellaam kaa'ngi'raar.
avar kaat'rukku athin ni'raiyai niyamiththu, jalaththukku athin a'lavaip piramaa'niththu,
mazhaikkuth thittaththaiyum, idimuzhakkaththoadea koodiya minnalukku vazhiyaiyum ea'rpaduththugi'raar.
avar athaip paarththuk ka'nakkittaar; athai aaraaynthu aayaththappaduththi,
manushanai noakki: ithoa, aa'ndavarukkup bayappaduvathea gnaanam; pollaappai vittu vilaguvathea buththi en'raar en'ru sonnaan.
pinnum yoabu than pirasanggavaakkiyaththaith thodarnthu sonnathu:
sen'rupoana maathangga'lilum, theavan ennaik kaappaat'rivantha naadka'lilum enakku u'ndaayiruntha seer ippozhuthu irunthaal nalamaayirukkum.
appozhuthu avar theebam en thalaiyinmeal piragaasiththathu; avar aru'lina ve'lichchaththinaal iru'laik kadanthupoanean.
theavanudaiya iragasiyachseyal en koodaaraththinmeal irunthathu.
appozhuthu sarvavallavar ennoadirunthaar; en pi'l'laiga'l ennaich soozhnthirunthaarga'l.
en paathangga'lai naan neyyinaal kazhuvinean; kanmalaiga'lilirunthu enakkaaga e'n'ney nathipoala oadivanthathu; anthach selvanaadka'lin seer ippoathirunthaal nalamaayirukkum.
naan patta'naveethiyaal vaasalukku'l pu'rappattuppoay, veethiyil en aasanaththaip poadumpoathu,
vaalibar ennaik ka'ndu o'liththukko'lvaarga'l; muthiyoar ezhunthirunthu ni'rpaarga'l.
pirabukka'l peasugi'rathai ni'ruththi, kaiyinaal thangga'l vaayaip poththikko'lvaarga'l.
periyoarin saththam adanggi, avarga'l naakku avarga'l mealvaayoadu ottikko'l'lum.
ennaik keatta kaathu ennaip baakkiyavaan en'rathu; ennaik ka'nda ka'n enakkuch saadchiyittathu.
mu'raiyidugi'ra eazhaiyaiyum, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyaiyum, uthaviyat'ravanaiyum iradchiththean.
kettuppoaga irunthavanudaiya aaseervaatham enmeal vanthathu; vithavaiyin iruthayaththaik kembeerikkappa'n'ninean.
neethiyaith thariththukko'ndean; athu en uduppaayirunthathu; en niyaayam enakkuch saalvaiyum paagaiyumaay irunthathu.
naan kurudanukkuk ka'n'num, sappaa'nikkuk kaalumaayirunthean.
naan e'liyavarga'lukkuth thagappanaayirunthu, naan a'riyaatha vazhakkai aaraaynthupaarththean.
naan aniyaayakkaararudaiya kadaivaayp pa'rka'lai udaiththu, avarga'l pa'riththathai avarga'l pa'rka'lilirunthu pidungginean.
en koottilea naan jeeviththuppoavean; en naadka'lai ma'nalaththanaiyaayp perugappa'n'nuvean en'rean.
en vear tha'n'neerga'lin oaramaayp padarnthathu; en ki'laiyinmeal pani iraamuzhuthum thanggiyirunthathu.
en magimai ennil sezhiththoanggi, en kaiyilu'l'la en vil puthupbelan ko'ndathu.
enakkuch sevikoduththuk kaaththirunthaarga'l; en aaloasanaiyaik keattu mavunamaayirunthaarga'l.
en peachchukkup peasaamalirunthaarga'l; en vasanam avarga'lmeal thu'lithu'liyaay vizhunthathu.
mazhaikkuk kaaththirukki'rathupoal enakkuk kaaththirunthu, pinmaarikku aasaiyu'l'lavarga'lpoal thangga'l vaayai aaven'ru thi'ranthirunthaarga'l.
naan avarga'laip paarththu nagaikkumpoathu, avarga'l thu'nigarangko'l'lavillai; en mugakka'laiyai maa'rachseyyavum illai.
avarga'l vazhiyeapoaga enakkuch siththamaagumpoathu, naan thalaivanaay udkaarnthu, iraa'nuvaththukku'l raajaavaippoalum, thukkiththavarga'laith theat'raravupa'n'nugi'ravanaippoalum irunthean.
ippoathoa ennilum i'lavayathaanavarga'l ennaip pariyaasampa'n'nugi'raarga'l; ivarga'ludaiya pithaakka'lai naan en manthaiyaik kaakkum naayga'loadea vaikkavungkooda vedkappattiruppean.
viruththaappiyaththinaalea belanat'ruppoana avarga'l kaiga'linaal enakku enna uthaviyirunthathu.
ku'raichchalinaalum pasiyinaalum avarga'l vaadi, vegunaa'laayp paazhum ve'rumaiyumaana antharave'likku oadippoay,
sediga'lukku'l irukki'ra thazhaiga'laip pidungguvaarga'l; kaattuppoo'nduga'lin kizhangguga'l avarga'lukku aagaaramaayirunthathu.
avarga'l manusharin naduvilirunthu thuraththappattaarga'l; ka'l'lanaith thuraththugi'rathupoal: ka'l'lan ka'l'lan en'ru avarga'laith thuraththivittaarga'l.
avarga'l pa'l'laththaakkuga'lin vedippuga'lilum, boomiyin kebiga'lilum, kanmalaiga'lilum poay kudiyirunthaarga'l.
sediga'lukku'l'lirunthu katha'ri, kaagncho'riga'linkeezh othungginaarga'l.
avarga'l moodarin makka'lum, neesarin pi'l'laiga'lum, theasaththilirunthu thuraththu'ndavarga'lumaay irunthaarga'l.
aanaalum ippoathu naan avarga'lukkup paattum pazhamozhiyum aanean.
ennai aruvaruththu, enakkuth thooramaagi, en mugaththukku munbaagath thuppak koosaathirukki'raarga'l.
naan kattina kattai avar avizhththu, ennaich si'rumaippaduththinapadiyinaal, avarga'lum kadivaa'laththai en mugaththukku munbaaga utha'rivittaarga'l.
valathupaarisaththil vaalibar ezhumbi, en kaalga'laith thava'rivizhappa'n'ni, thangga'l keadaana vazhiga'lai enakku nearaaga aayaththappaduththugi'raarga'l.
en paathaiyaik keduththu, en aabaththai varththikkappa'n'nugi'raarga'l; atha'rku avarga'lukku oththaasaipa'n'nugi'ravarga'l theavaiyillai.
perithaana thi'rappu'ndaakki, thaangga'l keduththa vazhiyil pura'nduvarugi'raarga'l.
bayanggarangga'l enmeal thirumbivarugi'rathu, avaiga'l kaat'raippoala en aaththumaavaip pinthodarugi'rathu; en sugavaazhvu oru meagaththaippoal kadanthupoayit'ru.
aagaiyaal ippoathu en aaththumaa ennil mu'rinthupoayit'ru; ubaththiravaththin naadka'l ennaip pidiththukko'ndathu.
iraakkaalaththilea en elumbuga'l thu'laikkappattu, en narambuga'lukku i'laippaa'ruthal illaathirukki'rathu.
noayin ukkiraththinaal en uduppu vea'rupattuppoayit'ru; athu en anggiyin kazhuththuppattaiyaippoala, ennaich sut'rikko'ndathu.
seat'rilea tha'l'lappattean; thoo'lukkum saambalukkum oppaanean.
ummai noakkik kooppidugi'rean; neer enakku ma'ruuththaravu kodaathirukki'reer; kegnchini'rki'rean, enmeal paaraamugamaayirukki'reer.
enmeal kodooramu'l'lavaraaga maa'rineer; ummudaiya karaththin vallamaiyaal ennai viroathikki'reer.
neer ennaith thookki, ennaik kaat'rilea pa'rakkavittu, ennaip bayaththinaal urugippoagappa'n'nugi'reer.
sagala jeevaaththumaakka'lukkum ku'rikkappatta thaavaramaagiya mara'naththukku ennai oppukkoduppeer en'ru a'rivean.
aanaalum naan yaathoruvanai avan aabaththilea thavikkappa'n'ninathum,

thunnaa'laik ka'ndavanukkaaga naan azhaathirunthathum, e'liyavanukkaaga en aaththumaa viyaagulappadaathirunthathum u'ndaanaal, avar en manuvukku idangkodaamal, enakku viroathamaayth thamathu kaiyai neettuvaaraaga.
nanmaikkuk kaaththiruntha enakkuth theemai vanthathu; ve'lichchaththai varap paarththukko'ndiruntha enakku iru'l vanthathu.
en kudalga'l kothiththu, amaraathirukki'rathu; ubaththiravanaadka'l enmeal vanthathu.
veyil padaathirunthum, naan ka'ruka'ruththuth thirigi'rean; naan sabaiyilirunthu ezhunthirukkumpoathu ala'rugi'rean.
naan malaippaambuga'lukkuch sagoatharanum, koattaanga'lukkuth thoazhanumaanean.
en thoal enmeal ka'ruththuppoayit'ru; en elumbuga'l ush'naththinaal kaaynthupoayit'ru.
en surama'ndalam pulambalaagavum, en kinnaram azhugi'ravarga'lin oalamaagavum maa'rina.
en ka'nga'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nina naan oru kannigaiyinmeal ninaippaayiruppatheppadi?
appozhuthu unnathangga'lilirunthu theavan a'likkum panggum, unnathaththilirunthu sarvavallavar kodukkum suthantharamum kidaikkumoa?
maa'rupaadaanavanukku aabaththum, akkiramach seygaikkaararukku aakkinaiyumallavoa kidaikkum.
avar en vazhiga'laip paarththu, en nadaiga'laiyellaam e'n'nugi'raar allavoa?
naan maayaiyilea nadantheanoa, en kaal kabaduseyyath theeviriththathoa en'ru,
sumuththiraiyaana tharaasilea theavan ennai ni'ruththu, en uththamaththai a'rivaaraaga.
en nadaiga'l vazhiyaivittu vilaginathum, en iruthayam en ka'nga'laip pinthodarnthathum, eathaagilum oru maasu en kaiga'lil ottikko'ndathum u'ndaanaal,
appozhuthu naan vithaiththathai vea'roruvan pusippaanaaga; en payirga'l vearat'ruppoagakkadavathu.
en manam yaathoru sthireeyinmeal mayanggi, ayalaanudaiya vaasalai naan ettippaarththathu'ndaanaal,
appozhuthu en manaivi vea'roruvanukku maavaraippaa'laaga; veat'rumanithar ava'lmeal saayvaarga'laaga.
athu thoasham, athu niyaayaathibathiga'laal visaarikkappadum akkiramamaamea.
athu paathaa'lapariyantham padchikkum akkiniyaay en sambaththaiyellaam nirmoolamaakkum.
en vealaikkaaranaanaalum, en vealaikkaariyaanaalum, ennoadu vazhakkaadumpoathu, avarga'l niyaayaththai naan asattaipa'n'niyirunthaal,
theavan ezhumbumpoathu, naan ennaseyvean; avar visaarikkumpoathu, naan avarukku enna ma'ruuththaravu solluvean.
thaayin karppaththil ennai u'ndupa'n'ninavar avanaiyum u'ndupa'n'ninaar allavoa? oreavithamaana karppaththil engga'lai uruvaakkinaar allavoa?
e'liyavarga'l vaagnchiththathai naan kodaathirunthu, vithavaiyin ka'nga'laip pooththuppoagappa'n'ni,
thaaythagappanillaatha pi'l'lai en aagaaraththil saappidaamal, naan oruvanaaych saappittathu'ndoa?
en si'ruvayathumuthal avan thagappanidaththil va'larvathupoala ennoadea va'larnthaan; naan en thaayin karppaththilea pi'ranthathumuthal appadippattavarga'laik kailaagukoduththu nadaththinean.
oruvan uduppillaathathinaal madinthupoagi'rathaiyum, eazhaikku mooda vasthiramillaathirukki'rathaiyum naan ka'ndapoathu,
avan en aattumayirk kamba'liyinaalea analko'ndathinaal, avan idai ennaip pugazhaathirunthathum,
olimugavaasalil enakkuch selvaakku u'nden'ru naan ka'ndu, thikkat'ravanukku viroathamaay en kaiyai neettinathum u'ndaanaal,
en kaippattai thoa'lilirunthu sarinthu, en puyaththu elumbu mu'rinthupoavathaaga.
theavan aakkinaiyiduvaar en'rum, avarudaiya magaththuvaththai uththarikkakkoodaathu en'rum, enakkup bayanggaramaayirunthathu.
naan ponninmeal en nambikkaiyai vaiththu, thanggaththaippaarththu: nee en aatharavu en'ru naan sonnathum,
en aasthiperiyathen'rum, en kaikku miguthiyum kidaiththathen'rum naan magizhnthathum,
sooriyan piragaasikkumpoathum, allathu santhiran magimaiyaaych sellumpoathum, naan athai noakki:
en manam iragasiyamaay mayakkappattu, en vaay en kaiyai muththi seythathu'ndaanaal,
ithuvum niyaayaathibathiga'laal visaarikkappadaththakka akkiramamaayirukkum; athinaal unnathaththilirukki'ra theavanai ma'ruthalippeanea.
en pagaignanudaiya aabaththilea naan magizhnthu, pollaappu avanukku nearittapoathu ka'likoornthiruntheanoa?
avan jeevanukkuch saabaththaik kodukkumpadi virumbi, vaayinaal paavagnseyya naan idangkodukkavillai.
avan inaththaarga'lil thirupthiyaagaathavanaik kaa'nbippavan yaaren'ru en koodaaraththin manushar sollaarga'loa?
paratheasi veethiyilea iraaththangginathillai; vazhippoakkanukku en vaasalga'laith thi'ranthean.
naan aathaamaippoala en mee'ruthalga'lai moodi, en akkiramaththai en madiyilea o'liththuvaiththeanoa?

thira'laana en koottaththukku naan bayanthathinaalaavathu, inaththaar janaththaar pa'n'num igazhchchi ennaith thidukkidappa'n'ninathinaalaavathu, naan peasaathirunthu, vaasa'rpadiyai vittup pu'rappadaathiruntheanoa?
aa, en vazhakkaik keadki'ravan oruvan irunthaal nalamaayirukkum; ithoa, sarvavallavar enakku uththaravu aru'lichseyyavum, en ethiraa'li than vazhakkai ezhuthikkodukkavum enakku viruppamu'ndu.
athai naan en thoa'linmeal vaiththu, enakkuk kireedamaagath thariththukko'lveanea.
avanukku naan en nadaiga'laith thogai thogaiyaayk kaa'nbiththu, oru pirabuvaippoala avanidaththil poavean.
enakku viroathamaaga en kaa'niboomi kooppidugi'rathum, athin padaichchaalga'lkooda azhugi'rathum,
koolikodaamal naan athin palanaip pusiththu, payirittavarga'lin aaththumaavai ubaththiravappaduththinathum u'ndaanaal,
athil koathumaikkup bathilaaga mu'l'lum, vaa'rkoathumaikkup bathilaagak ka'laiyum mu'laikkakkadavathu en'raan. yoabin vaarththaiga'l mudinthathu.
yoabu than paarvaikku neethimaanaayirunthapadiyinaal, avanukku antha moon'ru manusharum pirathiyuththaram solli oaynthaarga'l.

athinaal raamin vamsaththaanaana boosiyanaagiya barakeyealin kumaaran eligoovukkuk koabam moo'ndathu; yoabu, theavanaippaarkkilum thannaiththaan neethimaanaakkinathinimiththam, avanmealum avanukkuk koabam moo'ndathu.
kodukkaththakka ma'rumozhi yoabin moon'ru sineagitharukkum agappadaathirunthum, avarga'l avanai aagaathavanen'ru theerththathinimiththam, avarga'lmealum avanukkuk koabam moo'ndathu.
avarga'l thannaippaarkkilum vayathusen'ravarga'laanapadiyinaal, eligoo yoabin vaarththaiga'l mudinthu theerumattum kaaththirunthaan.
antha moon'ru manusharin vaayilum ma'ruuththaravu pi'rakkavillaiyen'ru eligoo ka'ndapoathu, avanukkuk koabam moo'ndathu.

aathalaal barakeyealin kumaaran eligoo ennum boosiyan pirathiyuththaramaaga: naan i'lavayathu'l'lavan, neengga'loa viruththaappiyar; aagaiyaal naan agnchi, en abippiraayaththai ungga'lukku munbaaga ve'lippaduththap bayanthirunthean.
muthiyoar peasattum, vayathusen'ravarga'l gnaanaththai a'rivikkattum en'rirunthean.
aanaalum manusharil oru aaviyu'ndu; sarvavallavarudaiya suvaasamea avarga'lai u'narvu'l'lavarga'laakkum.
periyoarellaam gnaaniga'lalla; muthiyoarellaam neethiyai a'rinthavarga'lumalla.
aagaiyaal enakkuch sevikodungga'l; naanum en abippiraayaththai ve'lippaduththuvean en'rean.
ithoa, ungga'l vasanangga'l mudiyumattum kaaththirunthean; neengga'l sollaththakkathai aaraaynthu theadumattum, ungga'l niyaayangga'lukkuch sevikoduththean.
naan ungga'l sollaik kavaniththean; aanaalum ithoa, ungga'lil yoabukku niyaayaththaith theriyakkaatti, avarudaiya vasanangga'lukku eat'ra pirathiyuththaram sollugi'ravanillai.
gnaanaththaik ka'ndupidiththoam en'ru neengga'l sollaathapadi paarungga'l; manushanalla, theavanea avarai jeyangko'l'lavea'ndum.
avar ennaippaarththup peasinathillai; neengga'l sonna vaarththaiga'linaal naan avarukkup pirathiyuththaram solvathumillai.
avarga'l kalanggi, appu'ram pirathiyuththaram sollaathirukki'raarga'l; avarga'lukkup peachchu at'ruppoayit'ru.
avarga'l peasaarga'loa en'ru kaaththirunthean; aanaalum avarga'l appu'ram ma'rumozhi kodaamalirunthapadiyinaal,
naanum pirathiyuththaramaaga enakkuth thoan'riyamattum solluvean; naanum en abippiraayaththai ve'lippaduththuvean.
vaarththaiga'l enakku'l ni'rainthirukki'rathu; en u'l'laththilu'l'la aavi ennai nerukki eavugi'rathu.
ithoa, en u'l'lam adaikkappattirunthu, puthuth thuruththiga'lai muthalaayp pee'rappa'n'nugi'ra puthu rasaththaippoalirukki'rathu.
naan aa'ruthaladaiyumpadi peasuvean; en uthaduga'laith thi'ranthu pirathiyuththaram solluvean.
naan oruvanudaiya mugaththaip paaraamalum, oru manushanukkum ichchagam peasaamalum iruppeanaaga.
naan ichchagam peasa a'riyean; peasinaal ennai u'ndaakkinavar seekkiramaay ennai eduththukko'lvaar.
yoabea, en niyaayangga'laik kea'lum; en vaarththaiga'lukkellaam sevikodum.
ithoa, en vaayai ippoathu thi'ranthean; en vaayilirukki'ra en naavaanathu peasum.
en vaarththaiga'l en iruthayaththin u'nmaikku oththirukkum; naan a'rinthathai en uthaduga'l suththamaay vasanikkum.
theavanudaiya aaviyaanavar ennai u'ndaakkinaar; sarvavallavarudaiya suvaasam enakku uyirkoduththathu.
ummaalea koodumaanaal enakku ma'rumozhi kodum; neer aayaththappattu enakku ethiraaga nillum.
ithoa, ummaippoala naanum theavanaal u'ndaanavan; naanum ma'n'ninaal uruvaakkappattavan.
ithoa, neer enakkup bayappattuk kalanggath theavaiyillai; en kai ummeal baaramaayirukkamaattaathu.
naan kaathaarak keadka neer sonnathum, enakkuk kea'lviyaana ummudaiya vaarththaiga'lin saththamum ennaven'raal:
naan mee'ruthal illaatha suththan, naan kut'ramat'ravan, ennil akkiramamillai.
ithoa, ennil avar kut'rampidikkap paarkki'raar, ennaith thamakkuch saththuruvaaga e'n'nikko'l'lugi'raar.
avar en kaalga'laith thozhuvilea maatti, en nadaiga'laiyellaam kaavalpaduththugi'raar en'ru sonneer.
ithilea neer neethiyu'l'lavar allaven'ru umakkup pirathiyuththaramaagach sollugi'rean; manushanaippaarkkilum theavan periyavaraayirukki'raar.
avar thammudaiya seyalga'l ellaavat'raiyungku'riththuk kaara'nam sollavillaiyen'ru neer avaroadea ean vazhakkaadugi'reer?
theavan oruvisai solliyirukki'ra kaariyaththai ira'ndaamvisai paarththuth thiruththugi'ravarallavea.
kananiththirai manusharmeal i'ranggi, avarga'l padukkaiyinmeal ayarnthirukkaiyil,
avar iraakkaalaththuth tharisanamaana soppanaththilea manusharudaiya sevikkuth thaam seyyum kaariyaththai ve'lippaduththi, athai avarga'lukku varum tha'ndanaiyinaalea muththiraipoattu,
manushan thannudaiya seygaiyaivittu neenggavum, manusharudaiya perumai adanggavum seygi'raar.
ivvithamaay avan aaththumaavaip padukuzhikkum, avan jeevanaip pattaya vettukkum thappuvikki'raar.
avan than padukkaiyilea vaathaiyinaalum, than sagala elumbuga'lilum agoaramaana noavinaalum tha'ndikkappadugi'raan.
avan jeevan appaththaiyum, avan aaththumaa rusigaramaana poajanaththaiyum aroasikkum.
avan maamsam kaa'nappadaathapadikku azhinthu, moodappattiruntha avan elumbuga'l ve'lippadugi'rathu.
avan aaththumaa paathaa'laththukkum, avan piraa'nan saavukkum sameebikki'rathu.
aayiraththil oruvaraagiya saamaasipa'n'nugi'ra thoothanaanavar manushanukkuth thammudaiya nithaanaththai a'rivikkumpadikku, avanukku anusaariyaayirunthaareayaagil,
avar avanukku iranggi, avan padukuzhiyil i'ranggaathapadikku: neer avanai iradchiyum; meedkumporu'lai naan ka'ndupidiththean enbaar.
appozhuthu avan maamsam vaalibaththil irunthathaippaarkkilum aaroakkiyamadaiyum; than vaalavayathu naadka'lukkuth thirumbuvaan.
avan theavanai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'numpoathu, avan avarudaiya samugaththaik kembeeraththoadea paarkkumpadi avar avanmeal piriyamaagi, antha manushanukku avanudaiya neethiyin palanaik koduppaar.
avan manusharai noakkippaarththu: naan paavagnseythu semmaiyaanathaip purattinean, athu enakkup pirayoajanamaayirukkavillai.
en aaththumaa padukuzhiyil i'ranggaathapadi, avar athai iradchippaar; aagaiyaal en piraa'nan ve'lichchaththaik kaa'num en'ru solluvaan.
ithoa, theavan manushanudaiya aaththumaavaip padukuzhikku vilakkugi'ratha'rkum, avanai jeevanu'l'loarin ve'lichchaththinaalea piragaasippikki'ratha'rkum,
avar ivaiga'laiyellaam avanidaththil palamu'rai nadappikki'raar.
yoabea, neer kavaniththu en sollaik kea'lum; naan peasappoagi'rean, neer mavunamaayirum.
sollaththakka niyaayangga'l irunthatheayaanaal, enakku ma'ruuththaravu kodum; neer peasum, ummai neethimaanaagath theerkka enakku aasaiyu'ndu.
on'rum illaathirunthatheayaagil neer en sollaik kea'lum, mavunamaayirum, naan umakku gnaanaththai ubatheasippean en'raan.
pinnum eligoo maa'ruththaramaaga:
gnaaniga'lea, en vaarththaiga'laik kea'lungga'l; a'rivaa'liga'lea, enakkuch sevikodungga'l.
vaayaanathu poajanaththai rusipaarkki'rathupoala, seviyaanathu vaarththaiga'laich soathiththuppaarkkum.
namakkaaga niyaayamaanathaith therinthuko'lvoamaaga; nanmai innathen'ru namakku'l'lea a'rinthuko'lvoamaaga.
yoabu: naan neethimaan; theavan en niyaayaththaith tha'l'livittaar en'rum,
niyaayam ennidaththil irunthum naan poyyanen'ru e'n'nappadugi'rean; mee'ruthal illaathirunthum, ambinaal enakku u'ndaana kaayam aa'raathathaayirukki'rathen'rum sonnaarea.
yoabaippoalavea, pariyaasampa'n'nuthalaith tha'n'neeraippoal kudiththu,
akkiramakkaararoadea koodikko'ndu, thunmaarkkaroadea thirigi'ravan yaar?
eppadiyenil, theavanmeal piriyam vaikki'rathu manushanukkup pirayoajanam alla en'raarea.
aagaiyaal buththimaanga'lea, enakkuch sevikodungga'l; akkiramam theavanukkum, aneethi sarvavallavarukkum thooramaayirukki'rathu.
manushanudaiya seygaikkuththakkathai avanukkuch sarikkatti, avanavan nadakkaikkuththakkathaaga avanavanukkup palana'likki'raar.
theavan aniyaayagn seyyaamalum, sarvavallavar neethiyaip purattaamalum irukki'rathu meyyea.
boomiyinmeal manushanukku athigaaram koduththavar yaar? poochchakkaram muzhuthaiyum ozhungguppaduththinavar yaar?
avar thammudaiya iruthayaththai avanukku viroathamaagath thiruppinaaraagil, avanudaiya aaviyaiyum avanudaiya suvaasaththaiyum thammidaththil izhuththukko'l'luvaar.
appadiyea maamsamaana yaavum eagamaay jeeviththuppoam, manushan thoo'lukkuth thirumbuvaan.
umakku u'narvirunthaal ithaik kea'lum, en vaarththaiga'lin saththaththukkuch sevikodum.
neethiyaip pagaikki'ra oruvan aa'lakkoodumoa? mahaa neethipararaik kut'rappaduththuveeroa?
oru raajaavaip paarththu, nee pollaathavan en'rum, athibathiga'laip paarththu, neengga'l akkiramakkaarar en'rum sollaththagumoa?

ippadiyirukka, pirabukka'lin mugaththaippaaraamalum, eazhaiyaippaarkkilum aisuvariyavaanai athigamaay e'n'naamalum irukki'ravarai noakki ippadich sollalaamaa? ivarga'l ellaarum avar karangga'lin kiriyaiyea.
ippadippattavarga'l sadithiyil saavaarga'l; janangga'l paathijaamaththil kalanggi ozhinthupoavaarga'l; kaa'naatha kaiyinaal balavanthar azhinthupoavaarga'l.
avarudaiya ka'nga'l manusharudaiya vazhiga'lai noakkiyirukki'rathu; avarga'ludaiya nadaiga'laiyellaam avar paarkki'raar.
akkiramakkaarar o'liththukko'l'laththakka anthagaaramumillai, mara'na iru'lumillai.
manushan theavanoadea vazhakkaadumpadi avar avanmeal mignchinathon'raiyum sumaththamaattaar.
aaraaynthu mudiyaatha niyaayamaay avar vallamaiyu'l'lavarga'lai no'rukki, vea'rea manusharai avarga'l sthaanaththilea ni'ruththugi'raar.
avarga'l kiriyaiga'lai avar a'rinthavaraanapadiyaal, avarga'l nasunggippoagaththakkathaay iraakkaalaththil avarga'laik kavizhththuppoadugi'raar.
avarga'l avarai vittup pinvaanggi, avarudaiya ellaa vazhiga'laiyum u'narnthuko'l'laamal poanapadiyinaalum,
e'liyavarga'lin kookkural avaridaththil searumpadi seythathinaalum, si'rumaiyaanavanudaiya kookkuralaik keadki'ra avar,
ellaarum paarkkumpadi avarga'laith thunmaarkkaren'ru adikki'raar.
maayakkaaran aa'laathapadikkum, janangga'l sikkikko'l'lappadaathapadikkum,
oru janaththukkaanaalum oru manushanukkaanaalum, avar samaathaanaththai aru'linaal yaar kalanggappa'n'nuvaan? avar thamathu mugaththai ma'raiththaal avaraik kaa'ngi'ravan yaar?
naan tha'ndikkappattean; naan inip paavagnseyyamaattean.
naan kaa'naatha kaariyaththai neer enakkup poathiyum, naan aniyaayam pa'n'nineanaanaal, naan ini appadich seyvathillai en'ru theavanai noakkich sollaththagumea.

neer appadich seyyamaattoamengi'rapadiyinaal, ummoadirukki'ravarga'lil oruvanai umakkup bathilaaga athaich seyyachsolveeroa? naan alla, neerea therinthuko'l'lavea'ndum; allaven'raal, neer a'rinthirukki'rathaich sollum.
yoabu a'rivillaamal peasinaar; avar vaarththaiga'l gnaanamu'l'lavaiga'l allaven'ru,
buththiyu'l'la manushar en padchamaayp peasuvaarga'l; gnaanamu'l'la manushanum enakkuch sevikoduppaan.
akkiramakkaarar sonna ma'ruuththaravuga'linimiththam yoabu mut'ramudiya soathikkappadavea'ndiyathea en abeadchai.
thammudaiya paavaththoadea mee'ruthalaik koottinaar; avar engga'lukku'l'lea kaikotti, theavanukku viroathamaayth thammudaiya vaarththaiga'lai miguthiyaaga vasaniththaar en'raan.
pinnum eligoo maa'ruththaramaaga:
en neethi theavanudaiya neethiyaippaarkkilum periyathen'ru neer sonnathu niyaayam en'ru e'n'nugi'reeroa?
naan paaviyaayiraathathinaal enakkup pirayoajanamenna? palan enna? en'ru sonneer.
umakkum ummoadea irukki'ra ummudaiya sineagitharukkum naan pirathiyuththaram sollugi'rean.
neer vaanaththai a'n'naanthupaarththu, ummaippaarkkilum uyaramaayirukki'ra aagaayama'ndalangga'laik ka'n'noakkum.
neer paavagnseythaal athinaalea avarukku enna nashdam? ummudaiya mee'ruthalga'l miguthiyaanaalum, athinaalea avarukku enna seatham?
neer neethimaanaayirunthaal, athinaalea avarukku enna kidaikkum? allathu avar ummudaiya kaiyil enna laabaththaip pe'ruvaar?
ummudaiya paavaththinaal ummaippoan'ra manushanukku nashdamum, ummudaiya neethiyinaal manupuththiranukku laabamum u'ndaagum.
aneagaraal balavanthamaay odukkappattavarga'l mu'raiyittu, vallavarga'ludaiya puyaththinimiththam ala'rugi'raarga'l.
boomiyin mirugangga'laippaarkkilum engga'laip buththimaanga'lum, aagaasaththup pa'ravaiga'laippaarkkilum engga'lai gnaanavaanga'lumaakki,
ennai u'ndaakkinavarum, iravilum keethampaada aru'lseygi'ravarumaagiya en sirushdikarththaavaagiya theavan enggea en'ru keadpavan oruvanumillai.
anggea avarga'l pollaathavarga'lin perumaiyinimiththam kooppidugi'raarga'l; avaroa ma'ruuththaravu kodukki'rathillai.
theavan vee'nvaarththaikkuch sevikodaar, sarvavallavar athaik kavaniyaar.
avarudaiya tharisanam umakkuk kidaikki'rathillai en'ru neer sollugi'reerea; aanaalum niyaayaththeerppu avaridaththil irukki'rathu; aagaiyaal avarukkuk kaaththukko'ndirum.
ippoathu avarudaiya koabamaanathu niyaayaththai mut'rilum visaariyaathu; avar innum on'raiyum ku'raiyat'ravithamaayth theerkkavillai.
aagaiyaal yoabu vee'naayth thammudaiya vaayaith thi'ranthu, a'rivillaamal vaarththaiga'lai miguthiyaay vasanikki'raar en'raan.
pinnum eligoo:
naan peasimudiyumattum sat'rea po'rum; innum theavanpadchaththil naan sollavea'ndiya niyaayangga'lai umakkuch sollikkaa'nbippean.
naan thooraththilirunthu en gnaanaththaik ko'nduvanthu, ennai u'ndaakkinavarudaiya neethiyai vi'langgappa'n'nuvean.
meyyaagavea en vaarththaiga'l poyyat'rirukkum; ummoadea peasugi'ravan a'rivil thea'rinavan.
ithoa, theavan magaththuvamu'l'lavar, avar oruvaraiyum pu'rakka'niyaar; mana urukkaththilum avar magaththuvamu'l'lavar.
avar thunmaarkkaraip pizhaikka ottaathirukki'raar; si'rumaiyaanavarga'lin niyaayaththai visaarikki'raar.
avar thammudaiya ka'nga'lai neethimaanga'laivittu vilakkaamal, avarga'lai raajaakka'loadea koodach singgaasanaththil ea'ravum, uyarntha sthalaththil en'raikkum udkaarnthirukkavum seygi'raar.
avarga'l vilangguga'l poadappattu, ubaththiravaththin kayi'ruga'laal kattappattirunthaalum,
avar, avarga'l kiriyaiyaiyum, mignchippoana avarga'ludaiya mee'ruthalga'laiyum avarga'lukkuth theriyappaduththi,
akkiramaththai vittuth thirumbumpadi avarga'l seviyaith thi'ranthu kadinthuko'l'lugi'raar.
avarga'l adanggi avaraich seaviththaal, thangga'l naadka'lai nanmaiyaagavum, thangga'l varushangga'laich selvavaazhvaagavum poakkuvaarga'l.
adanggaarga'leayaagil pattayaththukku iraiyaagi, gnaanam adaiyaamal maa'ndupoavaarga'l.
maayamu'l'la iruthayaththaar kuroathaththaik kuviththukko'l'lugi'raarga'l; avarga'lai avar kattivaikkumpoathu kegnchik kooppiduvaarga'l.
avarga'l vaalavayathilea maa'ndupoavaarga'l; ilachchaiyaanavarga'lukku'l'lea avarga'l piraa'nan mudiyum.
si'rumaippattavarga'lai avar si'rumaikku neenggalaakki, avarga'l odukkappattirukkaiyil avarga'l seviyaith thi'rakki'raar.
appadiyea avar ummaiyum nerukkaththinin'ru vilakki, odukkamillaatha visaalaththilea vaippaar; ummudaiya poajanapanthi kozhumaiyaana pathaarththangga'laal ni'rainthirukkum.
aagaathavanmeal varum niyaayaththeerppu ni'raivea'rap paarppeer; niyaayamum neethiyum ummai aatharikkum.
ukkiramu'ndaayirukki'rathinaal avar ummai oru adiyinaal vaarikko'ndu poagaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirum; appozhuthu meedkumporu'lai miguthiyaayk koduththaalum atha'rku neer neenggalaagamaatteer.
ummudaiya selvaththai avar mathippaaroa? ummudaiya ponnaiyum, poora'na baraakkiramaththaiyum avar mathikkamaattaarea.
janangga'l thangga'l idaththaivittu vaarikko'l'lappadappoagi'ra iravai vaagnchikkaathirum.
akkiramaththukkuth thirumbaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirum; ubaththiravaththaippaarkkilum akkiramaththaith therinthuko'ndeerea.
ithoa, theavan thammudaiya vallamaiyil uyarnthirukki'raar; avaraippoal poathikki'ravar yaar?
avarudaiya vazhiyin niyaayaththai visaarikkaththakkavan yaar? neer aniyaayam seytheer en'ru sollaththakkavan yaar?
manushar noakkippaarkki'ra avarudaiya kiriyaiyai neer magimaippaduththa ninaiyum.
ellaa manusharum athaik kaa'ngi'raarga'lea; thooraththilirunthu athu manusharukku ve'lippadugi'rathu.
ithoa, theavan magaththuvamu'l'lavar; naam avarai a'riya mudiyaathu; avarudaiya varushangga'lin ilakkam aaraaynthu mudiyaathathu.
avar neerththu'liga'lai a'nuvaippoala ea'rappa'n'nugi'raar; avaiga'l meagaththilirunthu mazhaiyaaych sorigi'rathu.
athai meagangga'l peythu, manusharmeal miguthiyaayp pozhigi'rathu.
meagangga'lin paravuthalaiyum, avarudaiya koodaaraththilirunthu ezhumbum kumu'ralga'laiyum a'riyamudiyumoa?
ithoa, athinmeal thammudaiya minnalin o'liyai virikki'raar; samuththiraththin aazhangga'laiyum moodugi'raar.
avaiga'laal janangga'lai tha'ndikki'ravarum, aagaarangkoduththu iradchikki'ravarumaayirukki'raar.
avar minnalin o'liyaith thamathu kaikku'l'lea moodi, athu inninnathai adikkavea'ndumen'ru katta'laiyidugi'raar.
athinaal avar seyya ninaikki'rathaiyum, manthaaram ezhumbappoagi'rathaiyum, aadumaaduga'l a'riyappaduththum.
ithinaal en iruthayam thaththa'liththu, thannidaththaivittuth the'rikki'rathu.
avarudaiya saththaththinaal u'ndaagi'ra athirchchiyaiyum, avar vaayilirunthu pu'rappadugi'ra muzhakkaththaiyum kavanamaayk kea'lungga'l.
avar vaanaththin keezhenggum anthath thoniyaiyum, boomiyin kadaiyaantharangga'lmeal athin minnalaiyum sellavidugi'raar.
atha'rkuppinbu avar saththamaay muzhanggi, thammudaiya magaththuvaththin saththaththaik kumu'rappa'n'nugi'raar; avarudaiya saththam keadkappadumpoathu athaith thavirkkamudiyaathu.
theavan thammudaiya saththaththai aachchariyamaanavithamaayk kumu'rappa'n'nugi'raar; naam kiragikkakkoodaatha periyakaariyangga'lai avar seygi'raar.
avar u'raintha mazhaiyaiyum, kalmazhaiyaiyum, thammudaiya vallamaiyin perumazhaiyaiyum paarththu: boomiyinmeal peyyungga'l en'ru katta'laiyidugi'raar.
thaam u'ndaakkina sagala manusharum thammai a'riyumpadikku, avar sagala manusharudaiya kaiyaiyum muththiriththuppoadugi'raar.
appozhuthu kaattumirugangga'l thangga'l kugaiga'lil pugunthu, thangga'l kebiga'lil thanggum.
the'rkeayirunthu soo'raava'liyum, vadakaat'rinaal ku'lirum varum.
thammudaiya suvaasaththinaal theavan ku'liraik kodukki'raar; appozhuthu jalaththin mea'rparappaanathu u'rainthupoam.
avar neerththu'liga'lai meagaththil eat'ri, minnalinaal meagaththaich sitha'rappa'n'nugi'raar.
avar avaiga'lukkuk katta'laiyidugi'ra yaavaiyum, avaiga'l poochchakkaraththil nadappikkumpadi, avar avaiga'laith thammudaiya gnaana aaloasanaiga'linpadiyea sut'rith thiriyappa'n'nugi'raar.
on'ril tha'ndanaiyaagavum, on'ril thammudaiya boomikku ubayoagamaagavum, on'ril kirubaiyaagavum, avaiga'lai varappa'n'nugi'raar.
yoabea, itha'rkuch sevikodum; thariththunin'ru theavanudaiya aachchariyamaana kiriyaiga'laith thiyaaniththuppaarum.
theavan avaiga'laith thittampa'n'ni, thammudaiya meagaththin minnalaip piragaasikkappa'n'num vithaththai a'riveeroa?
meagangga'l thonggumpadi vaikkum ni'raiyaiyum, poora'na gnaanamu'l'lavarin a'rputhamaana seygaiga'laiyum,
then'ralinaal avar boomiyai amaiyappa'n'numpoathu, ummudaiya vasthirangga'l ush'namaayirukkum vagaiyaiyum a'riveeroa?
vaarkkappatta ka'n'naadiyaippoal kettiyaana aagaayama'ndalangga'lai neer avaroadeakooda irunthu viriththeeroa?
avarukku naam sollaththakkathai engga'lukkup poathiyum; anthagaaraththinimiththam mu'raithappip peasugi'roam.
naan peasaththu'ninthean en'ru yaathaamoruvan avarukku munbaagach sollaththagumoa? oruvan peasaththu'ninthaal avan vizhunggappattuppoavaanea.
ippoathum kaat'ru veesi aagaayama'ndalangga'lilu'l'la mappu neenggappa'n'niyirukki'ra samayaththil vadakkeayirunthu ponmayamaana kaanthi varugi'rapoathu,
aagaayama'ndalaththilea piragaasikki'ra sooriyanai muthalaay oruvarum noakkip paarkkakkoodaathea; theavanidaththiloa bayanggaramaana magaththuvamu'ndu.
sarvavallavarai naam ka'ndupidikkakkoodaathu; avar vallamaiyilum niyaayaththilum peruththavar; avar mahaaneethiparar; avar odukkamaattaar.
aagaiyaal manushar avarukkup bayappadavea'ndum; thangga'l e'n'naththil gnaaniga'laayirukki'ra evarga'laiyum avar mathikkamaattaar en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar: perungkaat'rilirunthu yoabukku uththaravaaga:
a'rivillaatha vaarththaiga'linaal aaloasanaiyai anthagaarappaduththugi'ra ivan yaar?
ippoathum purushanaippoal idaikattikko'l; naan unnaik keadpean; nee enakku uththaravu sollu.
naan boomiyai asthibaarappaduththugi'rapoathu nee enggeayirunthaay? nee a'rivaa'liyaanaal athai a'rivi.
atha'rku a'lavu ku'riththavar yaar? athinmeal noolpoattavar yaar? ithai nee a'rinthirunthaal sollu.
athin aathaarangga'l ethinmeal poadappattathu? athin koadikkallai vaiththavar yaar?
appozhuthu vidiya'rkaalaththu nadchaththirangga'l eagamaayp paadi, theavapuththirar ellaarum kembeeriththaarga'lea.
karppaththilirunthu uthikki'rathupoal samuththiram pura'nduvanthapoathu, athaik kathavuga'laal adaiththavar yaar?
meagaththai atha'rku vasthiramaagavum, iru'lai atha'rkup pudavaiyaagavum naan uduththinapoathum,
naan atha'rku ellaiyaik ku'riththu, atha'rkuth thaazhppaa'lga'laiyum kathavuga'laiyum poattu:
immattum vaa, mignchi varaathea; un alaiga'lin perumai inggea adanggakkadavathu en'ru naan sollugi'rapoathum nee enggeayirunthaay?
thushdarga'l boomiyilirunthu utha'rippoadappadumpadikku, athin kadaiyaantharangga'laip pidikkumporuttu,
un jeevakaalaththil eppoathaavathu nee vidiya'rkaalaththukkuk katta'laikoduththu, aru'noathayaththukku athin idaththaik kaa'nbiththathu'ndoa?
boomi muththiraiyidappatta ka'lima'npoal vea'rea roobangko'l'lum; sagalamum vasthiram thariththirukki'rathupoal kaa'nappadum.
thunmaarkkarin o'li avarga'lai vittu edupadum; meattimaiyaana puyam mu'rikkappadum.
nee samuththiraththin adiththalangga'lmattum pugunthu, aazhaththin adiyil ulaavinathu'ndoa?
mara'navaasalga'l unakkuth thi'ranthathu'ndoa? mara'na iru'lin vaasalga'lai nee paarththathu'ndoa?
nee boomiyin visaalangga'lai aaraaynthu a'rinthathu'ndoa? ivaiga'laiyellaam nee a'rinthirunthaal sollu.
ve'lichcham vaasamaayirukkum idaththukku vazhiyenggea? iru'l kudiko'ndirukkum sthaanamenggea?
athin ellai innathen'ru unakkuth theriyumoa? athin veettukkuppoagi'ra paathaiyai a'rinthirukki'raayoa?
nee athai a'riyumpadi appoathu pi'ranthirunthaayoa? un naadka'lin thogai avva'lavu perithoa?
u'raintha mazhaiyin pa'ndasaalaiga'lukku'l nee piraveasiththaayoa? kalmazhaiyirukki'ra pa'ndasaalaiga'laip paarththaayoa?
aabaththu varungkaalaththilum, kalagamum yuththamum varungkaalaththilum, pirayoagikkumpadi naan avaiga'lai vaiththuvaiththirukki'rean.
ve'lichcham paravappadugi'ratha'rkum, keezhkkaat'ru boomiyinmeal veesugi'ratha'rkumaana vazhi enggea?
paazhum antharave'liyumaana tharaiyaith thirupthiyaakki, i'lampoo'nduga'lin mu'laiga'lai mu'laikkappa'n'numpadi,
boomiyenggum manushar kudiyillaatha idaththilum, manushasagnchaaramillaatha vanaantharaththilum mazhaiyai varushikkappa'n'ni,
ve'l'laththukku neerkkaalga'laiyum, idimuzhakkangga'loadu varum minnalukku vazhiga'laiyum paguththavar yaar?
mazhaikku oru thagappanu'ndoa? paniththu'liga'lai janippiththavar yaar?
u'raintha tha'n'neer yaarudaiya vayit'rilirunthu pu'rappadugi'rathu? aagaayaththinudaiya u'raintha paniyaip pet'ravar yaar?
jalam kalluruvangko'ndu ma'rainthu, aazhaththin mugam kettiyaay u'rainthirukki'rathea.
a'rumeen nadchaththiraththin sugirtha sambanthaththai nee i'naikkakkoodumoa? allathu mirugaseerishaththin kattuga'lai avizhppaayoa?
iraasiga'lai athinathin kaalaththilea varappa'n'nuvaayoa? thuruvachsakkara nadchaththiraththaiyum athaich searntha nadchaththirangga'laiyum vazhinadaththuvaayoa?
vaanaththin niyamangga'lai nee a'rivaayoa? athu boomiyaiyaa'lum aa'lugaiyai nee thittampa'n'nuvaayoa?
earaa'lamaana tha'n'neer unmeal soriyavea'num en'ru un saththaththai meagangga'lpariyantham uyarththuvaayoa?
nee minnalga'lai azhaiththanuppi, avaiga'l pu'rappattuvanthu: ithoa, inggeayirukki'roam en'ru unakkuch sollumpadi seyvaayoa?
anthakkara'nangga'lil gnaanaththai vaiththavar yaar? u'l'laththil buththiyaik koduththavar yaar?
gnaanaththinaalea kodimaasiga'lai e'n'nubavar yaar?
thoo'laanathu eagapaa'lamaagavum, ma'nkattiga'l on'roadon'ru ottikko'l'lavum, aagaayaththuruththiga'lilu'l'la tha'n'neeraip pozhiyappa'n'nugi'ravar yaar?
nee singgaththukku iraiyai veattaiyaadi,
singgakkuttiga'l thaangga'l thanggum idangga'lilea kidanthu kebiyilea pathivirukki'rapoathu, avaiga'lin aasaiyaith thirupthiyaakkuvaayoa?
kaakkaikkugnchuga'l theavanai noakkik kooppittu, aagaaramillaamal pa'ranthu alaigi'rapoathu, avaiga'lukku iraiyaich savathariththuk kodukki'ravar yaar?
varaiyaaduga'l eenungkaalaththai a'rivaayoa? maanga'l kuttipoadugi'rathaik kavaniththaayoa?
avaiga'l sinaippattirunthu varugi'ra maathangga'lai nee e'n'ni, avaiga'l eenungkaalaththai a'rivaayoa?
avaiga'l nonthu kuninthu thangga'l kuttiga'laip poattu, thangga'l veathanaiga'lai neekkividum.
avaiga'lin kuttiga'l balaththu, vanaththilea va'larnthu, avaiga'la'ndaikkuth thirumba varaama'rpoayvidum.
kaattukkazhuthaiyaith thannichchaiyaayth thiriyavittavar yaar? anthak kaattukkazhuthaiyin kattuga'lai avizhththavar yaar?
atha'rku naan vanaantharaththai veedaagavum, uvarnilaththai vaasasthalamaagavum koduththean.
athu patta'naththin iraichchalai aladchiyampa'n'ni, oattugi'ravanudaiya kookkuralai mathikki'rathillai.
athu malaiga'lilea than meaychchalaik ka'ndupidiththu, sagalavithap pachchaippoo'nduga'laiyum theadiththiriyum.
kaa'ndaamirugam unnidaththil seavikkach sammathikkumoa? athu un munna'naikku munbaaga iraaththanggumoa?
padaichchaalga'lai uzha nee kaa'ndaamirugaththaik kayi'rupoattu earilea poottuvaayoa? athu unakku isainthu parampadikkumoa?
athu athiga belamu'l'lathen'ru nee nambi athinidaththil vealai vaangguvaayoa?
un thaaniyaththai athu un veettil ko'nduvanthu, un ka'lagnchiyaththil searkkum en'ru nee athai nambuvaayoa?
theekkuruviga'l thangga'l settaiga'lai asaivaatti oadugi'ra oattam, naarai than settaiga'laalum i'raguga'laalum pa'rakki'ratha'rkuch samaanamallavoa?
athu than muttaiga'laith tharaiyilea ittu, avaiga'lai ma'nalilea analu'raikka vaiththuvittuppoay,
kaalaal mithipattu udainthupoam enbathaiyum, kaattumirugangga'l avaiga'lai mithiththuvidum enbathaiyum ninaikki'rathillai.
athu than kugnchuga'l thannudaiyathallaathathupoala avaiga'laik kaakkaatha kadinaku'namu'l'lathaayirukkum; avaiga'lukkaaga atha'rkuk kavalaiyillaathapadiyinaal athu patta varuththam viruthaavaam.
theavan atha'rkup buththiyaik kodaamal, gnaanaththai vilakkivaiththaar.
athu settai viriththu ezhumbumpoathu, kuthiraiyaiyum athinmeal ea'riyirukki'ravanaiyum aladchiyampa'n'num.
kuthiraikku nee veeriyaththaik koduththaayoa? athin tho'ndaiyil kumu'ralai vaiththaayoa?
oru vettukki'liyai mirattugi'rathupoala athai mirattuvaayoa? athinudaiya naasiyin serukku bayanggaramaayirukki'rathu.
athu tharaiyilea thaa'ladiththu, than balaththil ka'liththu, aayuthangga'laith thariththavarukku ethiraagap pu'rappadum.
athu kalanggaamalum, pattayaththukkup pinvaanggaamalumirunthu, bayappaduthalai aladchiyampa'n'num.
amba'raaththoo'niyum, minnugi'ra eettiyum, keadagamum athinmeal kalakalakkumpoathu,
karvamum moorkkamungko'ndu tharaiyai vizhunggividugi'rathupoal anumaaniththu, ekkaa'laththin thonikku agnchaamal paayum.
ekkaa'lam thonikkumpoathu athu nigiyen'ru kanaikkum; yuththaththaiyum, padaiththalaivarin aarpparippaiyum, seanaiga'lin aaravaaraththaiyum thooraththilirunthu moappam pidikkum.
un buththiyinaalea raajaa'li pa'ranthu, the'rkukku ethiraagath than settaiga'lai virikki'rathoa?
un ka'rpanaiyinaalea kazhugu uyarap pa'ranthu, uyaraththilea than koottaik kattumoa?
athu kanmalaiyilum, kanmalaiyin sigaraththilum, ara'naana sthalaththilum thanggi vaasampa'n'num.
anggeayirunthu iraiyai noakkum; athin ka'nga'l thooraththilirunthu athaip paarkkum.
athin kugnchuga'l iraththaththai u'rignchum; pi'nam enggeayoa anggea kazhugu searum en'raar.
pinnum karththar yoabukku uththaramaaga:
sarvavallavaroadea vazhakkaadi avarukkup buththi padippikki'ravan yaar? theavanpearil kut'ram pidikki'ravan ivaiga'lukku uththaravu sollakkadavan en'raar.
appozhuthu yoabu karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaga:
ithoa, naan neesan; naan umakku enna ma'ruuththaravu solluvean; en kaiyinaal en vaayaip poththikko'l'lugi'rean.
naan ira'ndorutharam peasinean; ini naan pirathiyuththaram kodaamalum peasaamalum iruppean en'raan.
appozhuthu karththar perungkaat'ril irunthu yoabukku uththaravu aru'linaar.
ippoathum purushanaippoala nee araikattikko'l; naan unnaik keadpean; nee enakku uththaravu sollu.
nee en niyaayaththai avamaakkuvaayoa? nee unnai neethimaanaakkikko'l'lumpadikku enmeal kut'ragnsumaththuvaayoa?
theavanudaiya puyaththaippoal unakkup puyamu'ndoa? avaraippoal idimuzhakkamaaych saththamidakkoodumoa?
ippoathum nee mukkiyaththaalum magaththuvaththaalum unnai alanggariththu, magimaiyaiyum kanaththaiyum thariththukko'ndu,
nee un koabaththin ukkiraththai veesi, aganthaiyu'l'lavanaiyellaam theadippaarththuth thaazhththivittu,
perumaiyu'l'lavanaiyellaam kavaniththu, avanaip pa'niyappa'n'ni, thunmaarkkarai avarga'lirukki'ra sthalaththilea mithiththuvidu.
nee avarga'lai eagamaayp puzhuthiyilea puthaiththu, avarga'l mugangga'lai antharanggaththilea kattippoadu.
appozhuthu un valathukai unakku iradchippu u'ndupa'n'num en'ru solli, naan unnaip pugazhuvean.
ippoathum bigemoaththai nee kavaniththuppaar; unnai u'ndaakkinathupoala athaiyum u'ndaakkinean; athu maattaippoal pullaith thinnum.
ithoa, athinudaiya belan athin iduppilum, athin veeriyam athin vayit'rin narambuga'lilum irukki'rathu.
athu than vaalaik keathurumaraththaippoal neettugi'rathu; athin iduppu narambuga'l pinnikko'ndirukki'rathu.
athin elumbuga'l kettiyaana ve'ngalaththaippoalavum, athin asthiga'l iruppuk kambiga'laippoalavum irukki'rathu.
athu theavanudaiya kiriyaiga'lil pirathaanamaana oru kiriyai, athai u'ndaakkinavar atha'rku oru pattayaththaiyum koduththaar.
kaattumirugangga'l yaavum vi'laiyaadugi'ra malaiga'l atha'rku meaychchalai vi'laivikkum.
athu nizhalu'l'la sediga'lin keezhum, naa'nalin ma'raivilum, u'laiyilum paduththukko'l'lum.
thazhaiga'lin nizhal athaik kavinthu, nathiyin alariga'l athaich soozhnthuko'l'lum.
ithoa, nathi pura'nduvanthaalum athu bayanthoadaathu; yoarthaan nathiyaththanai tha'n'neer athin mugaththil moathinaalum athu asaiyaamalirukkum.
athin ka'nga'l paarththirukka athai yaar pidikkakkoodum? mookka'naangkayi'rupoada athin mookkai yaar kuththakkoodum?
liviyaathaanai thoo'ndilinaal pidikkakkoodumoa? athin naakkai nee vidugi'ra kayit'rinaalea pidikkakkoodumoa?
athin mookkai naarkkayi'rupoattuk kattakkoodumoa? ku'rattinaal athin thaadaiyai uruvak kuththakkoodumoa?
athu unnaip paarththu aneaga vi'n'nappagn seyyumoa? unnai noakki ichchagavaarththaiga'laich sollumoa?
athu unnoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'numoa? athaich sathaakaalamum adimaiko'lvaayoa?
oru kuruviyoadea vi'laiyaadugi'rathupoal, nee athanoadea vi'laiyaadi, athai nee un pe'nmakka'la'ndaiyilea kattivaippaayoa?
koottaa'liga'l athaip pidikkap pirayaththanappattu, athai viyaabaariga'lukkup panggiduvaarga'loa?
nee athin thoalai aneaga ambuga'linaalum, athin thalaiyai e'rivallaiyangga'linaalum e'rivaayoa?
athinmeal un kaiyaippoadu, yuththaththai ninaiththukko'l; ini appadich seyyath thu'niyamaattaay.
ithoa, athaip pidikkalaam en'ru nambinavan moasampoay, athaip paarththavudanea vizhuvaan allavoa?
athai ezhuppaththakka thairiyavaan illaathirukka, enakku munbaaga ni'rpavan yaar?
thanakkup bathilkodukkappadumpadi, munthi enakkuk koduththavan yaar? vaanaththin keezhu'l'lavaiga'l ellaam ennudaiyavaiga'l.
athin anggangga'lum, athin veeriyamum, athin udal isaivin nearththiyum innathen'ru naan sollaamal ma'raikkamaattean.
athu moodiyirukki'ra athin poarvaiyaik ki'lappakkoodiyavan yaar? athin ira'ndu thaadaiga'lin naduvea kadivaa'lam poadaththakkavan yaar?
athin mugaththin kathavaith thi'rakkakkoodiyavan yaar? sut'rilumirukki'ra athin pa'rka'l bayanggaramaanavaiga'l.
muththiraip pathippuppoala azhuththangko'ndu adarththiyaayirukki'ra athin parisaiga'lin ara'nippu mahaa si'rappaayirukki'rathu.
avaiga'l naduvea kaat'rum pugamaattaatha nerukkamaay avaiga'l on'roadon'ru i'naikkappattirukki'rathu.
avaiga'l on'roadon'ru ottikko'ndu i'naipiriyaamal pidiththukko'ndirukki'rathu.
athu thummugaiyil o'li veesum, athin ka'nga'l aru'noathayaththin puruvangga'laippoal irukki'rathu.
athin vaayilirunthu erigi'ra panthangga'l pu'rappattu, akkinippo'riga'l pa'rakkum.
kothikki'ra sattiyilum kopparaiyilum irunthu pu'rappadugi'rathupoala, athin naasiga'lilirunthu pugai pu'rappadum.
athin suvaasam kariga'laik ko'luththum, athin vaayilirunthu juvaalai pu'rappadum.
athin kazhuththilea belan kudiko'ndirukkum; bayanggaram atha'rkumun kooththaadum.
athin uda'rkoo'ruga'l, asaiyaatha kettiyaay on'roadon'ru ottikko'ndirukkum.
athin negnchu kallaippoalavum, eanthiraththin adikkallaippoalavum kettiyaayirukkum.
athu ezhumbumpoathu balasaaliga'l agnchi bayaththinaal mayanggith thigaippaarga'l.
athaith thaakkugi'ravanudaiya pattayam, eetti, vallaiyam, kavasam, on'rum atha'rkumun ni'rkaathu.
athu irumbai vaikkoalaagavum, ve'ngalaththai u'luththa maramaagavum e'n'num.
ambu athaith thuraththaathu; kava'nka'rka'l atha'rkuth thurumbaagum.
athu perunthadiga'laith thaa'ladiga'laaga e'n'ni, eettiyin asaivai igazhum.
athin keezhaagak koormaiyaana ka'rka'l kidanthaalum, athu seat'rinmeal oadugi'rathupoalak karukkaana avaiga'linmealum oadum.
athu aazhaththai ulaippaanaiyaippoal ponggappa'n'ni, kadalaith thailampoalak kalakkividum.
athu thanakkup pinnaagap paathaiyaith thulanggappa'n'num; aazhamaanathu ve'luppaana naraiyaippoal vi'langgum.
boomiyinmeal atha'rku oppaanathu on'rumillai; athu nirpbayamaayirukka u'ndupa'n'nappattathu.
athu meattimaiyaanathaiyellaam a'rpamaay e'n'nugi'rathu; athu aganggaaramu'l'la jeevanga'lukkellaam raajaavaayirukki'rathu en'raar.
appozhuthu yoabu karththarukkup pirathiyuththaramaaga:
theavareer sagalaththaiyum seyya vallavar; neer seyya ninaiththathu thadaipadaathu enbathai a'rinthirukki'rean.
a'rivillaamal aaloasanaiyai ma'raikki'ra ivan yaar? aagaiyaal naan enakkuth theriyaathathaiyum, en buththikku ettaathathaiyum, naan a'riyaathathaiyum alappinean engi'rean.
neer enakkuch sevikodum, appozhuthu naan peasuvean; naan ummaik kea'lvikeadpean, neer enakku uththaravu sollum.
en kaathinaal ummaikku'riththuk kea'lvippattean; ippozhuthoa en ka'n ummaik kaa'ngi'rathu.
aagaiyaal naan ennai aruvaruththu, thoo'lilum saambalilum irunthu manasthaabappadugi'rean en'raan.

karththar intha vaarththaiga'lai yoaboadea peasinapin, karththar theamaaniyanaana elippaasai noakki: unmealum un ira'ndu sineagitharmealum enakkuk koabam moo'lugi'rathu; en thaasanaagiya yoabu peasinathupoal, neengga'l ennaikku'riththu nithaanamaayp peasavillai.

aathalaal neengga'l eazhu kaa'laiga'laiyum, eazhu aattukkadaakka'laiyum therinthuko'ndu, en thaasanaagiya yoabinidaththil poay, ungga'lukkaagach sarvaangga thaganabaliga'lai idungga'l; en thaasanaagiya yoabum ungga'lukkaaga vea'nduthal seyvaan; naan avan mugaththaip paarththu, ungga'lai ungga'l buththiyeenaththukkuth thakkathaaga nadaththaathiruppean; en thaasanaagiya yoabu peasinathupoal, neengga'l ennaikku'riththu nithaanamaayp peasavillai en'raar.

appozhuthu theamaaniyanaana elippaasum soogiyanaana bilthaathum naagamaaththiyanaana soappaarum poay, karththar thangga'lukkuch sonnapadiyea seythaarga'l; appozhuthu karththar yoabin mugaththaip paarththaar.

yoabu than sineagitharukkaaga vea'nduthal seythapoathu, karththar avan si'raiyiruppai maat'rinaar. yoabukku mun iruntha ellaavat'raippaarkkilum ira'ndaththanaiyaayk karththar avanukkuth thantharu'linaar.

appozhuthu avanudaiya ellaach sagoathararum sagoathariga'lum, mun avanukku a'rimugamaana anaivarum avanidaththil vanthu, avan veettilea avanoadea poajanampa'n'ni, karththar avanmeal varappa'n'nina sagala theengginimiththam avanukkaaga anggalaayththu, avanukku aa'ruthal solli, avaravar ovvoru thanggakkaasaiyum, avaravar ovvoru pon aabara'naththaiyum avanukkuk koduththaarga'l.

karththar yoabin munnilaimaiyaip paarkkilum avan pinnilaimaiyai aaseervathiththaar; pathinaalaayiram aaduga'lum, aa'raayiram ottagangga'lum, aayiram earga'lum, aayiram kazhuthaiga'lum avanukku u'ndaayina.
eazhu kumaararum, moon'ru kumaaraththiga'lum avanukkup pi'ranthaarga'l.
mooththa maga'lukku emeemaa'l en'rum, ira'ndaam maga'lukkuk kethseeyaa'l en'rum, moon'raam maga'lukkuk keareanaappuk en'rum pearittaan.
theasaththil enggum yoabin kumaaraththiga'laippoal saunthariyamaana pe'nga'l kaa'nappadavillai; avarga'l thagappan avarga'l sagoathararin naduvilea avarga'lukkuch suthantharam koduththaan.
itha'rkuppinbu yoabu noot'runaa'rpathu varusham uyiroadirunthu, naalu thalaimu'raiyaagath than pi'l'laiga'laiyum than pi'l'laiga'ludaiya pi'l'laiga'laiyum ka'ndaan.
yoabu nedunaa'lirunthu, poora'na vayathu'l'lavanaay mariththaan.
thunmaarkkarudaiya aaloasanaiyil nadavaamalum, paaviga'ludaiya vazhiyil nillaamalum, pariyaasakkaarar udkaarum idaththil udkaaraamalum,
karththarudaiya veathaththil piriyamaayirunthu, iravum pagalum avarudaiya veathaththil thiyaanamaayirukki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan.
avan neerkkaalga'lin oaramaay nadappattu, than kaalaththil than kaniyaith thanthu, ilaiyuthiraathirukki'ra maraththaippoaliruppaan; avan seyvathellaam vaaykkum.
thunmaarkkaroa appadiyiraamal, kaat'rup pa'rakkadikkum patharaippoal irukki'raarga'l.
aagaiyaal thunmaarkkar niyaayaththeerppilum, paaviga'l neethimaanga'lin sabaiyilum nilaini'rpathillai.
karththar neethimaanga'lin vazhiyai a'rinthirukki'raar; thunmaarkkarin vazhiyoa azhiyum.
jaathiga'l kontha'liththu, janangga'l viruthaakkaariyaththaich sinthippaanean?
karththarukku viroathamaagavum, avar abisheagampa'n'ninavarukku viroathamaagavum, boomiyin raajaakka'l ezhumbinin'ru, athigaariga'l eagamaay aaloasanaipa'n'ni:
avarga'l kattuga'lai a'ruththu, avarga'l kayi'ruga'lai nammaivittu e'rinthupoaduvoam engi'raarga'l.
paraloagaththil veet'rirukki'ravar nagaippaar; aa'ndavar avarga'lai igazhuvaar.
appozhuthu avar thamathu koabaththilea avarga'loadea peasi, thamathu ukkiraththilea avarga'laik kalanggappa'n'nuvaar.
naan ennudaiya parisuththa parvathamaagiya seeyoanmeethil ennudaiya raajaavai abisheagampa'n'ni vaiththean en'raar.
theermaanaththin vivaram solluvean; karththar ennai noakki: neer ennudaiya kumaaran, in'ru naan ummai jenippiththean;
ennaik kea'lum, appozhuthu jaathiga'lai umakkuch suthantharamaagavum, boomiyin ellaiga'lai umakkuch sonthamaagavum koduppean;
iruppukkoalaal avarga'lai no'rukki, kuyakkalaththaippoal avarga'lai udaiththuppoaduveer en'ru sonnaar.
ippoathum raajaakka'lea, u'narvadaiyungga'l, boomiyin niyaayaathibathiga'lea, echcharikkaiyaayirungga'l.
bayaththudanea karththaraich seaviyungga'l, nadukkaththudanea ka'likoorungga'l.

kumaaran koabangko'l'laamalum, neengga'l vazhiyilea azhiyaamalum irukkumpadikku, avarai muththagn seyyungga'l; kognchakkaalaththilea avarudaiya koabam pat'riyeriyum; avarai a'ndikko'l'lugi'ra yaavarum baakkiyavaanga'l.
karththaavea, en saththurukka'l evva'lavaayp perugiyirukki'raarga'l! enakku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'ravarga'l aneagar.
theavanidaththil avanukku iradchippu illaiyen'ru, en aaththumaavaik ku'riththuch sollugi'ravarga'l aneagaraayirukki'raarga'l. (sealaa.)
aanaalum karththaavea, neer en keadagamum, en magimaiyum, en thalaiyai uyarththugi'ravarumaayirukki'reer.
naan karththarai noakkich saththamittuk kooppittean; avar thamathu parisuththa parvathaththilirunthu enakkuch sevikoduththaar. (sealaa.)
naan paduththu niththirai seythean; vizhiththukko'ndean; karththar ennaith thaanggugi'raar.
enakku viroathamaagach sut'rilum padaiyeduththu varugi'ra pathinaayirampearukkum naan bayappadean.
karththaavea, ezhuntharu'lum; en theavanea, ennai iradchiyum. neer en pagaignar ellaaraiyum thaadaiyilea adiththu, thunmaarkkarudaiya pa'rka'laith thagarththuppoatteer.
iradchippu karththarudaiyathu; theavareerudaiya aaseervaatham ummudaiya janaththinmeal iruppathaaga. (sealaa.)
en neethiyin theavanea, naan kooppidugaiyil enakkuch sevikodum; nerukkaththil iruntha enakku visaalamu'ndaakkineer; enakku iranggi, en vi'n'nappaththaik keattaru'lum.
manupuththirarea, ethuvaraikkum en magimaiyai avamaanappaduththi, vee'naanathai virumbi, poyyai naaduveerga'l. (sealaa.)
bakthiyu'l'lavanaik karththar thamakkaagath therinthuko'ndaaren'ru a'riyungga'l; naan karththarai noakkik kooppidugaiyil avar keadpaar.
neengga'l koabangko'ndaalum, paavagnseyyaathirungga'l; ungga'l padukkaiyilea ungga'l iruthayaththil peasikko'ndu amarnthirungga'l. (sealaa.)
neethiyin baliga'laich seluththi, karththarmeal nambikkaiyaayirungga'l.
engga'lukku nanmai kaa'nbippavan yaar en'ru sollugi'ravarga'l aneagar; karththaavea, ummudaiya mugaththin o'liyai engga'lmeal piragaasikkappa'n'num.
avarga'lukkuth thaaniyamum thiraadcharasamum perugiyirukki'rakaalaththin santhoashaththaippaarkkilum, athiga santhoashaththai en iruthayaththil thantheer.
samaathaanaththoadea paduththukko'ndu niththiraiseyvean; karththaavea, neer oruvarea ennaich sugamaayth thanggappa'n'nugi'reer.
karththaavea, en vaarththaiga'lukkuch sevikodum, en thiyaanaththaik kavaniyum.
naan ummidaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'nuvean; en raajaavea, en theavanea, en vea'nduthalin saththaththaik keattaru'lum.
karththaavea, kaalaiyilea en saththaththaik keattaru'luveer; kaalaiyilea umakku nearea vanthu aayaththamaagi, kaaththiruppean.
neer thunmaarkkaththil piriyappadugi'ra theavan alla; theemai ummidaththil searvathillai.
veembukkaarar ummudaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaaga nilaini'rkamaattaarga'l; akkiramakkaarar yaavaraiyum ve'rukki'reer.
poy peasugi'ravarga'lai azhippeer; iraththappiriyanaiyum soothu'l'la manushanaiyum karththar aruvarukki'raar.
naanoa umathu miguntha kirubaiyinaalea umathu aalayaththukku'l piraveasiththu, umathu parisuththa sannithikku nearea bayabakthiyudan pa'ninthuko'l'luvean.
karththaavea, en saththurukka'linimiththam ennai ummudaiya neethiyilea nadaththi, enakkumunbaaga ummudaiya vazhiyaich sevvaippaduththum.
avarga'l vaayil u'nmai illai, avarga'l u'l'lam keadupaadu'l'lathu; avarga'l tho'ndai thi'rakkappatta pireathakkuzhi; thangga'l naavinaal ichchagam peasugi'raarga'l.

theavanea, avarga'laik kut'ravaa'liga'laagath theerum; avarga'l thangga'l aaloasanaiga'laaleayea vizhumpadi seyyum; avarga'l thuroagangga'linudaiya thiradchiyinimiththam avarga'laith tha'l'lividum; umakku viroathamaayk kalagampa'n'ninaarga'lea.
ummai nambugi'ravarga'l yaavarum santhoashiththu, ennaa'lum kembeerippaarga'laaga; neer avarga'laik kaappaat'ruveer; ummudaiya naamaththai neasikki'ravarga'l ummil ka'likooruvaarga'laaga.
karththaavea, neer neethimaanai aaseervathiththu, kaaru'niyam ennung keadagaththinaal avanaich soozhnthuko'l'luveer.
karththaavea, ummudaiya koabaththilea ennaik kadinthuko'l'laatheayum, ummudaiya ukkiraththilea ennaith tha'ndiyaatheayum.
enmeal irakkamaayirum karththaavea, naan belanat'ruppoanean; ennaik ku'namaakkum karththaavea, en elumbuga'l nadunggugi'rathu.
en aaththumaa migavum viyaagulappadugi'rathu; karththaavea, ethuvaraikkum iranggaathiruppeer.
thirumbum karththaavea, en aaththumaavai viduviyum; ummudaiya kirubaiyinimiththam ennai iradchiyum.
mara'naththil ummai ninaivukoorvathillai, paathaa'laththil ummaith thuthippavan yaar?
en perumoochchinaal i'laiththuppoanean; iraamuzhuvathum en ka'n'neeraal en padukkaiyai migavum eeramaakki, en kattilai nanaikki'rean.
thuyaraththinaal en ka'n kuzhi vizhunthupoayit'ru, en saththurukka'l anaivar nimiththamum manggippoayit'ru.
akkiramakkaararea, neengga'l ellaarum ennaivittu agan'rupoangga'l; karththar en azhugaiyin saththaththaik keattaar.
karththar en vi'n'nappaththaik keattaar; karththar en jebaththai eat'rukko'l'luvaar.
en pagaignar ellaarum vedki migavum kalanggippoavaarga'l; avarga'l pinnaagath thirumbich sadithiyilea vedkappaduvaarga'l.
en theavanaagiya karththaavea, ummai nambiyirukki'rean; ennaith thunbappaduththugi'ravarga'l ellaarukkum ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
saththuru singgampoal en aaththumaavaip pidiththukko'ndupoay, viduvikki'ravan illaamaiyaal, athaippee'raathapadikku ennaith thappuviyum.
en theavanaagiya karththaavea, naan ithaich seythathum, en kaiga'lil niyaayakkeadirukki'rathum,
ennoadea samaathaanamaayirunthavanukku naan theemaiseythathum, kaara'namillaamal enakkuch saththuruvaanavanai naan ko'l'laiyittathum u'ndaanaal,
pagaignan en aaththumaavaith thodarnthupidiththu, en piraa'nanaith tharaiyilea tha'l'li mithiththu, en magimaiyaith thoo'lilea thaazhththakkadavan. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, neer ummudaiya koabaththil ezhunthirunthu, en saththurukka'ludaiya moorkkangga'linimiththam ummai uyarththi, enakkaaga vizhiththukko'l'lum; niyaayaththeerppai niyamiththirukki'reerea.
janakkoottam ummaich soozhnthuko'l'lum; avarga'lukkaagath thirumbavum unnathaththi'rku ezhuntharu'lum.
karththar janangga'lukku niyaayagn seyvaar; karththaavea, en neethiyinpadiyum ennilu'l'la u'nmaiyinpadiyum enakku niyaayagnseyyum.
thunmaarkkanudaiya pollaanggai ozhiyappa'n'num; neethimaanai sthirappaduththuveeraaga; neethiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'ra theavareer iruthayangga'laiyum u'l'linthiriyangga'laiyum soathiththa'rigi'ravar.
semmaiyaana iruthayamu'l'lavarga'lai iradchikki'ra theavanidaththil en keadagam irukki'rathu.
theavan neethiyu'l'la niyaayaathibathi; avar naa'lthoa'rum paaviyinmeal sinangko'l'lugi'ra theavan.
avan mananthirumbaavittaal avar thammudaiya pattayaththaik karukkaakkuvaar; avar thammudaiya villai naa'neat'ri, athai aayaththappaduththiyirukki'raar.
avanukku mara'naayuthangga'lai aayaththampa'n'ninaar; thammudaiya ambuga'lai akkini ambuga'laakkinaar.
ithoa, avan akkiramaththaip pe'rak karppaveathanaippadugi'raan; theevinaiyaik karppanthariththu, poyyaip pe'rugi'raan.
kuzhiyai vetti, athai aazhamaakkinaan; thaan vettina kuzhiyil thaanea vizhunthaan.
avan theevinai avan sirasinmeal thirumbum, avan kodumai avan uchchanthalaiyinmeal i'ranggum.
naan karththarai avarudaiya neethiyinpadi thuthiththu, unnathamaana karththarudaiya naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
engga'l aa'ndavaraagiya karththaavea, ummudaiya naamam boomiyenggum evva'lavu meanmaiyu'l'lathaayirukki'rathu! ummudaiya magaththuvaththai vaanangga'lukku mealaaga vaiththeer.
pagaignanaiyum pazhikaaranaiyum adakkippoada, theavareer ummudaiya saththurukka'linimiththam kuzhanthaiga'l paalagar vaayinaal belan u'ndupa'n'nineer.
umathu viralga'lin kiriyaiyaagiya ummudaiya vaanangga'laiyum, neer sthaabiththa santhiranaiyum nadchaththirangga'laiyum naan paarkkumpoathu,
manushanai neer ninaikki'ratha'rkum, manushakumaaranai neer visaarikki'ratha'rkum avan emmaaththiram engi'rean.
neer avanaith theavathootharilum sat'ru si'riyavanaakkineer; magimaiyinaalum kanaththinaalum avanai mudisoottineer.
ummudaiya karaththin kiriyaiga'linmeal neer avanukku aa'lugai thanthu, sagalaththaiyum avanudaiya paathangga'lukkuk keezhppaduththineer.
aadumaaduga'lellaavat'raiyum, kaattumirugangga'laiyum,
aagaayaththup pa'ravaiga'laiyum, samuththiraththu machchangga'laiyum, kadalga'lil sagncharikki'ravaiga'laiyum avanudaiya paathangga'lukkuk keezhppaduththineer.
engga'l aa'ndavaraagiya karththaavea, ummudaiya naamam boomiyenggum evva'lavu meanmaiyu'l'lathaayirukki'rathu!
