karththaavea, en muzhu iruthayaththoadum ummaith thuthippean; ummudaiya athisayangga'laiyellaam vivarippean.
ummil magizhnthu ka'likooruvean; unnathamaanavarea, umathu naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
en saththurukka'l pinnaagath thirumbumpoathu, umathu samugaththil avarga'l ida'ru'ndu azhinthupoavaarga'l.
neer en niyaayaththaiyum en vazhakkaiyum theerththu, neethiyu'l'la niyaayaathibathiyaay singgaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'reer.
jaathiga'laik kadinthuko'ndu, thunmaarkkarai azhiththu, avarga'l naamaththai en'ren'raikkum illaathapadi kulaiththuppoatteer.
saththurukka'l en'ren'raikkum paazhaakkappattaarga'l; avarga'l patta'nangga'lai nirmoolamaakkineer; avarga'l pearum avarga'loadeakooda ozhinthupoayit'ru.
karththaroa en'ren'raikkum iruppaar; thammudaiya singgaasanaththai niyaayaththeerppukku aayaththampa'n'ninaar.
avar poochchakkaraththai neethiyaay niyaayantheerththu, sagala janangga'lukkum semmaiyaay neethiseyvaar.
si'rumaippattavanukkuk karththar adaikkalamaanavar; nerukkappadugi'ra kaalangga'lil avarea thagnchamaanavar.
karththaavea, ummaith theadugi'ravarga'lai neer kaividugi'rathillai; aathalaal, umathu naamaththai a'rinthavarga'l ummai nambiyiruppaarga'l.
seeyoanil vaasamaayirukki'ra karththaraik keerththanampa'n'ni, avar seygaiga'lai janangga'lukku'l'lea a'riviyungga'l.
iraththappazhiga'laikku'riththu avar visaara'nai seyyumpoathu, avaiga'lai ninaikki'raar; si'rumaippattavarga'ludaiya kooppiduthalai ma'ravaar.
mara'navaasalga'lilirunthu ennaith thookkividugi'ra karththaavea, naan ummudaiya thuthiga'laiyellaam seeyoan kumaaraththiyin vaasalga'lil vivariththu, ummudaiya iradchippinaal ka'likoorumpadikku,
theavareer enakku iranggi, ennaip pagaikki'ravarga'laal enakku varum thunbaththai noakkippaarum.
jaathiga'l thaangga'l vettina kuzhiyil thaangga'lea vizhunthaarga'l; avarga'l ma'raivaay vaiththa valaiyil avarga'ludaiya kaalea agappattukko'ndathu.
karththar thaam seytha niyaayaththinaal a'riyappadugi'raar; thunmaarkkan than kaiga'lin seygaiyilea sikkikko'ndaan. (ikaayoan, sealaa.)
thunmaarkkarum, theavanai ma'rakki'ra ellaa jaathiga'lum, naragaththilea tha'l'lappaduvaarga'l.
e'liyavan en'raikkum ma'rakkappaduvathillai; si'rumaippattavarga'ludaiya nambikkai orupoathum kettuppoavathillai.
ezhuntharu'lum karththaavea, manushan belanko'l'laathapadi seyyum; jaathiga'l ummudaiya samugaththil niyaayantheerkkappadakkadavarga'l.
jaathiga'l thangga'lai manusharen'ru a'riyumpadikku, avarga'lukkup bayamu'ndaakkum, karththaavea. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, ean thooraththil ni'rki'reer? aabaththu nearidugi'ra samayangga'lil neer ean ma'rainthirukki'reer?
thunmaarkkan than perumaiyinaal si'rumaippattavanaik kadooramaayth thunbappaduththugi'raan; avarga'l ninaiththa sathimoasangga'lil avarga'lea agappaduvaarga'l.
thunmaarkkan than u'l'lam ichchiththathaip pet'rathinaal perumaipaaraatti, poru'lai abagariththuth thannaiththaan poat'ri, karththarai asattaipa'n'nugi'raan.
thunmaarkkan than karvaththinaal theavanaith theadaan; avan ninaivuga'lellaam theavan illaiyenbathea.
avan vazhiga'l eppoathum keadu'l'lavaiga'l; ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuga'l avan paarvaikku ettaamal migavum uyaramaayirukki'rathu; than ethiraa'liga'lellaarmealum see'rugi'raan.
naan asaikkappaduvathillai, thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raithoa'rum theenggu ennai a'nuguvathillaiyen'ru than iruthayaththil sollikko'l'lugi'raan.
avan vaay sabippinaalum kabadaththinaalum kodumaiyinaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; avan naavinkeezh theevinaiyum akkiramamum u'ndu.
kiraamangga'lin o'lippidangga'lilea pathivirunthu, ma'raividangga'lilea kut'ramat'ravanaik kollugi'raan; thikkat'ravarga'laip pidikka avan ka'nga'l noakkikko'ndirukki'rathu.
than kebiyilirukki'ra singgaththaippoala ma'raivil pathivirukki'raan; eazhaiyaip pidikkap pathivirunthu, eazhaiyaith than valaikku'l izhuththup pidiththukko'l'lugi'raan.
thikkat'ravarga'l than balavaanga'l kaiyil vizhumpadi avan pathunggikkidakki'raan.
theavan athai ma'ranthaar en'rum, avar thammudaiya mugaththai ma'raiththu, orukkaalum athaik kaa'namaattaar en'rum, than iruthayaththilea sollikko'l'lugi'raan.
karththaavea, ezhuntharu'lum; theavanea, ummudaiya kaiyai uyarththum; eazhaiga'lai ma'ravaatheayum.
thunmaarkkan theavanai asattaipa'n'ni: neer keattu visaarippathillai en'ru than iruthayaththil sollikko'lvaanean?

athaip paarththirukki'reerea! ubaththiravaththaiyum kuroathaththaiyum kavaniththirukki'reerea; neer bathila'lippeer; eazhaiyaanavan thannai umakku oppuvikki'raan; thikkat'ra pi'l'laiga'lukkuch sagaayar neerea.
thunmaarkkanum pollaathavanumaayirukki'ravanudaiya puyaththai mu'riththuvidum; avanudaiya aagaamiyam kaa'naama'rpoagumattum athaith theadi visaariyum.
karththar sathaakaalangga'lukkum raajaavaayirukki'raar; pu'rajaathiyaar avarudaiya theasaththilirunthu azhinthupoavaarga'l.
karththaavea, si'rumaippattavarga'ludaiya vea'nduthalaik keattirukki'reer; avarga'l iruthayaththai sthirappaduththuveer.
ma'n'naana manushan inip balavanthagnseyyath thodaraathapadikku, theavareer thikkat'ra pi'l'laiga'lukkum odukkappattavarga'lukkum neethiseyya ummudaiya seviga'laich saayththuk keattaru'luveer.
naan karththarai nambiyirukki'rean; pinnai ean neengga'l en aaththumaavai noakki: padchiyaippoala un malaikkup pa'ranthupoa en'ru sollugi'reerga'l.
ithoa, thunmaarkkar villai va'laiththu, semmaiyaana iruthayaththaarmeal anthagaaraththil eyyumpadi thangga'l ambuga'lai naa'nilea thodukki'raarga'l.
asthibaarangga'lum nirmoolamaagi'rathea, neethimaan ennaseyvaan?

karththar thammudaiya parisuththa aalayaththil irukki'raar; karththarudaiya singgaasanam paraloagaththil irukki'rathu; avarudaiya ka'nga'l manupuththiraraip paarkki'rathu; avarudaiya imaiga'l avarga'laich soathiththa'rigi'rathu.
karththar neethimaanaich soathiththa'rigi'raar; thunmaarkkanaiyum kodumaiyil piriyamu'l'lavanaiyum avarudaiya u'l'lam ve'rukki'rathu.
thunmaarkkarmeal ka'n'niga'lai varushikkappa'n'nuvaar; akkiniyum kanthagamum kadungkoadaik kontha'lippum avarga'l kudikkum paaththiraththin panggu.
karththar neethiyu'l'lavar, neethiyinmeal piriyappaduvaar; avarudaiya mugam semmaiyaanavanai noakkiyirukki'rathu.
iradchiyum karththaavea, bakthiyu'l'lavan at'ruppoagi'raan; u'nmaiyu'l'lavarga'l manupuththiraril ku'rainthirukki'raarga'l.
avaravar thangga'l thoazharoadea poypeasugi'raarga'l; ichchaga uthaduga'laal irumanathaayp peasugi'raarga'l.
ichchagampeasugi'ra ellaa uthaduga'laiyum, perumaiga'laip peasugi'ra naavaiyum karththar a'ruththuppoaduvaar.
avarga'l: engga'l naavuga'laal mea'rko'l'luvoam, engga'l uthaduga'l engga'ludaiyathu; yaar engga'lukku aa'ndavan en'ru sollugi'raarga'l.

eazhaiga'l paazhaakkappattathinimiththamum, e'liyavarga'l vidum perumoochchinimiththamum, naan ippozhuthu ezhunthu, avanmeal see'rugi'ravarga'lukku avanaik kaaththuch sugamaayirukkappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
karththarudaiya so'rka'l ma'nkugaiyil eazhutharam urukki, pudamidappatta ve'l'likkoppaana suththa so'rka'laayirukki'rathu.
karththaavea, neer avarga'laik kaappaat'ri, avarga'lai en'raikkum inthach santhathikku vilakkik kaaththukko'l'luveer.
manupuththiraril sa'ndaa'lar uyarnthirukkumpoathu, thunmaarkkar enggum sut'riththirivaarga'l.
karththaavea, ethuvaraikkum ennai ma'ranthiruppeer, ethuvaraikkum ummudaiya mugaththai enakku ma'raippeer?
en iruthayaththilea sagnchalaththai niththam niththam vaiththu, ethuvaraikkum en aaththumaavilea aaloasanai pa'n'nikko'ndiruppean? ethuvaraikkum en saththuru enmeal thannai uyarththuvaan?
en theavanaagiya karththaavea, neer noakkippaarththu, enakkuch sevikoduththaru'lum; naan mara'naniththirai adaiyaathapadikku en ka'nga'laith the'livaakkum.
avanai mea'rko'ndean en'ru en pagaignan sollaathapadikkum, naan tha'l'laadugi'rathinaal en saththurukka'l ka'likooraathapadikkum ippadich seytharu'lum.
naan ummudaiya kirubaiyinmeal nambikkaiyaayirukki'rean; ummudaiya iradchippinaal en iruthayam ka'likoorum.
karththar enakku nanmaiseythapadiyaal avaraip paaduvean.
theavan illai en'ru mathikettavan than iruthayaththil sollikko'l'lugi'raan. avarga'l thangga'laik keduththu, aruvaruppaana kiriyaiga'laich seythuvarugi'raarga'l; nanmaiseygi'ravan oruvanum illai.
theavanaith theadugi'ra u'narvu'l'lavan u'ndoa en'ru paarkka, karththar paraloagaththilirunthu manupuththiraraik ka'n'noakkinaar.
ellaarum vazhivilagi, eagamaayk kettuppoanaarga'l; nanmaiseygi'ravan illai, oruvanaagilum illai.
akkiramakkaararil oruvanukkum a'rivuillaiyoa? appaththaip padchikki'rathupoala, en janaththaip padchikki'raarga'lea; avarga'l karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'lugi'rathillai.
anggea avarga'l migavum bayanthaarga'l; theavan neethimaanudaiya santhathiyoadea irukki'raarea.
si'rumaippattavanukkuk karththar adaikkalamaayirukki'raar en'ru solli, neengga'l avanudaiya aaloasanaiyai aladchiyampa'n'nineerga'l.
seeyoanilirunthu isravealukku iradchippu varuvathaaga; karththar thammudaiya janaththin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppumpoathu, yaakkoabukkuk ka'lippum, isravealukku magizhchchiyum u'ndaagum.
karththaavea, yaar ummudaiya koodaaraththil thangguvaan? yaar ummudaiya parisuththa parvathaththil vaasampa'n'nuvaan?
uththamanaay nadanthu, neethiyai nadappiththu, manathaarach saththiyaththaip peasugi'ravanthaanea.
avan than naavinaal pu'rangkoo'raamalum, than thoazhanukkuth theengguseyyaamalum, than ayalaanmeal sollappadum ninthaiyaana peachchai edukkaamalum irukki'raan.
aagaathavan avan paarvaikkuth theezhppaanavan; karththarukkup bayanthavarga'laiyoa kanampa'n'nugi'raan; aa'naiyittathil thanakku nashdam vanthaalum thava'raathirukki'raan.
than pa'naththai vattikkukkodaamalum, kut'ramillaathavanukku viroathamaayp parithaanam vaanggaamalum irukki'raan. ippadich seygi'ravan en'ren'raikkum asaikkappaduvathillai.
theavanea, ennaik kaappaat'rum, ummai nambiyirukki'rean.
en negnchamea, nee karththarai noakki: theavareer en aa'ndavaraayirukki'reer, en selvam umakku vea'ndiyathaayiraamal;
boomiyilu'l'la parisuththavaanga'lukkum, naan en muzhup piriyaththaiyum vaiththirukki'ra mahaaththumaakka'lukkum, athu vea'ndiyathaayirukki'rathu en'ru sonnaay.

anniya theavanai naadip pinpat'rugi'ravarga'lukku veathanaiga'l perugum; avarga'l seluththugi'ra iraththa baanabaliga'lai naan seluththamaattean, avarga'l naamangga'lai en uthaduga'linaal uchcharikkavumaattean.
karththar en suthantharamum en paaththiraththin panggumaanavar; en suthantharaththai theavareer kaappaat'rugi'reer.
nearththiyaana idangga'lil enakkup panggu kidaiththathu; aam, si'rappaana suthantharam enakku u'ndu.
enakku aaloasanai thantha karththaraith thuthippean; iraakkaalangga'lilum en u'l'linthiriyangga'l ennai u'narththum.
karththarai eppozhuthum enakku munbaaga vaiththirukki'rean; avar en valathupaarisaththil irukki'rapadiyaal naan asaikkappaduvathillai.
aagaiyaal en iruthayam pooriththathu, en magimai ka'likoornthathu; en maamsamum nambikkaiyoadea thanggiyirukkum.
en aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththil videer; ummudaiya parisuththavaanai azhivaik kaa'navotteer.
jeevamaarkkaththai enakkuth theriyappaduththuveer; ummudaiya samugaththil paripoora'na aananthamum, ummudaiya valathupaarisaththil niththiya pearinbamum u'ndu.
karththaavea, niyaayaththaik keattaru'lum, en kooppiduthalaik kavaniyum; kabadamillaatha uthaduga'linin'ru pi'rakkum en vi'n'nappaththi'rkuch sevikodum.
ummudaiya sannithiyilirunthu en niyaayam ve'lippaduvathaaga; ummudaiya ka'nga'l niyaayamaanavaiga'lai noakkuvathaaga.
neer en iruthayaththaip parisoathiththu, iraakkaalaththil athai visaariththu, ennaip pudamittuppaarththum on'rum kaa'naathirukki'reer; en vaay mee'raathapadikkuth theermaanampa'n'ninean.
manusharin seygaiga'laikku'riththu, naan ummudaiya uthaduga'lin vaakkinaalea thushdanudaiya paathaiga'lukku vilakkamaay ennaik kaaththuk ko'l'lugi'rean.
en kaaladiga'l vazhuvaathapadikku, en nadaiga'lai umathu vazhiga'lil sthirappaduththum.
theavanea, naan ummai noakkik kegnchugi'rean, enakkuch sevikodukki'reer; ennidaththil ummudaiya seviyaich saayththu, en vaarththaiyaik keattaru'lum.
ummai nambugi'ravarga'lai avarga'lukku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'ravarga'linin'ru umathu valathukaraththinaal thappuviththu iradchikki'ravarea! ummudaiya athisayamaana kirubaiyai vi'langgappa'n'num.
ka'nma'niyaippoala ennaik kaaththaru'lum.
ennai odukkugi'ra thunmaarkkarukkum, ennaich soozhnthuko'l'lugi'ra en piraa'nappagaignarukkum ma'raivaaga, ummudaiya settaiga'lin nizhalilea ennaik kaappaat'rum.
avarga'l ni'nanthunniyirukki'raarga'l, thangga'l vaayinaal veembu peasugi'raarga'l.
naangga'l sellum paathaiga'lil ippozhuthu engga'lai va'lainthuko'ndaarga'l; engga'laith tharaiyilea tha'l'lumpadi avarga'l ka'nga'l engga'lai noakkikko'ndirukki'rathu.
pee'rugi'ratha'rku aavalu'l'la singgaththukkum, ma'raividangga'lil pathivirukki'ra baalasinggaththukkum oppaayirukki'raarga'l.
karththaavea, neer ezhunthirunthu, avanukku ethirittu, avanai madanggadiyum; karththaavea, en aaththumaavaith thunmaarkkanudaiya kaikku ummudaiya pattayaththinaal thappuviyum.

manusharudaiya kaikkum, immaiyil thangga'l panggaip pet'rirukki'ra ulagamakka'lin kaikkum ummudaiya karaththinaal ennaith thappuviyum; avarga'l vayit'rai umathu thiraviyaththinaal nirappugi'reer; avarga'l puththirabaakkiyaththinaal thirupthiyadainthu, thangga'lukku meethiyaana poru'laith thangga'l kuzhanthaiga'lukku vaikki'raarga'l.
naanoa neethiyil ummudaiya mugaththaith tharisippean; naan vizhikkumpoathu umathu saayalaal thirupthiyaavean.
en belanaagiya karththaavea, ummil anbukooruvean.
karththar en kanmalaiyum, en koattaiyum, en iradchagarum, en theavanum, naan nambiyirukki'ra en thurugamum, en keadagamum, en iradcha'niyak kombum, en uyarntha adaikkalamumaayirukki'raar.
thuthikkup paaththiraraagiya karththarai noakkik kooppiduvean; athanaal en saththurukka'lukku neenggalaagi iradchikkappaduvean.
mara'nakkattuga'l ennaich sut'rikko'ndathu; thurchsanappiravaagam ennaip bayappaduththinathu.
paathaa'lakkattuga'l ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu; mara'nakka'n'niga'l enmeal vizhunthathu.

enakku u'ndaana nerukkaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittu, en theavanai noakki abayamittean; thamathu aalayaththilirunthu en saththaththaik keattaar, en kooppiduthal avar sannithiyil poay, avar seviga'lil ea'rit'ru.
appozhuthu boomi asainthu athirnthathu, avar koabangko'ndapadiyaal parvathangga'lin asthibaarangga'l kulunggi asainthathu.
avar naasiyilirunthu pugai ezhumbit'ru, avar vaayilirunthu padchikki'ra akkini pu'rappattathu; athanaal thazhal moo'ndathu.
vaanangga'laith thaazhththi i'rangginaar; avar paathangga'linkeezh kaariru'l irunthathu.
kearubeenmeal ea'ri veagamaaych sen'raar; kaat'rin settaiga'laik ko'ndu pa'ranthaar.
iru'laith thamakku ma'raividamaakkinaar; karumpunalga'laiyum, aagaayaththuk kaarmeagangga'laiyum thammaich soozhak koodaaramaakkinaar.
avarudaiya sannithip piragaasaththinaal avarudaiya meagangga'l pa'ranthu vilagit'ru, kalmazhaiyum neruppuththazhalum vizhunthathu.
karththar vaanangga'lilea kumu'rinaar, unnathamaanavar thamathu saththaththaith thonikkappa'n'ninaar; kalmazhaiyum neruppuththazhalum vizhunthathu.
thammudaiya ambuga'lai eythu, avarga'laich sitha'radiththaar; minnalga'laip pirayoagiththu, avarga'laik kalanggappa'n'ninaar.
appozhuthu karththaavea, ummudaiya ka'ndithaththinaalum ummudaiya naasiyin suvaasakkaat'rinaalum tha'n'neerga'lin mathaguga'l thi'ravu'ndu, poothalaththin asthibaarangga'l kaa'nappattathu.
uyaraththilirunthu avar kai neetti, ennaip pidiththu, jalappiravaagaththilirukki'ra ennaith thookkivittaar.
ennilum athiga balavaanga'laayiruntha en balaththa saththuruvukkum ennaip pagaikki'ravarga'lukkum ennai viduviththaar.
en aabaththunaa'lil enakku ethirittu vanthaarga'l; karththaroa enakku aatharavaayirunthaar.
avar visaalamaana idaththilea ennaik ko'nduvanthu, enmeal piriyamaayirunthapadiyaal, ennaith thappuviththaar.
karththar en neethikkuththakkathaaga enakkup bathila'liththaar; en kaiga'lin suththaththi'rkuththakkathaaga enakkuch sarikkattinaar.
karththarudaiya vazhiga'laik kaikko'nduvanthean; naan en theavanukkuth thuroagampa'n'ninathillai.
avarudaiya niyaayangga'laiyellaam enakku munbaaga ni'ruththinean; avarudaiya piramaa'nangga'lai naan tha'l'lippoadavillai.
avar munbaaga naan manavu'nmaiyaayirunthu, en thurkku'naththukku ennai vilakkik kaaththukko'ndean.
aagaiyaal karththar en neethikkum, thammudaiya ka'nga'lukku munnirukki'ra en kaiga'lin suththaththi'rkum thakkathaaga enakkup palana'liththaar.
thayavu'l'lavanukku neer thayavu'l'lavaraagavum, uththamanukku neer uththamaraagavum;
punithanukku neer punitharaagavum, maa'rupaadu'l'lavanukku neer maa'rupadugi'ravaraagavum thoan'ruveer.
theavareer si'rumaippatta janaththai iradchippeer; meattimaiyaana ka'nga'laith thaazhththuveer.
theavareer en vi'lakkai eat'ruveer; en theavanaagiya karththar en iru'lai ve'lichchamaakkuvaar.
ummaalea naan oru seanaikku'l paaynthupoavean; en theavanaalea oru mathilaith thaa'nduvean.
theavanudaiya vazhi uththamamaanathu; karththarudaiya vasanam pudamidappattathu; thammai nambugi'ra anaivarukkum avar keadagamaayirukki'raar.
karththaraiyallaamal theavan yaar? nammudaiya theavanaiyan'rik kanmalaiyum yaar?
ennaip balaththaal idaikatti, en vazhiyaich sevvaippaduththugi'ravar theavanea.
avar en kaalga'lai maanga'ludaiya kaalga'laippoalaakki, ennudaiya uyarthalangga'lil ennai ni'ruththugi'raar.
ve'ngala villum en puyangga'laal va'laiyumpadi, en kaiga'lai yuththaththi'rkup pazhakkuvikki'raar.
ummudaiya iradchippin keadagaththaiyum enakkuth thantheer; ummudaiya valathukaram ennaith thaanggugi'rathu; ummudaiya kaaru'niyam ennaip periyavanaakkum.
en kaalga'l vazhuvaathapadikku, naan nadakki'ra vazhiyai agalamaakkineer.
en saththurukka'laip pinthodarnthu, avarga'laip pidippean; avarga'lai nirmoolamaakkumvaraikkum thirumbean.
avarga'l ezhunthirukkamaattaathapadikku, en paathangga'linkeezh vizhaththakkathaaga avarga'lai vettinean.
yuththaththi'rku neer ennaip balaththaal idaikatti, enmeal ezhumbinavarga'lai en keezh madanggappa'n'nineer.
naan en pagaignaraich sanggarikkumpadiyaaga, en saththurukka'lin pidariyai enakku oppukkoduththeer.
avarga'l kooppidugi'raarga'l, avarga'lai iradchippaar oruvarumillai; karththarai noakkik kooppidugi'raarga'l, avarga'lukku avar uththaravu kodukki'rathillai.
naan avarga'laik kaat'rumugaththilea pa'rakki'ra thoo'laaga idiththu, therukka'lilu'l'la seat'raippoal avarga'lai e'rinthupoadugi'rean.
janangga'lin sa'ndaiga'lukku neer ennaith thappuviththu, jaathiga'lukku ennaith thalaivanaakkugi'reer; naan a'riyaatha janangga'l ennaich seavikki'raarga'l.
avarga'l en saththaththaik keattavudanea enakkuk keezhppadigi'raarga'l; anniyarum enakku ichchagampeasi adanggugi'raarga'l.
anniyar munaivizhunthupoay, thangga'l ara'nga'lilirunthu thaththa'lippaayp pu'rappadugi'raarga'l.
karththar jeevanu'l'lavar; en kanmalaiyaanavar thuthikkappaduvaaraaga; en iradchippin theavan uyarnthiruppaaraaga.
avar enakkaagap pazhikkup pazhivaanggi, janangga'lai enakkuk keezhppaduththugi'ra theavanaanavar.
avarea en saththurukka'lukku ennai vilakki viduvikki'ravar; enakku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'ravarga'lmeal ennai neer uyarththi, kodumaiyaana manushanukku ennaith thappuvikki'reer.
ithinimiththam karththaavea, jaathiga'lukku'l'lea ummaith thuthiththu, ummudaiya naamaththi'rkuch sanggeetham paaduvean.
thaam ea'rpaduththina raajaavukku magaththaana iradchippai a'liththu, thaam abisheagampa'n'nina thaaveethukkum avan santhathikkum sathaakaalamum kirubai seygi'raar.
vaanangga'l theavanudaiya magimaiyai ve'lippaduththugi'rathu, aagaayavirivu avarudaiya karangga'lin kiriyaiyai a'rivikki'rathu.
pagalukkup pagal vaarththaiga'laip pozhigi'rathu, iravukku iravu a'rivaith therivikki'rathu.
avaiga'lukkup peachchumillai, vaarththaiyumillai, avaiga'lin saththam keadkappaduvathumillai.
aagilum avaiga'lin saththam boomiyenggum, avaiga'lin vasanangga'l poochchakkaraththuk kadaisivaraikkum sellugi'rathu; avaiga'lil sooriyanukku oru koodaaraththai sthaabiththaar.
athu than ma'nava'raiyilirunthu pu'rappadugi'ra ma'navaa'lanaippoalirunthu, baraakkiramasaaliyaippoal than paathaiyil oada magizhchchiyaayirukki'rathu.
athu vaanangga'lin oru munaiyilirunthu pu'rappattu, avaiga'lin ma'rumunaivaraikkum sut'riyoadugi'rathu; athin kaanthikku ma'raivaanathu on'rumillai.
karththarudaiya veatham ku'raivat'rathum, aaththumaavai uyirppikki'rathumaayirukki'rathu; karththarudaiya saadchi saththiyamum, peathaiyai gnaaniyaakkugi'rathumaayirukki'rathu.
karththarudaiya niyaayangga'l semmaiyum, iruthayaththaich santhoashippikki'rathumaayirukki'rathu; karththarudaiya ka'rpanai thooymaiyum, ka'nga'laith the'livikki'rathumaayirukki'rathu.
karththarukkup bayappadugi'ra bayam suththamum, en'raikkum nilaikki'rathumaayirukki'rathu; karththarudaiya niyaayangga'l u'nmaiyum, avaiga'l anaiththum neethiyumaayirukki'rathu.
avaiga'l ponnilum, miguntha pasumponnilum virumbappadaththakkathum, theanilum theankoottilirunthu ozhugum the'litheanilum mathuramu'l'lathumaay irukki'rathu.
an'riyum avaiga'laal umathu adiyean echcharikkappadugi'rean; avaiga'laik kaikko'l'lugi'rathinaal miguntha palan u'ndu.
than pizhaiga'lai u'narugi'ravan yaar? ma'raivaana kut'rangga'lukku ennai neenggalaakkum.
thu'nigaramaana paavangga'lukku umathu adiyeanai vilakkikkaarum, avaiga'l ennai aa'nduko'l'la ottaathirum; appozhuthu naan uththamanaagi, perumpaathagaththukku neenggalaayiruppean.
en kanmalaiyum en meedparumaagiya karththaavea, en vaayin vaarththaiga'lum, en iruthayaththin thiyaanamum, umathu samugaththil pireethiyaayiruppathaaga.
aabaththunaa'lilea karththar umathu jebaththaik keadpaaraaga; yaakkoabin theavanudaiya naamam umakku uyarntha adaikkalamaavathaaga.
avar parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu umakku oththaasaiyanuppi, seeyoanilirunthu ummai aatharippaaraaga.
neer seluththum kaa'nikkaiga'laiyellaam avar ninaiththu, umathu sarvaangga thaganabaliyaip piriyamaay eat'rukko'lvaaraaga. (sealaa.)
avar umathu manaviruppaththinpadi umakkuth thantharu'li, umathu aaloasanaiga'laiyellaam ni'raiveat'ruvaaraaga.
naangga'l umathu iradchippinaal magizhnthu, engga'l theavanudaiya naamaththilea kodiyeat'ruvoam; umathu vea'nduthalga'laiyellaam karththar ni'raiveat'ruvaaraaga.

karththar thaam abisheagampa'n'ninavarai iradchikki'raar enbathai ippozhuthu a'rinthirukki'rean; thamathu valathukaram seyyum iradchippin vallamaiga'laik kaa'nbiththu, thamathu parisuththa vaanaththilirunthu avarudaiya jebaththaik keadpaar.
silar irathangga'laikku'riththum, silar kuthiraiga'laikku'riththum meanmaipaaraattugi'raarga'l; naangga'loa engga'l theavanaagiya karththarudaiya naamaththaikku'riththea meanmaipaaraattuvoam.
avarga'l mu'rinthu vizhunthaarga'l; naangga'loa ezhunthu nimirnthu ni'rki'roam.
karththaavea, iradchiyum; naangga'l kooppidugi'ra naa'lilea raajaa engga'lukkuch sevikoduppaaraaga.
karththaavea, ummudaiya vallamaiyilea raajaa magizhchchiyaayirukki'raar; ummudaiya iradchippilea evva'lavaayk ka'likoorugi'raar!
avarudaiya manaviruppaththinpadi neer avarukkuth thantharu'li, avarudaiya uthaduga'lin vi'n'nappaththaith tha'l'laathirukki'reer. (sealaa.)
uththama aaseervaathangga'loadu neer avarukku ethirko'nduvanthu, avar sirasil po'rkireedam tharippikki'reer.
avar ummidaththil aayusaikkeattaar; neer avarukku en'ren'raikkumu'l'la theerkkaayusai a'liththeer.
umathu iradchippinaal avar magimai perithaayirukki'rathu; meanmaiyaiyum magaththuvaththaiyum avarukku aru'lineer.
avarai niththiya aaseervaathangga'lu'l'lavaraakkugi'reer; avarai ummudaiya samugaththin magizhchchiyinaal poorippaakkugi'reer.
raajaa karththarmeal nambikkaiyaayirukki'raar; unnathamaanavarudaiya thayavinaal asaikkappadaathiruppaar.
umathu kai umathu saththurukka'lellaaraiyum ettippidikkum; umathu valathukaram ummaip pagaikki'ravarga'laik ka'ndupidikkum.
umathu koabaththin kaalaththilea avarga'lai akkinich soo'laiyaakkip poaduveer; karththar thamathu koabaththilea avarga'lai azhippaar; akkini avarga'laip padchikkum.
avarga'l kaniyai boomiyiliraathapadi neer azhiththu, avarga'l santhathiyai manupuththirariliraathapadi ozhiyappa'n'nuveer.
avarga'l umakku viroathamaayp pollaanggu ninaiththaarga'l; theevinaiyai eththanampa'n'ninaarga'l; on'rum vaaykkaama'rpoayit'ru.
avarga'lai ilakkaaga vaiththu, ummudaiya ambuga'lai naa'neat'ri avarga'l mugaththi'rku nearea vidugi'reer.
karththaavea, ummudaiya balaththilea neer ezhuntharu'lum; appozhuthu ummudaiya vallamaiyaip paadikkeerththanampa'n'nuvoam.
en theavanea, en theavanea, ean ennaik kaivitteer? enakku uthavi seyyaamalum, naan katha'rich sollum vaarththaiga'laik kea'laamalum ean thooramaayirukki'reer?
en theavanea, naan pagalilea kooppidugi'rean, uththaravukodeer; iravilea kooppidugi'rean, enakku amaithalillai.
isravealin thuthiga'lukku'l vaasamaayirukki'ra theavareerea parisuththar.
engga'l pithaakka'l ummidaththil nambikkaivaiththaarga'l; nambina avarga'lai neer viduviththeer.
ummai noakkik kooppittuth thappinaarga'l; ummai nambi vedkappattuppoagaathirunthaarga'l.
naanoa oru puzhu, manushanalla; manusharaal ninthikkappattum, janangga'laal avamathikkappattum irukki'rean.
ennaip paarkki'ravarga'lellaarum ennaip pariyaasampa'n'ni, uthattaip pithukki, thalaiyaith thulukki:
karththarmeal nambikkaiyaayirunthaanea, avar ivanai viduvikkattum; ivanmeal piriyamaayirukki'raarea, ippozhuthu ivanai meettuvidattum engi'raarga'l.
neerea ennaik karppaththilirunthu eduththavar; en thaayin mulaippaalai naan u'ngaiyil ennai ummudaiyapearil nambikkaiyaayirukkappa'n'nineer.
karppaththilirunthu ve'lippattapoathea umathu saarbil vizhunthean; naan en thaayin vayit'ril irunthathumuthal neer en theavanaayirukki'reer.
ennaivittuth thooramaagaatheayum; aabaththu kittiyirukki'rathu, sagaayarum illai.
aneagam kaa'laiga'l ennaich soozhnthirukki'rathu; baasaan theasaththup balaththa eruthuga'l ennai va'lainthuko'ndathu.
pee'ri kerchchikki'ra singgaththaippoal, enmeal thangga'l vaayaith thi'rakki'raarga'l.
tha'n'neeraippoala oot'ru'ndean; en elumbuga'lellaam kattuvittathu, en iruthayam mezhugupoalaagi, en kudalga'lin naduvea urugit'ru.
en belan oattaippoal kaaynthathu; en naavu mealvaayoadea ottikko'ndathu; ennai mara'naththoo'lilea poadugi'reer.
naayga'l ennaich soozhnthirukki'rathu; pollaathavarga'lin koottam ennai va'lainthuko'ndathu; en kaiga'laiyum en kaalga'laiyum uruvak kuththinaarga'l.
en elumbuga'laiyellaam naan e'n'nalaam; avarga'l ennai noakkip paarththukko'ndirukki'raarga'l.
en vasthirangga'laith thangga'lukku'l'lea panggittu, en udaiyinpearil seettuppoadugi'raarga'l.
aanaalum karththaavea, neer enakkuth thooramaagaatheayum; en belanea, enakkuch sagaayampa'n'nath theeviriththukko'l'lum.
en aaththumaavaip pattayaththi'rkum, enakku arumaiyaanathai naayga'lin thushdaththanaththi'rkum thappuviyum.
ennaich singgaththin vaayilirunthu iradchiyum; naan kaa'ndaamirugaththin kombuga'lil irukkumpoathu enakkuch sevikoduththaru'lineer.
ummudaiya naamaththai en sagoathararukku a'riviththu, sabainaduvil ummaith thuthippean.

karththarukkup bayappadugi'ravarga'lea, avaraith thuthiyungga'l; yaakkoabin santhathiyaarea, neengga'l ellaarum avaraik kanampa'n'nungga'l; isravealin vamsaththaarea, neengga'l ellaarum avarpearil bayabakthiyaayirungga'l.

ubaththiravappattavanudaiya ubaththiravaththai avar a'rpamaaye'n'naamalum aruvarukkaamalum, thammudaiya mugaththai avanukku ma'raikkaamalumirunthu, thammai noakki avan kooppidugaiyil avanaik keattaru'linaar.
mahaa sabaiyilea naan ummaith thuthippean; avarukkup bayappadugi'ravarga'lukku munbaaga en poruththanaiga'laich seluththuvean.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarga'l pusiththuth thirupthiyadaivaarga'l; karththaraith theadugi'ravarga'l avaraith thuthippaarga'l; ungga'l iruthayam en'ren'raikkum vaazhum.
boomiyin ellaiga'lellaam ninaivukoornthu karththaridaththil thirumbum; jaathiga'ludaiya santhathiga'lellaam umathu samugaththil thozhuthuko'l'lum.
raajyam karththarudaiyathu; avar jaathiga'lai aa'lugi'ravar.

boomiyin selvavaanga'l yaavarum pusiththup pa'ninthuko'lvaarga'l; puzhuthiyil i'ranggugi'ravarga'l yaavarum avarukku munbaaga va'nangguvaarga'l. oruvanum than aaththumaa azhiyaathapadi athaik kaakkakkoodaathea.
oru santhathi avaraich seavikkum; thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga athu aa'ndavarudaiya santhathi ennappadum.
avarga'l vanthu: avarea ivaiga'laich seythaar en'ru pi'rakkappoagi'ra janangga'lukku avarudaiya neethiyai a'rivippaarga'l.
karththar en meaypparaayirukki'raar; naan thaazhchchiyadaiyean.
avar ennaip pullu'l'la idangga'lil meayththu, amarntha tha'n'neerga'l a'ndaiyil ennaik ko'ndupoay vidugi'raar.
avar en aaththumaavaith theat'ri, thammudaiya naamaththinimiththam ennai neethiyin paathaiga'lil nadaththugi'raar.
naan mara'na iru'lin pa'l'laththaakkilea nadanthaalum pollaappukkup bayappadean; theavareer ennoadeakooda irukki'reer; umathu koalum umathu thadiyum ennaith theat'rum.
en saththurukka'lukku munbaaga neer enakku oru panthiyai aayaththappaduththi, en thalaiyai e'n'neyaal abisheagampa'n'nugi'reer; en paaththiram nirambi vazhigi'rathu.
en jeevanu'l'la naa'lellaam nanmaiyum kirubaiyum ennaith thodarum; naan karththarudaiya veettilea neediththa naadka'laay nilaiththiruppean.
boomiyum athin ni'raivum, ulagamum athilu'l'la kudiga'lum karththarudaiyathu.
avarea athaik kadalga'lukku mealaaga asthibaarappaduththi, athai nathiga'lukku mealaaga sthaabiththaar.
yaar karththarudaiya parvathaththil ea'ruvaan? yaar avarudaiya parisuththa sthalaththil nilaiththiruppaan?
kaiga'lil suththamu'l'lavanum iruthayaththil maasillaathavanumaayirunthu, than aaththumaavai maayaikku oppukkodaamalum, kabadaay aa'naiyidaamalum irukki'ravanea.
avan karththaraal aaseervaathaththaiyum, than iradchippin theavanaal neethiyaiyum pe'ruvaan.
ithuvea avaraith theadi visaariththu, avarudaiya samugaththai naadugi'ra yaakkoabu ennum santhathi. (sealaa.)
vaasalga'lea, ungga'l thalaiga'lai uyarththungga'l; anaathi kathavuga'lea, uyarungga'l; magimaiyin raajaa udpiraveasippaar.
yaar intha magimaiyin raajaa? avar vallamaiyum baraakkiramamumu'l'la karththar; avar yuththaththil baraakkiramamu'l'la karththaraamea.
vaasalga'lea, ungga'l thalaiga'lai uyarththungga'l; anaathi kathavuga'lea, uyarungga'l, magimaiyin raajaa udpiraveasippaar.
yaar intha magimaiyin raajaa? avar seanaiga'lin karththaraanavar; avarea magimaiyin raajaa. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, ummidaththil en aaththumaavai uyarththugi'rean.
en theavanea, ummai nambiyirukki'rean, naan vedkappattuppoagaathapadi seyyum; en saththurukka'l ennai mea'rko'ndu magizhavidaatheayum.
ummai noakkik kaaththirukki'ra oruvarum vedkappattup poagaathapadi seyyum; mugaantharamillaamal thuroagampa'n'nugi'ravarga'lea vedkappattup poavaarga'laaga.
karththaavea, ummudaiya vazhiga'lai enakkuth theriviyum; ummudaiya paathaiga'lai enakkup poathiththaru'lum.
ummudaiya saththiyaththilea ennai nadaththi, ennaip poathiththaru'lum; neerea en iradchippin theavan, ummai noakki naa'lmuzhuthum kaaththirukki'rean.
karththaavea, ummudaiya irakkangga'laiyum ummudaiya kaaru'niyangga'laiyum ninaiththaru'lum, avaiga'l anaathikaalamuthal irukki'rathea.
en i'lavayathin paavangga'laiyum en mee'ruthalga'laiyum ninaiyaathirum; karththaavea, ummudaiya thayavinimiththam ennai umathu kirubaiyinpadiyea ninaiththaru'lum.
karththar nallavarum uththamarumaayirukki'raar; aagaiyaal paaviga'lukku vazhiyaith therivikki'raar.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarga'lai niyaayaththilea nadaththi, saanthaku'namu'l'lavarga'lukkuth thamathu vazhiyaip poathikki'raar.
karththarudaiya udanpadikkaiyaiyum avarudaiya saadchiga'laiyum kaikko'l'lugi'ravarga'lukku, avarudaiya paathaiga'lellaam kirubaiyum saththiyamumaanavaiga'l.
karththaavea, en akkiramam perithu; ummudaiya naamaththinimiththam athai manniththaru'lum.
karththarukkup bayappadugi'ra manushan evanoa avanukkuth thaam therinthuko'l'lum vazhiyaip poathippaar.
avan aaththumaa nanmaiyil thanggum; avan santhathi boomiyaich suthanthariththukko'l'lum.
karththarudaiya iragasiyam avarukkup bayanthavarga'lidaththil irukki'rathu; avarga'lukkuth thammudaiya udanpadikkaiyaith theriyappaduththuvaar.
en ka'nga'l eppoathum karththarai noakkik ko'ndirukki'rathu; avarea en kaalga'lai valaikku neenggalaakkividuvaar.
enmeal noakkamaagi, enakku iranggum; naan thaniththavanum si'rumaippadugi'ravanumaayirukki'rean.
en iruthayaththin viyaagulangga'l perugiyirukki'rathu; en idukka'nga'lukku ennai neenggalaakkividum.
en thunbaththaiyum en varuththaththaiyum paarththu, en paavangga'laiyellaam manniththaru'lum.
en saththurukka'laip paarum; avarga'l perugiyirunthu, ukkirapagaiyaay ennaip pagaikki'raarga'l.
en aaththumaavaik kaappaat'ri ennai viduviyum; naan vedkappattuppoagaathapadi seyyum; ummai nambiyirukki'rean.
uththamamum nearmaiyum ennaik kaakkakkadavathu; naan umakkuk kaaththirukki'rean.
theavanea, isravealai avanudaiya ellaa ikkattuga'lukkum neenggalaakki meettuvidum.
karththaavea, ennai niyaayam visaariyum, naan en uththamaththilea nadakki'rean; naan karththarai nambiyirukki'rean, aagaiyaal naan tha'l'laaduvathillai.
karththaavea, ennaip pareedchiththu, ennaich soathiththuppaarum; en u'l'linthiriyangga'laiyum en iruthayaththaiyum pudamittuppaarum.
ummudaiya kirubai en ka'nga'lukku munbaaga irukki'rathu; ummudaiya saththiyaththilea nadanthuko'l'lugi'rean.
vee'naroadea naan udkaaravillai, vagnchagaridaththil naan searuvathillai.
pollaathavarga'lin koottaththaip pagaikki'rean; thunmaarkkaroadea udkaarean.
karththaavea, naan thuthiyin saththaththaith thonikkappa'n'ni, ummudaiya athisayangga'laiyellaam vivarippatha'rkaaga,
naan kut'ramillaamaiyilea en kaiga'laik kazhuvi, ummudaiya peedaththaich sut'rivarugi'rean.
karththaavea, umathu aalayamaagiya vaasasthalaththaiyum, umathu magimai thanggiya sthaanaththaiyum vaagnchikki'rean.
en aaththumaavaip paaviga'loadum, en jeevanai iraththappiriyaroadungkooda vaarikko'l'laatheayum.
avarga'l kaiga'lilea theevinaiyirukki'rathu; avarga'l valathukai parithaanangga'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
naanoa en uththamaththilea nadappean; ennai meettukko'ndu enmeal irakkamaayirum.
en kaal semmaiyaana idaththilea ni'rki'rathu; sabaiga'lilea naan karththaraith thuthippean.
karththar en ve'lichchamum en iradchippumaanavar, yaarukkup bayappaduvean? karththar en jeevanin belanaanavar, yaarukku agnchuvean?
en saththurukka'lum en pagaignarumaagiya pollaathavarga'l en maamsaththaip padchikka, ennai nerukkugaiyil avarga'lea ida'rivizhunthaarga'l.
enakku viroathamaaga oru paa'layami'rangginaalum, en iruthayam bayappadaathu; enmeal yuththam ezhumbinaalum, ithilea naan nambikkaiyaayiruppean.

karththaridaththil on'rai naan keattean, athaiyea naaduvean; naan karththarudaiya magimaiyaip paarkkumpadiyaagavum, avarudaiya aalayaththil aaraaychchiseyyumpadiyaagavum, naan en jeevanu'l'la naa'lellaam karththarudaiya aalayaththil thanggiyiruppathaiyea naaduvean.
theenggunaa'lil avar ennaith thammudaiya koodaaraththil ma'raiththu, ennaith thamathu koodaara ma'raivilea o'liththuvaiththu, ennaik kanmalaiyinmeal uyarththuvaar.

ippozhuthu en thalai ennaich sut'rilum irukki'ra en saththurukka'lukku mealaaga uyarththappadum; athinimiththam avarudaiya koodaaraththilea naan aanantha baliga'laiyittu, karththaraip paadi, avaraik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
karththaavea, naan kooppidugi'ra saththaththai neer keattu, enakku iranggi, enakku uththaravu aru'lichseyyum.
en mugaththaith theadungga'l en'ru sonneerea, ummudaiya mugaththaiyea theaduvean karththaavea, en'ru en iruthayam ummidaththil sollit'ru.

umathu mugaththai enakku ma'raiyaatheayum; neer koabaththudan umathu adiyeanai vilakkippoadaatheayum; neerea enakkuch sagaayar; en iradchippin theavanea, ennai negizhavidaamalum ennaik kaividaamalum irum.
en thagappanum en thaayum ennaik kaivittaalum, karththar ennaich searththukko'l'luvaar.
karththaavea, umathu vazhiyai enakkup poathiththu, en ethiraa'liga'linimiththam sevvaiyaana paathaiyil ennai nadaththum.
en saththurukka'lin ishdaththukku ennai oppukkodaatheayum; poychsaadchiga'lum aakkiramiththuch see'rugi'ravarga'lum enakku viroathamaay ezhumbiyirukki'raarga'l.
naanoa, jeevanu'l'loar theasaththilea karththarudaiya nanmaiyaik kaa'nbean en'ru visuvaasiyaathirunthaal kettuppoayiruppean.
karththarukkuk kaaththiru; avar un iruthayaththai sthirappaduththuvaar; thidamanathaayirunthu, karththarukkea kaaththiru.
en kanmalaiyaagiya karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppidugi'rean; neer kea'laathavarpoala mavunamaayiraatheayum; neer mavunamaayirunthaal naan kuzhiyil i'ranggugi'ravarga'lukku oppaavean.
naan ummai noakkich saththamittu, ummudaiya parisuththa sannithikku nearaagak kaiyedukkaiyil, en vi'n'nappangga'lin saththaththaik keattaru'lum.
ayalaanukkuch samaathaana vaazhththuthalaich solliyum, thangga'l iruthayangga'lil pollaappai vaiththirukki'ra thunmaarkkaroadum akkiramakkaararoadum ennai vaarikko'l'laatheayum.

avarga'ludaiya kiriyaiga'lukkum avarga'ludaiya nadaththaiga'lin pollaanggukkum thakkathaaga avarga'lukkuch seyyum; avarga'l kaiga'lin seygaikkuththakkathaaga avarga'lukku a'liyum, avarga'lukkuch sarikkuch sarikkattum.
avarga'l karththarudaiya seygaiga'laiyum avar karaththin kiriyaiga'laiyum kavaniyaathapadiyaal, avarga'lai idiththuppoaduvaar, avarga'laik kattamaattaar.
karththarukku sthoaththiram; avar en vi'n'nappangga'lin saththaththaik keattaar.
karththar en belanum en keadagamumaayirukki'raar; en iruthayam avarai nambiyirunthathu; naan sagaayam pet'rean; aagaiyaal en iruthayam ka'likoorugi'rathu; en paattinaal avaraith thuthippean.
karththar avarga'ludaiya belan; avarea thaam abisheagampa'n'ninavanukku ara'naana adaikkalamaanavar.
theavareer umathu janaththai iradchiththu, umathu suthantharaththai aaseervathiyum; avarga'laip poashiththu, avarga'lai en'ren'raikkum uyarththiyaru'lum.
balavaanga'lin puththirarea, karththarukku magimaiyaiyum vallamaiyaiyum seluththungga'l; karththarukkea athaich seluththungga'l.
karththarudaiya naamaththi'rkuriya magimaiyai avarukkuch seluththungga'l; parisuththa alanggaaraththudanea karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'lungga'l.
karththarudaiya saththam tha'n'neerga'linmeal thonikki'rathu; magimaiyu'l'la theavan muzhanggugi'raar; karththar thira'laana tha'n'neerga'linmeal irukki'raar.
karththarudaiya saththam vallamaiyu'l'lathu; karththarudaiya saththam magaththuvamu'l'lathu.
karththarudaiya saththam keathurumarangga'lai mu'rikki'rathu; karththar leebanoanin keathurumarangga'lai mu'rikki'raar.
avaiga'laik kan'rukkuttiga'laippoalavum, leebanoanaiyum seeriyoanaiyum kaa'ndaamirugak kuttiga'laippoalavum thu'l'lappa'n'nugi'raar.
karththarudaiya saththam akkinijuvaalaiga'laip pi'lakkum.
karththarudaiya saththam vanaantharaththai athirappa'n'num; karththar kaatheas vanaantharaththai athirappa'n'nugi'raar.
karththarudaiya saththam pe'nmaanga'lai eenumpadi seythu, kaaduga'lai ve'liyaakkum; avarudaiya aalayaththilu'l'la yaavarum avarudaiya magimaiyaip pirasthaabikki'raarga'l.
karththar jalappiravaagaththinmeal udkaarnthirukki'raar; karththar en'ren'raikkum raajaavaaga veet'rirukki'raar.
karththar thamathu janaththi'rkup belankoduppaar; karththar thamathu janaththi'rkuch samaathaanam aru'li, avarga'lai aaseervathippaar.
karththaavea, en saththurukka'l ennai mea'rko'ndu magizhavottaamal, neer ennaik kaithookki eduththapadiyinaal, naan ummaip poat'ruvean.
en theavanaagiya karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppittean, ennai neer ku'namaakkineer.
karththaavea, neer en aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththilirunthu ea'rappa'n'ni, naan kuzhiyil i'ranggaathapadi ennai uyiroadea kaaththeer.
karththarudaiya parisuththavaanga'lea, avaraik keerththanampa'n'ni, avarudaiya parisuththaththin ninaivukooruthalaik ko'ndaadungga'l.
avarudaiya koabam oru nimisham, avarudaiya thayavoa neediya vaazhvu; saayanggaalaththil azhugai thanggum, vidiya'rkaalaththilea ka'lippu'ndaagum.
naan orukkaalum asaikkappaduvathillaiyen'ru, en vaazhvilea sonnean.
karththaavea, ummudaiya thayavinaal neer en parvathaththaith thidamaay ni'rkappa'n'niyiruntheer; umathu mugaththai neer ma'raiththukko'ndapoathoa naan kalangginavanaanean.
naan kuzhiyil i'ranggugaiyil en iraththaththaal enna laabamu'ndu? puzhuthi ummaith thuthiththu, umathu saththiyaththai a'rivikkumoa?
karththaavea, neer enakkuch sevikoduththu enmeal irakkamaayirum; karththaavea, neer enakkuch sagaayaraayirum en'ru solli;
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppittean; karththarai noakkik kegnchinean.

en pulambalai aananthak ka'lippaaga maa'rappa'n'nineer; en magimai amarnthiraamal ummaik keerththanampa'n'numpadiyaaga neer en irattaik ka'lainthupoattu, magizhchchiyennum kattinaal ennai idaikattineer.
en theavanaagiya karththaavea, ummai en'ren'raikkum thuthippean.
karththaavea, ummai nambiyirukki'rean; naan orukkaalum vedkamadaiyaathapadi seyyum; umathu neethiyinimiththam ennai viduviyum.
umathu seviyai enakkuch saayththu, seekkiramaay ennaith thappuviyum; neer enakkup balaththa thurugamum, enakku adaikkalamaana ara'numaayirum.
en kanmalaiyum en koattaiyum neerea; umathu naamaththinimiththam enakku vazhikaatti, ennai nadaththiyaru'lum.
avarga'l enakku ma'raivaay vaiththa valaikku ennai neenggalaakkividum; theavareerea enakku ara'n.
umathu kaiyil en aaviyai oppuvikki'rean; saththiyaparanaagiya karththaavea, neer ennai meettukko'ndeer.
vee'nmaayaiga'laip pat'rikko'l'lugi'ravarga'lai naan ve'ruththu, karththaraiyea nambiyirukki'rean.
umathu kirubaiyilea ka'likoornthu magizhuvean; neer en ubaththiravaththaip paarththu, en aaththumaviyaagulangga'lai a'rinthirukki'reer.
saththuruvin kaiyil ennai oppukkodaamal, en paathangga'lai visaalaththilea ni'ruththineer.
enakku iranggum karththaavea, naan nerukkappadugi'rean; thukkaththinaal en ka'n'num en aaththumaavum en vayi'rungkoodak karugippoayit'ru.
en piraa'nan sagnchalaththinaalum, en varushangga'l thavippinaalum kazhinthu poayit'ru; en akkiramaththinaalea en belan ku'rainthu, en elumbuga'l ularnthupoayit'ru.
en saththurukka'laagiya yaavar nimiththamum, naan en ayalaarukku ninthaiyum, enakku a'rimugamaanavarga'lukku arukka'lippumaanean; veethiyilea ennaik ka'ndavarga'l enakku vilagi oadippoanaarga'l.
seththavanaippoala ellaaraalum muzhuvathum ma'rakkappattean; udaintha paaththiraththaippoalaanean.
aneagar sollum avathoo'raik keattean; enakku viroathamaaga avarga'l eagamaay aaloasanaipa'n'nugi'rathinaal thigil ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu; en piraa'nanai vaanggath theadugi'raarga'l.
naanoa, karththaavea, ummai nambiyirukki'rean; neerea en theavan en'ru sonnean.
en kaalangga'l umathu karaththilirukki'rathu; en saththurukka'lin kaikkum ennaith thunbappaduththugi'ravarga'lin kaikkum ennaith thappuviyum.
neer umathu mugaththai umathu oozhiyakkaaranmeal piragaasikkappa'n'ni, umathu kirubaiyinaalea ennai iradchiyum.
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppittean; naan vedkappattup poagaathapadi seyyum; thunmaarkkar vedkappattup paathaa'laththil mavunamaayirukkattum.
neethimaanukku viroathamaayp perumaiyoadum igazhchchiyoadum kadinamaayp peasugi'ra poy uthaduga'l kattappattuppoavathaaga.
umakkup bayanthavarga'lukkum, manupuththirarukku munbaaga ummai nambugi'ravarga'lukkum, neer u'ndu pa'n'nivaiththirukki'ra ummudaiya nanmai evva'lavu perithaayirukki'rathu!
manusharudaiya aganggaaraththukku avarga'lai umathu samugaththin ma'raivilea ma'raiththu, naavuga'lin sa'ndaikku avarga'lai vilakki, umathu koodaaraththilea o'liththuvaiththuk kaappaat'rugi'reer.
karththar ara'naana nagaraththil enakkuth thamathu kirubaiyai athisayamaay vi'langgappa'n'ninapadiyaal, avarukku sthoaththiram.
ummudaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaaga iraathapadikku vettu'ndean en'ru naan en manakkalakkaththilea sonnean; aanaalum naan ummai noakkik kooppittapoathu, en vi'n'nappangga'lin saththaththaik keatteer.
karththarudaiya parisuththavaanga'lea, neengga'lellaarum avaril anbukoorungga'l; u'nmaiyaanavanaik karththar tha'rkaaththu, idumbuseygi'ravanukkup poora'namaayp bathila'lippaar.
karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'ravarga'lea, neengga'lellaarum thidamanathaayirungga'l, avar ungga'l iruthayaththai sthirappaduththuvaar.
evanudaiya mee'ruthal mannikkappattathoa, evanudaiya paavam moodappattathoa, avan baakkiyavaan.
evanudaiya akkiramaththaik karththar e'n'naathirukki'raaroa, evanudaiya aaviyil kabadamillaathirukki'rathoa, avan baakkiyavaan.
naan adakkivaiththamattum, niththam en katha'ruthalinaalea en elumbuga'l ularnthupoayit'ru.
iravum pagalum enmeal ummudaiya kai baaramaayirunthathinaal, en saaram ush'nakaala va'radchipoala va'ra'ndupoayit'ru. (sealaa.)
naan en akkiramaththai ma'raikkaamal, en paavaththai umakku a'riviththean; en mee'ruthalga'laik karththarukku a'rikkaiyiduvean en'rean; theavareer en paavaththin thoashaththai manniththeer. (sealaa.)
itha'rkaagach sagaayangkidaikkung kaalaththil bakthiyu'l'lavanevanum ummai noakki vi'n'nappagnseyvaan; appozhuthu miguntha jalappiravaagam vanthaalum athu avanai a'nugaathu.
neer enakku ma'raividamaayirukki'reer; ennai neer ikkattukku vilakkikkaaththu, iradcha'niyap paadalga'l ennaich soozhnthuko'l'lumpadi seyveer. (sealaa.)
naan unakkup poathiththu, nee nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyai unakkuk kaattuvean; unmeal en ka'n'nai vaiththu, unakku aaloasanai solluvean.
vaarinaalum kadivaa'laththinaalum vaaykattappattaalozhiya, un kittach searaatha buththiyillaak kuthiraiyaippoalavum koavea'ru kazhuthaiyaippoalavum irukkavea'ndaam.
thunmaarkkanukku aneaga veathanaiga'lu'ndu; karththarai nambiyirukki'ravanaiyoa kirubai soozhnthuko'l'lum.
neethimaanga'lea, karththarukku'l magizhnthu ka'likoorungga'l; semmaiyaana iruthayamu'l'lavarga'lea, neengga'l ellaarum aananthamuzhakkamidungga'l.
neethimaanga'lea, karththarukku'l ka'likoorungga'l; thuthiseyvathu semmaiyaanavarga'lukkuth thagum.
surama'ndalaththinaal karththaraith thuthiththu, paththu narambu vee'naiyinaalum avaraik keerththanampa'n'nungga'l.
avarukkup puthuppaattaip paadungga'l; aananthasaththaththoadea vaaththiyangga'lai nearththiyaay vaasiyungga'l.
karththarudaiya vaarththai uththamamum, avarudaiya seygaiyellaam saththiyamumaayirukki'rathu.
avar neethiyilum niyaayaththilum piriyappadugi'raar; boomi karththarudaiya kaaru'niyaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinaal vaanangga'lum, avarudaiya vaayin suvaasaththinaal avaiga'lin sarvaseanaiyum u'ndaakkappattathu.
avar samuththira jalangga'laik kuviyalaagach searththu, aazhamaana jalangga'laip pokkishavaippaaga vaikki'raar.
boomiyellaam karththarukkup bayappaduvathaaga; ulagaththilu'l'la kudiga'lellaam avarukku agnchiyiruppathaaga.
avar solla aagum, avar katta'laiyida ni'rkum.
karththar jaathiga'lin aaloasanaiyai viruthaavaakki, janangga'ludaiya ninaivuga'lai avamaakkugi'raar.
karththarudaiya aaloasanai niththiyakaalamaagavum, avarudaiya iruthayaththin ninaivuga'l thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaagavum ni'rkum.
karththaraith thangga'lukkuth theyvamaagakko'nda jaathiyum, avar thamakkuch suthantharamaagath therinthuko'nda janamum baakkiyamu'l'lathu.
karththar vaanaththilirunthu noakkippaarththu, ellaa manupuththiraraiyum kaa'ngi'raar.
thaam vaasamaayirukki'ra sthaanaththilirunthu boomiyin kudiga'l ellaarmealum ka'n'noakkamaayirukki'raar.
avarga'ludaiya iruthayangga'laiyellaam avar uruvaakki, avarga'l seygaiga'laiyellaam kavaniththirukki'raar.
entha raajaavum than seanaiyin miguthiyaal iradchikkappadaan; savuriyavaanum than balaththin miguthiyaal thappaan.
iradchikki'ratha'rkuk kuthirai viruthaa; athu than miguntha veeriyaththaal thappuviyaathu.
thamakkup bayanthu, thamathu kirubaikkuk kaaththirukki'ravarga'lin aaththumaakka'lai mara'naththi'rku vilakki viduvikkavum;
pagnchaththil avarga'lai uyiroadea kaakkavum, karththarudaiya ka'n avarga'lmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu.
nammudaiya aaththumaa karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'rathu; avarea namakkuth thu'naiyum namakkuk keadagamumaanavar.
avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththai naam nambiyirukki'rapadiyaal, nammudaiya iruthayam avarukku'l ka'likoorum.
karththaavea, naangga'l ummai nambiyirukki'rapadiyea umathu kirubai engga'lmeal iruppathaaga.
karththarai naan ekkaalaththilum sthoaththirippean; avar thuthi eppoathum en vaayilirukkum.
karththarukku'l en aaththumaa meanmaipaaraattum; si'rumaippattavarga'l athaikkeattu magizhuvaarga'l.
ennoadeakoodak karththarai magimaippaduththungga'l; naam orumiththu avar naamaththai uyarththuvoamaaga.
naan karththaraith theadinean, avar enakkuch sevikoduththu, ennudaiya ellaap bayaththukkum ennai neenggalaakkivittaar.
avarga'l avarai noakkippaarththup piragaasamadainthaarga'l; avarga'l mugangga'l vedkappadavillai.
intha eazhai kooppittaan, karththar keattu, avanai avan idukka'nga'lukkellaam neenggalaakki iradchiththaar.
karththarudaiya thoothan avarukkup bayanthavarga'laich soozhap paa'layami'ranggi avarga'lai viduvikki'raar.
karththar nallavar enbathai rusiththuppaarungga'l; avarmeal nambikkaiyaayirukki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan.
karththarudaiya parisuththavaanga'lea, avarukkup bayanthirungga'l; avarukkup bayanthavarga'lukkuk ku'raivillai.
singgakkuttiga'l thaazhchchiyadainthu pattiniyaayirukkum; karththaraith theadugi'ravarga'lukkoa oru nanmaiyung ku'raivupadaathu.
pi'l'laiga'lea, vanthu enakkuch sevikodungga'l; karththarukkup bayappaduthalai ungga'lukkup poathippean.
nanmaiyaik kaa'numpadi, jeevanai virumbi, neediththa naadka'lai abeadchikki'ra manushan yaar?
un naavaip pollaappukkum, un uthaduga'laik kabattuvasanippukkum vilakkik kaaththukko'l.
theemaiyai vittu vilagi, nanmaisey; samaathaanaththaith theadi, athaith thodarnthuko'l.
karththarudaiya ka'nga'l neethimaanga'lmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu; avarudaiya seviga'l avarga'l kooppiduthalukkuth thi'ranthirukki'rathu.
theemaiseygi'ravarga'ludaiya pearaip boomiyil iraamal at'ruppoagappa'n'na, karththarudaiya mugam avarga'lukku viroathamaayirukki'rathu.
neethimaanga'l kooppidumpoathu karththar keattu, avarga'lai avarga'ludaiya ellaa ubaththiravangga'lukkum neenggalaakkividugi'raar.
no'runggu'nda iruthayamu'l'lavarga'lukkuk karththar sameebamaayirunthu, narunggu'nda aaviyu'l'lavarga'lai iradchikki'raar.
neethimaanukku varum thunbangga'l aneagamaayirukkum, karththar avaiga'lellaavat'rilum nin'ru avanai viduvippaar.
avanudaiya elumbuga'laiyellaam kaappaat'rugi'raar; avaiga'lil on'rum mu'rikkappaduvathillai.
theemai thunmaarkkanaik kollum; neethimaanaip pagaikki'ravarga'l kut'ravaa'liga'laavaarga'l.
karththar thamathu oozhiyakkaararin aaththumaavai meettukko'l'lugi'raar; avarai nambugi'ra oruvanmealum kut'ragnsumaraathu.
karththaavea, neer en vazhakkaa'liga'loadea vazhakkaadi, ennoadu yuththampa'n'nugi'ravarga'loadea yuththampa'n'num.
neer keadagaththaiyum parisaiyaiyum pidiththu, enakku oththaasaiyaaga ezhunthunillum.
ennaith thunbappaduththugi'ravarga'loadu ethirththunin'ru, eettiyaiyoanggi avarga'lai ma'riththu: naan un iradchippu en'ru en aaththumaavukkuch sollum.
en piraa'nanai vaanggaththeadugi'ravarga'l vedkappattuk kalangguvaarga'laaga; enakkuth theengguseyya ninaikki'ravarga'l naa'namadaivaarga'laaga.
avarga'l kaat'rumugaththil pa'rakkum patharaippoalaavaarga'laaga; karththarudaiya thoothan avarga'laith thuraththuvaanaaga.
avarga'ludaiya vazhi iru'lum sa'rukkalumaayiruppathaaga; karththarudaiya thoothan avarga'laip pinthodaruvaanaaga.
mugaantharamillaamal enakkaagath thangga'l valaiyaik kuzhiyil o'liththuvaiththaarga'l; mugaantharamillaamal en aaththumaavukkup padukuzhi vettinaarga'l.
avan ninaiyaatha azhivu avanukku varavum, avan ma'raivaay vaiththa valai avanaiyea pidikkavungkadavathu; avanea anthak kuzhiyil vizhunthu azhivaanaaga.
en aaththumaa karththaril ka'likoornthu, avarudaiya iradchippil magizhnthirukkum.

si'rumaippattavanai avanilum balavaanudaiya kaikkum, si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanaik ko'l'laiyidugi'ravanudaiya kaikkum thappuvikki'ra umakkoppaanavar yaar karththaavea, en'ru en elumbuga'lellaam sollum.
kodumaiyaana saadchiga'l ezhumbi, naan a'riyaathathai ennidaththil keadki'raarga'l.
naan seytha nanmaikkup bathilaagath theemaiseygi'raarga'l; en aaththumaa thikkat'ruppoagap paarkki'raarga'l.
avarga'l viyaathiyaayirunthapoathu irattu en uduppaayirunthathu; naan ubavaasaththaal en aaththumaavai ubaththirappaduththinean; en jebamum en madiyilea thirumbavanthathu.
naan avanai en sineagithanaagavum sagoatharanaagavum paaviththu nadanthuko'ndean; thaaykkaagath thukkikki'ravanaippoal thukkavasthiram thariththuth thalaikavizhnthu nadanthean.
aanaalum enakku aabaththu'ndaanapoathu avarga'l santhoashappattuk koottangkoodinaarga'l; neesarum naan a'riyaathavarga'lum enakku viroathamaayk koottangkoodi, oayaamal ennai ninthiththaarga'l.
appaththi'rkaaga ichchagampeasugi'ra pariyaasakkaararoadea searnthuko'ndu enpearil pa'rkadikki'raarga'l.
aa'ndavarea, ethuvaraikkum ithaip paarththukko'ndiruppeer? en aaththumaavai azhivukkum, enakku arumaiyaanathaich singgakkuttiga'lukkum thappuviyum.
mahaa sabaiyilea ummaith thuthippean; thira'laana janangga'lukku'l'lea ummaip pugazhuvean.
vee'naay enakkuch saththurukka'laanavarga'l ennimiththam santhoashiyaamalum, mugaantharamillaamal ennaip pagaikki'ravarga'l ka'n simittaamalum iruppaarga'laaga.
avarga'l samaathaanamaayp peasaamal, theasaththilea amaithalaayirukki'ravarga'lukku viroathamaay vagnchagamaana kaariyangga'laik karuthugi'raarga'l.
enakku viroathamaagath thangga'l vaayai virivaayth thi'ranthu, aa aa, aa aa, engga'l ka'n ka'ndathu engi'raarga'l.
karththaavea, neer ithaik ka'ndeer, mavunamaayiraatheayum; aa'ndavarea, enakkuth thooramaagaatheayum.
en theavanea, en aa'ndavarea, enakku niyaayagnseyyavum en vazhakkaith theerkkavum vizhiththukko'ndu ezhuntharu'lum.
en theavanaagiya karththaavea, ummudaiya neethiyinpadi ennai niyaayam visaariyum, ennaikku'riththu avarga'lai magizhavottaathirum.
avarga'l thangga'l iruthayaththilea: aa aa, ithuvea naangga'l virumbinathu en'ru sollaathapadikkum, avanai vizhunggivittoam en'ru peasaathapadikkum seyyum.
enakku nearitta aabaththukkaagach santhoashikki'ravarga'l eagamaay vedki naa'ni, enakku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattugi'ravarga'l vedkaththaalum ilachchaiyaalum moodappadakkadavarga'l.
en neethivi'langga virumbugi'ravarga'l kembeeriththu magizhnthu, thamathu oozhiyakkaaranudaiya sugaththai virumbugi'ra karththarukku magimai u'ndaavathaaga en'ru eppoathum sollakkadavarga'l.
en naavu umathu neethiyaiyum, naa'lmuzhuthum umathu thuthiyaiyum sollikko'ndirukkum.
thunmaarkkanudaiya thuroagappeachchu en u'l'laththi'rkuth theriyum; avan ka'nga'lukkumun theyvabayam illai.
avan, than akkiramam aruvaruppaanathen'ru kaa'nappaduma'lavum, than paarvaikkeat'rapadi thanakkuththaanea ichchagam peasugi'raan.
avan vaayin vaarththaiga'l akkiramamum vagnchagamumu'l'lathu; buththiyaay nadanthuko'lvathaiyum nanmaiseyvathaiyum vittuvittaan.
avan than padukkaiyinmeal akkiramaththai yoasiththu, nallathallaatha vazhiyilea nilaiththu, pollaappai ve'rukkaathirukki'raan.
karththaavea, umathu kirubai vaanangga'lil vi'langgugi'rathu; umathu saththiyam meagama'ndalangga'l pariyantham ettugi'rathu.
umathu neethi magaththaana parvathangga'lpoalavum, umathu niyaayangga'l mahaa aazhamaagavum irukki'rathu; karththaavea, manusharaiyum mirugangga'laiyum kaappaat'rugi'reer.
theavanea, ummudaiya kirubai evva'lavu arumaiyaanathu! athinaal manupuththirar umathu settaiga'lin nizhalilea vanthadaigi'raarga'l.
umathu aalayaththilu'l'la sampoora'naththinaal thirupthiyadaivaarga'l; umathu pearinba nathiyinaal avarga'l thaagaththaith theerkki'reer.
jeevaoot'ru ummidaththil irukki'rathu; ummudaiya ve'lichchaththilea ve'lichcham kaa'ngi'roam.
ummai a'rinthavarga'lmeal umathu kirubaiyaiyum, semmaiyaana iruthayamu'l'lavarga'lmeal umathu neethiyaiyum paaraattiyaru'lum.
perumaikkaararin kaal enmeal varaamalum, thunmaarkkarudaiya kai ennaip pa'rakkadiyaamalum iruppathaaga.
athoa akkiramakkaarar vizhunthaarga'l; ezhunthirukkamaattaamal tha'l'lu'ndupoanaarga'l.
pollaathavarga'laikku'riththu erichchaladaiyaathea; niyaayakkeaduseygi'ravarga'lmeal po'raamaiko'l'laathea.
avarga'l pullaippoal seekkiramaay a'ruppu'ndu, pasumpoo'ndaippoal vaadippoavaarga'l.
karththarai nambi nanmaisey; theasaththil kudiyirunthu saththiyaththai meaynthuko'l.
karththaridaththil manamagizhchchiyaayiru; avar un iruthayaththin vea'nduthalga'lai unakku aru'lseyvaar.
un vazhiyaik karththarukku oppuviththu, avarmeal nambikkaiyaayiru; avarea kaariyaththai vaaykkappa'n'nuvaar.
un neethiyai ve'lichchaththaippoalavum, un niyaayaththaip pattappagalaippoalavum vi'langgappa'n'nuvaar.
karththarai noakki amarnthu, avarukkuk kaaththiru; kaariyasiththiyu'l'lavanmealum theevinaiga'laich seygi'ra manushanmealum erichchalaagaathea.
koabaththai negizhnthu, ukkiraththai vittuvidu; pollaappuchseyya eathuvaana erichchal unakku vea'ndaam.
pollaathavarga'l a'ruppu'ndupoavaarga'l; karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'ravarga'loa boomiyaich suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l.
innung kognchanearanthaan, appoathu thunmaarkkan iraan; avan sthaanaththai ut'ru visaariththaayaanaal avan illai.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarga'l boomiyaich suthanthariththu, miguntha samaathaanaththinaal manamagizhchchiyaayiruppaarga'l.
thunmaarkkan neethimaanukku viroathamaayth theenggu ninaiththu, avanpearil pa'rkadikki'raan.
aa'ndavar avanaippaarththu nagaikki'raar; avanudaiya naa'l varugi'rathen'ru kaa'ngi'raar.
si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanai madivikkavum, semmai maarkkaththaarai vizhappa'n'navum, thunmaarkkar pattayaththai uruvi, thangga'l villai naa'neat'rugi'raarga'l.
aanaalum avarga'l pattayam avarga'ludaiya iruthayaththi'rku'l uruvippoam; avarga'l villuga'l mu'riyum.
aneaga thunmaarkkarukku'l'la selvaththiradchiyaippaarkkilum, neethimaanukku'l'la kognchamea nallathu.
thunmaarkkarudaiya puyangga'l mu'riyum; neethimaanga'laiyoa karththar thaanggugi'raar.
uththamarga'lin naadka'laik karththar a'rinthirukki'raar; avarga'l suthantharam en'ren'raikkum irukkum.
avarga'l aabaththukkaalaththilea vedkappattuppoagaathirunthu, pagnchakaalaththilea thirupthiyadaivaarga'l.
thunmaarkkaroa azhinthupoavaarga'l, karththarudaiya saththurukka'l aattukkuttiga'lin ni'naththaippoal pugainthupoavaarga'l, avarga'l pugaiyaayp pugainthupoavaarga'l.
thunmaarkkan kadanvaanggich seluththaama'rpoagi'raan; neethimaanoa iranggikkodukki'raan.
avaraal aaseervathikkappattavarga'l boomiyaich suthanthariththukko'l'luvaarga'l; avaraal sabikkappattavarga'loa a'ruppu'ndupoavaarga'l.
nalla manushanudaiya nadaiga'l karththaraal u'ruthippadum, avanudaiya vazhiyinmeal avar piriyamaayirukki'raar.
avan vizhunthaalum tha'l'lu'ndu poavathillai; karththar thamathu kaiyinaal avanaith thaanggugi'raar.
naan i'laignanaayirunthean, muthirvayathu'l'lavanumaanean; aanaalum neethimaan kaividappattathaiyum, avan santhathi appaththukku iranthuthirigi'rathaiyum naan kaa'navillai.
avan niththam iranggik kadan kodukki'raan, avan santhathi aaseervathikkappadum.
theemaiyai vittu vilagi, nanmaisey; en'ren'raikkum nilaiththiruppaay.
karththar niyaayaththai virumbugi'ravar; avar thamathu parisuththavaanga'laik kaividuvathillai; avarga'l en'raikkum kaakkappaduvaarga'l; thunmaarkkarudaiya santhathiyoa a'ruppu'ndupoam.
neethimaanga'l boomiyaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, en'raikkum athilea vaasamaayiruppaarga'l.
neethimaanudaiya vaay gnaanaththai uraiththu, avanudaiya naavu niyaayaththaip peasum.
avanudaiya theavan aru'liya veatham avan iruthayaththil irukki'rathu; avan nadaiga'lil on'rum pisaguvathillai.
thunmaarkkan neethimaanmeal ka'nvaiththu, avanaik kolla vagaitheadugi'raan.
karththaroa avanai ivan kaiyil viduvathillai; avan niyaayam visaarikkappadugaiyil, avanai aakkinaikku'l'laagath theerppathumillai.
nee karththarukkuk kaaththirunthu, avarudaiya vazhiyaik kaikko'l; appozhuthu nee boomiyaich suthanthariththukko'lvatha'rku avar unnai uyarththuvaar; thunmaarkkar a'ruppu'ndupoavathai nee kaa'nbaay.
kodiya balavanthanaana oru thunmaarkkanaik ka'ndean, avan thanakkeat'ra nilaththil mu'laiththirukki'ra pachchaimaraththaippoal thazhaiththavanaayirunthaan.
aanaalum avan ozhinthupoanaan; paarungga'l, avan illai; avanaith theadinean, avan kaa'nappadavillai.
nee uththamanai noakki, semmaiyaanavanaip paarththiru; antha manushanudaiya mudivu samaathaanam.
akkiramakkaarar eagamaay azhikkappaduvaarga'l; a'ruppu'ndupoavathea thunmaarkkarin mudivu.
neethimaanga'ludaiya iradchippu karththaraal varum; ikkattukkaalaththil avarea avarga'l adaikkalam.
karththar avarga'lukku uthaviseythu, avarga'lai viduvippaar; avarga'l avarai nambiyirukki'rapadiyaal, avarga'laith thunmaarkkarudaiya kaikkuth thappuviththu iradchippaar.
karththaavea, ummudaiya koabaththil ennaik kadinthuko'l'laatheayum; ummudaiya ukkiraththil ennaith tha'ndiyaatheayum.
ummudaiya ambuga'l enakku'l'lea thaiththirukki'rathu; umathu kai ennai iruththugi'rathu.
umathu koabaththinaal en maamsaththil aaroakkiyamillai; en paavaththinaal en elumbuga'lil savukkiyamillai.
en akkiramangga'l en thalaikku mealaagap perugit'ru, avaiga'l baarachsumaiyaippoala ennaal thaanggakkoodaatha baaramaayit'ru.
en mathikeattinimiththam en pu'nga'l azhugi naat'rameduththathu.
naan veathanaippattu odungginean; naa'lmuzhuthum thukkappattuth thirigi'rean.
en kudalga'l eripanthamaay erigi'rathu; en maamsaththil aaroakkiyam illai.
naan belanat'ruppoay, migavum no'rukkappattean; en iruthayaththin kontha'lippinaal katha'rugi'rean.
aa'ndavarea, en eanggalellaam umakku munbaaga irukki'rathu; en thavippu umakku ma'raivaayirukkavillai.
en u'l'lam kuzhambi alaigi'rathu; en belan ennai vittu vilagi, en ka'nga'lin o'li muthalaay illaama'rpoayit'ru.
en sineagitharum en thoazharum en vaathaiyaik ka'ndu vilagugi'raarga'l; en inaththaarum thooraththilea ni'rki'raarga'l.
en piraa'nanai vaanggaththeadugi'ravarga'l enakkuk ka'n'niga'lai vaikki'raarga'l; enakkup pollaanggu theadugi'ravarga'l keadaanavaiga'laip peasi, naa'lmuzhuthum vagnchanaiga'lai yoasikki'raarga'l.
naanoa sevidanaippoalak kea'laathavanaagavum, oomaiyanaippoala vaaythi'ravaathavanaagavum irukki'rean.
kaathukea'laathavanum, than vaayil ma'ruuththaravuga'l illaathavanumaayirukki'ra manushanaippoalaanean.
karththaavea, umakkuk kaaththirukki'rean; en theavanaagiya aa'ndavarea, neer ma'ruuththaravu koduppeer.
avarga'l ennimiththam santhoashappadaathapadikku ippadich sonnean; en kaal thava'rumpoathu enmeal perumaipaaraattuvaarga'lea.
naan thadumaa'ri vizha eathuvaayirukki'rean; en thukkam eppozhuthum en munbaaga irukki'rathu.
en akkiramaththai naan a'rikkaiyittu, en paavaththinimiththam visaarappadugi'rean.
en saththurukka'l vaazhnthu balaththirukki'raarga'l; mugaantharamillaamal ennaip pagaikki'ravarga'l perugiyirukki'raarga'l.
naan nanmaiyaip pinpat'rugi'rapadiyaal, nanmaikkuth theemai seygi'ravarga'l ennai viroathikki'raarga'l.
karththaavea, ennaik kaividaatheayum; en theavanea, enakkuth thooramaayiraatheayum.
en iradchippaagiya aa'ndavarea, enakkuch sagaayagnseyyath theeviriyum.
en naavinaal paavagnseyyaathapadikku naan en vazhiga'laik kaaththu, thunmaarkkan enakku munbaaga irukkumattum en vaayaik kadivaa'laththaal adakkivaippean en'rean.
naan mavunamaagi, oomaiyanaayirunthean, nalamaanathaiyum peasaamal amarnthirunthean; aanaalum en thukkam athigariththathu;
en iruthayam enakku'l'lea analko'ndathu; naan thiyaanikkaiyil akkini moo'ndathu; appozhuthu en naavinaal vi'n'nappam seythean.
karththaavea, naan evva'lavaay nilaiyat'ravan en'ru u'narumpadi en mudivaiyum, en naadka'lin a'lavu ivva'lavu enbathaiyum enakkuth theriviyum.
ithoa, en naadka'lai naalu vira'rkadaiya'lavaakkineer; en aayusu umathu paarvaikku illaathathupoalirukki'rathu; entha manushanum maayaiyea enbathu nichchayam. (sealaa.)
veashamaagavea manushan thirigi'raan; viruthaavaagavea sagnchalappadugi'raan; aasthiyaich searkki'raan, yaar athai vaarikko'l'luvaan en'ru a'riyaan.
ippoathum aa'ndavarea, naan etha'rku ethirpaarththirukki'rean? neerea en nambikkai.
en mee'ruthalga'l ellaavat'rilumirunthu ennai viduthalaiyaakkum, moodanudaiya ninthanaikku ennai oppukkodaatheayum.
neerea ithaich seytheer en'ru naan en vaayaith thi'ravaamal mavunamaayirunthean.
ennilirunthu ummudaiya vaathaiyai eduththuppoadum; umathu karaththin adiga'laal naan soarnthupoanean.
akkiramaththinimiththam neer manushanaik kadinthuko'ndu tha'ndikki'rapoathu, avan vadivaip pottarippaippoal azhiyappa'n'nugi'reer; nichchayamaaga entha manushanum maayaiyea. (sealaa.)

karththaavea, en jebaththaikkeattu, en kooppiduthalukkuch sevikodum; en ka'n'neerukku mavunamaayiraatheayum; en pithaakka'lellaaraiyumpoala naanum umakku munbaaga anniyanum paratheasiyumaayirukki'rean.
naan ini iraama'rpoagumunnea, thea'ruthaladaiyumpadi ennidaththil po'rumaiyaayirum.
karththarukkaagap po'rumaiyudan kaaththirunthean; avar ennidamaaych saaynthu, en kooppiduthalaik keattaar.
bayanggaramaana kuzhiyilum u'laiyaana seat'rilumirunthu ennaith thookkiyeduththu, en kaalga'laik kanmalaiyinmeal ni'ruththi, en adiga'lai u'ruthippaduththi,
namathu theavanaith thuthikkum puthuppaattai avar en vaayilea koduththaar; aneagar athaik ka'ndu, bayanthu, karththarai nambuvaarga'l.
aganggaariga'laiyum poyyaich saarnthirukki'ravarga'laiyum noakkaamal, karththaraiyea than nambikkaiyaaga vaikki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan.

en theavanaagiya karththaavea, neer engga'l nimiththagnseytha ummudaiya athisayangga'lum ummudaiya yoasanaiga'lum aneagamaayirukki'rathu; oruvarum avaiga'lai umakku vivariththuch sollimudiyaathu; naan avaiga'laich solli a'rivikkavea'ndumaanaal avaiga'l e'n'nikkaikku mealaanavaiga'l.
baliyaiyum kaa'nikkaiyaiyum neer virumbaamal, en seviga'laith thi'rantheer; sarvaangga thaganabaliyaiyum paavanivaara'nabaliyaiyum neer keadkavillai.
appozhuthu naan: ithoa, varugi'rean, pusthagachsuru'lil ennaikku'riththu ezhuthiyirukki'rathu;
en theavanea, umakkup piriyamaanathaich seyya virumbugi'rean; umathu niyaayappiramaa'nam en u'l'laththi'rku'l irukki'rathu en'ru sonnean.
mahaa sabaiyilea neethiyaip pirasanggiththean; en uthaduga'lai moodean, karththaavea, neer athai a'riveer.

ummudaiya neethiyai naan en iruthayaththi'rku'l ma'raiththuvaikkavillai; umathu saththiyaththaiyum umathu iradchippaiyum solliyirukki'rean; umathu kirubaiyaiyum umathu u'nmaiyaiyum mahaa sabaikku a'riviyaathapadikku naan o'liththuvaikkavillai.
karththaavea neer ummudaiya irakkangga'lai enakkuk kidaiyaama'r poagappa'n'naatheayum; umathu kirubaiyum umathu u'nmaiyum eppozhuthum ennaik kaakkakkadavathu.

e'n'nikkaikku adanggaatha theemaiga'l ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu, en akkiramangga'l ennaith thodarnthupidiththathu, naan nimirnthu paarkkakkoodaathirukki'rathu, avaiga'l en thalaimayirilum athigamaayirukki'rathu, en iruthayam soarnthupoagi'rathu.
karththaavea, ennai viduviththaru'lum; karththaavea, enakkuch sagaayampa'n'nath theeviriyum.
en piraa'nanai azhikkath theadugi'ravarga'l eagamaay vedki naa'ni, enakkuth theengguseyya virumbugi'ravarga'l pinnittu ilachchaiyadaivaarga'laaga.
enpearil aa aa! aa aa! en'ru sollugi'ravarga'l, thangga'l vedkaththin palanaiyadainthu kaividappaduvaarga'laaga.
ummaith theadugi'ra anaivarum umakku'l magizhnthu santhoashappaduvaarga'laaga; ummudaiya iradchippai virumbugi'ravarga'l karththarukku magimai u'ndaavathaaga en'ru eppozhuthum solvaarga'laaga.
naan si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan, karththaroa enmeal ninaivaayirukki'raar; theavareer en thu'naiyum ennai viduvikki'ravarumaayirukki'reer; en theavanea, thaamathiyaatheayum.
si'rumaippattavanmeal sinthaiyu'l'lavan baakkiyavaan; theenggunaa'lil karththar avanai viduvippaar.
karththar avanaip paathukaaththu avanai uyiroadea vaippaar; boomiyil avan baakkiyavaanaayiruppaan; avan saththurukka'lin ishdaththi'rku neer avanai oppukkodeer.
padukkaiyinmeal viyaathiyaaykkidakki'ra avanaik karththar thaangguvaar; avanudaiya viyaathiyilea avan padukkai muzhuvathaiyum maat'rippoaduveer.
karththaavea, enmeal irakkamaayirum; umakku viroathamaayp paavagnseythean, en aaththumaavaik ku'namaakkum en'ru naan sonnean.
avan eppozhuthu saavaan, avan pear eppozhuthu azhiyum? en'ru en saththurukka'l enakku viroathamaaych sollugi'raarga'l.
oruvan ennaip paarkkavanthaal vagnchanaiyaayp peasugi'raan; avan than iruthayaththil akkiramaththaich seagariththukko'ndu, theruvileapoay, athaith thoot'rugi'raan.
en pagaignarellaarum enmeal eagamaay mu'numu'nuththu, enakku viroathamaayirunthu, enakkup pollaanggu ninaiththu,
theeraaviyaathi avanaip pidiththukko'ndathu; padukkaiyil kidakki'ra avan ini ezhunthiruppathillai engi'raarga'l.
en piraa'nasineagithanum, naan nambinavanum, en appam pusiththavanumaagiya manushanum, enmeal than kuthikaalaith thookkinaan.
karththaavea, neer enakku iranggi, naan avarga'lukkuch sarikkatta ennai ezhunthirukkappa'n'num.
en saththuru enmeal jeyangko'l'laathathinaal, neer enmeal piriyamaayirukki'reeren'ru a'rivean.
neer en uththamaththilea ennaiththaanggi, en'ren'raikkum ummudaiya samugaththil ennai nilaini'ruththuveer.
isravealin theavanaagiya karththar anaathiyaay en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangga'lilum sthoaththirikkappadaththakkavar. aamen, aamen.
maanaanathu neeroadaiga'lai vaagnchiththuk katha'ruvathupoala, theavanea, en aaththumaa ummai vaagnchiththuk katha'rugi'rathu.
en aaththumaa theavanmeal, jeevanu'l'la theavanmealeayea thaagamaayirukki'rathu; naan eppozhuthu theavanudaiya sannithiyil vanthu ni'rpean?
un theavan enggea en'ru avarga'l naa'lthoa'rum ennidaththil sollugi'rapadiyaal, iravum pagalum en ka'n'neerea enakku u'navaayit'ru.

munnea naan pa'ndigaiyai aasarikki'ra janangga'loadea kooda nadanthu, koottaththin ka'lippum thuthiyumaana saththaththoadea theavaalayaththi'rkup poayvaruveanea; ivaiga'lai naan ninaikkumpoathu en u'l'lam enakku'l'lea urugugi'rathu.
en aaththumaavea, nee ean kalanggugi'raay? ean enakku'l thiyanggugi'raay? theavanai noakkik kaaththiru; avar samugaththu iradchippinimiththam naan innum avaraith thuthippean.
en theavanea, en aaththumaa enakku'l kalanggugi'rathu; aagaiyaal yoarthaan theasaththilum ermoan malaiga'lilum si'rumalaiyilumirunthu ummai ninaikki'rean.
umathu mathaguga'lin iraichchalaal aazhaththai aazham kooppidugi'rathu; umathu alaiga'lum thiraiga'lum ellaam enmeal pura'ndupoagi'rathu.

aagilum karththar paga'rkaalaththilea thamathu kirubaiyaik katta'laiyidugi'raar; iraakkaalaththilea avaraip paadum paattu en vaayilirukki'rathu; en jeevanudaiya theavanai noakki vi'n'nappagnseygi'rean.
naan en kanmalaiyaagiya theavanai noakki: ean ennai ma'rantheer? saththuruvinaal odukkappattu, naan ean thukkaththudanea thiriyavea'ndum en'ru sollugi'rean.
un theavan enggea en'ru en saththurukka'l naa'lthoa'rum ennoadea solli, ennai ninthippathu en elumbuga'lai uruvakkuththugi'rathupoal irukki'rathu.
en aaththumaavea, nee ean kalanggugi'raay? ean enakku'l thiyanggugi'raay? theavanai noakkik kaaththiru; en mugaththi'rku iradchippum en theavanumaayirukki'ravarai naan innum thuthippean.
theavanea, neer en niyaayaththai visaariththu, bakthiyillaatha jaathiyaaroadu enakkaaga vazhakkaadi, soothum aniyaayamumaana manushanukku ennaith thappuviyum.
en ara'naagiya theavan neer; ean ennaith tha'l'lividugi'reer? saththuruvinaal odukkappattu naan ean thukkaththudanea thiriyavea'ndum?
umathu ve'lichchaththaiyum umathu saththiyaththaiyum anuppiyaru'lum; avaiga'l ennai nadaththi, umathu parisuththa parvathaththi'rkum umathu vaasasthalangga'lukkum ennaik ko'ndupoavathaaga.
appozhuthu naan theavanudaiya peedaththa'ndaikkum, enakku aanantha magizhchchiyaayirukki'ra theavanidaththi'rkum piraveasippean. theavanea, en theavanea, ummaich surama'ndalaththaal thuthippean.
en aaththumaavea, nee ean kalanggugi'raay? ean enakku'l thiyanggugi'raay? theavanai noakkik kaaththiru; en mugaththi'rku iradchippum en theavanumaayirukki'ravarai naan innum thuthippean.
theavanea, engga'l pithaakka'ludaiya naadka'laagiya poorvanaadka'lil neer nadappiththa kiriyaiga'lai avarga'l engga'lukku a'riviththaarga'l; avaiga'lai engga'l kaathuga'laal keattoam.
theavareer ummudaiya kaiyinaalea jaathiga'laith thuraththi, ivarga'lai naatti; janangga'laith thunbappaduththi, ivarga'laip paravappa'n'nineer.

avarga'l thangga'l pattayaththaal theasaththaik kattikko'l'lavillai; avarga'l puyamum avarga'lai iradchikkavillai; neer avarga'lmeal piriyamaayirunthapadiyaal, ummudaiya valathukaramum, ummudaiya puyamum, ummudaiya mugaththin piragaasamum avarga'lai iradchiththathu.
theavanea, neer en raajaa; yaakkoabukku iradchippaik katta'laiyidum.
ummaalea engga'l saththurukka'laik keezhea vizhaththaakki, engga'lukku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'ravarga'lai ummudaiya naamaththinaal mithippoam.
en villai naan nambean, en pattayam ennai iradchippathillai.
neerea engga'l saththurukka'linin'ru engga'lai iradchiththu, engga'laip pagaikki'ravarga'lai vedkappaduththugi'reer.
theavanukku'l niththam meanmaipaaraattuvoam; umathu naamaththai en'ren'raikkum thuthippoam. (sealaa.)
neer engga'laith tha'l'livittu, naa'nappa'n'nugi'reer; engga'l seanaiga'ludanea sellaathirukki'reer.
saththuruvukku naangga'l idainthu pinnittuth thirumbippoagap pa'n'nugi'reer; engga'l pagaignar thangga'lukken'ru engga'laik ko'l'laiyidugi'raarga'l.
neer engga'lai aaduga'laippoala iraiyaaga oppukkoduththu, jaathiga'lukku'l'lea engga'laich sitha'radikki'reer.
neer ummudaiya janangga'lai ilavasamaaga vi'rki'reer; avarga'l kirayaththinaal umakku laabamillaiyea.
engga'l ayalaarukku engga'lai ninthaiyaagavum, engga'l sut'ruppu'raththaarukkup pariyaasamum sakkanthamumaagavum vaikki'reer.
naangga'l jaathiga'lukku'l'lea pazhamozhiyaayirukkavum, janangga'l engga'laikku'riththuth thalaithulukkavum seygi'reer.
ninthiththuth thooshikki'ravanudaiya saththaththinimiththamum, saththuruvinimiththamum, pazhivaanggugi'ravanimiththamum,
en ilachchai niththam enakku munbaaga irukki'rathu; en mugaththin vedkam ennai moodugi'rathu.
ivaiyellaam engga'lmeal vanthirunthum, ummai naangga'l ma'rakkavum illai, ummudaiya udanpadikkaikkuth thuroagampa'n'navum illai.
neer engga'lai valusarppangga'lu'l'la idaththilea no'rukki, mara'na iru'linaalea engga'lai moodiyirunthum,
engga'l iruthayam pinvaanggavum illai, engga'l kaaladi ummudaiya paathaiyai vittu vilagavum illai.
naangga'l engga'l theavanudaiya naamaththai ma'ranthu, anniya theavanai noakkik kaiyeduththirunthoamaanaal,
theavan athai aaraaynthu, visaariyaathiruppaaroa? iruthayaththin antharanggangga'lai avar a'rinthirukki'raarea.
umathu nimiththam ennearamum kollappadugi'roam; adikkappadum aaduga'laippoala e'n'nappadugi'roam.
aa'ndavarea, vizhiththukko'l'lum; ean niththiraipa'n'nugi'reer? ezhuntharu'lum, engga'lai en'raikkum tha'l'lividaathirum.
ean ummudaiya mugaththai ma'raiththu, engga'l si'rumaiyaiyum engga'l nerukkaththaiyum ma'ranthuvidugi'reer?
engga'l aaththumaa puzhuthimattum thaazhnthirukki'rathu; engga'l vayi'ru tharaiyoadu ottiyirukki'rathu.
engga'lukku oththaasaiyaaga ezhuntharu'lum; ummudaiya kirubaiyinimiththam engga'lai meettuvidum.
en iruthayam nalla viseashaththinaal ponggugi'rathu; naan raajaavaikku'riththup paadina kaviyaich sollugi'rean; en naavu viraivaay ezhuthugi'ravanudaiya ezhuththaa'ni.
ellaa manupuththirarilum neer mahaa savunthariyamu'l'lavar; ummudaiya uthaduga'lil aru'l pozhigi'rathu; aagaiyaal theavan ummai en'ren'raikkum aaseervathikki'raar.
savuriyavaanea, umathu magimaiyum umathu magaththuvamumaagiya ummudaiya pattayaththai neer ummudaiya araiyilea kattikko'ndu,
saththiyaththinimiththamum, neethiyudan koodiya saanthaththinimiththamum, umathu magaththuvaththilea jeyamaaga ea'rivaarum; umathu valathukaram bayanggaramaanavaiga'lai umakku vi'langgappa'n'num.
ummudaiya ambuga'l koormaiyaanavaiga'l, avaiga'l raajaavudaiya saththurukka'lin iruthayaththi'rku'l paayum; janasatha'langga'l umakkuk keezhea vizhuvaarga'l.
theavanea, umathu singgaasanam en'ren'raikkumu'l'lathu, umathu raajyaththin senggoal neethiyu'l'la senggoalaayirukki'rathu.
neer neethiyai virumbi, akkiramaththai ve'rukki'reer; aathalaal theavanea, ummudaiya theavan umathu thoazharaippaarkkilum ummai aananthathailaththinaal abisheagampa'n'ninaar.
thanthaththinaal seytha aramanaiga'lilirunthu pu'rappadugaiyil, neer magizhumpadi umathu vasthirangga'lellaam ve'l'laippoa'lam santhanam lavanggam ivaiga'lin vaasanai porunthiyathaayirukki'rathu.
umathu naayagiga'lukku'l'lea arasarin kumaaraththiga'lu'ndu, raajasthiree oappeerin thanggam a'ninthava'laay umathu valathupaarisaththil ni'rki'raa'l.
kumaaraththiyea kea'l, nee un seviyaich saayththuch sinthiththukko'l; un janaththaiyum un thagappan veettaiyum ma'ranthuvidu.
appozhuthu raajaa un azhagil piriyappaduvaar; avar un aa'ndavar, aagaiyaal avaraip pa'ninthuko'l.
theeru kumaaraththi kaa'nikkai ko'nduvaruvaa'l; janangga'lil aisuvariyavaanga'lum un thayavai naadi va'nangguvaarga'l.
raajakumaaraththi u'l'laagap poora'na magimaiyu'l'lava'l; ava'l udai po'rsarigaiyaayirukki'rathu.

siththiraththaiyalaadai thariththava'laay, raajaavinidaththil azhaiththukko'nduvarappaduvaa'l; ava'l pinnaalea sellum ava'ludaiya thoazhiga'laagiya kannigaiga'l ummidaththil koottikko'nduvarappaduvaarga'l.
avarga'l magizhchchiyoadum ka'lippoadum vanthu, raaja aramanaikku'l piraveasippaarga'l.
umathu pithaakka'lukkup bathilaaga umathu kumaarar iruppaarga'l; avarga'laip boomiyenggum pirabukka'laaga vaippeer.
umathu naamaththai ellaath thalaimu'raiga'lilum pirasthaabappaduththuvean, ithinimiththam janangga'l ummai en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangga'lilum thuthippaarga'l.
theavan namakku adaikkalamum belanum, aabaththukkaalaththil anugoolamaana thu'naiyumaanavar.
aagaiyaal boomi nilaimaa'rinaalum, malaiga'l naduchsamuththiraththil saaynthupoanaalum,
athin jalangga'l kontha'liththup ponggi, athin perukkinaal parvathangga'l athirnthaalum, naam bayappadoam. (sealaa.)
oru nathiyu'ndu, athin neerkkaalga'l theavanudaiya nagaraththaiyum, unnathamaanavar vaasampa'n'num parisuththa sthalaththaiyum santhoashippikkum.
theavan athin naduvil irukki'raar, athu asaiyaathu; athikaalaiyilea theavan atha'rkuch sagaayampa'n'nuvaar.
jaathiga'l kontha'liththathu, raajyangga'l thaththa'liththathu; avar thamathu saththaththai muzhanggappa'n'ninaar, boomi urugippoayit'ru.
seanaiga'lin karththar nammoadirukki'raar; yaakkoabin theavan namakku uyarntha adaikkalamaanavar. (sealaa.)
boomiyilea paazhkkadippuga'lai nadappikki'ra karththarudaiya seygaiga'lai vanthu paarungga'l.
avar boomiyin kadaimunaimattum yuththangga'lai oayappa'n'nugi'raar; villai odiththu, eettiyai mu'rikki'raar; irathangga'lai neruppinaal sutterikki'raar.
neengga'l amarnthirunthu, naanea theavanen'ru a'rinthuko'l'lungga'l; jaathiga'lukku'l'lea uyarnthiruppean, boomiyilea uyarnthiruppean.
seanaiga'lin karththar nammoadirukki'raar, yaakkoabin theavan namakku uyarntha adaikkalamaanavar. (sealaa.)
sagala janangga'lea, kaikotti, theavanukku munbaagak kembeerasaththamaay aarppariyungga'l.
unnathamaanavaraagiya karththar bayanggaramaanavarum, boomiyinmeethenggum magaththuvamaana raajaavumaayirukki'raar.
janangga'lai namakku vasappaduththi, jaathiga'lai nammudaiya paathangga'lukkuk keezhppaduththuvaar.
thamakkup piriyamaana yaakkoabin si'rappaana theasaththai namakkuch suthantharamaagath therintha'lippaar. (sealaa.)
theavan aarpparippoadum, karththar ekkaa'la saththaththoadum uyara ezhuntharu'linaar.
theavanaip poat'rip paadungga'l, paadungga'l; nammudaiya raajaavaip poat'rip paadungga'l, paadungga'l.
theavan boomiyanaiththi'rkum raajaa; karuththudanea avaraip poat'rip paadungga'l.
theavan jaathiga'lmeal arasaa'lugi'raar; theavan thamathu parisuththa singgaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukki'raar.
janangga'lin pirabukka'l aabirahaamin theavanudaiya janangga'laagach searkkappadugi'raarga'l; boomiyin keadagangga'l theavanudaiyavaiga'l; avar mahaa unnathamaanavar.
karththar periyavar, avar namathu theavanudaiya nagaraththilum, thamathu parisuththa parvathaththilum migavum thuthikkappadaththakkavar.
vadathisaiyilu'l'la seeyoan parvatham vadippamaana sthaanamum sarvaboomiyin magizhchchiyumaayirukki'rathu, athuvea mahaaraajaavin nagaram.
athin aramanaiga'lil theavan uyarntha adaikkalamaaga a'riyappattirukki'raar.
ithoa, raajaakka'l koodikko'ndu, eagamaayk kadanthuvanthaarga'l.
avarga'l athaik ka'ndapoathu piramiththuk kalanggi virainthoadinaarga'l.
anggea nadukkangko'ndu, pirasavaveathanaippadugi'ra sthireeyaippoala veathanaippattaarga'l.
keezhkkaat'rinaal tharsheesin kappalga'lai neer udaikki'reer.
naam kea'lvippattapadiyea namathu theavanudaiya nagaramaagiya seanaiga'ludaiya karththarin nagaraththilea ka'ndoam; theavan athai en'ren'raikkum sthirappaduththuvaar. (sealaa.)
theavanea, umathu aalayaththin naduvilea, umathu kirubaiyaich sinthiththuk ko'ndirukki'roam.
theavanea, umathu naamam vi'langgugi'rathupoala umathu pugazhchchiyum boomiyin kadaiyaantharangga'l pariyanthamum vi'langgugi'rathu; umathu valathukaram neethiyaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuga'linimiththam seeyoan parvatham magizhvathaaga, yoothaavin kumaaraththiga'l ka'likooruvaarga'laaga.
seeyoanaich sut'ri ulaavi, athin koththa'langga'lai e'n'nungga'l.
pinvarum santhathikku neengga'l vivarippatha'rkaaga, athin alanggaththaik kavaniththu, athin aramanaiga'lai ut'ruppaarungga'l.
inthath theavan en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangga'lilum nammudaiya theavan; mara'napariyantham nammai nadaththuvaar.
janangga'lea, neengga'l ellaarum ithaik kea'lungga'l.
boomiyin kudiga'lea, si'riyoarum periyoarum aisuvariyavaanga'lum e'liyavarga'lumaagiya neengga'l ellaarum eagamaaych sevikodungga'l.
en vaay gnaanaththaip peasum; en iruthayam u'narvaith thiyaanikkum.
