en seviyai uvamaimozhikkuch saayththu, en ma'raiporu'laich surama'ndalaththinmeal ve'lippaduththuvean.
ennaith thodarugi'ravarga'ludaiya akkiramam ennaich soozhnthuko'l'lun theenggunaadka'lil, naan bayappadavea'ndiyathenna?
thangga'l selvaththai nambi thangga'l thira'laana aisuvariyaththinaal perumaipaaraattugi'ra,
oruvanaavathu, than sagoatharan azhivaik kaa'naamal ini en'raikkum uyiroadirukkumpadi,
evvithaththinaalaavathu avanai meettukko'l'lavum, avanimiththam meedkumporu'lai theavanukkuk kodukkavungkoodaathea.
avarga'l aaththumameedpu migavum arumaiyaayirukki'rathu; athu orupoathum mudiyaathu.
gnaaniga'lum mariththu, agngnaaniga'lum nirmoodarum eagamaay azhinthu, thangga'l aasthiyai mat'ravarga'lukku vaiththuppoagi'rathaik kaa'ngi'raan.

thangga'l veeduga'l niththiyakaalamaagavum, thangga'l vaasasthalangga'l thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaagavum irukkumenbathu avarga'l u'l'laththin abippiraayam; avarga'l thangga'l naamangga'laith thangga'l nilangga'lukkuth tharikki'raarga'l.
aagilum kanamporunthiyavanaayirukki'ra manushan nilaiththirukki'rathillai; azhinthupoagum mirugangga'lukku oppaayirukki'raan.
ithuthaan avarga'l vazhi, ithuthaan avarga'l paiththiyam; aagilum avarga'l santhathiyaar avarga'l sollai mechchikko'l'lugi'raarga'l. (sealaa.)

aattumanthaiyaippoalap paathaa'laththilea kidaththappadugi'raarga'l; mara'nam avarga'lai meaynthupoadum; semmaiyaanavarga'l athikaalaiyil avarga'lai aa'nduko'lvaarga'l; avarga'l thangga'l vaasasthalaththil nilaiththirukkakkoodaathapadi avarga'ludaiya roobaththaip paathaa'lam azhikkum.
aanaalum theavan en aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththin vallamaikkuth thappuviththu meedpaar, avar ennai eat'rukko'lvaar. (sealaa.)
oruvan aisuvariyavaanaagi, avan veettin magimai perugumpoathu, nee bayappadaathea.
avan marikkumpoathu on'rum ko'ndupoavathillai; avan magimai avanaip pinpat'rich selvathumillai.
avan uyiroadirukkaiyil than aaththumaavai vaazhththinaalum: nee unakku nanmaiyai naadinaay en'ru manushar avanaip pugazhnthaalum,
avan en'ren'raikkum ve'lichchaththaik kaa'naatha than pithaakka'lin santhathiyaich searuvaan.
kanam porunthinavanaayirunthum a'rivillaatha manushan azhinthupoagum mirugangga'lukku oppaayirukki'raan.
vallamaiyu'l'la theavanaagiya karththar vasaniththu, sooriyan uthikkun thisaithodanggi athu asthamikkun thisaivaraikkumu'l'la boomiyaik kooppidugi'raar.
poora'navadivu'l'la seeyoanilirunthu theavan piragaasikki'raar.
nammudaiya theavan varuvaar, mavunamaayiraar; avarukkumun akkini padchikkum; avaraich sut'rilum mahaa pusal kontha'lippaayirukkum.
avar thammudaiya janaththai niyaayantheerkka uyara irukkum vaanangga'laiyum boomiyaiyum kooppiduvaar.
baliyinaalea ennoadea udanpadikkai pa'n'nina ennudaiya parisuththavaanga'lai ennidaththil koottungga'l enbaar.
vaanangga'l avarudaiya neethiyai a'rivikkum; theavanea niyaayaathibathi. (sealaa.)
en janamea, kea'l, naan peasuvean; isravealea, unakku viroathamaaych saadchiyiduvean; naanea theavan, un theavanaayirukki'rean.
un baliga'linimiththam unnaik kadinthuko'l'lean; un thaganabaliga'l eppoathum enakku munbaaga irukki'rathu.
un veettilirunthu kaa'laiga'laiyum, un thozhuvangga'lilirunthu aattukkadaakka'laiyum naan vaanggikko'lvathillai.
sagala kaattujeevanga'lum, parvathangga'lil aayiramaayiramaayth thirigi'ra mirugangga'lum ennudaiyavaiga'l.
malaiga'lilu'l'la pa'ravaiga'laiyellaam a'rivean; ve'liyil nadamaadugi'ravaiga'lellaam ennudaiyavaiga'l.
naan pasiyaayirunthaal unakkuch sollean; boomiyum athin ni'raivum ennudaiyavaiga'lea.
naan eruthuga'lin maamsam pusiththu, aattukkadaakka'lin iraththam kudippeanoa?
nee theavanukku sthoaththirabaliyittu, unnathamaanavarukku un poruththanaiga'laich seluththi;
aabaththukkaalaththil ennai noakkik kooppidu; naan unnai viduvippean, nee ennai magimaippaduththuvaay.
theavan thunmaarkkanai noakki: nee en piramaa'nangga'lai eduththuraikkavum, en udanpadikkaiyai un vaayinaal sollavum, unakku enna niyaayamu'ndu.
sidchaiyai nee pagaiththu, en vaarththaiga'lai unakkup pinnaaga e'rinthupoadugi'raay.
nee thirudanaik kaa'numpoathu avanoadu orumiththuppoagi'raay; vibasaararoadum unakkup panggu'ndu.
un vaayaip pollaappukkuth thi'rakki'raay, un naavu sa'rpanaiyaip pi'naikki'rathu.
nee udkaarnthu un sagoatharanukku viroathamaayp peasi, un thaayin maganukku avathoo'ru u'ndaakkugi'raay.

ivaiga'lai nee seyyumpoathu naan mavunamaayirunthean, unnaippoal naanum iruppean en'ru ninaivu ko'ndaay; aanaalum naan unnaik kadinthuko'ndu, avaiga'lai un ka'nga'lukku munbaaga ovvon'raaga ni'ruththuvean.
theavanai ma'rakki'ravarga'lea, ithaich sinthiththukko'l'lungga'l; illaavittaal naan ungga'laip pee'rippoaduvean, oruvarum ungga'lai viduvippathillai.
sthoaththira baliyidugi'ravan ennai magimaippaduththugi'raan; than vazhiyaich sevvaippaduththugi'ravanukku theavanudaiya iradchippai ve'lippaduththuvean en'ru sollugi'raar.
theavanea, umathu kirubaiyinpadi enakku iranggum, umathu miguntha irakkangga'linpadi en mee'ruthalga'l neengga ennaich suththigariyum.
en akkiramam neengga ennai mut'rilum kazhuvi, en paavama'ra ennaich suththigariyum.
en mee'ruthalga'lai naan a'rinthirukki'rean; en paavam eppozhuthum enakku munbaaga ni'rki'rathu.

theavareer oruvarukkea viroathamaaga naan paavagnseythu, umathu ka'nga'lukku munbaagap pollaanggaanathai nadappiththean; neer peasumpoathu ummudaiya neethi vi'langgavum, neer niyaayantheerkkumpoathu ummudaiya parisuththam vi'langgavum ithai a'rikkaiyidugi'rean.
ithoa, naan thurkku'naththil uruvaanean; en thaay ennaip paavaththil karppanthariththaa'l.
ithoa, u'l'laththil u'nmaiyirukka virumbugi'reer; anthakkara'naththil gnaanaththai enakkuth theriyappaduththuveer.
neer ennai eesoappinaal suththigariyum, appozhuthu naan suththamaavean; ennaik kazhuviyaru'lum, appozhuthu naan u'raintha mazhaiyilum ve'nmaiyaavean.
naan santhoashamum magizhchchiyum keadkumpadi seyyum, appozhuthu neer no'rukkina elumbuga'l ka'likoorum.
en paavangga'laip paaraathapadikku neer umathu mugaththai ma'raiththu, en akkiramangga'laiyellaam neekkiyaru'lum.
theavanea, suththa iruthayaththai ennilea sirushdiyum, nilaivaramaana aaviyai en u'l'laththilea puthuppiyum.
umathu samugaththai vittu ennaith tha'l'laamalum, umathu parisuththa aaviyai ennidaththilirunthu eduththukko'l'laamalum irum.
umathu iradcha'niyaththin santhoashaththaith thirumbavum enakkuth thanthu, u'rchaagamaana aavi ennaith thaanggumpadi seyyum.
appozhuthu paathagarukku umathu vazhiga'lai ubatheasippean; paaviga'l ummidaththil mananthirumbuvaarga'l.
theavanea, ennai iradchikkun theavanea, iraththappazhiga'lukku ennai neenggalaakkividum; appozhuthu en naavu ummudaiya neethiyaik kembeeramaayppaadum.
aa'ndavarea, en uthaduga'laith thi'rantharu'lum; appozhuthu en vaay ummudaiya pugazhai a'rivikkum.
baliyai neer virumbugi'rathillai, virumbinaal seluththuvean; thaganabaliyum umakkup piriyamaanathalla.
theavanukkea'rkum baliga'l no'runggu'nda aavithaan; theavanea, no'runggu'ndathum narunggu'ndathumaana iruthayaththai neer pu'rakka'niyeer.
seeyoanukku umathu piriyaththinpadi nanmaiseyyum; erusaleamin mathilga'laik kattuveeraaga.
appozhuthu thaganabaliyum sarvaangga thaganabaliyumaagiya neethiyin baliga'lil piriyappaduveer; appozhuthu umathu peedaththinmeal kaa'laiga'laip baliyiduvaarga'l.
balavaanea, pollaappil ean perumaipaaraattugi'raay? theavanudaiya kirubai ennaa'lumu'l'lathu.
nee keaduga'laich seyya eththanampa'n'nugi'raay, kabaduseyyum un naavu theettappatta savaragan kaththiyaippoal irukki'rathu.
nanmaiyaippaarkkilum theemaiyaiyum, yathaarththam peasugi'rathaippaarkkilum poyyaiyum virumbugi'raay. (sealaa.)
kabadamu'l'la naavea, sanggarikkum sagala vaarththaiga'laiyum nee virumbugi'raay.

theavan unnai en'ren'raikkum iraathapadi azhiththuppoaduvaar; avar unnaip pidiththu, un vaasasthalaththilirunthu pidunggi, nee jeevanu'l'loar theasaththil iraathapadikku unnai nirmoolamaakkuvaar. (sealaa.)
neethimaanga'l athaik ka'ndu bayanthu, avanaippaarththu nagaiththu:
ithoa, theavanaith than belanaaga e'n'naamal, than selvapperukkaththai nambi, than theevinaiyil balaththukko'nda manushan ivanthaan enbaarga'l.
naanoa theavanudaiya aalayaththil pachchaiyaana olivamaraththaippoalirukki'rean, theavanudaiya kirubaiyai en'ren'raikkum nambiyirukki'rean.
neerea ithaich seytheer en'ru ummai en'ren'raikkum thuthiththu, umathu naamaththi'rkuk kaaththiruppean; ummudaiya parisuththavaanga'lukku munbaaga athu nalamaayirukki'rathu.
theavan illai en'ru mathikeadan than iruthayaththil sollikko'l'lugi'raan; avarga'l thangga'laik keduththu, aruvaruppaana akkiramangga'laich seythuvarugi'raarga'l; nanmaiseygi'ravan oruvanum illai.
theavanaith theadugi'ra u'narvu'l'lavan u'ndoa en'ru paarkka, theavan paraloagaththilirunthu manupuththiraraik ka'n'noakkinaar.
avarga'l ellaarum vazhivilagi, eagamaayk kettuppoanaarga'l; nanmaiseygi'ravan illai, oruvanaagilum illai.
akkiramakkaararukku a'rivu illaiyaa? appaththaip padchikki'rathupoal en janaththaip padchikki'raarga'lea; avarga'l theavanaith thozhuthuko'l'lugi'rathillai.

unakku viroathamaayp paa'layami'rangginavanudaiya elumbuga'laith theavan sitha'rappa'n'ninapadiyaal, bayamillaatha idaththil migavum bayanthaarga'l; theavan avarga'lai ve'ruththapadiyinaal nee avarga'lai vedkappaduththinaay.
seeyoanilirunthu isravealukku iradchippu varuvathaaga; theavan thammudaiya janaththin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppumpoathu, yaakkoabukkuk ka'lippum isravealukku magizhchchiyum u'ndaagum.
theavanea, umathu naamaththinimiththam ennai iradchiththu, umathu vallamaiyinaal enakku niyaayagnseyyum.
theavanea, en vi'n'nappaththaikkeattu, en vaayin vaarththaiga'lukkuch sevikodum.
anniyar enakku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'raarga'l; kodiyar en piraa'nanai vaanggath theadugi'raarga'l; theavanaith thangga'lukku munbaaga ni'ruththi noakkaarga'l. (sealaa.)
ithoa, theavan enakkuch sagaayar; aa'ndavar en aaththumaavai aatharikki'ravarga'loadea irukki'raar.
avar en saththurukka'lukkuth theemaikkuth theemaiyaich sarikkattuvaar, umathu saththiyaththinimiththam avarga'lai nirmoolamaakkum.
u'rchaagaththudan naan umakkup baliyiduvean; karththaavea, umathu naamaththaith thuthippean, athu nalamaanathu.
avar ellaa nerukkaththaiyum neekki, ennai viduviththaar; en ka'n en saththurukka'lil neethi sarikkattuthalaik ka'ndathu.
theavanea, en jebaththaik keattaru'lum; en vi'n'nappaththi'rku ma'rainthiraatheayum.
enakkuch sevikoduththu, uththaravu aru'lichseyyum; saththuruvinudaiya kookkuralinimiththamum, thunmaarkkar seyyum idukkaththinimiththamum en thiyaanaththil mu'raiyidugi'rean.
avarga'l enmeal pazhisaatti, kuroathangko'ndu, ennaip pagaikki'raarga'l.
en iruthayam enakku'l viyaagulappadugi'rathu; mara'naththigil enmeal vizhunthathu.
bayamum nadukkamum ennaip pidiththathu; arukka'lippu ennai moodit'ru.
appozhuthu naan: aa, enakkup pu'raavaippoal si'raguga'l irunthaal, naan pa'ranthupoay i'laippaa'ruvean.
naan thooraththil alainthu thirinthu vanaantharaththil thanggiyiruppean. (sealaa.)
perungkaat'rukkum pusalukkum thappath theeviriththukko'l'luvean en'rean.
aa'ndavarea, avarga'lai azhiththu, avarga'l baashaiyaip pirinthupoagappa'n'num; kodumaiyaiyum sa'ndaiyaiyum nagaraththilea ka'ndean;
avaiga'l iravum pagalum athin mathilga'lmeal sut'riththirigi'rathu; akkiramamum vaathaiyum athin naduvil irukki'rathu;
keadupaaduga'l athin naduvil irukki'rathu; kodumaiyum kabadum athin veethiyai vittu vilagippoagi'rathillai.
ennai ninthiththavan saththuru alla, appadiyirunthaal sagippean; enakku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattinavan en pagaignan alla, appadiyirunthaal avanukku ma'rainthiruppean.
enakkuch samamaana manushanum, en vazhikaattiyum, en thoazhanumaagiya neeyea avan.
naam orumiththu, inbamaana aaloasanaipa'n'ni, koottaththoadea theavaalayaththukkup poanoam.
mara'nam avarga'laith thodarnthu pidippathaaga; avarga'l uyiroadea paathaa'laththil i'rangguvaarga'laaga; avarga'l vaasasthalangga'lilum avarga'l u'l'laththilum pollaanggu irukki'rathu.
naanoa theavanai noakkik kooppiduvean; karththar ennai iradchippaar.
anthisanthi maththiyaana vea'laiga'lilum naan thiyaanampa'n'ni mu'raiyiduvean; avar en saththaththaik keadpaar.
thira'laana koottamaayk koodi ennoadu ethirththaarga'l; avaroa enakku nearitta poarai neekki, en aaththumaavaich samaathaanaththudan meettuvittaar.
aathimuthalaay veet'rirukki'ra theavan keattu, avarga'lukkup bathila'lippaar; avarga'lukku maa'ruthalga'l nearidaathathinaal, avarga'l theavanukkup bayappadaama'rpoagi'raarga'l. (sealaa.)
avan thannoadea samaathaanamaayirunthavarga'lukku viroathamaay than kaiyai neetti, than udanpadikkaiyai mee'ri nadanthaan.
avan vaayin so'rka'l ve'n'neyaippoala methuvaanavaiga'l, avan iruthayamoa yuththam; avan vaarththaiga'l e'n'neyilum miruthuvaanavaiga'l, aanaalum avaiga'l uruvina pattayangga'l.
karththarmeal un baaraththai vaiththuvidu, avar unnai aatharippaar; neethimaanai orupoathum tha'l'laadavottaar.

theavanea, neer avarga'lai azhivin kuzhiyil i'ranggappa'n'nuveer; iraththappiriyarum soothu'l'la manusharum thangga'l aayu'lin naadka'lil paathivaraiyilaagilum pizhaiththirukkamaattaarga'l; naanoa ummai nambiyirukki'rean.
theavanea, enakku iranggum; manushan ennai vizhunggappaarkki'raan; naa'lthoa'rum poarseythu, ennai odukkugi'raan.
en saththurukka'l naa'lthoa'rum ennai vizhunggappaarkki'raarga'l; unnathamaanavarea, enakku viroathamaay aganggariththup poarseygi'ravarga'l aneagar.
naan bayappadugi'ra naa'lil ummai nambuvean.
theavanai munnittu avarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pugazhuvean; theavanai nambiyirukki'rean, naan bayappadean; maamsamaanavan enakku enna seyvaan?
niththamum en vaarththaiga'laip purattugi'raarga'l; enakkuth theengguseyvathea avarga'l muzhu e'n'namaayirukki'rathu.
avarga'l eagamaayk koodi, pathivirukki'raarga'l; en piraa'nanai vaangga virumbi, en kaaladiga'laith thodarnthuvarugi'raarga'l.
avarga'l thangga'l akkiramaththinaal thappuvaarga'loa? theavanea, koabangko'ndu janangga'laik keezhea tha'l'lum.
en alaichchalga'laith theavareer e'n'niyirukki'reer; en ka'n'neerai ummudaiya thuruththiyil vaiyum; avaiga'l ummudaiya ka'nakkil allavoa irukki'rathu?
naan ummai noakkik kooppidum naa'lil en saththurukka'l pinnittuth thirumbuvaarga'l; theavan en padchaththil irukki'raar enbathai a'rivean.
theavanai munnittu avarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pugazhuvean; karththarai munnittu avarudaiya vaarththaiyaip pugazhuvean.
theavanai nambiyirukki'rean, naan bayappadean; manushan enakku ennaseyvaan?
theavanea, naan umakkup pa'n'nina poruththanaiga'l enmeal irukki'rathu; umakku sthoaththirangga'laich seluththuvean.
naan theavanukku munbaaga jeevanu'l'loarudaiya ve'lichchaththilea nadakkumpadi, neer en aaththumaavai mara'naththukkum en kaalga'lai ida'ralukkum thappuviyaathiruppeeroa?
enakku iranggum, theavanea, enakku iranggum; ummai en aaththumaa a'ndikko'l'lugi'rathu; vikkinangga'l kadanthupoagumattum umathu settaiga'lin nizhalilea vanthu adaivean.
enakkaaga yaavaiyum seythu mudikkappoagi'ra theavanaagiya unnathamaana theavanai noakkik kooppiduvean.
ennai vizhunggappaarkki'ravan ennai ninthikkaiyil, avar paraloagaththilirunthu oththaasai anuppi, ennai iradchippaar: (sealaa.) theavan thamathu kirubaiyaiyum thamathu saththiyaththaiyum anuppuvaar.

en aaththumaa singgangga'lin naduvilirukki'rathu; theeyai i'raikki'ra manupuththirarukku'l'lea kidakki'rean; avarga'l pa'rka'l eettiga'lum ambuga'lum, avarga'l naavu karukkaana pattayamumaayirukki'rathu.
theavanea, vaanangga'lukku mealaaga uyarntharu'lum; umathu magimai boomiyanaiththinmealum uyarnthiruppathaaga.
en kaalga'lukkuk ka'n'niyai vaiththirukki'raarga'l; en aaththumaa thoynthupoayit'ru; enakku munbaagak kuzhiyai vetti, athin naduvilea vizhunthaarga'l. (sealaa.)
en iruthayam aayaththamaayirukki'rathu, theavanea, en iruthayam aayaththamaayirukki'rathu; naan paadik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
en magimaiyea, vizhi; vee'naiyea, surama'ndalamea, vizhiyungga'l; athikaalaiyil vizhiththukko'lvean.
aa'ndavarea, janangga'lukku'l'lea ummaith thuthippean; jaathiga'lukku'l'lea ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
umathu kirubai vaanapariyanthamum, umathu saththiyam meagama'ndalangga'lpariyanthamum ettugi'rathu.
theavanea, vaanangga'lukkumealaaga uyarntharu'lum; umathu magimai boomiyanaiththinmealum uyarnthiruppathaaga.
mavunamaayirukki'ravarga'lea, neengga'l meyyaay neethiyaip peasuveerga'loa? manupuththirarea, niyaayamaayth theerppuseyveerga'loa?
manathaara niyaayakkeadu seygi'reerga'l; boomiyilea ungga'l kaiga'lin kodumaiyai ni'ruththuk kodukki'reerga'l.
thunmaarkkar karppaththil u'rpaviththathumuthal peathalikki'raarga'l; thaayin vayit'rilirunthu pi'ranthathumuthal poy solli vazhithappip poagi'raarga'l.
sarppaththin vishaththi'rku oppaana visham avarga'lil irukki'rathu.
paambaattiga'l vinoathamaay oothinaalum avarga'l oothum saththaththi'rkuch sevikodaathapadikkuth than kaathai adaikki'ra sevittu viriyanaippoal irukki'raarga'l.
theavanea, avarga'l vaayilu'l'la pa'rka'laith thagarththuppoadum; karththaavea, baalasinggangga'lin kadaivaayppa'rka'lai no'rukkippoadum.
kadanthoadugi'ra tha'n'neeraippoal avarga'l kazhinthupoagattum; avan than ambuga'laith thodukkumpoathu avaiga'l sinnapinnamaayp poagakkadavathu.
karainthupoagi'ra naththaiyaippoal ozhinthupoavaarga'laaga; sthireeyin muthiraap pi'ndaththaippoal sooriyanaik kaa'naathiruppaarga'laaga.
mu'l neruppinaal ungga'l paanaiga'lil soodea'rumunnea pachchaiyaanathaiyum erinthupoanathaiyum avar suzhalkaat'rinaal adiththukko'ndupoavaar.
pazhivaangguthalai neethimaan kaa'numpoathu magizhuvaan; avan than paathangga'laith thunmaarkkanudaiya iraththaththilea kazhuvuvaan.
appozhuthu, meyyaay neethimaanukkup palan u'nden'rum, meyyaay boomiyilea niyaayagnseygi'ra theavan u'nden'rum manushan solluvaan.
en theavanea, en saththurukka'lukku ennaith thappuviyum; enmeal ezhumbugi'ravarga'lukku ennai vilakki uyarntha adaikkalaththilea vaiyum.
akkiramakkaararukku ennaith thappuviththu, iraththappiriyaraana manusharukku ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
ithoa, en piraa'nanukkup pathivirukki'raarga'l; karththaavea, ennidaththil mee'ruthalum paavamum illaathirunthum, balavaanga'l enakku viroathamaayk koottangkoodugi'raarga'l.
ennidaththil akkiramam illaathirunthum, oadiththirinthu yuththaththukku aayaththamaagi'raarga'l; enakkuth thu'naiseyya vizhiththu ennai noakkippaarum.
seanaiga'lin theavanaagiya karththaavea, isravealin theavanea, neer sagala jaathiga'laiyum visaarikka vizhiththezhumbum; vagnchagamaayth thuroagagnseygi'ra oruvarukkum thayai seyyaatheayum. (sealaa.)
avarga'l saayanggaalaththil thirumbivanthu, naayga'laippoala oo'laiyittu, ooraichsut'rith thirigi'raarga'l.
ithoa, thangga'l vaarththaiga'laik kakkugi'raarga'l; avarga'l uthaduga'lil pattayangga'l irukki'rathu, keadki'ravan yaar engi'raarga'l.
aanaalum karththaavea, neer avarga'laip paarththu nagaippeer; pu'rajaathiga'l yaavaraiyum igazhuveer.
avan vallamaiyai naan ka'ndu, umakkuk kaaththiruppean; theavanea enakku uyarntha adaikkalam.
en theavan thammudaiya kirubaiyinaal ennaich santhippaar; theavan en saththurukka'lukkuvarum neethisarikkattuthalai naan kaa'numpadi seyvaar.
avarga'laik kon'rupoadaatheayum, en janangga'l ma'ranthupoavaarga'lea; engga'l keadagamaagiya aa'ndavarea, umathu vallamaiyinaal avarga'laich sitha'radiththu, avarga'laith thaazhththippoadum.
avarga'l uthaduga'lin peachchu avarga'l vaayin paavamaayirukki'rathu; avarga'l itta saabamum solliya poyyum aagiya ivaiga'linimiththam thangga'l perumaiyil agappaduvaarga'laaga.

theavan boomiyin ellaivaraikkum yaakkoabilea arasaa'lugi'ravar en'ru avarga'l a'riyumporuttu, avarga'lai ummudaiya ukkiraththilea nirmoolamaakkum; ini iraathapadikku avarga'lai nirmoolamaakkum. (sealaa.)
avarga'l saayanggaalaththil thirumbivanthu, naayga'laippoala oo'laiyittu, ooraichsut'rith thirigi'raarga'l.
avarga'l u'navukkaaga alainthu thirinthu thirupthiyadaiyaamal, mu'rumu'ruththukko'ndiruppaarga'l.
naanoa ummudaiya vallamaiyaip paadi, kaalaiyilea ummudaiya kirubaiyai magizhchchiyoadu pugazhuvean; enakku nerukkamu'ndaana naa'lilea neer enakkuth thagnchamum uyarntha adaikkalamumaaneer.
en belanea, ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean; theavan enakku uyarntha adaikkalamum, kirubaiyu'l'la en theavanumaayirukki'raar.
theavanea, neer engga'laik kaivitteer, engga'laich sitha'radiththeer, engga'lmeal koabamaayiruntheer; ma'rupadiyum engga'lidamaayth thirumbiyaru'lum.
boomiyai athirappa'n'ni, athai vedippaakkineer; athin vedippuga'laip porunthappa'n'num; athu asaigin'rathu.
ummudaiya janangga'lukkuk kadinamaana kaariyaththaik kaa'nbiththeer; thaththa'lippin mathubaanaththai engga'lukkuk kudikkak koduththeer.
saththiyaththinimiththam eat'rumpadiyaaga, umakkup bayanthu nadakki'ravarga'lukku oru kodiyaik koduththeer. (sealaa.)
umathu piriyar viduvikkappadumpadi, umathu valathukaraththinaal iradchiththu, enakkuch sevikoduththaru'lum.
theavan thamathu parisuththaththaikko'ndu vi'lambinaar, aagaiyaal ka'likooruvean; seekeamaip panggittu, sukkoaththin pa'l'laththaakkai a'lanthuko'l'luvean.
keeleayaath ennudaiyathu, manaaseayum ennudaiyathu, eppiraayeem en thalaiyin belan, yoothaa en niyaayappiramaa'nigan.
moavaab en paathapaaththiram, eathoaminmeal en paatharadchaiyai e'rinthupoaduvean; pelisthiyaavea, ennimiththam aarppariththukko'l.
ara'naana patta'naththi'rku'l ennai nadaththikko'ndupoagi'ravar yaar? eathoammattum enakku vazhikaattugi'ravar yaar?
engga'l seanaiga'loadea pu'rappadaamaliruntha theavareer allavoa? engga'laith tha'l'livittiruntha theavareer allavoa?
ikkattil engga'lukku uthaviseyyum; manushanudaiya uthavi viruthaa.
theavanaalea baraakkiramam seyvoam; avarea engga'l saththurukka'lai mithiththuppoaduvaar.
theavanea, en kooppiduthalaik keattu, en vi'n'nappaththaik kavaniyum.
en iruthayam thoyyumpoathu boomiyin kadaiyaantharaththilirunthu ummai noakkik kooppiduvean; enakku ettaatha uyaramaana kanmalaiyil ennaik ko'ndupoayvidum.
neer enakku adaikkalamum, saththuruvukku ethirea belaththa thurugamumaayiruntheer.
naan ummudaiya koodaaraththil sathaakaalamum thangguvean; umathu settaiga'lin ma'raivilea vanthu adaivean. (sealaa.)
theavanea, neer en poruththanaiga'laik keatteer; umathu naamaththi'rkup bayappadugi'ravarga'lin suthantharaththai enakkuth thantheer.
raajaavin naadka'loadea naadka'laik koottuveer; avar varushangga'l thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga irukkum.
avar theavanukku munbaaga en'ren'raikkum nilaiththiruppaar; thayaiyum u'nmaiyum avaraik kaakkak katta'laiyidum.
ippadiyea thinamum en poruththanaiga'lai naan seluththumpadiyaaga, umathu naamaththai en'raikkum keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
theavanaiyea noakki en aaththumaa amarnthirukki'rathu; avaraal en iradchippu varum.
avarea en kanmalaiyum, en iradchippum, en uyarntha adaikkalamumaanavar; naan athigamaay asaikkappaduvathillai.
neengga'l ethuvaraikkum oru manushanukkuth theengguseyya ninaippeerga'l, neengga'l anaivarum sanggarikkappaduveerga'l, saaynthamathilukkum idinthasuvarukkum oppaaveerga'l.

avanudaiya meanmaiyilirunthu avanaith tha'l'lumpadikkea avarga'l aaloasanaipa'n'ni, abaththampeasa virumbugi'raarga'l; thangga'l vaayinaal aaseervathiththu, thangga'l u'l'laththil sabikki'raarga'l. (sealaa.)
en aaththumaavea, theavanaiyea noakki amarnthiru; naan nambugi'rathu avaraalea varum.
avarea en kanmalaiyum, en iradchippum, en uyarntha adaikkalamumaanavar; naan asaikkappaduvathillai.
en iradchippum, en magimaiyum theavanidaththil irukki'rathu; belanaana en kanmalaiyum en adaikkalamum theavanukku'l irukki'rathu.
janangga'lea, ekkaalaththilum avarai nambungga'l; avar samugaththil ungga'l iruthayaththai oot'rividungga'l; theavan namakku adaikkalamaayirukki'raar. (sealaa.)
keezhmakka'l maayaiyum, meanmakka'l poyyumaamea; tharaasilea vaikkappattaal avarga'lellaarum maayaiyilum leasaanavarga'l.
kodumaiyai nambaathirungga'l; ko'l'laiyinaal perumaipaaraattaathirungga'l; aisuvariyam viruththiyaanaal iruthayaththai athinmeal vaikkaatheayungga'l.
theavan orutharam vi'lambinaar, ira'ndutharam keattirukki'rean; vallamai theavanudaiyathu enbathea.
kirubaiyum ummudaiyathu, aa'ndavarea! theavareer avanavan seygaikkuth thakkathaagap palana'likki'reer.

theavanea, neer ennudaiya theavan; athikaalamea ummaith theadugi'rean; va'ra'ndathum vidaayththathum tha'n'neerat'rathumaana nilaththilea en aaththumaa ummeal thaagamaayirukki'rathu, en maamsamaanathu ummai vaagnchikki'rathu.
ippadiyea parisuththa sthalaththil ummaippaarkka aasaiyaayirunthu, umathu vallamaiyaiyum umathu magimaiyaiyum ka'ndean.
jeevanaippaarkkilum umathu kirubai nallathu; en uthaduga'l ummaith thuthikkum.
en jeevanu'l'lamattum naan ummaith thuthiththu, umathu naamaththaich sollik kaiyeduppean.
ni'naththaiyum kozhuppaiyum u'ndathupoala en aaththumaa thirupthiyaagum; en vaay aananthakka'lippu'l'la uthaduga'laal ummaip poat'rum.
en padukkaiyinmeal naan ummai ninaikkumpoathu, iraachsaamangga'lil ummaith thiyaanikki'rean.
neer enakkuth thu'naiyaayirunthathinaal, umathu settaiga'lin nizhalilea ka'likoorugi'rean.
en aaththumaa ummaith thodarnthu pat'rikko'ndirukki'rathu; umathu valathukaram ennaith thaanggugi'rathu.
en piraa'nanai azhikkath theadugi'ravarga'loa, boomiyin thaazhvidangga'lil i'rangguvaarga'l.
avarga'l pattayaththaal vizhuvaarga'l; nariga'lukku iraiyaavaarga'l.
raajaavoa theavanil ka'likooruvaar; avarpearil saththiyampa'n'nugi'ravarga'l yaavarum meanmaipaaraattuvaarga'l; poy peasugi'ravarga'lin vaay adaikkappadum.
theavanea, en vi'n'nappaththil en saththaththaik keattaru'lum; saththuruvaal varum bayaththai neekki, en piraa'nanaik kaaththaru'lum.
thunmaarkkar seyyum iragasiya aaloasanaikkum, akkiramakkaararudaiya kalagaththukkum ennai vilakki ma'raiththaru'lum.
avarga'l thangga'l naavaip pattayaththaippoal koormaiyaakki,
ma'raivuga'lil uththamanmeal eyyumporuttuk kasappaana vaarththaiga'laagiya thangga'l ambuga'lai naa'neat'rugi'raarga'l; sat'rum bayamin'rich sadithiyil avanmeal eygi'raarga'l.
avarga'l pollaatha kaariyaththil thangga'lai u'ruthippaduththikko'ndu, ma'raivaana ka'n'niga'lai vaikka aaloasanaipa'n'ni, avaiga'laik kaa'nbavan yaar engi'raarga'l.
avarga'l niyaayakkeaduga'lai aaynthutheadi, thanthiramaana yoasanai ni'raivea'rumpadi pirayaththanampa'n'nugi'raarga'l; avarga'lil ovvoruvanudaiya udkaruththum iruthayamum aazhamaayirukki'rathu.
aanaalum theavan avarga'lmeal ambuga'lai eyvaar, sadithiyaay avarga'l kaayappaduvaarga'l.
avarga'l tha'l'lappattu, keezheavizhumpadi avarga'l naavuga'lea avarga'laik kedukkum; avarga'laik kaa'ngi'ra yaavarum oadippoavaarga'l.
ellaa manusharum bayanthu, theavanudaiya seyalai a'riviththu, avar kiriyaiyai u'narnthuko'lvaarga'l.
neethimaan karththarukku'l magizhnthu, avarai nambuvaan; semmaiyaana iruthayamu'l'lavarga'l yaavarum meanmaipaaraattuvaarga'l.
theavanea, seeyoanil umakkaagath thuthiyaanathu amainthu kaaththirukki'rathu; poruththanai umakkuch seluththappadum.
jebaththaik keadki'ravarea, maamsamaana yaavarum ummidaththil varuvaarga'l.
akkirama vishayangga'l enmeal mignchi vallamaiko'ndathu; theavareeroa engga'l mee'ruthalga'lai nivirththiyaakkugi'reer.
ummudaiya piraagaarangga'lil vaasamaayirukkumpadi neer therinthuko'ndu searththukko'l'lugi'ravan baakkiyavaan; ummudaiya parisuththa aalayamaagiya umathu veettin nanmaiyaal thirupthiyaavoam.

boomiyin kadaiyaantharangga'lilum thooramaana samuththirangga'lilumu'l'lavarga'l ellaarum nambum nambikkaiyaayirukki'ra engga'l iradchippin theavanea, neer bayanggaramaana kaariyangga'laich seygi'rathinaal engga'lukku neethiyu'l'la uththaravu aru'lugi'reer.
vallamaiyai idaikattikko'ndu, ummudaiya balaththinaal parvathangga'lai u'ruthippaduththi,
samuththirangga'lin mummuraththaiyum avaiga'ludaiya alaiga'lin iraichchalaiyum, janangga'lin ama'liyaiyum amarththugi'reer.
kadaiyaanthara idangga'lil kudiyirukki'ravarga'lum ummudaiya adaiyaa'langga'linimiththam bayappadugi'raarga'l; kaalaiyaiyum maalaiyaiyum ka'likoorappa'n'nugi'reer.

theavareer boomiyai visaariththu atha'rku neerppaaychchugi'reer; tha'n'neer ni'raintha theavanathiyinaal athai migavum sezhippaakkugi'reer; ippadi neer athaith thiruththi, avarga'lukkuth thaaniyaththai vi'laivikki'reer.
athin varappuga'l tha'niyaththakkathaay athin padaichchaalga'lukkuth tha'n'neer i'raiththu, athai mazhaiga'laal karaiyappa'n'ni, athin payirai aaseervathikki'reer.
varushaththai ummudaiya nanmaiyaal mudisoottugi'reer; umathu paathaiga'l neyyaayp pozhigi'rathu.
vanaanthara thaabarangga'lilum pozhigi'rathu; meaduga'l sut'rilum poorippaayirukki'rathu.
meaychchalu'l'la ve'liga'lil aaduga'l ni'rainthirukki'rathu; pa'l'laththaakkuga'l thaaniyaththaal moodiyirukki'rathu; avaiga'l kembeeriththup paadugi'rathu.
boomiyin kudiga'lea, neengga'l ellaarum theavanukku munbaagak kembeeramaayp paadungga'l.
avar naamaththin magaththuvaththaik keerththanampa'n'ni, avarudaiya thuthiyin magimaiyaik ko'ndaadungga'l.
theavanai noakki: umathu kiriyaiga'lil evva'lavu bayanggaramaayirukki'reer; umathu magaththuvamaana vallamaiyinimiththam ummudaiya saththurukka'l umakku ichchagampeasi adangguvaarga'l.
boomiyinmeethenggum ummaip pa'ninthuko'ndu ummaith thuthiththup paaduvaarga'l; avarga'l ummudaiya naamaththaith thuthiththup paaduvaarga'l en'ru sollungga'l. (sealaa.)
theavanudaiya seygaiga'lai vanthu paarungga'l; avar manupuththiraridaththil nadappikkung kiriyaiyil bayanggaramaanavar.
kadalai ularntha tharaiyaaga maat'rinaar; aat'raik kaalnadaiyaayk kadanthaarga'l; anggea avaril ka'likoornthoam.
avar thammudaiya vallamaiyinaal en'ren'raikkum arasaa'lugi'raar; avarudaiya ka'nga'l jaathiga'lmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu; thuroagiga'l thangga'lai uyarththaathiruppaarga'laaga. (sealaa.)
janangga'lea, nammudaiya theavanai sthoaththiriththu, avaraith thuthikkugnsaththaththaik keadkappa'n'nungga'l.
avar nammudaiya kaalga'laith tha'l'laadavottaamal, nammudaiya aaththumaavai uyiroadea vaikki'raar.
theavanea, engga'laich soathiththeer; ve'l'liyaip pudamidugi'rathupoala engga'laip pudamitteer.
engga'lai valaiyil agappaduththi, engga'l iduppuga'linmeal varuththamaana baaraththai eat'rineer.
manusharai engga'l thalaiyinmeal ea'rippoagappa'n'nineer; theeyaiyum tha'n'neeraiyum kadanthuvanthoam; sezhippaana idaththil engga'laik ko'nduvanthu vitteer.
sarvaangga thaganabaliga'loadea umathu aalayaththi'rku'l piraveasippean;
en ikkattil naan en uthaduga'laith thi'ranthu, en vaayinaal solliya en poruththanaiga'lai umakkuch seluththuvean.
aattukkadaakka'lin ni'nappugaiyudanea kozhumaiyaanavaiga'lai umakkuth thaganabaliyaaga iduvean; kaa'laiga'laiyum semma'riyaattuk kadaakka'laiyum umakkup baliyiduvean. (sealaa.)
theavanukkup bayanthavarga'lea, neengga'l ellaarum vanthu kea'lungga'l; avar en aaththumaavukkuch seythathaich solluvean.
avarai noakki en vaayinaal kooppittean, en naavinaal avar pugazhappattaar.
en iruthayaththil akkiramasinthai ko'ndiruntheanaanaal, aa'ndavar enakkuch sevikodaar.
meyyaay theavan enakkuch sevikoduththaar, en jebaththin saththaththaik keattaar.
en jebaththaith tha'l'laamalum, thamathu kirubaiyai ennaivittu vilakkaamalum iruntha theavanukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaga.
theavanea, boomiyil ummudaiya vazhiyum, ellaa jaathiga'lukku'l'lum ummudaiya iradcha'niyamum vi'langgumpadiyaay,
theavareer engga'lukku iranggi, engga'lai aaseervathiththu, ummudaiya mugaththai engga'lmeal piragaasikkappa'n'num. (sealaa.)
theavanea, janangga'l ummaith thuthippaarga'laaga; sagala janangga'lum ummaith thuthippaarga'laaga.
theavareer janangga'lai nithaanamaay niyaayantheerththu, boomiyilu'l'la jaathiga'lai nadaththuveer; aathalaal jaathiga'l santhoashiththu, kembeeraththoadea magizhakkadavarga'l. (sealaa.)
theavanea, janangga'l ummaith thuthippaarga'laaga; sagala janangga'lum ummaith thuthippaarga'laaga.
boomi than palanaith tharum, theavanaagiya engga'l theavanea engga'lai aaseervathippaar.
theavan engga'lai aaseervathippaar; boomiyin ellaiga'lellaam avarukkup bayanthirukkum.
theavan ezhuntharu'luvaar, avarudaiya saththurukka'l sitha'ru'ndu, avaraip pagaikki'ravarga'l avarukku munbaaga oadippoavaarga'l.
pugai pa'rakkadikkappaduvathupoala avarga'laip pa'rakkadippeer; mezhugu akkinikkumun uruguvathupoala thunmaarkkar theavanukkumun azhivaarga'l.
neethimaanga'loa theavanukkumunbaaga magizhnthu ka'likoornthu, aanantha santhoashamadaivaarga'l.

theavanaip paadi, avarudaiya naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nungga'l; vanaantharangga'lil ea'rivarugi'ravarukku vazhiyai aayaththappaduththungga'l; avarudaiya naamam yeagoavaa, avarukku munbaagak ka'likoorungga'l.
thammudaiya parisuththa vaasasthalaththilirukki'ra theavan, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiga'lukkuth thagappanum, vithavaiga'lukku niyaayam visaarikki'ravarumaayirukki'raar.
theavan thanimaiyaanavarga'lukku veeduvaasal ea'rpaduththi, kattu'ndavarga'lai viduthalaiyaakkugi'raar; thuroagiga'loa va'ra'nda boomiyil thangguvaarga'l.
theavanea, neer ummudaiya janangga'lukku munnea sen'ru, avaantharave'liyilea nadanthuvarugaiyil, (sealaa.)
boomi athirnthathu; theavanaagiya umakku munbaaga vaanamum pozhinthathu; isravealin theavanaayirukki'ra theavanukku munbaagavea inthach seenaay malaiyum asainthathu.
theavanea, sampoora'na mazhaiyaip peyyappa'n'nineer; i'laiththuppoana umathu suthantharaththaith thidappaduththineer.
ummudaiya manthai athilea thanggiyirunthathu; theavanea, ummudaiya thayaiyinaalea eazhaiga'laip paraamarikki'reer.
aa'ndavar vasanam thanthaar; athaip pirasiththappaduththugi'ravarga'lin koottam miguthi.
seanaiga'lin raajaakka'l thaththa'liththu oadinaarga'l; veettiliruntha sthireeyaanava'l ko'l'laipporu'laip panggittaa'l.
neengga'l aduppinadiyil kidanthavarga'laayirunthaalum, ve'l'liyaal alanggarikkappatta pu'raachsi'raguga'lpoalavum, pasumpon ni'ramaagiya athin i'raguga'lin saayalaagavum iruppeerga'l.
sarvavallavar athil raajaakka'laich sitha'radiththapoathu, athu salmoan malaiyin u'raintha mazhaipoal ve'nmaiyaayit'ru.
theavaparvatham baasaan parvathampoalirukki'rathu; baasaan parvatham uyarntha sigarangga'lu'l'lathu.
uyarntha sigaramu'l'la parvathangga'lea, ean thu'l'lugi'reerga'l; inthap parvathaththil vaasamaayirukka theavan virumbinaar; aam, karththar ithilea en'ren'raikkum vaasamaayiruppaar.
theavanudaiya irathangga'l pathinaayirangga'lum, aayiramaayirangga'lumaayirukki'rathu; aa'ndavar parisuththa sthalamaana seenaayilirunthava'n'namaay avaiga'lukku'l irukki'raar.

theavareer unnathaththi'rku ea'ri, si'raippattavarga'laich si'raiyaakkik ko'ndupoaneer; theavanaagiya karththar manusharukku'l vaasampa'n'num poruttu, thuroagiga'laagiya manusharga'lukkaagavum varangga'laip pet'rukko'ndeer.
ennaa'lum aa'ndavarukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaga; nammeal baaragnsumaththinaalum nammai iradchikki'ra theavan avarea. (sealaa.)
nammudaiya theavan iradchippai aru'lum theavanaayirukki'raar; aa'ndavaraagiya karththaraal mara'naththi'rku neenggum vazhiga'lu'ndu.
meyyaagavea theavan thammudaiya saththurukka'lin sirasaiyum, than akkiramangga'lil thu'ninthu nadakki'ravanudaiya mayiru'l'la uchchanthalaiyaiyum udaippaar.
un kaalga'l saththurukka'lin iraththaththil pathiyumpadiyaagavum, un naayga'lin naavu athai nakkumpadiyaagavum,
ennudaiya janaththaip baasaanilirunthu thirumba azhaiththuvaruvean; athaich samuththira aazhangga'lilirunthum thirumba azhaiththuvaruvean en'ru aa'ndavar sonnaar.
theavanea, ummudaiya nadaiga'laik ka'ndaarga'l; en theavanum en raajaavum parisuththa sthalaththilea nadanthuvarugi'ra nadaiga'laiyea ka'ndaarga'l.
munnaagap paadugi'ravarga'lum, pinnaaga vee'naiga'lai vaasikki'ravarga'lum, sut'rilum thamburu vaasikki'ra kannigaiga'lum nadanthaarga'l.
isravealin oot'rilirunthu thoan'rinavarga'lea, sabaiga'lin naduvea aa'ndavaraagiya theavanai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
anggea avarga'lai aa'lugi'ra sinna benyameenum, yoothaavin pirabukka'lum, avarga'l koottamum, sebuloanin pirabukka'lum, napthaliyin pirabukka'lum u'ndu.
un theavan unakkup balaththaik katta'laiyittaar; theavanea, neer engga'lnimiththam u'ndupa'n'ninathaith thidappaduththum.
erusaleamilu'l'la ummudaiya aalayaththinimiththam, raajaakka'l umakkuk kaa'nikkaiga'laik ko'nduvaruvaarga'l.

naa'nalilu'l'la mirugakoottaththaiyum, janangga'laagiya kan'ruga'loadukooda rishaba koottaththaiyum athattum; ovvoruvanum ve'l'lippa'nangga'laik ko'nduvanthu pa'ninthuko'l'luvaan; yuththangga'lil piriyappadugi'ra janangga'laich sitha'radippaar.
pirabukka'l egipthilirunthu varuvaarga'l; eththiyoappiyaa theavanai noakki kaiyedukkath theevirikkum.
boomiyin raajyangga'lea, theavanaip paadi, aa'ndavaraik keerththanam pa'n'nungga'l. (sealaa.)
aathimuthalaayirukki'ra vaanaathi vaanangga'linmeal ezhuntharu'liyirukki'ravaraip paadungga'l; ithoa, thamathu saththaththaip balaththa saththamaay muzhanggappa'n'nugi'raar.
theavanudaiya vallamaiyaip pirasiththappaduththungga'l; avarudaiya magimai isravealinmealum, avarudaiya vallamai meagama'ndalangga'lilum u'l'lathu.

theavanea, umathu parisuththa sthalangga'lilirunthu bayanggaramaay vi'langgugi'reer; isravealin theavan thammudaiya janangga'lukkup belanaiyum saththuvaththaiyum aru'lugi'ravar; theavanukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaga.
theavanea, ennai iradchiyum; ve'l'langga'l en aaththumaamattum perugivarugi'rathu.
aazhamaana u'laiyil amizhnthirukki'rean, ni'rka nilaiyillai, nilaiyaatha jalaththil aazhnthirukki'rean; ve'l'langga'l enmeal pura'ndupoagi'rathu.
naan kooppidugi'rathinaal i'laiththean; en tho'ndai va'ra'ndupoayit'ru; en theavanukku naan kaaththirukkaiyaal, en ka'nga'l pooththuppoayit'ru.

nimiththamillaamal ennaip pagaikki'ravarga'l en thalaimayirilum athigamaayirukki'raarga'l; vee'naaga enakkuch saththurukka'laagi ennaich sanggarikkavea'ndumen'rirukki'ravarga'l balaththirukki'raarga'l; naan eduththukko'l'laathathai naan kodukka vea'ndiyathaayit'ru.
theavanea, neer en buththiyeenaththai a'rinthirukki'reer; en kut'rangga'l umakku ma'rainthirukkavillai.

seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavarea, umakkaagak kaaththirukki'ravarga'l ennimiththam vedkappattuppoagaathiruppaarga'laaga; isravealin theavanea, ummaith theadugi'ravarga'l ennimiththam naa'namadaiyaathiruppaarga'laaga.
umathunimiththam ninthaiyaich sagiththean; ilachchai en mugaththai moodit'ru.
en sagoathararukku veat'ru manushanum, en thaayin pi'l'laiga'lukku anniyanumaanean.
ummudaiya veettaikku'riththu u'ndaana bakthivairaakkiyam ennaip padchiththathu; ummai ninthikki'ravarga'ludaiya ninthanaiga'l enmeal vizhunthathu.
en aaththumaa vaadumpadi ubavaasiththu azhuthean; athuvum enakku ninthaiyaay mudinthathu.
irattai en uduppaakkinean; appozhuthum avarga'lukkup pazhamozhiyaanean.
vaasalil udkaarnthirukki'ravarga'l enakku viroathamaayp peasugi'raarga'l; mathubaanampa'n'nugi'ravarga'lin paadalaanean.
aanaalum karththaavea, anukkiragakaalaththilea ummai noakki vi'n'nappagn seygi'rean; theavanea, umathu miguntha kirubaiyinaalum umathu iradchippin saththiyaththinaalum enakkuch sevikoduththaru'lum.
naan amizhnthippoagaathapadikkuch seat'rinin'ru ennaith thookkividum; ennaip pagaikki'ravarga'linin'rum nilaiyaatha jalaththinin'rum naan neenggumpadi seyyum.
jalappiravaagangga'l enmeal pura'laamalum, aazham ennai vizhunggaamalum, paathaa'lam enmeal than vaayai adaiththukko'l'laamalum iruppathaaga.
karththaavea, en vi'n'nappaththaik keattaru'lum, ummudaiya thayai nalamaayirukki'rathu; umathu urukkamaana irakkangga'linpadi ennaik kadaadchiththaru'lum.
umathu mugaththai umathu adiyeanukku ma'raiyaatheayum; naan viyaagulappadugi'rean, enakkuth theeviramaaych sevikoduththaru'lum.
neer en aaththumaavinidaththil vanthu athai viduthalaipa'n'num; en saththurukka'linimiththam ennai meettuvidum.
theavareer en ninthaiyaiyum en vedkaththaiyum en avamaanaththaiyum a'rinthirukki'reer; en saththurukka'l ellaarum umakku munbaaga irukki'raarga'l.

ninthai en iruthayaththaip pi'lanthathu; naan migavum veathanaippadugi'rean; enakkaaga parithabikki'ravanu'ndoa en'ru kaaththirunthean, oruvanum illai; theat'rugi'ravarga'lukkuk kaaththirunthean, oruvanaiyum kaa'nean.
en aagaaraththil kasappuk kalanthu koduththaarga'l, en thaagaththukkuk kaadiyaik kudikkakkoduththaarga'l.
avarga'ludaiya panthi avarga'lukkuk ka'n'niyum, avarga'ludaiya selvam avarga'lukku valaiyumaayirukkakkadavathu.
avarga'ludaiya ka'nga'l kaa'naathapadi anthagaarappadakkadavathu; avarga'l iduppuga'lai eppoathum tha'l'laadappa'n'num.
ummudaiya ukkiraththai avarga'lmeal oot'rum; ummudaiya koabaakkini avarga'laith thodarnthu pidippathaaga.
avarga'l vaasasthalam paazhaagakkadavathu; avarga'ludaiya koodaarangga'lil kudiyillaama'rpoavathaaga.
theavareer adiththavanai avarga'l thunbappaduththi, neer kaayappaduththinavarga'lai noagap peasugi'raarga'lea.
akkiramaththinmeal akkiramaththai avarga'lmeal sumaththum, avarga'l umathu neethikku vanthettaathiruppaarga'laaga.
jeevapusthagaththilirunthu avarga'lpear ki'rukkappattuppoavathaaga; neethimaanga'l pearoadea avarga'l pear ezhuthappadaathiruppathaaga.
naanoa si'rumaiyum thuyaramumu'l'lavan; theavanea, ummudaiya iradchippu enakku uyarntha adaikkalamaavathaaga.
theavanudaiya naamaththaip paattinaal thuthiththu, avarai sthoaththiraththinaal magimaippaduththuvean.
kombum viriku'lambumu'l'la kaa'laiyeruthaippaarkkilum, ithuvea karththarukkup piriyamaayirukkum.
saanthaku'namu'l'lavarga'l ithaik ka'ndu santhoashappaduvaarga'l; theavanaith theadugi'ravarga'lea, ungga'l iruthayam vaazhum.
karththar e'liyavarga'lin vi'n'nappaththaik keadki'raar, kattu'nda thammudaiyavarga'lai avar pu'rakka'niyaar.
vaanamum boomiyum samuththirangga'lum avaiga'lil sagncharikki'ra yaavum avaraith thuthikkakkadavathu.
theavan seeyoanai iradchiththu, yoothaavin patta'nangga'laik kattuvaar; appozhuthu anggea kudiyirunthu athaich suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l.
avarudaiya oozhiyakkaararin santhathiyaar athaich suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l; avarudaiya naamaththai neasikki'ravarga'l athil vaasamaayiruppaarga'l.
theavanea, ennai viduviyum, karththaavea, enakkuch sagaayagnseyyath theeviriyum.
en piraa'nanai vaanggaththeadugi'ravarga'l vedki naa'nuvaarga'laaga; enakkuth theengguvarumpadi virumbugi'ravarga'l pinnittuth thirumbi ilachchaiyadaivaarga'laaga.
aa aa, aa aa, enbavarga'l thaangga'l adaiyum vedkaththinaal pinnittuppoavaarga'laaga.
ummaith theadugi'ra yaavarum ummil magizhnthu santhoashappaduvaarga'laaga; umathu iradchippil piriyappadugi'ravarga'l theavanukku magimaiyu'ndaavathaaga en'ru eppozhuthum solvaarga'laaga.
naanoa si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan; theavanea, ennidaththil theeviramaay vaarum: neerea en thu'naiyum ennai viduvikki'ravarumaanavar, karththaavea, thaamathiyaatheayum.
karththaavea, ummai nambiyirukki'rean; naan orupoathum vedkam adaiyaathapadi seyyum.
umathu neethiyinimiththam ennai viduviththu, ennaik kaaththaru'lum; umathu seviyai enakkuch saayththu, ennai iradchiyum.
naan eppozhuthum vanthadaiyaththakkak kanmalaiyaayirum; ennai iradchippatha'rkuk katta'laiyitteerea; neerea en kanmalaiyum en koattaiyumaay irukki'reer.
en theavanea, thunmaarkkanudaiya kaikkum, niyaayakkeadum kodumaiyumu'l'lavanudaiya kaikkum ennaith thappuviyum.
karththaraagiya aa'ndavarea, neerea en noakkamum, en si'ruvayathuthodanggi en nambikkaiyumaayirukki'reer.
naan karppaththil u'rpaviththathumuthal ummaal aatharikkappattean; en thaayin vayit'rilirunthu ennai eduththavar neerea; ummaiyea naan eppozhuthum thuthippean.
aneagarukku naan oru puthumaippoalaanean; neeroa enakkup balaththa adaikkalamaayirukki'reer.
en vaay umathu thuthiyinaalum, naa'lthoa'rum umathu magaththuvaththinaalum ni'rainthiruppathaaga.
muthirnthavayathil ennaith tha'l'lividaamalum, en belan odunggumpoathu ennaik kaividaamalum irum.
en saththurukka'l enakku viroathamaayp peasi, en aaththumaavukkuk kaaththirukki'ravarga'l eagamaay aaloasanaipa'n'ni:
theavan avanaik kaivittaar, avanaith thodarnthupidiyungga'l; avanai viduvippaar illai engi'raarga'l.
theavanea, enakkuth thooramaayiraatheayum; en theavanea, enakkuch sagaayampa'n'nath theeviriyum.
en aaththumaavai viroathikki'ravarga'l vedki azhiyavum, enakkup pollaapputh theadugi'ravarga'l ninthaiyaalum ilachchaiyaalum moodappadavungkadavarga'l.
naanoa eppozhuthum nambikkaiko'ndirunthu, meanmealum ummaith thuthippean.
en vaay naa'lthoa'rum umathu neethiyaiyum umathu iradchippaiyum sollum; avaiga'lin thogaiyai naan a'riyean.
karththaraagiya aa'ndavarudaiya vallamaiyai munnittu nadappean; ummudaiya neethiyaippat'riyea meanmaipaaraattuvean.
theavanea, en si'ruvayathumuthal enakkup poathiththuvantheer; ithuvaraikkum ummudaiya athisayangga'lai a'riviththuvanthean.

ippozhuthum theavanea, inthach santhathikku umathu vallamaiyaiyum, varappoagi'ra yaavarukkum umathu baraakkiramaththaiyum naan a'rivikkuma'lavum, muthirvayathum naraimayirumu'l'lavanaagumvaraikkum ennaik kaivideeraaga.
theavanea, ummudaiya neethi unnathamaanathu, perithaanavaiga'lai neer seytheer; theavanea, umakku nigaraanavar yaar?
aneaga ikkattuga'laiyum aabaththuga'laiyum kaa'numpadi seytha ennai neer thirumbavum uyirppiththu, thirumbavum ennaip boomiyin paathaa'langga'lilirunthu ea'rappa'n'nuveer.
en meanmaiyaip perugappa'n'ni, ennai ma'rupadiyum theat'ruveer.
en theavanea, naan vee'naiyaikko'ndu ummaiyum ummudaiya saththiyaththaiyum thuthippean; isravealin parisuththarea, surama'ndalaththaikko'ndu ummaip paaduvean.
naan paadumpoathu en uthaduga'lum, neer meettukko'nda en aaththumaavum kembeeriththu magizhum.
enakkup pollaappaith theadugi'ravarga'l vedki ilachchaiyadainthapadiyaal, naa'lthoa'rum en naavu umathu neethiyaik ko'ndaadum.
theavanea, raajaavukku ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuga'laiyum, raajaavin kumaaranukku ummudaiya neethiyaiyum koduththaru'lum.
avar ummudaiya janangga'lai neethiyoadum, ummudaiya eazhaiga'lai niyaayaththoadum visaarippaar.
parvathangga'l janaththi'rkuch samaathaanaththaith tharum, meaduga'l neethiyin vi'laivoadirukkum.
janaththil si'rumaippadugi'ravarga'lai avar niyaayam visaariththu, eazhaiyin pi'l'laiga'lai iradchiththu, idukka'n seygi'ravanai no'rukkuvaar.
sooriyanum santhiranumu'l'lamattum, avarga'l umakkuth thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaagap bayanthiruppaarga'l.
pulla'ruppu'nda ve'liyinmeal peyyum mazhaiyaippoalavum, boomiyai nanaikkum thoo'ralaippoalavum i'rangguvaar.
avarudaiya naadka'lil neethimaan sezhippaan; santhiranu'l'lavaraikkum miguntha samaathaanam irukkum.
oru samuththiranthodanggi ma'rusamuththiramvaraikkum, nathithodanggi boomiyin ellaiga'lvaraikkum avar arasaa'luvaar.
vanaantharaththaar avarukku munbaagak kuninthu va'nangguvaarga'l; avarudaiya saththurukka'l ma'n'nai nakkuvaarga'l.
tharsheesin raajaakka'lum theevuga'lin raajaakka'lum kaa'nikkaiga'laik ko'nduvaruvaarga'l; sheabaavilum seabaavilumu'l'la raajaakka'l vegumaanangga'laik ko'nduvaruvaarga'l.
sagala raajaakka'lum avaraip pa'ninthuko'lvaarga'l; sagala jaathiga'lum avaraich seavippaarga'l.
kooppidugi'ra e'liyavanaiyum, uthaviyat'ra si'rumaiyaanavanaiyum avar viduvippaar.
balaveenanukkum e'liyavanukkum avar iranggi, e'liyavarga'lin aaththumaakka'lai iradchippaar.
avarga'l aaththumaakka'lai vagnchagaththi'rkum kodumaikkum thappuvippaar; avarga'ludaiya iraththam avarudaiya paarvaikku arumaiyaayirukkum.
avar pizhaiththiruppaar, sheabaavin pon avarukkuk kodukkappadum; avarnimiththam idaividaamal jebampa'n'nappadum, ennaa'lum sthoaththirikkappaduvaar.
boomiyilea malaiga'lin uchchiga'lil oru pidi thaaniyam vithaikkappattirukkum; athin vi'laivu leebanoanaippoala asaiyum; boomiyin pullaippoala nagaraththaar sezhiththoangguvaarga'l.

avarudaiya naamam en'ren'raikkum irukkum; sooriyanu'l'lamattum avarudaiya naamam santhaana parambaraiyaay nilaikkum; manushar avarukku'l aaseervathikkappaduvaarga'l, ellaa jaathiga'lum avaraip baakkiyamudaiyavar en'ru vaazhththuvaarga'l.
isravealin theavanaayirukki'ra karththaraagiya theavanukku sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaga; avarea athisayangga'laich seygi'ravar.
avarudaiya magimaiporunthiya naamaththukku en'ren'raikkum sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaga; boomi muzhuvathum avarudaiya magimaiyaal ni'rainthiruppathaaga. aamen, aamen.
eesaayin puththiranaagiya thaaveethin vi'n'nappangga'l mudinthathu.
suththa iruthayamu'l'lavarga'laagiya isravealarukku theavan nallavaraagavea irukki'raar.
aanaalum en kaalga'l tha'l'laaduthalukkum, en adiga'l sa'rukkuthalukkum sat'rea thappit'ru.
thunmaarkkarin vaazhvai naan kaa'ngaiyil, veembukkaararaagiya avarga'lmeal po'raamaiko'ndean.
mara'napariyantham avarga'lukku idukka'nga'lillai; avarga'ludaiya belan u'ruthiyaayirukki'rathu.
narar padum varuththaththil agappadaarga'l; manushar adaiyum ubaathiyai adaiyaarga'l.
aagaiyaal perumai sarappa'niyaippoal avarga'laich sut'rikko'l'lum, kodumai aadaiyaippoal avarga'lai moodikko'l'lum.
avarga'l ka'nga'l kozhuppinaal eduppaayp paarkki'rathu; avarga'l iruthayam virumbuvathilum athigamaay nadanthea'rugi'rathu.
avarga'l seerkettuppoay, aganthaiyaayk kodumaipeasugi'raarga'l; i'rumaappaayp peasugi'raarga'l.
thangga'l vaay vaanamattum ettappeasugi'raarga'l; avarga'l naavu boomiyenggum ulaavugi'rathu.
aagaiyaal avarudaiya janangga'l intha vazhiyaagavea thirumbugi'raarga'l; tha'n'neerga'l avarga'lukkup paripoora'namaaych suranthuvarum.
theavanukku athu eppadith theriyum? unnathamaanavarukku athaippat'ri a'rivu u'ndoa? en'ru sollugi'raarga'l.
ithoa, ivarga'l thunmaarkkar; ivarga'l en'rum sugajeeviga'laayirunthu, aasthiyaip perugappa'n'nugi'raarga'l.
naan viruthaavaagavea en iruthayaththaich suththampa'n'ni, kut'ramillaamaiyilea en kaiga'laik kazhuvinean.
naa'lthoa'rum naan vaathikkappattum, kaalaithoa'rum tha'ndikkappattum irukki'rean.
ivvithamaayp peasuvean en'ru naan sonneanaanaal, ithoa, ummudaiya pi'l'laiga'lin santhathikkuth thuroagiyaavean.
ithai a'riyumpadikku yoasiththuppaarththean; naan theavanudaiya parisuththa sthalaththukku'l piraveasiththu,
avarga'l mudivaik kavaniththu u'naruma'lavum, athu en paarvaikku visanamaayirunthathu.
nichchayamaagavea neer avarga'laich sa'rukkalaana idangga'lil ni'ruththi, paazhaana idangga'lil vizhappa'n'nugi'reer.
avarga'l oru nimishaththil evva'lavu paazhaayppoagi'raarga'l! bayanggarangga'laal azhinthu nirmoolamaagi'raarga'l.
niththirai the'linthavudanea soppanam ozhivathupoal, aa'ndavarea, neer vizhikkumpoathu, avarga'l veashaththai igazhuveer.
ippadiyaaga en manam kasanthathu, en u'l'linthiriyangga'lilea kuththu'ndean.
naan kaariyam a'riyaatha moodanaanean; umakku munbaaga mirugampoalirunthean.
aanaalum naan eppozhuthum ummoadirukki'rean; en valathukaiyaip pidiththuth thaanggugi'reer.
ummudaiya aaloasanaiyinpadi neer ennai nadaththi, mudivilea ennai magimaiyil eat'rukko'lveer.
paraloagaththil ummaiyallaamal enakku yaar u'ndu? booloagaththil ummaith thavira enakku vea'rea viruppamillai.
en maamsamum en iruthayamum maa'ndupoagi'rathu; theavan en'ren'raikkum en iruthayaththin kanmalaiyum en panggumaayirukki'raar.
ithoa, ummaivittuth thooramaayppoagi'ravarga'l naasamadaivaarga'l; ummaivittuch soarampoagi'ra anaivaraiyum sanggarippeer.
enakkoa, theavanai a'ndikko'ndiruppathea nalam; naan umathu kiriyaiga'laiyellaam sollivarumpadi karththaraagiya aa'ndavarmeal en nambikkaiyai vaiththirukki'rean.
theavanea, neer engga'lai en'ren'raikkum ean tha'l'lividugi'reer? umathu meaychchalin aaduga'lmeal umathu koabam ean pugaigi'rathu?
neer poorvakaalaththil sambaathiththa umathu sabaiyaiyum, neer meettukko'nda umathu suthantharamaana koaththiraththaiyum, neer vaasamaayiruntha seeyoan parvathaththaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
nedungkaalamaagap paazhaaykkidakki'ra sthalangga'lil ummudaiya paathangga'lai ezhuntharu'lappa'n'num; parisuththa sthalaththilea saththuru anaiththaiyum keduththuppoattaan.
ummudaiya saththurukka'l ummudaiya aalayangga'lukku'l'lea kerchchiththu, thangga'l kodiga'lai adaiyaa'langga'laaga naattugi'raarga'l.
koadariga'lai oanggich soalaiyilea marangga'lai vettugi'ravan pearpet'ravanaanaan.
ippozhuthoa avarga'l athin siththiravealaiga'l muzhuvathaiyum vaachchiga'laalum sammattiga'laalum thagarththup poadugi'raarga'l.
umathu parisuththa sthalaththai akkinikku iraiyaakki, umathu naamaththin vaasasthalaththaith tharaimattum idiththu, asuththappaduththinaarga'l.
avarga'lai eagamaay nirththoo'liyaakkuvoam en'ru thangga'l iruthayaththil solli, theasaththilu'l'la aalayangga'laiyellaam sutteriththuppoattaarga'l.
engga'lukku iruntha adaiyaa'langga'laik kaa'noam; theerkkatharisiyum illai; ithu ethuvaraikkum en'ru a'rigi'ravanum engga'lidaththil illai.
theavanea, ethuvaraikkum saththuru ninthippaan? pagaivan umathu naamaththai eppozhuthum thooshippaanoa?
umathu valathukaraththai ean mudakkikko'l'lugi'reer; athai umathu madiyilirunthu eduththu oanggi nirmoolamaakkum.
boomiyin naduvil iradchippuga'laich seythuvarugi'ra theavan poorvakaalamuthal ennudaiya raajaa.
theavareer umathu vallamaiyinaal samuththiraththai ira'ndaagap pi'lanthu, jalaththilu'l'la valusarppangga'lin thalaiga'lai udaiththeer.
theavareer muthalaiga'lin thalaiga'lai narukkippoattu, athai vanaantharaththu janangga'lukku u'navaagak koduththeer.
oot'raiyum aat'raiyum pi'lanthuvitteer; mahaa nathiga'laiyum vat'rippoagappa'n'nineer.
pagalum ummudaiyathu, iravum ummudaiyathu; theavareer o'liyaiyum sooriyanaiyum padaiththeer.
boomiyin ellaiga'laiyellaam thittampa'n'nineer; koadaikaalaththaiyum maarikaalaththaiyum u'ndaakkineer.
karththaavea, saththuru ummai ninthiththathaiyum, mathiyeena janangga'l umathu naamaththaith thooshiththathaiyum ninaiththukko'l'lum.
umathu kaattuppu'raavin aaththumaavaith thushdarudaiya koottaththi'rku oppukkodaatheayum; umathu eazhaiga'lin koottaththai en'raikkum ma'ravaatheayum.
ummudaiya udanpadikkaiyai ninaiththaru'lum; boomiyin iru'laana idangga'l kodumaiyu'l'la kudiyiruppuga'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathea.
thunbappattavan vedkaththoadea thirumbavidaathirum; si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan umathu naamaththaith thuthikkumpadi seyyum.
theavanea, ezhuntharu'lum, umakkaaga neerea vazhakkaadum; mathiyeenanaalea naadoa'rum umakku varum ninthaiyai ninaiththukko'l'lum.
ummudaiya saththurukka'lin aaravaaraththai ma'ravaatheayum; umakku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'ravarga'lin ama'li eppozhuthum athigarikki'rathu.
ummaith thuthikki'roam, theavanea, ummaith thuthikki'roam; umathu naamam sameebamaayirukki'rathen'ru umathu athisayamaana kiriyaiga'l a'rivikki'rathu.
niyamikkappatta kaalaththilea, yathaarththamaay niyaayantheerppean.
boomiyaanathu athin ellaak kudiga'loadum karainthupoagi'rathu; athin thoo'nga'lai naan nilaini'ruththugi'rean. (sealaa.)
veembukkaararai noakki, veembu peasaatheayungga'l en'rum; thunmaarkkarai noakki, kombai uyarththaathirungga'l en'rum sonnean.
ungga'l kombai uyaramaay uyarththaathirungga'l; i'rumaappu'l'la kazhuththudaiyavarga'laayp peasaathirungga'l.
kizhakkilum mea'rkilum vanaantharathisaiyilumirunthu jeyam varaathu.
theavanea niyaayaathibathi; oruvanaith thaazhththi, oruvanai uyarththugi'raar.

kalanggip ponggugi'ra mathubaanaththinaal ni'raintha paaththiram karththarudaiya kaiyilirukki'rathu, athilirunthu vaarkki'raar; boomiyilu'l'la thunmaarkkar yaavarum athin va'ndalga'lai u'rignchik kudippaarga'l.
naanoa en'ren'raikkum ithai a'riviththu, yaakkoabin theavanaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
thunmaarkkarudaiya kombuga'laiyellaam vettippoaduvean; neethimaanudaiya kombuga'loa uyarththappadum.
yoothaavil theavan a'riyappattavar; isravealil avarudaiya naamam periyathu.
saaleamil avarudaiya koodaaramum, seeyoanil avarudaiya vaasasthalamum irukki'rathu.
anggeayirunthu villin ambuga'laiyum, keadagaththaiyum, pattayaththaiyum, yuththaththaiyum mu'riththaar. (sealaa.)
magaththuvamu'l'lavarea, ko'l'laiyu'l'la parvathangga'laippaarkkilum neer piragaasamu'l'lavar.
thairiya negnchu'l'lavarga'l ko'l'laiyidappattu, niththiraiyadainthu asarnthaarga'l; vallamaiyu'l'la ellaa manusharudaiya kaiga'lum avarga'lukku uthavaama'rpoayit'ru.
yaakkoabin theavanea, ummudaiya ka'ndithaththinaal irathangga'lum kuthiraiga'lum u'ranggi vizhunthathu.
neer, neerea, bayanggaramaanavar; umathu koabam moo'lumpoathu umakku munbaaga ni'rpavan yaar?
niyaayam visaarikkavum boomiyil si'rumaippattavarga'l yaavaraiyum iradchikkavum, theavareer ezhuntharu'linapoathu,
vaanaththilirunthu niyaayaththeerppuk keadkappa'n'nineer; boomi bayanthu amarnthathu. (sealaa.)
manushanudaiya koabam umathu magimaiyai vi'langgappa'n'num; mignchungkoabaththai neer adakkuveer.
poruththanaipa'n'ni athai ungga'l theavanaagiya karththarukku ni'raiveat'rungga'l; avaraich soozhnthirukki'ra anaivarum bayanggaramaanavarukkuk kaa'nikkaiga'laik ko'nduvarakkadavarga'l.
pirabukka'lin aaviyai adakkuvaar; boomiyin raajaakka'lukku avar bayanggaramaanavar.
naan theavanai noakki en saththaththai uyarththik kegnchinean, en saththaththai theavanidaththil uyarththinean, avar enakkuch sevikoduththaar.
en aabaththunaa'lil aa'ndavaraith theadinean; iravilum en kai tha'laraamal virikkappattirunthathu; en aaththumaa aa'ruthaladaiyaama'rpoayit'ru.
naan theavanai ninaiththapoathu ala'rinean; naan thiyaanikkumpoathu en aavi thoynthupoayit'ru. (sealaa.)
naan thoonggaathapadi en ka'n'nimaiga'laip pidiththirukki'reer; naan peasamaattaathapadi sagnchalappadugi'rean.
poorvanaadka'laiyum, aathikaalaththu varushangga'laiyum sinthikki'rean.
iraakkaalaththil en sanggeethaththai naan ninaiththu, en iruthayaththoadea sambaashiththukko'l'lugi'rean; en aavi aaraaychchiseythathu.
aa'ndavar niththiyakaalamaayth tha'l'lividuvaaroa? ini orupoathum thayaiseyyaathiruppaaroa?
avarudaiya kirubai mut'rilum at'ruppoayit'roa? vaakkuththaththamaanathu thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raikkum ozhinthupoayit'roa?
theavan irakkagnseyya ma'ranthaaroa? koabaththinaalea thamathu urukkamaana irakkangga'lai adaiththukko'ndaaroa? en'rean. (sealaa.)
appozhuthu naan: ithu en balaveenam; aanaalum unnathamaanavarudaiya valathukaraththilu'l'la varushangga'lai ninaivukooruvean.
karththarudaiya seyalga'lai ninaivukooruvean, ummudaiya poorvakaalaththu athisayangga'laiyea ninaivukooruvean;
ummudaiya kiriyaiga'laiyellaam thiyaaniththu, ummudaiya seyalga'lai yoasippean en'rean.
theavanea, umathu vazhi parisuththa sthalaththilu'l'lathu; nammudaiya theavanaippoalap periya theavan yaar?
athisayangga'laich seygi'ra theavan neerea; janangga'lukku'l'lea ummudaiya vallamaiyai vi'langgappa'n'nineer.
yaakkoabu yoaseappu enbavarga'lin puththiraraagiya ummudaiya janangga'lai, umathu puyaththinaalea meettukko'ndeer. (sealaa.)
jalangga'l ummaik ka'ndathu; theavanea, jalangga'l ummaik ka'ndu thaththa'liththathu; aazhangga'lum kalangginathu.
meagangga'l jalangga'laip pozhinthathu; aagaayama'ndalangga'l muzhakkamittathu; ummudaiya ambuga'lum the'rippu'ndu pa'ranthathu.
ummudaiya kumu'ralin saththam suzhalkaat'ril muzhangginathu; minnalga'l poochchakkaraththaip piragaasippiththathu; boomi kulunggi athirnthathu.
umathu vazhi kadalilum, umathu paathaiga'l thira'nda tha'n'neerga'lilum irunthathu; umathu kaaladiga'l theriyappadaama'rpoayit'ru.
moasea aaroan enbavarga'lin kaiyaal, umathu janangga'lai oru aattumanthaiyaippoala vazhinadaththineer.
en janangga'lea, en ubatheasaththaik kea'lungga'l; en vaayin vasanangga'lukku ungga'l seviga'laich saayungga'l.
en vaayai uvamaiga'laal thi'rappean; poorvakaalaththu ma'raiporu'lga'lai ve'lippaduththuvean.
avaiga'lai naangga'l kea'lvippattu a'rinthoam; engga'l pithaakka'l avaiga'lai engga'lukkuth theriviththaarga'l.
pinvarum santhathiyaana pi'l'laiga'lukku naangga'l avaiga'lai ma'raikkaamal, karththarin thuthiga'laiyum avarudaiya balaththaiyum, avar seytha avarudaiya athisayangga'laiyum vivarippoam.
avar yaakkoabilea saadchiyai ea'rpaduththi, isravealilea veathaththai sthaabiththu, avaiga'laith thangga'l pi'l'laiga'lukku a'rivikkumpadi nammudaiya pithaakka'lukkuk katta'laiyittaar.
inip pi'rakkum pi'l'laiga'laagiya pinsanthathiyaar athai a'rinthuko'ndu, avarga'l ezhumbith thangga'l pi'l'laiga'lukku avaiga'laich sollumpadikkum;
theavanmeal avarga'l thangga'l nambikkaiyai vaiththu, theavanudaiya seyalga'lai ma'ravaamal, avar ka'rpanaiga'laik kaikko'l'lumpadikkum;

iruthayaththaich sevvaippaduththaamalum, theavanai u'ruthiyaayp pat'rikko'l'laamalum iruntha murattaattamum kalagamumu'l'la santhathiyaagiya thangga'l pithaakka'lukku avarga'l oppaagaathapadikkum, ivaiga'laik katta'laiyittaar.
aayuthama'nintha vilveeraraana eppiraayeem puththirar yuththanaa'lilea muthugukaattinaarga'l.
avarga'l theavanudaiya udanpadikkaiyaik kaikko'l'laamalum, avarudaiya katta'laiga'linpadi nadakkach sammathiyaamalum,
avarudaiya seyalga'laiyum, avar thangga'lukkuk kaa'nbiththa athisayangga'laiyum ma'ranthaarga'l.
avarga'ludaiya pithaakka'lukkumunbaaga, egipthutheasaththuch soavaan ve'liyilea, avar athisayamaanavaiga'laich seythaar.
kadalaip pi'lanthu, avarga'laik kadakkappa'n'ni, jalaththaik kuviyalaaga ni'rkumpadi seythaar.
pagalilea meagaththinaalum, iraamuzhuthum akkini ve'lichchaththinaalum avarga'lai vazhinadaththinaar.
vanaantharaththilea kanmalaiga'laip pi'lanthu, mahaa aazhangga'lilirunthu tha'n'neerai avarga'lukkuk kudikkakkoduththaar.
kanmalaiyilirunthu neeroattangga'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ni, tha'n'neerai nathipoala oadivarumpadi seythaar.
en'raalum, avarga'l pinnum avarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythu, va'ra'nda ve'liyilea unnathamaanavarukkuk koabam moottinaarga'l.
thangga'l ichchaikkeat'ra poajanaththaik keattu, thangga'l iruthayaththil theavanaip pareedchaipaarththaarga'l.
avarga'l theavanukku viroathamaayp peasi: theavan vanaantharaththilea poajanapanthiyai aayaththappaduththakkoodumoa?

ithoa avar kanmalaiyai adiththathinaal tha'n'neer pu'rappattu, nathiga'laayp pura'nduvanthathu; avar appaththaiyum kodukkakkoodumoa? thammudaiya janaththi'rku maamsaththaiyum aayaththappaduththuvaaroa? en'raarga'l.
aagaiyaal karththar athaik keattuk koabangko'ndaar; avarga'l theavanai visuvaasiyaamalum, avarudaiya iradchippai nambaamalum poanathinaal,
yaakkoabukku viroathamaay akkini pat'riyerinthathu; isravealukku viroathamaayk koabam moo'ndathu.
avar uyaraththilu'l'la meagangga'lukkuk katta'laiyittu, vaanaththin kathavuga'laith thi'ranthu,
mannaavai avarga'lukku aagaaramaaga varushikkappa'n'ni, vaanaththin thaaniyaththai avarga'lukkuk koduththaar.
thootharga'lin appaththai manushan saappittaan; avarga'lukku aagaaraththaip poora'namaay anuppinaar.
aagaasaththilea keezhkkaat'rai varappa'n'ni, thammudaiya vallamaiyinaal then'ralaiyum veesachseythu,
maamsaththaith thoo'laththanaiyaayum, si'ragu'l'la pa'ravaiga'laik kada'rkarai ma'nalaththanaiyaayum varushikkappa'n'ni,
avaiga'lai avarga'l paa'layaththin naduvilum, avarga'l koodaarangga'laich sut'rilum i'ranggappa'n'ninaar.
avarga'l pusiththuth thirupthiyadainthaarga'l; avarga'l ichchiththathai avarga'lukkuk koduththaar.
avarga'l thangga'l ichchaiyai ve'rukkavillai; avarga'ludaiya poajanam avarga'l vaayil irukkumpoathea,
theavakoabam avarga'lmeal ezhumbi, avarga'lil kozhuththavarga'laich sanggariththu, isravealil viseashiththavarga'lai madiyappa'n'nit'ru.
ivaiyellaam nadanthum, avar seytha athisayangga'lai avarga'l nambaamal, pinnum paavagnseythaarga'l.
aathalaal avarga'l naadka'lai viruthaavilum, avarga'l varushangga'laip bayanggaraththilum kazhiyappa'n'ninaar.
avarga'lai avar kollumpoathu avaraikku'riththu visaariththu, avarga'l thirumbivanthu theavanai athikaalamea theadi;
theavan thangga'l kanmalaiyen'rum, unnathamaana theavan thangga'l meedpar en'rum, ninaivukoornthaarga'l.
aanaalum avarga'l thangga'l vaayinaal avarukku ichchagampeasi, thangga'l naavinaal avaridaththil poysonnaarga'l.
avarga'l iruthayam avaridaththil nilaivarappadavillai; avarudaiya udanpadikkaiyil avarga'l u'nmaiyaayirukkavillai.
avaroa avarga'lai azhikkaamal, irakkamu'l'lavaraay avarga'l akkiramaththai manniththaar; avar thamathu ukkiram muzhuvathaiyum ezhuppaamal, aneagantharam thamathu koabaththai vilakkivittaar.
avarga'l maamsamen'rum, thirumbivaraamal agalugi'ra kaat'ren'rum ninaivukoornthaar.
eththanaitharamoa vanaantharaththilea avarukkuk koabam mootti, avaantharave'liyilea avarai visanappaduththinaarga'l.
avarga'l thirumbi theavanaip pareedchaipaarththu, isravealin parisuththarai mattuppaduththinaarga'l.
avarudaiya karaththaiyum, avar thangga'laich saththuruvukku vilakki meetta naa'laiyum ninaiyaama'rpoanaarga'l.
avar egipthilea thammudaiya adaiyaa'langga'laiyum, soavaan ve'liyilea thammudaiya a'rputhangga'laiyum seythaar.
avarga'ludaiya nathiga'lai iraththamaaga maat'ri, avarga'ludaiya aa'ruga'lilu'l'la jalaththaik kudikkakkoodaathapadi seythaar.
avarga'lai azhikkumpadi va'ndu jaathiga'laiyum, avarga'laik kedukkumpadi thava'laiga'laiyum avarga'lukku'l'lea anuppinaar.
avarga'ludaiya vi'laichchalaip puzhukka'lukkum, avarga'ludaiya pirayaasaththin palanai vettukki'liga'lukkum koduththaar.
kalmazhaiyinaal avarga'ludaiya thiraadchachsediga'laiyum, aalaangkattiyinaal avarga'ludaiya aththimarangga'laiyum azhiththu,
avarga'ludaiya mirugajeevanga'laik kalmazhaikkum, avarga'ludaiya aadumaaduga'lai idiga'lukkum oppukkoduththaar.
thamathu ukkiramaana koabaththaiyum, moorkkaththaiyum, sinaththaiyum, ubaththiravaththaiyum, theengguseyyum thootharga'laiyum avarga'lukku'l'lea anuppinaar.
avar thammudaiya koabaththukku vazhithi'ranthu, avarga'l aaththumaavai mara'naththukku vilakkik kaavaamal, avarga'l jeevanaik ko'l'lainoaykku oppukkoduththaar.
egipthilea thalaichchanga'l anaiththaiyum, kaamin koodaarangga'lilea avarga'ludaiya belanil mutha'rpalanaana yaavaraiyum azhiththu;
thammudaiya janangga'lai aaduga'laippoal pu'rappadappa'n'ni, avarga'lai vanaantharaththilea manthaiyaippoal koottikko'ndupoay;
avarga'l bayappadaathapadikku avarga'laip paththiramaay vazhinadaththinaar; avarga'l saththurukka'laik kadal moodippoattathu.
avarga'laith thamathu parisuththa sthalaththin ellaivaraikkum, thamathu valathukaram sambaathiththa inthap parvathamattukkum azhaiththukko'nduvanthu,
avarga'l mugaththi'rku munbaaga jaathiga'laith thuraththivittu, theasaththai noolpoattup panggittu, avarga'ludaiya koodaarangga'lil isravealin koaththirangga'laik kudiyeat'rinaar.
aanaalum avarga'l unnathamaana theavanaip pareedchaipaarththu, avarukkuk koabam mootti, avarudaiya saadchiga'laik kaikko'l'laama'rpoay,
thangga'l pithaakka'laippoala vazhivilagi, thuroagampa'n'ni, moasampoakkum villaippoal thuva'ndu,
thangga'l meadaiga'linaal avarukkuk koabam mootti, thangga'l vikkiragangga'linaal erichchal u'ndaakkinaarga'l.
theavan athaik keattu ukkiramaagi, isravealai migavum ve'ruththu,
thaam manusharukku'l'lea poatta koodaaramaagiya seeloavilu'l'la vaasasthalaththai vittuvilagi,
thamathu balaththaich si'raiyiruppukkum, thamathu magimaiyaich saththuruvin kaikkum oppukkoduththu,
thamathu janaththaip pattayaththukku iraiyaakki, thamathu suthantharaththinmeal koabangko'ndaar.
avarga'l vaalibarai akkini padchiththathu, avarga'l kanniyaasthireega'l vaazhkkaippadaathirunthaarga'l.
avarga'ludaiya aasaariyarga'l pattayaththaal vizhunthaarga'l, avarga'ludaiya vithavaiga'l azhavillai.
appozhuthu aa'ndavar niththirai the'linthavanaippoalavum, thiraadcharasaththaal kembeerikki'ra baraakkiramasaaliyaippoalavum vizhiththu,
thammudaiya saththurukka'laip pinpu'ramaaga adiththu, avarga'lukku niththiya ninthaiyai varappa'n'ninaar.
avar yoaseappin koodaaraththaip pu'rakka'niththaar; eppiraayeem koaththiraththai avar therinthuko'l'laamal,
yoothaa koaththiraththaiyum thamakkup piriyamaana seeyoan parvathaththaiyum therinthuko'ndaar.
thammudaiya parisuththa sthalaththai malaiga'laippoalavum, en'raikkum ni'rkumpadi thaam asthibaarappaduththina boomiyaippoalavum kattinaar.
thammudaiya thaasanaagiya thaaveethaith therinthuko'ndu, aattuththozhuvangga'lilirunthu avanai eduththaar.
ka'ravalaaduga'lin pinnaagath thirintha avanai, thammudaiya janamaagiya yaakkoabaiyum thammudaiya suthantharamaagiya isravealaiyum meayppatha'rkaaga, azhaiththukko'nduvanthaar.
ivan avarga'laith than iruthayaththin u'nmaiyinpadiyea meayththu, than kaiga'lin thi'ramaiyinaal avarga'lai nadaththinaan.
theavanea, pu'rajaathiyaar umathu suthantharaththil vanthu, umathu parisuththa aalayaththaith theettuppaduththi, erusaleamai ma'nmeaduga'laakkinaarga'l.
umathu oozhiyakkaararin pireathangga'lai aagaayaththup pa'ravaiga'lukkum, umathu parisuththavaanga'lin maamsaththaip boomiyin mirugangga'lukkum iraiyaagak koduththaarga'l.
erusaleamaich sut'rilum avarga'ludaiya iraththaththai tha'n'neeraippoalach sinthinaarga'l; avarga'lai adakkampa'n'nuvaarumillai.
engga'l ayalaarukku ninthaiyum, engga'l sut'ruppu'raththaarukkup pariyaasamum sakkanthamumaanoam.
ethuvaraikkum karththaavea! neer en'raikkum koabamaayiruppeeroa? ummudaiya erichchal akkiniyaippoal eriyumoa?
ummai a'riyaatha jaathiga'lmealum, umathu naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'laatha raajyangga'lmealum, ummudaiya ukkiraththai oot'rividum.
avarga'l yaakkoabaip padchiththu, avan kudiyiruppaip paazhaakkinaarga'lea.
poorvakaalaththu akkiramangga'lai engga'lukku viroathamaaga ninaiyaatheayum; ummudaiya irakkangga'l seekkiramaay engga'lukku neariduvathaaga; naangga'l migavum thaazhththappattuppoanoam.
engga'lai iradchikkum theavanea, neer umathu naamaththin magimaiyinimiththam engga'lukku uthaviseythu, umathu naamaththinimiththam engga'lai viduviththu, engga'l paavangga'lai nivirththiyaakkum.

avarga'ludaiya theavan enggea en'ru pu'rajaathiga'l solvaanean? umathu oozhiyakkaararudaiya sinthu'nda iraththaththin pazhivaangguthal jaathiga'lukku'l'lea engga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaaga vi'langgumpadi seyyum.
kattu'ndavanudaiya perumoochchu umakku munbaaga varattum; kolaikku niyamikkappattavarga'lai umathu puyabalaththinaal uyiroadea kaaththaru'lum.
aa'ndavarea, engga'l ayalaar ummai ninthiththa ninthaiyai, eazhaththanaiyaaga avarga'l madiyilea thirumbappa'n'num.
appozhuthu, ummudaiya janangga'lum ummudaiya meaychchalin aaduga'lumaagiya naangga'l ummai en'ren'raikkum pugazhuvoam; thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga umathu thuthiyaich sollivaruvoam.
isravealin meaypparea, yoaseappai aattumanthaiyaippoal nadaththugi'ravarea, sevikodum; kearubeenga'l maththiyil vaasampa'n'nugi'ravarea, piragaasiyum.
eppiraayeem benyameen manaasea enbavarga'lukku munbaaga, neer umathu vallamaiyai ezhuppi, engga'lai iradchikka vantharu'lum.
theavanea, engga'laith thiruppikko'nduvaarum, umathu mugaththaip piragaasikkappa'n'num, appozhuthu iradchikkappaduvoam.
seanaiga'lin theavanaagiya karththaavea, umathu janaththin vi'n'nappaththukku viroathamaay neer ethuvaraikkum koabangko'lveer.
ka'n'neeraagiya appaththai avarga'lukku poajanamaagavum, miguthiyaana ka'n'neeraiyea avarga'lukkup baanamaagavum koduththeer.
engga'l ayalaarukku engga'lai vazhakkaaga vaikki'reer; engga'l saththurukka'l engga'laip pariyaasampa'n'nugi'raarga'l.
seanaiga'lin theavanea, engga'laith thiruppikko'nduvaarum, umathu mugaththaip piragaasikkappa'n'num, appozhuthu iradchikkappaduvoam.
neer egipthilirunthu oru thiraadchakkodiyaik ko'nduvanthu, jaathiga'laith thuraththivittu, athai naattineer.
atha'rku idaththai aayaththappaduththineer; athu vearoon'ri, theasamenggum padarnthathu.
athin nizhalaal malaiga'lum athin ki'laiga'laal thivviyamaana keathurukka'lum moodappattathu.
athu than kodiga'laich samuththiramattaagavum, than ki'laiga'lai nathimattaagavum padaravittathu.
ippozhuthoa vazhinadakki'ra yaavarum athaip pa'rikkumpadiyaaga, athin adaippuga'lai ean thagarththuppoatteer?
kaattuppan'ri athai uzhuthupoadugi'rathu, ve'liyin mirugangga'l athai meaynthupoadugi'rathu.
seanaiga'lin theavanea, thirumbivaarum, vaanaththilirunthu ka'n'noakkippaarththu, inthath thiraadchachsediyai visaariththaru'lum;
ummudaiya valathukaram naattina kodiyaiyum, umakku neer thidappaduththina ki'laiyaiyum kadaadchiththaru'lum.
athu akkiniyaal sudappattum vettu'ndum poayit'ru; ummudaiya mugaththin bayamu'ruththalaal azhinthupoagi'raarga'l.
umathu karam umathu valathupaarisaththup purushanmeethilum, umakku neer thidappaduththina manushakumaaranmeethilum iruppathaaga.
appozhuthu ummaivittup pinvaanggamaattoam; engga'lai uyirppiyum, appozhuthu umathu naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'luvoam.
seanaiga'lin theavanaagiya karththaavea, engga'laith thiruppikko'ndu vaarum; umathu mugaththaip piragaasikkappa'n'num, appozhuthu iradchikkappaduvoam.
nammudaiya belanaagiya theavanaik kembeeramaayp paadi, yaakkoabin theavanaikku'riththu aarppariyungga'l.
thamburu vaasiththu, vee'naiyaiyum iniya oasaiyaana surama'ndalaththaiyum eduththu, sanggeetham paadungga'l.
maathappi'rappilum, niyamiththakaalaththilum, nammudaiya pa'ndigainaadka'lilum, ekkaa'lam oothungga'l.
ithu isravealukkup piramaa'namum, yaakkoabin theavan vithiththa niyaayamumaayirukki'rathu.
naam a'riyaatha baashaiyaik keatta egipthutheasaththaivittup pu'rappadugaiyil, ithai yoaseappilea saadchiyaaga ea'rpaduththinaar.
avan thoa'laich sumaikku vilakkinean; avan kaiga'l koodaikku neenggalaakkappattathu.

nerukkaththilea nee kooppittaay, naan unnaith thappuviththean; idimuzhakkam u'ndaagum ma'raividaththilirunthu unakku uththaravu aru'linean; mearibaavin tha'n'neerga'lidaththil unnaich soathiththu a'rinthean. (sealaa.)
en janamea kea'l, unakkuch saadchiyittuch solluvean; isravealea, nee enakkuch sevikoduththaal nalamaayirukkum.
unakku'l vea'ru theavan u'ndaayirukkavea'ndaam; anniya theavanai nee namaskarikkavum vea'ndaam.
unnai egipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nina un theavanaagiya karththar naanea; un vaayai virivaayth thi'ra, naan athai nirappuvean.
en janamoa en saththaththukkuch sevikodukkavillai; israveal ennai virumbavillai.
aagaiyaal avarga'lai avarga'l iruthayaththin kadinaththi'rku vittuvittean; thangga'l yoasanaiga'linpadiyea nadanthaarga'l.
aa, en janam enakkuch sevikoduththu, israveal en vazhiga'lil nadanthaal nalamaayirukkum!
naan seekkiraththil avarga'l ethiraa'liga'laith thaazhththi, en kaiyai avarga'l saththurukka'lukku viroathamaagath thiruppuvean.
appozhuthu karththaraip pagaikki'ravarga'l avarukku ichchagam peasi adangguvaarga'l; avarga'ludaiya kaalam en'ren'raikkum irukkum.
uchchithamaana koathumaiyinaal avarga'laip poashippaar; kanmalaiyin theaninaal unnaith thirupthiyaakkuvean.
theavasabaiyilea theavan ezhuntharu'liyirukki'raar; theavarga'lin naduvilea avar niyaayam visaarikki'raar.
ethuvaraikkum neengga'l aniyaayaththeerppuchseythu, thunmaarkkarukku mugathaadchi'niyam pa'n'nuveerga'l. (sealaa.)
eazhaikkum thikkat'ra pi'l'laikkum niyaayagnseythu, si'rumaippattavanukkum thikkat'ravanukkum neethi seyyungga'l.
balaveenanaiyum e'liyavanaiyum viduviththu, thunmaarkkarin kaikku avarga'laith thappuviyungga'l.
a'riyaamalum u'naraamalum irukki'raarga'l, anthagaaraththilea nadakki'raarga'l; theasaththin asthibaarangga'lellaam asaigi'rathu.
neengga'l theavarga'l en'rum, neengga'lellaarum unnathamaanavarin makka'l en'rum naan solliyirunthean.
aanaalum neengga'l manusharaippoalach seththu, loagappirabukka'lil oruvanaippoala vizhunthupoaveerga'l.
theavanea, ezhuntharu'lum, boomikku niyaayaththeerppuch seyyum; neerea sagala jaathiga'laiyum suthantharamaagak ko'ndiruppavar.
theavanea, mavunamaayiraatheayum, peasaamaliraatheayum; theavanea, summaayiraatheayum.
ithoa, ummudaiya saththurukka'l kontha'liththu, ummudaiya pagaignar thalaiyedukki'raarga'l.
umathu janaththukku viroathamaaga ubaaya thanthirangga'lai yoasiththu, umathu ma'raivilirukki'ravarga'lukku viroathamaaga aaloasanaipa'n'nugi'raarga'l.
avarga'l ini oru jaathiyaaraayiraamalum, isravealin pear ini ninaikkappadaamalum poavatha'rkaaga, avarga'lai athampa'n'nuvoam vaarungga'l engi'raarga'l.
ippadi, eathoamin koodaaraththaarum, ismavealarum, moavaabiyarum, aagaariyarum,
keabaalarum, ammoaniyarum, amaleakkiyarum, theeruvin kudiga'loadu koodiya pelistharum,
eagamananir'nayamaay aaloasanaiseythu, umakku viroathamaay oppanthampa'n'nikko'ndirukki'raarga'l.
aseeriyarum avarga'loadeakoodak kalanthu, loaththin puththirarukkup puyabalamaanaarga'l. (sealaa.)
meethiyaaniyarukkuch seythathupoalavum, keesoan ennum aat'ra'ndai enthoarilea azhikkappattu,
nilaththukku eruvaayppoana siseraa, yaabeen enbavarga'lukkuch seythathupoalavum, avarga'lukkuch seyyum.
avarga'laiyum avarga'l athibathiga'laiyum oareabukkum seabukkum, avarga'l pirabukka'laiyellaam seabaavukkum salmunaavukkum samamaakkum.
theavanudaiya vaasasthalangga'lai engga'lukkuch suthantharamaaga naangga'l kattikko'lvoam en'ru sollugi'raarga'lea.
en theavanea, avarga'laich suzhalkaat'rin puzhuthikkum, kaat'rumugaththil pa'rakkum thurumbukkum samamaakkum.
neruppu kaattaik ko'luththuvathupoalavum, akkinijuvaalaiga'l malaiga'lai erippathupoalavum,
neer umathu pusalinaalea avarga'laith thodarnthu, umathu perungkaat'rinaalea avarga'laik kalanggappa'n'num.
karththaavea, avarga'l umathu naamaththaith theadumpadikku, avarga'l mugangga'lai avamaanaththaalea moodum.
yeagoavaa ennum naamaththaiyudaiya theavareer oruvarea boomiyanaiththinmealum unnathamaanavar en'ru manushar u'narumpadi,
avarga'l en'raikkum vedkikkalanggi, naa'namadainthu azhinthupoavaarga'laaga.
seanaiga'lin karththaavea, umathu vaasasthalangga'l evva'lavu inbamaanavaiga'l!
en aaththumaa karththarudaiya aalayappiraagaarangga'linmeal vaagnchaiyum thavanamumaayirukki'rathu; en iruthayamum en maamsamum jeevanu'l'la theavanai noakkik kembeera saththamidugi'rathu.
en raajaavum en theavanumaagiya seanaiga'lin karththaavea, ummudaiya peedangga'la'ndaiyil adaikkalaan kuruvikku veedum, thagaivilaan kuruvikkuth than kugnchuga'lai vaikkum koodum kidaiththathea.
ummudaiya veettil vaasamaayirukki'ravarga'l baakkiyavaanga'l; avarga'l eppozhuthum ummaith thuthiththukko'ndiruppaarga'l. (sealaa.)
ummilea belanko'l'lugi'ra manushanum, thangga'l iruthayangga'lil sevvaiyaana vazhiga'laik ko'ndirukki'ravarga'lum baakkiyavaanga'l.
azhugaiyin pa'l'laththaakkai uruva nadanthu athai neeroot'raakkik ko'l'lugi'raarga'l; mazhaiyum ku'langga'lai nirappum.
avarga'l balaththinmeal balam adainthu, seeyoanilea theavasannithiyil vanthu kaa'nappaduvaarga'l.
seanaiga'lin theavanaagiya karththaavea, en vi'n'nappaththai kea'lum; yaakkoabin theavanea, sevikodum. (sealaa.)
engga'l keadagamaagiya theavanea, ka'n'noakkamaayirum; neer abisheagampa'n'ninavarin mugaththaip paarum.

aayiram naa'laippaarkkilum umathu piraagaarangga'lil sellum orea naa'l nallathu; aagaamiyak koodaarangga'lil vaasamaayiruppathaippaarkkilum en theavanudaiya aalayaththin vaasa'rpadiyil kaaththiruppathaiyea therinthuko'l'luvean.
theavanaagiya karththar sooriyanum keadagamumaanavar; karththar kirubaiyaiyum magimaiyaiyum aru'luvaar; uththamamaay nadakki'ravarga'lukku nanmaiyai vazhanggaathiraar.
seanaiga'lin karththaavea, ummai nambiyirukki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan.
karththaavea, umathu theasaththinmeal piriyam vaiththu, yaakkoabin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppineer.
umathu janaththin akkiramaththai manniththu, avarga'l paavaththaiyellaam moodineer. (sealaa.)
umathu ukkiraththaiyellaam adakkikko'ndu, umathu koabaththin erichchalaivittuth thirumbineer.
engga'l iradchippin theavanea, neer engga'laith thiruppikko'nduvaarum, engga'lmealu'l'la umathu koabaththai aa'rappa'n'num.
en'raikkum engga'lmeal koabamaayiruppeeroa? thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga umathu koabaththai neediththirukkappa'n'nuveeroa?
umathu janangga'l ummil magizhnthirukkumpadi neer engga'laith thirumba uyirppikkamaatteeroa?
karththaavea, umathu kirubaiyai engga'lukkuk kaa'nbiththu, umathu iradchippai engga'lukku aru'lichseyyum.

karththaraagiya theavan vi'lambuvathaik keadpean; avar thammudaiya janangga'lukkum thammudaiya parisuththavaanga'lukkum samaathaanam koo'ruvaar; avarga'loa mathikeattukkuth thirumbaathiruppaarga'laaga.
nammudaiya theasaththil magimai vaasamaayirukkumpadi, avarudaiya iradchippu avarukkup bayanthavarga'lukkuch sameebamaayirukki'rathu.
kirubaiyum saththiyamum on'raiyon'ru santhikkum, neethiyum samaathaanamum on'raiyon'ru muththagnseyyum.
saththiyam boomiyilirunthu mu'laikkum, neethi vaanaththilirunthu thaazhappaarkkum.
karththar nanmaiyaanathaith tharuvaar; nammudaiya theasamum than palanaik kodukkum.
neethi avarukku munnaagach sen'ru, avarudaiya adichsuvaduga'lin vazhiyilea nammai ni'ruththum.
karththaavea, umathu seviyaich saayththu, en vi'n'nappaththaik keattaru'lum; naan si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan.
en aaththumaavaik kaaththaru'lum, naan bakthiyu'l'lavan; en theavanea, ummai nambiyirukki'ra umathu adiyeanai neer iradchiyum.
aa'ndavarea, enakku iranggum, naadoa'rum ummai noakkik kooppidugi'rean.
umathu adiyeanudaiya aaththumaavai magizhchchiyaakkum; aa'ndavarea, ummidaththil en aaththumaavai uyarththugi'rean.
aa'ndavarea, neer nallavarum, mannikki'ravarum, ummai noakkik kooppidugi'ra yaavarmealum kirubai migunthavarumaayirukki'reer.
karththaavea, en jebaththi'rkuch sevikoduththu, en vi'n'nappangga'lin saththaththaik kavaniyum.
naan thuyarappadugi'ra naa'lil ummai noakkik kooppiduvean; neer ennaik keattaru'luveer.
aa'ndavarea, theavarga'lukku'l'lea umakku nigarumillai; ummudaiya kiriyaiga'lukku oppumillai.
aa'ndavarea, neer u'ndaakkina ellaa jaathiga'lum vanthu, umakku munbaagap pa'ninthu, umathu naamaththai magimaippaduththuvaarga'l.
theavareer magaththuvamu'l'lavarum athisayangga'laich seygi'ravarumaayirukki'reer; neer oruvarea theavan.
karththaavea, umathu vazhiyai enakkup poathiyum, naan umathu saththiyaththilea nadappean; naan umathu naamaththi'rkup bayanthirukkumpadi en iruthayaththai orumugappaduththum.
en theavanaagiya aa'ndavarea ummai en muzhu iruthayaththoadum thuthiththu, umathu naamaththai en'ren'raikkum magimaippaduththuvean.
