neer enakkup paaraattina umathu kirubai periyathu; en aaththumaavaith thaazhntha paathaa'laththi'rkuth thappuviththeer.

theavanea, aganggaariga'l enakku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'raarga'l, kodumaikkaararaagiya koottaththaar en piraa'nanai vaanggath theadugi'raarga'l, ummaith thangga'lukku munbaaga ni'ruththi noakkaathirukki'raarga'l.
aanaalum aa'ndavarea, neer manavurukkamum, irakkamum, neediya po'rumaiyum, poora'na kirubaiyum, saththiyamumu'l'la theavan.
enmeal noakkamaagi, enakku iranggum; umathu vallamaiyai umathu adiyaanukku aru'li, umathu adiyaa'lin kumaaranai iradchiyum.
karththaavea, neer enakkuth thu'naiseythu ennaith theat'rugi'rathai en pagaignar ka'ndu vedkappadumpadikku, enakku anugoolamaaga oru adaiyaa'laththaik kaa'nbiththaru'lum.
avar asthibaaram parisuththa parvathangga'lil irukki'rathu.
karththar yaakkoabin vaasasthalangga'lellaavat'raippaarkkilum seeyoanin vaasalga'lil piriyamaayirukki'raar.
theavanudaiya nagaramea! unnaik ku'riththu magimaiyaana viseashangga'l vasanikkappadum. (sealaa.)
ennai a'rinthavarga'lukku'l'lea raahaabaiyum baabiloanaiyum ku'riththup peasuvean; ithoa, pelisthiyarilum, theeriyarilum, eththiyoappiyarilungkooda, innaan anggea pi'ranthaan en'rum;
seeyoanaikku'riththu, innaan innaan athilea pi'ranthaanen'rum sollappadum; unnathamaanavarthaamea athai sthirappaduththuvaar.
karththar janangga'laip pearezhuthumpoathu, innaan athilea pi'ranthaan en'ru avarga'laith thogaiyiduvaar. (sealaa.)
engga'l oot'ruga'lellaam unnil irukki'rathu en'ru paaduvaarum aaduvaarum eagamaaych solluvaarga'l.
en iradchippin theavanaagiya karththaavea, iravum pagalum ummai noakkik kooppidugi'rean.
en vi'n'nappam umathu samugaththil varuvathaaga; en kooppiduthalukku umathu seviyaich saayththaru'lum.
en aaththumaa thukkaththaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; en jeevan paathaa'laththi'rkuch sameebamaay vanthirukki'rathu.
naan kuzhiyil i'ranggugi'ravarga'loadu e'n'nappattu, belanat'ra manushanaippoalaanean.
mariththavarga'lil oruvanaippoal negizhappattirukki'rean; neer ini orupoathum ninaiyaathapadi, umathu kaiyaal a'ruppu'ndupoayp pireathakkuzhiga'lilea kidakki'ravarga'laippoalaanean.
ennaip paathaa'lakkuzhiyilum iru'lilum aazhangga'lilum vaiththeer.
ummudaiya koabam ennai iruththugi'rathu; ummudaiya alaiga'l ellaavat'rinaalum ennai varuththappaduththugi'reer. (sealaa.)
enakku a'rimugamaanavarga'lai enakkuth thooramaaga vilakki, avarga'lukku ennai aruvaruppaakkineer; naan ve'liyea pu'rappadakkoodaathapadi adaipattirukki'rean.
thukkaththinaal en ka'n thoynthupoayit'ru; karththaavea, anuthinamum naan ummai noakkik kooppittu, umakku nearaaga en kaiga'lai virikki'rean.
mariththavarga'lukku athisayangga'laich seyveeroa? seththuppoana veerar ezhunthu ummaith thuthippaarga'loa? (sealaa.)
pireathakkuzhiyil umathu kirubaiyum, azhivil umathu u'nmaiyum vivarikkappadumoa?
iru'lil umathu athisayangga'lum, ma'rathiyin boomiyil umathu neethiyum a'riyappadumoa?
naanoa karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppidugi'rean; kaalaiyilea en vi'n'nappam umakku munbaaga varum.
karththaavea, ean en aaththumaavaith tha'l'lividugi'reer? ean umathu mugaththai enakku ma'raikki'reer?
si'ruvayathumuthal naan si'rumaippattavanum maa'ndupoagi'ravanumaayirukki'rean; ummaal varum thigilga'l enmeal sumanthirukki'rathu, naan manangkalanggugi'rean.
ummudaiya erichchalga'l enmeal pura'ndupoagi'rathu; ummudaiya bayanggarangga'l ennai athampa'n'nugi'rathu.
avaiga'l naadoa'rum tha'n'neeraippoal ennaich soozhnthu, eagamaay ennai va'lainthuko'l'lugi'rathu.
sineagithanaiyum thoazhanaiyum enakkuth thooramaaga vilakkineer; enakku a'rimugamaanavarga'l ma'rainthupoanaarga'l.
karththarin kirubaiga'lai en'ren'raikkum paaduvean; umathu u'nmaiyaith thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga en vaayinaal a'rivippean.
kirubai en'ren'raikkum sthirappattirukkum; umathu u'nmaiyai vaanangga'lilea sthaabippeer en'rean.
ennaal therinthuko'l'lappattavanoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni, en thaasanaagiya thaaveethai noakki:
en'ren'raikkum un santhathiyai nilaippaduththi, thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga un singgaasanaththai sthaabippean en'ru aa'naiyittean en'reer. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, vaanangga'l ummudaiya athisayangga'laith thuthikkum, parisuththavaanga'lin sabaiyilea ummudaiya u'nmaiyum vi'langgum.
aagaayama'ndalaththil karththarukku nigaraanavar yaar? balavaanga'lin puththiraril karththarukku oppaanavar yaar?
theavan parisuththavaanga'ludaiya aaloasanaich sabaiyil migavum bayappadaththakkavar, thammaich soozhnthirukki'ra anaivaraalum agnchappadaththakkavar.
seanaiga'lin theavanaagiya karththaavea, ummaippoal vallamaiyu'l'la karththar yaar? ummudaiya u'nmai ummaich soozhnthirukki'rathu.
theavareer samuththiraththin perumaiyai aa'lugi'ravar; athin alaiga'l ezhumbumpoathu avaiga'lai adanggappa'n'nugi'reer.
neer raahaabai vettu'nda oruvanaippoal no'rukkineer; umathu vallamaiyaana puyaththinaal ummudaiya saththurukka'laich sitha'radiththeer.
vaanangga'l ummudaiyathu, boomiyum ummudaiyathu, booloagaththaiyum athilu'l'la yaavaiyum neerea asthibaarappaduththineer.
vadakkaiyum the'rkaiyum neer u'ndaakkineer; thaaboarum ermoanum ummudaiya naamam vi'langgak kembeerikkum.
umakku vallamaiyu'l'la puyamirukki'rathu; ummudaiya karam baraakkiramamu'l'lathu; ummudaiya valathukaram unnathamaanathu.
neethiyum niyaayamum ummudaiya singgaasanaththin aathaaram; kirubaiyum saththiyamum umakku munbaaga nadakkum.
kembeerasaththaththai a'riyum janangga'l baakkiyamu'l'lavarga'l; karththaavea, avarga'l ummudaiya mugaththin ve'lichchaththil nadappaarga'l.
avarga'l ummudaiya naamaththil naadoa'rum ka'likoornthu, ummudaiya neethiyaal uyarnthiruppaarga'l.
neerea avarga'l balaththin magimaiyaayirukki'reer; ummudaiya thayavinaal engga'l kombu uyarum.
karththaraal engga'l keadagamum, isravealin parisuththaraal engga'ludaiya raajaavum u'ndu.
appozhuthu neer ummudaiya bakthanukkuth tharisanamaagi: sagaayagnseyyaththakka sakthiyai oru savuriyavaanmeal vaiththu, janaththil therinthuko'l'lappattavanai uyarththinean.
en thaasanaagiya thaaveethaik ka'ndupidiththean; en parisuththa thailaththinaal avanai abisheagampa'n'ninean.
en kai avanoadea u'ruthiyaayirukkum; en puyam avanaip balappaduththum.
saththuru avanai nerukkuvathillai; niyaayakkeattin magan avanai odukkuvathillai.
avan saththurukka'lai avanukkumunbaaga madanggadiththu, avanaip pagaikki'ravarga'lai vettuvean.
en u'nmaiyum en kirubaiyum avanoadirukkum; en naamaththinaal avan kombu uyarum.
avan kaiyaich samuththiraththinmealum, avan valathukaraththai aa'ruga'lmealum aa'lumpadi vaippean.
avan ennai noakki: neer en pithaa, en theavan, en iradchippin kanmalaiyen'ru solluvaan.
naan avanai enakku mutha'rpea'raanavanum, boomiyin raajaakka'laippaarkkilum mahaa uyarnthavanumaakkuvean.
en kirubaiyai en'ren'raikkum avanukkaagak kaappean; en udanpadikkai avanukkaaga u'ruthippaduththappadum.
avan santhathi en'ren'raikkum nilaiththirukkavum, avan raajaasanam vaanangga'lu'l'lamattum nilaini'rkavum seyvean.
avan pi'l'laiga'l en niyaayangga'linpadi nadavaamal, en veathaththai vittu vilagi;
en katta'laiga'laik kaikko'l'laamal, en niyamangga'lai mee'rinadanthaal;
avarga'l mee'ruthalai milaat'rinaalum, avarga'l akkiramaththai vaathaiga'linaalum tha'ndippean.
aanaalum en kirubaiyai avanai vittu vilakkaamalum, en u'nmaiyil pisagaamalum iruppean.
en udanpadikkaiyai mee'raamalum, en uthaduga'l vi'lambinathai maat'raamalum iruppean.
oruvisai en parisuththaththinpearil aa'naiyittean, thaaveethukku naan poysollean.
avan santhathi en'ren'raikkum irukkum; avan singgaasanam sooriyanaippoala enakku munbaaga nilaini'rkum.
santhiranaippoala athu en'ren'raikkum u'ruthiyaayum, aagaayama'ndalaththuch saadchiyaippoal u'nmaiyaayum irukkum en'ru vi'lambineer. (sealaa.)
aanaalum neer engga'lai ve'ruththuth tha'l'livitteer, neer abisheagampa'n'nuviththavanmeal ukkiramaaneer.
umathu adiyaanudan neer pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyai ozhiththuvittu, avan kireedaththaith tharaiyilea tha'l'li avamaanappaduththineer.
avan mathilga'laiyellaam thagarththuppoattu, avan ara'naana sthalangga'laip paazhaakkineer.
vazhinadakki'ra yaavarum avanaik ko'l'laiyidugi'raarga'l; than ayalaarukku ninthaiyaanaan.
avan saththurukka'lin valathukaiyai neer uyarththi, avan viroathiga'l yaavarum santhoashikkumpadi seytheer.
avan pattayaththin karukkai mazhukkippoattu, avanai yuththaththil ni'rkaathapadi seytheer.
avan magimaiyai at'ruppoagappa'n'ni, avan singgaasanaththaith tharaiyilea tha'l'lineer.
avan vaalibanaadka'laik ku'rukki, avanai vedkaththaal moodineer. (sealaa.)
ethuvaraikkum, karththaavea! neer en'raikkum ma'rainthiruppeeroa? umathu koabam akkiniyaippoala eriyumoa?
en jeevan evva'lavu nilaiyat'rathu enbathai ninaiththaru'lum; manupuththirar yaavaraiyum vee'naagach sirushdikka vea'ndiyathenna?
mara'naththaik kaa'naamal uyiroadiruppavan yaar? than aaththumaavaip paathaa'la valladikku vilakkividugi'ravan yaar? (sealaa.)
aa'ndavarea, neer thaaveethukku ummudaiya u'nmaiyaikko'ndu saththiyampa'n'nina umathu poorva kirubaiga'l enggea?
aa'ndavarea, ummudaiya saththurukka'l ummudaiya oozhiyakkaararaiyum, neer abisheagampa'n'ninavanin kaaladiga'laiyum ninthikki'rapadiyinaal,
karththaavea, umathu adiyaar sumakkum ninthaiyaiyum, valumaiyaana janangga'lellaaraalum naan en madiyil sumakkum en ninthaiyaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
karththarukku en'ren'raikkum sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaga. aamen, aamen.
aa'ndavarea, theavareer thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga engga'lukku adaikkalamaanavar.
parvathangga'l thoan'rumunnum, neer boomiyaiyum ulagaththaiyum uruvaakkumunnum, neerea anaathiyaay en'ren'raikkum theavanaayirukki'reer.
neer manusharai nirththoo'liyaakki, manupuththirarea, thirumbungga'l engi'reer.
umathu paarvaikku aayiram varusham neat'rukkazhintha naa'lpoalavum iraachsaamampoalavum irukki'rathu.
avarga'lai ve'l'lampoal vaarikko'ndupoagi'reer; niththiraikku oththirukki'raarga'l; kaalaiyilea mu'laikki'ra pullukku oppaayirukki'raarga'l.
athu kaalaiyilea mu'laiththup pooththu, maalaiyilea a'ruppu'ndu ularnthupoam.
naangga'l umathu koabaththinaal azhinthu, umathu ukkiraththinaal kalanggippoagi'roam.
engga'l akkiramangga'lai umakku munbaagavum, engga'l antharangga paavangga'lai umathu mugaththin ve'lichchaththilum ni'ruththineer.
engga'l naadka'lellaam umathu koabaththaal poayvittathu; oru kathaiyaippoal engga'l varushangga'laik kazhiththuppoattoam.

engga'l aayusunaadka'l ezhubathu varusham, belaththin miguthiyaal e'nbathu varushamaayirunthaalum, athin meanmaiyaanathu varuththamum sagnchalamumea; athu seekkiramaayk kadanthupoagi'rathu, naangga'lum pa'ranthupoagi'roam.
umathu koabaththin vallamaiyaiyum, umakkup bayappadaththakkavithamaay umathu ukkiraththaiyum a'rinthuko'l'lugi'ravan yaar?
naangga'l gnaana iruthayamu'l'lavarga'laagumpadi, engga'l naadka'lai e'n'num a'rivai engga'lukkup poathiththaru'lum.
karththaavea, thirumbivaarum, ethuvaraikkum koabamaayiruppeer? umathu adiyaarukkaagap parithabiyum.
naangga'l engga'l vaazhnaa'lellaam ka'likoornthu magizhumpadi, kaalaiyilea engga'lai umathu kirubaiyaal thirupthiyaakkum.
theavareer engga'laich si'rumaippaduththina naadka'lukkum, naangga'l thunbaththaik ka'nda varushangga'lukkum sariyaay engga'lai magizhchchiyaakkum.
umathu kiriyai umathu oozhiyakkaararukkum, umathu magimai avarga'l pi'l'laiga'lukkum vi'langguvathaaga.

engga'l theavanaagiya aa'ndavarin piriyam engga'lmeal iruppathaaga; engga'l kaiga'lin kiriyaiyai engga'lidaththil u'ruthippaduththum; aam, engga'l kaiga'lin kiriyaiyai engga'lidaththil u'ruthippaduththiyaru'lum.
unnathamaanavarin ma'raivilirukki'ravan sarvavallavarudaiya nizhalil thangguvaan.
naan karththarai noakki: neer en adaikkalam, en koattai, en theavan, naan nambiyirukki'ravar en'ru solluvean.
avar unnai veadanudaiya ka'n'nikkum, paazhaakkum ko'l'lainoaykkum thappuvippaar.
avar thamathu si'raguga'laalea unnai mooduvaar; avar settaiga'lin keezhea adaikkalam puguvaay; avarudaiya saththiyam unakkup parisaiyum keadagamumaagum.
iravil u'ndaagum bayanggaraththukkum, pagalil pa'rakkum ambukkum,
iru'lil nadamaadum ko'l'lainoaykkum, maththiyaanaththil paazhaakkum sanggaaraththukkum bayappadaathiruppaay.
un pakkaththil aayirampearum, un valathupu'raththil pathinaayirampearum vizhunthaalum, athu unnai a'nugaathu.
un ka'nga'laal maaththiram nee athaip paarththu, thunmaarkkarukku varum palanaik kaa'nbaay.
enakku adaikkalamaayirukki'ra unnathamaana karththarai unakkuth thaabaramaagakko'ndaay.
aagaiyaal pollaappu unakku nearidaathu, vaathai un koodaaraththai a'nugaathu.
un vazhiga'lilellaam unnaik kaakkumpadi, unakkaagath thammudaiya thootharga'lukkuk katta'laiyiduvaar.
un paatham kallil ida'raathapadikku avarga'l unnaith thangga'l kaiga'lil eanthikko'ndupoavaarga'l.
singgaththinmealum viriyan paambinmealum nee nadanthu, baalasinggaththaiyum valusarppaththaiyum mithiththuppoaduvaay.
avan ennidaththil vaagnchaiyaayirukki'rapadiyaal avanai viduvippean; en naamaththai avan a'rinthirukki'rapadiyaal avanai uyarntha adaikkalaththilea vaippean.
avan ennai noakkik kooppiduvaan, naan avanukku ma'ruuththaravu aru'lichseyvean; aabaththil naanea avanoadirunthu, avanaith thappuviththu, avanaik kanappaduththuvean.
neediththa naadka'laal avanaith thirupthiyaakki, en iradchippai avanukkuk kaa'nbippean.
karththaraith thuthippathum, unnathamaanavarea, umathu naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nuvathum,
paththunarambu vee'naiyinaalum, thamburuvinaalum, thiyaanaththoadu vaasikkum surama'ndalaththinaalum,
kaalaiyilea umathu kirubaiyaiyum, iravilea umathu saththiyaththaiyum a'rivippathum nalamaayirukkum.
karththaavea, umathu seygaiga'laal ennai magizhchchiyaakkineer, umathu karaththin kiriyaiga'linimiththam aananthasaththamiduvean.
karththaavea, umathu kiriyaiga'l evva'lavu magaththuvamaanavaiga'l! umathu yoasanaiga'l mahaa aazhamaanavaiga'l.
mirugaku'namu'l'la manushan athai a'riyaan; moodan athai u'naraan.
thunmaarkkar pullaippoalea thazhaiththu, akkiramakkaarar yaavarum sezhikkumpoathu, athu avarga'l en'ren'raikkum azhinthupoavatha'rkea eathuvaagum.
karththaavea, neer en'ren'raikkum unnathamaanavaraayirukki'reer.
karththaavea, umathu saththurukka'l azhivaarga'l; umathu saththurukka'l azhintheapoavaarga'l; sagala akkiramakkaararum sitha'ru'ndupoavaarga'l.
en kombaik kaa'ndaamirugaththin kombaippoala uyarththuveer; puthu e'n'neyaal abisheagampa'n'nappadugi'rean.
en saththurukka'lukku neariduvathai en ka'n kaa'num; enakku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'ra thunmaarkkarukku neariduvathai en kaathu keadkum.
neethimaan panaiyaippoal sezhiththu, leebanoanilu'l'la keathuruvaippoal va'laruvaan.
karththarudaiya aalayaththilea naattappattavarga'l engga'l theavanudaiya piraagaarangga'lil sezhiththiruppaarga'l.
karththar uththamaren'rum, en kanmalaiyaagiya avaridaththil aneethiyillaiyen'rum, vi'langgappa'n'numpadi,
avarga'l muthirvayathilum kani thanthu, pushdiyum pasumaiyumaayiruppaarga'l.

karththar raajarigampa'n'nugi'raar, magaththuvaththai a'ninthuko'ndirukki'raar; karththar baraakkiramaththai a'ninthu, avar athaik kachchaiyaagak kattikko'ndirukki'raar; aathalaal poochchakkaram asaiyaathapadi nilaipet'rirukki'rathu.
umathu singgaasanam poorvamuthal u'ruthiyaanathu; neer anaathiyaayirukki'reer.
karththaavea, nathiga'l ezhumbina; nathiga'l iraichchalittu ezhumbina; nathiga'l alaithira'ndu ezhumbina.
thira'laana tha'n'neerga'lin iraichchalaippaarkkilum, samuththiraththin valumaiyaana alaiga'laippaarkkilum, karththar unnathaththilea vallamaiyu'l'lavar.
umathu saadchiga'l migavum u'nmaiyu'l'lavaiga'l; karththaavea, parisuththamaanathu niththiyanaa'laaga umathu aalayaththin alanggaaramaayirukki'rathu.
neethiyaich sarikkattugi'ra theavanaagiya karththaavea, neethiyaich sarikkattugi'ra theavanea, piragaasiyum.
boomiyin niyaayaathibathiyea, neer ezhunthu, perumaikkaararukkup bathila'liyum.
karththaavea, thunmaarkkar ethuvaraikkum magizhnthu, thunmaarkkar ethuvaraikkum ka'likoornthiruppaarga'l?
ethuvaraikkum akkiramakkaarar yaavarum vaayaadi, kadinamaayp peasi, perumaipaaraattuvaarga'l?
karththaavea, avarga'l umathu janaththai no'rukki, umathu suthantharaththai odukkugi'raarga'l.
vithavaiyaiyum paratheasiyaiyum kon'ru, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiga'laik kolaiseythu:
karththar paaraar, yaakkoabin theavan kavaniyaar en'ru sollugi'raarga'l.
janaththil mirugaku'namu'l'lavarga'lea, u'narvadaiyungga'l; moodarea, eppozhuthu buththimaanga'laaveerga'l?
kaathai u'ndaakkinavar kea'laaroa? ka'n'nai uruvaakkinavar kaa'naaroa?
jaathiga'lai tha'ndikki'ravar kadinthuko'l'laaroa? manushanukku a'rivaip poathikki'ravar a'riyaaroa?
manushanudaiya yoasanaiga'l vee'nen'ru karththar a'rinthirukki'raar.
karththaavea, thunmaarkkanukkuk kuzhivettappadumvaraikkum, neer theenggunaadka'lil amarnthirukkappa'n'ni,
sidchiththu, ummudaiya veathaththaikko'ndu poathikki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan.
karththar thammudaiya janaththai negizhavidaamalum, thammudaiya suthantharaththaik kaividaamalum iruppaar.
niyaayam neethiyinidamaagath thirumbum; semmaiyaana iruthayaththaar yaavarum athaip pinpat'ruvaarga'l.
thunmaarkkarukku viroathamaay en padchaththil ezhumbugi'ravan yaar? akkiramakkaararukku viroathamaay en padchaththil ni'rpavan yaar?
karththar enakkuth thu'naiyaayiraavittaal, en aaththumaa seekkiramaay mavunaththil vaasampa'n'niyirukkum.
en kaal sa'rukkugi'rathu en'ru naan sollumpoathu, karththaavea, umathu kirubai ennaith thaanggugi'rathu.
en u'l'laththil visaarangga'l perugugaiyil, ummudaiya aa'ruthalga'l en aaththumaavaith theat'rugi'rathu.
theemaiyaik katta'laiyinaal pi'rappikki'ra kodungkoalaasanam umakku isainthirukkumoa?
avarga'l neethimaanudaiya aaththumaavukku viroathamaayk koottangkoodi, kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaik kut'rappaduththugi'raarga'l.
karththaroa enakku adaikkalamum, en theavan naan nambiyirukki'ra kanmalaiyumaayirukki'raar.
avarga'ludaiya akkiramaththai avarga'lmeal thiruppi, avarga'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam avarga'laich sanggarippaar; nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththarea avarga'laich sanggarippaar.
karththaraik kembeeramaayp paadi, nammudaiya iradcha'niyak kanmalaiyaich sanggeerththanam pa'n'nakkadavoam vaarungga'l.
thuthiththaludanea avar sannithikku munbaaga vanthu, sanggeethangga'laal avarai aarppariththup paadakkadavoam.
karththarea mahaa theavanum, ellaa theavarga'lukkum mahaaraajanumaayirukki'raar.
boomiyin aazhangga'l avar kaiyil irukki'rathu; parvathangga'lin uyarangga'lum avarudaiyavaiga'l.
samuththiram avarudaiyathu, avarea athai u'ndaakkinaar; vettaantharaiyaiyum avarudaiya karam uruvaakkit'ru.
nammai u'ndaakkina karththarukku munbaaga naam pa'ninthu kuninthu muzhanggaa'rpadiyidakkadavoam vaarungga'l.
avar nammudaiya theavan; naam avar meaychchalin janangga'lum, avar kaikku'l'laana aaduga'lumaamea.
in'ru avarudaiya saththaththaik keadpeerga'laagil, vanaantharaththil koabam moottinapoathum soathanainaa'lilum nadanthathupoala, ungga'l iruthayaththaik kadinappaduththaatheayungga'l.
anggea ungga'l pithaakka'l ennaich soathiththu, ennaip pareedchaipaarththu, en kiriyaiyaiyum ka'ndaarga'l.
naa'rpathu varushamaay naan anthach santhathiyai aroasiththu, avarga'l vazhuvippoagi'ra iruthayamu'l'la janamen'rum, ennudaiya vazhiga'lai a'riyaathavarga'len'rum solli,
ennudaiya i'laippaa'ruthalil avarga'l piraveasippathillaiyen'ru, ennudaiya koabaththilea aa'naiyittean.
karththarukkup puthuppaattaip paadungga'l; boomiyin kudiga'lea, ellaarum karththaraip paadungga'l.
karththaraip paadi, avarudaiya naamaththai sthoaththiriththu, naa'lukkunaa'l avarudaiya iradchippaich suviseashamaay a'riviyungga'l.
jaathiga'lukku'l avarudaiya magimaiyaiyum, sagala janangga'lukku'l'lum avarudaiya athisayangga'laiyum vivariththuch sollungga'l.
karththar periyavarum, migavum sthoaththirikkappadaththakkavarumaayirukki'raar; ellaa theavarga'lilum bayappadaththakkavar avarea.
sagala janangga'ludaiya theavarga'lum vikkiragangga'lthaanea; karththaroa vaanangga'lai u'ndaakkinavar.
magimaiyum kanamum avar samugaththil irukki'rathu, vallamaiyum magaththuvamum avar parisuththa sthalaththilu'l'lathu.
janangga'lin vamsangga'lea, karththarukku magimaiyaiyum vallamaiyaiyum seluththungga'l, karththarukkea athaich seluththungga'l.
karththarukku avarudaiya naamaththi'rkuriya magimaiyaich seluththi, kaa'nikkaiga'laik ko'nduvanthu, avarudaiya piraagaarangga'lil piraveasiyungga'l.
parisuththa alanggaaraththudanea karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'lungga'l; booloagaththaarea, neengga'l yaavarum avarukku munbaaga nadunggungga'l.
karththar raajarigampa'n'nugi'raar, aagaiyaal poochchakkaram asaiyaathapadi u'ruthippattirukkum; avar janangga'lai nithaanamaay niyaayantheerppaar en'ru jaathiga'lukku'l'lea sollungga'l.
vaanangga'l magizhnthu, boomi poorippaagi, samuththiramum athin ni'raivum muzhangguvathaaga.
naadum athilu'l'la yaavum ka'likooruvathaaga; appozhuthu karththarukku munbaaga kaattuvirudchangga'lellaam kembeerikkum.
avar varugi'raar, avar boomiyai niyaayantheerkka varugi'raar; avar booloagaththai neethiyoadum, janangga'laich saththiyaththoadum niyaayantheerppaar.
karththar raajarigampa'n'nugi'raar; boomi poorippaagi, thira'laana theevuga'l magizhakkadavathu.
meagamum manthaaramum avaraich soozhnthirukki'rathu; neethiyum niyaayamum avarudaiya singgaasanaththin aathaaram.
akkini avarukku munsen'ru, sut'rilum irukki'ra avarudaiya saththurukka'laich sutterikki'rathu.
avarudaiya minnalga'l poochchakkaraththaip piragaasippiththathu; boomi athaik ka'ndu athirnthathu.
karththarin pirasannaththinaal parvathangga'l mezhugupoala urugit'ru, sarva boomiyinudaiya aa'ndavarin pirasannaththinaaleayea urugippoayit'ru.
vaanangga'l avarudaiya neethiyai ve'lippaduththugi'rathu; sagala janangga'lum avarudaiya magimaiyaik kaa'ngi'raarga'l.
soroobangga'lai va'nanggi, vikkiragangga'laippat'rip perumaipaaraattugi'ra yaavarum vedkappattup poavaarga'laaga; theavarga'lea, neengga'lellaarum avaraith thozhuthuko'l'lungga'l.
seeyoan keattu magizhnthathu; karththaavea, ummudaiya niyaayaththeerppuga'linimiththam yoothaavin kumaaraththiga'l ka'likoornthaarga'l.
karththaavea, boomi muzhuvathukkum neer unnathamaanavar; ellaa theavarga'lilum neerea migavum uyarnthavar.
karththaril anbukoorugi'ravarga'lea, theemaiyai ve'ruththuvidungga'l; avar thammudaiya parisuththavaanga'lin aaththumaakka'laik kaappaat'ri, thunmaarkkarin kaikku avarga'laith thappuvikki'raar.
neethimaanukkaaga ve'lichchamum, semmaiyaana iruthayaththaarukkaaga magizhchchiyum vithaikkappattirukki'rathu.
neethimaanga'lea, karththarukku'l magizhnthu, avarudaiya parisuththaththin ninaivukooruthalaik ko'ndaadungga'l.
karththarukkup puthuppaattaip paadungga'l; avar athisayangga'laich seythirukki'raar; avarudaiya valathukaramum, avarudaiya parisuththa puyamum, iradchippai u'ndaakkinathu.
karththar thamathu iradchippaip pirasthaabamaakki, thamathu neethiyai jaathiga'ludaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaaga vi'langgappa'n'ninaar.
avar israveal kudumbaththukkaagath thamathu kirubaiyaiyum u'nmaiyaiyum ninaivukoornthaar; boomiyin ellaiga'lellaam namathu theavanudaiya iradchippaik ka'ndathu.
boomiyin kudiga'lea, neengga'lellaarum karththarai noakki aananthamaay aarppariyungga'l; muzhakkamittuk kembeeramaayp paadungga'l.
surama'ndalaththaal karththaraik keerththanampa'n'nungga'l, surama'ndalaththaalum keethasaththaththaalum avaraik keerththanampa'n'nungga'l.
karththaraagiya raajaavin samugaththil poorigaiga'laalum ekkaa'la saththaththaalum aananthamaay aarppariyungga'l.
samuththiramum athin ni'raivum, poochchakkaramum athin kudiga'lum muzhangguvathaaga.
karththarukku munbaaga aa'ruga'l kaikotti, parvathangga'l eagamaayk kembeeriththup paadakkadavathu.
avar boomiyai niyaayantheerkka varugi'raar; booloagaththai neethiyoadum janangga'lai nithaanaththoadum niyaayantheerppaar.
karththar raajarigampa'n'nugi'raar, janangga'l thaththa'lippaarga'laaga; avar kearubeenga'lin maththiyil veet'rirukki'raar, boomi asaivathaaga.
karththar seeyoanil periyavar, avar ellaa janangga'lmealum uyarnthavar.
magaththuvamum bayanggaramumaana umathu naamaththai avarga'l thuthippaarga'laaga; athu parisuththamu'l'lathu.
raajaavin vallamai neethiyil piriyappadugi'rathu, theavareer niyaayaththai nilaini'ruththugi'reer; neer yaakkoabil niyaayamum neethiyum seygi'reer.
nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththarai uyarththi, avar paathapadiyilea pa'niyungga'l; avar parisuththamu'l'lavar.
avarudaiya aasaariyaril moaseayum aaroanum, avar naamaththaippat'rik kooppidugi'ravarga'lil saamuvealum, karththarai noakkik kooppittaarga'l; avar avarga'lukku ma'ruuththaravu aru'linaar.
meagasthambaththilirunthu avarga'loadea peasinaar; avarga'l avarudaiya saadchippiramaa'nangga'laiyum avar thangga'lukkuk koduththa katta'laiyaiyum kaikko'ndaarga'l.
engga'l theavanaagiya karththaavea, neer avarga'lukku uththaravu aru'lineer; neer avarga'l kiriyaiga'linimiththam neethi sarikkattinapoathilum, avarga'lukku mannikki'ra theavanaayiruntheer.
nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththarai uyarththi, avarudaiya parisuththa parvathaththi'rku nearaagap pa'niyungga'l; nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththar parisuththamu'l'lavar.
boomiyin kudiga'lea, ellaarum karththaraik kembeeramaayp paadungga'l.
magizhchchiyoadea karththarukku aaraathanaiseythu, aananthasaththaththoadea avar sannithimun vaarungga'l.
karththarea theavanen'ru a'riyungga'l; naam alla, avarea nammai u'ndaakkinaar; naam avar janangga'lum, avar meaychchalin aaduga'lumaayirukki'roam.
avar vaasalga'lil thuthiyoadum, avar piraagaarangga'lil pugazhchchiyoadum piraveasiththu, avaraith thuthiththu, avarudaiya naamaththai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
karththar nallavar, avarudaiya kirubai en'ren'raikkum, avarudaiya u'nmai thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raikkum u'l'lathu.
irakkaththaiyum niyaayaththaiyum ku'riththup paaduvean; karththaavea, ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
uththamamaana vazhiyilea viveagamaay nadappean; eppozhuthu ennidaththil varuveer! en veettilea uththama iruthayaththoadu nadanthuko'l'luvean.
theenggaana kaariyaththai en ka'nmun vaikkamaattean; vazhi vilagugi'ravarga'lin seygaiyai ve'rukki'rean; athu ennaip pat'raathu.
maa'rupaadaana iruthayam ennaivittu agalavea'ndum; pollaathavanai a'riyamaattean.
pi'ranai iragasiyamaay avathoo'rupa'n'nugi'ravanaich sanggarippean; meattimaik ka'n'nanaiyum perunegnchu'l'lavanaiyum po'rukkamaattean.
theasaththil u'nmaiyaanavarga'l ennoadea vaasampa'n'numpadi en ka'nga'l avarga'lmeal noakkamaayirukkum; uththamamaana vazhiyil nadakki'ravan ennaich seavippaan.
kabaduseygi'ravan en veettukku'l iruppathillai; poysollugi'ravan en ka'nmun nilaippathillai.
akkiramakkaarar oruvarum karththarudaiya nagaraththil iraathapadi vear a'ruppu'ndupoaga, theasaththilu'l'la akkiramakkaarar yaavaraiyum athikaalamea sanggarippean.
karththaavea, en vi'n'nappaththaik kea'lum; en kooppiduthal ummidaththil searvathaaga.
en aabaththunaa'lilea umathu mugaththai enakku ma'raiyaatheayum; umathu seviyai ennidaththil saayum; naan kooppidugi'ra naa'lilea enakkuth theeviramaay uththaravu aru'lichseyyum.
en naadka'l pugaiyaippoal ozhinthathu; en elumbuga'l oru ko'l'liyaippoal eriyu'ndathu.
en iruthayam pullaippoal vettu'ndu ularnthathu; en poajanaththaip pusikka ma'ranthean.
en perumoochchin saththaththinaal, en elumbuga'l en maamsaththoadu ottikko'l'lugi'rathu.
vanaanthara naaraikku oppaanean; paazhaana idangga'lil thanggum aanthaiyaippoalaanean.
naan niththiraiyillaamal veettinmeal thaniththirukkum kuruviyaippoal irukki'rean.
naadoa'rum en saththurukka'l ennai ninthikki'raarga'l; enmeal moorkkave'riko'ndavarga'l enakku viroathamaaych saabam idugi'raarga'l.
neer ennai uyarath thookki, thaazhaththa'l'lineer, umathu sinaththi'rkum kadungkoabaththi'rkum u'l'laanean.
aathalaal naan saambalai appamaagap pusiththu, en baanangga'laik ka'n'neeroadea kalakki'rean.
en naadka'l saaynthupoagi'ra nizhalaippoalirukki'rathu; pullaippoal ularnthupoagi'rean.
karththaraagiya neeroa en'ren'raikkum irukki'reer; ummudaiya pear pirasthaabam thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga ni'rkum.
theavareer ezhuntharu'li seeyoanukku irangguveer; atha'rkuth thayaiseyyungkaalamum, atha'rkaagak ku'riththanearamum vanthathu.
ummudaiya oozhiyakkaarar athin kalluga'lmeal vaagnchaivaiththu, athin ma'n'nukkup parithabikki'raarga'l.
karththar seeyoanaik katti, thamathu magimaiyil ve'lippaduvaar.
thikkat'ravarga'ludaiya jebaththai aladchiyampa'n'naamal, avarga'l vi'n'nappaththai anggeegarippaar.
appozhuthu jaathiga'l karththarudaiya naamaththukkum, boomiyilu'l'la raajaakka'lellaarum ummudaiya magimaikkum bayappaduvaarga'l.
pinsanthathikkaaga ithu ezhuthappadum; sirushdikkappadum janam karththaraith thuthikkum.
karththar kattu'ndavarga'lin perumoochchaik keadkavum, kolaikku niyamikkappattavarga'lai viduthalaiyaakkavum,
thammudaiya uyarntha parisuththa sthalaththilirunthu paarththu, vaanangga'lilirunthu boomiyinmeal ka'n'noakkamaanaar.
karththarukku aaraathanaiseyya, janangga'lum raajyangga'lum eagamaayk koodikko'l'lugaiyil,
seeyoanil karththarudaiya naamaththaiyum, erusaleamil avarudaiya thuthiyaiyum pirasthaabappaduththuvaarga'l.
vazhiyilea en belanai avar odukki, en naadka'laik ku'rugappa'n'ninaar.
appozhuthu naan: en theavanea, paathi vayathil ennai eduththukko'l'laatheayum; ummudaiya varushangga'l thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga irukkum.
neer aathiyilea boomiyai asthibaarappaduththineer; vaanangga'l ummudaiya karaththin kiriyaiyaayirukki'rathu.
avaiga'l azhinthupoam, neeroa nilaiththiruppeer; avaiga'lellaam vasthirampoal pazhamaiyaayppoam; avaiga'lai oru saalvaiyaippoal maat'ruveer, appozhuthu maa'rippoam.
neeroa maa'raathavaraayirukki'reer; umathu aa'nduga'l mudinthupoavathillai.
umathu adiyaarin pi'l'laiga'l thaabariththiruppaarga'l; avarga'l santhathi umakku munbaaga nilaipet'rirukkum en'ru sonnean.
en aaththumaavea, karththarai sthoaththiri; en muzhu u'l'lamea, avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththai sthoaththiri.
en aaththumaavea, karththarai sthoaththiri; avar seytha sagala ubagaarangga'laiyum ma'ravaathea.
avar un akkiramangga'laiyellaam manniththu, un noayga'laiyellaam ku'namaakki,
un piraa'nanai azhivukku vilakki meettu, unnaik kirubaiyinaalum irakkangga'linaalum mudisootti,
nanmaiyinaal un vaayaith thirupthiyaakkugi'raar; kazhugukkuch samaanamaay un vayathu thirumba vaala vayathupoalaagi'rathu.
odukkappadugi'ra yaavarukkum, karththar neethiyaiyum niyaayaththaiyum seygi'raar.
avar thamathu vazhiga'lai moaseakkum, thamathu kiriyaiga'lai israveal puththirarukkum theriyappa'n'ninaar.
karththar urukkamum, irakkamum, neediya saanthamum, miguntha kirubaiyumu'l'lavar.
avar eppozhuthum kadinthuko'l'laar; en'raikkum koabangko'ndiraar.
avar nammudaiya paavangga'lukkuththakkathaaga namakkuch seyyaamalum, nammudaiya akkiramangga'lukkuth thakkathaaga namakkuch sarikkattaamalum irukki'raar.
boomikku vaanam evva'lavu uyaramaayirukki'rathoa, avarukkup bayappadugi'ravarga'lmeal avarudaiya kirubaiyum avva'lavu perithaayirukki'rathu.
mea'rkukkum kizhakkukkum evva'lavu thooramoa, avva'lavu thooramaay avar nammudaiya paavangga'lai nammai vittu vilakkinaar.
thagappan than pi'l'laiga'lukku iranggugi'rathupoala, karththar thamakkup bayanthavarga'lukku iranggugi'raar.
nammudaiya uruvam innathen'ru avar a'rivaar; naam ma'n'nen'ru ninaivukoorugi'raar.
manushanudaiya naadka'l pullukku oppaayirukki'rathu; ve'liyin pushpaththaippoal pookki'raan.
kaat'ru athinmeal veesinavudanea athu illaama'rpoayit'ru; athu iruntha idamum ini athai a'riyaathu.
karththarudaiya kirubaiyoa avarukkup bayanthavarga'lmealum, avarudaiya neethi avarga'l pi'l'laiga'ludaiya pi'l'laiga'lmealum anaathiyaay en'ren'raikkum u'l'lathu.
avarudaiya udanpadikkaiyaik kaikko'ndu, avarudaiya katta'laiga'linpadi seyya ninaikki'ravarga'l mealeayea u'l'lathu.
karththar vaanangga'lil thamathu singgaasanaththai sthaabiththirukki'raar; avarudaiya raajarigam sarvaththaiyum aa'lugi'rathu.
karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaikkeattu, avarudaiya vasanaththinpadi seygi'ra balaththa savuriyavaanga'laagiya avarudaiya thootharga'lea, avarai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
karththarukkup piriyamaanathaich seythu, avar pa'nividaikkaararaayirukki'ra avarudaiya sarvaseanaiga'lea, avarai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
karththar aa'lugi'ra evvidangga'lilumu'l'la avarudaiya sagala kiriyaiga'lea, avarai sthoaththiriyungga'l; en aaththumaavea, karththarai sthoaththiri.
en aaththumaavea, karththarai sthoaththiri; en theavanaagiya karththaavea, neer migavum periyavaraayirukki'reer; magimaiyaiyum magaththuvaththaiyum a'ninthuko'ndirukki'reer.
o'liyai vasthiramaagath thariththu, vaanangga'laith thiraiyaippoal viriththirukki'reer.
thamathu mealveeduga'laith tha'n'neerga'laal machchuppaavi, meagangga'laith thamathu irathamaakki, kaat'rinudaiya settaiga'linmeal sellugi'raar.
thammudaiya thootharga'laik kaat'ruga'laagavum, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararai akkinijuvaalaiga'laagavum seygi'raar.
boomi orupoathum nilaipearaathapadi athin aathaarangga'lmeal athai sthaabiththaar.
athai vasthiraththinaal mooduvathupoala aazhaththinaal moodineer; parvathangga'linmeal tha'n'neerga'l nin'rathu.
avaiga'l umathu ka'ndithaththaal vilagiyoadi, umathu kumu'ralin saththaththaal virainthupoayit'ru.
avaiga'l malaiga'lil ea'ri, pa'l'laththaakkuga'lil i'ranggi, neer avaiga'lukku ea'rpaduththina idaththil sen'rathu.
avaiga'l thirumbavum vanthu boomiyai moodikko'l'laathapadi kadavaathirukkum ellaiyai avaiga'lukku ea'rpaduththineer.
avar pa'l'laththaakkuga'lil neeroot'ruga'lai varavidugi'raar; avaiga'l malaiga'l naduvea oadugi'rathu.
avaiga'l ve'liyin jeevanga'lukkellaam tha'n'neer kodukkum; anggea kaattukkazhuthaiga'l thangga'l thaagaththaith theerththukko'l'lum.
avaiga'lin oaramaay aagaayaththup pa'ravaiga'l sagnchariththu, ki'laiga'lmealirunthu paadum.
thammudaiya mealveeduga'lilirunthu parvathangga'lukkuth tha'n'neer i'raikki'raar; umathu kiriyaiga'lin palanaalea boomi thirupthiyaayirukki'rathu.
boomiyilirunthu aagaaram u'ndaagumpadi, avar mirugangga'lukkup pullaiyum, manusharukku ubayoagamaana payirvagaiga'laiyum mu'laippikki'raar.

manushanudaiya iruthayaththai magizhchchiyaakkum thiraadcharasaththaiyum, avanukku mugakka'laiyai u'ndupa'n'num e'n'neyaiyum, manushanudaiya iruthayaththai aatharikkum aagaaraththaiyum vi'laivikki'raar.
karththarudaiya virudchangga'lum, avar naattina leebanoanin keathurukka'lum saaraththinaal ni'rainthirukkum.
anggea kuruviga'l koodukattum; theavathaaruvirudchangga'l kokkuga'lin kudiyiruppu.
uyarntha parvathangga'l varaiyaaduga'lukkum, kanmalaiga'l kuzhimusalga'lukkum adaikkalam.
santhiranaik kaalakku'rippuga'lukkaagap padaiththaar; sooriyan than asthamanaththai a'riyum.
neer iru'laik katta'laiyidugi'reer, iraakkaalamaagum; athilea sagala kaattu jeevanga'lum nadamaadum.
baalasinggangga'l iraikkaaga kerchchiththu, theavanaal thangga'lukku aagaaram kidaikkumpadith theadum.
sooriyan uthikkaiyil avaiga'l othunggi, thangga'l thaabarangga'lil paduththukko'l'lum.
appozhuthu manushan saayanggaalamattum than vealaikkum, than pa'n'naikkum pu'rappadugi'raan.
karththaavea, umathu kiriyaiga'l evva'lavu thira'laayirukki'rathu! avaiga'laiyellaam gnaanamaayp padaiththeer; boomi ummudaiya poru'lga'linaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
perithum visthaaramumaana inthach samuththiramum appadiyea ni'rainthirukki'rathu; athilea sagncharikkum si'riyavaiga'lum periyavaiga'lumaana e'n'ni'rantha jeevanga'l u'ndu.
athilea kappalga'l oadum; athilea vi'laiyaadumpadi neer u'ndaakkina thiminggilangga'lum u'ndu.
eat'ravea'laiyil aagaaraththaith tharuveer en'ru avaiga'lellaam ummai noakkik kaaththirukkum.
neer kodukka, avaiga'l vaanggikko'l'lum; neer ummudaiya kaiyaiththi'rakka, avaiga'l nanmaiyaal thirupthiyaagum.
neer umathu mugaththai ma'raikka, thigaikkum; neer avaiga'lin suvaasaththai vaanggikko'l'la, avaiga'l maa'ndu, thangga'l ma'n'nukkuth thirumbum.
neer ummudaiya aaviyai anuppumpoathu, avaiga'l sirushdikkappadum; neer boomiyin roobaththaiyum puthithaakkugi'reer.
karththarudaiya magimai en'ren'raikkum vi'langgum; karththar thammudaiya kiriyaiga'lilea magizhuvaar.
avar boomiyai noakkippaarkka, athu athirum; avar parvathangga'laith thoda, avaiga'l pugaiyum.
naan uyiroadirukkumattum en karththaraip paaduvean; naan u'l'la'lavum en theavanaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
naan avaraith thiyaanikkum thiyaanam inithaayirukkum; naan karththarukku'l magizhuvean.
paaviga'l boomiyilirunthu nirmoolamaagi, thunmaarkkar ini iraama'rpoavaarga'l. en aaththumaavea, karththarai sthoaththiri, allealooyaa.
karththaraith thuthiththu, avarudaiya naamaththaip pirasthaabamaakkungga'l, avarudaiya seygaiga'lai janangga'lukku'l'lea pirasiththappaduththungga'l.
avaraip paadi, avaraik keerththanampa'n'nungga'l; avarudaiya athisayangga'laiyellaam thiyaaniththup peasungga'l.
avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththaik ku'riththu meanmaipaaraattungga'l; karththaraith theadugi'ravarga'lin iruthayam magizhvathaaga.
karththaraiyum avar vallamaiyaiyum naadungga'l; avar samugaththai niththamum theadungga'l.
avarudaiya thaasanaagiya aabirahaamin santhathiyea! avaraal therinthuko'l'lappattavarga'laagiya yaakkoabin puththirarea!
avar seytha athisayangga'laiyum, avarudaiya a'rputhangga'laiyum, avar vaakkin niyaayaththeerppuga'laiyum ninaivukoorungga'l.
avarea nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththar, avarudaiya niyaayaththeerppuga'l boomiyenggum vi'langgum.
aayiranthalaimu'raikken'ru avar katta'laiyitta vaakkaiyum, aabirahaamoadea avar pa'n'nina udanpadikkaiyaiyum,
avar eesaakkukku itta aa'naiyaiyum en'ren'raikkum ninaiththirukki'raar.
athai yaakkoabukkup piramaa'namaagavum, isravealukku niththiya udanpadikkaiyaagavum u'ruthippaduththi:
ungga'l suthantharapaagamaana kaanaan theasaththai unakkuth tharuvean en'raar.
akkaalaththil avarga'l kognchath thogaikkudpatta so'rpa janangga'lum paratheasiga'lumaayirunthaarga'l.
avarga'l oru janaththaivittu ma'ru janaththa'ndaikkum, oru raajyaththaivittu ma'ru theasaththaara'ndaikkum poanaarga'l.
avarga'lai odukkumpadi oruvarukkum idangkodaamal, avarga'l nimiththam raajaakka'laik kadinthu ko'ndu:
naan abisheagampa'n'ninavarga'lai neengga'l thodaamalum, ennudaiya theerkkatharisiga'lukkuth theenggu seyyaamalum irungga'l en'raar.
avar theasaththilea pagnchaththai varuviththu, aagaaramennum aatharavukoalai mut'rilum mu'riththaar.
avarga'lukku munnaalea oru purushanai anuppinaar; yoaseappu si'raiyaaga vi'rkappattaan.
avan kaalga'lai vilanggupoattu odukkinaarga'l; avan piraa'nan irumbil adaipattirunthathu.
karththar sonna vaarththai ni'raivea'ruma'lavum avarudaiya vasanam avanaip pudamittathu.
raajaa aa'l anuppi, avanaik kattavizhkkachsonnaan; janangga'lin athibathi avanai viduthalaipa'n'ninaan.
than pirabukka'lai avan manathinpadi kattavum, than moopparga'lai gnaaniga'laakkavum,
avanaith than veettukku aa'ndavanum, than aasthikkellaam athibathiyumaakkinaan.
appozhuthu israveal egipthi'rku vanthaan; yaakkoabu kaamin theasaththilea paratheasiyaayirunthaan.
avar thammudaiya janangga'lai migavum palugappa'n'ni, avarga'ludaiya saththurukka'laippaarkkilum avarga'laip balavaanga'laakkinaar.
thammudaiya janangga'laip pagaikkavum, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararai vagnchanaiyaay nadaththavum, avarga'ludaiya iruthayaththai maat'rinaar.
thammudaiya thaasanaagiya moaseayaiyum thaam therinthuko'nda aaroanaiyum anuppinaar.
ivarga'l avarga'lukku'l avarudaiya adaiyaa'langga'laiyum, kaamin theasaththilea a'rputhangga'laiyum seythaarga'l.
avar iru'lai anuppi, anthagaaraththai u'ndaakkinaar; avarudaiya vaarththaiga'lai ethirppaarillai.
avarga'ludaiya tha'n'neerga'lai iraththamaaga maat'ri, avarga'ludaiya machchangga'laich saagappa'n'ninaar.
avarga'ludaiya theasam thava'laiga'laith thira'laayp pi'rappiththathu; avarga'ludaiya raajaakka'lin a'raiveeduga'lilum avaiga'l vanthathu.
avar katta'laiyida, avarga'ludaiya ellaiga'lilenggum va'nduga'lum peanga'lum vanthathu.
avarga'ludaiya mazhaiga'laik kalmazhaiyaakki, avarga'ludaiya theasaththilea juvaalikki'ra akkiniyai varappa'n'ninaar.
avarga'ludaiya thiraadchach sediga'laiyum aththimarangga'laiyum azhiththu, avarga'ludaiya ellaiga'lilu'l'la marangga'laiyum mu'riththaar.
avar katta'laiyida, e'n'nimudiyaatha vettukki'liga'lum pachchaippuzhukka'lum vanthu,
avarga'ludaiya theasaththilu'l'la sagala poo'nduga'laiyum ariththu, avarga'ludaiya nilaththin kaniyaith thin'rupoattathu.
avarga'ludaiya theasaththilea thalaichchanga'l anaiththaiyum, avarga'ludaiya belanil mutha'rbelanaana yaavaraiyum sanggariththaar.
appozhuthu avarga'lai ve'l'liyoadum ponnoadum pu'rappadappa'n'ninaar; avarga'l koaththirangga'lil balaveenappattavan oruvanum irunthathillai.
egipthiyar avarga'lukkup bayanthathinaal, avarga'l pu'rappattapoathu magizhnthaarga'l.
avar meagaththai ma'raivukkaaga viriththu, iravai ve'lichchamaakkugi'ratha'rkaaga akkiniyaiyum thanthaar.
keattaarga'l, avar kaadaiga'lai varappa'n'ninaar; vaana appaththinaalum avarga'laith thirupthiyaakkinaar.
kanmalaiyaith thi'ranthaar, tha'n'neerga'l pu'rappattu, va'ra'nda ve'liga'lil aa'raay oadit'ru.
avar thammudaiya parisuththa vaakkuththaththaththaiyum, thammudaiya thaasanaagiya aabirahaamaiyum ninaiththu,
thammudaiya janaththaik ka'lippoadum, thaam therinthuko'ndavarga'laik kembeera saththaththoadum pu'rappadappa'n'ni,
thamathu katta'laiga'laik kaaththu nadakkumpadikkum, thamathu niyaayappiramaa'nangga'laik kaikko'l'lumpadikkum,
avarga'lukkup pu'rajaathiga'ludaiya theasangga'laik koduththaar; anniya janangga'ludaiya pirayaasaththin palanaich suthanthariththukko'ndaarga'l. allealooyaa.
allealooyaa, karththaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar nallavar, avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
karththarudaiya vallamaiyaana seygaiga'laich solli, avarudaiya thuthiyaiyellaam pirasthaabappaduththaththakkavan yaar?
niyaayaththaik kaikko'l'lugi'ravarga'lum, ekkaalaththilum neethiyaichseygi'ravarga'lum baakkiyavaanga'l.
karththaavea, neer therinthuko'ndavarga'lin nanmaiyai naan ka'ndu, ummudaiya jaathiyin magizhchchiyaal magizhnthu, ummudaiya suthantharaththoadea meanmaipaaraattumpadikku,
ummudaiya janangga'lukku neer paaraattum kirubaiyinpadi ennai ninaiththu, ummudaiya iradchippinaal ennaich santhiththaru'lum.
engga'l pithaakka'loadungkooda naangga'lum paavagnseythu, akkiramam nadappiththu, aagaamiyampa'n'ninoam.
engga'l pithaakka'l egipthilea ummudaiya athisayangga'lai u'naraamalum, ummudaiya kirubaiga'lin thiradchiyai ninaiyaamalum poay, sivantha samuththira oaraththilea kalagampa'n'ninaarga'l.
aanaalum avar thamathu vallamaiyai ve'lippaduththumpadi, thammudaiya naamaththinimiththam avarga'lai iradchiththaar.
avar sivantha samuththiraththai athattinaar, athu vat'rippoayit'ru; vettaantharaiyil nadakki'rathupoala avarga'lai aazhangga'lil nadanthupoagappa'n'ninaar.
pagaignan kaikku avarga'lai vilakki iradchiththu, saththuruvin kaikku avarga'lai vilakki meettaar.
avarga'l saththurukka'laith tha'n'neerga'l moodikko'ndathu; avarga'lil oruvanum meenthirukkavillai.
appozhuthu avarga'l avarudaiya vaarththaiga'lai visuvaasiththu, avarudaiya thuthiyaip paadinaarga'l.
aanaalum seekkiramaay avarudaiya kiriyaiga'lai ma'ranthaarga'l; avarudaiya aaloasanaikku avarga'l kaaththiraamal,
vanaantharaththilea ichchaiyu'l'lavarga'laagi, avaantharave'liyilea theavanaip pareedchaipaarththaarga'l.
appozhuthu avarga'l keattathai avarga'lukkuk koduththaar, avarga'l aaththumaakka'liloa i'laippai anuppinaar.
paa'layaththil avarga'l moaseayinmealum, karththarudaiya parisuththanaagiya aaroaninmealum po'raamaiko'ndaarga'l.
boomi pi'lanthu thaaththaanai vizhunggi, abiraamin koottaththai moodippoattathu.
avarga'l koottaththil akkini pat'riyerinthathu; akkinijuvaalai thunmaarkkarai eriththuppoattathu.
avarga'l oareabilea oru kan'rukkuttiyaiyu'ndaakki, vaarppikkappatta vikkiragaththai namaskariththaarga'l.
thangga'l magimaiyaip pullaith thingi'ra maattin saayalaaga maat'rinaarga'l.
egipthilea periya kiriyaiga'laiyum, kaamin theasaththilea athisayangga'laiyum, sivantha samuththiraththa'ndaiyilea bayanggaramaanavaiga'laiyum seythavaraagiya,
thangga'l iradchagaraana theavanai ma'ranthaarga'l.

aagaiyaal, avarga'lai naasampa'n'nuvean en'raar; appozhuthu avaraal therinthuko'l'lappatta moasea, avarga'lai avar azhikkaathapadikku, avarudaiya ukkiraththai aat'rumporuttu, avarukku munbaagath thi'rappin vaayilea nin'raan.
avarudaiya vaarththaiyai visuvaasiyaamal, ichchikkappadaththakka theasaththai asattaipa'n'ninaarga'l.
karththarudaiya saththaththi'rkuch sevikodaamal, thangga'l koodaarangga'lil mu'rumu'ruththaarga'l.
appozhuthu avarga'l vanaantharaththilea madiyavum, avarga'l santhathi jaathiga'lukku'l'lea azhiyavum,
avarga'l pa'rpala theasangga'lilea sitha'radikkappadavum, avarga'lukku viroathamaagath thammudaiya kaiyai eduththaar.
avarga'l baagaalpeayoaraip pat'rikko'ndu, jeevanillaathavaiga'lukku itta baliga'laip pusiththu,
thangga'l kiriyaiga'linaal avarukkuk koabam moottinaarga'l; aagaiyaal vaathai avarga'lukku'l pugunthathu.
appozhuthu pinegaas ezhunthu nin'ru niyaayagnseythaan; athinaal vaathai ni'ruththappattathu.
athu thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga en'raikkum avanukku neethiyaaga e'n'nappattathu.
mearibaavin tha'n'neerga'lidaththilum avarukkuk kadungkoabam moottinaarga'l; avarga'l nimiththam moaseakkum pollaappu vanthathu.
avarga'l avan aaviyai visanappaduththinathinaalea, than uthaduga'linaal patha'rippeasinaan.
karththar thangga'lukkuch sonnapadi, avarga'l antha janangga'lai azhikkavillai.
jaathiga'ludanea kalanthu, avarga'l kiriyaiga'laik kat'ru;
avarga'ludaiya vikkiragangga'laich seaviththaarga'l; avaiga'l avarga'lukkuk ka'n'niyaayit'ru.
avarga'l thangga'l kumaararaiyum thangga'l kumaaraththiga'laiyum pisaasuga'lukkup baliyittaarga'l.
avarga'l kaanaantheasaththu vikkiragangga'lukkup baliyittu, thangga'l kumaarar kumaaraththiga'ludaiya kut'ramillaatha iraththaththaich sinthinaarga'l; theasam iraththaththaal theettuppattathu.
avarga'l thangga'l kiriyaiga'linaal asuththamaagi, thangga'l seygaiga'linaal soarampoanaarga'l.
athinaal karththarudaiya koabam thamathu janaththinmeal moo'ndathu; avar thamathu suthantharaththai aruvaruththaar.
avarga'lai jaathiga'ludaiya kaiyil oppukkoduththaar; avarga'ludaiya pagaignar avarga'lai aa'ndaarga'l.
avarga'ludaiya saththurukka'l avarga'lai odukkinaarga'l; avarga'ludaiya kaiyinkeezhth thaazhththappattaarga'l.
aneagantharam avarga'lai viduviththaar; avarga'loa thangga'l yoasanaiyinaal avarukku viroathamaayk kalagampa'n'ni, thangga'ludaiya akkiramaththinaal si'rumaippaduththappattaarga'l.
avarga'l kooppiduthalai avar keadkumpoathoa, avarga'lukku u'ndaana idukkaththai avar ka'n'noakki,
avarga'lukkaagath thamathu udanpadikkaiyai ninaiththu, thamathu miguntha kirubaiyinpadi manasthaabappattu,
avarga'laich si'raipidiththa yaavarum avarga'lukku iranggumpadi seythaar.

engga'l theavanaagiya karththaavea, naangga'l umathu parisuththa naamaththaippoat'ri, ummaith thuthikki'rathil meanmaipaaraattumpadi engga'lai iradchiththu, engga'lai jaathiga'lilirunthu searththaru'lum.
isravealin theavanaagiya karththar anaathiyaay en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirikkappadaththakkavar. janangga'lellaarum: aamen, allealooyaa, enbaarga'laaga.
karththaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar nallavar, avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
karththaraal saththuruvin kaikku neenggalaakki meedkappattu,
kizhakkilum mea'rkilum vadakkilum the'rkilumu'l'la pala theasangga'lilumirunthu searkkappattavarga'l, appadich sollakkadavarga'l.
avarga'l thaabarikkum ooraik kaa'naamal, vanaantharaththilea avaantharavazhiyaay,
pasiyaagavum, thaagamaagavum, aaththumaa thoynthathaagavum alainthu thirinthaarga'l.
thangga'l aabaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittaarga'l, avarga'l ikkattuga'lilirunthu avarga'lai viduviththaar.
thaabarikkum oorukkuppoaychseara, avarga'laich sevvaiyaana vazhiyilea nadaththinaar.
thavanamu'l'la aaththumaavaik karththar thirupthiyaakki, pasiyu'l'la aaththumaavai nanmaiyinaal nirappugi'raaren'ru,
avarudaiya kirubaiyinimiththamum, manupuththirarukku avar seygi'ra athisayangga'linimiththamum avaraith thuthippaarga'laaga.
theavanudaiya vaarththaiga'lukku viroathamaayk kalagampa'n'ni, unnathamaanavarudaiya aaloasanaiyai asattaipa'n'ninavarga'l,
anthagaaraththilum mara'na iru'lilum vaikkappattirunthu, odukkaththilum irumbilum kattu'ndu kidanthaarga'l.
avarga'ludaiya iruthayaththai avar varuththaththaal thaazhththinaar; sagaayarillaamal vizhunthupoanaarga'l.
thangga'l aabaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittaarga'l; avarga'l ikkattuga'lilirunthu avarga'lai neenggalaakki iradchiththaar.
anthagaaraththilum mara'na iru'lilumirunthu avarga'lai ve'lippadappa'n'ni, avarga'l kattuga'lai a'ruththaar.
karththar ve'ngalak kathavuga'lai udaiththu, irupputh thaazhppaa'lga'lai mu'riththaaren'ru,
avarudaiya kirubaiyinimiththamum, manupuththirarukku avar seygi'ra athisayangga'linimiththamum avaraith thuthippaarga'laaga.
nirmoodar thangga'l paathagamaarkkaththaalum thangga'l akkiramangga'laalum noayko'ndu odunggippoagi'raarga'l.
avarga'l aaththumaa sagala poajanaththaiyum aroasikki'rathu, avarga'l mara'navaasalga'l pariyantham sameebikki'raarga'l.
thangga'l aabaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppidugi'raarga'l; avarga'l ikkattuga'lukku avarga'lai neenggalaakki iradchikki'raar.
avar thamathu vasanaththai anuppi avarga'laik ku'namaakki, avarga'lai azhivukkuth thappuvikki'raar.
avarga'l karththarai avarudaiya kirubaiyinimiththamum, manupuththirarukku avar seygi'ra athisayangga'linimiththamum thuthiththu,
sthoaththirabaliga'laich seluththi, avarudaiya kiriyaiga'lai aananthasaththaththoadea vivarippaarga'laaga.
kappalea'ri, kadalyaaththiraipa'n'ni, thira'laana tha'n'neerga'lilea thozhil seygi'raarga'lea,
avarga'l karththarudaiya kiriyaiga'laiyum, aazhaththilea avarudaiya athisayangga'laiyum kaa'ngi'raarga'l.
avar katta'laiyida perungkaat'ru ezhumbi, athin alaiga'laik kontha'likkappa'n'num.
avarga'l aagaayaththil ea'ri, aazhangga'lil i'ranggugi'raarga'l, avarga'l aaththumaa kileasaththinaal karainthupoagi'rathu.
ve'riththavanaippoal alainthu thadumaa'rugi'raarga'l; avarga'ludaiya gnaanamellaam muzhugippoagi'rathu.
appozhuthu thangga'l aabaththilea avarga'l karththarai noakkik kooppidugi'raarga'l, avarga'l ikkattuga'lukku avarga'lai neenggalaakki viduvikki'raar.
kontha'lippai amarththugi'raar, athin alaiga'l adanggugin'rathu.
amaithalu'ndaanathinimiththam avarga'l santhoashappadugi'raarga'l; thaangga'l naadina thu'raimugaththil avarga'laik ko'nduvanthu searkki'raar.
avarga'l karththarai avarudaiya kirubaiyinimiththamum, manupuththirarukku avar seygi'ra athisayangga'linimiththamum thuthiththu,
janangga'lin sabaiyilea avarai uyarththi, moopparga'lin sanggaththilea avaraip poat'ruvaarga'laaga.
avar aa'ruga'lai avaantharave'liyaagavum, neeroot'ruga'lai va'ra'nda sthalamaagavum,
kudiga'ludaiya pollaappinimiththam sezhippaana theasaththai uvar nilamaagavum maat'rugi'raar.
avar avaantharave'liyaith tha'n'neerth thadaagamaagavum, va'ra'nda nilaththai neeroot'ruga'laagavum maat'ri,
pasiththavarga'lai anggea kudiyeat'rugi'raar; anggea avarga'l kudiyirukkum nagaraththaik katti,
vayalga'lai u'ndaakki vithaiththu, thiraadchaththoattangga'lai naattugi'raarga'l, avaiga'l varaththu'l'la palanaith tharum.
avarga'lai aaseervathikki'raar, miguthiyum perugugi'raarga'l; avarga'ludaiya mirugajeevanga'l ku'raiyaathirukkappa'n'nugi'raar.
pinbu avarga'l idukkaththinaalum, aabaththinaalum, thuyaraththinaalum ku'raivupattuth thaazhvadaigi'raarga'l.
avar pirabukka'linmeal igazhchchi varappa'n'ni, vazhiyillaatha avaantharave'liyilea avarga'laith thiriyachseythu,
e'liyavanaiyoa si'rumaiyinin'ru eduththu, uyarntha adaikkalaththilea vaiththu, avan vamsangga'lai manthaiyaippoalaakkugi'raar.
uththamarga'l athaikka'ndu magizhuvaarga'l; niyaayakkeadellaam than vaayai moodum.
evan gnaanamu'l'lavanoa avan ivaiga'laik kavanikkakkadavan; gnaanavaanga'l karththarudaiya kirubaiga'lai u'narnthuko'lvaarga'l.
theavanea, en iruthayam aayaththamaayirukki'rathu; naan paadik keerththanampa'n'nuvean; en magimaiyum paadum.
vee'naiyea, surama'ndalamea, vizhiyungga'l, naan athikaalaiyil vizhippean.
karththaavea, janangga'lukku'l'lea ummaiththuthippean; jaathiga'lukku'l'lea ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
umathu kirubai vaanangga'lukku mealaagavum, umathu saththiyam meagama'ndalangga'l pariyanthamum ettugi'rathu.
theavanea, vaanangga'lukku mealaaga uyarnthirum; umathu magimai boomiyanaiththinmealum uyarnthiruppathaaga.
umathu piriyar viduvikkappadumporuttu, umathu valathukaraththinaal iradchiththu, engga'l jebaththaik keattaru'lum.
theavan thamathu parisuththaththaikko'ndu vi'lambinaar, aagaiyaal ka'likooruvean; seekeamaip panggittu, sukkoaththin pa'l'laththaakkai a'lanthuko'l'luvean.
keeleayaath ennudaiyathu, manaaseayum ennudaiyathu; eppiraayeem en thalaiyin belan, yoothaa en niyaayappiramaa'nigan.
moavaab en paathapaaththiram; eathoaminmeal en paatharadchaiyai e'rivean; pelisthiyaavin meal aarpparippean.
ara'naana patta'naththi'rku'l ennai nadaththikko'ndu poagi'ravan yaar? eathoammattum enakku vazhikaattugi'ravan yaar?
engga'l seanaiga'loadea pu'rappadaamaliruntha theavareerallavaa? engga'laith tha'l'livittiruntha theavareerallavaa?
ikkattil engga'lukku uthaviseyyum; manushanudaiya uthavi viruthaa.
theavanaalea baraakkiramagnseyvoam; avarea engga'l saththurukka'lai mithiththuppoaduvaar.
naan thuthikkum theavanea, mavunamaayiraatheayum.
thunmaarkkanudaiya vaayum, kabattuvaayum, enakku viroathamaayth thi'ranthirukki'rathu; ka'l'lanaavinaal ennoadea peasugi'raarga'l.
pagaiyu'ndaakkum vaarththaiga'laal ennaich soozhnthuko'ndu, mugaantharamillaamal ennoadea poarseygi'raarga'l.
en sineagaththukkup bathilaaga ennai viroathikki'raarga'l, naanoa jebampa'n'nikko'ndirukki'rean.
nanmaikkup bathilaaga enakkuth theemaiseygi'raarga'l, en sineagaththukkup bathilaaga ennaip pagaikki'raarga'l.
avanukku mealaagath thushdanai ea'rpaduththivaiyum, saaththaan avan valathupakkaththil ni'rpaanaaga.
avan niyaayam visaarikkappadumpoathu kut'ravaa'liyaagakkadavan; avan jebam paavamaagakkadavathu.
avan naadka'l kognchamaagakkadavathu; avan uththiyoagaththai vea'roruvan pe'rakkadavan.
avan pi'l'laiga'l thikkat'ravarga'lum, avan manaivi vithavaiyumaagakkadavarga'l.
avan pi'l'laiga'l alainthu thirinthu pichchaiyeduththu, thangga'l paazhaana veeduga'lilirunthu iranthu'n'nakkadavarga'l.
kadan koduththavan avanukku u'l'lathellaavat'raiyum abagariththukko'lvaanaaga; avan pirayaasaththin palanai anniyar pa'riththukko'l'lakkadavarga'l.
avanukku oruvarum irakkang kaa'nbiyaamalum, avanudaiya thikkat'ra pi'l'laiga'lukkuth thayavuseyyaamalum poavaarga'laaga.
avan santhathiyaar nirmoolamaagakkadavarga'l; ira'ndaanthalaimu'raiyil avarga'l pear at'ruppoavathaaga.
avan pithaakka'lin akkiramam karththarukku munbaaga ninaikkappadakkadavathu, avan thaayin paavam neenggaamaliruppathaaga.
avaiga'l niththamum karththarukku munbaaga irukkakkadavathu; avarga'l pear boomiyiliraamal nirmoolamaavathaaga.
avan thayaiseyya ninaiyaamal, si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanaith thunbappaduththi, manamu'rivu'l'lavanaik kolaiseyyumpadi theadinaanea.
saabaththai virumbinaan, athu avanukku varum; avan aaseervaathaththai virumbaama'rpoanaan, athu avanukkuth thooramaay vilagippoam.
saabaththai avan thanakku anggiyaaga uduththikko'ndaan; athu avan u'l'laththil tha'n'neeraippoalavum, avan elumbuga'lil e'n'neyaippoalavum paayum.
athu avan moodikko'l'lugi'ra vasthiramaagavum, niththamum kattikko'l'lugi'ra kachchaiyaagavum iruppathaaga.
ithuthaan ennai viroathikki'ravarga'lukkum, en aaththumaavukku viroathamaayth theenggu peasugi'ravarga'lukkum karththaraal varum palan.
aa'ndavaraagiya karththaavea, neer umathu naamaththinimiththam ennai aathariththu, umathu kirubai nalamaanathinaal, ennai viduviththaru'lum.
naan si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavan, en iruthayam enakku'l kuththu'ndirukki'rathu.
saayum nizhalaippoal agan'ru poanean; vettukki'liyaippoal pa'rakkadikkappadugi'rean.
ubavaasaththinaal en muzhangkaalga'l tha'larchchiyadaigi'rathu; en maamsam pushdiyat'ru ularnthu poagi'rathu.
naan avarga'lukku ninthaiyaanean; avarga'l ennaip paarththu, thangga'l thalaiyaith thulukkugi'raarga'l.
en theavanaagiya karththaavea enakkuch sagaayampa'n'num; umathu kirubaiyinpadi ennai iradchiyum.
ithu umathu karam en'rum, karththaavea, theavareer ithaich seytheer en'rum, avarga'l a'rivaarga'laaga.
avarga'l sabiththaalum, neer aaseervathiyum; avarga'l ezhumbinaalum vedkappattuppoavaarga'laaga; umathu adiyaanoa magizhakkadavan.
en viroathiga'l ilachchaiyaal moodappattu, thangga'l vedkaththaich saalvaiyaippoal thariththukko'l'lakkadavarga'l.
karththarai naan en vaayinaal migavum thuthiththu, aneagar naduvilea avaraip pugazhuvean.
aakkinaikku'l'laagath theerkki'ravarga'linin'ru e'liyavanudaiya aaththumaavai iradchikkumpadi avar avan valathupaarisaththil ni'rpaar.
karththar en aa'ndavarai noakki: naan ummudaiya saththurukka'lai umakkup paathapadiyaakkip poadumvaraikkum, neer ennudaiya valathupaarisaththil udkaarum en'raar.
karththar seeyoanilirunthu umathu vallamaiyin senggoalai anuppuvaar; neer ummudaiya saththurukka'lin naduvea aa'lugaiseyyum.

umathu baraakkiramaththin naa'lilea ummudaiya janangga'l manappoorvamum parisuththa alanggaaramumu'l'lavarga'laayiruppaarga'l; vidiya'rkaalaththuk karppaththil pi'rakkum panikkuch samaanamaay ummudaiya yauvana janam umakkup pi'rakkum.
neer melkiseatheakkin mu'raimaiyinpadi en'ren'raikkum aasaariyaraayirukki'reer en'ru karththar aa'naiyittaar; manam maa'raamalumiruppaar.
ummudaiya valathupaarisaththilirukki'ra aa'ndavar, thamathu koabaththin naa'lilea raajaakka'lai vettuvaar.
avar jaathiga'lukku'l niyaayantheerppaar; ellaa idangga'laiyum pireathangga'laal nirappuvaar; visthaaramaana theasangga'linmeal thalaivarga'laayirukki'ravarga'lai no'rukkippoaduvaar.
vazhiyilea avar nathiyil kudippaar; aagaiyaal avar thamathu thalaiyai eduppaar.
allealooyaa, semmaiyaanavarga'ludaiya sanggaththilum sabaiyilum karththarai muzhu iruthayaththoadum thuthippean.
karththarin seygaiga'l periyavaiga'lum, avaiga'lil piriyappadugi'ra ellaaraalum aaraayappadugi'ravaiga'lumaayirukki'rathu.
avarudaiya seyal magimaiyum magaththuvamumu'l'lathu, avarudaiya neethi en'ren'raikkum ni'rkum.
avar thammudaiya athisayamaana seygaiga'lai ninaivukoorumpadi seythaar, karththar irakkamum manaurukkamumu'l'lavar.
thamakkup bayanthavarga'lukku aagaaram koduththaar; thamathu udanpadikkaiyai en'ren'raikkum ninaippaar.
jaathiga'lin suthantharaththaith thamathu janangga'lukkuk koduththathinaal, thamathu kiriyaiga'lin belaththai avarga'lukkuth theriyappaduththinaar.
avarudaiya karaththin kiriyaiga'l saththiyamum niyaayamumaanavaiga'l; avarudaiya katta'laiga'lellaam u'nmaiyaanavaiga'l.
avaiga'l en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangga'lukkum u'ruthiyaanavaiga'l, avaiga'l u'nmaiyum semmaiyumaaych seyyappattavaiga'l.
avar thamathu janaththi'rku meedpai anuppi, thamathu udanpadikkaiyai niththiya udanpadikkaiyaagak katta'laiyittaar; avarudaiya naamam parisuththamum bayanggaramumaanathu.
karththarukkup bayappaduthalea gnaanaththin aarambam; avarudaiya ka'rpanaiga'linpadi seygi'ra yaavarukkum na'rbuththiyu'ndu; avar pugazhchchi en'raikkum ni'rkum.
allealooyaa, karththarukkup bayanthu, avarudaiya katta'laiga'lil migavum piriyamaayirukki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan.
avan santhathi boomiyil balaththirukkum, semmaiyaanavarga'lin vamsam aaseervathikkappadum.
aasthiyum aisuvariyamum avan veettilirukkum; avanudaiya neethi en'raikkum ni'rkum.
semmaiyaanavarga'lukku iru'lilea ve'lichcham uthikkum; avan irakkamum manaurukkamum neethiyumu'l'lavan.
iranggik kadankoduththu, than kaariyangga'lai niyaayamaanapadi nadappikki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan.
avan en'ren'raikkum asaikkappadaathiruppaan; neethimaan niththiya keerththiyu'l'lavan.
thurchseythiyaik keadki'rathinaal bayappadaan; avan iruthayam karththarai nambith thidanaayirukkum.
avan iruthayam u'ruthiyaayirukkum; avan than saththurukka'lil sarikkattuthalaik kaa'numattum bayappadaathiruppaan.
vaariyi'raiththaan, eazhaiga'lukkuk koduththaan, avanudaiya neethi en'ren'raikkum ni'rkum; avan kombu magimaiyaay uyarththappadum.
thunmaarkkan athaik ka'ndu manamadivaagi, than pa'rka'laik kadiththuk karainthupoavaan; thunmaarkkarudaiya aasai azhiyum.
allealooyaa, karththarudaiya oozhiyakkaararea, thuthiyungga'l; karththarudaiya naamaththaith thuthiyungga'l.
ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum karththarudaiya naamam sthoaththirikkappadakkadavathu.
sooriyan uthikkum thisaithodanggi athu asthamikkum thisaimattum karththarudaiya naamam thuthikkappaduvathaaga.
karththar ellaa jaathiga'lmealum uyarnthavar; avarudaiya magimai vaanangga'lukku mealaanathu.
unnathangga'lil vaasampa'n'nugi'ra nammudaiya theavanaagiya karththarukkuch samaanamaanavar yaar?
avar vaanaththilum boomiyilumu'l'lavaiga'laip paarkkumpadi thammaith thaazhththugi'raar.
avar si'riyavanaip puzhuthiyilirunthu thookkividugi'raar; e'liyavanaik kuppaiyilirunthu uyarththugi'raar.
avanaip pirabukka'loadum, thamathu janaththin athibathiga'loadum udkaarappa'n'nugi'raar.
maladiyaich santhoashamaana pi'l'laiththaaychchiyaakki, veettilea kudiyirukkappa'n'nugi'raar. allealooyaa.
israveal egipthilum, yaakkoabin kudumbam anniya baashaikkaararaana janaththilumirunthu pu'rappattapoathu,
yoothaa avarukkup parisuththa sthaanamum, israveal avarukku raajyamumaayit'ru.
kadal ka'ndu vilagi oadit'ru; yoarthaan pinnittuth thirumbinathu.
malaiga'l aattukkadaakka'laippoalavum, kun'ruga'l aattukkuttiga'laippoalavum thu'l'linathu.
kadalea, nee vilagiyoadugi'ratha'rkum; yoarthaanea, nee pinnittuth thirumbugi'ratha'rkum;
malaiga'lea, neengga'l aattukkadaakka'laippoalavum; kun'ruga'lea, neengga'l aattukkuttiga'laippoalavum thu'l'lugi'ratha'rkum, ungga'lukku enna vanthathu?
boomiyea, nee aa'ndavarukku munbaagavum, yaakkoabudaiya theavanukku munbaagavum athiru.
avar kanmalaiyaith tha'n'neerth thadaagamaagavum, ka'rpaa'raiyai neeroot'ruga'laagavum maat'rugi'raar.
engga'lukku alla, karththaavea, engga'lukku alla, umathu kirubaiyinimiththamum, umathu saththiyaththinimiththamum, ummudaiya naamaththi'rkea magimai varappa'n'num.
avarga'ludaiya theavan ippozhuthu enggea en'ru pu'rajaathiga'l solvaanean?
nammudaiya theavan paraloagaththil irukki'raar; thamakkuch siththamaana yaavaiyum seygi'raar.
avarga'ludaiya vikkiragangga'l ve'l'liyum ponnum, manusharudaiya kaivealaiyumaayirukki'rathu.
avaiga'lukku vaayirunthum peasaathu; avaiga'lukkuk ka'nga'lirunthum kaa'naathu.
avaiga'lukkuk kaathuga'lirunthum kea'laathu; avaiga'lukku mookkirunthum mugaraathu.
avaiga'lukkuk kaiga'lirunthum thodaathu; avaiga'lukkuk kaalga'lirunthum nadavaathu; thangga'l tho'ndaiyaal saththamidavum maattaathu.
avaiga'laip pa'n'nugi'ravarga'lum, avaiga'lai nambugi'ravarga'l yaavarum, avaiga'laippoalavea irukki'raarga'l.
isravealea, karththarai nambu; avarea avarga'lukkuth thu'naiyum avarga'lukkuk keadagamumaayirukki'raar.
aaroan kudumbaththaarea, karththarai nambungga'l; avarea avarga'lukkuth thu'naiyum avarga'lukkuk keadagamumaayirukki'raar.
karththarukkup bayappadugi'ravarga'lea, karththarai nambungga'l; avarea avarga'lukkuth thu'naiyum avarga'lukkuk keadagamumaayirukki'raar.
karththar nammai ninaiththirukki'raar, avar aaseervathippaar; israveal kudumbaththaarai aaseervathippaar, avar aaroan kudumbaththaarai aaseervathippaar.
karththarukkup bayappadugi'ra periyoaraiyum si'riyoaraiyum aaseervathippaar.
karththar ungga'laiyum ungga'l pi'l'laiga'laiyum varththikkappa'n'nuvaar.
vaanaththaiyum boomiyaiyum padaiththa karththaraalea neengga'l aaseervathikkappattavarga'l.
vaanangga'l karththarudaiyavaiga'l; boomiyaiyoa manupuththirarukkuk koduththaar.
mariththavarga'lum mavunaththil i'ranggugi'ra anaivarum karththaraith thuthiyaarga'l.
naamoa, ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum karththarai sthoaththirippoam. allealooyaa.
karththar en saththaththaiyum en vi'n'nappaththaiyum keattathinaal, avaril anbukoorugi'rean.
avar thamathu seviyai enakkuch saayththapadiyaal, naan uyiroadirukkuma'lavum avaraith thozhuthuko'l'luvean.
mara'nakkattuga'l ennaich sut'rikko'ndathu, paathaa'la idukka'nga'l ennaip pidiththathu; ikkattaiyum sagnchalaththaiyum adainthean.
appozhuthu naan karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'ndu: karththaavea, en aaththumaavai viduviyum en'ru kegnchinean.
karththar kirubaiyum neethiyumu'l'lavar, nammudaiya theavan manaurukkamaanavar.
karththar kabadat'ravarga'laik kaakki'raar; naan melinthupoanean, avar ennai iradchiththaar.
en aaththumaavea, karththar unakku nanmai seythapadiyaal, nee un i'laippaa'ruthalukkuth thirumbu.
en aaththumaavai mara'naththukkum, en ka'n'naik ka'n'neerukkum, en kaalai ida'ruthalukkum thappuviththeer.
naan karththarukku munbaaga jeevanu'l'loar theasaththilea nadappean.
visuvaasiththean, aagaiyaal peasugi'rean; naan miguthiyum varuththappattean.
