ummudaiya vasanaththin pirasiththam ve'lichcham thanthu, peathaiga'lai u'narvu'l'lavarga'laakkum.
ummudaiya ka'rpanaiga'lai naan vaagnchikki'rapadiyaal, en vaayai aaven'ru thi'ranthu avaiga'lukku eanggugi'rean.
ummudaiya naamaththai neasikki'ravarga'lukku vazhanggum niyaayaththinpadiyea ennai noakkippaarththu, enakku iranggum.
ummudaiya vaarththaiyilea en kaaladiga'lai nilaippaduththi, oru aniyaayamum ennai aa'lavottaatheayum.
manushar seyyum idukkaththukku ennai vilakki viduviththaru'lum; appozhuthu naan ummudaiya katta'laiga'laik kaaththukko'l'luvean.
umathu adiyeanmeal umathu mugaththaip piragaasikkappa'n'ni, umathu piramaa'nangga'lai enakkup poathiyum.
ummudaiya veathaththai manushar kaaththu nadavaathapadiyaal, en ka'nga'lilirunthu neerththaaraiga'l oadugi'rathu.
(thsaadea.) karththaavea, neer neethiparar, umathu niyaayaththeerppuga'l semmaiyaanavaiga'l.
neer katta'laiyitta saadchiga'l neethiyum, mahaa u'nmaiyumaanavaiga'l.
en saththurukka'l ummudaiya vasanangga'lai ma'ranthapadiyaal, en bakthivairaakkiyam ennaip padchikki'rathu.
umathu vaarththai migavum pudamidappattathu, umathu adiyean athil piriyappadugi'rean.
naan si'riyavanum asattai pa'n'nappattavanumaayirukki'rean; aanaalum umathu katta'laiga'lai ma'ravean.
ummudaiya neethi niththiya neethi, ummudaiya veatham saththiyam.
ikkattum nerukkamum ennaip pidiththathu; aanaalum ummudaiya ka'rpanaiga'l en manamagizhchchi.
ummudaiya saadchiga'lin neethi en'raikkum ni'rkum; ennai u'narvu'l'lavanaakkum, appozhuthu naan pizhaiththiruppean.
(koap.) muzhu iruthayaththoadum kooppittean, karththaavea, en jebaththaik kea'lum; ummudaiya piramaa'nangga'laik kaikko'l'luvean.
ummai noakkik kooppittean, ennai iradchiyum; appozhuthu naan ummudaiya saadchiga'laik kaaththukko'l'luvean.
athikaalaiyil naan ezhunthu saththamittean; ummudaiya vasanaththukkuk kaaththirukki'rean.
umathu vasanaththaith thiyaanikkumpadi, ku'riththa jaamangga'lukku munnea en ka'nga'l vizhiththukko'l'lum.
ummudaiya kirubaiyinpadi en saththaththaik kea'lum; karththaavea, ummudaiya niyaayaththinpadi ennai uyirppiyum.
theevinaiyaip pinpat'rugi'ravarga'l sameebikki'raarga'l; avarga'l ummudaiya veathaththukkuth thooramaayirukki'raarga'l.
karththaavea, neer sameebamaayirukki'reer; umathu ka'rpanaiga'lellaam u'nmai.
neer ummudaiya saadchiga'lai en'ren'raikkum ni'rka sthaabiththeer enbathai, avaiga'laal naan nedunaa'laay a'rinthirukki'rean.
(reash.) en ubaththiravaththaip paarththu, ennai viduviyum; umathu veathaththai ma'ravean.
enakkaaga neer vazhakkaadi ennai meettukko'l'lum, ummudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea ennai uyirppiyum.
iradchippu thunmaarkkarukkuth thooramaayirukki'rathu, avarga'l umathu piramaa'nangga'laith theadaarga'l.
karththaavea, ummudaiya irakkangga'l miguthiyaayirukki'rathu; umathu niyaayangga'linpadi ennai uyirppiyum.
ennaith thunbappaduththugi'ravarga'lum ennai viroathikki'ravarga'lum aneagar; aanaalum ummudaiya saadchiga'lai vittu vilagean.
umathu vasanaththaik kaaththukko'l'laatha thuroagiga'lai naan ka'ndapoathu, enakku aruvaruppaayirunthathu.
ithoa, ummudaiya katta'laiga'lai neasikki'rean; karththaavea, umathu kirubaiyinpadi ennai uyirppiyum.
ummudaiya vasanam samoolamum saththiyam, ummudaiya neethi niyaayamellaam niththiyam.
(sheen.) pirabukka'l kaara'namillaamal ennaith thunbappaduththinaarga'l, aanaalum en iruthayam umathu vasanaththi'rkea bayappadugi'rathu.
miguntha ko'l'laiyudaimaiyaik ka'ndupidikki'ravan magizhugi'rathupoala, naan umathu vaarththaiyinpearil magizhugi'rean.
poyyaip pagaiththu aruvarukki'rean; ummudaiya veathaththaiyoa neasikki'rean.
umathu neethiniyaayangga'linimiththam, orunaa'lil eazhutharam ummaith thuthikki'rean.
ummudaiya veathaththai neasikki'ravarga'lukku miguntha samaathaanamu'ndu; avarga'lukku ida'ralillai.
karththaavea, ummudaiya iradchippukku naan kaaththirunthu, ummudaiya ka'rpanaiga'linpadi seygi'rean.
en aaththumaa umathu saadchiga'laik kaakkum; avaiga'lai naan migavum neasikki'rean.
umathu katta'laiga'laiyum umathu saadchiga'laiyum kaaththu nadakki'rean; en vazhiga'lellaam umakku munbaaga irukki'rathu.
(thau.) karththaavea, en kooppiduthal umathu sannithiyil varuvathaaga; umathu vasanaththinpadiyea ennai u'narvu'l'lavanaakkum.
en vi'n'nappam umathu sannithiyil varuvathaaga; umathu vaarththaiyinpadi ennai viduviththaru'lum.
ummudaiya piramaa'nangga'lai neer enakkup poathikkumpoathu, en uthaduga'l umathu thuthiyaip pirasthaabappaduththum.
umathu ka'rpanaiga'lellaam neethiyu'l'lavaiga'l; aathalaal, en naavu ummudaiya vasanaththai vivariththuchsollum.
naan ummudaiya katta'laiga'laith therinthuko'ndapadiyaal, umathu karam enakkuth thu'naiyaayiruppathaaga.
karththaavea, ummudaiya iradchippinmeal aavalaayirukki'rean; ummudaiya veatham en manamagizhchchi.
en aaththumaa pizhaiththirunthu ummaith thuthikkakkadavathu; umathu niyaayaththeerppuga'l enakku uthaviyaayiruppathaaga.
kaa'naama'rpoana aattaippoala vazhithappippoanean; umathu adiyeanaith theaduveeraaga; umathu ka'rpanaiga'lai naan ma'ravean.
en nerukkaththilea karththarai noakkik kooppittean; avar enakkuch sevikoduththaar.
karththaavea, poy uthaduga'lukkum kabadanaavukkum en aaththumaavaith thappuviyum.
kabadanaavea, unakku enna kidaikkum? unakku enna seyyappadum?
balavaanudaiya koormaiyaana ambuga'lum, sooraichsediga'lai erikkum thazhalumea kidaikkum.
aiyoa! naan measeakkilea sagnchariththathu poathum, keathaarin koodaarangga'la'ndaiyilea kudiyirunthathum poathum!
samaathaanaththaip pagaikki'ravarga'lidaththil en aaththumaa kudiyirunthathum poathum!
naan samaathaanaththai naadugi'rean; avarga'loa, naan peasumpoathu yuththaththukku eththanappadugi'raarga'l.
enakku oththaasai varum parvathangga'lukku nearaaga en ka'nga'lai ea'redukki'rean.
vaanaththaiyum boomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina karththaridaththilirunthu enakku oththaasai varum.
un kaalaith tha'l'laadavottaar; unnaik kaakki'ravar u'ranggaar.
ithoa, isravealaik kaakki'ravar u'rangguvathumillai thoonggugi'rathumillai.
karththar unnaik kaakki'ravar; karththar un valathupakkaththilea unakku nizhalaayirukki'raar.
pagalilea veyilaagilum, iravilea nilavaagilum unnaich seathappaduththuvathillai.
karththar unnai ellaath theenggukkum vilakkik kaappaar; avar un aaththumaavaik kaappaar.
karththar un poakkaiyum un varaththaiyum ithumutha'rko'ndu en'raikkung kaappaar.
karththarudaiya aalayaththi'rkup poavoam vaarungga'l en'ru enakku avarga'l sonnapoathu magizhchchiyaayirunthean.
erusaleamea, un vaasalga'lil engga'l kaalga'l ni'rkalaayit'ru.
erusaleam isaivi'naippaana nagaramaayk kattappattirukki'rathu.
anggea isravealukkuch saadchiyaagak karththarudaiya janangga'laagiya koaththirangga'l karththarin naamaththai sthoaththirippatha'rkup poagum.
anggea thaaveethin vamsaththaarudaiya singgaasanangga'laagiya niyaayaasanangga'l vaikkappattirukki'rathu.
erusaleamin samaathaanaththukkaaga vea'ndikko'l'lungga'l; unnai neasikki'ravarga'l sugiththiruppaarga'laaga.
un alanggaththi'rku'l'lea samaathaanamum, un aramanaiga'lukku'l'lea sugamum iruppathaaga.
en sagoatharar nimiththamum en sineagithar nimiththamum, unnil samaathaanam iruppathaaga enbean.
engga'l theavanaagiya karththarin aalayaththinimiththam unakku nanmaiyu'ndaagath theaduvean.
paraloagaththil vaasamaayirukki'ravarea, ummidaththi'rku en ka'nga'lai ea'redukki'rean.

ithoa, vealaikkaararin ka'nga'l thangga'l ejamaanga'lin kaiyai noakkiyirukkumaappoalavum, vealaikkaariyin ka'nga'l than ejamaattiyin kaiyai noakkiyirukkumaappoalavum, engga'l theavanaagiya karththar engga'lukku irakkagnseyyumvaraikkum, engga'l ka'nga'l avarai noakkiyirukki'rathu.
engga'lukku iranggum karththaavea, engga'lukku iranggum; ninthanaiyinaal migavum ni'rainthirukki'roam.
sugajeeviga'ludaiya ninthanaiyinaalum, aganggaariga'ludaiya igazhchchiyinaalum, engga'l aaththumaa migavum ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
manushar namakku viroathamaay ezhumbinapoathu, karththar namathu pakkaththiliraavittaal,
karththar thaamea namathu pakkaththiliraavittaal,
avarga'l koabam nammeal erigaiyil, nammai uyiroadea vizhunggiyiruppaarga'l.
appozhuthu tha'n'neerga'l nammeal paaynthu, ve'l'langga'l namathu aaththumaavinmeal perugi,
kontha'likkum jalangga'l namathu aaththumaavinmeal pura'ndupoayirukkum en'ru israveal ippozhuthu solvathaaga.
nammai avarga'ludaiya pa'rka'lukku iraiyaaga oppukkodaathirukki'ra karththarukku sthoaththiram.
veadarudaiya ka'n'nikkuth thappina kuruviyaippoala nammudaiya aaththumaa thappit'ru, ka'n'ni the'riththathu, naam thappinoam.
nammudaiya sagaayam vaanaththaiyum boomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina karththarudaiya naamaththil u'l'lathu.
karththarai nambugi'ravarga'l en'ren'raikkum asaiyaamal nilaiththirukkum seeyoan parvathaththaippoal iruppaarga'l.
parvathangga'l erusaleamaich sut'rilum irukkumaappoal, karththar ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum thammudaiya janaththaich sut'rilum irukki'raar.
neethimaanga'l aniyaayaththi'rkuth thangga'l kaiga'lai neettaathapadikku, aagaamiyaththin kodungkoal neethimaanga'ludaiya suthantharaththinmeal nilaiththiraathu.
karththaavea, nallavarga'lukkum iruthayaththil semmaiyaanavarga'lukkum nanmaiseyyum.
thangga'l koa'nalaana vazhiga'lukkuch saaygi'ravarga'laik karththar akkiramakkaararoadea poagappa'n'nuvaar. isravealukkoa samaathaanam u'ndu.
seeyoanin si'raiyiruppaik karththar thiruppumpoathu, soppanam kaa'ngi'ravarga'lpoal irunthoam.

appozhuthu nammudaiya vaay nagaippinaalum, nammudaiya naavu aananthasaththaththinaalum ni'rainthirunthathu; appozhuthu: karththar ivarga'lukkup periya kaariyangga'laich seythaar en'ru pu'rajaathiga'lukku'l'lea sollikko'ndaarga'l.
karththar namakkup periya kaariyangga'laich seythaar; ithinimiththam naam magizhnthirukki'roam.
karththaavea, the'rkaththi ve'l'langga'laith thiruppuvathupoala, engga'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppum.
ka'n'neeroadea vithaikki'ravarga'l kembeeraththoadea a'ruppaarga'l.
a'l'liththoovum vithaiyaich sumakki'ravan azhuthuko'ndu poagi'raan; aanaalum thaan a'ruththa ariga'laich sumanthuko'ndu kembeeraththoadea thirumbivaruvaan.
karththar veettaik kattaaraagil, athaik kattugi'ravarga'lin pirayaasam viruthaa; karththar nagaraththaik kaavaaraagil kaavalaa'lar vizhiththirukki'rathu viruthaa.
neengga'l athikaalaiyil ezhunthu, nearappada vealaiyilea thariththu, varuththaththin appaththaich saappidugi'rathum viruthaa; avarea thamakkup piriyamaanavanukku niththirai a'likki'raar.
ithoa, pi'l'laiga'l karththaraal varum suthantharam, karppaththin kani avaraal kidaikkum palan.
vaalavayathin kumaarar balavaan kaiyilu'l'la ambuga'lukku oppaayirukki'raarga'l.
avaiga'laal than amba'raaththoo'niyai nirappina purushan baakkiyavaan; avarga'l naa'namadaiyaamal olimugavaasalil saththurukka'loadea peasuvaarga'l.
karththarukkup bayanthu, avar vazhiga'lil nadakki'ravan evanoa, avan baakkiyavaan.
un kaiga'lin pirayaasaththai nee saappiduvaay; unakkup baakkiyamum nanmaiyum u'ndaayirukkum.
un manaivi un veettoarangga'lil kanitharum thiraadchakkodiyaippoal iruppaa'l; un pi'l'laiga'l un panthiyaich sut'rilum olivamarak kan'ruga'laippoal iruppaarga'l.
ithoa, karththarukkup bayappadugi'ra manushan ivvithamaay aaseervathikkappaduvaan.
karththar seeyoanilirunthu unnai aaseervathippaar; nee jeevanu'l'la naa'lellaam erusaleamin vaazhvaik kaa'nbaay.
nee un pi'l'laiga'lin pi'l'laiga'laiyum, isravealukku u'ndaagum samaathaanaththaiyum kaa'nbaay.
en si'ruvayathu thodanggi aneagantharam ennai nerukkinaarga'l.
en si'ruvayathu thodanggi aneagantharam ennai nerukkiyum, ennai mea'rko'l'laama'rpoanaarga'l.
uzhugi'ravarga'l en muthuginmeal uzhuthu, thangga'l padaichchaalga'lai nee'lamaakkinaarga'l.
karththaroa neethiyu'l'lavar; thunmaarkkarudaiya kayi'ruga'lai avar a'ruththaar en'ru, israveal ippozhuthu solvathaaga.
seeyoanaip pagaikki'ra anaivarum vedkip pinnittuth thirumbakkadavarga'l.
veettinmeal mu'laikkum pullukku avarga'l oppaavaarga'laaga; athu va'larumun ularnthupoam.
a'rukki'ravan athinaal than kaiyaiyum, ariga'laik kattugi'ravan than madiyaiyum nirappuvathillai.
karththarudaiya aaseervaatham ungga'lukku u'ndaavathaaga; karththarin naamaththinaal ungga'lai aaseervathikki'roam en'ru vazhippoakkar solvathumillai.
karththaavea, aazhangga'lilirunthu ummai noakkik kooppidugi'rean.
aa'ndavarea, en saththaththaik kea'lum; en vi'n'nappangga'lin saththaththi'rku umathu seviga'l kavaniththiruppathaaga.
karththaavea, neer akkiramangga'laik kavaniththiruppeeraanaal, yaar nilaini'rpaan, aa'ndavarea.
umakkup bayappadumpadikku ummidaththil mannippu u'ndu.
karththarukkuk kaaththirukki'rean; en aaththumaa kaaththirukki'rathu; avarudaiya vaarththaiyai nambiyirukki'rean.
eppozhuthu vidiyum en'ru vidiya'rkaalaththukkuk kaaththirukki'ra jaamakkaararaippaarkkilum athigamaay en aaththumaa aa'ndavarukkuk kaaththirukki'rathu.
israveal karththarai nambiyiruppathaaga; karththaridaththil kirubaiyum, avaridaththil thira'laana meedpum u'ndu.
avar isravealai athin sagala akkiramangga'linin'rum meettukko'lvaar.
karththaavea, en iruthayam i'rumaappu'l'lathalla, en ka'nga'l meattimaiyu'l'lavaiga'lumalla; periya kaariyangga'lilum, enakku mignchina karumangga'lilum naan thalaiyidugi'rathumillai.
thaayin paalma'rantha kuzhanthaiyaippoala naan en aaththumaavai adakki amarappa'n'ninean; en aaththumaa paalma'rantha kuzhanthaiyaippoal irukki'rathu.
ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum israveal karththarai nambiyiruppathaaga.
karththaavea, thaaveethaiyum avanudaiya sagala ubaththiravaththaiyum ninaiththaru'lum.
avan: naan karththarukku oru idaththaiyum, yaakkoabin vallavarukku oru vaasasthalaththaiyum kaa'numattum,
en veedaagiya koodaaraththil piraveasippathumillai, en padukkaiyaagiya kattilinmeal ea'ruvathumillai;
en ka'nga'lukku niththiraiyaiyum, en imaiga'lukku u'rakkaththaiyum varaviduvathumillai en'ru,
karththarukku aa'naiyittu, yaakkoabin vallavarukkup poruththanai pa'n'ninaan.
ithoa, naam eppiraaththaavilea athin seythiyaik keattu, vanaththin ve'liga'lil athaik ka'ndoam.
avarudaiya vaasasthalangga'lukku'l piraveasiththu, avar paathapadiyil pa'nivoam.
karththaavea, umathu vallamai vi'langgum pettiyudan neer umathu thaabara sthalaththi'rku'l ezhuntharu'lum.
ummudaiya aasaariyarga'l neethiyaith thariththu, ummudaiya parisuththavaanga'l kembeerippaarga'laaga.
neer abisheagampa'n'nuviththavanin mugaththai umathu thaasanaagiya thaaveethinimiththam pu'rakka'niyaathirum.
un karppaththin kaniyai un singgaasanaththinmeal vaippean en'rum,

un kumaarar en udanpadikkaiyaiyum, naan poathikkum en saadchiga'laiyum kaaththu nadanthaal, avarga'l kumaararum en'ren'raikkum un singgaasanaththil veet'riruppaarga'l en'rum, karththar thaaveethukku u'nmaiyaay aa'naiyittaar; avar thava'ramaattaar.
karththar seeyoanaith therinthuko'ndu, athu thamakku vaasasthalamaagumpadi virumbinaar.
ithu en'ren'raikkum naan thanggum idam; ithai naan virumbinapadiyaal, inggea vaasampa'n'nuvean.
athin aagaaraththai naan aaseervathiththu varuvean; athin eazhaiga'lai naan appaththinaal thirupthiyaakkuvean.
athin aasaariyarga'lukku iradchippai uduththuvean; athilu'l'la parisuththavaanga'l migavum kembeerippaarga'l.
anggea thaaveethukkaaga oru kombai mu'laikkappa'n'nuvean; naan abisheagampa'n'nuviththavanukkaaga oru vi'lakkai aayaththampa'n'ninean.
avan saththurukka'lukku vedkaththai uduththuvean; avanmeethiloa avan kireedam pookkum en'raar.
ithoa, sagoatharar orumiththu vaasampa'n'nugi'rathu eththanai nanmaiyum eththanai inbamumaanathu?
athu aaroanudaiya sirasinmeal oot'rappattu, avanudaiya thaadiyilea vadigi'rathum, avanudaiya anggiga'linmeal i'ranggugi'rathumaana nalla thailaththukkum,
ermoanmealum, seeyoan parvathangga'lmealum i'ranggum panikkum oppaayirukki'rathu; anggea karththar en'ren'raikkum aaseervaathaththaiyum jeevanaiyum katta'laiyidugi'raar.
ithoa, iraakkaalangga'lil karththarudaiya aalayaththil ni'rkum karththarin oozhiyakkaararea, neengga'lellaarum karththarai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
ungga'l kaiga'laip parisuththa sthalaththi'rku nearaaga eduththu, karththarai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
vaanaththaiyum boomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina karththar seeyoanilirunthu unnai aaseervathippaaraaga.
allealooyaa, karththarudaiya naamaththaith thuthiyungga'l; karththarin oozhiyakkaararea, thuthiyungga'l.
karththarudaiya veettilum, namathu theavanudaiya aalayappiraagaarangga'lilum ni'rki'ravarga'lea, karththaraith thuthiyungga'l.
karththar nallavar; avarudaiya naamaththaik keerththanampa'n'nungga'l; athu inbamaanathu.
karththar yaakkoabaith thamakkaagavum, isravealaith thamakkuch sonthamaagavum therinthuko'ndaar.
karththar periyavar en'rum, nammudaiya aa'ndavar ellaa theavarga'lukkum mealaanavar en'rum naan a'rivean.
vaanaththilum boomiyilum, samuththirangga'lilum, ellaa aazhangga'lilum, karththar thamakkuch siththamaanathaiyellaam seygi'raar.
avar boomiyin kadaiyaantharangga'lilirunthu meagangga'lai ezhumbappa'n'ni, mazhaiyudan minnalaiyum u'ndaakki, kaat'raith thamathu pa'ndasaalaiga'lilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'nugi'raar.
avar egipthilea manusharudaiya thalaippi'l'laiga'laiyum mirugaththin thalaiyeet'ruga'laiyum adiththaar.
egipthutheasamea, un naduvil paarvoanmealum avanudaiya ellaa oozhiyakkaararmealum adaiyaa'langga'laiyum a'rputhangga'laiyum anuppinaar.
avar aneagam jaathiga'lai adiththu, balaththa raajaakka'laik kon'ru;
emoariyarin raajaavaagiya seegoanaiyum, baasaanin raajaavaagiya oakaiyum, kaanaanin sagala raajyangga'laiyum azhiththu,
avarga'l theasaththaith thammudaiya janamaagiya isravealukkuch suthantharamaagak koduththaar.
karththaavea, ummudaiya naamam en'raikkumu'l'lathu; karththaavea, ummudaiya pirasthaabam thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raikkum irukkum.
karththar thammudaiya janaththin niyaayaththai visaariththu, thammudaiya oozhiyakkaararmeal parithaabappaduvaar.
agngnaaniga'ludaiya vikkiragangga'l ve'l'liyum ponnum, manusharudaiya kaivealaiyumaayirukki'rathu.
avaiga'lukku vaayirunthum peasaathu, avaiga'lukkuk ka'nga'lirunthum kaa'naathu.
avaiga'lukkuk kaathuga'lirunthum kea'laathu, avaiga'ludaiya vaayilea suvaasamumillai.
avaiga'laip pa'n'nugi'ravarga'lum, avaiga'lai nambugi'ravarga'l yaavarum, avaiga'laippoal irukki'raarga'l.
israveal kudumbaththaarea, karththarai sthoaththiriyungga'l; aaroan kudumbaththaarea, karththarai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
leavi kudumbaththaarea, karththarai sthoaththiriyungga'l; karththarukkup bayanthavarga'lea, karththarai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
erusaleamil vaasampa'n'nugi'ra karththarukku seeyoanilirunthu sthoaththiramu'ndaavathaaga. allealooyaa.
karththaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar nallavar, avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
theavaathi theavanaith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
karththaathi karththaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
oruvaraayp periya athisayangga'laich seygi'ravaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
vaanangga'lai gnaanamaay u'ndaakkinavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
tha'n'neerga'lukku mealea boomiyaip parappinavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
periya sudarga'lai u'ndaakkinavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu;
pagalil aa'lach sooriyanaip padaiththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
iravil aa'lach santhiranaiyum nadchaththirangga'laiyum padaiththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu;
egipthiyarudaiya thalaichchanga'laich sanggariththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
avarga'l naduvilirunthu isravealaip pu'rappadappa'n'ninavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
balaththa kaiyinaalum oanggiya puyaththinaalum athaich seythavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
sivantha samuththiraththai ira'ndaagap piriththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
athin naduvea isravealaik kadanthupoagappa'n'ninavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
paarvoanaiyum avan seanaiga'laiyum sivantha samuththiraththil kavizhththuppoattavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
thammudaiya janangga'lai vanaantharaththil nadaththinavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
periya raajaakka'laich sanggariththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
pirabalamaana raajaakka'lai azhiththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
emoariyarin raajaavaagiya seegoanai azhiththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
baasaanin raajaavaagiya oakai azhiththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
avarga'l theasaththaich suthantharamaagath thanthavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
athaith thammudaiya thaasanaagiya isravealukkuch suthantharamaagavea thanthavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
nammudaiya thaazhvil nammai ninaiththavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
nammudaiya saththurukka'lin kaiyilirunthu nammai viduthalaipa'n'ninavaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
maamsatheagamu'l'la yaavukkum aagaarang kodukki'ravaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
paraloagaththin theavanaith thuthiyungga'l; avar kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu.
baabiloan aa'ruga'l arugea naangga'l udkaarnthu, anggea seeyoanai ninaiththu azhuthoam.
athin naduvilirukkum alarichsediga'linmeal engga'l kinnarangga'laith thookkivaiththoam.

engga'laich si'raipidiththavarga'l anggea engga'l paadalga'laiyum, engga'laip paazhaakkinavarga'l mangga'la keethaththaiyum virumbi: seeyoanin paattuga'lil silathai engga'lukkup paadungga'l en'ru sonnaarga'l.
karththarin paattai anniyatheasaththil naangga'l paaduvatheppadi?
erusaleamea, naan unnai ma'ranthaal en valathukai than thozhilai ma'rappathaaga.
naan unnai ninaiyaamalum, erusaleamai en mukkiyamaana magizhchchiyilum athigamaaga e'n'naamalumpoanaal, en naavu en mealvaayoadu ottikko'lvathaaga.
karththaavea, erusaleamin naa'lil eathoamin puththirarai ninaiyum; avarga'l: athai idiththuppoadungga'l, asthibaaramattum idiththuppoadungga'l en'ru sonnaarga'lea.
baabiloan kumaaraththiyea, paazhaayppoagi'rava'lea, nee engga'lukkuch seythapadi unakkup bathil seygi'ravan baakkiyavaan.
un kuzhanthaiga'laip pidiththu, kallinmeal moathiyadikki'ravan baakkiyavaan.
ummai en muzhu iruthayaththoadum thuthippean; theavarga'lukku munbaaga ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.

umathu parisuththa aalayaththi'rku nearaaga naan pa'ninthu, umathu kirubaiyinimiththamum umathu u'nmaiyinimiththamum umathu naamaththaith thuthippean; umathu sagala pirasthaabaththaippaarkkilum umathu vaarththaiyai neer magimaippaduththiyirukki'reer.
naan kooppitta naa'lilea enakku ma'ruuththaravu aru'lineer; en aaththumaavilea belanthanthu ennaith thairiyappaduththineer;
karththaavea, boomiyin raajaakka'lellaarum umathu vaayin vaarththaiga'laik keadkumpoathu ummaith thuthippaarga'l.
karththarin magimai perithaayiruppathinaal, avarga'l karththarin vazhiga'laip paaduvaarga'l.
karththar uyarnthavaraayirunthum, thaazhmaiyu'l'lavanai noakkip paarkki'raar; meattimaiyaanavanaiyoa thooraththilirunthu a'rigi'raar.
naan thunbaththin naduvil nadanthaalum neer ennai uyirppippeer; en saththurukka'lin koabaththukku viroathamaaga umathu kaiyai neettuveer; umathu valathukaram ennai iradchikkum.
karththar enakkaaga yaavaiyum seythu mudippaar; karththaavea, umathu kirubai en'rumu'l'lathu; umathu karaththin kiriyaiga'lai negizhavidaathiruppeeraaga.
karththaavea, neer ennai aaraaynthu, a'rinthirukki'reer.
en udkaaruthalaiyum en ezhunthirukkuthalaiyum neer a'rinthirukki'reer; en ninaivuga'laith thooraththilirunthu a'rigi'reer.
naan nadanthaalum paduththirunthaalum ennaich soozhnthirukki'reer; en vazhiga'lellaam umakkuth theriyum.
en naavil sol pi'ravaathatha'rkumunnea, ithoa, karththaavea, athaiyellaam neer a'rinthirukki'reer.
mu'rpu'raththilum pi'rpu'raththilum neer ennai nerukki, umathu karaththai enmeal vaikki'reer.
intha a'rivu enakku miguntha aachchariyamum, enakku ettaatha uyaramumaayirukki'rathu.
ummudaiya aavikku ma'raivaaga enggea poavean? ummudaiya samugaththaivittu enggea oaduvean?
naan vaanaththi'rku ea'rinaalum, neer anggea irukki'reer; naan paathaa'laththil padukkai poattaalum, neer anggeayum irukki'reer.
naan vidiya'rkaalaththuch settaiga'lai eduththu, samuththiraththin kadaiyaantharangga'lilea poayth thangginaalum,
anggeayum umathu kai ennai nadaththum, umathu valathukaram ennaip pidikkum.
iru'l ennai moodikko'l'lumen'raalum, iravum ennaich sut'ri ve'lichchamaayirukkum.
umakku ma'raivaaga iru'lum anthagaarappaduththaathu; iravum pagalaippoala ve'lichchamaayirukkum; umakku iru'lum ve'lichchamum sari.
neer en u'l'linthiriyangga'laik kaikko'ndirukki'reer; en thaayin karppaththil ennaik kaappaat'rineer.
naan piramikkaththakka athisayamaay u'ndaakkappattapadiyaal, ummaith thuthippean; umathu kiriyaiga'l athisayamaanavaiga'l, athu en aaththumaavukku nan'raayth theriyum.
naan o'lippidaththilea u'ndaakkappattu, boomiyin thaazhvidangga'lilea visiththira vinoathamaay uruvaakkappattapoathu, en elumbuga'l umakku ma'raivaayirukkavillai.
en karuvai ummudaiya ka'nga'l ka'ndathu; en avayavangga'lil on'raagilum illaathapoathea avaiga'l anaiththum, avaiga'l uruvea'rpadum naadka'lum, umathu pusthagaththil ezhuthiyirunthathu.
theavanea, umathu aaloasanaiga'l enakku eththanai arumaiyaanavaiga'l; avaiga'lin thogai evva'lavu athigam.
avaiga'lai naan e'n'nappoanaal, ma'nalaippaarkkilum athigamaam; naan vizhikkumpoathu innum umma'ndaiyil irukki'rean.
theavanea, neer thunmaarkkanai azhiththeeraanaal nalamaayirukkum; iraththappiriyarea, neengga'l ennaivittu agan'rupoangga'l.
avarga'l ummaik ku'riththuth thunmaarkkamaayp peasugi'raarga'l; ummudaiya saththurukka'l umathu naamaththai vee'naay vazhanggugi'raarga'l.
karththaavea, ummaip pagaikki'ravarga'lai naan pagaiyaamalum, umakku viroathamaay ezhumbugi'ravarga'lai aruvarukkaamalum iruppeanoa?
muzhuppagaiyaay avarga'laip pagaikki'rean; avarga'lai enakkup pagaignaraaga e'n'nugi'rean.
theavanea, ennai aaraaynthu, en iruthayaththai a'rinthuko'l'lum; ennaich soathiththu, en sinthanaiga'lai a'rinthuko'l'lum.
veathanai u'ndaakkum vazhi ennidaththil u'ndoa en'ru paarththu, niththiya vazhiyilea ennai nadaththum.
karththaavea, pollaatha manushanukku ennaith thappuviyum; kodumaiyu'l'lavanukku ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
avarga'l thangga'l iruthayaththil pollaappuga'laich sinthiththu, yuththagnseyya naa'lthoa'rum koottangkoodugi'raarga'l.
sarppaththaippoal thangga'l naavaik koormaiyaakkugi'raarga'l; avarga'l uthaduga'linkeezh viriyan paambinvisham irukki'rathu. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, thunmaarkkanudaiya kaiga'lukku ennai neenggalaakki, kodiyavanukku ennai vilakki iradchiyum; avarga'l en nadaiga'laik kavizhkkappaarkki'raarga'l.
aganggaariga'l enakkuk ka'n'niyaiyum kayi'ruga'laiyum ma'raivaay vaikki'raarga'l; vazhiyoaraththilea valaiyai viriththu, enakkuch surukkuga'lai vaikki'raarga'l. (sealaa.)
naan karththarai noakki: neer en theavan en'rean; karththaavea, en vi'n'nappangga'lin saththaththukkuch sevikodum.
aa'ndavaraagiya karththaavea, en iradchippin belanea, yuththanaa'lil en thalaiyai moodineer.
karththaavea, thunmaarkkanudaiya aasaiga'l siththiyaathapadi seyyum; avan thannai uyarththaathapadi avanudaiya yoasanaiyai nadanthea'ravottaatheayum. (sealaa.)
ennai va'lainthuko'l'lugi'ravarga'ludaiya uthaduga'lin theevinaiga'l avarga'l thalaiga'laiyea mooduvathaaga.
neruppuththazhal avarga'lmeal vizhuvathaaga; akkiniyilum, avarga'l ezhunthirukkakkoodaatha padukuzhiga'lilum tha'l'lappaduvaarga'laaga.
pollaatha naavu'l'lavan boomiyilea nilaippathillai; kodumaiyaana manushanai pa'rakkadikkap pollaappu avanai veattaiyaadum.
si'rumaiyaanavanin vazhakkaiyum, e'liyavarga'lin niyaayaththaiyum karththar visaarippaaren'ru a'rivean.
neethimaanga'l umathu naamaththaith thuthippaarga'l; semmaiyaanavarga'l umathu samugaththil vaasampa'n'nuvaarga'l.
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppidugi'rean, ennidaththi'rku varaththeeviriyum; naan ummai noakkik kooppidugaiyil, en saththaththi'rkuch sevikodum.
en vi'n'nappam umakku munbaagath thoobamaagavum, en kaiyeduppu anthipbaliyaagavum irukkakkadavathu.
karththaavea, en vaaykkuk kaaval vaiyum; en uthaduga'lin vaasalaik kaaththukko'l'lum.

akkiramagnseygi'ra manusharoadea aagaamiyak kiriyaiga'lai nadappikkumpadi en iruthayaththaith thunmaarkkaththi'rku i'nanggavottaatheayum; avarga'ludaiya rusiyu'l'la pathaarththangga'lil on'raiyum naan saappidaamal iruppeanaaga.
neethimaan ennaith thayavaaykkutti, ennaik kadinthuko'l'lattum; athu en thalaikku e'n'neyaippoalirukkum; en thalai athai allaththattuvathillai; avarga'l ikkattuga'lil naan innum jebampa'n'nuvean.
avarga'ludaiya niyaayaathibathiga'l kanmalaich saarbuga'lilirunthu tha'l'lu'ndupoagi'rapoathu, en vaarththaiga'l inbamaanavaiga'len'ru keadpaarga'l.
boomiyinmeal oruvan maraththai vettip pi'lakki'rathupoala, engga'l elumbuga'l paathaa'lavaaykku nearaaych sitha'radikkappattirukki'rathu.
aanaalum aa'ndavaraagiya karththaavea, en ka'nga'l ummai noakkiyirukki'rathu; ummai nambiyirukki'rean; en aaththumaavai ve'rumaiyaaga vidaatheayum.
avarga'l enakku vaiththa ka'n'niyin sikkuga'lukkum, akkiramakkaararin surukkuga'lukkum ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
thunmaarkkar thangga'l valaiga'lil agappaduvaarga'laaga; naanoa atha'rkuth thappik kadanthupoavean.
karththarai noakkich saththamittuk kooppidugi'rean; karththarai noakkich saththamittuk kegnchugi'rean.
avarukku munbaaga en sagnchalaththai oot'rugi'rean; avarukku munbaaga en nerukkaththai a'rikkaiyidugi'rean.
en aavi ennil thiyanggumpoathu, neer en paathaiyai a'rinthirukki'reer; naan nadakki'ra vazhiyil ma'raivaaga enakkuk ka'n'nivaiththaarga'l.
valathupu'ramaayk ka'n'noakkippaarum, ennai a'rivaar oruvarum illai; enakku adaikkalamillaama'rpoayit'ru; en aaththumaavai visaarippaar oruvarum illai.
karththaavea, ummai noakkik kooppidugi'rean; neerea en adaikkalamum, jeevanu'l'loar theasaththilea en panggumaayirukki'reer en'rean.
en kookkuralukkuch sevikodum, naan migavum thaazhththappattean; ennaip pinthodarugi'ravarga'lukku ennaith thappuviyum, avarga'l ennilum balavaanga'laayirukki'raarga'l.
umathu naamaththai naan thuthikkumpadi, en aaththumaavaik kaavalukku neenggalaakkividum; enakku neer thayavuseyyumpoathu neethimaanga'l ennaich soozhnthuko'l'luvaarga'l.
karththaavea, en jebaththaik kea'lum, en vi'n'nappangga'lukkuch sevikodum; umathu u'nmaiyinpadiyum umathu neethiyinpadiyum enakku uththaravu aru'lichseyyum.
jeevanu'l'la oruvanum umakku munbaaga neethimaan allaathathinaalea, adiyeanai niyaayantheerkkap piraveasiyaatheayum.
saththuru en aaththumaavaith thodarnthu, en piraa'nanaith tharaiyoadea nasukki, vegukaalaththukkumun mariththavarga'lpoal ennai iru'lil irukkappa'n'nugi'raan.
en aavi ennil thiyanggugi'rathu; en iruthayam enakku'l soarnthupoagi'rathu.
poorvanaadka'lai ninaikki'rean, umathu seygaiga'laiyellaam thiyaanikki'rean; umathu karaththin kiriyaiga'lai yoasikki'rean.
en kaiga'lai umakku nearaaga virikki'rean; va'ra'nda nilaththaippoal en aaththumaa ummeal thaagamaayirukki'rathu. (sealaa.)
karththaavea, seekkiramaay enakkuch sevikodum, en aavi thoynthupoagi'rathu; naan kuzhiyil i'ranggugi'ravarga'lukku oppaagaathapadikku, umathu mugaththai enakku ma'raiyaatheayum.
athikaalaiyil umathu kirubaiyaik keadkappa'n'num, ummai nambiyirukki'rean, naan nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyai enakkuk kaa'nbiyum; ummidaththil en aaththumaavai uyarththugi'rean.
karththaavea, en saththurukka'lukku ennaith thappuviyum; ummaip pugalidamaagak ko'l'lugi'rean.
umakkup piriyamaanathaich seyya enakkup poathiththaru'lum, neerea en theavan; ummudaiya nalla aavi ennaich semmaiyaana vazhiyilea nadaththuvaaraaga.
karththaavea, ummudaiya naamaththinimiththam ennai uyirppiyum; ummudaiya neethiyinpadi en aaththumaavai idukkaththi'rku neenggalaakkividum.
ummudaiya kirubaiyinpadi en saththurukka'lai azhiththu, en aaththumaavai odukkugi'ra yaavaraiyum sanggaarampa'n'num; naan umathu adiyean.
en kaiga'laip poarukkum en viralga'lai yuththaththi'rkum padippikki'ra en kanmalaiyaagiya karththarukku sthoaththiram.
avar en thayaapararum, en koattaiyum, en uyarntha adaikkalamum, ennai viduvikki'ravarum, en keadagamum, naan nambinavarum, en janangga'lai enakkuk keezhppaduththugi'ravarumaayirukki'raar.
karththaavea, manushanai neer kavanikki'ratha'rkum, manupuththiranai neer e'n'nugi'ratha'rkum, avan emmaaththiram?
manushan maayaikku oppaayirukki'raan; avan naadka'l kadanthupoagi'ra nizhalukkuch samaanam.
karththaavea, neer umathu vaanangga'laith thaazhththi i'ranggi, parvathangga'l pugaiyumpadi avaiga'laith thodum.
minnalga'lai varavittuch saththurukka'laich sitha'radiyum, umathu ambuga'lai eythu avarga'laik kalanggadiyum.
uyaraththilirunthu umathu karaththai neetti, jalappiravaagaththukku ennai vilakki iradchiyum.
maayaiyaip peasum vaayum, ka'l'laththanamaana valathukaiyum udaiya anniya puththirarin kaikku ennai vilakkith thappuviyum.
karththaavea, naan umakkup puthuppaattaip paaduvean; thamburinaalum paththunarambu vee'naiyinaalum ummaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
neerea raajaakka'lukku jeyaththaith thanthu, umathadiyaanaagiya thaaveethaip pollaatha pattayaththi'rkuth thappuvikki'ravar.
maayaiyaip peasum vaayum, ka'l'laththanamaana valathukaiyum udaiya anniya puththirarin kaikku ennai vilakkith thappuviyum.
appozhuthu engga'l kumaarar i'lamaiyil oanggiva'larugi'ra virudchakkan'ruga'laippoalavum, engga'l kumaaraththiga'l siththirantheerntha aramanai moolaikka'rka'laippoalavum iruppaarga'l.
engga'l ka'lagnchiyangga'l sagalavitha vasthukka'laiyum kodukkaththakkathaay nirambiyirukkum; engga'l kiraamangga'lil engga'l aaduga'l aayiram pathinaayiramaayp palugum.
engga'l eruthuga'l balaththavaiga'laayirukkum; saththuru udpuguthalum kudiyoadippoaguthalum iraathu; engga'l veethiga'lil kookkuralum u'ndaagaathu.
ivvithamaana seeraippet'ra janam baakkiyamu'l'lathu; karththaraith theyvamaagak ko'ndirukki'ra janam baakkiyamu'l'lathu.
raajaavaagiya en theavanea, ummai uyarththi, ummudaiya naamaththai eppozhuthum en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirippean.
naadoa'rum ummai sthoaththiriththu, eppozhuthum en'ren'raikkum ummudaiya naamaththaith thuthippean.
karththar periyavarum migavum pugazhappadaththakkavarumaayirukki'raar; avarudaiya magaththuvam aaraaynthumudiyaathu.
thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaaga ummudaiya kiriyaiga'lin pugazhchchiyaich solli, ummudaiya vallamaiyu'l'la seygaiga'lai a'rivippaarga'l.
ummudaiya si'rantha magimaippirathaabaththaiyum, ummudaiya athisayamaana kiriyaiga'laiyungku'riththup peasuvean.
janangga'l ummudaiya bayanggaramaana kiriyaiga'lin vallamaiyaich solluvaarga'l; ummudaiya magaththuvaththai naan vivarippean.
avarga'l umathu miguntha thayavai ninaiththu ve'lippaduththi, umathu neethiyaik kembeeriththup paaduvaarga'l.
karththar irakkamum mana urukkamum, neediya saanthamum miguntha kirubaiyum u'l'lavar.
karththar ellaarmealum thayavu'l'lavar; avar irakkangga'l avarudaiya ellaak kiriyaiga'linmealumu'l'lathu.
karththaavea, ummudaiya kiriyaiga'lellaam ummaith thuthikkum; ummudaiya parisuththavaanga'l ummai sthoaththirippaarga'l.
manupuththirarukku umathu vallamaiyu'l'la seygaiga'laiyum, umathu raajyaththin si'rantha magimaippirathaabaththaiyum therivikkumpadikku;
umathu raajyaththin magimaiyai a'riviththu, umathu vallamaiyaik ku'riththup peasuvaarga'l.
ummudaiya raajyam sathaakaalangga'lilumu'l'la raajyam, ummudaiya aa'lugai thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaagavum u'l'lathu.
karththar vizhugi'ra yaavaraiyum thaanggi, madanggadikkappatta yaavaraiyum thookkividugi'raar.
ellaa jeevanga'lin ka'nga'lum ummai noakkikko'ndirukki'rathu; eat'ra vea'laiyilea neer avaiga'lukku aagaarangkodukki'reer.
neer umathu kaiyaith thi'ranthu, sagala piraa'niga'lin vaagnchaiyaiyum thirupthiyaakkugi'reer.
karththar thamathu vazhiga'lilellaam neethiyu'l'lavarum, thamathu kiriyaiga'lilellaam kirubaiyu'l'lavarumaayirukki'raar.
thammai noakkik kooppidugi'ra yaavarukkum, u'nmaiyaayth thammai noakkik kooppidugi'ra yaavarukkum, karththar sameebamaayirukki'raar.
avar thamakkup bayanthavarga'ludaiya viruppaththinpadi seythu, avarga'l kooppiduthalaik keattu, avarga'lai iradchikki'raar.
karththar thammil anbukoorugi'ra yaavaraiyum kaappaat'ri, thunmaarkkar yaavaraiyum azhippaar.
en vaay karththarin thuthiyaich solvathaaga; maamsatheagamu'l'la yaavum avarudaiya parisuththa naamaththai eppozhuthum en'ren'raikkum sthoaththirikkakkadavathu.
allealooyaa, en aaththumaavea, karththaraith thuthi.
naan uyiroadirukkumattum karththaraith thuthippean; naan u'l'la'lavum en theavanaik keerththanampa'n'nuvean.
pirabukka'laiyum, iradchikkaththiraa'niyillaatha manupuththiranaiyum nambaatheayungga'l.
avanudaiya aavi piriyum, avan than ma'n'nukkuth thirumbuvaan; annaa'lilea avan yoasanaiga'l azhinthupoam.
yaakkoabin theavanaith than thu'naiyaagak ko'ndirunthu, than theavanaagiya karththarmeal nambikkaiyai vaikki'ravan baakkiyavaan.
avar vaanaththaiyum boomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum avaiga'lilu'l'la yaavaiyum u'ndaakkinavar; avar en'ren'raikkum u'nmaiyaik kaakki'ravar.
avar odukkappattavarga'lukku niyaayagnseygi'raar; pasiyaayirukki'ravarga'lukku aagaarang kodukki'raar; kattu'ndavarga'laik karththar viduthalaiyaakkugi'raar.
kurudarin ka'nga'laik karththar thi'rakki'raar; madanggadikkappattavarga'laik karththar thookkividugi'raar; neethimaanga'laik karththar sineagikki'raar.
paratheasiga'laik karththar kaappaat'rugi'raar; avar thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyaiyum vithavaiyaiyum aatharikki'raar; thunmaarkkarin vazhiyaiyoa kavizhththuppoadugi'raar.
karththar sathaakaalangga'lilum arasaa'lugi'raar; seeyoanea, un theavan thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiyaagavum raajarigampa'n'nugi'raar. allealooyaa.
karththaraith thuthiyungga'l; nammudaiya theavanaik keerththanampa'n'nugi'rathu nallathu, thuthiththalea inbamum eat'rathumaayirukki'rathu.
karththar erusaleamaik kattugi'raar; thuraththu'nda isravealaraik koottich searkki'raar.
iruthayam no'runggu'ndavarga'laik ku'namaakkugi'raar, avarga'ludaiya kaayangga'laik kattugi'raar.
avar nadchaththirangga'lin ilakkaththai e'n'ni, avaiga'lukkellaam pearittu azhaikki'raar.
nammudaiya aa'ndavar periyavarum mahaa belamu'l'lavarumaayirukki'raar; avarudaiya a'rivu a'lavillaathathu.
karththar saanthaku'namu'l'lavarga'lai uyarththugi'raar; thunmaarkkaraith tharaimattum thaazhththugi'raar.
karththaraith thuthiyudan paadik ko'ndaadungga'l; nammudaiya theavanaich surama'ndalaththaal keerththanam pa'n'nungga'l.
avar vaanaththai meagangga'laal moodi, boomikku mazhaiyai aayaththappaduththi, malaiga'lil pullai mu'laippikki'raar.
avar mirugajeevanga'lukkum kooppidugi'ra kaakkaik kugnchuga'lukkum aagaarangkodukki'raar.
avar kuthiraiyin balaththil viruppamaayiraar; veeranudaiya kaalga'lil piriyappadaar.
thamakkup bayanthu, thamathu kirubaikkuk kaaththirukki'ravarga'lmeal karththar piriyamaayirukki'raar.
erusaleamea, karththarai sthoaththiri; seeyoanea, un theavanaith thuthi.
avar un vaasalga'lin thaazhppaa'lga'laip balappaduththi, unnidaththilu'l'la un pi'l'laiga'lai aaseervathikki'raar.
avar un ellaiga'laich samaathaanamu'l'lavaiga'laakki, uchchithamaana koathumaiyinaal unnaith thirupthiyaakkugi'raar.
avar thamathu vaarththaiyaip boomiyilea anuppugi'raar; avarudaiya sol mahaa theeviramaaych sellugi'rathu.
pagnchaippoal u'raintha mazhaiyaith tharugi'raar; saambalaippoala u'raintha paniyaith thoovugi'raar.
avar thamathu kalmazhaiyaith thu'nikkaiga'laaga anuppugi'raar; avarudaiya ku'lirukku munbaaga ni'rpavan yaar?
avar thamathu vaarththaiyai anuppi, avaiga'lai urugappa'n'nugi'raar; thamathu kaat'rai veesumpadi seyya, tha'n'neerga'l oadum.
yaakkoabukkuth thammudaiya vasanangga'laiyum, isravealukkuth thamathu piramaa'nangga'laiyum thamathu niyaayangga'laiyum a'rivikki'raar.
avar vea'rea entha jaathikkum ippadich seythathillai; avarudaiya niyaayangga'lai a'riyaama'rpoagi'raarga'l. allealooyaa.
allealooyaa, vaanangga'lil u'l'lavaiga'lea, karththaraith thuthiyungga'l; unnathangga'lil avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
avarudaiya thootharga'lea, neengga'l yaavarum avaraith thuthiyungga'l; avarudaiya seanaiga'lea, neengga'l yaavarum avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
sooriya santhirarea, avaraith thuthiyungga'l; piragaasamu'l'la sagala nadchaththirangga'lea, avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
vaanaathi vaanangga'lea, avaraith thuthiyungga'l; aagaayama'ndalaththinmealu'l'la tha'n'neerga'lea, avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
avaiga'l karththarin naamaththaith thuthikkakkadavathu; avar katta'laiyida avaiga'l sirushdikkappattathu.
avar avaiga'lai en'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangga'lilum nilaikkumpadi seythaar; maa'raatha piramaa'naththai avaiga'lukku niyamiththaar.
boomiyilu'l'lavaiga'lea, karththaraith thuthiyungga'l; mahaamachchangga'lea, sagala aazhangga'lea,
akkiniyea, kalmazhaiyea, u'rainthamazhaiyea, moodupaniyea, avar so'rpadi seyyum perungkaat'rea,
malaiga'lea, sagala meaduga'lea, kanimarangga'lea, sagala keathurukka'lea,
kaattumirugangga'lea, sagala naattu mirugangga'lea, oorum piraa'niga'lea, i'ragu'l'la pa'ravaiga'lea,
boomiyin raajaakka'lea, sagala janangga'lea, pirabukka'lea, boomiyilu'l'la sagala niyaayaathibathiga'lea,
vaalibarea, kannigaiga'lea, muthirvayathu'l'lavarga'lea, pi'l'laiga'lea, karththaraith thuthiyungga'l.
avarga'l karththarin naamaththaith thuthikkakkadavarga'l; avarudaiya naamam maaththiram uyarnthathu; avarudaiya magimai boomikkum vaanaththi'rkum mealaanathu.
avar thammudaiya parisuththavaanga'l yaavarukkum, thammaich searntha janamaagiya israveal puththirarukkum ko'ndaattamaaga, thammudaiya janaththi'rku oru kombai uyarththinaar. allealooyaa.
allealooyaa, karththarukkup puthuppaattaip paadungga'l; parisuththavaanga'lin sabaiyilea avarudaiya thuthi vi'langguvathaaga.
israveal thannai u'ndaakkinavaril magizhavum, seeyoan kumaarar thangga'l raajaavil ka'likooravungkadavarga'l.
avarudaiya naamaththai nadanaththoadea thuthiththu, thamburinaalum kinnaraththinaalum avaraik keerththanampa'n'nakkadavarga'l.
karththar thammudaiya janaththinmeal piriyam vaikki'raar; saanthaku'namu'l'lavarga'lai iradchippinaal alanggarippaar.
parisuththavaanga'l magimaiyoadea ka'likoornthu, thangga'l padukkaiga'linmeal kembeerippaarga'l.
jaathiga'lidaththil pazhivaanggavum, janangga'laith tha'ndikkavum,
avarga'ludaiya raajaakka'laich sanggiliga'laalum, avarga'ludaiya meanmakka'lai iruppu vilangguga'laalum kattavum, ezhuthappatta niyaayaththeerppai avarga'lpearil seluththavum,
avarga'l vaayil karththarai uyarththum thuthiyum, avarga'l kaiyil irupu'ramum karukku'l'la pattayamum irukkum.
inthak kanam avarudaiya parisuththavaanga'l yaavarukkum u'ndaagum. allealooyaa.
allealooyaa, theavanai avarudaiya parisuththa sthalaththil thuthiyungga'l; avarudaiya vallamai vi'langgum aagaaya virivaippaarththu avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
avarudaiya vallamaiyu'l'la kiriyaiga'lukkaaga avaraith thuthiyungga'l; maadchimai porunthiya avarudaiya magaththuvaththi'rkaaga avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
ekkaa'la thoniyoadea avaraith thuthiyungga'l; vee'naiyoadum surama'ndalaththoadum avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
thamburoadum nadanaththoadum avaraith thuthiyungga'l; yaazhoadum theengkuzhaloadum avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
oasaiyu'l'la kaiththaa'langga'loadum avaraith thuthiyungga'l; pearoasaiyu'l'la kaiththaa'langga'loadum avaraith thuthiyungga'l.
suvaasamu'l'la yaavum karththaraith thuthippathaaga. allealooyaa.
thaaveethin kumaaranum isravealin raajaavumaagiya saalomoanin neethimozhiga'l:
ivaiga'laal gnaanaththaiyum poathagaththaiyum a'rinthu, buththimathiga'lai u'narnthu,
viveagam, neethi, niyaayam, nithaanam enbavaiga'laippat'riya ubatheasaththai adaiyalaam.
ivaiga'l peathaiga'lukku vinaavaiyum, vaalibarukku a'rivaiyum viveagaththaiyum kodukkum.
buththimaan ivaiga'laik keattu, a'rivil thea'ruvaan; viveagi nallaaloasanaiga'lai adainthu;
neethimozhiyaiyum, athin arththaththaiyum, gnaaniga'lin vaakkiyangga'laiyum, avarga'l uraiththa puthaiporu'lga'laiyum a'rinthuko'lvaan.
karththarukkup bayappaduthalea gnaanaththin aarambam; moodar gnaanaththaiyum poathagaththaiyum asattaipa'n'nugi'raarga'l.
en maganea, un thagappan buththiyaik kea'l, un thaayin poathagaththaith tha'l'laathea.
avaiga'l un sirasukku alanggaaramaana mudiyum, un kazhuththukkuch sarappa'niyumaayirukkum.
en maganea, paaviga'l unakku nayangkaattinaalum nee sammathiyaathea.
engga'loadea vaa, iraththagnsinthumpadi naam pathivirunthu, kut'ramat'rirukki'ravarga'lai mugaantharamin'rip pidikkumpadi o'liththiruppoam;
paathaa'lam vizhungguvathupoal naam avarga'lai uyiroadea vizhungguvoam; kuzhiyil i'ranggugi'ravarga'l vizhunggappaduvathupoal avarga'lai muzhumaiyum vizhungguvoam;
vilaiyuyarntha sagalavithap poru'lga'laiyum ka'ndadaivoam; ko'l'laip poru'linaal nammudaiya veeduga'lai nirappuvoam.
engga'loadea panggaa'liyaayiru; nammellaarukkum orea pai irukkum en'ru avarga'l solvaarga'laagil;
en maganea, nee avarga'loadea vazhinadavaamal, un kaalai avarga'l paathaikku vilakkuvaayaaga.
avarga'l kaalga'l theengguseyya oadi, iraththagnsinthath theevirikki'rathu.
evvagaiyaana padchiyaanaalum sari, athin ka'nga'lukku munbaaga valaiyai virippathu viruthaa.
ivarga'loa thangga'l iraththaththi'rkea pathivirukki'raarga'l, thangga'l piraa'nanukkea o'livaiththirukki'raarga'l.
poru'laasaiyu'l'la ellaarudaiya vazhiyum ithuvea; ithu thannaiyudaiyavarga'lin uyirai vaanggum.
gnaanamaanathu ve'liyea nin'ru kooppidugi'rathu, veethiga'lil saththamidugi'rathu.
athu santhadiyu'l'la therukka'lin santhilum, olimugavaasalilum nin'ru kooppittu, patta'naththil than vaarththaiga'lai vasaniththuch sollugi'rathu:
peathaiga'lea, neengga'l peathaimaiyai virumbuvathum, ninthanaikkaararea, neengga'l ninthanaiyil piriyappaduvathum, mathiyeenarea, neengga'l gnaanaththai ve'ruppathum, ethuvaraikkum irukkum.
en kadinthuko'l'luthalukkuth thirumbungga'l; ithoa, en aaviyai ungga'lukku aru'luvean, en vaarththaiga'lai ungga'lukkuth therivippean.
naan kooppittum, neengga'l keadkamaattoam engi'reerga'l; naan en kaiyai neettiyum kavanikki'ravan oruvanum illai.
en aaloasanaiyaiyellaam neengga'l tha'l'li, en kadinthuko'l'luthalai ve'ruththeerga'l.
aagaiyaal, naanum ungga'l aabaththukkaalaththil nagaiththu, neengga'l bayappadungkaariyam varumpoathu aagadiyampa'n'nuvean.
neengga'l bayappadungkaariyam pusalpoal varumpoathum, aabaththu soo'raava'lipoal ungga'lukku nearidumpoathum, nerukkamum idukka'num ungga'lmeal varumpoathum, aagadiyampa'n'nuvean.
appozhuthu avarga'l ennai noakkik kooppiduvaarga'l; naan ma'ruuththaravu kodukkamaattean; avarga'l athikaalaiyilea ennaith theaduvaarga'l, ennaik kaa'namaattaarga'l.
avarga'l a'rivai ve'ruththaarga'l, karththarukkup bayappaduthalaith therinthu ko'l'laama'rpoanaarga'l.
en aaloasanaiyai avarga'l virumbavillai; en kadinthuko'l'luthalaiyellaam asattaipa'n'ninaarga'l.
aagaiyaal avarga'l thangga'l vazhiyin palanaip pusippaarga'l; thangga'l yoasanaiga'linaal thirupthiyadaivaarga'l.
peathaiga'lin maa'rupaadu avarga'laik kollum, moodarin nirvisaaram avarga'lai azhikkum.
enakkuch sevikodukki'ravan evanoa, avan vikkinamin'ri vaasampa'n'ni, aabaththi'rkup bayappadaamal amaithiyaayiruppaan.
en maganea, nee un seviyai gnaanaththi'rkuch saayththu, un iruthayaththaip buththikku amaiyappa'n'numporuttu,
nee en vaarththaiga'lai eat'rukko'ndu, en katta'laiga'lai unnidaththil paththirappaduththi,
gnaanaththai vaa en'ru kooppittu, buththiyaich saththamittu azhaiththu,
athai ve'l'liyaippoal naadi, puthaiyalga'laith theadugi'rathupoal theaduvaayaagil,
appozhuthu karththarukkup bayappaduthal innathen'ru nee u'narnthu, theavanai a'riyum a'rivaik ka'ndadaivaay.
karththar gnaanaththaith tharugi'raar; avar vaayinin'ru a'rivum buththiyum varum.
avar neethimaanga'lukken'ru meygngnaanaththai vaiththuvaiththirukki'raar; uththamamaay nadakki'ravarga'lukku avar keadagamaayirukki'raar.
avar niyaayaththin ne'riga'laith tha'rkaaththu, thammudaiya parisuththavaanga'lin paathaiyaik kaappaat'rugi'raar.
appozhuthu neethiyaiyum, niyaayaththaiyum, nithaanaththaiyum, sagala nalvazhiga'laiyum a'rinthuko'l'luvaay.
gnaanam un iruthayaththil piraveasiththu, a'rivu un aaththumaavukku inbamaayirukkumpoathu,
nalyoasanai unnaik kaappaat'rum, buththi unnaip paathukaakkum.
athinaal nee thunmaarkkanudaiya vazhikkum, maa'rupaadu peasugi'ra manushanukkum,
anthagaara vazhiga'lil nadakka neethine'riga'lai vittu,
theemaiseyya magizhnthu, thunmaarkkarudaiya maa'rupaaduga'lil ka'likoorugi'ravarga'lukkum,
maa'rupaadaana paathaiga'lilum koa'nalaana vazhiga'lilum nadakki'ravarga'lukkum nee thappuvikkappaduvaay.
than i'lavayathin naayaganai vittu, than theavanudaiya udanpadikkaiyai ma'ranthu,
ichchagamaana vaarththaiga'laippeasum anniya pe'n'naagiya parasthireekkum thappuvikkappaduvaay.
ava'ludaiya veedu mara'naththukkum, ava'ludaiya paathaiga'l mariththoaridaththi'rkum saaygi'rathu.
ava'lidaththil poagi'ravarga'lil oruvarum thirumbugi'rathillai, jeevapaathaiga'lil vanthu searugi'rathumillai.
aathalaal nee nallavarga'lin vazhiyilea nadanthu, neethimaanga'lin paathaiga'laik kaaththukko'lvaayaaga.
sevvaiyaanavarga'l boomiyilea vaasampa'n'nuvaarga'l; uththamarga'l athilea thanggiyiruppaarga'l.
thunmaarkkaroa boomiyilirunthu a'ruppu'ndupoavaarga'l; thuroagiga'l athil iraathapadikku nirmoolamaavaarga'l.
en maganea, en poathagaththai ma'ravaathea; un iruthayam en katta'laiga'laik kaakkakkadavathu.
avaiga'l unakku neediththa naadka'laiyum, theerkkaayusaiyum, samaathaanaththaiyum perugappa'n'num.
kirubaiyum saththiyamum unnaivittu vilagaathiruppathaaga; nee avaiga'lai un kazhuththilea poo'ndu, avaiga'lai un iruthayamaagiya palagaiyil ezhuthikko'l.
athinaal theavanudaiya paarvaiyilum manusharudaiya paarvaiyilum thayaiyum na'rbuththiyum pe'ruvaay.
un suyabuththiyinmeal saayaamal, un muzhu iruthayaththoadum karththaril nambikkaiyaayirunthu,
un vazhiga'lilellaam avarai ninaiththukko'l; appozhuthu avar un paathaiga'laich sevvaippaduththuvaar.
nee unnai gnaaniyen'ru e'n'naathea; karththarukkup bayanthu, theemaiyai vittu vilagu.
athu un naabikku aaroakkiyamum, un elumbuga'lukku oonumaagum.
un poru'laalum, un ellaa vi'laivin mutha'rpalanaalum karththaraik kanampa'n'nu.
appozhuthu un ka'lagnchiyangga'l poora'namaay nirambum; un aalaiga'lil thiraadcharasam pura'ndoadum.
en maganea, nee karththarudaiya sidchaiyai a'rpamaaga e'n'naathea, avar kadinthuko'l'lumpoathu soarnthupoagaathea.
thagappan thaan neasikki'ra puththiranaich sidchikki'rathupoala, karththarum evanidaththil anbukoorugi'raaroa avanaich sidchikki'raar.
gnaanaththaik ka'ndadaigi'ra manushanum, buththiyaich sambaathikki'ra manushanum baakkiyavaanga'l.
athin varththagam ve'l'li varththagaththilum, athin aathaayam pasumponnilum uththamamaanathu.
muththukka'laippaarkkilum athu vilaiyea'rappet'rathu; nee ichchikkaththakkathon'rum atha'rku nigaralla.
athin valathukaiyil theerkkaayusum, athin idathukaiyil selvamum kanamum irukki'rathu.
athin vazhiga'l inithaana vazhiga'l, athin paathaiga'lellaam samaathaanam.
athu thannai adainthavarga'lukku jeevavirudcham, athaip pat'rikko'l'lugi'ra evanum baakkiyavaan.
karththar gnaanaththinaalea boomiyai asthibaarappaduththi, buththiyinaalea vaanangga'lai sthaabiththaar.
avarudaiya gnaanaththinaalea aazhangga'l pirinthathu, aagaayamum paniyaip peygi'rathu.
en maganea, ivaiga'l un ka'nga'lai vittup piriyaathiruppathaaga; meygngnaanaththaiyum nallaaloasanaiyaiyum kaaththukko'l.
avaiga'l un aaththumaavukku jeevanum, un kazhuththukku alanggaaramumaayirukkum.
appozhuthu nee bayamin'ri un vazhiyil nadappaay, un kaal ida'raathu.
nee padukkumpoathu bayappadaathiruppaay; nee paduththukko'l'lumpoathu un niththirai inbamaayirukkum.
sadithiyaana thigilum, thushdarga'lin paazhkkadippum varumpoathu nee agnchavea'ndaam.
karththar un nambikkaiyaayirunthu, un kaal sikkikko'l'laathapadi kaappaar.
nanmaiseyyumpadi unakkuth thiraa'niyirukkumpoathu, athaich seyyaththakkavarga'lukkuch seyyaamal iraathea.
unnidaththil poru'l irukkaiyil un ayalaanai noakki: nee poayth thirumbavaa, naa'laikkuth tharuvean en'ru sollaathea.
achchamin'ri unnidaththil vaasampa'n'nugi'ra un ayalaanukku viroathamaaga theenggu ninaiyaathea.
oruvan unakkuth theengguseyyaathirukka, kaara'namin'ri avanoadea vazhakkaadaathea.
kodumaiyu'l'lavanmeal po'raamai ko'l'laathea; avanudaiya vazhiga'lil on'raiyum therinthuko'l'laathea.
maa'rupaadu'l'lavan karththarukku aruvaruppaanavan; neethimaanga'loadea avarudaiya iragasiyam irukki'rathu.
thunmaarkkanudaiya veettil karththarin saabam irukki'rathu, neethimaanga'ludaiya vaasasthalaththaiyoa avar aaseervathikki'raar.
igazhvoarai avar igazhugi'raar; thaazhmaiyu'l'lavarga'lukkoa kirubaiya'likki'raar.
gnaanavaanga'l kanaththaich suthantharippaarga'l; mathikeadaroa kanaveenaththai adaivaarga'l.
pi'l'laiga'lea, neengga'l thagappan poathagaththaik keattu, buththiyai adaiyumpadi kavaniyungga'l.
naan ungga'lukku na'rpoathagaththaith tharugi'rean; en ubatheasaththai vidaathirungga'l.
naan en thagappanukkup piriyamaana kumaaranum, en thaaykku migavum arumaiyaana orea pi'l'laiyumaanavan.
avar enakkup poathiththuch sonnathu: un iruthayam en vaarththaiga'laik kaaththukko'l'lakkadavathu; en katta'laiga'laik kaikko'l, appozhuthu pizhaippaay.
gnaanaththaich sambaathi, buththiyaiyum sambaathi; en vaayin vaarththaiga'lai ma'ravaamalum vittu vilagaamalum iru.
athai vidaathea, athu unnaith tha'rkaakkum; athinmeal piriyamaayiru, athu unnaik kaaththukko'l'lum.
gnaanamea mukkiyam, gnaanaththaich sambaathi; ennaththaich sambaathiththaalum buththiyaich sambaathiththukko'l.
nee athai meanmaippaduththu, athu unnai meanmaippaduththum; nee athaith thazhuvikko'ndaal, athu unnaik kanampa'n'num.
athu un thalaikku alanggaaramaana mudiyaik kodukkum; athu magimaiyaana kireedaththai unakkuch soottum.
en maganea, kea'l, en vaarththaiga'lai eat'rukko'l; appozhuthu un aayusin varushangga'l athigamaagum.
gnaanamaarkkaththai naan unakkup poathiththean; sevvaiyaana paathaiga'lilea unnai nadaththinean.
nee avaiga'lil nadakkumpoathu un nadaiga'lukku idukka'n u'ndaavathillai; nee avaiga'lil oadinaalum ida'ramaattaay.
buththimathiyai u'ruthiyaayp pat'rikko'l, athai vittuvidaathea; athaik kaaththukko'l, athuvea unakku jeevan.
thunmaarkkarudaiya paathaiyil piraveasiyaathea; theeyoarudaiya vazhiyil nadavaathea.
athai ve'ruththuvidu, athin vazhiyaayp poagaathea; athai vittu vilagik kadanthupoa.
pollaappuch seythaalozhiya avarga'lukku niththirai varaathu; avarga'l yaaraiyaagilum vizhappa'n'naathirunthaal avarga'l thookkam kalainthupoam.
avarga'l aagaamiyaththin appaththaip pusiththu, kodumaiyin irasaththaik kudikki'raarga'l.
neethimaanga'ludaiya paathai naduppagalvaraikkum athigamathigamaayp piragaasikki'ra sooriyappiragaasampoalirukkum.
thunmaarkkarudaiya paathaiyoa kaariru'laippoalirukkum; thaangga'l ida'ruvathu innathil en'ru a'riyaarga'l.
en maganea, en vaarththaiga'laik kavani; en vasanangga'lukku un seviyaich saay.
avaiga'l un ka'nga'lai vittup piriyaathiruppathaaga; avaiga'lai un iruthayaththukku'l'lea kaaththukko'l.
avaiga'laik ka'ndupidikki'ravarga'lukku avaiga'l jeevanum, avarga'l udalukkellaam aaroakkiyamumaam.
ellaak kaavaloadum un iruthayaththaik kaaththukko'l, athinidaththinin'ru jeevaoot'ru pu'rappadum.
vaayin thaa'rumaa'ruga'lai unnai vittagat'ri, uthaduga'lin maa'rupaattai unakkuth thoorappaduththu.
un ka'nga'l nearaay noakkakkadavathu; un ka'n'nimaiga'l unakku munnea sevvaiyaayp paarkkakkadavathu.
un kaal nadaiyaich seerthookkippaar; un vazhiga'lellaam nilaivarappattiruppathaaga.
valathupu'ramaavathu idathupu'ramaavathu saayaathea; un kaalaith theemaikku vilakkuvaayaaga.
en maganea, en gnaanaththaik kavaniththu, en buththikku un seviyaich saay;
appozhuthu nee viveagaththaip pea'nikko'lvaay, un uthaduga'l a'rivaik kaaththukko'l'lum.
parasthireeyin uthaduga'l theankoodupoal ozhugum; ava'l vaay e'n'neyilum miruthuvaayirukkum.
ava'l seygaiyin mudivoa ettiyaippoalak kasappum, irupu'ramung karukku'l'la pattayampoal koormaiyumaayirukkum.
ava'l kaaladiga'l mara'naththukku i'ranggum; ava'l nadaiga'l paathaa'laththaip pat'rippoagum.
nee jeevamaarkkaththaich sinthiththuk ko'l'laathapadikku, ava'ludaiya nadaiga'l maa'rimaa'ri vigaarappadum; avaiga'lai a'riyamudiyaathu.
aathalaal pi'l'laiga'lea, ippozhuthu enakkuch sevikodungga'l; en vaayin vasanangga'lai vittu neenggaathirungga'l.
un vazhiyai ava'lukkuth thoorappaduththu; ava'ludaiya veettin vaasalaik kittich searaathea.
searnthaal un meanmaiyai anniyarga'lukkum, un aayusin kaalaththaik kodoorarukkum koduththuviduvaay.
anniyar un selvaththinaal thirupthiyadaivaarga'l; un pirayaasaththin palan pu'raththiyaarudaiya veettil searum.
mudivilea un maamsamum un sareeramum uruvazhiyumpoathu nee thukkiththu:
aiyoa, poathagaththai naan ve'ruththeanea, kadinthuko'l'luthalai en manam aladchiyampa'n'ninathea!
en poathagarin sollai naan kea'laamalum, enakku ubatheasampa'n'ninavarga'lukku en seviyaich saayaamalum poaneanea!
sabaikku'l'lum sanggaththukku'l'lum kognchangku'raiya ellaath theemaikkumu'l'laaneanea! en'ru mu'raiyiduvaay.
un ki'nat'rilu'l'la tha'n'neeraiyum, un thuravil oo'rugi'ra jalaththaiyum baanampa'n'nu.
un oot'ruga'l ve'liyilum un vaaykkaalga'l veethiga'lilum paayvathaaga.
avaiga'l anniyarukkum uriyavaiga'laayiraamal, unakkea uriyavaiga'laayiruppathaaga.
un oot'rukka'n aaseervathikkappaduvathaaga; un i'lavayathin manaiviyoadea magizhnthiru.

ava'lea neasikkappadaththakka pe'nmaanum, azhagaana varaiyaadumpoaliruppaa'laaga; ava'ludaiya sthanangga'lea eppozhuthum unnaith thirupthiseyvathaaga; ava'ludaiya neasaththaal nee eppozhuthum mayanggiyiruppaayaaga.
en maganea, nee parasthireeyinmeal mayanggith thirinthu, anniya sthireeyin maarbaith thazhuvavea'ndiyathenna?
manushanudaiya vazhiga'l karththarin ka'nga'lukku munbaaga irukki'rathu; avanudaiya vazhiga'lellaavat'raiyum avar seerthookkippaarkki'raar.
thunmaarkkanai avanudaiya akkiramangga'lea pidiththukko'l'lum; than paavakkayi'ruga'laal kattappaduvaan.
avan buththiyaik kea'laathathinaal madinthu, than mathikeattin miguthiyinaal mayanggippoavaan.
en maganea, nee un sineagithanukkaagap pi'naippattu, anniyanukkuk kaiyadiththukkoduththaayaanaal,
nee un vaaymozhiga'laal sikku'ndaay, un vaayin vaarththaiga'laal pidipattaay.
ippozhuthu en maganea, un sineagithanudaiya kaiyil nee agappattukko'ndapadiyaal, nee unnaith thappuviththukko'l'la on'ru sey.
un ka'n'nukku niththiraiyum, un ka'n'nimaikkuth thookkamum varavidaamal, un sineagithanidaththil poay, unnaith thaazhththi, avanai varunthik keattukko'l.
ve'limaan veattaikkaaran kaikkum, kuruvi veadan kaikkum thappuvathupoala, nee unnaith thappuviththukko'l.
soambea'riyea, nee e'rumbinidaththilpoay, athin vazhiga'laip paarththu, gnaanaththaik kat'rukko'l.
atha'rkup pirabuvum, thalaivanum, athigaariyum illaathirunthum,
koadaikaalaththil thanakku aagaaraththaich sambaathiththu, a'ruppukkaalaththil thanakkuth thaaniyaththaich searththuvaikkum.
soambea'riyea, nee evva'lavunearam paduththiruppaay? eppozhuthu un thookkaththaivittu ezhunthiruppaay?
innung kogncham thoonggattum, innung kogncham u'ranggattum, innung kogncham kaimudakkikko'ndu niththirai seyyattum enbaayoa?
un thariththiram vazhippoakkanaippoalavum, un va'rumai aayuthama'ninthavanaippoalavum varum.
bealiyaa'lin manushanaagiya oru thunmaarkkan aagadiyam peasiththirigi'raan.
avan than ka'nga'laal saigaikaatti, than kaalga'laal peasi, than viralga'laal poathanaiseygi'raan.
avan iruthayaththilea thiriyaavaramu'ndu; idaividaamal pollaappaip pi'naiththu, vazhakkuga'lai u'ndupa'n'nugi'raan.
aagaiyaal sadithiyil avanukku aabaththu varum; sagaayamin'rich sadithiyil naasamadaivaan.
aa'ru kaariyangga'laik karththar ve'rukki'raar, eazhum avarukku aruvaruppaanavaiga'l.
avaiyaavana: meattimaiyaana ka'n, poynaavu, kut'ramat'ravarga'ludaiya iraththam sinthung kai,
thuraaloasanaiyaip pi'naikkum iruthayam, theenggu seyvatha'rku virainthoadung kaal,
abaththampeasum poychsaadchi, sagoathararukku'l'lea viroathaththai u'ndupa'n'nuthal aagiya ivaiga'lea.
en maganea, un thagappan ka'rpanaiyaik kaaththukko'l; un thaayin poathagaththaith tha'l'laathea.
avaiga'lai eppozhuthum un iruthayaththilea a'ninthu, avaiga'lai un kazhuththilea kattikko'l.
nee nadakkumpoathu athu unakku vazhikaattum; nee padukkumpoathu athu unnaik kaappaat'rum; nee vizhikkumpoathu athu unnoadea sambaashikkum.
katta'laiyea vi'lakku, veathamea ve'lichcham, poathagasidchaiyea jeevavazhi.
athu unnaith thunmaarkka sthireekkum, ichchagampeasum naavaiyudaiya parasthireekkum vilakkik kaakkum.
un iruthayaththilea ava'l azhagai ichchiyaathea; ava'l than ka'n'nimaiga'linaal unnaip pidikkavidaathea.
veasiyinimiththam oru appaththu'nikkaiyaiyum irakkavea'ndiyathaagum; vibasaariyaanava'l arumaiyaana uyirai veattaiyaadugi'raa'l.
than vasthiram veagaamal madiyilea evanaavathu neruppai vaiththukko'l'lakkoodumoa?
than kaal sudaamal evanaavathu thazhalinmeal nadakkakkoodumoa?
pi'ranudaiya manaiviyidaththil piraveasippavanum, appadiyea ava'laith thodugi'ra evanum, aakkinaikkuth thappaan.
thirudan than pasiyai aat'rath thirudinaal janangga'l avanai igazhamaattaarga'l;
avan ka'ndupidikkappattaal eazhumadanggu koduththuth theeravea'ndum; than veettilu'l'la poru'lga'laiyellaam kodukkavea'ndiyathaagum.
sthireeyudanea vibasaarampa'n'nugi'ravan mathikettavan; appadich seygi'ravan than aaththumaavaik keduththuppoadugi'raan.
vaathaiyaiyum ilachchaiyaiyum adaivaan; avan ninthai ozhiyaathu.
sthireeyaippat'riya erichchal purushanukku moorkkaththai u'ndupa'n'num; avan pazhivaanggum naa'lil thappavidaan.
avan entha eettaiyum paaraan; aneagam vegumathiga'laik koduththaalum amarnthirukkamaattaan.
en maganea, nee en vaarththaiga'laik kaaththu, en katta'laiga'lai unnidaththil paththirappaduththu.
en katta'laiga'laiyum en poathagaththaiyum un ka'nma'niyaippoal kaaththukko'l, appozhuthu pizhaippaay.
avaiga'lai un viralga'lil katti, avaiga'lai un iruthaya palagaiyil ezhuthikko'l.
ichchagavaarththaiga'laip peasum anniya pe'n'naagiya parasthireekku unnai vilakkik kaappatha'rkaaga,
gnaanaththai noakki, nee en sagoathari en'rum, buththiyaippaarththu, nee en inaththaa'l en'rum solvaayaaga.
naan en veettin jannalarugea nin'ru, palaga'ni vazhiyaayp paarththapoathu,
peathaiyarga'laagiya vaalibarukku'l'lea oru buththiyeena vaalibanaikka'ndu avanaik kavaniththean.
avan maalaimayanggum asthamananearaththilum, iravin iru'nda anthagaaraththilum,
ava'l irukkum santhukkaduththa theruvil sen'ru, ava'l veettuvazhiyaay nadanthupoanaan.
appozhuthu ithoa, veasiyin aadaiyaabara'nanthariththa thanthiramanamu'l'la oru sthiree avanukku ethirppattaa'l.
ava'l vaayaadiyum adanggaathava'lumaanava'l; ava'l kaalga'l veettilea tharikki'rathillai.
silavea'lai ve'liyiliruppaa'l, silavea'lai veethiyiliruppaa'l, santhuga'lthoa'rum pathiviruppaa'l.
ava'l avanaip pidiththu muththagnseythu, mugam naa'naamal avanaip paarththu:
samaathaana baliga'l enmeal sumanthirunthathu, in'raikkuththaan en poruththanaiga'lai ni'raiveat'rinean.
aathalaal, naan unnaich santhikkap pu'rappattu, un mugaththai aavaloadu theadinean; ippozhuthu unnaik ka'ndupidiththean.
en magnchaththai iraththina kamba'langga'laalum, egipthutheasaththu visiththiramaana melliya vasthirangga'laalum singgaariththean.
en padukkaiyai ve'l'laippoa'laththaalum santhanaththaalum ilavanggappattaiyaalum vaasanai kattinean.
vaa, vidiya'rkaalamvaraikkum samboagamaayiruppoam, inbangga'linaal poorippoam.
purushan veettilea illai, thoorap pirayaa'nam poanaan.
pa'nappaiyaith than kaiyilea ko'ndupoanaan, ku'rikkappatta naa'lilea veettukku varuvaan en'ru solli,
than miguthiyaana iniya so'rka'laal avanai vasappaduththi, than uthaduga'lin mathuravaakkinaal avanai i'nanggappa'n'ninaa'l.
udanea avan ava'l pinnea sen'raan; oru maadu adikkappadumpadi selvathupoalum, oru moodan vilanggidappattuth tha'ndanaikkup poavathu poalum,
oru kuruvi than piraa'nanai vaanggum ka'n'niyai a'riyaamal athil vizhath theevirikki'rathupoalum, ava'lukkup pinnea poanaan; ambu avan eeralaip pi'lanthathu.
aathalaal pi'l'laiga'lea, enakkuch sevikodungga'l; en vaayin vaarththaiga'laik kavaniyungga'l.
un iruthayam ava'l vazhiyilea saayavea'ndaam; ava'l paathaiyilea mayanggith thiriyaathea.
ava'l aneagaraik kaayappaduththi, vizhappa'n'ninaa'l; balavaanga'l aneagaraik kolaiseythaa'l.
ava'l veedu paathaa'laththukkuppoam vazhi; athu mara'na a'raiga'lukkuk ko'ndupoayvidum.
gnaanam kooppidugi'rathillaiyoa? buththi saththamidugi'rathillaiyoa?
athu vazhiyarugeayu'l'la meadaiga'lilum, naa'rsanthiga'lilum ni'rki'rathu.
athu oorvaasalga'lin oaraththilum, patta'naththin mugappilum, nadai koodangga'lilum nin'ru saththamittu:
manusharea, ungga'lai noakkik kooppidugi'rean; en saththam manupuththirarukkuth thonikkum.
peathaiga'lea, viveagam adaiyungga'l; moodarga'lea, buththiyu'l'la sinthaiyaayirungga'l.
kea'lungga'l, meampaadaana kaariyangga'laip peasuvean; en uthaduga'l uththama kaariyangga'lai vasanikkum.
en vaay saththiyaththai vi'lambum, aagaamiyam en uthaduga'lukku aruvaruppaanathu.
en vaayin vaakkuga'lellaam neethiyaanavaiga'l; avaiga'lil purattum vibareethamum illai.
avaiga'lellaam buththiyu'l'lavanukkuth the'livum, gnaanaththaip pet'ravarga'lukku yathaarththamumaayirukkum.
ve'l'liyaippaarkkilum en buththimathiyaiyum, pasumponnaippaarkkilum gnaanaththaiyum anggeegariththukko'l'lungga'l.
muththukka'laippaarkkilum gnaanamea nallathu; ichchikkappadaththakkavaiga'lellaam atha'rku nigaralla.
gnaanamaagiya naan viveagaththoadea vaasampa'n'ni, nalyukthiyaana a'rivuga'laik ka'ndadaigi'rean.
theemaiyai ve'ruppathea karththarukkup bayappadum bayam; perumaiyaiyum, aganthaiyaiyum, theeya vazhiyaiyum, purattuvaayaiyum naan ve'rukki'rean.
aaloasanaiyum meygngnaanamum ennudaiyavaiga'l; naanea buththi, vallamai ennudaiyathu.
ennaalea raajaakka'l arasaa'lugi'raarga'l, pirabukka'l neethiseluththugi'raarga'l.
ennaalea athigaariga'lum, pirabukka'lum, boomiyilu'l'la sagala niyaayaathibathiga'lum aa'lugaiseythuvarugi'raarga'l.
ennaich sineagikki'ravarga'lai naan sineagikki'rean; athikaalaiyil ennaith theadugi'ravarga'l ennaik ka'ndadaivaarga'l.
aisuvariyamum, kanamum, nilaiyaana poru'lum, neethiyum ennidaththil u'ndu.
ponnaiyum thanggaththaiyum paarkkilum en palan nallathu; suththa ve'l'liyaippaarkkilum en varumaanam nallathu.
ennaich sineagikki'ravarga'l meypporu'laich suthantharikkumpadikkum, avarga'ludaiya ka'lagnchiyangga'lai naan nirappumpadikkum,
avarga'lai neethiyin vazhiyilum, niyaayapaathaiga'lukku'l'lum nadaththugi'rean.
karththar thamathu kiriyaiga'lukkumun poorvamuthal ennaith thamathu vazhiyin aathiyaagak ko'ndirunthaar.
boomi u'ndaagumunnum, aathimutha'rko'ndum anaathiyaay naan abisheagampa'n'nappattean.
aazhangga'lum, jalam pura'nduvarum oot'ruga'lum u'ndaagumunnea naan janippikkappattean.
malaiga'l nilaipe'ruvatha'rku munnum, kun'ruga'l u'ndaavatha'rku munnum,
avar boomiyaiyum athin ve'liga'laiyum, boomiyilu'l'la ma'n'nin thira'lga'laiyum u'ndaakkumunnum naan janippikkappattean.
avar vaanangga'laip padaikkaiyil naan anggea irunthean; avar samuththira vilaasaththai vatta'nikkaiyilum,
uyaraththil meagangga'lai sthaabiththu, samuththiraththin oot'ruga'lai adaiththu vaikkaiyilum,
samuththira jalam than karaiyai vittu mee'raathapadikku atha'rku ellaiyaik katta'laiyittu, boomiyin asthibaarangga'lai nilaippaduththugaiyilum,
naan avar arugea sellappi'l'laiyaayirunthean; niththam avarudaiya manamagizhchchiyaayirunthu, eppozhuthum avar samugaththil ka'likoornthean.
avarudaiya poovulagaththil santhoashappattu, manumakka'ludanea magizhnthuko'ndirunthean.
aathalaal pi'l'laiga'lea, enakkuch sevikodungga'l; en vazhiga'laik kaaththu nadakki'ravarga'l baakkiyavaanga'l.
neengga'l buththiyaik keattu, gnaanamadaiyungga'l; athai vittu vilagaathirungga'l.
en vaasa'rpadiyil niththam vizhiththirunthu, en kathavu nilaiyarugea kaaththirunthu, enakkuch sevikodukki'ra manushan baakkiyavaan.
ennaik ka'ndadaigi'ravan jeevanaik ka'ndadaigi'raan; karththaridaththil thayavaiyum pe'ruvaan.
enakku viroathamaagap paavagnseygi'ravanoa, than aaththumaavaich seathappaduththugi'raan; ennai ve'rukki'ravarga'l yaavarum mara'naththai virumbugi'ravarga'l en'ru sollugi'rathu.
gnaanam than veettaik katti, than eazhu thoo'nga'laiyum siththirantheerththu,
than kozhuththa janthukka'lai adiththu, thiraadcharasaththai vaarththuvaiththu, than poajanapanthiyai aayaththappaduththi,
than pa'nividaikkaariga'lai anuppi, patta'naththin uyarntha meadaiga'linmeal nin'ru kooppittu,

buththimathiyaith tha'l'lividugi'ravan than aaththumaavai ve'rukki'raan; kadinthuko'l'luthalaik keadki'ravanoa gnaanamadaivaan.
karththarukkup bayappaduthal gnaanaththaip poathikkum; meanmaikku munnaanathu thaazhmai.
manathin yoasanaiga'l manushanudaiyathu; naavin pirathiyuththaram karththaraal varum.
manushanudaiya vazhiga'lellaam avan paarvaikkuch suththamaanavaiga'l; karththaroa aaviga'lai ni'ruththuppaarkki'raar.
un seygaiga'laik karththarukku oppuvi; appozhuthu un yoasanaiga'l u'ruthippadum.
karththar sagalaththaiyum thamakken'ru padaiththaar; theenggunaa'lukkaagath thunmaarkkanaiyum u'ndaakkinaar.
manameattimaiyu'l'lavanevanum karththarukku aruvaruppaanavan; kaiyoadea kaikoarththaalum avan tha'ndanaikkuth thappaan.
kirubaiyinaalum saththiyaththinaalum paavam nivirththiyaagum; karththarukkup bayappadugi'rathinaal manushar theemaiyai vittu vilaguvaarga'l.
oruvanudaiya vazhiga'l karththarukkup piriyamaayirunthaal, avanudaiya saththurukka'lum avanoadea samaathaanamaagumpadi seyvaar.
aniyaayamaay vantha athiga varumaanaththilum, niyaayamaay vantha kogncha varumaanamea uththamam.
manushanudaiya iruthayam avanudaiya vazhiyai yoasikkum; avanudaiya nadaiga'lai u'ruthippaduththugi'ravaroa karththar.
raajaavin uthaduga'lil thivviya vaakku pi'rakkum; niyaayaththil avan vaay thava'raathu.
sumuththiraiyaana ni'raikoalum tharaasum karththarudaiyathu; paiyilirukkum ni'raikallellaam avarudaiya seyal.
aniyaayagnseyvathu raajaakka'lukku aruvaruppu; neethiyinaal singgaasanam u'ruthippadum.
neethiyu'l'la uthaduga'l raajaakka'lukkup piriyam; nithaanamaayp peasugi'ravanil raajaakka'l piriyappaduvaarga'l.
raajaavin koabam mara'nathootharukkuch samaanam; gnaanamu'l'lavanoa athai aat'ruvaan.
raajaavin mugakka'laiyil jeevan u'ndu; avanudaiya thayai pinmaari peyyum meagaththaippoal irukkum.
ponnaich sambaathippathilum gnaanaththaich sambaathippathu evva'lavu uththamam! ve'l'liyaich sambaathippathilum buththiyaich sambaathippathu evva'lavu meanmai!
theemaiyai vittu vilaguvathea semmaiyaanavarga'lukkuch samanaana paathai; than nadaiyaik kavaniththirukki'ravan than aaththumaavaik kaakki'raan.
azhivukku munnaanathu aganthai; vizhuthalukku munnaanathu manameattimai.
aganggaariga'loadea ko'l'laip poru'laip panggiduvathaippaarkkilum, si'rumaiyaanavarga'loadea manaththaazhmaiyaayiruppathu nalam.
viveagaththudan kaariyaththai nadappikki'ravan nanmaipe'ruvaan; karththarai nambugi'ravan baakkiyavaan.
iruthayaththil gnaanamu'l'lavan viveagiyennappaduvaan; uthaduga'lin mathuram kalviyaip perugappa'n'num.
buththi thannai udaiyavarga'lukku jeeva oot'ru; mathiyeenarin poathanai mathiyeenamea.
gnaaniyin iruthayam avan vaaykku a'rivaiyoottum; avan uthaduga'lukku athu meanmealum kalviyaik kodukkum.
iniya so'rka'l theankoodupoal aaththumaavukku mathuramum, elumbuga'lukku aushathamumaagum.
manushanukkuch semmaiyaayth thoan'rugi'ra vazhiyu'ndu; athin mudivoa mara'na vazhiga'l.
pirayaasappadugi'ravan thanakkaagavea pirayaasappadugi'raan; avan vaay athai avanidaththil varunthik keadkum.
bealiyaa'lin magan ki'ndividugi'raan; erigi'ra akkinipoan'rathu avan uthaduga'lil irukki'rathu.
maa'rupaadu'l'lavan sa'ndaiyaik ki'lappividugi'raan; koa'l sollugi'ravan piraa'nasineagitharaiyum piriththuvidugi'raan.

katta'laiyaik kaaththukko'l'lugi'ravan than aaththumaavaik kaakki'raan; than vazhiga'lai avamathikki'ravan saavaan.

nambikkaiyirukkumattum un maganaich sidchaisey; aanaalum avanaik kolla un aaththumaavai ezhumbavottaathea.
kadungkoabi aakkinaikku'l'laavaan; nee avanaith thappuviththaal thirumbavum thappuvikkavea'ndiyathaay varum.
un anthiyakaalaththil nee gnaanamu'l'lavanaayirukkumpadi, aaloasanaiyaikkeattu, buththimathiyai eat'rukko'l.
manushanudaiya iruthayaththin e'n'nangga'l aneagam; aanaalum karththarudaiya yoasanaiyea nilaini'rkum.
nanmaiseyya manushan ko'ndirukkum aasaiyea thayai; poyyanaippaarkkilum thariththiran vaasi.
karththarukkup bayappaduthal jeevanukkeathuvaanathu; athai adainthavan thirupthiyadainthu nilaiththiruppaan; theemai avanai a'nugaathu.
soambea'ri than kaiyaik kalaththilea vaiththu, athaith thirumbath than vaaya'ndaikku edukkaamalirukki'raan.
pariyaasakkaaranai adi, appozhuthu peathai echcharikkappaduvaan; buththimaanaik kadinthuko'l, avan a'rivu'l'lavanaavaan.

en maganea, a'rivaith tharum vaarththaiga'lai vittu vilagachseyyum poathagangga'lai nee kea'laathea.
bealiyaa'lin saadchikkaaran niyaayaththai ninthikki'raan; thunmaarkkarudaiya vaay akkiramaththai vizhunggum.
pariyaasakkaararukkuth tha'ndanaiga'lum, moodarudaiya muthugukku adiga'lum aayaththamaayirukki'rathu.
thiraadcharasam pariyaasagnseyyum, mathubaanam ama'lipa'n'num; athinaal mayanggugi'ra oruvanum gnaanavaanalla.
raajaavin u'rukkuthal singgaththin kerchchippukkuch samaanam; avanaik koabappaduththugi'ravan than piraa'nanukkea thuroagagnseygi'raan.
vazhakkukku vilaguvathu manushanukku meanmai; moodanaanavan evanum athilea thalaiyittukko'lvaan.
soambea'ri ku'lirugi'rathen'ru uzhamaattaan; a'ruppilea pichchaikeattaalum avanukku on'rungkidaiyaathu.
manushanudaiya iruthayaththilu'l'la yoasanai aazhamaana tha'n'neerpoalirukki'rathu; buththimaanoa athai mo'ndeduppaan.
manushar perumbaalum thangga'l thayaa'laththaip pirasiththappaduththuvaarga'l; u'nmaiyaana manushanaik ka'ndupidippavan yaar?
neethimaan than uththamaththilea nadakki'raan; avanukkuppi'ragu avan pi'l'laiga'lum baakkiyavaanga'laayiruppaarga'l.
niyaayaasanaththil veet'rirukkum raajaa than ka'nga'linaal sagala pollaappaiyum sitha'rappa'n'nugi'raan.
en iruthayaththaich suththamaakkinean, en paavama'rath thuppuravaanean en'ru sollaththakkavan yaar?
vevvea'raana ni'raikallum, vevvea'raana marakkaalum aagiya ivvira'ndum karththarukku aruvaruppaanavaiga'l.
pi'l'laiyaanaalum, athin seygai suththamoa semmaiyoa enbathu, athin nadakkaiyinaal vi'langgum.
keadki'ra kaathum, kaa'ngi'ra ka'n'num aagiya ivvira'ndaiyum karththar u'ndaakkinaar.
thookkaththai virumbaathea, virumbinaal thariththiranaavaay; ka'nvizhiththiru, appozhuthu aagaaraththinaal thirupthiyaavaay.
ko'l'lugi'ravan: nallathalla, nallathalla enbaan; poayvittapinboa mechchikko'lvaan.
ponnum miguthiyaana muththukka'lum u'ndu; a'rivu'l'la uthaduga'loa vilaiyuyarntha iraththinam.
anniyanukkaagap pi'naippattavanudaiya vasthiraththai eduththukko'l; anniya sthireeyinimiththam avan kaiyil eedu vaanggikko'l.
vagnchanaiyinaal vantha poajanam manushanukku inbamaayirukkum; pinboa avanudaiya vaay parukkaikka'rka'laal nirappappadum.
aaloasanaiyinaal e'n'nangga'l sthirappadum; nalyoasanai seythu yuththampa'n'nu.
thoot'rikko'ndu thirigi'ravan iragasiyangga'lai ve'lippaduththuvaan; aathalaal than uthaduga'linaal alappugi'ravanoadea kalavaathea.
than thagappanaiyum than thaayaiyum thooshikki'ravanudaiya theebam kaariru'lil a'nainthupoam.
aarambaththilea thurithamaagak kidaiththa suthantharam mudivilea aaseervaatham pe'raathu.
theemaikkuch sarikkattuvean en'ru sollaathea; karththarukkuk kaaththiru, avar unnai iradchippaar.
vevvea'raana ni'raika'rka'l karththarukku aruvaruppaanavaiga'l; ka'l'lath tharaasu nallathalla.
karththaraalea manusharudaiya nadaiga'l vaaykkum; aagaiyaal manushan than vazhiyai a'rinthuko'lvatheppadi?
parisuththamaanathai vizhunggugi'rathum, poruththanai seythapinbu yoasikki'rathum, manushanukkuk ka'n'niyaayirukkum.
gnaanamu'l'la raajaa thunmaarkkaraich sitha'radiththu, avarga'lmeal uru'laiyai uruttuvaan.
manushanudaiya aavi karththar thantha theebamaayirukki'rathu; athu u'l'laththil u'l'lavaiga'laiyellaam aaraaynthupaarkkum.
thayaiyum saththiyamum raajaavaik kaakkum; thayaiyinaalea than singgaasanaththai ni'rkappa'n'nuvaan.
vaalibarin alanggaaram avarga'l baraakkiramam; muthirvayathaanavarga'lin magimai avarga'l narai.
kaayaththin thazhumbuga'lum, u'l'laththil u'raikkum adiga'lum, pollaathavanai azhukka'rath thudaikkum.
raajaavin iruthayam karththarin kaiyil neerkkaalga'laippoalirukki'rathu; athaith thamathu siththaththinpadi avar thiruppugi'raar.
manushanudaiya vazhiyellaam avan paarvaikkuch semmaiyaagath thoan'rum; karththaroa iruthayangga'lai ni'ruththuppaarkki'raar.
baliyiduvathaippaarkkilum, neethiyum niyaayamum seyvathea karththarukkup piriyam.
meattimaiyaana paarvaiyum, aganthaiyaana manamumu'l'la thunmaarkkar poadum ve'lichcham paavamea.
jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavanudaiya ninaivuga'l selvaththukkum, patha'rugi'ravanudaiya ninaivuga'l thariththiraththukkum eathuvaagum.
poynaavinaal poru'laich sambaathippathu saavaith theadugi'ravarga'l vidugi'ra suvaasampoalirukkum.
thunmaarkkar niyaayagnseyya manathillaathirukki'rapadiyaal, avarga'l paazhkkadikkappattuppoavaarga'l.
kut'ramu'l'lavan than vazhiga'lil maa'rupaadu'l'lavan; suththamu'l'lavanoa than kiriyaiyil semmaiyaanavan.
sa'ndaikkaariyoadea oru periya veettil kudiyiruppathaippaarkkilum, veettinmeal oru moolaiyil thanggiyiruppathea nalam.
thunmaarkkanudaiya manam pollaappaich seyya virumbum; avan ka'nga'lil avan ayalaanukku irakkangkidaiyaathu.
pariyaasakkaaranaith tha'ndikkumpoathu peathai gnaanamadaivaan; gnaanavaan poathikkappadumpoathu a'rivadaivaan.
neethiparar thunmaarkkarudaiya veettaik kavaniththuppaarkki'raar; thunmaarkkaraith theenggil kavizhththuppoaduvaar.
eazhaiyin kookkuralukkuth than seviyai adaiththukko'l'lugi'ravan, thaanum saththamittuk kooppidumpoathu keadkappadamaattaan.
antharanggamaayk kodukkappatta vegumathi koabaththaith tha'nikkum; madiyilu'l'la parithaanam kuroathaththai aat'rum.
niyaayantheerppathu neethimaanukkuch santhoashamum, akkiramakkaararukkoa azhivumaam.
viveagaththin vazhiyai vittuth thappi nadakki'ra manushan seththavarga'lin koottaththil thaabarippaan.
sit'rinbappiriyan thariththiranaavaan; mathubaanaththaiyum e'n'neyaiyum virumbugi'ravan aisuvariyavaanaavathillai.
neethimaanukkup bathilaagath thunmaarkkanum, semmaiyaanavanukkup bathilaaga thuroagiyum meedkumporu'laavaarga'l.
sa'ndaikkaariyum koabakkaariyumaana sthireeyudan kudiyiruppathaippaarkkilum vanaantharaththil kudiyiruppathu nalam.
vea'ndiya thiraviyamum e'n'neyum gnaanavaanudaiya vaasasthalaththil u'ndu; moodanoa athaich selavazhiththuppoadugi'raan.
neethiyaiyum thayaiyaiyum pinpat'rugi'ravan jeevanaiyum neethiyaiyum magimaiyaiyum ka'ndadaivaan.
balavaanga'ludaiya patta'naththin mathilai gnaanamu'l'lavan ea'rippidiththu, avarga'l nambina ara'nai idiththuppoaduvaan.
than vaayaiyum than naavaiyum kaakki'ravan than aaththumaavai idukka'nga'lukku vilakkik kaakki'raan.
aganggaaramum idumbumu'l'lavanukkup pariyaasakkaaranen'ru peyar, avan aganthaiyaana sinaththoadea nadakki'raan.
soambea'riyin kaiga'l vealaiseyyach sammathiyaathathinaal, avan aasai avanaik kollum.
avan naa'lthoa'rum aavaludan ichchikki'raan; neethimaanoa pisiniththanamillaamal koduppaan.
thunmaarkkarudaiya bali aruvaruppaanathu; athaith thurchsinthaiyoadea seluththinaaloa eththanai athigamaay aruvarukkappadum.
poychsaadchikkaaran kettuppoavaan; sevikodukki'ravanoa eppozhuthum peasaththakkavanaavaan.
thunmaarkkan than mugaththaik kadinappaduththugi'raan; semmaiyaanavanoa than vazhiyai nearppaduththugi'raan.
karththarukku viroathamaana gnaanamumillai, buththiyumillai, aaloasanaiyumillai.
kuthirai yuththanaa'lukku aayaththamaakkappadum; jeyamoa karththaraal varum.
thira'laana aisuvariyaththaippaarkkilum na'rkeerththiyea therinthuko'l'lappadaththakkathu; pon ve'l'liyaippaarkkilum thayaiyea nalam.
aisuvariyavaanum thariththiranum oruvaraiyoruvar santhikki'raarga'l; avarga'l anaivaraiyum u'ndaakkinavar karththar.
viveagi aabaththaik ka'ndu ma'rainthuko'l'lugi'raan; peathaiga'l nedugappoayth tha'ndikkappadugi'raarga'l.
thaazhmaikkum karththarukkup bayappaduthalukkum varum palan aisuvariyamum magimaiyum jeevanumaam.
maa'rupaadu'l'lavanudaiya vazhiyilea mu'l'luga'lum ka'n'niga'lumu'ndu; than aaththumaavaik kaakki'ravan avaiga'lukkuth thooramaay vilagippoavaan.
pi'l'laiyaanavan nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyilea avanai nadaththu; avan muthirvayathilum athai vidaathiruppaan.
aisuvariyavaan thariththiranai aa'lugi'raan; kadanvaangginavan kadankoduththavanukku adimai.
aniyaayaththai vithaikki'ravan varuththaththai a'ruppaan; avan ukkiraththin milaa'ru ozhiyum.
karu'naikka'n'nan aaseervathikkappaduvaan; avan than aagaaraththil thariththiranukkuk kodukki'raan.
pariyaasakkaaranaith thuraththividu; appozhuthu vaathu neenggum, viroathamum avamaanamum ozhiyum.
suththa iruthayaththai virumbugi'ravanudaiya uthaduga'l inimaiyaanavaiga'l; raajaa avanukkuch sineagithanaavaan.
karththarudaiya ka'nga'l gnaanaththaik kaakkum; thuroagiga'lin vaarththaiga'laiyoa avar thaa'rumaa'raakkugi'raar.
ve'liyilea singgam, veethiyilea kolaiyu'nbean en'ru soambea'ri solluvaan.
parasthireega'lin vaay aazhamaana padukuzhi; karththarudaiya koabaththi'rku eathuvaanavan athilea vizhuvaan.
pi'l'laiyin negnchil mathiyeenam ottiyirukkum; athaith tha'ndanaiyin pirambu avanaivittu agat'rum.
thanakku athigam u'ndaagath thariththiranai odukkugi'ravan thanakkuk ku'raichchalu'ndaagavea aisuvariyavaanukkuk koduppaan.
un seviyaich saayththu, gnaaniga'ludaiya vaarththaiga'laik keattu, en poathagaththai un iruthayaththil vai.
