un naabi thiraadcharasam ni'raintha vattakkalasampoalirukki'rathu; un vayi'ru leelipushpangga'l soozhntha koathumai ambaarampoalirukki'rathu.
un ira'ndu sthanangga'lum ve'limaanin irattaikkuttiga'lukkuch samaanamaayirukki'rathu.

un kazhuththu yaanaiththanthaththinaal seytha koapuraththaippoalavum, un ka'nga'l esboanilea bathrabeem vaasala'ndaiyilirukkum ku'langga'laippoalavum, un mookku thamaskuvin thisaiyai noakkum leebanoanin koapuraththaippoalavum irukki'rathu.
un sirasu karmeal malaiyaippoalirukki'rathu; un thalaimayir iraththaambaramayamaayirukki'rathu; raajaa nadaikkaava'nangga'lil mayanggini'rki'raar.
manamagizhchchiyai u'ndaakkum en piriyamea! nee evva'lavu roobavathi, nee evva'lavu inbamu'l'lava'l.
un uyaram panaimaraththozhunggupoalavum, un sthanangga'l thiraadchakkulaiga'lpoalavum irukki'rathu.
naan panaimaraththilea'ri, athin madalga'laip pidippean en'rean; ippozhuthum un sthanangga'l thiraadchakkulaiga'lpoalavum, un mookkin vaasanai kichchilippazhangga'lpoalavum irukki'rathu.
un tho'ndai, en neasar kudikkaiyil methuvaayi'ranggugi'rathum, u'ranggugi'ravarga'lin uthaduga'laip peasappa'n'nugi'rathumaana, nalla thiraadcharasaththaippoalirukki'rathu.
naan en neasarudaiyava'l, avar piriyam enmealirukki'rathu.
vaarum en neasarea! vayalve'liyil poay, kiraamangga'lil thangguvoam.

athikaalaiyilea thiraadchaththoattangga'lukkup poavoam; thiraadchakkodi thu'lirththu athin poo malarnthathoa en'rum, maatha'lagnsediga'l pooppooththathoa en'rum paarppoam; anggea en neasaththin uchchithangga'lai umakkuth tharuvean.
thoothaayeem pazham vaasanai veesum; namathu vaasalga'la'ndaiyilea puthiyavaiga'lum pazhaiyavaiga'lumaana sagalavitha arumaiyaana kaniga'lumu'ndu; en neasarea! avaiga'lai umakku vaiththirukki'rean.
aa, neer en thaayin paalkudiththa en sagoatharanaippoaliruntheeraanaal, naan ummai ve'liyilea santhiththu muththamiduvean; ennai ninthikkavumaattaarga'l.

naan ummaik koottikko'ndu, en thaayin veettukku azhaiththukko'ndupoavean; neer ennaip poathippeer, kanthavarkkamitta thiraadcharasaththaiyum, en maatha'lampazharasaththaiyum umakkuk kudikkakkoduppean.
avar idathukai en thalaiyin keezhirukkum, avar valathukai ennai a'naikkum.
erusaleamin kumaaraththiga'lea! enakkup piriyamaanava'lukku manathaagumattum neengga'l ava'lai vizhikkappa'n'naamalum ezhuppaamalum irukka ungga'lai aa'naiyidugi'rean.

than neasarmeal saarnthuko'ndu vanaantharaththilirunthu varugi'ra iva'l yaar? kichchilimaraththinkeezh ummai ezhuppinean; anggea umathu thaay ummaip pet'raa'l; anggea ummaip pet'rava'l veathanaippattu ummaip pet'raa'l.

neer ennai umathu iruthayaththinmeal muththiraiyaippoalavum, umathu puyaththinmeal muththiraiyaippoalavum vaiththukko'l'lum; neasam mara'naththaippoal valithu; neasavairaakkiyam paathaa'laththaippoal kodithaayirukki'rathu; athin thazhal akkiniththazhalum athin juvaalai kadum juvaalaiyumaayirukki'rathu.

thira'laana tha'n'neerga'l neasaththai avikkamaattaathu, ve'l'langga'lum athaith tha'nikkamaattaathu; oruvan than veettilu'l'la aasthiga'laiyellaam neasaththukkaagak koduththaalum, athu mut'rilum asattaipa'n'nappadum.
namakku oru si'riya sagoathariyu'ndu, ava'lukku sthanangga'lillai; nammudaiya sagoathariyaik keadkum naa'lil ava'lukkaaga naam enna seyvoam?
ava'l oru mathilaanaal, athinmeal ve'l'likkoattaiyaik kattuvoam; ava'l kathavaanaal, keathuruppalagaiga'lai atha'rku i'naippoam.
naan mathilthaan, en sthanangga'l koapurangga'l; avarudaiya ka'nga'lil kadaadchampe'ralaanean.

baagaal aamoanilea saalomoanukku oru thiraadchaththoattam u'ndaayirunthathu, anthath thoattaththaik kaavalaa'liga'l vasaththilea athin palanukkaaga, ovvoruvan aayiram ve'l'likkaasu ko'nduvarumpadi vittaar.
en thiraadchaththoattam enakku munbaaga irukki'rathu; saalomoanea! umakku antha aayiramum, athin kaniyaik kaakki'ravarga'lukku irunoo'rum searum.
thoattangga'lil vaasampa'n'nugi'rava'lea! thoazhar un saththaththaik keadki'raarga'l; naanum athaik keadkattum.
en neasarea! theeviriyum, kanthavarkkangga'lin malaiga'lmealu'l'la ve'limaanukkum maraiga'lin kuttikkum samaanamaayirum.
aamoathsin kumaaranaagiya easaayaa, yoothaavin raajaakka'laagiya usiyaa, yoathaam, aagaas, eseakkiyaa enbavarga'lin naadka'lil, yoothaavaiyum erusaleamaiyum ku'riththuk ka'nda tharisanam.
vaanangga'lea, kea'lungga'l; boomiyea, sevikodu; karththar peasugi'raar; naan pi'l'laiga'lai va'larththu aathariththean; avarga'loa enakku viroathamaayk kalagampa'n'ninaarga'l.
maadu than ejamaanaiyum, kazhuthai than aa'ndavanin munna'naiyaiyum a'riyum; isravealoa a'rivillaamalum, en janam u'narvillaamalum irukki'rathu engi'raar.

aiyoa, paavamu'l'la jaathiyum, akkiramaththaal baaragnsumantha janamum, pollaathavarga'lin santhathiyum, keadu u'ndaakkugi'ra puththirarumaayirukki'raarga'l; karththarai vittu, isravealin parisuththarukkuk koabamu'ndaakki, pinvaanggippoanaarga'l.
innum neengga'l ean adikkappadavea'ndum? athigam athigamaay vilagippoagi'reerga'lea; thalaiyellaam viyaathiyum, iruthayamellaam paladchayamumaay irukki'rathu.

u'l'langkaal thodanggi uchchanthalaimattum athilea sugameayillai; athu kaayamum, veekkamum, nothikki'ra ira'namumu'l'lathu; athu seezh pithukkappadaamalum, kattappadaamalum, e'n'neyinaal aat'rappadaamalum irukki'rathu.

ungga'l theasam paazhaayirukki'rathu; ungga'l patta'nangga'l akkiniyinaal sutterikkappattathu; ungga'l naattai anniyar ungga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaagap padchikki'raarga'l; athu anniyaraal kavizhkkappatta paazhntheasampoal irukki'rathu.
seeyoan kumaaraththi thiraadchaththoattaththilu'l'la oru kuchchupoalavum, ve'l'lariththoattaththilu'l'la oru kudisaipoalavum, mut'rikkaipoadappatta oru patta'nampoalavum meenthirukki'raa'l.
seanaiga'lin karththar namakkuk kogncham meethiyai vaikkaathirunthaaraanaal, naam soathoamaippoalaagi, komoaraavukku oththiruppoam.
soathoamin athibathiga'lea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungga'l; komoaraavin janamea, namathu theavanudaiya veathaththukkuch sevikodungga'l.

ungga'l baliga'lin thira'l enakku ennaththukku en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; aattukkadaakka'lin thaganabaliga'lum, kozhuththa mirugangga'lin ni'namum enakku aroasigamaayirukki'rathu; kaa'laiga'l, aattukkuttiga'l, kadaakka'ludaiya iraththaththinmeal enakkup piriyamillai.
neengga'l en sannithiyil varumpoathu, en piraagaarangga'lai ippadi mithikkavea'ndumen'ru ungga'lidaththil keattathu yaar?

ini vee'n kaa'nikkaiga'laik ko'nduvaravea'ndaam; thoobangkaattuthal enakku aruvaruppaayirukki'rathu; neengga'l akkiramaththoadea aasarikki'ra maathappi'rappaiyum, oayvunaa'laiyum, sabaikkoottaththaiyum naan inich sagikkamaattean.
ungga'l maathappi'rappuga'laiyum, ungga'l pa'ndigaiga'laiyum en aaththumaa ve'rukki'rathu; avaiga'l enakku varuththamaayirukki'rathu; avaiga'laich sumanthu i'laiththuppoanean.
neengga'l ungga'l kaiga'lai viriththaalum, en ka'nga'lai ungga'laivittu ma'raikki'rean; neengga'l miguthiyaay jebampa'n'ninaalum kea'lean; ungga'l kaiga'l iraththaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.
ungga'laik kazhuvich suththigariyungga'l; ungga'l kiriyaiga'lin pollaappai en ka'nga'lukku ma'raivaaga agat'rivittu, theemaiseythalai vittu oayungga'l;
nanmaiseyyap padiyungga'l; niyaayaththaith theadungga'l; odukkappattavanai aathariththu, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyin niyaayaththaiyum, vithavaiyin vazhakkaiyum visaariyungga'l.

vazhakkaaduvoam vaarungga'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; ungga'l paavangga'l sivearen'rirunthaalum u'raintha mazhaiyaippoal ve'nmaiyaagum; avaiga'l iraththaambarachsivappaayirunthaalum pagnchaippoalaagum.
neengga'l manamporunthich sevikoduththaal, theasaththin nanmaiyaip pusippeerga'l.
maattoam en'ru ethirththuni'rpeerga'laagil pattayaththukku iraiyaaveerga'l; karththarin vaay ithaich sollit'ru.
u'nmaiyu'l'la nagaram eppadi veasiyaayppoayit'ru! athu niyaayaththaal ni'rainthirunthathu, neethi athil kudiko'ndirunthathu; ippozhuthoa athin kudiga'l kolaipaathagar.
un ve'l'li ka'limbaayit'ru; un thiraadcharasam tha'n'neerkkalappaanathu.

un pirabukka'l muradarum thirudarin thoazharumaayirukki'raarga'l; avarga'lil ovvoruvanum parithaanaththai virumbi, kaikkooliyai naadiththirigi'raan; thikkat'ra pi'l'laiyin niyaayaththai visaariyaarga'l; vithavaiyin vazhakku avarga'lidaththil ea'rugi'rathillai.
aagaiyaal seanaiga'lin karththarum isravealin vallavarumaagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathaavathu: oahoa, naan en saththurukka'lil koabam aa'ri, en pagaignarukku neethiyaich sarikkattuvean.
naan en kaiyai unnidamaayth thiruppi, un ka'limbu neengga unnaich suththamaayp pudamittu, un eeyaththaiyellaam neekkuvean.
un niyaayaathibathiga'lai munnirunthathupoalavum, un aaloasanaikkaararai aathiyil irunthathupoalavum thirumbak katta'laiyiduvean; pinbu nee neethipuram en'rum, saththiyanagaram en'rum peyarpe'ruvaay.
seeyoan niyaayaththinaalum, athilea thirumbivarugi'ravarga'l neethiyinaalum meedkappaduvaarga'l.
thuroagiga'lum paaviga'lumoa eagamaay no'runggu'ndupoavaarga'l; karththarai vittu vilagugi'ravarga'l nirmoolamaavaarga'l.
neengga'l virumbina karvaalimarangga'linimiththam vedkappaduveerga'l; neengga'l therinthuko'nda thoappuga'linimiththam naa'namadaiveerga'l.
ilaiyuthirntha karvaalimaraththaippoalavum, tha'n'neerillaatha thoappaippoalavum iruppeerga'l.
baraakkiramasaali sa'na'rkoo'lamum, avan kiriyai akkinippo'riyumaagi, ira'ndum avippaarillaamal eagamaay venthupoam en'ru sollugi'raar.
aamoathsin kumaaranaagiya easaayaa yoothaavaiyum erusaleamaiyum ku'riththuk ka'nda tharisanam.
kadaisinaadka'lil karththarudaiya aalayamaagiya parvatham parvathangga'lin kodumudiyil sthaabikkappattu, malaiga'lukku mealaay uyarththappadum; ellaa jaathiga'lum atha'rku oadivaruvaarga'l.

thira'laana janangga'l pu'rappattu vanthu: naam karththarin parvathaththukkum, yaakkoabin theavanudaiya aalayaththukkum poavoam vaarungga'l; avar thamathu vazhiga'lai namakkup poathippaar, naam avar paathaiga'lil nadappoam enbaarga'l; eanenil seeyoanilirunthu veathamum, erusaleamilirunthu karththarin vasanamum ve'lippadum.

avar jaathiga'lukku'l niyaayantheerththu, thira'laana janangga'laik kadinthuko'lvaar; appozhuthu avarga'l thangga'l pattayangga'lai ma'nvettiga'laagavum, thangga'l eettiga'lai arivaa'lga'laagavum adippaarga'l; jaathikku viroathamaay jaathi pattayam eduppathillai, ini avarga'l yuththaththaik ka'rpathumillai.
yaakkoabin vamsaththaarea, karththarin ve'lichchaththilea nadappoam vaarungga'l.

yaakkoabin vamsaththaaraagiya ummudaiya janaththaik kainegizhntheer; avarga'l keezhththisaiyaarin poathagaththaal ni'rainthu, pelistharaippoal naa'lpaarkki'ravarga'laayirunthu, anniya puththirarmeal piriyappadugi'raarga'lea.

avarga'l theasam ve'l'liyinaalum ponninaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; avarga'l pokkishangga'lukku mudivillai; avarga'l theasam kuthiraiga'laalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; avarga'l irathangga'lukkum mudivillai.
avarga'l theasam vikkiragangga'laalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; thangga'l kaiga'lin kiriyaiyaiyum, thangga'l viralga'l u'ndupa'n'ninathaiyum pa'ninthuko'l'lugi'raarga'l.
si'riyavanum kunigi'raan, periyavanum pa'nigi'raan; aagaiyaal avarga'lukku manniyaathiruppeer.
karththarin bayanggaraththi'rkum, avarudaiya magimaippirathaabaththi'rkum vilagi, nee kanmalaiyil othunggi, ma'n'nil o'liththukko'l.
nararin meattimaiyaana ka'nga'l thaazhththappadum, manusharin vee'raappum tha'niyum; karththar oruvarea annaa'lil uyarnthiruppaar.
ellaam thaazhththappadumporuttuch seanaiga'ludaiya karththarin naa'laanathu perumaiyum meattimaiyumaanavai ellaavat'rinmealum, uyarnthavai ellaavat'rinmealum,
leebanoanilu'l'la uyaramum oanggalumaana ellaak keathurukka'linmealum, baasaanilu'l'la ellaak karvaali marangga'linmealum,
unnathamaana ellaap parvathangga'linmealum, uyaramaana ellaa malaiga'linmealum,
uyarntha ellaak koapuraththinmealum, ara'naana ellaa mathilinmealum,
tharsheesin kappalga'l ellaavat'rinmealum, ellaach siththira vinoathangga'linmealum varum.
appozhuthu nararin meattimai thaazhnthu, manusharin vee'raapputh tha'niyum; karththar oruvarea annaa'lil uyarnthiruppaar.
vikkiragangga'l kattoadea ozhinthupoam.

boomiyaith thaththa'likkappa'n'nak karththar ezhumbumpoathu, avarudaiya bayanggaraththi'rkum, avarudaiya magimaippirathaabaththi'rkum vilagi, kanmalaiga'lin kebiga'lilum, boomiyin kugaiga'lilum pugunthuko'lvaarga'l.

boomiyaith thaththa'likkappa'n'nak karththar ezhumbum annaa'lilea, avarudaiya bayanggaraththi'rkum, avarudaiya magimaippirathaabaththi'rkum vilagi, kanmalaiga'lin vedippuga'lilum kun'ruga'lin santhuga'lilum pugunthuko'l'lumpadikku,
manushan pa'ninthuko'l'lath thanakku u'ndaakkiyiruntha than ve'l'li vikkiragangga'laiyum, than pon vikkiragangga'laiyum, moognchoo'ruga'lukkum thurignchilga'lukkum e'rinthuviduvaan.
naasiyilea suvaasamu'l'la manushanai nambuvathai vittuvidungga'l; e'n'nappaduvatha'rku avan emmaaththiram.
ithoa, seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar erusaleamilirunthum yoothaavilirunthum sagalavithamaana aatharavuga'laagiya appamengi'ra ellaa aatharavaiyum, tha'n'neerengi'ra ellaa aatharavaiyum;
baraakkiramasaaliyaiyum, yuththaveeranaiyum, niyaayaathibathiyaiyum, theerkkatharisiyaiyum, saasthiriyaiyum, mooppanaiyum;
aimbathupearukku athibathiyaiyum, kanamporunthinavanaiyum, aaloasanaikkaaranaiyum, thozhilga'lil saamarththiyamu'l'lavanaiyum, saathuriyanaiyum vilakkuvaar.
vaalibarai avarga'lukku athibathiga'laagath tharuvean engi'raar; pi'l'laiga'l avarga'lai aa'luvaarga'l.
janangga'l odukkappaduvaarga'l; oruvarukkoruvarum, ayalaanukku ayalaanum viroathamaayiruppaarga'l; vaaliban muthirvayathu'l'lavanukkum, keezhmagan meanmaganukkum idumbu seyvaan.

appozhuthu oruvan than thagappan veettaanaagiya than sagoatharanaip pidiththu: unakku vasthiram irukki'rathu, nee engga'lukku athibathiyaayiru; keattukku inamaana inthak kaariyam un kaiyin keezhaavathaaga en'ru solla;
avan annaa'lilea than kaiyai uyarththi: naan seerppaduththugi'ravanaayirukkamaattean; en veettilea appamumillai, vasthiramumillai; ennai janangga'lukku athibathiyaaga vaikkavea'ndaam enbaan.

eanen'raal erusaleam paazhaakkappattathu, yoothaa vizhunthupoayit'ru; avarga'l naavum, avarga'l kiriyaiga'lum, karththarudaiya magimaiyin ka'nga'lukku erichchal u'ndaakkaththakkathaaga avarukku viroathamaayirukki'rathu.

avarga'l mugappaarvai avarga'lukku viroathamaaych saadchiyidum; avarga'l thangga'l paavaththai ma'raikkaamal, soathoam ooraaraippoala ve'lippaduththugi'raarga'l; avarga'l aaththumaavukku aiyoa! thangga'lukkea theemaiyai varuviththukko'l'lugi'raarga'l.
ungga'lukku nanmaiyu'ndaagum en'ru neethimaanga'lukkuch sollungga'l; avarga'l thangga'l kiriyaiga'lin palanai anubavippaarga'l.
thunmaarkkanukku aiyoa! avanukkuk keadu u'ndaagum; avan kaiga'lin palan avanukkuk kidaikkum.

pi'l'laiga'l en janangga'lai odukkugi'ravarga'laayirukki'raarga'l; sthireega'l avarga'lai aa'lugi'raarga'l. en janamea, unnai nadaththugi'ravarga'l unnai moasampoakki, nee nadakkavea'ndiya vazhiyai azhiththuppoadugi'raarga'l.
karththar vazhakkaada ezhunthirunthu, janangga'lai niyaayantheerkka ni'rki'raar.

karththar thamathu janaththin moopparaiyum, athin pirabukka'laiyum niyaayam visaarippaar. neengga'lea inthath thiraadchaththoattaththaip padchiththuppoatteerga'l; si'rumaiyaanavanidaththil ko'l'laiyitta poru'l ungga'l veeduga'lil irukki'rathu.
neengga'l en janaththai no'rukkich si'rumaiyaanavarga'lin mugaththai nerikki'rathu ennaven'ru seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

pinnum karththar sollugi'rathaavathu: seeyoan kumaaraththiga'l aganthaiyaayirunthu, kazhuththai ne'riththu nadanthu, ka'nga'laal maruttippaarththu, oyyaaramaay nadanthu, thangga'l kaalga'lil silambu olikkath thirigi'raarga'l.
aathalaal aa'ndavar seeyoan kumaaraththiga'lin uchchanthalaiyai mottaiyaakkuvaar; karththar avarga'l maanaththaik kulaippaar.
annaa'lilea aa'ndavar avarga'ludaiya aabara'nangga'laagiya silambuga'laiyum, suttiga'laiyum, pi'raichchinthaakkuga'laiyum,
aarangga'laiyum, asthakadagangga'laiyum, thalaimukkaaduga'laiyum,
sirapoosha'nangga'laiyum, paathasarangga'laiyum, maarkkachchaiga'laiyum, suganthapara'niga'laiyum,
thaayiththuga'laiyum, moathirangga'laiyum, mookkuththiga'laiyum,
vinoatha vasthirangga'laiyum, saalvaiga'laiyum, poarvaiga'laiyum, kuppiga'laiyum,
ka'n'naadiga'laiyum, sallaakka'laiyum, kullaakka'laiyum, thuppattaakka'laiyum urinthupoaduvaar.

appozhuthu, suganthaththukkup bathilaagath thurkkanthamum, kachchaikkup bathilaagak kayi'rum, mayirchsuru'lukkup bathilaaga mottaiyum, aadambaramaana vasthirangga'lukkup bathilaaga irattukkachchum, azhagukkup bathilaagak karugippoaguthalum irukkum.
un purushar kadkaththinaalum, un belasaaliga'l yuththaththilum vizhuvaarga'l.
ava'ludaiya vaasalga'l thukkiththup pulambum; ava'l ve'rumaiyaakkappattuth tharaiyilea udkaaruvaa'l engi'raar.

annaa'lil eazhu sthireega'l orea purushanaip pidiththu: naangga'l engga'l sontha aagaaraththaip pusiththu, engga'l sontha vasthiraththai uduppoam; engga'l ninthai neenggumpadikku unpearmaaththiram engga'lmeal vi'langgattum enbaarga'l.
isravealil thappinavarga'lukku annaa'lilea karththarin ki'lai alanggaaramum magimaiyumaayirukkum; boomiyin kani avarga'lukkuch si'rappum alanggaaramumaayirukkum.
appozhuthu aa'ndavar, seeyoan kumaaraththiga'lin azhukkaik kazhuvi, niyaayaththin aaviyinaalum, sutterippin aaviyinaalum, erusaleamin iraththappazhiga'lai athin naduvilirunthu neekkividumpoathu,
seeyoanil meethiyaayirunthu, erusaleamil thariththirunthu jeevanukken'ru pearezhuthappattavanevanum parisuththanen'ru sollappaduvaan.

appozhuthu karththar seeyoan malaiyilu'l'la ellaa vaasasthalangga'lilum, athin sabaiga'linmealum, pagalil meagaththaiyum pugaiyaiyum, iravil kozhunthuvittu eriyum akkinippiragaasaththaiyum u'ndaakkuvaar; magimaiyaanavaiga'linmealellaam kaaval u'ndaayirukkum.
pagalilea veyilukku nizhalaagavum, perungkaat'rukkum mazhaikkum adaikkalamaagavum, ma'raividamaagavum, oru koodaaram u'ndaayirukkum.

ippozhuthu naan en neasaridaththil avarudaiya thiraadchaththoattaththaik ku'riththu en neasarukkeat'ra oru paattaip paaduvean; en neasarukku mahaa sezhippaana meattilea oru thiraadchaththoattam u'ndu.

avar athai vealiyadaiththu, athilu'l'la ka'rka'laip po'rukki, athilea na'rkula thiraadchachsediga'lai nattu, athin naduvil oru koapuraththaikkatti, athil aalaiyaiyum u'ndupa'n'ni, athu nalla thiraadchappazhangga'laith tharumen'ru kaaththirunthaar; athuvoa kasappaana pazhangga'laith thanthathu.
erusaleamin kudiga'lea, yoothaavin manusharea, enakkum en thiraadchaththoattaththukkum niyaayantheerungga'l.

naan en thiraadchaththoattaththi'rkaagach seyyaatha entha vealaiyai atha'rku inich seyyalaam? athu nalla thiraadchappazhangga'laith tharumen'ru naan kaaththirukka, athu kasappaana pazhangga'laith thanthathenna?
ippoathum naan en thiraadchaththoattaththukkuch seyvathai ungga'lukku a'rivippean; athin vealiyai eduththuppoaduvean, athu meaynthupoadappadum; athin adaippaith thagarppean, athu mithiyu'ndupoam.

athaip paazhaakkividuvean; athin ki'lai na'rukkappadaamalum, ka'laikoththi edukkappadaamalum poavathinaal, mudchediyum nerignchilum mu'laikkum; athinmeal mazhai peyyaathapadikku meagangga'lukkum katta'laiyiduvean engi'raar.

seanaiga'lin karththarudaiya thiraadchaththoattam isravealin vamsamea; avarudaiya manamagizhchchiyin naat'ru yoothaavin manusharea; avar niyaayaththukkuk kaaththirunthaar, ithoa, kodumai; neethikkuk kaaththirunthaar, ithoa, mu'raippaadu.
thaangga'lmaaththiram theasaththin naduvil vaasamaayirukkumpadi mat'ravarga'lukku idamillaama'rpoagumattum, veettoadea veettaich searththu, vayaloadea vayalaik koottugi'ravarga'lukku aiyoa!
seanaiga'lin karththar en sevikeadkach sonnathu: meyyaagavea anthath thira'laana veeduga'l paazhaagum; periyavaiga'lum nearththiyaanavaiga'lumaagiya veeduga'l kudiyillaathirukkum.
paththear nilamaagiya thiraadchaththoattam oreapadi rasam tharum; oru kala vithai oru ku'ru'ni vi'laiyum.
saaraayaththai naadi athikaalamea ezhunthu, mathubaanam thangga'laich soodaakkumpadi thariththirunthu, iruttippoaguma'lavum kudiththukko'ndeayirukki'ravarga'lukku aiyoa!

avarga'l surama'ndalaththaiyum, thamburuvaiyum, mea'laththaiyum, naagasuraththaiyum, mathubaanaththaiyum vaiththu virunthuko'ndaadugi'raarga'l; aanaalum karththarin kiriyaiyai noakkugi'rathumillai; avar karaththin seygaiyaich sinthikki'rathumillai.

en janangga'l a'rivillaamaiyinaal si'raippattuppoagi'raarga'l; avarga'lil kanamu'l'lavarga'l pattiniyinaal thoynthupoagi'raarga'l; avarga'ludaiya thira'laana koottaththaar thaagaththaal naava'ra'ndupoagi'raarga'l.

athinimiththam paathaa'lam thannai virivaakki, than vaayai aaven'ru mattillaamal thi'ranthathu; avarga'l magimaiyum, avarga'l thira'lkoottamum, avarga'l aadambaramum, avarga'lil ka'likoorugi'ravarga'lum atha'rku'l i'ranggippoavaarga'l.
si'riyavan thaazhththappaduvaan, periyavanum thaazhchchiyadaivaan; meattimaiyaanavarga'lin ka'nga'l thaazhnthupoam.
seanaiga'lin karththar niyaayaththeerppinaal uyarnthu, parisuththamu'l'la theavan neethiyinaal parisuththaraay vi'langguvaar.
appozhuthu aattukkuttiga'l ka'ndavidamellaam meayum; kozhuththavarga'ludaiyathaayirunthu paazhaayppoana nilangga'laip paratheasiga'l anubavippaarga'l.
maayaiyin kayi'ruga'laal akkiramaththaiyum, va'ndiyin vadangga'laal paavaththaiyum izhuththukko'ndu vanthu,

naam paarkkumpadi avar theeviriththuth thamathu kiriyaiyaich seekkiramaay nadappikkattumen'rum, isravealin parisuththarudaiya aaloasanaiyai naam a'riyumpadi athu sameebiththu varattumen'rum sollugi'ravarga'lukku aiyoa!

theemaiyai nanmaiyen'rum, nanmaiyaith theemaiyen'rum solli, iru'lai ve'lichchamum, ve'lichchaththai iru'lumaagap paaviththu, kasappaith thiththippum, thiththippaik kasappumen'ru saathikki'ravarga'lukku aiyoa!
thangga'l paarvaikku gnaaniga'lum, thangga'l e'n'naththukkup buththimaanga'lumaay irukki'ravarga'lukku aiyoa!
saaraayaththaik kudikka veerarum, mathuvaik kalanthuvaikkap baraakkiramasaaliga'lumaayirunthu,
parithaanaththi'rkaagak kut'ravaa'liyai neethimaanaagath theerththu, neethimaanin niyaayaththai avanukku viroathamaayp purattugi'ravarga'lukku aiyoa!

ithinimiththam akkinijuvaalai vaikkoalaip padchippathupoalavum, seththaiyaanathu neruppukku iraiyaagi erinthupoavathupoalavum, avarga'l vear vaadi, avarga'l thu'lir thoosiyaippoal pa'ranthupoagum; avarga'l seanaiga'lin karththarudaiya veathaththai ve'ruththu, isravealilu'l'la parisuththarudaiya vasanaththai asattaipa'n'ninaarga'lea.

aagaiyaal karththarudaiya koabam thamathu janangga'lukku viroathamaay moo'ndathu; avar thamathu kaiyai avarga'lukku viroathamaay neetti, parvathangga'l athiraththakkathaayum, avarga'l pi'nangga'l naduveethiga'lil kuppaipoalaagaththakkathaayum, avarga'lai adiththaar; ivai ellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koabam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
avar thooraththilu'l'la jaathiyaarukku oru kodiyai eat'ri, avarga'laip boomiyin kadaiyaantharangga'lilirunthu payilkaatti azhaippaar; appozhuthu avarga'l theeviramum veagamumaay varuvaarga'l.

avarga'lil vidaayththavanum ida'rugi'ravanum illai; thoonggugi'ravanum u'ranggugi'ravanum illai; avarga'lil oruvanudaiya iduppin kachchai avizhvathum, paatharadchaiga'lin vaar a'runthupoavathum illai.

avarga'l ambuga'l koormaiyum, avarga'l villuga'lellaam naa'neat'rinavaiga'lum, avarga'l kuthiraiga'lin ku'lambuga'l ka'rpaa'raiyaaga e'n'nappattavaiga'lum, avarga'l uru'laiga'l suzhalkaat'rukku oththavaiga'lumaayirukkum.

avarga'l kerchchippu singgaththin kerchchippupoalirukki'rathu; baalasinggangga'laippoalak kerchchiththu, u'rumi, iraiyaip pidiththu, thappuvikki'ravan illaamal, athai eduththukko'ndu poayviduvaarga'l.

annaa'lil, samuththiram iraivathupoal avarga'lukku viroathamaay iraivaarga'l; appozhuthu theasaththaippaarththaal, ithoa, anthagaaramum viyaagulamum u'ndu; athin meagangga'linaal ve'lichcham iru'ndupoam.
usiyaa raajaa mara'namadaintha varushaththil, aa'ndavar uyaramum unnathamumaana singgaasanaththinmeal veet'rirukkakka'ndean; avarudaiya vasthiraththonggalaal theavaalayam ni'rainthirunthathu.

searaabeenga'l avarukku mealaaga nin'raarga'l; avarga'lil ovvoruvanukkum avvaa'ru settaiga'lirunthana; avanavan ira'ndu settaiga'laal than than mugaththai moodi, ira'ndu settaiga'laal than than kaalga'lai moodi, ira'ndu settaiga'laal pa'ranthu;
oruvaraiyoruvar noakki: seanaiga'lin karththar parisuththar, parisuththar, parisuththar, boomiyanaiththum avarudaiya magimaiyaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu en'ru kooppittuch sonnaarga'l.
kooppidugi'ravarga'lin saththaththaal vaasalga'lin nilaiga'l asainthu, aalayam pugaiyinaal ni'rainthathu.

appozhuthu naan: aiyoa! athamaanean, naan asuththa uthaduga'lu'l'la manushan, asuththa uthaduga'lu'l'la janangga'lin naduvil vaasamaayirukki'ravan; seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya raajaavai en ka'nga'l ka'ndathea en'rean.
appozhuthu searaabeenga'lil oruvan balipeedaththilirunthu, than kaiyilea pidiththa ku'rattaal oru neruppuththazhalai eduththu, ennidaththil pa'ranthu vanthu,
athinaal en vaayaith thottu: ithoa, ithu un uthaduga'laith thottathinaal un akkiramam neenggi, un paavam nivirththiyaanathu en'raan.
pinbu: yaarai naan anuppuvean, yaar namathu kaariyamaayp poavaan en'ru uraikki'ra aa'ndavarudaiya saththaththaik keattean. atha'rku naan: ithoa, adiyean irukki'rean; ennai anuppum en'rean.
appozhuthu avar: nee poay, intha janangga'lai noakki, neengga'l kaathaarak keattum u'naraamalum, ka'n'naarakka'ndum a'riyaamalum irungga'l en'ru sol.

intha janangga'l thangga'l ka'nga'linaal kaa'naamalum, thangga'l kaathuga'linaal kea'laamalum, thangga'l iruthayaththinaal u'narnthu ku'nappadaamalum, naan avarga'lai aaroakkiyamaakkaamalumirukka, nee avarga'l iruthayaththaik kozhuththathaakki, avarga'l kaathuga'lai manthappaduththi, avarga'l ka'nga'lai moodippoadu en'raar.
appozhuthu naan: aa'ndavarea, ethuvaraikkum en'ru keattean. atha'rku avar: patta'nangga'l kudiyillaamalum, veeduga'l manushasagnchaaramillaamalum paazhaagi, boomi avaantharave'liyaagi,
karththar manusharaith thooramaaga vilakkuvathinaal, theasaththin nadumaiyam mut'rilum ve'rumaiyaakkappadum varaikkumea.

aagilum athil innum paththil oru panggirukkum, athuvum thirumba nirmoolamaakkappadum; karvaalimaramum arasamaramum ilaiyat'ruppoanapinbu, avaiga'lin adimaram iruppathupoala, athin adimaramum parisuththa viththaayirukkum en'raar.

usiyaavinudaiya kumaaranaagiya yoathaamin kumaaran aagaas ennum yoothaatheasaththu raajaavin naadka'lilea, reathseen ennum seeriyaavin raajaavum, remaliyaavin kumaaranaagiya pekkaa ennum isravealin raajaavum erusaleaminmeal yuththampa'n'na vanthaarga'l, avarga'laal athaip pidikkakkoodaama'rpoayit'ru.

seeriyar eppiraayeemaich saarnthirukki'raarga'len'ru thaaveethin kudumbaththukku a'rivikkappattapoathu, raajaavin iruthayamum avan janaththin iruthayamum kaattilu'l'la marangga'l kaat'rinaal asaigi'rathupoal asainthathu.
appozhuthu karththar easaayaavai noakki: neeyum un magan seayaaryaasoobumaaga va'n'naar thu'raivazhiyilu'l'la mea'rku'laththu mathagin kadaisimattum aagaasukku ethirko'ndupoay,
nee avanai noakki: seeriyar eppiraayeemoadum, remaliyaavin maganoadum unakku viroathamaagath thuraaloasanai pa'n'ni,
naam yoothaavukku viroathamaayppoay, athai nerukki, athai namakku'l'lea panggittukko'ndu, atha'rkuth thabeayaalin kumaaranai raajaavaaga ea'rpaduththuvoam en'ru sonnathinimiththam;

nee bayappadaamal amarnthirukkap paar; intha ira'ndu pugaigi'ra ko'l'likkattaiga'laagiya seeriyaroadea vantha reathseenum, remaliyaavin maganum ko'nda ukkirakkoabaththinimiththam un iruthayam thuva'lavea'ndaam.
karththaraagiya aa'ndavar: antha aaloasanai nilaini'rpathillai, athinpadi sambavippathumillai;
seeriyaavin thalai thamasku, thamaskuvin thalai reathseen; innum a'rubaththainthu varushangga'lilea eppiraayeem oru janamaayiraathapadikku no'runggu'ndupoam.
eppiraayeemin thalai samaariyaa, samaariyaavin thalai remaliyaavin magan; neengga'l visuvaasiyaavittaal nilaipe'ramaatteerga'l en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththar aagaasai noakki:
nee un theavanaagiya karththaridaththil oru adaiyaa'laththai vea'ndikko'l; athai aazhaththilirunthaagilum, unnathaththilirunthaagilum u'ndaagak keattukko'l en'ru sonnaar.
aagaasoa: naan keadkamaattean, naan karththaraip pareedchai seyyamaattean en'raan.
appozhuthu easaayaa: thaaveethin vamsaththaarea, kea'lungga'l; neengga'l manusharai visanappaduththugi'rathu poathaathen'ru en theavanaiyum visanappaduththap paarkki'reerga'loa?
aathalaal aa'ndavar thaamea ungga'lukku oru adaiyaa'laththaik koduppaar; ithoa, oru kannigai karppavathiyaagi oru kumaaranaip pe'ruvaa'l, avarukku immaanuveal en'ru peariduvaa'l.
theemaiyai ve'ruththu nanmaiyaith therinthuko'l'la a'riyum vayathumattum avar ve'n'neyaiyum theanaiyum saappiduvaar.
anthap pi'l'lai theemaiyai ve'rukkavum, nanmaiyaith therinthuko'l'lavum a'rigi'ratha'rkumunnea, nee aruvarukki'ra theasam athin ira'ndu raajaakka'laal vittuvidappadum.
eppiraayeem yoothaavaivittup pirintha naa'lmuthal varaatha naadka'laik karththar unmealum, un janaththinmealum, un pithaavudaiya vamsaththinmealum, aseeriyaavin raajaavinaalea varappa'n'nuvaar.
annaadka'lilea, karththar egipthu nathiga'lin kadaiyaantharaththilu'l'la eeyaiyum, aseeriyaa theasaththilirukkum theaneeyaiyum payilkaatti azhaippaar.
avaiga'l vanthu eagamaay vanaantharangga'lin pa'l'laththaakkuga'lilum, kanmalaiga'lin vedippuga'lilum, ellaa mudkaaduga'lilum, meaychchalu'l'la ellaa idangga'lilum thanggum.

akkaalaththilea aa'ndavar koolikkuvaanggina savaragan kaththiyinaal, athaavathu, nathiyin akkaraiyilu'l'la aseeriyaa raajaavinaal, thalaimayiraiyum kaalmayiraiyum siraippiththu, thaadiyaiyum vaanggippoaduvippaar.
akkaalaththil oruvan oru i'lampasuvaiyum, ira'ndu aaduga'laiyum va'larththaal,
avaiga'l poora'namaayp paal ka'rakki'rapadiyinaal ve'n'neyaich saappiduvaan; theasaththin naduvil meethiyaayiruppavanevanum ve'n'neyaiyum theanaiyumea saappiduvaan.
annaa'lilea, aayiram ve'l'likkaasu pe'rum aayiram thiraadchachsediyiruntha nilamellaam mudchediyum nerignchilumaagum.
theasamenggum mudchediyum nerignchilum u'ndaayiruppathinaal, ambuga'laiyum villaiyum pidiththu anggea poagavea'ndiyathaayirukkum.

ma'nvettiyaal koththappadugi'ra malaiga'l u'ndea; mudchediga'lukkum nerignchilga'lukkum bayappaduvathinaal avaiga'lil on'ri'rkum poagak koodaamaiyinaal, avaiga'l maaduga'lai oattividuvatha'rkum, aaduga'l mithippatha'rkumaana idamaayirukkum en'raan.
pinnum karththar ennai noakki: nee oru periya paththiraththai eduththu manushan ezhuthugi'ra piragaaramaay athilea mahear-saalaal-ash-baas en'ru ezhuthu en'raar.
appozhuthu naan u'nmaiyu'l'la saadchikkaararaagiya aasaariyanaana uriyaavaiyum, yeberekiyaavin kumaaranaana sagariyaavaiyum atha'rkuch saadchiga'laaga vaiththukko'ndean.
naan theerkkatharisiyaanava'laich searnthapoathu, ava'l karppavathiyaagi oru kumaaranaip pet'raa'l; appozhuthu karththar ennai noakki: mahear-saalaal-ash-baas ennum pearai avanukku idu.
inthap paalagan, appaa, ammaa en'ru kooppida a'riyumunnea, thamaskuvin aasthiyum, samaariyaavin ko'l'laiyum, aseeriyaavin raajaavukku munbaagak ko'ndupoagappadum en'raar.
pinnum karththar ennai noakki:
intha janam methuvaay oadugi'ra seeloavaavin tha'n'neerga'lai asattaipa'n'ni, reathseenaiyum remaliyaavin kumaaranaiyum saarnthu santhoashikki'rapadiyinaal,

ithoa, aa'ndavar vallamaiyu'l'la thira'laana aat'runeeraippoan'ra aseeriyaavin raajaavaiyum, avanudaiya sagala aadambaraththaiyum avarga'lmeal pura'lappa'n'nuvaar; athu avarga'ludaiya oadaiga'lellaavat'rinmealum poay, avarga'ludaiya ellaak karaiga'lmealum pura'ndu,
yoothaavukku'l pugunthu piravaagiththuk kadanthu, kazhuththumattum varum en'raar. immaanuvealea, avan settaiga'lin virivu umathu theasaththin visaalaththai moodum.
janangga'lea, neengga'l koottangkoodungga'l, mu'riyadikkappaduveerga'l; thooratheasaththaaraagiya neengga'l ellaarum sevikodungga'l; idaikkattikko'l'lungga'l, mu'rinthoaduveerga'l,
aaloasanai seyyungga'l, athu abaththamaagum; vaarththaiyai vasaniyungga'l, athu ni'rkaathu; theavan engga'loadea irukki'raar.
karththarudaiya karam enmeal amarnthu, avar ennudanea peasi, naan intha janaththin vazhiyilea nadavaathapadi enakkup buththisolli vi'lambinathaavathu:
intha janangga'l kattuppaadu en'ru sollugi'rathaiyellaam neengga'l kattuppaadu en'ru sollaamalum, avarga'l bayappadugi'ra bayaththinpadi neengga'l bayappadaamalum, kalanggaamalum,
seanaiga'lin karththaraiyea parisuththampa'n'nungga'l; avarea ungga'l bayamum, avarea ungga'l achchamumaayiruppaaraaga.

avar ungga'lukkup parisuththa sthalamaayiruppaar; aagilum isravealin ira'ndu koaththiraththukkum thadukkalin kallum, ida'ruthalin kanmalaiyum, erusaleamin kudiga'lukkuch surukkum ka'n'niyumaayiruppaar.
avarga'lil aneagar ida'rivizhunthu no'runggich sikku'ndu pidipaduvaarga'l.
saadchi aagamaththaik katti, en seesharukku'l'lea veathaththai muththiraiyidu en'raar.
naanoa yaakkoabin kudumbaththukkuth thamathu mugaththai ma'raikki'ra karththarukkaagak kaaththirunthu, avarukku ethirpaarththiruppean.
ithoa, naanum, karththar enakkuk koduththa pi'l'laiga'lum seeyoan parvathaththil vaasamaayirukki'ra seanaiga'lin karththaraalea isravealil adaiyaa'langga'laagavum a'rputhangga'laagavum irukki'roam.

avarga'l ungga'lai noakki: agnchanam paarkki'ravarga'lidaththilum, mu'numu'nen'ru oathugi'ra ku'rikaararidaththilum visaariyungga'l en'ru sollumpoathu, janangga'l than theavanidaththil visaarikkavea'ndiyathallavoa? uyiru'l'lavarga'lukkaagach seththavarga'lidaththil visaarikkalaamoa?
veathaththaiyum saadchi aagamaththaiyum kavanikkavea'ndum; intha vaarththaiyinpadiyea sollaavittaal, avarga'lukku vidiya'rkaalaththu ve'lichchamillai.
idukka'n adainthavarga'laayum pattiniyaayum theasaththaik kadanthupoavaarga'l; avarga'l pattiniyaayirukkumpoathu, moorkkave'riko'ndu, thangga'l raajaavaiyum thangga'l theavanaiyum thooshippaarga'l.
avarga'l a'n'naanthupaarppaarga'l, boomiyaiyum noakkippaarppaarga'l; aanaalum ithoa, ikkattum anthagaaramum irukkum; idukkaththaal iru'ladainthu, anthagaaraththilea tha'l'lu'ndu alaivaarga'l.

aagilum avar sebuloan naattaiyum, napthali naattaiyum idukkamaay eenappaduththina munthina kaalaththilirunthathupoala athu iru'ndiruppathillai; eanen'raal avar kada'rkaraiyarugilum, yoarthaan nathiyoaraththilumu'l'la pu'rajaathiyaarudaiya kalileayaavaagiya aththeasaththaip pi'rkaalaththilea magimaippaduththuvaar.
iru'lil nadakki'ra janangga'l periya ve'lichchaththaik ka'ndaarga'l; mara'na iru'lin theasaththil kudiyirukki'ravarga'linmeal ve'lichcham piragaasiththathu.

antha jaathiyaith thira'laakki, atha'rku magizhchchiyaip perugappa'n'nineer; a'ruppil magizhgi'rathupoalavum, ko'l'laiyaip panggittukko'l'lugaiyil ka'likoorugi'rathupoalavum, umakku munbaaga magizhugi'raarga'l.
meethiyaaniyarin naa'lil nadanthathupoala, avarga'l sumantha nugaththadiyaiyum, avarga'l thoa'linmealiruntha milaat'raiyum, avarga'l aa'loattiyin koalaiyum mu'riththuppoatteer.
ama'liyaay yuththampa'n'nugi'ra veerarudaiya aayuthavarkkangga'lum, iraththaththil pura'nda uduppum akkinikku iraiyaagach sutterikkappadum.

namakku oru paalagan pi'ranthaar; namakku oru kumaaran kodukkappattaar; karththaththuvam avar thoa'linmealirukkum; avar naamam athisayamaanavar, aaloasanaikkarththaa, vallamaiyu'l'la theavan, niththiya pithaa, samaathaanappirabu ennappadum.

thaaveethin singgaasanaththaiyum avanudaiya raajyaththaiyum avar thidappaduththi, athai ithumutha'rko'ndu en'ren'raikkum niyaayaththinaalum neethiyinaalum nilaippaduththumpadikku, avarudaiya karththaththuvaththin perukkaththukkum, athin samaathaanaththukkum mudivillai; seanaiga'lin karththarudaiya vairaakkiyam ithaich seyyum.
aa'ndavar yaakkoabukku oru vaarththaiyai anuppinaar; athu isravealinmeal i'ranggit'ru.
senggalkattu idinthupoayit'ru, po'lintha kallaalea thirumbak kattuvoam; kaattaththimarangga'l vettippoadappattathu, avaiga'lukkup bathilaagak keathurumarangga'lai vaippoam en'ru,
aganthaiyum, manapperumaiyumaaych sollugi'ra eppiraayeemarum, samaariyaavin kudiga'lumaagiya ellaa janaththukkum athu theriyavarum.
aathalaal karththar reathseenudaiya saththurukka'lai avarga'lmeal uyarththi, avarga'ludaiya mat'rach saththurukka'lai avarga'loadea koottik kalappaar.

mu'rpu'raththil seeriyarum, pi'rpu'raththil pelistharum vanthu, isravealaith thi'ranthavaayaal padchippaarga'l; ivaiyellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koabam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
janangga'l thangga'lai adikki'ravaridaththil thirumbaamalum, seanaiga'lin karththaraith theadaamalum irukki'raarga'l.
aagaiyaal karththar isravealilea thalaiyaiyum, vaalaiyum, ki'laiyaiyum, naa'nalaiyum, oreanaa'lilea vettippoaduvaar.
mooppanum kanamporunthinavanumea thalai, poyppoathagampa'n'nugi'ra theerkkatharisiyea vaal.
intha janaththai nadaththugi'ravarga'l eththarumaay, avarga'laal nadaththappadugi'ravarga'l naasamadaigi'ravarga'lumaay irukki'raarga'l.

aathalaal, aa'ndavar avarga'l vaalibarmeal piriyamaayiruppathillai; avarga'lilirukki'ra thikkat'ra pi'l'laiga'lmealum vithavaiga'lmealum irangguvathumillai; avarga'l anaivarum maayakkaararum pollaathavarga'lumaayirukki'raarga'l; ellaa vaayum aagaamiyam peasum; ivaiyellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koabam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
aagaamiyamaanathu akkiniyaippoala erigi'rathu; athu mudchediyaiyum nerignchilaiyum padchikkum, athu nerunggiya kaattaik ko'luththum, pugai thira'ndu ezhumbum.
seanaiga'lin karththarudaiya sinaththaal theasam anthagaarappattu, janangga'l akkinikku iraiyaavaarga'l; oruvanum than sagoatharanaith thappavidaan.
valathupu'raththil padchiththaalum pasiththiruppaarga'l; idathupu'raththil thin'raalum thirupthiyadaiyaarga'l; avanavan thanthan puyaththin maamsaththaith thinbaan.

manaasea eppiraayeemaiyum, eppiraayeem manaaseayaiyum padchippaarga'l; ivarga'l eagamaay yoothaavukku viroathamaayiruppaarga'l; ivaiyellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koabam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
eazhaiga'lai vazhakkilea thoa'rkappa'n'navum, en janaththil si'rumaiyaanavarga'lin niyaayaththaip purattavum, vithavaiga'laich soo'raiyaadavum, thikkat'ra pi'l'laiga'laik ko'l'laiyidavum,
aniyaayamaana theerppuga'laich seygi'ravarga'lukkum, kodumaiyaana katta'laiga'lai ezhuthugi'ravarga'lukkum aiyoa!
visaarippin naa'lilum, thooraththilirunthu varum paazhkkadippin naa'lilum neengga'l ennaseyveerga'l? uthavipe'rumpadi yaaridaththil oaduveerga'l? ungga'l magimaiyai enggea vaiththuviduveerga'l?
kattu'ndavarga'linkeezh mudangginaalozhiya kolaiseyyappattavarga'lukku'l vizhuvaarga'l; ivaiyellaavat'rilum avarudaiya koabam aa'raamal, innum avarudaiya kai neettinapadiyea irukki'rathu.
en koabaththin koalaagiya aseeriyanukku aiyoa! avan kaiyilirukki'rathu en sinaththin tha'ndaayutham.

avabakthiyaana janangga'lukku viroathamaay naan avanai anuppi, enakkuk koabamoottina janaththaik ko'l'laiyidavum, soo'raiyaadavum, athai veethiga'lin seat'raippoal mithiththuppoadavum avanukkuk katta'laikoduppean.
avanoa appadi e'n'nugi'rathumillai, avan iruthayam appadippattathai ninaikki'rathumillai; aneagam jaathiga'lai azhikkavum, sanggarikkavumea than manathilea ninaivuko'l'lugi'raan.
avan: en pirabukka'l anaivarum raajaakka'lallavoa?
kalnoapatta'nam karkeamisaippoalaanathillaiyoa? aamaath arpaaththaippoalaanathillaiyoa? samaariyaa thamaskuvaippoalaanathillaiyoa?
erusaleamaiyum samaariyaavaiyumpaarkkilum viseashiththa silaiga'lu'l'la vikkiraga raajyangga'lai en kai ka'ndupidiththirukka,
naan samaariyaavukkum, athin vikkiragangga'lukkum seythathupoal, erusaleamukkum athin vikkiragangga'lukkum seyyaamaliruppeanoa en'ru sollugi'raan.

aathalaal: aa'ndavar seeyoan malaiyilum erusaleamilum thamathu seyalaiyellaam mudiththirukkumpoathu, aseeriya raajaavinudaiya perumaiyaana negnchin vinaiyaiyum, avan ka'nga'lin meattimaiyaana paarvaiyaiyum naan visaarippean engi'raar.

avan: en kaiyin belaththinaalum, en gnaanaththinaalum ithaich seythean; naan buththimaan, naan janangga'lin ellaiga'lai maat'ri, avarga'l pa'ndagasaalaiga'laik ko'l'laiyittu vallavanaippoal kudiga'laith thaazhththinean.

oru kuruvikkoottaik ka'ndupidikki'rathupoal en kai janangga'lin aasthiyaik ka'ndupidiththathu; vittuvidappatta muttaiga'lai vaarikko'lvathupoal boomiyaiyellaam naan vaarikko'ndean; oruvarum settaiyai asaiththathumillai, vaayaith thi'ranthathumillai, keechchen'ru saththamittathumillai en'ru sollugi'raan.

koadariyaanathu thannaal vettugi'ravanukku viroathamaay meanmaipaaraattalaamoa? vaa'laanathu thannaik kaiyaadugi'ravanukku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraattalaamoa? paaraattinaal, thadiyaanathu thannaip pidiththavanai mirattinaa'rpoalavum, koalaanathu naan marakkattaiyallaven'ru ezhumbinaa'rpoalavum irukkumea.
aagaiyaal seanaiga'lin aa'ndavaraagiya karththar, avanaichsearntha kozhuththavarga'lukku'l'lea i'laippai anuppuvaar; padchikkum akkiniyaippoalum oru akkiniyai avan magimaiyinkeezh ko'luththuvaar.
isravealin o'liyaanavar akkiniyum, athin parisuththar akkinijuvaalaiyumaagi, oreanaa'lilea avanudaiya mudchediga'laiyum, nerignchilga'laiyum thagiththup padchiththu,
avanudaiya vanaththin magimaiyaiyum, avanudaiya payirnilaththin magimaiyaiyum, u'l'lum pu'rambumaay azhiyappa'n'nuvaar; kodipidikki'ravan ka'laiththu vizhuvathupoalaagum.
kaattil avanukku meethiyaana marangga'l kognchamaayirukkum, oru si'rupi'l'lai avaiga'lai e'n'ni ezhuthalaam.

akkaalaththilea isravealil meethiyaanavarga'lum, yaakkoabin vamsaththil thappinavarga'lum, pinnorupoathum thangga'lai adiththavanaich saarnthuko'l'laamal, isravealin parisuththaraagiya karththaraiyea u'nmaiyaaych saarnthuko'lvaarga'l.
meethiyaayiruppavarga'l, yaakkoabil meethiyaayiruppavarga'lea, vallamaiyu'l'la theavanidaththil thirumbuvaarga'l.

isravealea, un janangga'l samuththiraththin ma'nalaththanaiyaayirunthaalum, avarga'lil meethiyaayiruppavarga'lmaaththiram thirumbuvaarga'l; theermaanikkappatta azhivu ni'raintha neethiyoadea pura'nduvarum.
seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar theasaththukku'l'lenggum theermaanikkappatta azhivai varachseyvaar.
aagaiyaal seeyoanil vaasamaayirukki'ra en janamea, aseeriyanukkup bayappadaathea; avan unnaik koalaal adiththu, egipthiyaraippoal than tha'ndaayuthaththai unmeal oangguvaan.
aanaalum innum kognchakkaalaththukku'l'lea en ukkiramum, avarga'laich sanggarikkappoagi'rathinaal en koabamum theernthupoam en'ru seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.

oareab kanmalaiya'ndaiyilea meethiyaaniyar vettu'ndathupoal seanaiga'lin karththar avanmeal oru savukkai ezhumbivarappa'n'ni, egipthilea thamathu koalaik kadalinmeal oangginathupoal athai avanmeal oangguvaar.
annaa'lil un thoa'linin'ru avan sumaiyum, un kazhuththinin'ru avan nugamum neekkappadum; abisheagaththin nugam mu'rinthupoam.
avan aayaaththukku vanthu, mikroanaik kadanthu, mikmaasilea than rasthukka'lai vaiththirukki'raan.
ka'navaayaith thaa'ndi, keabaavilea paa'layami'ranggugi'raarga'l; raamaa athirgi'rathu; savulin ooraagiya kibiyaa oadippoagi'rathu.
kaaleem kumaaraththiyea, uraththa saththamaayk kooppidu; eazhai aanathoaththea, laayeesh oormattum etta saththamittuk kooppidu.
mathmeanaa valasaivaanggippoam, keabimin kudiga'l thappioadak koottangkoodugi'raarga'l.
ini orunaa'l noabilea thanggi, seeyoan kumaaraththiyin parvathaththukkum, erusaleamin meattukkum viroathamaayk kai neetti mirattuvaan.
ithoa, seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar thoappuga'laip bayanggaramaay vettuvaar; oanggi va'larnthavaiga'l vettu'ndu meattimaiyaanavaiga'l thaazhththappadum.
avar kaattin adarththiyaik koadariyinaalea vettippoaduvaar; magaththuvamaanavaraalea leebanoan vizhum.
eesaayennum adimaraththilirunthu oru thu'lir thoan'ri, avan vearga'lilirunthu oru ki'lai ezhumbich sezhikkum.

gnaanaththaiyum u'narvaiyum aru'lum aaviyum, aaloasanaiyaiyum belanaiyum aru'lum aaviyum, a'rivaiyum karththarukkup bayappadugi'ra bayaththaiyum aru'lum aaviyumaagiya karththarudaiya aaviyaanavar avarmeal thanggiyiruppaar.
karththarukkup bayappaduthal avarukku ugantha vaasanaiyaayirukkum; avar thamathu ka'n ka'ndapadi niyaayantheerkkaamalum, thamathu kaathu keattapadi theerppuchseyyaamalum,

neethiyinpadi eazhaiga'lai niyaayam visaariththu, yathaarththaththinpadi boomiyilu'l'la si'rumaiyaanavarga'lukkuth theerppuchseythu, boomiyaith thamathu vaakkin koalaal adiththu, thamathu vaayin suvaasaththaal thunmaarkkaraich sanggarippaar.
neethi avarukku araikkattum, saththiyam avarukku idaikkachchaiyumaayirukkum.

appozhuthu oanaay aattukkuttiyoadea thanggum, puli ve'l'laattukkuttiyoadea paduththukko'l'lum; kan'rukkuttiyum, baalasinggamum, kaa'laiyum, orumiththirukkum; oru si'ru paiyan avaiga'lai nadaththuvaan.
pasuvum karadiyum koodimeayum, avaiga'lin kuttiga'l orumiththup paduththukko'l'lum; singgam maattaippoal vaikkoal thinnum.
paal kudikkungkuzhanthai viriyanpaambu va'laiyinmeal vi'laiyaadum, paal ma'rantha pi'l'lai kattuviriyan put'rilea than kaiyai vaikkum.
en parisuththa parvathamenggum theengguseyvaarumillai; keaduseyvaarumillai; samuththiram jalaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathupoal, boomi karththarai a'rigi'ra a'rivinaal ni'rainthirukkum.
akkaalaththilea, janangga'lukkuk kodiyaaga ni'rkum eesaayin vearukkaaga jaathiga'l visaariththuk keadpaarga'l; avarudaiya thaabarasthalam magimaiyaayirukkum.

akkaalaththilea, aa'ndavar aseeriyaavilum, egipthilum, pathroasilum, eththiyoappiyaavilum, persiyaavilum, sineayaarilum, aamaaththilum, samuththirath theevuga'lilum, thammudaiya janaththil meethiyaanavarga'lai meettukko'l'lath thirumba ira'ndaamvisai thamathu karaththai neetti,
jaathiga'lukku oru kodiyai eat'ri, isravealil thuraththu'ndavarga'laich searththu, yoothaavil sitha'radikkappattavarga'lai boomiyin naangu thisaiga'lilumirunthu koottuvaar.
eppiraayeemin po'raamai neenggum, yoothaavin saththurukka'l sanggarikkappaduvaarga'l; eppiraayeem yoothaavinmeal po'raamaiyaayiraan, yoothaa eppiraayeemaith thunbappaduththaan.

avarga'l iruvarum eagamaayk koodi mea'rkeayirukki'ra pelistharudaiya ellaiga'linmeal paaynthu, keezhththisaiyaaraik ko'l'laiyittu, eathoaminmealum moavaabinmealum kaipoaduvaarga'l; ammoan puththirar avarga'lukkuk keezhppadivaarga'l.

egipthin samuththiramunaiyaik karththar mut'rilum azhiththu, thammudaiya kaat'rin valumaiyinaal nathiyinmeal thamathu kaiyai neetti, eazhaa'ruga'laagap piriththu, janangga'l kaalnanaiyaamal kadanthupoagumpadi pa'n'nuvaar.
isravealar egipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappattanaa'lil avarga'lukku irunthathupoala, aseeriyaavilea avarudaiya janaththil meethiyaanavarga'lukku oru perumpaathaiyirukkum.
akkaalaththilea nee solvathu: karththaavea, naan ummaith thuthippean; neer enmeal koabamaayiruntheer; aanaalum ummudaiya koabam neenggit'ru; neer ennaith theat'rugi'reer.
ithoa, theavanea en iradchippu; naan bayappadaamal nambikkaiyaayiruppean; karththaraagiya yeagoavaa en belanum, en keethamumaanavar; avarea enakku iradchippumaanavar.
neengga'l iradchippin oot'ruga'lilirunthu magizhchchiyoadea tha'n'neer mo'nduko'lveerga'l.

akkaalaththilea neengga'l solvathu: karththaraith thuthiyungga'l; avar naamaththaith thozhuthuko'l'lungga'l; avarudaiya seygaiga'lai janangga'lukku'l'lea a'riviyungga'l; avarudaiya naamam uyarnthathen'ru pirasthaabampa'n'nungga'l.
karththaraik keerththanampa'n'nungga'l, avar magaththuvamaana kiriyaiga'laich seythaar; ithu boomiyenggum a'riyappadakkadavathu enbeerga'l.
seeyoanil vaasamaayirukki'rava'lea, nee saththamittuk kembeeri; isravealin parisuththar un naduvil periyavaraayirukki'raar.
aamoathsin kumaaranaagiya easaayaa baabiloanmeal varakka'nda baaram.
uyarntha parvathaththinmeal kodiyeat'rungga'l; uraththa saththamittu janangga'lai varavazhaiyungga'l; avarga'l pirabukka'lin vaasalga'lukku'l piraveasippatha'rkuch saigai kaattungga'l.

naan parisuththamaakkinavarga'lukkuk katta'lai koduththean; en koabaththai ni'raiveat'ra en baraakkiramasaaliga'lai azhaiththum irukki'rean; avarga'l en magaththuvaththinaalea ka'likoorugi'ravarga'l engi'raar.

thira'laana janangga'lin saththaththukkoththa vegu koottaththin iraichchalum, koottappatta jaathiga'ludaiya raajyangga'lin ama'liyaana iraichchalum malaiga'lil keadkappadugi'rathu; seanaiga'lin karththar yuththaraa'nuvaththai ilakkampaarkki'raar.
karththar varugi'raar; avarudaiya koabaththin aayuthangga'lum, theasaththaiyellaam azhikka, vaanangkavizhntha kadaiyaanthara theasaththilirunthu varugi'rathu.
ala'rungga'l, karththarin naa'l sameebamaayirukki'rathu; athu sarvavallavaridaththilirunthu mahaa sanggaaramaay varum.
aathalaal ellaak kaiga'lum negizhnthu, ellaa manusharin iruthayamum karainthupoam.

avarga'l thigiladaivaarga'l; veathanaiga'lum vaathaiga'lum avarga'laip pidikkum; pi'l'laipe'rugi'rava'laippoala veathanaippaduvaarga'l; oruvaraiyoruvar piramiththuppaarppaarga'l; avarga'l mugangga'l neruppaana mugangga'laayirukkum.
ithoa, theasaththaip paazhaakki, athin paaviga'lai athilirunthu azhippatha'rkaagak karththarudaiya naa'l kadooramum, moorkkamum, ukkirakoabamumaay varugi'rathu.
vaanaththin nadchaththirangga'lum raasiga'lum o'li kodaathirukkum; sooriyan uthikkaiyil iru'ndupoam; santhiran o'li kodaathirukkum.
paavaththinimiththam ulagaththaiyum, akkiramaththinimiththam thunmaarkkaraiyum naan tha'ndiththu, aganggaararin perumaiyai ozhiyappa'n'ni, kodiyarin idumbaith thaazhththuvean.
purushanaip pasumponnilum, manushanai oappeerin thanggaththilum abooruvamaakkuvean.
ithinimiththam seanaiga'lin karththarudaiya ukkiraththinaal avarudaiya kadungkoabaththin naa'lilea boomi thannidaththaivittu neenggumpadi vaanaththai athirappa'n'nuvean.

thuraththappatta ve'limaanaippoalum, yaarum searkkaatha aattaippoalum iruppaarga'l; avaravar thangga'l janaththa'ndaikkup poaga mugaththaith thiruppi, avaravar thangga'l theasaththukku oadippoavaarga'l.
agappattavanevanum kuththu'ndu, avarga'laich searnthirunthavanevanum pattayaththaal vizhuvaan.
avarga'l kuzhanthaiga'l avarga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaaga moathiyadikkappadum; avarga'l veeduga'l ko'l'laiyidappadum; avarga'l manaiviga'l avamaanappaduvaarga'l.
ithoa, naan avarga'lukku viroathamaay meathiyarai ezhuppuvean; avarga'l ve'l'liyai mathiyaamalum, ponninmeal piriyappadaamalum,
villuga'laal i'laignaraich sithaiththuviduvaarga'l; karppakkaniyinmeal avarga'l irangguvathillai; avarga'l ka'n pi'l'laiga'laith thappaviduvathumillai.
raajyangga'lukku'l alanggaaramum, kaltheayarudaiya pirathaana magimaiyumaagiya baabiloanaanathu theavanaal soathoamum komoaraavum kavizhkkappattathupoala kavizhkkappadum.

ini orupoathum athil oruvarum kudiyea'ruvathumillai, thalaimu'raithoa'rum athil oruvarum thanggith tharippathumillai; anggea arabiyan koodaarampoaduvathumillai; anggea meayppar manthaiyai ma'rippathumillai.
kaattumirugangga'l anggea paduththukko'l'lum; oo'laiyidum piraa'niga'l avarga'l veeduga'lai nirappum; koattaanga'l anggea kudiko'l'lum; kaattaadu anggea thu'l'lum.

avarga'l paazhaana maa'ligaiga'lil oariga'l oo'laiyidum; valusarppangga'l avarga'l selvikkaiyaana aramanaiga'lil eagamaayk koodum; athinkaalam seekkiram varum, athin naadka'l neediththiraathu engi'raar.

karththar yaakkoabukku iranggi, pinnum isravealaraith therinthuko'ndu, avarga'lai avarga'l theasaththilea thaabarikkappa'n'nuvaar; anniyarum avarga'loadu searkkaiyaagi, yaakkoabin vamsaththoadea koodikko'lvaarga'l.

janangga'l avarga'lai azhaiththukko'ndupoay avarga'l sthaanaththil viduvaarga'l; israveal vamsaththaar karththarudaiya theasaththilea avarga'lai vealaikkaararaagavum vealaikkaariga'laagavum kaiyaa'ndu, thangga'laich si'raiyaakkinavarga'laich si'raiyaakki, thangga'lai odukkinavarga'lai aa'luvaarga'l.
karththar un thukkaththaiyum, un thaththa'lippaiyum, nee adimaiyaakkappattiruntha kadinamaana adimaiththanaththaiyum neekki, unnai i'laippaa'rappa'n'num akkaalaththilea,
nee baabiloan raajaavinmeal sollum vaakkiyamaavathu: odukkinavan ozhinthupoanaanea! ponnagari ozhinthupoayit'rea!
karththar thushdarin tha'ndaayuthaththaiyum, arasaa'ndavarga'lin senggoalaiyum mu'riththuppoattaar.
ukkirangko'ndu oayaatha adiyaay janangga'lai adiththu, koabamaay jaathiga'lai arasaa'ndavan, thaduppaarillaamal thunbappaduththappadugi'raan.
boomimuzhuthum i'laippaa'ri amainthirukki'rathu; kembeeramaay muzhanggugi'raarga'l.
theavathaaru virudchangga'lum, leebanoanin keathurukka'lum, unnimiththam santhoashappattu, nee vizhunthukidanthathu mutha'rko'ndu engga'lai vettavaruvaar oruvarum illai en'ru sollugi'rathu.

keezhea irukki'ra paathaa'lam unnimiththam athirnthu, un varugaikku ethirko'ndu, boomiyil athibathiga'laayirunthu seththa iraadchathar yaavaraiyum unnimiththam ezhuppi, jaathiga'ludaiya ellaa raajaakka'laiyum avarga'ludaiya singgaasanangga'lilirunthu ezhunthirukkappa'n'nugi'rathu.
avarga'lellaarum unnai noakki: neeyum engga'laippoalap paladchayamaanaayoa? engga'lukkuch samaanamaanaayoa? en'ru solluvaarga'l.
un aadambaramum, un vaaththiyangga'lin muzhakkamum paathaa'laththil tha'l'lu'ndupoayit'ru; puzhukka'lea un padukkai, poochchiga'lea un poarvai.
athikaalaiyin maganaagiya vidive'l'liyea, nee vaanaththilirunthu vizhunthaayea! jaathiga'lai eenappaduththinavanea, nee tharaiyilea vizha vettappattaayea!

naan vaanaththukku ea'ruvean, theavanudaiya nadchaththirangga'lukkumealaaga en singgaasanaththai uyarththuvean; vadapu'rangga'lilu'l'la aaraathanaik koottaththin parvathaththilea veet'riruppean en'rum,
naan meagangga'lukku mealaaga unnathangga'lil ea'ruvean; unnathamaanavarukku oppaavean en'rum nee un iruthayaththil sonnaayea.
aanaalum nee agaathamaana paathaa'laththilea tha'l'lu'ndupoanaay.
unnaik kaa'ngi'ravarga'l unnai ut'ruppaarththu, unnaikku'riththuch sinthiththu: ivanthaanaa boomiyaith thaththa'likkavum, raajyangga'lai athiravum seythu,
ulagaththai vanaantharamaakki, athin nagarangga'lai azhiththu, si'raippattavarga'laith thangga'l veeduga'lukkup poagavidaamalirunthavan enbaarga'l.
jaathiga'ludaiya sagala raajaakka'lum, avaravar thangga'l a'raiyilea magimaiyoadea kidaththappattirukki'raarga'l.

neeyoa azhugippoana ki'laiyaippoalavum, pattayakkuththaal kolaiyu'ndavarga'lin uduppaippoalavum, oru kuzhiyin ka'rka'lukku'l'lea kidakki'ravarga'laippoalavum, kaalaal mithikkappatta pi'naththaippoalavum, un kalla'raikkup pu'rambaay e'rinthuvidappattaay.
nee avarga'loadea adakkam pa'n'nappaduvathillai; nee un theasaththaik keduththu un janaththaik kon'rupoattaay; theemaiseygi'ravarga'ludaiya santhathi orupoathum pearpe'ruvathillai.

avan puththirar ezhumbith theasaththaich suthanthariththukko'ndu, ulagaththaip patta'nangga'laal nirappaathapadikku, avarga'l pithaakka'ludaiya akkiramaththinimiththam avarga'laik kolaiseyya aayaththampa'n'nungga'l.

naan avarga'lukku viroathamaay ezhumbuvean en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar; baabiloanudaiya pearaiyum, athil meenthirukki'rathaiyum, puththiranaiyum pauththiranaiyum sanggarippeanen'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
athai mu'l'lampan'riga'lukkuch suthantharamum, tha'n'neer ni'rkum pa'l'langga'lumaakki, athaich sanggaaram ennum thudaippaththinaal perukkividuvean en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
naan ninaiththirukki'rapadiyea nadakkum; naan nir'nayiththapadiyea nilaini'rkum en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar aa'naiyittuch sonnaar.
aseeriyanai en theasaththilea mu'riththu, en malaiga'linmeal avanai mithiththuppoaduvean; appozhuthu avanudaiya nugam avarga'lmealirunthu vilagi, avanudaiya sumai avarga'l thoa'lilirunthu neenggum.
theasamanaiththinmealum nir'nayikkappatta yoasanai ithuvea; sagala jaathiga'lmealum neettappattirukki'ra kaiyum ithuvea en'raar.
seanaiga'lin karththar ippadi nir'nayiththirukki'raar, yaar athai viyarththamaakkuvaan? avarudaiya kai neettappattirukki'rathu, yaar athaith thiruppuvaan?
aagaas raajaa mara'namadaintha varushaththilea u'ndaana baaram ennaven'raal:
muzhu pelisthiyaavea, unnai adiththa koal mu'rinthathen'ru akka'lippaayiraathea; paambin vearilirunthu kattuviriyan thoan'rum; athin kani pa'rakki'ra akkini sarppamaayirukkum.

thariththirarin thalaippi'l'laiga'l thirupthiyaayp pusiththu, e'liyavarga'l sugamaayp paduththiruppaarga'l; unvearaip pagnchaththinaalea saagappa'n'nuvean, unnil meethiyaanavarga'lai avan kon'rupoaduvaan.
vaasalea ala'ru; nagaramea katha'ru; pelisthiyaavea, nee muzhuthum karainthupoagi'raay; eanen'raal, vadakkea irunthu pugaikkaadaay varugi'raan; avan koottangga'lil thaniththavanillai.

ippoathum intha jaathiyin sthaanaabathiga'lukku enna maa'ruththaravu sollappadum? karththar seeyoanai asthibaarappaduththinaar; avarudaiya janaththil si'rumaiyaanavarga'l athilea thidanko'ndu thangguvaarga'l enbathea.

moavaabin baaram. iravilea moavaabilu'l'la aar ennum patta'nam paazhaakkappattathu, athu sanggaaramaayit'ru; iravilea moavaabilu'l'la keer ennum patta'nam paazhaakkappattathu, athu sanggaaramaayit'ru.

azhumpadi meadaiga'laagiya baayiththukkum theeboanukkum poagi'raarga'l; neaboavinimiththamum meathebaavinimiththamum moavaab ala'rugi'rathu; avarga'ludaiya thalaiga'lellaam mottaiyadiththirukkum; thaadiga'lellaam kaththariththirukkum.
athin veethiga'lil irattaikkattikko'ndu, ellaarum athin veeduga'lmealum, athin therukka'lilum ala'ri, azhuthuko'ndirukki'raarga'l.

esboan ooraarum eleyaalea ooraarum kookkuralidugi'raarga'l; avarga'l saththam yaagaasmattum keadkappadugi'rathu; aagaiyaal moavaabin aayuthabaa'niga'l katha'rugi'raarga'l; avanavanudaiya aaththumaa avanavanil kileasappadugi'rathu.

en iruthayam moavaabinimiththam oalamidugi'rathu; athilirunthu oadivarugi'ravarga'l moon'ru vayathu kidaariyaippoala alaigi'raarga'l; loogiththukku ea'rippoagi'ra vazhiyilea azhugaiyoadea ea'rugi'raarga'l; oroanaayeemin vazhiyilea no'rungguthalin kookkural idugi'raarga'l.
nimreemin neerppaaychchalaana idangga'l paazhaayppoam; pul ularnthu, mu'lai azhinthu, pachchaiyillaama'rpoagi'rathu.
aathalaal miguthiyaagach searththathaiyum, avarga'l sambaathiththu vaiththathaiyum, alariga'lin aat'rukkappaalea eduththukko'ndupoavaarga'l.
kookkural moavaabin ellaiyenggum sut'rum; eklaayimmattum athin ala'ruthalum, berealeemmattum athin pulambuthalum ettum.

theemoanin tha'n'neerga'l iraththaththaal ni'rainthirukkum; theemoaninmeal athiga keaduga'laik katta'laiyiduvean; moavaabilea thappinavarga'lmealum, theasaththil meethiyaanavarga'lmealum singgaththai varappa'n'nuvean.
theasaathibathikkuch seluththum aattukkuttiga'lai neengga'l sealaapatta'nanthuvakki vanaantharamattum searththuch seeyoan kumaaraththiyin malaikku anuppungga'l.
illaavittaal koottaivittuth thuraththappattu alaigi'ra kuruviyaippoala moavaabin kumaaraththiga'l arnoan nathiyin thu'raiga'lidaththiliruppaarga'l.
nee aaloasanaipa'n'ni, niyaayagnseythu, maththiyaanaththilea un nizhalai iravaippoalaakki, thuraththappattavarga'lai ma'raiththukko'l, oadivarugi'ravarga'laik kaattikkodaathiru.

moavaabea, thuraththividappatta en janangga'l unnidaththil thanggattum; sanggarikki'ravanukkuth thappa avarga'lukku adaikkalamaayiru; odukkugi'ravan illaatheapoavaan; sanggarippu ozhinthupoam; mithikki'ravarga'l theasaththil iraathapadikku azhinthupoavaarga'l.
kirubaiyinaalea singgaasanam sthaabikkappadum; niyaayam visaariththuth thurithamaay neethiseygi'ra oruvar athinmeal thaaveethin koodaaraththilea niyaayaathibathiyaay u'nmaiyoadea veet'riruppaar.
moavaabin perumaiyaiyum, avan meattimaiyaiyum, avan aganggaaraththaiyum, avan ukkiraththaiyum ku'riththuk keattoam; avan meththap perumaikkaaran; aanaalum avan veembu sellaathu.

aagaiyaal, moavaabiyar oruvarukkaaga oruvar ala'ruvaarga'l, ellaarum eagamaay ala'ruvaarga'l; kiraareaseath oorin asthibaarangga'l thagarkkappattathea en'ru avaiga'lukkaagap perumoochchu viduvaarga'l.

esboan oor vayalga'l vaadippoayina; sibmaaoorth thiraadchachsediyin nalla kodiga'lai jaathiga'lin athibathiga'l na'rukkippoattaarga'l; avaiga'l yaasearmattum sen'ru vanaantharaththil padarnthirunthathu; avaiga'lin kodiga'l nee'ndu kadalukkappaalea ettiyirunthathu.

aagaiyaal yaasearukkaaga azhuthathupoala, sibmaaoorth thiraadchachsedikkaagavum migavum azhuvean; esboanea, eleyaaleayea, unakku en ka'n'neeraip paaychchuvean; un vasanthakaalaththup pazhangga'lukkaagavum, un thiraadchappazha a'ruppukkaagavum aaravaarikki'ra santhoasha saththam vizhunthupoayit'ru.

payirve'liyilirunthu santhoashamum ka'lippum at'ruppoayina; thiraadchaththoattangga'lil paadalumillai aarpparippumillai; aalaiyil irasaththai mithikki'ravanumillai; santhoasha aaravaaraththai oayappa'n'ninean.
aagaiyaal moavaabinimiththam en kudalga'lum, kiraareasinimiththam en u'l'lamum surama'ndalaththaip poalath thonikki'rathu.
moavaab meadaiga'linmeal saliththuppoanaan en'ru kaa'nappadumpoathu, piraarththanaiseyyath than parisuththa sthaanaththilea piraveasippaan; aanaalum anugoolappadamaattaan.
moavaabaikku'riththu akkaalaththilea karththar sonna vaarththai ithuvea.

oru koolikkaaranudaiya varushangga'lukkoththa moon'ru varushangga'lukku'l'lea moavaabin magimaiyum athin mahaa janakkoottamum seerazhinthupoam; athil meethiyaayiruppathu migavum si'rithum a'rpamumaayirukkum en'ru karththar ippozhuthu sollugi'raar.
thamaskuvin baaram. ithoa, thamaskuvaanathu nagaramaayiraamal tha'l'lappattu, paazhaana ma'nmeadaagum.
aaroavearin patta'nangga'l paazhaay vidappattu, manthaiga'lin ve'liyaayirukkum; mirattuvaarillaamal avaiga'l anggea paduththukko'l'lum.

ara'n eppiraayeemaiyum, raajaanggam thamaskuvaiyum vittozhiyum; israveal puththirarudaiya magimaikku nearittathupoala seeriyaavil meethiyaayiruppavarga'lukkum nearidum en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
akkaalaththilea yaakkoabin magimai ku'rainthupoam, avanudaiya kozhuththa theagam melinthupoam.
oruvan oanggina payirai arinthu, than kaiyinaal kathirga'lai a'ruththu, reppaayeem pa'l'laththaakkilea kathirga'laich searkki'rathupoalirukkum.

aanaalum oliva maraththai ulukkumpoathu nunikkombilea ira'ndu moon'ru kaayga'lum, kaaykki'ra athin ki'laiga'lilea naalainthu kaayga'lum meethiyaayiruppathupoala, athilea pinpa'rippukkuk kogncham meethiyaayirukkumen'ru isravealin theavanaagiya karththar sollugi'raar.
akkaalaththilea manushan than kaiga'lin kiriyaiyaagiya peedangga'lai noakkaamalum, than viralga'l u'ndupa'n'nina thoappuvikkiragangga'laiyum, silaiga'laiyum noakkaamalum,
thannai u'ndaakkinavaraiyea noakkuvaan, avan ka'nga'l isravealin parisuththaraiyea noakkikko'ndirukkum.
akkaalaththilea avarga'ludaiya ara'naana patta'nangga'l israveal puththirarukku meethiyaay vaikkappatta thazhaiyaippoalavum, nunikkombaippoalavumaagi, paazhaayk kidakkum.
un belamaagiya kanmalaiyai nee ninaiyaamal, un iradchippaagiya theavanai ma'ranthaay; aathalaal nee nearththiyaana naat'ruga'lai nattaalum, anniya theasaththuk kan'ruga'lai vaiththaalum,
paga'rkaalaththilea un naat'rai va'laravum, vidiya'rkaalaththilea un vithaiyai mu'laikkavum pa'n'ninaalum, palanaich searkkum naa'lilea thukkamum kadumveathanaiyumea ungga'l a'ruppaayirukkum.
aiyoa! kadalga'l kontha'likki'rathupoala kontha'likki'ra aneaga janangga'lin thira'lum, balaththa tha'n'neerga'l iraigi'rathupoala iraigi'ra janakkoottangga'lin ama'liyum u'ndaayirukki'rathu.

janakkoottangga'l thira'laana tha'n'neerga'l iraigi'rathupoala irainthaalum, avarga'lai avar athattuvaar; avarga'l thooramaay oadippoavaarga'l; malaiga'lilea kaat'rinaal pa'rakkadikki'ra patharaippoalavum, suzhalkaat'rilea agappatta thurumbaippoalavum thuraththappaduvaarga'l.

ithoa, saayanggaalaththilea kalakkamu'ndaagum, vidiya'rkaalaththukkumun avarga'l ozhinthupoavaarga'l; ithuvea nammaik ko'l'laiyaadugi'ravarga'lin panggum, nammaich soo'raiyaadugi'ravarga'lin veethamumaayirukkum.
eththiyoappiyaavin nathiga'lukku akkaraiyilea nizhalidum settaiga'ludaiyathum,

kadalvazhiyaayth tha'n'neerga'linmeal naa'nal padavuga'lilea sthaanaabathiga'lai anuppugi'rathumaana theasaththukku aiyoa! veagamaana thootharga'lea, nedunthooramaayp paraviyirukki'rathum, siraikkappattathum, thuvakkamuthal ithuvaraikkum kediyaayirunthathum, a'lavidappattathum, mithikkappattathum, nathiga'l paazhaakkugi'rathumaana jaathiya'ndaikkup poangga'l.
poochchakkaraththil vaasamaayirukki'ravarga'lum, theasaththuk kudiga'lumaagiya neengga'lellaarum, malaiga'linmeal kodiyeat'rappadumpoathu paarungga'l, ekkaa'lam oothappadumpoathu kea'lungga'l.

naan amarnthirunthu payirinmeal kaayum kaanthiyu'l'la veyilaippoalavum, a'ruppukkaalaththu ush'naththil u'ndaagum panimeagaththaippoalavum, en vaasasthalaththilirunthu ka'n'noakkuvean en'ru karththar ennudanea sonnaar.
thiraadchachsediga'l a'ruppukku munnea pooppooththu mut'rik kaaykki'ra kaayga'l pignchaayirukkumpoathea, avar arivaa'lga'linaalea kappukkavarga'lai a'ruththuk kodiga'laiyarinthu agat'rippoaduvaar.
avaiga'l eagamaay malaiga'lin padchiga'lukkum, boomiyin mirugangga'lukkum vidappadum; padchiga'l athinmeal koadaikaalaththilum, kaattumirugangga'lellaam athinmeal maarikaalaththilum thanggum.

akkaalaththilea nedunthooramaayp paraviyirukki'rathum, siraikkappattathum, thuvakkamuthal ithuvaraikkum kediyaayirunthathum, a'lavidappattathum, mithikkappattathum, nathiga'l paazhaakkugi'rathumaana jaathiyaanathu, seanaiga'lin karththarin naamam thanggum sthalamaagiya seeyoan malaiyil, seanaiga'lin karththarukkuk kaa'nikkaiyaagak ko'nduvarappadum.

egipthin baaram. ithoa, karththar veagamaana meagaththinmeal ea'ri egipthukku varuvaar; appozhuthu egipthin vikkiragangga'l avarukku munbaagak kulunggum, egipthin iruthayam thanakku'l'lea karainthupoagum.

sagoatharanoadea sagoatharanum, sineagithanoadea sineagithanum, patta'naththoadea patta'namum, raajyaththoadea raajyamum yuththampa'n'numpadiyaay, egipthiyarai egipthiyaroadea poar kalakkappa'n'nuvean.

athinaal egipthiyarudaiya aavi avarga'lukku'l soarnthupoagum; avarga'l aaloasanaiyai muzhugippoagap pa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu vikkiragangga'laiyum, manthiravaathiga'laiyum, sannathakkaararga'laiyum, ku'risollugi'ravarga'laiyum theaduvaarga'l.
naan egipthiyaraik kadinamaana athibathiyin kaiyil oppippean; kadooramaana raajaa avarga'lai aa'luvaan en'ru seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
appozhuthu kadalin tha'n'neerga'l ku'rainthu, nathiyum vat'ri va'ra'ndupoam.
aa'ruga'laith thiruppividuvaarga'l; ara'nippaana agazhiga'l ve'rumaiyaagi va'ra'ndupoam; ko'rukkaiyum naa'nalum vaadum.
nathiyoaraththilum nathimugaththilum irukki'ra madalu'l'la sediga'lum, nathiyarugea vithaikkappatta yaavum ularnthupoam; athu pa'rakkadikkappattu illaatheapoam.
meenpidikki'ravarga'l perumoochchuviduvaarga'l, nathiyilea thoo'ndilpoadugi'ra yaavarum thukkippaarga'l; tha'n'neerga'linmeal valaiga'lai veesugi'ravarga'l saliththuppoavaarga'l.
melliya sa'nalaip pakkuvappaduththugi'ravarga'lum, sallaakka'lai neygi'ravarga'lum naa'nuvaarga'l.
meen va'larkki'ra ku'langga'laik koolikku a'naikkattugi'ra anaivarudaiya a'naikkattuga'lum udainthupoam.

soavaanpatta'naththin pirabukka'laanavarga'l moodarga'l; paarvoanudaiya gnaanamu'l'la aaloasanaikkaararin aaloasanai mathiyeenamaayit'ru: naan gnaaniga'lin puththiran, naan poorva raajaakka'lin kumaaran en'ru paarvoanudanea eppadich sollugi'reerga'l?
avarga'l enggea? un gnaaniga'l enggea? seanaiga'lin karththar egipthaikku'riththup pa'n'nina yoasanaiyai avarga'l unakkuth therivikkattum; allathu thaangga'lea a'rinthuko'l'lattum.
soavaan pirabukka'l moodaraanaarga'l; noappin pirabukka'l moasampoanaarga'l; egipthaiyum athin koaththiraththalaivaraiyum vazhithappappa'n'nugi'raarga'l.

karththar athin naduvil thaa'rumaa'ruga'lin aaviyai varappa'n'ninaar; aanathuko'ndu ve'riyan vaanthipa'n'ni, tha'l'laadith thirigi'rathupoala, avarga'l egipthai athin ellaach seygaiyilum tha'l'laadith thiriyappa'n'nugi'raarga'l.
egipthil thalaiyaagilum vaalaagilum ki'laiyaagilum naa'nalaagilum seyyum vealai on'rumiraathu.
akkaalaththilea egipthiyar pe'nduga'laippoalirunthu, seanaiga'lin karththar thangga'lmeal asaikkum kaiyasaivinaalea agnchi nadungguvaarga'l.

seanaiga'lin karththar avarga'lukku viroathamaaga nir'nayiththukko'nda aaloasanaiyinimiththam yoothaavin theasam egipthiyarukkup bayanggaramaayirukkum; thanakku'l athai ninaikki'ravanevanum thidukkiduvaan.
akkaalaththilea egipthutheasaththilirukkum ainthu patta'nangga'l kaanaan baashaiyaip peasi, seanaiga'lin karththarai munnittu aa'naiyidum; avaiga'lil on'ru nirmoolamaana patta'nam ennappadum.
akkaalaththilea egipthutheasaththin naduvilea karththarukku oru balipeedamum, athin ellaiyarugea karththarukku oru sthambamum u'ndaayirukkum.

athu egipthu theasaththilea seanaiga'lin karththarukku adaiyaa'lamum saadchiyumaayirukkum; odukkugi'ravarga'linimiththam avarga'l karththarai noakkik kooppiduvaarga'l; appozhuthu avarga'lukku oru iradchaganaiyum, oru belavaanaiyum anuppi avarga'lai viduvippaar.

appozhuthu karththar egipthiyarukku a'riyappaduvaar; egipthiyar karththarai akkaalaththilea a'rinthu, avarukkup baliga'loadum kaa'nikkaiga'loadum aaraathanaiseythu, karththarukkup poruththanaiga'laippa'n'ni avaiga'laich seluththuvaarga'l.
karththar egipthiyarai vaathaiyinaal adippaar; adiththuk ku'namaakkuvaar; avarga'l karththaridaththil mananthirumbuvaarga'l; appozhuthu avarga'l vi'n'nappaththaik keattu, avarga'laik ku'namaakkuvaar.

akkaalaththilea egipthilirunthu aseeriyaavukkup poagi'ra perumpaathai u'ndaayirukkum; aseeriyar egipthukkum, egipthiyar aseeriyaavukkum vanthu, egipthiyar aseeriyaroadungkooda aaraathanai seyvaarga'l.
akkaalaththilea israveal egipthoadum aseeriyaavoadum moon'raavathaagap boomiyin naduvil aaseervaathamaayirukkum.

avarga'laikku'riththuch seanaiga'lin karththar: egipthiyaraagiya en janamum, aseeriyaraagiya en karaththin kiriyaiyum, isravealaraagiya en suthantharamum aaseervathikkappattathu en'ru solli, avarga'lai aaseervathippaar.
tharththaan, aseeriyaa raajaavaagiya sargoanaalea anuppappattu, asthoaththukku vanthu, asthoaththinmeal yuththampa'n'ni, athaip pidiththa varushaththilea,

karththar aamoathsin kumaaranaagiya easaayaavai noakki: nee poay un araiyilirukki'ra irattai avizhththu, un kaalga'lilirukki'ra paatharadchaiga'laik kazhat'ru en'raar; avan appadiyea seythu, vasthiramillaamalum ve'rungkaalumaay nadanthaan.

appozhuthu karththar: egipthinmealum eththiyoappiyaavinmealum varum moon'ruvarushaththuk kaariyangga'lukku adaiyaa'lamum ku'rippumaaga en oozhiyakkaaranaagiya easaayaa vasthiramillaamalum ve'rungkaalumaay nadakki'rathupoala,

aseeriyaa raajaa, thaan si'raipidikkappoagi'ra egipthiyarum, thaan kudivilakkappoagi'ra eththiyoappiyarumaagiya i'laignaraiyum kizhavaraiyum, vasthiramillaamalum ve'rungkaalumaay egipthiyarukku vedkamu'ndaagumpadi, iruppidam moodappadaathavarga'laayk ko'ndupoavaan.
appozhuthu inthak kada'rkaraik kudiga'l thaangga'l nambiyiruntha eththiyoappiyaavaikku'riththum, thaangga'l perumaipaaraattina egipthaikku'riththum kalanggi vedki:

ithoa, aseeriya raajaavin mugaththukkuth thappumpadikku naangga'l nambi, sagaayaththukken'ru oadivanthu a'ndinavan ippadiyaanaanea; naangga'l eppadi viduvikkappaduvoam en'ru akkaalaththilea solluvaarga'l en'raar.
kadal vanaantharaththin baaram. suzhalkaat'ru thenthisaiyilirunthu ezhumbik kadanthuvarugi'rathupoala, bayanggaramaana theasamaagiya vanaantharaththilirunthu athu varugi'rathu.

kodiya tharisanam enakkuth therivikkappattathu; thuroagi thuroagampa'n'ni, paazhaakki'ravan paazhaakkikko'ndea irukki'raan; ealaamea ezhumbu; meathiyaavea mut'rikkaipoadu; athinaalea u'ndaana thavippaiyellaam ozhiyappa'n'ninean.

aagaiyaal, en iduppu mahaa veathanaiyaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; pi'l'laipe'rugi'rava'lin veathanaiga'lukku oththa veathanaiga'l ennaip pidiththathu; keattathinaal u'laivuko'ndu, ka'ndathinaal kalangginean.
en iruthayam thigaiththathu; thigil ennaith thidukkidappa'n'nit'ru; enakku inbanthantha iravu bayanggaramaayit'ru.
panthiyai aayaththappaduththungga'l, jaamakkaararai vaiyungga'l, pusiyungga'l, kudiyungga'l; pirabukka'lea, ezhunthu parisaiga'lukku e'n'ney poosungga'l.
aa'ndavar ennai noakki: nee poay, kaa'nbathaith therivikkumpadi jaamakkaaranai vai en'raar.

avan oru irathaththaiyum, joadu joadaana kuthiraiveeraraiyum, joadu joadaagak kazhuthaiga'linmealum ottagangga'linmealum ea'rivarugi'ravarga'laiyum ka'ndu, miguntha kavanamaayk kavaniththukko'ndea irunthu:
aa'ndavarea, naan pagalmuzhuthum en kaavalilea nin'ru, iraamuzhuthum naan en kaavalidaththilea thariththirukki'rean en'ru singgaththaippoal saththamittuk kooppidugi'raan.

ithoa, oru joadu kuthirai poo'nda irathaththinmeal ea'riyirukki'ra oru manushan varugi'raan; baabiloan vizhunthathu, vizhunthathu; athin vikkiraga theavarga'laiyellaam tharaiyoadea moathi udaiththaar en'ru pirathiyuththaram sollugi'raan.
en poaradippin thaaniyamea, en ka'laththin koathumaiyea, isravealin theavanaagiya seanaiga'lin karththaraal naan kea'lvippattathai ungga'lukku a'riviththean.
thoomaavin baaram. seayeerilirunthu ennai noakki: jaamakkaaranea, iravu evva'lavu sen'rathu? en'ru kooppittuk keadka;
atha'rku jaamakkaaran: vidiya'rkaalam varugi'rathu, iraakkaalamum varugi'rathu; neengga'l keadka manathaanaal thirumbivanthu kea'lungga'l en'ru sollugi'raan.
arabiyaavin baaram. thithaaniyaraagiya paya'nakkoottangga'lea, neengga'l arabiyaavin kaaduga'lil iraaththangguveerga'l.
theamaatheasaththin kudiga'lea, neengga'l thaagamaayirukki'ravarga'lukkuth tha'n'neer ko'ndupoay, thappi oadugi'ravarga'lukku appangkodukka ethirko'ndupoangga'l.
avarga'l, pattayangga'lukkum, uruvina kadkaththukkum, naa'neat'rina villukkum, yuththaththin kodumaikkum thappi oadugi'raarga'l.
aa'ndavar ennai noakki: oru koolikkaaranudaiya varushangga'lukkoththa orea varushaththilea keathaarudaiya magimaiyellaam at'ruppoam.
keathaar puththiraraagiya baraakkirama vilveerarin thogaiyil meethiyaanavarga'l kognchappearaayiruppaarga'l en'raar; isravealin theavanaagiya karththar ithai uraiththaar.
tharisanap pa'l'laththaakkin baaram. unnil u'l'lavarga'l ellaarum veeduga'linmeal ea'ruvatha'rku unakku ippozhuthu vanthathu enna?
santhadiga'laal ni'rainthu aaravaarampa'n'ni, ka'likoornthiruntha nagaramea, unnidaththil kolaiyu'ndavarga'l pattayaththaal kolaiyu'ndathillai, yuththaththil seththathum illai.
un athibathiga'l ellaarum eagamaay oadi alainthum, vilveeraraal kattappadugi'raarga'l; unnil agappatta yaavarum thooraththukku oadiyum eagamaayk kattappadugi'raarga'l.
aagaiyaal, ennai noakkip paaraatheayungga'l; en janamaagiya kumaaraththi paazhaayppoanathinimiththam manangkasanthu azhuvean; enakku aa'ruthal solla varaatheayungga'l engi'rean.

seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavaraalea ithu tharisanap pa'l'laththaakkilea ama'liyum, mithiyu'nguthalum, kalakkamumu'l'la naa'laayirukki'rathu; ithu alanggaththaith thagarththu, parvathaththukku nearea aarpparikkum naa'laayirukki'rathu.
ealaamiyan amba'raaththoo'niyai eduththu, irathangga'loadum kaalaadka'loadum kuthiraiveeraroadum varugi'raan; keer keadagaththai ve'lippaduththum.
mahaa vadivaana un pa'l'laththaakkuga'l irathangga'laal nirappappadum; kuthiraiveerar vaasalga'lmattum vanthu a'nivaguththu ni'rpaarga'l.
avan yoothaavin ma'raivai neekkippoaduvaan; annaa'lilea vanamaa'ligaiyaagiya aayuthasaalaiyai noakkuvaay.
neengga'l thaaveethu nagaraththin idithalga'l aneagamaayiruppathaik ka'ndu, keezhkku'laththuth tha'n'neerga'laik kattivaiththu,
erusaleamin veeduga'lai e'n'ni, alanggaththai ara'nippaakkumpadi veeduga'lai idiththu,

ira'ndu mathilga'lukku naduvea pazhaiya ku'laththuth tha'n'neerga'lukku oru agazhai u'ndupa'n'nuveerga'l; aanaalum athaich seythavarai neengga'l noakkaamalum, athai ea'rpaduththith thooraththilirunthu varappa'n'ninavaraik kavaniyaamalum poagi'reerga'l.
seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar akkaalaththilea azhavum, pulambavum, mottaiyidavum, irattuduththavum katta'laiyittaar.
neengga'loa, santhoashiththuk ka'liththu, aadumaaduga'lai adiththu, i'raichchiyaich saappittu, thiraadcharasaththaik kudiththu: pusippoam kudippoam, naa'laikkuch saavoam en'ru solveerga'l.

meyyaagavea neengga'l saagumattum intha akkiramam ungga'lukku nivirththiyaavathillai en'ru seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raarenbathu en sevi keadkumpadi seanaiga'lin karththaraal therivikkappattathu.
seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraiththathaavathu: nee aramanai visaarippukkaaranum pokkishakkaaranumaagiya sebnaa enbavanidaththil poaych sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,

uyarntha sthalaththilea than kalla'raiyai vetti, kanmalaiyilea thanakku vaasasthalaththaith thoa'ndugi'ravanaippoala, nee unakku inggea kalla'raiyai vettumpadikku unakku inggea enna irukki'rathu? unakku inggea yaar irukki'raarga'l?
ithoa, belavaan oruvanaith thuraththugi'rava'n'namaagak karththar unnaith thuraththivittu, nichchayamaay unnai moodippoaduvaar.

avar unnai uru'ndaiyaippoala agalamum visaalamumaana theasaththilea suzhat'ri e'rinthuviduvaar; anggea nee saavaay; anggea un magimaiyin irathangga'l un aa'ndavanudaiya veettukku igazhchchiyaaga irukkum.
unnai un nilaiyaivittuth thuraththividuvean; un sthaanaththilirunthu nee pidunggippoadappaduvaay.
annaa'lilea ilkkiyaavin kumaaranaagiya eliyaakkeem ennum en oozhiyakkaaranai naan azhaiththu:
un vasthiraththai avanukkuth thariththu, un kachchaiyaal avanai idaikkatti, un athigaaraththai avan kaiyilea koduppean; avan erusaleamin kudiga'lukkum, yoothaavin vamsaththukkum thagappanaayiruppaan.
thaaveethudaiya veettin thi'ravukoalai avan thoa'linmeal vaippean; oruvarum poottakkoodaathapadikku avan thi'rappaan, oruvarum thi'rakkakkoodaathapadikku avan poottuvaan.
avanai u'ruthiyaana idaththilea aa'niyaagak kadaavuvean; avan than thagappan veettukku magimaiyaana singgaasanamaaga iruppaan.
athinmeal avan thagappan vamsaththaaraagiya puththirar pauththirarudaiya magimai anaiththaiyum, si'rithum perithumaana sagala baanapaaththirangga'laiyum thookkivaippaarga'l.

u'ruthiyaana idaththil kadaavappattiruntha aa'ni annaa'lilea pidunggappattu, mu'rinthuvizhum; appozhuthu athinmeal thonggina baaram a'runthuvizhum en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar uraikki'raar; karththarea ithai uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.

theeruvin baaram. tharshees kappalga'lea, ala'rungga'l; athu veedu illaathapadikkum, athil varuvaar illaathapadikkum paazhaakkappattathu; inthach seythi kiththeem theasaththilirunthu avarga'lukkuth therivikkappadugi'rathu.
theevukkudiga'lea, mavunamaayirungga'l; seethoanin varththagar samuththiraththilea yaaththiraipa'n'ni unnai nirappinaarga'l.
seegoar nathiyin miguntha neerppaaychchalga'laal vi'laiyum payirvagaiga'lum, aat'rangkaraiyin a'ruppum athin varumaanamaayirunthathu; athu jaathiga'lin santhaiyaayirunthathu.

seethoanea, vedkappadu; naan inik karppaveathanaippadugi'rathum illai; pe'rugi'rathum illai; i'laignarai va'larkki'rathum illai; kannigaiga'lai aatharikki'rathum illai en'ru samuththirak koattaiyaana kadalthu'rai sollugi'rathu.
egipthin seythi keadkappattathinaal noay u'ndaanathupoala, theeruvin seythi keadkappaduvathinaalum noay u'ndaagum.
karaithu'raik kudiga'lea, neengga'l tharsheesmattum pu'rappattuppoay ala'rungga'l.
poorvanaadka'lmuthal nilaipet'ruk ka'likoornthiruntha ungga'l patta'nam ithuthaanaa? paratheasampoaych sagncharikki'ratha'rku ava'l kaalga'lea ava'laith thooramaayk ko'ndupoam.
kireedam tharippikkum theeruvukku viroathamaaga ithai yoasiththuth theermaaniththavar yaar? athin varththagar pirabukka'lum, athin viyaabaariga'l boomiyin kanavaanga'lumaamea.
sarva singgaaraththin meanmaiyaik kulaikkavum, boomiyin kanavaanga'l yaavaraiyum kanaeenappaduththavum, seanaiga'lin karththarea ithai yoasiththuth theermaaniththaar.
tharsheesin kumaaraththiyea, nathiyaippoala nee un theasaththil paaynthupoa, unakku a'naiyillai.
karththar thamathu kaiyaich samuththiraththinmeal neetti, raajyangga'laik kulunggappa'n'ninaar; kaanaanin ara'nga'lai azhikka avar atha'rku viroathamaayk katta'laikoduththu:
odunggu'nda kanniyaagiya seethoan kumaaraththiyea, inik ka'likoornthuko'ndiraay; ezhunthu kiththeemukkup pu'rappattuppoa, anggum unakku i'laippaa'ruthal illaiyen'raar.

kaltheayarudaiya theasaththaip paar; antha janam munnirunthathillai; aseeriyan vanaantharaththaarukkaaga athai asthibaarappaduththinaan; avarga'l athin koapurangga'lai u'ndaakki, athin aramanaiga'laik kattinaarga'l; avar athai azhivukken'ru niyamiththaar.
tharshees kappalga'lea, ala'rungga'l; ungga'l ara'n paazhaakkappattathu.

akkaalaththilea theeru, oru raajaavudaiya naadka'linpadi, ezhubathu varusham ma'rakkappattirukkum; ezhubathu varushangga'lin mudivilea theeruvukkuch sambavippathu veasiyin paadalukkuch samaanamaayirukkum.
ma'rakkappatta veasiyea, nee vee'naiyai eduththu nagaraththaich sut'riththiri; nee ninaikkappadumpadi athai inithaaga vaasiththup pala paattuga'laip paadu.
ezhubathu varushangga'lin mudivilea karththar vanthu theeruvaich santhippaar; appozhuthu athu than pa'naiyaththukku thirumbivanthu, boomiyilu'l'la sagala raajyangga'loadum veasiththanam pa'n'num.

athin viyaabaaramum, athin pa'naiyamum karththarukkup parisuththamaakkappadum; athu pokkishamaaych searkkappaduvathum illai; pootti vaikkappaduvathum illai; karththarudaiya samugaththil vaasamaayirukki'ravarga'l thirupthiyaagach saappidavum nalla vasthirangga'laith tharikkavum athin viyaabaaram avarga'laich searum.
ithoa, karththar theasaththai ve'rumaiyum paazhumaakki, athaik kavizhththu, athin kudiga'laich sitha'radippaar.
