keabaar nathiya'ndaiyilea thelaabeebilea thaabarikki'ra si'raippattavarga'lidaththukku naan vanthu, avarga'l thaabarikki'ra sthalaththilea thaabariththu, eazhunaa'l avarga'l naduvilea piramiththavanaayth thangginean.
eazhunaa'l mudinthapinbu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, unnai israveal vamsaththaarukkuk kaavalaa'lanaaga vaiththean; nee en vaayinaalea vaarththaiyaikkeattu, en naamaththinaalea avarga'lai echcharippaayaaga.

saagavea saavaay en'ru naan thunmaarkkanukkuch sollugaiyil, nee thunmaarkkanaith than thunmaarkkamaana vazhiyil iraathapadikku echcharikkumpadiyaagavum, avanai uyiroadea kaakkumpadiyaagavum, athai avanukkuch sollaamalum, nee avanai echcharikkaamalum irunthaal, anthath thunmaarkkan than thunmaarkkaththilea saavaan; avan iraththappazhiyaiyoa un kaiyilea keadpean.

nee thunmaarkkanai echchariththum, avan than thunmaarkkaththaiyum than aagaatha vazhiyaiyum vittuth thirumbaama'r poavaanaagil, avan than thunmaarkkaththilea saavaan; neeyoaven'raal un aaththumaavaith thappuvippaay.

appadiyea, neethimaan than neethiyai vittuth thirumbi, neethikeadu seyyumpoathum, naan avanmun ida'ralai vaikkumpoathum, avan saavaan; nee avanai echcharikkaathapadiyinaalea avan than paavaththilea saavaan; avan seytha neethiga'l ninaikkappaduvathillai; avanudaiya iraththappazhiyaiyoa un kaiyilea keadpean.

neethimaan paavagn seyyaathapadikku nee neethimaanai echchariththapinbu avan paavagnseyyaavittaal, avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan; avan echcharikkappattaan; neeyum un aaththumaavaith thappuviththaay en'raar.
avvidaththilea karththarudaiya karam enmeal amarnthathu; avar: nee ezhunthirunthu pa'l'laththaakkukkup pu'rappattuppoa, anggea unnudanea peasuvean en'raar.

appadiyea naan ezhunthirunthu, pa'l'laththaakkukkup pu'rappattup poanean; ithoa, keabaar nathiya'ndaiyilea naan ka'nda magimaikkuch sariyaaga anggea karththarudaiya magimai vi'langginathu; appozhuthu naan mugangkuppu'ra vizhunthean.
udanea aavi enakku'l'lea pugunthu, ennaik kaaloon'ri ni'rkumpadi seythathu, appozhuthu avar ennudanea peasi: nee poay, un veettukku'l'lea unnai adaiththukko'ndiru.
ithoa, manupuththiranea, unmeal kayi'ruga'laippoattu, avaiga'laal unnaik kattappoagi'raarga'l; aagaiyaal nee avarga'lukku'l'lea poagavea'ndaam.
naan un naavai un mealvaayoadea ottikko'l'lappa'n'nuvean; nee avarga'laik kadinthuko'l'lugi'ra manushanaayiraamal, oomaiyanaayiruppaay; avarga'l kalagaveettaar.

naan unnoadea peasumpoathu, un vaayaith thi'rappean; appozhuthu karththaraagiya aa'ndavar inninnathai uraiththaar en'ru avarga'loadea solvaay; keadki'ravan keadkattum, kea'laathavan kea'laathirukkattum; avarga'l kalagaveettaar.
manupuththiranea, nee oru senggalai eduththu, athai unmun vaiththu, athinmeal erusaleam nagaraththai varainthu,

atha'rku viroathamaaga mut'rikkaipoattu, atha'rku viroathamaagak koththa'langga'laik katti, atha'rku viroathamaaga ma'nmeadupoattu, atha'rku viroathamaaga iraa'nuvangga'lai ni'ruththi, sut'rilum atha'rku viroathamaaga mathilidikkum yanthirangga'lai vai.

mealum nee oru iruppuchsattiyai vaanggi, athai unakkum nagaraththukkum naduvaaga iruppuchsuvaraakki, athu mut'rikkaiyaayk kidakkumpadikku un mugaththai atha'rku nearaayth thiruppi, athai mut'rikkaipoattukko'ndiru; ithu israveal vamsaththukku adaiyaa'lam.

nee un idathupakkamaay orukka'liththup paduththu, athinmeal israveal vamsaththaarin akkiramaththaich sumaththikko'l; nee anthappakkamaay orukka'liththirukkum naadka'lin ilakkaththinpadiyea avarga'ludaiya akkiramaththaich sumappaay.
avarga'ludaiya akkiramaththin varushangga'lai unakku naadka'nakkaay e'n'nak katta'laiyittean; munnoot'ruth tho'n'noo'ru naadka'lvaraikkum nee israveal vamsaththaarin akkiramaththaich sumakkavea'ndum.

nee ivaiga'lai ni'raiveat'rinapinbu, ma'rupadiyum un valathupakkamaay orukka'liththu, yoothaa vamsaththaarin akkiramaththai naa'rpathunaa'lvaraikkum sumakkavea'ndum; ovvoru varushaththukkup bathilaaga ovvoru naa'lai unakkuk katta'laiyittean.
nee erusaleamin mut'rikkaikku nearaagath thiruppiya mugamum, thi'rantha puyamumaaga irunthu, atha'rku viroathamaagath theerkkatharisanam sollu.
ithoa, nee athai mut'rikkaippoadum naadka'lai ni'raiveat'rumattum oru pakkaththilirunthu ma'rupakkaththil pura'lakkoodaathapadikku unnaik kayi'ruga'laal kattuvean.

nee koathumaiyaiyum vaa'rkoathumaiyaiyum perumpayat'raiyum si'rupayat'raiyum thinaiyaiyum kambaiyum vaanggi, avaiga'lai oru paaththiraththilea poattu, avaiga'laal unakku appagnsuduvaay; nee orukka'liththup padukkum naadka'ludaiya ilakkaththinpadiyea munnoot'ruth tho'n'noo'runaa'l athil eduththuch saappiduvaayaaga.
nee saappidum poajanam, naa'l on'rukku irubathu seakkal ni'raiyaayirukkum; appadi naa'lukkunaa'l saappiduvaayaaga.
tha'n'neeraiyum a'lavaay hin ennum padiyil aa'riloru panggaik kudippaay; appadi naa'lukkunaa'l kudippaayaaga.
athai vaa'rkoathumai adaiyaippoal saappiduvaayaaga; athu manushanilirunthu kazhintha kashdaththin va'rattiga'laal avarga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaagach sudappaduvathaaga.
atha'rku oththapadiyea israveal puththirar, naan avarga'laith thuraththugi'ra pu'rajaathiga'lukku'l'lea thangga'l appaththaith theettu'l'lathaagach saappiduvaarga'l en'ru karththar sonnaar.

appozhuthu naan: aa, karththaraagiya aa'ndavarea, ithoa, en aaththumaa theettuppadavillai; thaanaaych seththathaiyaavathu, pee'ru'ndathaiyaavathu naan en si'ruvayathumuthal ithuvaraikkum saappittathillai; aruvaruppaana i'raichchi en vaaykkudpattathumillai en'rean.
appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: paar, manusha kashdaththin va'rattikkup bathilaaga unakku maattuchchaa'ni va'rattiyaik katta'laiyidugi'rean; athinaal un appaththaich suduvaayaaga en'raar.
pinnum avar: manupuththiranea, ithoa, appamum tha'n'neerum avarga'lukkuk ku'raiyavum, avanavan thidukkidavum, avarga'l thangga'l akkiramaththilea vaadippoagavum,
naan erusaleamilea appam ennum aatharavukoalai mu'rikki'rean; avarga'l appaththai ni'raiyinpadiyea visaaraththoadea saappittu, tha'n'neerai a'lavinpadiyea thidukkiduthaloadea kudippaarga'l.

pinnum avar: manupuththiranea, savaragan kaththiyaagiya karukkaana kaththiyai vaanggi, athinaal un thalaiyaiyum un thaadiyaiyum siraiththukko'ndu, pinbu ni'rukkum tharaasai eduththu, antha mayiraip panggidakkadavaay.

moon'ril oru panggai eduththu mut'rikkaipoadum naadka'l mudigi'rapoathu nagaraththin naduvilea akkiniyaal sutteriththu, moon'ril oru panggai eduththu, athaich sut'rilum kaththiyaalea vetti, moon'ril oru panggai eduththuk kaat'rilea thoot'rakkadavaay; avaiga'lin pinnaaga naan pattayaththai uruvuvean.
athil kognchammaaththiram eduththu, athai un vasthiraththoarangga'lil mudinthuvaippaayaaga.
pinnum athil kogncham eduththu, athaith theeyin naduvil e'rinthu, athai akkiniyaal sutterippaayaaga; athilirunthu israveal vamsaththaar anaivarukkum viroathamaaga akkini pu'rappadum.
karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal, ithuvea erusaleam, pu'rajaathiga'lin naduvilea naan athai vaiththean, athaich sut'rilum theasangga'l irukki'rathu.

athu pu'rajaathiga'laippaarkkilum en niyaayangga'laiyum, thannaich sut'rilum irukki'ra theasangga'laippaarkkilum en katta'laiga'laiyum akkiramamaaga maat'rippoattathu; avarga'l en niyaayangga'lai ve'ruththu, en katta'laiga'lil nadavaama'r poanaarga'l.

aagaiyaal karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal, ungga'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra pu'rajaathiga'laippaarkkilum athigarikki'ravarga'laagiya neengga'l en katta'laiga'lilea nadavaamalum, en niyaayangga'linpadi seyyaamalum, ungga'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra pu'rajaathiga'ludaiya neethiniyaayangga'linpadiyaavathu nadavaamalum poanapadiyinaalea,
ithoa, naan, naanea unakku viroathamaaga vanthu, pu'rajaathiga'ludaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaaga un naduvilea neethi seluththi,
naan munbu seyyaathathum inichseyyaathiruppathumaanavithamaay unakku un ellaa aruvaruppuga'linimiththamum seyvean.

aathalaal un naduvilea pithaakka'l pi'l'laiga'laith thinbaarga'l; pi'l'laiga'l pithaakka'laith thinbaarga'l; naan unnil neethiseluththi unnil meethiyaayiruppavarga'laiyellaam sagala thisaiga'lilum sitha'rippoagappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.

aathalaal, cheeyen'rigazhappadaththakkathum aruvarukkappadaththakkathumaana un kiriyaiga'laal nee en parisuththa sthalaththaith theettuppaduththinapadiyaal en ka'n unnaith thappavidaathu, naan unnaik ku'rugippoagappa'n'nuvean, naan iranggamaattean, ithai en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

unnilea moon'ril oru panggu ko'l'lainoayaal saavaarga'l, pagnchaththaalum un naduvilea madinthupoavaarga'l; moon'ril oru panggu unnaich sut'rilum irukki'ra pattayaththaal vettu'ndu vizhuvaarga'l; moon'ril oru panggai naan sagala thisaiga'lilum sitha'rippoagappa'n'ni, avarga'l pinnea pattayaththai uruvuvean.

ippadi en koabam ni'raivea'rum; ippadi naan en ukkiraththai avarga'lmeal thanggappa'n'nugi'rathinaal ennai aat'rikko'lvean; naan en ukkiraththai avarga'lil ni'raiveat'rumpoathu, karththaraagiya naan en vairaakkiyaththilea ithaip peasinean en'ru a'rivaarga'l.
kadanthupoagi'ra yaavarudaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaagavum un sut'ruppu'raththaaraagiya jaathiga'lukku'l'lea naan unnaip paazhum ninthaiyumaakkuvean.

naan koabaththaalum ukkiraththaalum kodiya ka'ndanaiga'laalum, unnil neethiseluththumpoathu, un sut'ruppu'raththaaraagiya jaathiga'lukku athu ninthaiyum thurkkeerththiyum echcharippum piramippumaay irukkum; karththaraagiya naan ithaich sonnean.

ungga'lai azhippatha'rku naan anuppum azhivukkeathuvaana pagnchaththin kodiya ambuga'lai naan avarga'lukku'l'lea eyyumpoathu, naan pagnchaththai ungga'lmeal athigarikkappa'n'ni, ungga'l appam ennum aatharavukoalai mu'riththuppoaduvean.

pagnchaththaiyum, unnaip pi'l'laiyillaama'rpoagappa'n'num thushdamirugangga'laiyum ungga'lukku viroathamaaga anuppuvean; ko'l'lainoayum iraththagnsinthuthalum unnil sut'riththiriyum; pattayaththai naan unmeal varappa'n'nuvean; karththaraagiya naan ithaich sonnean en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee isravealin parvathangga'lukku nearaaga un mugaththaith thiruppi, avaiga'lukku viroathamaagath theerkkatharisanam uraiththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal,

isravealin parvathangga'lea, karththaraagiya aa'ndavarin vaarththaiyaik kea'lungga'l; karththaraagiya aa'ndavar parvathangga'laiyum kun'ruga'laiyum oadaiga'laiyum pa'l'laththaakkuga'laiyum noakki: ithoa, ungga'lmeal naan, naanea pattayaththai varappa'n'ni, ungga'l meadaiga'lai azhiththuppoaduvean.
ungga'l balipeedangga'l paazhaakkappattu, ungga'l silaiga'l thagarkkappadum; ungga'lil kolaiyu'ngi'ravarga'lai ungga'l naragalaana vikkiragangga'lukku munbaaga vizhappa'n'nuvean.
naan israveal puththirarudaiya pireathangga'lai avarga'ludaiya naragalaana vikkiragangga'lin munnea kidakkappa'n'ni, ungga'l balipeedangga'laich sut'rilum ungga'l elumbuga'laich sitha'rappa'n'nuvean.

ungga'l balipeedangga'l nirmoolamum paazhumaagumpadikkum, ungga'l naragalaana vikkiragangga'l thagarkkappattu, oaynthu, ungga'l silaiga'l vettu'ndu, ungga'l kiriyaiga'l kulainthupoagumpadikkum, ungga'ludaiya sagala vaasasthalangga'lilumu'l'la patta'nangga'l nirmoolamum ungga'l meadaiga'l paazhumaagum.
kolaiseyyappattavarga'l ungga'l naduvil vizhuvaarga'l; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.
neengga'l theasangga'lil sitha'radikkappadumpoathu, pu'rajaathiga'lukku'l'lea pattayaththukkuth thappuvaarai ungga'lukku meethiyaaga vaippean.

ennai vittuch soarampoagi'ra iruthayaththaikku'riththum, thangga'l naragalaana vikkiragangga'lin pinnea soarampoagi'ra thangga'l ka'nga'laikku'riththum manamadivaanean en'ru ungga'lil thappippoana avarga'l thaangga'l si'raippattirukkum pu'rajaathiga'lukku'l'lea ennai ninaiththu, thangga'ludaiya sagala aruvaruppuga'linaalum thaangga'l seytha pollaappuga'linimiththam thangga'laiyea ve'ruththu,
inthath theengguga'laiyellaam thangga'lukku nearidappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraagiya naan viruthaavaaych sonnathillaiyen'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarga'l en'raar.

karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: nee un kaiyil adiththu, un kaalaal thatti, israveal vamsaththaarudaiya sagala pollaatha aruvaruppuga'linimiththamum aiyoa! en'ru sol; avarga'l pattayaththaalum pagnchaththaalum ko'l'lainoayaalum vizhuvaarga'l.

thooraththilirukki'ravan ko'l'lainoayaal saavaan; sameebaththilirukki'ravan pattayaththaal vizhuvaan; meethiyaayirunthu, mut'rikkaipoadappattavan pagnchaththaal saavaan; ippadi avarga'lil en ukkiraththaith theerththukko'l'luvean.

avarga'l thangga'l naragalaana sagala vikkiragangga'lukkum mathuravaasanaiyaana thoobaththaik kaattina sthalangga'laagiya uyarntha sagala meaduga'lilum, parvathangga'ludaiya sagala sigarangga'lilum, pachchaiyaana sagala virudchangga'linkeezhum, thazhaiththirukki'ra sagala karvaali marangga'linkeezhum, avarga'ludaiya naragalaana vikkiragangga'lin naduvilum avarga'ludaiya balipeedangga'laich sut'rilum, avarga'lil kolaiyu'ndavarga'l kidakkumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarga'l.

naan en kaiyai avarga'lukku viroathamaaga neetti, avarga'ludaiya ellaa vaasasthalangga'lumu'l'la theasaththai azhiththu, athaith thiblaaththin vanaantharaththaippaarkkilum athigamaayp paazhaakkuvean, appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarga'l en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, israveal theasaththaikku'riththuk karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: mudivu varugi'rathu, theasaththin naalu munaiga'linmealum mudivu varugi'rathu.
ippoathea unmeal mudivu varugi'rathu; naan en koabaththai unmeal varuviththu, un vazhiga'lukkuththakkathaaga unnai niyaayantheerththu, un ellaa aruvaruppuga'lin palanaiyum unmeal varappa'n'nuvean.

en ka'n unnaith thappavidaathu; naan iranggaamal un vazhiga'lukkuththakkathai unmeal varappa'n'nuvean; un aruvaruppuga'lukkuththakkathu un naduvil vanthirukkum; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.
karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: theenggu varugi'rathu; ithoa, eagamaana theenggu varugi'rathu.
mudivu varugi'rathu, mudivu varugi'rathu, athu unmeal noakkamaayirukki'rathu; ithoa, varugi'rathu.
theasaththil kudiyirukki'ravanea, annaa'lin vidiya'rkaalam varugi'rathu, kaalam varugi'rathu, ama'liyin naa'l sameebiththirukki'rathu, malaiga'lil santhoashasaththam illai.

ippozhuthu viraivil en ukkiraththai unmeal oot'ri, en koabaththai unnil theerththukko'ndu, unnai un vazhiga'lukkuththakkathaaga niyaayantheerththu, un ellaa aruvaruppuga'lin palanaiyum unmeal varappa'n'nuvean.

en ka'n unnaith thappavidaathu; naan iranggaamal un vazhiga'lukkuththakkathai unmeal varappa'n'nuvean; un aruvaruppuga'lukkuththakkathu un naduvil vanthirukkum; appozhuthu adikki'ravaraagiya naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.
ithoa, antha naa'l, ithoa, varugi'rathu, annaa'lin vidiya'rkaalam uthikki'rathu, milaa'ru pookki'rathu, aganthai sezhikki'rathu.

akkiramaththukku milaa'raagak kodumai ezhumbugi'rathu; avarga'lilum avarga'ludaiya thira'laana kumbilum avarga'ludaiya ama'liyilum on'rum meethiyaayiruppathillai; avarga'l nimiththam pulambal u'ndaayiruppathumillai.
anthak kaalam varugi'rathu, antha naa'l kittugi'rathu; ko'l'lugi'ravan santhoashappadaamalum, vi'rki'ravan thukkappadaamalum iruppaanaaga; athin thira'laana kumbinmealum ukkiram i'ranggum.

avarga'l jeevanu'l'loarukku'l'lea innum uyiroadirunthaalum, vit'ravan vi'rkappattatha'rkuth thirumbivaruvathillai; athin thira'laana kumbinmealum u'ndaana tharisanam thirumbaathu; than akkiramaththilea vaazhugi'ra evanum thannaith thidappaduththamaattaan.
avarga'l ekkaa'lam oothi, ellaavat'raiyum aayaththampa'n'niyum, yuththaththukkup poagi'ravanillai; en ukkiram athin thira'laana kumbinmealum i'ranggugi'rathu.
ve'liyea pattayamum u'l'lea ko'l'lainoayum pagnchamum u'ndu; vayalve'liyil irukki'ravan pattayaththaal saavaan; nagaraththil irukki'ravanaiyoa pagnchamum ko'l'lainoayum padchikkum.

avarga'lil thappugi'ravarga'l thappuvaarga'l; aanaalum avarga'l anaivarum avanavan than than akkiramaththinimiththam thukkiththuk kooppidugi'ra pa'l'laththaakkuga'lin pu'raakka'laippoala malaiga'lil iruppaarga'l.
ellaak kaiga'lum saliththu, ellaa muzhangkaalga'lum tha'n'neeraippoal thaththa'likkum.
irattai uduththikko'lvaarga'l; thaththa'lippu avarga'lai moodum; ellaa mugangga'lum vedkappadum, ellaath thalaiga'lum mottaiyidappadum.

thangga'l ve'l'liyaith therukka'lil e'rinthuviduvaarga'l; avarga'ludaiya pon vea'ndaave'ruppaayirukkum; karththarudaiya sinaththin naa'lilea avarga'l ve'l'liyum avarga'l ponnum avarga'lai viduvikkamaattaathu; avarga'l athinaal thangga'l aaththumaakka'laith thirupthiyaakkuvathum illai, thangga'l vayi'ruga'lai nirappuvathum illai; avarga'l akkiramamea avarga'lukku ida'ralaayirunthathu.

avarudaiya singgaaraththin magimaiyai aganthaikken'ru vaiththu, athilea aruvarukkappadaththakkathum cheeyen'rigazhappadaththakkathumaana kaariyangga'lin vikkiragangga'lai u'ndupa'n'ninaarga'l; aagaiyaal naan avaiga'lai avarga'lukku vea'ndaave'ruppaakki,
athai anniyar kaiyilea ko'l'laiyaagavum, boomiyil thushdarga'lukkuch soo'raiyaagavum koduppean; avarga'l athaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuvaarga'l.

en mugaththai avarga'lai vittuth thiruppuvean; athinaal en antharangga sthalaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuvaarga'l; pa'rikaarar atha'rku'l piraveasiththu, athaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuvaarga'l.
oru sanggiliyaip pa'n'nivai; theasam niyaayaththeerppukku'l'laana iraththappazhiga'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; nagaram kodumaiyaal ni'rainthirukki'rathu.

aagaiyaal pu'rajaathiga'lin thushdarga'lai varappa'n'nuvean, avarga'l ivarga'ludaiya veeduga'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l; balavaanga'lin perumaiyai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean, avarga'l parisuththa sthalangga'l parisuththakkulaichchalaagum.
sanggaaram varugi'rathu; appozhuthu samaathaanaththaith theaduvaarga'l; aanaalum athu kidaiyaathu.

vikkinaththinmeal vikkinam varum; thurchseythiyinmeal thurchseythi pi'rakkum; appozhuthu theerkkatharisiyinidaththilea tharisanaththaith theaduvaarga'l; aanaalum aasaariyanidaththilea veathamum moopparidaththilea aaloasanaiyum iraamal ozhinthupoagum.

raajaa thukkiththukko'ndiruppaan; pirabuvaith thigil moodikko'ndirukkum; theasaththu janangga'lin kaiga'l tha'larnthupoagum; naan avarga'l vazhiga'linpadiyea avarga'lukkuch seythu, avarga'l niyaayangga'linpadiyea avarga'lai niyaayantheerppean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarga'l en'raar.

aa'raam varushaththu aa'raam maatham ainthaantheathiyilea, naan en veettil udkaarnthirukki'rapoathum, yoothaavin moopparga'l enakku munbaaga udkaarnthirukki'rapoathum, karththaraagiya aa'ndavarudaiya karam anggea enmeal amarnthathu.

appozhuthu ithoa, akkinichsaayalaayth thoan'rugi'ra oruvaraik ka'ndean; avarudaiya iduppukkuk keezhellaam akkiniyum avarudaiya iduppukku mealellaam sogusaavaippoal piragaasikki'ra saayalumaayirunthathu.

kaipoal thoan'rinathai avar neetti, en thalaimayiraip pidiththu ennaith thookkinaar; aaviyaanavar ennaip boomikkum vaanaththukkum naduvea ko'ndupoay, theavatharisanaththilea ennai erusaleamil vadathisaikku ethiraana u'lvaasalin nadaiyilea vittaar; anggea erichchalu'ndaakkugi'ra vikkiragaththin sthaanam irunthathu.
ithoa, naan pa'l'laththaakkilea ka'ndiruntha tharisanaththukkuch sariyaaga isravealin theavanudaiya magimai anggea vi'langginathu.

avar ennaippaarththu: manupuththiranea, un ka'nga'lai ea'reduththu, vadakkea paar en'raar; appozhuthu naan en ka'nga'lai ea'reduththu, vadakkea paarththean; ithoa, balipeedaththin vaasalukku vadakkea paarththean; nadaiyilea erichchalu'ndaakkugi'ra antha vikkiragam irunthathu.

avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, avarga'l seygi'rathaik kaa'ngi'raayaa? en parisuththa sthalaththaivittu ennaith thooramaayp poagappa'n'numpadiyaana israveal vamsaththaar inggea seygi'ra miguntha aruvaruppuga'laik kaa'ngi'raay allavaa? ithilum athiga aruvaruppuga'lai innamum kaa'nbaay en'ru solli,
ennaip piraagaaraththin vaasalukkuk ko'ndupoanaar; appozhuthu ithoa, suvaril oru thuvaaraththaik ka'ndean.
avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, nee suvarilea thuvaaramidu en'raar; naan suvarilea thuvaaramittapoathu, ithoa, oru vaasal irunthathu.
avar ennaippaarththu: nee u'l'lea poay, avarga'l inggea seygi'ra kodiya aruvaruppuga'laip paar en'raar.

naan u'l'lea poayp paarththapoathu, ithoa, sagalavitha oorumpiraa'niga'lum aruvaruppaana mirugangga'lumaagiya ivaiga'lin suroobangga'lum, israveal vamsaththaarudaiya naragalaana sagala vikkiragangga'lum suvaril sut'rilum siththirantheerappattirunthana.

israveal vamsaththaarin moopparil ezhubathupearum, avarga'lin naduvilea saappaanudaiya kumaaranaagiya yasaniyaavum, avanavan thanthan kaiyilea thanthan thoobakalasaththaip pidiththukko'ndu, avaiga'lukku munbaaga nin'raarga'l; thoobavarkkaththinaal miguntha pugai ezhumbit'ru.

appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, israveal vamsaththaarin moopparga'l anthagaaraththilea avaravar thangga'l vikkiragangga'lin siththira vinoatha a'raiga'lil seygi'rathai nee ka'ndaayaa? karththar engga'laip paarkki'rathillai; karththar theasaththaik kaivittaar en'ru sollugi'raarga'lea en'raar.
pinnum avarga'l seygi'ra athiga aruvaruppuga'lai innamum kaa'nbaay en'ru avar ennudanea solli,
ennaik karththarudaiya aalayaththu vadakku vaasalin nadaiyilea ko'ndu poanaar; ithoa, anggea thammoosukkaaga azhuthuko'ndirukki'ra sthireega'l udkaarnthirunthaarga'l.
appozhuthu avar: manupuththiranea, ithaik ka'ndaayaa? ithilum athiga aruvaruppuga'lai innamum kaa'nbaay en'ru ennudanea solli,

ennaik karththarudaiya aalayaththin udpiraagaaraththilea ko'ndupoanaar; ithoa, karththarudaiya aalayaththin vaasal nadaiyilea ma'ndabaththukkum balipeedaththukkum naduvea, ea'rakku'raiya irubaththainthu purushar, thangga'l muthugaik karththarudaiya aalayaththukkum thangga'l mugaththaik keezhththisaikkum nearaagath thiruppinavarga'laayk kizhakkea irukkum sooriyanai namaskariththaarga'l.

appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, ithaik ka'ndaayaa? inggea yoothaa vamsaththaar seygi'ra aruvaruppuga'l a'rpamaana kaariyamaa? avarga'l theasaththaik kodumaiyinaal nirappi ennai adikkadi koabamoottugi'raarga'l; ithoa, avarga'l thiraadchakki'laiyaith thangga'l naasikku nearaagap pidikki'raarga'l.

aagaiyaal naanum ukkiraththoadea kaariyaththai nadaththuvean; en ka'n thappaviduvathillai, naan irangguvathillai; avarga'l mahaa saththamaay en seviga'l keadkak kooppittaalum avarga'lukku naan sevikoduppathillai en'raar.
pinbu avar en kaathuga'l keadka mahaa saththamaay: nagaraththin visaarippukkaarar sanggarikkum aayuthangga'laith thangga'l kaiga'lil pidiththukko'ndu varakkadavarga'l en'ru sonnaar.

appozhuthu ithoa, aa'ru purushar, vettugi'ra aayuthangga'laith thangga'l kaiga'lil pidiththukko'ndu, vadakkea paarththa uyarntha vaasalin vazhiyilirunthu vanthaarga'l; avarga'lil sa'nalnool anggithariththu, than araiyil ka'nakkanudaiya maikkoottai vaiththirukki'ra oruvan irunthaan; avarga'l u'l'lea piraveasiththu, ve'ngala balipeedaththa'ndaiyilea nin'raarga'l.

appozhuthu isravealin theavanudaiya magimai kearubeenmealirunthezhumbi, aalayaththin vaasa'rpadiyilea vanthu, sa'nalnool anggithariththu, than araiyilea ka'nakkanudaiya maikkoottai vaiththirukki'ra purushanaik kooppittu,

karththar avanai noakki: nee erusaleam nagaram enggum uruvappoay, atha'rku'l'lea seyyappadugi'ra sagala aruvaruppuga'linimiththamum perumoochchuvittazhugi'ra manusharin net'riga'lil adaiyaa'lam poadu en'raar.
pinbu avar en kaathuga'l keadka mat'ravarga'lai noakki: neengga'l ivan pinnaalea nagaramenggum uruvappoay vettungga'l; ungga'l ka'n thappavidaamalum, neengga'l iranggaamalum,

muthiyoaraiyum, vaalibaraiyum, kannigaiga'laiyum, kuzhanthaiga'laiyum, sthireega'laiyum sanggariththuk kon'rupoadungga'l; adaiyaa'lam poadappattirukki'ra oruvanaiyum kittaathirungga'l, en parisuththa sthalaththilea thuvakkungga'l en'ru en kaathuga'l keadkach sonnaar; appozhuthu avarga'l aalayaththukkumunnea iruntha moopparidaththil thuvakkam pa'n'ninaarga'l.
avar avarga'lai noakki: neengga'l aalayaththaith theettuppaduththi, piraagaarangga'laik kolaiyu'ndavarga'laalea nirappi, pu'rappattuppoangga'l en'raar; avarga'l nagaraththil poay vettinaarga'l.

avarga'l vettikko'ndupoagaiyil naanmaaththiram thaniththu, mugangkuppu'ra vizhunthu: aa, karththaraagiya aa'ndavarea, theavareer erusaleaminmeal umathu ukkiraththai oot'rugaiyil isravealin meethiyaanavarga'laiyellaam azhippeeroa en'ru mu'raiyittean.

atha'rku avar: isravealum yoothaavumaagiya vamsaththaarin akkiramam migavum perithu; theasam iraththappazhiga'laal ni'rainthirukki'rathu; nagaramum maa'rupaattinaal nirappappattirukki'rathu; karththar theasaththaik kaivittaar; karththar paarkkamaattaar en'ru sollugi'raarga'l.
aagaiyaal en ka'n thappaviduvathumillai, naan irakkagnseyvathumillai; avarga'ludaiya vazhiyin palanai avarga'l sirasinmeal i'ranggappa'n'nuvean en'raar.
ithoa, sa'nalnool anggi thariththu, than araiyil maikkoottai vaiththirukki'ra purushan vanthu: neer enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea seythean en'ru kaariyaththaith theriviththaan.
ithoa, kearubeenga'ludaiya thalaikkumeal iruntha ma'ndalaththil inthiraneelaraththinampoan'ra singgaasanach saayalaana oru thoat'raththaik ka'ndean; athu avaiga'lukkumeal kaa'nappattathu.

avar sa'nalnool anggi thariththiruntha purushanai noakki: nee kearubeeninkeezh irukki'ra sakkarangga'lukku naduvilea piraveasiththu, kearubeenga'lin naduvea irukki'ra akkiniththazhalil un kai ni'raiya eduththu, athai nagaraththinmeal i'raiyen'raar; appadiyea avan en ka'n kaa'na u'l'lea piraveasiththaan.
anthap purushan u'l'lea piraveasikkaiyil, kearubeenga'l aalayaththin valathupu'raththil nin'rana; oru meagam udpiraagaaraththai nirappit'ru.

karththarudaiya magimai kearubeenin mealirunthu ezhumbi, aalayaththin vaasa'rpadiyilea vanthathu; aalayam meagaththinaalea ni'rainthirunthathu, piraagaaramum karththarudaiya magimaiyin piragaasaththinaal nirambit'ru.
kearubeenga'ludaiya settaiga'lin iraichchal sarvaththukkum valla theavan peasugaiyil u'ndaagum saththampoala ve'lippiraagaaramattum keadkappattathu.

avar sa'nalnool anggi thariththiruntha purushanai noakki: nee kearubeenga'lukku'l sakkarangga'lin naduvilirunthu akkiniyai edu en'ru katta'laiyittavudanea, avan u'l'lea piraveasiththuch sakkarangga'la'ndaiyilea nin'raan.

appozhuthu kearubeenga'lukku'l'lea oru kearubeen than kaiyaik kearubeenga'lin naduvil irukki'ra akkiniyil neetti, athil eduththu, sa'nalnool anggi thariththiruntha purushanudaiya kaiyil koduththaan; avan athai vaanggikko'ndu ve'liyea vanthaan.
kearubeenga'ludaiya settaiga'lin keezh manushar kaiyin saayalaanathu kaa'nappattathu.
ithoa, kearubeenga'la'ndaiyil naalu sakkarangga'l irukkak ka'ndean; ovvoru kearubeen a'ndaiyil ovvoru sakkaram irunthathu; sakkarangga'lin thoat'ram padigappachchai varu'nampoalirunthathu.
avaiga'l naalukkum orea saayalaana roobam irunthathu; sakkarangga'lin naduvilea sakkaram irukkumaappoal kaa'nappattathu.
avaiga'l oadugaiyil thangga'l naalu pakkangga'lilum oadum; oadugaiyil avaiga'l thirumbinathillai; thalainoakkum idaththukkea avaiga'l athin pinnaalea oadina; oadugaiyil avaiga'l thirumbinathillai.

avaiga'lin udal anaiththum, avaiga'lin muthuguga'lum, avaiga'lin kaiga'lum, avaiga'lin settaiga'lum, anthach sakkarangga'lum, sut'rilum ka'nga'linaalea ni'rainthirunthana; avaiga'l naalukkum iruntha sakkarangga'lum appadiyea irunthana.
anthach sakkarangga'laip paarththu: sakkaramea en'ru oruvan kooppidugi'ra saththaththaik keattean.
ovvon'rukkum naalu mugangga'l irunthana; muthalaam mugam kearubeen mugamum, ira'ndaam mugam manushamugamum, moon'raam mugam singgamugamum, naalaam mugam kazhugumugamumaayirunthathu.
kearubeenga'l mealea ezhumbina; ithuthaan, naan keabaar nathiya'ndaiyilea ka'ndiruntha jeevan.
kearubeenga'l sellugaiyil sakkarangga'l avaiga'l arugea oadina; boomiyilirunthu ezhumbak kearubeenga'l thangga'l settaiga'lai viriththapoathu, sakkarangga'lum avaiga'lai vittu vilagippoagavillai.
avaiga'l ni'rkaiyil ivaiga'lum nin'rana; avaiga'l ezhumbugaiyil ivaiga'lum ezhumbina; jeevanudaiya aavi ivaiga'lil irunthathu.
karththarudaiya magimai aalayaththin vaasa'rpadiyaivittup pu'rappattu, kearubeenga'linmeal nin'rathu.

appozhuthu kearubeenga'l thangga'l settaiga'lai viriththu, en ka'n kaa'nap boomiyaivittu ezhumbina; avaiga'l pu'rappadugaiyil sakkarangga'lum avaiga'lukkuch sariyaaych sen'rana; karththarudaiya aalayaththin kizhakku vaasalilea poay ni'rka, isravealin theavanudaiya magimai avaiga'linmeal uyara irunthathu.
ithu naan keabaar nathiya'ndaiyilea isravealin theavanukkuk keezhea irukkakka'nda antha jeevanthaanea; avaiga'l kearubeenga'l en'ru a'rinthuko'ndean.
avaiga'lil ovvon'rukkum naalu mugamum, ovvon'rukkum naalu settaiga'lum irunthana; avaiga'ludaiya settaiga'lin keezh manushakaiga'lin saayal irunthathu.
avaiga'ludaiya mugangga'l naan keabaar nathiya'ndaiyilea ka'ndiruntha antha mugangga'lin saayalaayirunthathu; ovvon'rum thanthan mugaththukku ethiraana thisaiyai noakkich sen'rathu.

pinbu aaviyaanavar ennai eduththu, ennaik karththarudaiya aalayaththin kizhakku mugamaayirukki'ra vaasalukkuk ko'ndupoanaar; ithoa, antha vaasalin nadaiyil irubaththainthu purushar irunthaarga'l; avarga'lin naduvea janaththin pirabukka'laagiya aasoorin kumaaranaagiya yasaniyaavaiyum, benaayaavin kumaaranaagiya pelaththiyaavaiyum ka'ndean.
appozhuthu avar ennai noakki: manupuththiranea, ivarga'l intha nagaraththilea akkiramamaana ninaivuga'lai ninaiththu, thuraaloasanai sollugi'ra manushar.
ithu veeduga'laik kattuvatha'rkuk kaalamalla en'rum, intha nagaram paanai, naangga'l athilu'l'la i'raichchiyen'rum sollugi'raarga'l.
aagaiyaal avarga'lukku viroathamaayth theerkkatharisanagnsollu, manupuththiranea, theerkkatharisanagnsollu en'raar.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya aavi enmeal i'rangginaar; avar ennai noakki: nee sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, israveal vamsaththaarea, neengga'l ippadip peasugi'rathu u'ndu; ungga'l manathil ezhumbugi'rathai naan a'rivean.
intha nagaraththil neengga'l aneagaraik kolaiseytheerga'l; athin veethiga'laik kolaiyu'ndavarga'laal nirappineerga'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.

aagaiyaal neengga'l kolaiseythu, athin naduvilea poattuvittavarga'lea i'raichchiyum, intha nagaram paanaiyumaamea; ungga'laiyoa atha'rku'l iraathapadikkup pu'rambaakkuvean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
pattayaththukkup bayappatteerga'l, pattayaththaiyea ungga'lmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
naan ungga'lai atha'rku'l iraathapadikkup pu'rambaakki, ungga'lai anniyarin kaiyil oppukkoduththu, ungga'lil niyaayaththeerppuga'lai ni'raiveat'ruvean.
pattayaththaal vizhuveerga'l; israveal theasaththin ellaiyilea ungga'lai niyaayantheerppean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.
intha nagaram ungga'lukkup paanaiyaayiruppathumillai, neengga'l athilu'l'la i'raichchiyaayiruppathumillai; israveal theasaththin ellaiyilea ungga'lai niyaayantheerppean.

en katta'laiga'linpadi nadavaamalum, en niyaayangga'linpadi seyyaamalum, ungga'laich sut'rilumirukki'ra pu'rajaathiga'ludaiya mu'raimaiga'linpadi seytha neengga'l appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l en'ru sol en'raar.

naan ippadith theerkkatharisanagnsollugaiyil, benaayaavin kumaaranaagiya pelaththiyaa seththaan; appozhuthu naan mugangkuppu'ra vizhunthu, mahaa saththamaay: aa, karththaraagiya aa'ndavarea, theavareer isravealil meethiyaanavarga'laich sarvasanggaaragnseyveeroa en'ru mu'raiyittean.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:

manupuththiranea, neengga'l karththarai vittuth thooramaayp poangga'l, engga'lukku inthath theasam suthantharamaagak kodukkappattathen'ru, un sagoathararukkum, un kudumbaththaarukkum, un panthu janangga'lukkum, israveal vamsaththaar anaivarukkum, erusaleamin kudiga'l sollugi'raarga'l.

aagaiyaal naan avarga'laith thooramaagap pu'rajaathiga'lukku'l'lea thuraththiyirunthaalum, naan avarga'laith theasangga'lilea sitha'radiththirunthaalum, naan avarga'l poana theasangga'lil avarga'lukkuk kognchakkaalaththukkup parisuththa sthalamaaga iruppean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol.

aathalaal naan ungga'lai janangga'lidaththilirunthu searththu, neengga'l sitha'radikkappatta theasangga'lilirunthu ungga'laik koottikko'ndu, israveal theasaththai ungga'lukkuk koduppean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sollu.
avarga'l anggea vanthu, athil cheeyen'rigazhappadaththakkathum aruvarukkappadaththakkathumaayirukki'rathaiyellaam athilirunthu agat'ruvaarga'l.

avarga'l en katta'laiga'linpadi nadanthu, en niyaayangga'laik kaikko'ndu, avaiga'linpadi seyya naan avarga'lukku eaga iruthayaththaith thanthu, avarga'l u'l'laththil puthiya aaviyaik koduththu, kallaana iruthayaththai avarga'l maamsaththilirunthu eduththuppoattu, sathaiyaana iruthayaththai avarga'lukku aru'luvean.
avarga'l en janamaayiruppaarga'l, naan avarga'l theavanaayiruppean.

aanaalum cheeyen'rigazhappadaththakkathum aruvarukkappadaththakkathumaana thangga'l iruthayaththin ichchaiyilea evarga'l nadakki'raarga'loa avarga'ludaiya vazhiyin palanai avarga'l thalaiga'linmeal sumarappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
appozhuthu kearubeenga'l thangga'l settaiga'lai viriththu ezhumbina; sakkarangga'lum avaiga'lukku arugea sen'rana; isravealin theavanudaiya magimai avaiga'linmeal uyara irunthathu.
karththarudaiya magimai nagaraththin naduvilirunthezhumbi, nagaraththukkuk kizhakkea irukki'ra malaiyinmeal poay nin'rathu.

pinbu aaviyaanavar ennai eduththu, ennai theavanudaiya aavikku'l'laana tharisanaththilea kaltheayaavukkuch si'raippattuppoanavarga'l idaththilea ko'ndupoay vittaar; appozhuthu naan ka'nda tharisanam ennilirunthu edupattuppoayit'ru.
karththar enakkuk kaa'nbiththa yaavaiyum si'raiyiruppilirunthavarga'lukkuch sonnean.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee kalagaveettaarin naduvilea thanggiyirukki'raay; kaa'numpadikku avarga'lukkuk ka'nga'l irunthaalum kaa'naama'rpoagi'raarga'l; keadkumpadikku avarga'lukkuk kaathuga'l irunthaalum kea'laama'rpoagi'raarga'l; avarga'l kalagaveettaar.

ippoathum manupuththiranea, nee paratheasam poagumpadi pirayaa'na saamaanga'lai aayaththappaduththi, paga'rkaalaththilea avarga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaagap pirayaa'nappadu; un sthalaththaivittu vea'rea sthalaththukku avarga'ludaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaagap pu'rappattuppoa; avarga'l kalagaveettaaraanapoathilum oruvea'lai sinthiththu u'naruvaarga'l.

si'raiyiruppukkup poagi'ravanaippoal un saamaanga'lai nee paga'rkaalaththilea avarga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaaga ve'liyea vaiththu, nee saayanggaalaththilea avarga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaagach si'raiyiruppukkup poagi'ravanaippoal pu'rappaduvaayaaga.
avarga'ludaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaaga nee suvarilea thuvaaramittu, athin vazhiyaay avaiga'lai ve'liyea ko'ndupoavaayaaga.

avarga'ludaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaaga avaiga'lai un thoa'linmeal eduththu, maalaimayanggum vea'laiyilea ve'liyea ko'ndupoavaayaaga; nee theasaththaip paaraathapadi un mugaththai moodikko'l; israveal vamsaththaarukku unnai adaiyaa'lamaakkinean en'raar.

enakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea naan seythean; si'raippattuppoagumpoathu saamaanga'laik ko'ndupoavathupoala en saamaanga'laip paga'rkaalaththil ve'liyea vaiththean; saayanggaalaththiloa kaiyinaal suvarilea thuvaaramittu, maalai mayanggum vea'laiyilea avaiga'lai ve'liyea ko'ndupoay, avarga'l ka'nga'lukku munbaaga avaiga'laith thoa'linmeal eduththukko'ndupoanean.
vidiya'rkaalaththilea karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, kalagaveettaaraagiya israveal vamsaththaar unnaip paarththu: nee seygi'rathu ennaven'ru unnaik keattaarga'l allavaa?
ithu erusaleamil irukki'ra athibathiyinmealum athin naduvil irukki'ra israveal vamsaththaar anaivarinmealum sumarum baaram en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru avarga'lidaththil sollu.
nee avarga'lai noakki: naan ungga'lukku adaiyaa'lamaayirukki'rean; naan seyvathu eppadiyoa, appadiyea avarga'lukkum seyyappadum; si'raippattup paratheasam poavaarga'l.

avarga'l naduvil irukki'ra athibathi maalaimayanggumpoathu thoa'linmeal sumaisumanthu pu'rappaduvaan; ve'liyea sumaiko'ndupoagach suvarilea thuvaaramiduvaarga'l; ka'n'ninaalea avan than theasaththaik kaa'naathapadi than mugaththai moodikko'lvaan.
naan en valaiyai avanmeal veesuvean, avan en ka'n'niyilea pidipaduvaan; avanaik kaltheayar theasamaagiya baabiloanukkuk ko'ndupoavean; anggea avan saavaan; aagilum athaik kaa'namaattaan.
avanukku uthaviyaaga avanaich sut'rilum irukki'ra yaavaraiyum avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvangga'laiyum naan sagala thisaiga'lilum thoot'ri, avarga'l pinnea pattayaththai uruvuvean.
appadi naan avarga'lai jaathiga'lukku'l'lea thoot'ri, avarga'lai theasangga'lilea sitha'radikkumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarga'l.

aanaalum thaangga'l poaychsearum jaathiga'lukku'l'lea thangga'l aruvaruppuga'laiyellaam vivarikkumpadi, naan avarga'lil kognchampearaip pagnchaththukkum pattayaththukkum ko'l'lainoaykkum thappi meenthirukkappa'n'nuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lvaarga'l en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee un appaththai nadukkaththoadea pusiththu, un tha'n'neeraith thaththa'lippoadum visaaraththoadum kudiththu,

theasaththilu'l'la janangga'lai noakki: israveal theasaththilu'l'la erusaleamin kudiga'laikku'riththuk karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal, thangga'l appaththai visaaraththoadea pusiththu, thangga'l tha'n'neeraith thigiloadea kudippaarga'l; avarga'ludaiya theasaththuk kudiga'ludaiya kodumaiga'linimiththam athilu'l'lathellaam azhiya, athu paazhaagum.
kudiyea'riyirukki'ra patta'nangga'l vanaantharangga'laagi, theasam paazhaayppoagum; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, naadka'l needikkum, tharisanam ellaam avamaagum en'ru israveal theasaththilea vazhanggum pazhamozhi enna?

aagaiyaal nee avarga'lai noakki: karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, avarga'l ini isravealilea inthap pazhamozhiyaich sollivaraathapadikku naan athai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean; naadka'lum ellaath tharisanaththin poru'lum sameebiththu vanthana en'ru avarga'loadea sollu.
israveal vamsaththaarin naduvil inich sagala ka'l'laththarisanamum mugasthuthiyaana ku'risolluthalum iraama'rpoagum.

naan karththar, naan solluvean, naan sollum vaarththai ni'raivea'rum; inith thaamathiyaathu; kalagaveettaarea, ungga'l naadka'lilea naan vaarththaiyaich solluvean, athai ni'raivea'ravum pa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinnum karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:

manupuththiranea, ithoa, israveal vamsaththaar: ivan kaa'ngi'ra tharisanam ni'raivea'ra aneaganaa'l sellum; thooramaayirukki'ra kaalangga'laikku'riththu ivan theerkkatharisanam sollugi'raan engi'raarga'l.

aagaiyaal en vaarththaiga'lil on'raagilum inith thaamathippathillaiyen'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar; naan sonna vaarththai ni'raivea'rum en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru avarga'loadea sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:

manupuththiranea, theerkkatharisanam sollugi'ra isravealin theerkkatharisiga'lukku viroathamaaga nee theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, thangga'l iruthayaththil irukki'rathaiyea eduththuth theerkkatharisanagn sollugi'ravarga'loadea nee sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'lungga'l.
karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathaavathu: thaangga'l on'rum tharisiyaathirunthum, thangga'ludaiya aaviyin eavuthalaip pinpat'rugi'ra mathiketta theerkkatharisiga'lukku aiyoa!
isravealea, un theerkkatharisiga'l vanaantharangga'lilu'l'la nariga'lukku oppaayirukki'raarga'l.
neengga'l karththarudaiya naa'lilea yuththaththil nilaini'rkumpadikku, thi'rappuga'lil ea'rinathumillai; israveal vamsaththaarukkaagach suvarai adaiththathumillai.

karththar thangga'lai anuppaathirunthum, karththar uraiththaar en'ru solli, avarga'l abaththaththaiyum poykku'riyaiyum tharisiththu, kaariyaththai nirvaagampa'n'nalaamen'ru nambikkaiyaayirukki'raarga'l.
naan uraikkaathirunthum, neengga'l karththar uraiththaar en'ru sollumpoathu, abaththamaana tharisanaiyaith tharisiththu, poykku'riyaich sollugi'reerga'l allavaa?

aagaiyaal karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: neengga'l abaththamaanathaich solli, poyyaanathaith tharisikki'rapadiyinaal, ithoa, naan ungga'lukku viroathamaanavar en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.

abaththamaanathaith tharisiththu, poykku'riyaich sollugi'ra theerkkatharisiga'lukku en kai viroathamaayirukkum; avarga'l en janaththin sanggaththil iruppathumillai; israveal vamsaththaarin attava'naiyil ezhuthappaduvathumillai; israveal theasaththukku'l piraveasippathumillai; appozhuthu naan karththaraagiya aa'ndavaren'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.

samaathaanam illaathirunthum samaathaanamen'ru solli, avarga'l en janaththai moasampoakkugi'raarga'l; oruvan ma'nsuvarai vaikki'raan; ithoa, mat'ravarga'l saaramillaatha saanthai atha'rkup poosugi'raarga'l.
saaramillaatha saanthaip poosugi'ravarga'lai noakki: athu idinthuvizhumen'ru sol; ve'l'lamaagap perugugi'ra mazhai peyyum; mahaa kalmazhaiyea, nee sorivaay; kodiya pusalkaat'rum athaip pi'lakkum.
ithoa, suvar vizhumpoathu: neengga'l poosina poochchu enggea en'ru solvaarga'l allavaa?

aagaiyaal en ukkiraththilea kodiya pusalkaat'rai ezhumbi adikkappa'n'nuvean; en koabaththilea ve'l'lamaaga adikki'ra mazhaiyum, en ukkiraththilea nirmoolamaakkaththakka perungkal mazhaiyum soriyum en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.

appozhuthu neengga'l saaramillaatha saanthaip poosina suvarai naan idiththu, athin asthibaaram thi'ranthukidakkumpadi athaith tharaiyilea vizhappa'n'nuvean; u'l'lea irukki'ra neengga'l nirmoolamaagumpadi athu vizhum; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.
ippadich suvarilum, atha'rkuch saaramillaatha saanthaip poosinavarga'lilum naan en ukkiraththaith theerththukko'ndu: suvarumillai, atha'rkuch saanthu poosinavarga'lumillai.

erusaleamaikku'riththuth theerkkatharisanagnsolli, samaathaanam illaathirunthum samaathaanam u'nden'ru tharisanangkaa'ngi'ra isravealin theerkkatharisiga'l illaama'rpoavaarga'l en'ru ungga'lukkuch sollugi'rean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

manupuththiranea, thangga'ludaiya iruthayaththil irukki'rathaiyea eduththu, theerkkatharisanagnsollugi'ra un janaththin kumaaraththiga'lukku ethiraaga un mugaththaith thiruppi, avarga'lukku viroathamaagath theerkkatharisanam uraiththu, sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

aaththumaakka'lai veattaiyaadumpadikkuch sagala kaiga'lukkum thazhuva'naiga'laith thaiththu, anthantha vayathu'l'lavarga'ludaiya thalaikkum thalaiya'naiga'lai u'ndu pa'n'nugi'ravarga'lukku aiyoa! neengga'l en janaththin aaththumaakka'lai veattaiyaadi, avaiga'lai ungga'lukku uyiroadea kaappaat'ruveerga'loa?

saagaththagaatha aaththumaakka'laik kolvatha'rkum, uyiroadea irukkaththagaatha aaththumaakka'lai uyiroadea kaappaat'ruvatha'rkumaaga neengga'l poykkuch sevikodukki'ra en janaththukkup poy sollugi'rathinaalea sila siranggai vaa'rkoathumaikkaagavum appaththu'nduga'lukkaagavum ennai en janaththukku'l'lea parisuththakkulaichchalaakkuveerga'loa en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

aagaiyaal karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: ithoa, neengga'l aaththumaakka'laip pa'rakkadikkumpadi veattaiyaadugi'ra ungga'l thazhuva'naiga'lukku viroathamaaga naan vanthu, avaiga'lai ungga'l puyangga'lilirunthu pidunggik kizhiththu, neengga'l pa'rakkadikka veattaiyaadugi'ra aaththumaakka'lai naan viduthalai pa'n'ni,

ungga'l thalaiya'naiga'laik kizhiththu, en janaththai ungga'l kaiga'lukku neenggalaakkividuvean; avarga'l ini veattaiyaadappadumpadi ungga'l kaiga'lil iraarga'l; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.

naan sagnchalappaduththaatha neethimaanin iruthayaththai neengga'l vee'naay mu'riyappa'n'ninapadiyinaalum, thunmaarkkan than pollaatha vazhiyaivittuth thirumbavum naan avanai uyiroadea kaakkavung koodaathapadikku neengga'l avanudaiya kaiga'laith thidappaduththinapadiyinaalum,

neengga'l ini abaththamaanathaith tharisippathumillai, saasthiram paarppathumillai; naan en janaththai ungga'l kaiga'lukku neenggalaakkividuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l en'ru sol en'raar.
isravealudaiya moopparil silar ennidaththil vanthu, enakku munbaaga udkaarnthaarga'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:

manupuththiranea, intha manushar thangga'l naragalaana vikkiragangga'laith thangga'l iruthayaththinmeal naatti, thangga'l akkiramamaagiya ida'ralaith thangga'l mugaththukku ethiraaga vaiththukko'ndirukki'raarga'lea; ivarga'l ennidaththil visaarikkaththagumaa?

aagaiyaal, nee avarga'loadea peasichsollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: israveal vamsaththaaril thannudaiya naragalaana vikkiragangga'laith than iruthayaththinmeal naatti, than akkiramamaagiya ida'ralaith than mugaththukku ethiraaga vaiththukko'ndirukki'ra evanaagilum theerkkatharisiyinidaththil vanthaal, karththaraagiya naan israveal vamsaththaarudaiya iruthayaththil irukki'rathaip pidikkumpadiyaaga appadippattavanudaiya naragalaana vikkiragangga'lin thiradchikkuththakkathaaga uththaravu koduppean.
avarga'l ellaarum thangga'l naragalaana vikkiragangga'laip pinpat'ri, ennaivittup peathaliththuppoanaarga'l en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.

aagaiyaal, nee israveal vamsaththaarai noakki: thirumbungga'l, ungga'l naragalaana vikkiragangga'lai vittuth thirumbungga'l; ungga'l sagala aruvaruppuga'laiyum vittu ungga'l mugangga'laith thiruppungga'l en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

israveal vamsaththaarilum isravealil thanggugi'ra anniyarilum ennaip pinpat'raamal peathaliththu, than naragalaana vikkiragangga'laith than iruthayaththinmeal naatti, than akkiramamaagiya ida'ralaith than mugaththukkethiraaga vaiththukko'ndirukki'ra evanaagilum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaay ennidaththil visaarikka vanthaal, avanukkuk karththaraagiya naanea uththaravukoduththu,

antha manushanukku viroathamaaga en mugaththaith thiruppi, avanai adaiyaa'lamaagavum pazhamozhiyaagavum vaiththu, avanai en janaththin naduvil iraathapadikkuch sanggariththuppoaduvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.

oru theerkkatharisi eththappattu oru viseashaththaich sonnaanaagil, appadikkoththa theerkkatharisiyaik karththaraagiya naanea eththappadappa'n'ninean; naan avanukku viroathamaaga en kaiyai neetti, avanai israveal janaththin naduvil iraathapadikku azhippean.

appadiyea avaravar thangga'l thangga'l akkiramaththaich sumappaarga'l; theerkkatharisiyinidaththil visaarikki'ravanudaiya tha'ndanai eppadiyoa appadiyea theerkkatharisiyinudaiya tha'ndanaiyum irukkum.

israveal vamsaththaar ini ennaivittu vazhithappippoagaamalum, thangga'l ellaa mee'ruthalga'laalum ini asusippadaamalum irukkumporuttaaga ippadich sambavikkum; appozhuthu avarga'l en janamaayiruppaarga'l, naan avarga'l theavanaayiruppean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:

manupuththiranea, oru theasam enakku viroathamaayth thuroagampa'n'nikko'ndeayirunthu, paavagnseythaal, naan atha'rku viroathamaaga en kaiyai neetti, athil appam ennum aatharavukoalai mu'riththu, athil pagnchaththai anuppi, manusharaiyum mirugangga'laiyum athil iraathapadikku naasampa'n'nuvean.

appozhuthu noavaa thaaniyeal yoabu aagiya immoon'ru purusharum athin naduvil irunthaalum, avarga'l thangga'l neethiyinaal thangga'l aaththumaakka'laimaaththiram thappuvippaarga'l en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
naan theasaththil thushdamirugangga'lai anuppa, ammirugangga'linimiththam oruvarum athin vazhiyaay nadakkakkoodaathapadi ve'rumaiyum paazhumaagumpoathu,

antha moon'ru purusharum athin naduvil irunthaalum, thaangga'lmaaththiram thappuvaarga'leayallaamal, kumaararaiyaagilum kumaaraththiga'laiyaagilum thappuvikkamaattaarga'l; theasamum paazhaayppoagum en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean enbathaik karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
allathu naan anthath theasaththinmeal pattayaththai varappa'n'ni: pattayamea, theasaththai uruvappoa en'ru solli, athilu'l'la manusharaiyum mirugangga'laiyum naasampa'n'numpoathu,

antha moon'ru purusharum athin naduvil irunthaalum, thaangga'lmaaththiram thappuvaarga'leayallaamal, kumaararaiyaagilum kumaaraththiga'laiyaagilum thappuvikkamaattaarga'l en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean enbathaik karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
allathu naan anthath theasaththil ko'l'lainoayai anuppi, athilu'l'la manusharaiyum mirugangga'laiyum naasampa'n'numpadi athinmeal iraththappazhiyaaga en ukkiraththai oot'rumpoathu,

noavaavum thaaniyealum yoabum athin naduvil irunthaalum, avarga'l thangga'l neethiyinaal thangga'l aaththumaakka'lai maaththiram thappuvippaarga'leayallaamal, kumaaranaiyaagilum, kumaaraththiyaiyaagilum thappuvikkamaattaarga'l en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean enbathaik karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

aagaiyaal, karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: naan manusharaiyum mirugangga'laiyum naasampa'n'numpadi erusaleamukku viroathamaagap pattayam, pagncham, thushdamirugangga'l, ko'l'lainoay ennum innaangu kodiya tha'ndanaiga'laiyum anuppumpoathu evva'lavu athiga sanggaaramaagum?

aagilum, ithoa, athilea thappi meethiyaagi ve'liyea ko'nduvarappadugi'ra kumaararum kumaaraththiga'lum silar iruppaarga'l; ithoa, avarga'l ungga'la'ndaikkup pu'rappattu varuvaarga'l; appozhuthu neengga'l avarga'l maarkkaththaiyum avarga'l kiriyaiga'laiyum ka'ndu, naan erusaleaminmeal varappa'n'nina theenggaiyum athinmeal naan varappa'n'nina ellaavat'raiyungku'riththuth theat'rappaduveerga'l.

neengga'l avarga'l maarkkaththaiyum avarga'l kiriyaiyaiyum kaa'numpoathu, avarga'l ungga'lukkuth theat'raravaayiruppaarga'l; naan athilea seytha ellaavat'raiyum mugaantharamillaamal seyyavillaiyen'ru appozhuthu a'rinthuko'lveerga'l enbathaik karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sonnaar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, kaattilirukki'ra sediga'lukku'l mat'ra ellaach sedikodiga'laippaarkkilum thiraadchachsedikku meanmai enna?
yaathoru vealaiseyya athilea oru kattai edukkappadumoa? yaathoru thattumuttaith thookkivaikkumpadi oru mu'laiyai athinaal seyvaarga'loa?
ithoa, athu akkinikku iraiyaaga e'riyappadum; athin ira'ndu munaiga'laiyum akkini eriththuppoadum; athin naduththu'ndum venthupoam; athu entha vealaikkaavathu uthavumoa?
ithoa, athu veagaathirukkumpoathea oru vealaikkum uthavaathirukka, akkini athai eriththu, athu venthupoanapinbu, athu ini oru vealaikku uthavuvatheppadi?

aathalaal, karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: kaattuch sediga'lukku'l'lirukki'ra thiraadchachsediyai naan akkinikku iraiyaaga oppukkoduththathupoala, erusaleamin kudiga'laiyum appadiyea oppukkoduththu,

en mugaththai avarga'lukku viroathamaagath thiruppuvean; avarga'l oru akkiniyilirunthu neenggith thappinaalum, vea'rea akkini avarga'laip padchikkum; appadiyea naan en mugaththai avarga'lukku viroathamaayth thiruppumpoathu, naan karththar en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.
avarga'l thuroagampa'n'ninapadiyinaal, naan theasaththaip paazhaayp poagappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee erusaleamin aruvaruppuga'lai atha'rku a'riviththuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:
karththaraagiya aa'ndavar erusaleamukkuch sollugi'raar, kaanaan theasamea un u'rpaththikkum un pi'rappukkum idam, un thagappan emoariyan, un thaay eaththiththi.

un pi'rappin varththamaanam ennaven'raal, nee pi'rantha naa'lilea un thoppu'l a'rukkappadavumillai; nee suththamaavatha'rkuth tha'n'neerinaal ku'lippaattappadavumillai; uppaal suththigarikkappadavumillai; thu'niga'lil sut'rappadavumillai.
unakkaagap parithabiththu, ivaiga'lil on'raiyaagilum unakkuch seyya oru ka'n'num unpearil irakkamaayirunthathumillai; nee pi'ranthanaa'lil nee aruvarukkappattathinaal ve'liyil e'rinthuvidappattaay.

naan un arugea kadanthupoagumpoathu, mithikkappaduvatha'rku eathuvaay nee un iraththaththil kidakki'rathaik ka'ndu, un iraththaththil kidakki'ra unnaippaarththu: pizhaiththiru en'rean; aam, un iraththaththil kidakki'ra unnaippaarththu: pizhaiththiru en'ru sonnean.

unnai vayalin payiraippoala aneagamaayiramaayp perugumpadi vaiththean; nee va'larnthu periyava'laagi, mahaa saunthariyavathiyaanaay; un sthanangga'l ezhumbina, un mayir va'larnthathu; aanaalum, nee nirvaa'namum amma'namumaayirunthaay.

naan un arugea kadanthupoanapoathu, unnaip paarththean; ithoa, un kaalam paruvakaalamaayirunthathu; appozhuthu en vasthiraththai unmeal viriththu, un nirvaa'naththai moodi, unakku aa'naiyittukkoduththu, unnoadu udanpadikkai pa'n'ninean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar; ivvithamaay nee ennudaiyava'laanaay.
naan unnai jalaththinaal muzhukkaatti, unnai iraththama'ra snaanam pa'n'nuviththu, unakku e'n'ney poosi,
siththiraththaiyalaadaiyai unakku uduththi, saayantheerntha paatharadchaiga'lai unakkuth thariththu, katta melliya pudavaiyaiyum, moodikko'l'lap pattuch saalvaiyaiyum unakkuk koduththu,
unnai aabara'nangga'laal alanggariththu, un kaiga'lilea kadagangga'laiyum, un kazhuththilea sarappa'niyaiyum poattu,
un net'riyil net'rippattaththaiyum, un kaathuga'lil kaatha'niyaiyum, un thalaiyinmeal singgaaramaana kireedaththaiyum thariththean.

ivvithamaayp ponninaalum ve'l'liyinaalum nee alanggarikkappattaay; un uduppu melliya pudavaiyum pattum siththiraththaiyalaadaiyumaayirunthathu; melliya maavaiyum theanaiyum neyyaiyum saappittaay; nee migavum azhagu'l'lava'laagi, raajyaththaich suthantharikkum silaakkiyaththaiyum pet'raay.
un azhaginaalea un keerththi pu'rajaathiga'lukku'l'lea pirasiththamaayit'ru; naan unmeal vaiththa en magimaiyinaalea athu ku'raivat'rathaay irunthathen'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
neeyoaven'raal un azhagai nambi, un keerththiyinaal soaramaarkkamaay nadanthu, vazhippoakkaril unakku nearpatta yaavaroadum veasiththanampa'n'ni,

un vasthirangga'lil silavat'rai eduththu, palavaru'nach soadippaana meadaiga'lai unakku u'ndaakki, avaiga'linmeal veasiththanampa'n'ninaay; appadikkoththa kaariyangga'l orukkaalum sambaviththathumillai, sambavippathumillai.
naan unakkuk koduththa en ponnum en ve'l'liyumaana un singgaara aabara'nangga'lai nee eduththu, unakku aa'nsuroobangga'lai u'ndaakki, avaiga'loadea veasiththanampa'n'ni,
un siththiraththaiyalaadaiga'lai eduththu, avaiga'lai moodi, en e'n'neyaiyum en thoobavarkkaththaiyum avaiga'linmun padaiththu,

naan unakkuk koduththa en appaththaiyum, nee saappidumpadi unakkuk koduththa melliya maavaiyum neyyaiyum theanaiyum nee avaiga'linmun suganthavaasanaiyaagap padaiththaay; kaariyam ippadi aayit'ren'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
nee enakkup pet'ra un kumaararaiyum un kumaaraththiga'laiyum eduththu, avarga'lai avaiga'lukku iraiyaagap baliyittaay.
nee seytha veasiththanangga'l poathaathen'ru, nee en pi'l'laiga'lai avaiga'lukkuth theekkadakkappa'n'na oppukkoduththu, avarga'laik kolaiseythaay.

nee un ellaa aruvaruppuga'lilum veasiththanangga'lilum nadakkumpoathu, nirvaa'namum amma'namumaayirunthathum, un iraththaththilea mithikkappada eathuvaayk kidanthathumaana un si'ruvayathin naadka'lai ninaiyaama'rpoanaay.
aiyoa! unakku aiyoa! en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar; nee seytha pollaappuga'lellaam thavira,
nee unakku ma'ndabangga'laik katti, unakkuch sagala veethiga'lilum uyarntha meadaiga'lai u'ndupa'n'ninaay.
nee sagala vazhimuganaiyilum un uyarntha meadaiga'laik katti, un azhagai aruvaruppaakki, vazhippoakkar yaavarukkum un kaalga'lai viriththu, un veasiththanangga'laith thira'laayp perugappa'n'ni,
sathai peruththa un ayal theasaththaaraagiya egipthiya puththiraroadea veasiththanampa'n'ni, enakkuk koabam u'ndaakkumpadi un veasiththanangga'laip perugappa'n'ninaay.

aathalaal, ithoa, naan en kaiyai unakku viroathamaaga neetti, unakku niyamiththa poajanaththaik ku'rukki, un mu'raikeadaana maarkkaththaik ku'riththu vedkappatta un pagaiyaa'liga'laagiya pelistharudaiya kumaaraththiga'lin ichchaikku unnai oppukkoduththean.
nee thirupthiyadaiyaathathinaal aseeriya puththiraroadum veasiththanampa'n'ninaay; avarga'loadea veasiththanampa'n'niyum nee thirupthiyadaiyavillai.
nee kaanaan theasaththilea seytha veasiththanaththaik kaltheayarmattum ettach seythaay; athinaalum nee thirupthiyadaiyaama'rpoanaay.
vedkangketta veasiyin kiriyaiga'laagiya ivaiga'laiyellaam nee seythu,

sagala vazhimuganaiyilum un ma'ndabangga'laik katti, sagala veethiga'lilum un meadaiga'lai u'ndaakkinapadiyaal, un iruthayam evva'lavaayk ka'laiththuppoayirukki'rathu en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar; nee pa'naiyaththai aladchiyampa'n'nugi'rathinaal, nee veasiyaippoala iraamal,
than purushanukkup bathilaaga anniyaraich searththukko'l'lugi'ra vibasaara sthireeyaippoala irukki'raay.

ellaa veasiga'lukkum pa'naiyang kodukki'raarga'l; neeyoa un neasarga'l sut'ruppu'rangga'lilirunthu unnidaththil veasiththanagnseyya varumpadi avarga'lukkellaam neeyea pa'naiyangkoduththu, avarga'lukku vegumathiga'laith tharugi'raay.

ivvithamaay un veasiththanangga'lukkum vea'rea sthireega'lin veasiththanangga'lukkum viththiyaasamu'ndu; veasiththanampa'n'na avarga'l unnaip pin sellamaattaarga'l; pa'naiyam unakkuk kodukkappadaamal neeyea pa'naiyam kodukki'rapadiyaal nee seyvathu vibareetham.
aagaiyaal, veasiyea, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyaik kea'l.

karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: un veasiththanaththin asuththam paaynthapadiyinaalum, nee un kaamavigaariga'loadum aruvaruppaagiya un naragalaana vikkiragangga'loadum veasiththanampa'n'ni, ivaiga'lukku un pi'l'laiga'lin iraththaththaip padaiththathinaal un nirvaa'nam thi'rakkappattapadiyinaalum,

ithoa, nee samboagampa'n'nina un ellaak kaamavigaariga'laiyum, nee neasiththa yaavaraiyum, nee pagaiththirukki'ra anaivaroadum naan koodivarachseythu, sut'rilumirunthu avarga'lai unakku viroathamaagach searththu, avarga'l un nirvaa'naththaiyellaam kaa'numpadi un nirvaa'naththai avarga'lukku munbaagath thi'ranthuvaiththu,
vibasaariga'laiyum iraththagnsinthinavarga'laiyum niyaayantheerkki'rapadiyea unnai niyaayantheerththu, ukkiraththoadum erichchaloadum iraththappazhiyai unpearil sumaththi,

unnai avarga'l kaiyil oppukkoduppean; avarga'l un ma'ndabangga'lai idiththu, un meadaiga'laith tharaiyaakkippoattu, un vasthirangga'lai urinthu, un singgaara aabara'nangga'lai eduththukko'ndu, unnai amma'namum nirvaa'namumaaga vittuppoay,
unakku viroathamaaga oru koottaththaik ko'nduvanthu, unnaik kalle'rinthu, unnaith thangga'l pattayangga'laal kuththipoattu,

un veeduga'lai akkiniyaal sutteriththu, aneaga sthireega'lin ka'nga'lukku munbaaga unnil niyaayaththeerppuga'laich seyvaarga'l; un veasiththanaththai ozhiyappa'n'nuvean; nee inip pa'naiyangkoduppathillai.
ivvithamaay en erichchal unnai vittu neenggumpadi, naan en ukkiraththai unnil aa'rappa'n'ni, ini koabamaayiraamal amaruvean.

nee un i'lavayathin naadka'lai ninaiyaamal, ivaiga'lellaavat'rinaalum enakkuk koabam u'ndaakkinapadiyinaal, ithoa, naan un vazhiyin palanai un thalaiyinmeal sumarappa'n'nuvean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar; athinaalea ini un ellaa aruvaruppuga'linaalum ippadippatta mu'raikeadaana kaariyaththaich seyyamaattaay.
ithoa, pazhamozhi sollugi'ravarga'l ellaarum: thaayaippoala maga'l en'ru unnaikku'riththup pazhamozhi solluvaarga'l.

nee, than purushanaiyum than pi'l'laiga'laiyum aruvaruththa un thaayin maga'l; nee, thangga'l purusharaiyum thangga'l pi'l'laiga'laiyum aruvaruththa un sagoathariga'lin sagoathari; ungga'l thaay eaththiththi; ungga'l thagappan emoariyan.
un idathupu'raththilea, thaanum than kumaaraththiga'lumaayk kudiyiruntha samaariyaa un thamakkai; un valathupu'raththilea, thaanum than kumaaraththiga'lumaayk kudiyiruntha soathoam un thanggai.

aagilum nee avarga'ludaiya maarkkangga'lilea nadavaamalum, avarga'ludaiya aruvaruppuga'linpadi seyyaamalum, athu mahaa a'rpakaariyam engi'rathupoala nee un ellaa vazhiga'lileayum avarga'laippaarkkilum keadaay nadanthaay.

neeyum un kumaaraththiga'lum seythathupoala, un sagoathariyaagiya soathoamum ava'ludaiya kumaaraththiga'lum seyyavillai en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.

ithoa, kervamum, aagaarath thiradchiyum, nirvisaaramaana saanggoabaanggamumaagiya ivaiga'lea un sagoathariyaana soathoamin akkiramam; ivaiga'lea ava'lidaththilum ava'l kumaaraththiga'lidaththilum irunthana; si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanudaiya kaiyai ava'l balappaduththavillai.
avarga'l thangga'lai uyarththi, en mugaththukku munbaaga aruvaruppaanathaich seythaarga'l; athai naan ka'ndapoathu, avarga'lai ozhiththuvittean.

nee seytha paavangga'lil araivaasiyum samaariyaa seyyavillai; nee un sagoathariga'laippaarkkilum un paavangga'laip perugappa'n'ni, nee seytha un ellaa aruvaruppuga'linaalum avarga'lai neethiyu'l'lavarga'len'ru vi'langgappa'n'ninaay.

ippoathum un sagoathariga'laik kut'ravaa'liga'l en'ru theerththa nee avarga'laippaarkkilum aruvaruppaagach seytha un paavangga'linimiththam un ilachchaiyaich sumanthuko'l; unnaippaarkkilum avarga'l neethiyu'l'lavarga'l; un sagoathariga'lai neethiyu'l'lavarga'len'ru vi'langgappa'n'nina nee vedkamadainthu, un ilachchaiyaich sumanthuko'l.

naan soathoamum ava'l kumaaraththiga'lum si'raiyirukki'ra avarga'ludaiya si'raiyiruppaiyum, samaariyaavum ava'l kumaaraththiga'lum si'raiyirukki'ra si'raiyiruppaiyum thiruppumpoathu, avarga'l naduvilea nee si'raiyirukki'ra unnudaiya si'raiyiruppaiyum thiruppuvean.
athinaal nee avarga'lukku aa'ruthalaaga irunthu, un ilachchaiyaich sumanthu, nee seytha ellaavat'rinaalum vedkamadaivaay.

un sagoathariga'laagiya soathoamum ava'l kumaaraththiga'lum thangga'l munthina seerukkuth thirumbuvaarga'l; samaariyaavum ava'l kumaaraththiga'lum thangga'l munthina seerukkuth thirumbuvaarga'l; neeyum un kumaaraththiga'lum ungga'l munthina seerukkuth thirumbuveerga'l.
unnai ve'rukkum seeriyaavin kumaaraththiga'lum, ava'laich sut'rilum irukki'ra pelistharin kumaaraththiga'lum avamaanampa'n'ninapoathu un pollaappu ve'liyaayit'rea.
atha'rkumun un kervaththin naa'lilea un sagoathariyaagiya soathoamin peyarai un vaayinaalea uchcharikkavumaattaay.
un mu'raikeattaiyum un aruvaruppuga'laiyum nee sumappaay en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththuppoadugi'rathinaal aa'naiyai asattaipa'n'nina nee seythathupoala naan unakkum seyvean.
aagilum un i'lavayathil unnoadea pa'n'nina en udanpadikkaiyai naan ninaiththu, niththiya udanpadikkaiyai unakku ea'rpaduththuvean.

appozhuthu un thamakkaiga'laiyum un thanggaiga'laiyum nee searththukko'l'lugaiyil, un vazhiga'lai ninaiththu naa'nuvaay; avarga'lai naan unakkuk kumaaraththiga'laagak koduppean; unnudaiya udanpadikkaiyaip paarththuk koduppathillai.
unnoadea en udanpadikkaiyaippa'n'ni ea'rpaduththuvean; appozhuthu naan karththar en'ru a'rivaay.

nee seytha ellaavat'raiyum naan manniththaru'lumpoathu, nee ninaiththu vedki, un naa'naththinaal un vaayai inith thi'rakkamaattaathiruppaay en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
manupuththiranea, nee israveal vamsaththaarukku oru vidukathaiyaiyum uvamaiyaiyum koo'ri, sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar, periya settaiga'laiyum nee'lamaana i'raguga'laiyum udaiyathum, palavaru'namaana i'raguga'laal ni'rainthathumaagiya oru periya kazhugu leebanoanil vanthu, oru keathuruvin nunikki'laiyaip pidiththu,
athin i'langki'laiyilu'l'la kozhunthuga'laikkoythu, athai varththaga theasaththukkuk ko'ndupoay, athai varththagarudaiya nagaraththilea vaiththathu;
theasaththin vithaiyil on'rai eduththu, athaip payirnilaththilea poattu, athai eduththu, miguntha tha'n'neer oaraththilea paththiramaay nattathu.

athu thu'lirththu, padarnthu, thaazhntha adimaramu'l'la thiraadchachsediyaayit'ru; athinkodiga'l anthak kazhugukku nearaagavum, athin vearga'l athin keezhaagavum irunthana; ivvithamaay athu thiraadchachsediyaagi, ki'laiga'lai veesi, koppuga'lai vittathu.

an'riyum periya settaiga'laiyum thira'laana i'raguga'laiyum udaiya vea'roru periya kazhugu irunthathu; ithoa, athu than nadavaagiya paaththiga'lilirunthu atha'rkuth tha'n'neer paaychchumpadi intha thiraadchachsedi atha'rku nearaagath than vearga'lai vittu, atha'rku nearaagath than kodiga'lai veesinathu.
koppuga'lai vidugi'ratha'rkum, kaniyaith tharugi'ratha'rkum, magimaiyaana thiraadchachsediyaagi'ratha'rkum, ithu miguntha tha'n'neerga'lin oaramaagiya nalla nilaththil nadappattirunthathu.

ithu sezhikkumaa? ithu pattuppoagaththakkathaay oruvan ithin vearga'laip pidunggaamalum, ithin kaniyai vettaamalum iruppaanoa? thu'lirththa ellaa ilaiga'loadum ithu pattuppoagum; ithai vearoadea pidunggumpadi oruvan balaththa puyaththoadum thira'nda janaththoadum varaththeavaiyillai.

ithoa, nadappatta ithu sezhippaayirukkumoa? ko'ndalkaat'ru ithinpearil padumpoathu ithu vaadi ularnthu poagaathoa? ithu nadappatta paaththiga'lilea vaadippoamen'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
pinbu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:

ippoathum ivaiga'lin thaa'rpariyam theriyumaa en'ru nee kalagaveettaaraikkeattuch sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, ithoa, baabiloan raajaa erusaleamukku vanthu, athin raajaavaiyum athin pirabukka'laiyum pidiththu, avarga'laith thannidamaagap baabiloanukkuk ko'ndupoagumpoathu,
avan raajavamsaththilea oruvanaith therintheduththu, avanoadea udanpadikkaipa'n'ni,

raajyam thannai uyarththaamal thaazhnthirukkumpadikkum, than udanpadikkaiyai avan kaikko'l'lugi'rathinaal athu nilaini'rkumpadikkum, avanai aa'naippiramaa'naththukku udpaduththi, theasaththil balasaaliga'laip pidiththuk ko'ndupoanaanea.

ivan avanukku viroathamaayk kalagagnseythu, thanakkuk kuthiraiga'laiyum aneagam aadka'laiyum anuppavea'ndumen'ru than sthaanaabathiga'lai egipthukku anuppinaan; ippadippattavanukku vaaykkumoa? ippadich seygi'ravan thappiththukko'lvaanoa? udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththavan thappiththukko'lvaanoa?

thannai raajaavaaga ea'rpaduththiya raajaavinudaiya aa'naiyai asattaipa'n'ni, avanudaiya udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththuppoattavan, antha raajaavinudaiya sthaanamaagiya baabiloan naduvilea avana'ndaiyil irunthu mara'namadaivaanen'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
avan aneagam janangga'lai naasampa'n'numpadi a'naipoattu, koththa'langga'laik kattumpoathu, paarvoan periya seanaiyoadum, thira'laana koottaththoadum vanthu ivanukkaaga yuththaththil uthavamaattaan.
ithoa, ivan kaiyadiththuk koduththirunthum udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththuppoattu, aa'naiyai asattaipa'n'ninaan; ippadiyellaam seythavan thappuvathillai.

athinimiththam karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: avan en aa'naiyai asattaipa'n'ninathaiyum, en udanpadikkaiyai mu'riththuppoattathaiyum, naan avanudaiya thalaiyinmeal varappa'n'nuvean en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean.

avan ennudaiya ka'n'niyil agappadumpadikku naan en valaiyai avanmeal veesi, avanaip baabiloanukkuk ko'ndupoay, avan enakku viroathamaayp pa'n'nina thuroagaththinimiththam anggea avanai niyaayam visaarippean.

avanoadeakooda oadippoagi'ra yaavarum avanudaiya ellaa iraa'nuvangga'lum pattayaththaal vizhuvaarga'l; meethiyaanavarga'loa sagala thisaiga'lilum sitha'radikkappaduvaarga'l; appozhuthu karththaraagiya naan ithaich sonnean en'ru a'rinthuko'lveerga'l.

karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: naan uyarntha keathuruvin nunikki'laiga'lil on'rai eduththu, athai naduvean; athin i'langki'laiyilu'l'la kozhunthuga'lil i'lasaayirukki'ra on'raik koythu, athai uyaramum unnathamumaana oru parvathaththinmeal naattuvean.

isravealin uyaramaana parvathaththilea athai naattuvean; athu koppuga'lai vittu, kanithanthu, magimaiyaana keathuruvaagum; athin keezhea sagalavitha padchijaathiga'lum thanggi, athin ki'laiga'lin nizhalilea thaabarikkum.

appadiyea karththaraagiya naan uyarntha virudchaththaith thaazhththi, thaazhntha virudchaththai uyarththinean en'rum, naan pachchaiyaana virudchaththaip pattuppoagappa'n'ni, pattuppoana virudchaththaith thazhaikkappa'n'ninean en'rum ve'liyin virudchangga'lukku ellaam theriyavarum; karththaraagiya naan ithaich sonnean, ithai ni'raiveat'rinean en'ru uraiththaar en'ru sol en'raar.
karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:
pithaakka'l thiraadchakkaayga'laith thin'raarga'l, pi'l'laiga'lin pa'rka'l koosippoayina ennum pazhamozhiyai neengga'l israveal theasaththaikku'riththuch sollugi'rathu enna?
ini isravealil inthap pazhamozhiyaich solvathu illai enbathai en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar.
ithoa, ellaa aaththumaakka'lum ennudaiyavaiga'l; thagappanin aaththumaa eppadiyoa, appadiyea maganin aaththumaavum ennudaiyathu; paavagnseygi'ra aaththumaavea saagum.
oruvan neethimaanaayirunthu, niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seythu,

malaiga'linmeal saappidaamalum, israveal vamsaththaarin naragalaana vikkiragangga'lukku nearaagath than ka'nga'lai ea'redukkaamalum, than ayalaanudaiya manaiviyaith theettuppaduththaamalum thoorasthireeyoadea searaamalum,

oruvanaiyum odukkaamalum, ko'l'laiyidaamalumirunthu, kadan vaangginavanukku adaimaanaththaith thirumbakkoduththu, than appaththaip pasiththavanukkup panggittu, vasthiramillaathavanukku vasthiram tharippiththu,
vattikkuk kodaamalum, polisai vaanggaamalum, aniyaayaththukkuth than kaiyai vilakki, manitharukku'l'la vazhakkai u'nmaiyaayth theerththu,
en katta'laiga'linpadi nadanthu, en niyaayangga'laik kaikko'ndu, u'nmaiyaayiruppaanaagil avanea neethimaan; avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
aanaalum avanukku oru kumaaran pi'ranthu, avan ka'l'lanum iraththagnsinthugi'ravanum, mea'rsolliya kadamaiga'linpadi nadavaamal,
ivaiga'lil on'rukkoppaanathaich seygi'ravanumaayirunthu, malaiga'linmeal saappittu, than ayalaanudaiya manaiviyaith theettuppaduththi,

si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaanavanai odukki, ko'l'laikkaaranaayirunthu, adaimaanaththaith thirumbak kodaamal, naragalaana vikkiragangga'lukku nearaagath than ka'nga'lai ea'reduththu, aruvaruppaanathaich seythu,
vattikkuk koduththu, polisai vaangginaal, avan pizhaippaanoa? avan pizhaippathillai; intha ellaa aruvaruppuga'laiyum seythaanea; avan saagavea saavaan; avan iraththappazhi avanmeal irukkum.
pinnum, ithoa, avanukku oru kumaaran pi'ranthu, avan than thagappan seytha ellaap paavangga'laiyum ka'ndu, thaan avaiga'linpadi seyyaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirunthu,
malaiga'linmeal saappidaamalum, israveal vamsaththaarin naragalaana vikkiragangga'lukku nearaagath than ka'nga'lai ea'redukkaamalum, than ayalaanudaiya manaiviyaith theettuppaduththaamalum,
oruvanaiyum odukkaamalum, adaimaanaththai vaiththukko'ndiraamalum, ko'l'laiyidaamalum, than appaththaip pasiththavanukkup panggittu, vasthiramillaathavanukku vasthirantharippiththu,

si'rumaiyaanavanukku noavu'ndaakkaathapadith than kaiyai vilakki, vattiyum polisaiyum vaanggaamalirunthu en niyaayangga'linpadi seythu, en katta'laiga'lil nadanthaal, avan than thagappanudaiya akkiramaththinimiththam saagaamal pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan.
avan thagappanoaven'raal kodumaiseythu, sagoatharanaik ko'l'laiyittu, thagaathathaith than janangga'lin naduvilea seythapadiyinaal, ithoa, avan than akkiramaththilea saavaan.

itheppadi, kumaaran thagappanudaiya akkiramaththaich sumakki'rathillaiyaa en'ru neengga'l keattaal, kumaaran niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seythu, en katta'laiga'laik kaikko'ndu, avaiga'linpadi seythathinaal, avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan.

paavagnseygi'ra aaththumaavea saagum; kumaaran thagappanudaiya akkiramaththaich sumappathumillai, thagappan kumaaranudaiya akkiramaththaich sumappathumillai; neethimaanudaiya neethi avanmealthaan irukkum, thunmaarkkanudaiya thunmaarkkamum avanmealthaan irukkum.

thunmaarkkan thaan seytha ellaap paavangga'laiyum vittuth thirumbi, en katta'laiga'laiyellaam kaikko'ndu, niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seyvaaneayaagil, avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan, avan saavathillai.
avan seytha ellaa mee'ruthalga'lum ninaikkappaduvathillai; avan thaan seytha neethiyilea pizhaippaan.
thunmaarkkan saagi'rathu enakku evva'laveanum piriyamoa? avan than vazhiga'lai vittuth thirumbip pizhaippathu allavoa enakkup piriyam en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.

neethimaan than neethiyaivittu vilagi, aneethi seythu, thunmaarkkan seygi'ra sagala aruvaruppuga'linpadiyum seyvaaneayaagil, avan pizhaippaanoa? avan seytha avanudaiya ellaa neethiga'lum ninaikkappaduvathillai; avan seytha than thuroagaththileayum avan seytha than paavaththileayum saavaan.

neengga'loa, aa'ndavarudaiya vazhi semmaiyaay irukkavillai engi'reerga'l; israveal vamsaththaarea, kea'lungga'l; en vazhi semmaiyaayiraathoa? ungga'l vazhiga'l allavoa semmaiyallaathathaayirukki'rathu.
neethimaan than neethiyaivittu vilagi, aneethiseythu athilea seththaal, avan seytha than aneethiyinimiththam avan saavaan.
thunmaarkkan thaan seytha thunmaarkkaththaivittu vilagi, niyaayaththaiyum neethiyaiyum seyvaaneayaagil, avan than aaththumaavaip pizhaikkappa'n'nuvaan.
avan echcharippadainthu, thaan seytha ellaa mee'ruthalga'laiyum vittuth thirumbugi'rapadiyinaalea avan pizhaikkavea pizhaippaan, avan saavathillai.

israveal vamsaththaaroa: aa'ndavarudaiya vazhi semmaiyaay irukkavillai engi'raarga'l; israveal vamsaththaarea, en vazhiga'l semmaiyaayiraathoa? ungga'l vazhiga'l allavoa semmaiyallaathathaayirukki'rathu.

aagaiyaal israveal vamsaththaarea, naan ungga'lil avanavanai avanavan vazhiga'lukkuth thakkathaaga niyaayantheerppean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar; neengga'l mananthirumbungga'l, ungga'ludaiya ellaa mee'ruthalga'laiyum vittuth thirumbungga'l; appozhuthu akkiramam ungga'l keattukkuk kaara'namaayiruppathillai.

neengga'l thuroagampa'n'nina ungga'ludaiya ellaath thuroagangga'laiyum ungga'lmeal iraathapadikku vilakki, ungga'lukkup puthu iruthayaththaiyum puthu aaviyaiyum u'ndupa'n'nikko'l'lungga'l; israveal vamsaththaarea, neengga'l ean saagavea'ndum?
mananthirumbungga'l, appozhuthu pizhaippeerga'l; saagi'ravanudaiya saavai naan virumbugi'rathillai en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar sollugi'raar.
nee israveal pirabukka'linpearil oru pulambal paadi,
sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal: un thaay eppadippattava'l? ava'l oru pe'nsinggam, ava'l singgangga'lukku'l'lea paduththirunthu, baalasinggangga'lin naduvilea than kuttiga'lai va'larththaa'l.
than kuttiga'lil on'ru va'larnthu, baalasinggamaagi, iraitheadap pazhagi, manusharaip padchiththathu.
pu'rajaathiga'lum athin seythiyaik keattaarga'l, athu avarga'ludaiya padukuzhiyil agappattathu; athaich sanggiliga'linaal katti, egipthutheasaththi'rkuk ko'ndupoanaarga'l.
thaaychsinggam kaaththirunthu, than nambikkai abaththamaayp poayit'ren'ru ka'ndu, athu than kuttiga'lil vea'ron'rai eduththu, athaip baalasinggamaaga vaiththathu.
athu singgangga'lukku'l'lea sagnchariththu, baalasinggamaagi, iraitheadap pazhagi, manusharaip padchiththathu.
avarga'ludaiya paazhaana aramanaiga'lil thirinthu, avarga'ludaiya patta'nangga'laip paazhaakkit'ru; athinudaiya kerchchippin saththaththukkuth theasamum athilu'l'la yaavum thigaiththathu.
appozhuthu sut'ruppu'raththu jaathiga'l atha'rku viroathamaaga ezhumbivanthu, thangga'l valaiyai athinmeal veesinaarga'l; athu avarga'ludaiya padukuzhiyilea agappattathu.

avarga'l athaich sanggiliga'linaal katti, oru koottukkudpaduththi, athaip baabiloan raajaavinidaththukkuk ko'ndupoanaarga'l; ini athin saththam isravealin parvathangga'linmeal keadkappadaathapadikku athai ara'naana idangga'lil ko'ndupoay adaiththaarga'l.
nee amarikkaiyoadu irukkaiyil un thaay tha'n'neer oaramaay naattappattathum, miguthiyaana neerppaaychchalaal kanitharugi'rathum thazhaiththirukki'rathumaana thiraadchachsediyaayirunthaa'l.

aa'lugi'ravarga'lin senggoalukkeat'ra balaththa koppuga'l atha'rku irunthathu; athin va'larththi adarththiyaana ki'laiga'lukku'l'lea uyara oanggi, than uyarththiyinaalea than thira'laana kodiga'loadungkoodath thoan'rit'ru.

aanaalum athu ukkiramaayp pidunggappattu, tharaiyilea tha'l'lu'ndathu; keezhkkaat'rinaal athin kani kaaynthupoayit'ru; athin balaththa koppuga'l mu'rinthu, pattuppoayina; akkini avaiga'laip padchiththathu.
ippozhuthu athu va'ra'ndathum tha'n'neer illaathathumaana vanaanthara boomiyilea nadappattirukki'rathu.

athin kodiga'lilu'l'la oru koppilirunthu akkini pu'rappattu, athin kaniyaip padchiththathu; aa'lugi'ra senggoalukkeat'ra balaththa koppu ini athil illaiyen'ru sol; ithuvea pulambal, ithuvea pulambalaayirukkum en'raar.
eazhaam varushaththu ainthaam maatham paththaantheathiyilea isravealin moopparil silar karththaridaththil visaarikkumpadivanthu, enakku munbaaga udkaarnthaarga'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya vaarththai enakku u'ndaagi, avar:

manupuththiranea, nee israveal moopparoadea peasi, avarga'lai noakki: karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, neengga'l ennidaththil visaarikka vantheerga'loa? neengga'l ennidaththil visaarikka idangkodean en'ru en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean en'ru karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'raar en'ru sol.
manupuththiranea, nee avarga'lukkaaga vazhakkaaduvaayoa? vazhakkaada manathaanaal, nee avarga'l pithaakka'lin aruvaruppuga'lai avarga'lukkuth theriyakkaatti, avarga'lai noakki:

karththaraagiya aa'ndavar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal, naan isravealaith therinthuko'nda naa'lilea yaakkoabu vamsaththu janangga'lukku naan aa'naiyittu, egipthutheasaththil ennai avarga'lukkuth theriyappaduththi, naan ungga'l theavanaagiya karththar en'ru aa'naiyittean.

naan avarga'lai egipthutheasaththilirunthu azhaippean en'rum, avarga'lukkaaga naan paarththuvaiththathum, paalum theanum oadugi'rathum ellaath theasangga'lin singgaaramumaana theasaththilea avarga'laik ko'nduvanthu viduvean en'rum annaa'lilea aa'naiyittu,

ungga'lil avaravar thangga'l ka'nga'laal noakkina aruvaruppuga'laith tha'l'livittu, egipthin naragalaana vikkiragangga'laal ungga'laith theettuppaduththaathiruppeerga'laaga; ungga'l theavanaagiya karththar naan en'ru avarga'loadea sonnean.

avarga'loa, en sollaik keadka manathillaamal enakku viroathamaay ira'ndagampa'n'ninaarga'l; avaravar thangga'l ka'nga'laal noakkina aruvaruppuga'laith tha'l'lippoadaamalum, egipthin naragalaana vikkiragangga'lai vidaamalum irunthaarga'l; aathalaal egipthu theasaththin naduvilea en koabaththai avarga'lilea theerththukko'l'lumpadikku en ukkiraththai avarga'lmeal oot'ruvean en'rean.

aagilum naan ennai ivarga'lukku ve'lippaduththi, ivarga'lukku munbaaga en naamam parisuththakkulaichchalaagaathapadikku, ivarga'lai egipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, en naamaththinimiththam kirubaiseythean.
aagaiyaal naan avarga'lai egipthutheasaththilirunthu pu'rappadappa'n'ni, avarga'lai vanaantharaththil azhaiththuvanthu,
en katta'laiga'lai avarga'lukkuk koduththu, en niyaayangga'lai avarga'lukkuth theriyappaduththinean; avaiga'linpadi seygi'ra manushan avaiga'laal pizhaippaan.
naan thangga'laip parisuththampa'n'nugi'ra karththar en'ru avarga'l a'riyumpadikku, enakkum avarga'lukkum adaiyaa'lamaay iruppatha'rkaana en oayvunaadka'laiyum avarga'lukkuk katta'laiyittean.

aanaalum israveal vamsaththaar vanaantharaththil enakku viroathamaay ira'ndagampa'n'ninaarga'l; en katta'laiga'linpadiyea manushan seythaal avaiga'laal pizhaippaan; avarga'loa avaiga'lil nadavaamal, en niyaayangga'lai ve'ruththu, en oayvunaadka'lin parisuththaththai migavum kulaiththuppoattaarga'l; aathalaal avarga'lai nirmoolamaakkumpadi vanaantharaththilea en ukkiraththai avarga'lmeal oot'ruvean en'rean.
aagilum naan ivarga'laip pu'rappadappa'n'ninathaik ka'nda pu'rajaathiga'ludaiya ka'nga'lukku munbaaga en naamam parisuththakkulaichchalaagaathapadikku, en naamaththinimiththam kirubaiseythean.

aanaalum avarga'ludaiya iruthayam avarga'ludaiya naragalaana vikkiragangga'laip pinpat'ri, avarga'l en niyaayangga'lai ve'ruththu, en katta'laiga'lil nadavaama'rpoay, en oayvunaadka'laip parisuththakkulaichchalaakkinapadiyaal,

naan vaakkuththaththampa'n'ninathum, paalum theanum oadugi'rathum, ellaa theasangga'lin singgaaramaayirukki'rathumaana theasaththilea avarga'laik ko'nduvanthu viduvathillai en'ru vanaantharaththil aa'naiyittean.
aagilum avarga'lai azhikkaathapadikku, en ka'n avarga'laith thappavittathu; naan avarga'lai vanaantharaththil nirmoolamaakkavillai.

vanaantharaththil avarga'ludaiya pi'l'laiga'lai noakki: neengga'l ungga'l pithaakka'lin mu'raimaiga'lil nadavaamalum avarga'ludaiya niyaayangga'laik kaikko'l'laamalum, avarga'ludaiya naragalaana vikkiragangga'laal ungga'laith theettuppaduththaamalum irungga'l.
