appozhuthu avarga'l karththarudaiya vasanaththaith theada oru samuththiranthodanggi ma'ru samuththiramattum, vadathisaithodanggik keezhththisaimattum alainthu thirinthum athaik ka'ndadaiyaama'r poavaarga'l.
annaa'lilea saunthariyamu'l'la kannigaiga'lum vaalibarum thaagaththinaal soarnthupoavaarga'l.

thaa'nea! un theavanudaiya jeevanaikko'ndum, beyersebaa maarkkaththin theavanudaiya jeevanaikko'ndum en'ru solli, samaariyaavin thoashaththinmeal aa'naiyidugi'ravarga'l vizhuvaarga'l; ini orupoathum ezhunthirukkamaattaarga'l en'raar.

aa'ndavaraip balipeedaththinmeal ni'rkakka'ndean; avar: nee vaasal nilaiga'l asaiyumpadi poathigaiyai adiththu, avaiga'lai avarga'l ellaarudaiya thalaiyinmealum vizha udaiththuppoadu; avarga'lukkup pinnaagavarum meethiyaanavarga'lai naan pattayaththinaal kon'rupoaduvean; avarga'lil oadugi'ravan oruvanum thappuvathumillai, avarga'lil thappugi'ravan oruvanum iradchikkappaduvathumillai.

avarga'l paathaa'lapariyantham thoa'ndip pathunggikko'ndaalum, en kai avvidaththilirunthu avarga'laip pidiththukko'nduvarum; avarga'l vaanapariyantham ea'rinaalum, avvidaththilumirunthu avarga'lai i'ranggappa'n'nuvean;

avarga'l karmealin kodumudiyilea o'liththukko'ndaalum, anggea avarga'laith theadippidippean; avarga'l samuththiraththin aazhaththilea poay en ka'nga'lukku ma'rainthuko'ndaalum, anggea avarga'laik kadikkap paambuga'lukkuk katta'laiyiduvean.

avarga'l thangga'l saththuruvukku munbaagach si'raippattuppoanaalum, anggea avarga'laik kon'rupoadap pattayaththukku naan katta'laiyittu, en ka'nga'lai avarga'lmeal nanmaikkalla, theemaikken'rea vaippean.

seanaiga'lin karththaraagiya aa'ndavar theasaththaith thoda, athu urugippoam; appozhuthu athin kudiga'lellaarum pulambuvaarga'l; enggum nathiyaayp pura'ndoadi, egipthinudaiya aat'ru ve'l'laththaippoal ve'l'lamaagum.

avar vaanaththil thamathu meala'raiga'laik katti, boomiyil thamathu keezha'raiga'lai asthibaarappaduththi, samuththiraththin tha'n'neerga'lai varavazhaiththu, avaiga'laip boomiyinudaiya visaalaththinmeal oot'rugi'ravar; karththar enbathu avarudaiya naamam.

israveal puththirarea, neengga'l enakku eththiyoappiyarin puththiraraippoal irukki'reerga'l allavoa en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; naan isravealai egipthutheasaththilirunthum, pelistharaik kapthoarilirunthum, seeriyaraik keerilirunthum ko'nduvaravillaiyoa?

ithoa, karththaraagiya aa'ndavarin ka'nga'l paavamu'l'la raajyaththukku viroathamaaga vaikkappattirukki'rathu; athaip boomiyinmeal iraathapadikku azhiththuppoaduvean; aagilum yaakkoabin vamsaththai muzhuvathum azhikkamaattean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.

ithoa, jalladaiyinaal saliththarikki'rathupoal israveal vamsaththaarai ellaa jaathiga'lukku'l'lum saliththarikkumpadikku naan katta'laiyiduvean; aanaalum oru koathumaima'niyum tharaiyilea vizhuvathillai.
theenggu engga'lai a'nuguvathumillai, engga'lukku neariduvathumillaiyen'ru en janaththil sollugi'ra paaviga'lellaarum pattayaththinaal saavaarga'l.
eathoamil meethiyaanavarga'laiyum, en naamam vi'langgiya sagala jaathiga'laiyum vasamaakkikko'l'lumpadikku,

annaa'lilea vizhunthupoana thaaveethin koodaaraththai naan thirumba eduppiththu, athin thi'rappuga'lai adaiththu, athil pazhuthaayppoanathaich seerppaduththi, poorvanaadka'lil irunthathupoala athai sthaabippean en'ru ithaich seygi'ra karththar sollugi'raar.

ithoa, uzhugi'ravan a'rukki'ravanaiyum, thiraadchappazhangga'lai aalaiyaadugi'ravan vithaikki'ravanaiyum thodarnthupidiththu, parvathangga'l thiraadcharasamaay vadigi'rathum, meaduga'lellaam karaigi'rathumaana naadka'l varum en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.

en janamaagiya isravealin si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvean; avarga'l paazhaana nagarangga'laik katti, avaiga'lil kudiyirunthu, thiraadchaththoattangga'lai naatti, avaiga'ludaiya pazharasaththaik kudiththu, thoattangga'lai u'ndaakki, avaiga'lin kaniga'laip pusippaarga'l.
avarga'lai avarga'l theasaththilea naattuvean; naan avarga'lukkuk koduththa theasaththilirunthu avarga'l inip pidunggappaduvathillaiyen'ru un theavanaagiya karththar sollugi'raar en'raar.

obathiyaavin tharisanam; karththaraagiya aa'ndavar eathoamaik ku'riththuch sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: ezhumbungga'l, atha'rku viroathamaaga yuththampa'n'na ezhumbuvoam vaarungga'l en'ru a'rivikka sthaanaabathi jaathiga'lidaththil anuppappadum seythiyaik karththar sollakkeattoam.
ithoa, naan unnai jaathiga'lil si'rugappa'n'ninean; nee meththavum asattaipa'n'nappattirukki'raay.

kanmalai vedippuga'laagiya un uyarntha sthaanaththilea kudiyirunthu, ennaith tharaiyilea vizhaththa'l'lugi'ravan yaar en'ru un iruthayaththil sollugi'ravanea, un iruthayaththin aganthai unnai moasampoakkugi'rathu.
nee kazhugaippoala uyarappoanaalum, nee nadchaththirangga'lukku'l'lea un koottaik kattinaalum, avvidaththilirunthum unnai vizhaththa'l'luvean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.

nee evva'lavaaych sanggarippattuppoanaay! thirudaraagilum iraaththiriyil ko'l'laiyadikki'ravarga'laagilum unnidaththil vanthaal, thangga'lukkup poathumaanamattum thiruduvaarga'l allavoa? thiraadchappazhangga'lai a'rukki'ravarga'l unnidaththil vanthaal, sila pazhangga'lai vittuviduvaarga'l allavoa?
easaavinudaiyavaiga'l evva'lavaayth theadippaarkkappattathu; avanudaiya antharanggap pokkishangga'l evva'lavaay aaraayntheduththuk ko'l'lappattathu.

unnoadu udanpadikkai seytha ellaa manusharum unnai ellaimattum thuraththivittaarga'l; unnoadu samaathaanamaayiruntha manushar unnai moasampoakki, unnai mea'rko'ndaarga'l; un appaththaich saappittavarga'l unakkuk keezhea ka'n'nivaiththaarga'l. avanukku u'narvillai.
annaa'lil allavoa naan eathoamilu'l'la gnaaniga'laiyum, easaavin parvathaththilu'l'la buththimaanga'laiyum azhippean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
theamaanea, easaavin parvathaththilu'l'la manushar yaavarum kolaiyinaal sanggarikkappadumpadi un baraakkiramasaaliga'l kalangguvaarga'l.
nee un sagoatharanaagiya yaakkoabukkuch seytha kodumaiyinimiththam vedkam unnai moodum; nee mut'rilum sanggarikkappattuppoavaay.

nee ethirththunin'ra naa'lilum, anniyar avan seanaiyaich si'raipidiththuppoana naa'lilum, ma'rutheasaththaar avan vaasalga'lukku'l piraveasiththu erusaleaminpearil seettuppoatta kaalaththil, neeyum avarga'lil oruvanaippoal irunthaay.

un sagoatharan anniyarvasamaana naa'laagiya avanudaiya naa'lai nee piriyaththoadea paaraamalum, yoothaa puththirarudaiya azhivin naa'lilea avarga'l nimiththam santhoashappadaamalum, avarga'l nerukkappadugi'ra naa'lilea nee perumaiyaayp peasaamalum irukka vea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.

en janaththin aabaththunaa'lilea nee avarga'l vaasalga'lukku'l piraveasiyaamalum, avarga'l aabaththunaa'lilea avarga'l anubavikki'ra theenggai nee piriyaththoadea paaraamalum, avarga'l aabaththunaa'lilea avarga'l aasthiyil kaipoadaamalum,
avarga'lil thappinavarga'laich sanggarikkumpadi vazhichsanthiga'lilea ni'rkaamalum, ikkattu naa'lil avarga'lil meethiyaanavarga'laik kaattikkodaamalum irukkavea'ndiyathaayirunthathu.
ellaa jaathiga'lukkum viroathamaana naa'laagiya karththarudaiya naa'l sameebamaay vanthirukki'rathu; nee seythapadiyea unakkum seyyappadum; un seygaiyin palan un thalaiyinmeal thirumbum.

neengga'l en parisuththa parvathaththinmeal mathubaanampa'n'ninapadiyea ellaa jaathiga'lum eppozhuthum mathubaanampa'n'nuvaarga'l; avarga'l kudiththu vizhungguvaarga'l, iraathavarga'laippoal iruppaarga'l.
aanaalum seeyoan parvathaththilea thappiyiruppaar u'ndu, avarga'l parisuththamaayiruppaarga'l; yaakkoabin vamsaththaar thangga'ludaiya suthantharangga'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l.

yaakkoabu vamsaththaar akkiniyum, yoaseappu vamsaththaar akkinijuvaalaiyumaayiruppaarga'l; easaa vamsaththaaroa vaikkoal thurumbaayiruppaarga'l; avarga'l ivarga'laik ko'luththi, easaavin vamsaththil meethiyiraathapadi ivarga'laip padchippaarga'l; karththar ithaich sonnaar.

thentheasaththaar easaavin malaiyaiyum, samanaana theasaththaar pelistharin theasaththaiyum suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l; avarga'l eppiraayeemin naattaiyum, samaariyaavin naattaiyum suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l; benyameen manushar keeleayaaththaiyum suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l.

sarpaathmattum kaanaaniyarukku'l'lea si'raippattuppoana israveal puththiraraagiya inthach seanaiyum, seappaaraaththil si'raippattuppoana erusaleam nagaraththaarum thenthisaip patta'nangga'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l.
easaavin parvathaththai niyaayantheerppatha'rkaaga iradchagarga'l seeyoan parvathaththil vanthea'ruvaarga'l; appozhuthu raajyam karththarudaiyathaay irukkum.
amiththaayin kumaaranaagiya yoanaavukkuk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaagi, avar:
nee ezhunthu mahaa nagaramaagiya niniveakkup poay, atha'rku viroathamaagap pirasanggi; avarga'ludaiya akkiramam en samugaththil vanthu ettinathu en'raar.

appozhuthu yoanaa karththarudaiya samugaththinin'ru vilagi, tharsheesukku oadippoagumpadi ezhunthu, yoappaavukkup poay, tharsheesukkup poagi'ra oru kappalaikka'ndu, kooli koduththu, thaan karththarudaiya samugaththinin'ru vilagumpadi, avarga'loadea tharsheesukkup poagak kappal ea'rinaan.
karththar samuththiraththinmeal perungkaat'rai varavittaar; athinaal kadalilea kappal udaiyumen'ru ninaikkaththakka periya kontha'lippu u'ndaayit'ru.

appozhuthu kappa'rkaarar bayanthu, avanavan thanthan theavanai noakki vea'nduthalseythu, baaraththai leasaakkumpadik kappalil iruntha sarakkuga'laich samuththiraththil e'rinthuvittaarga'l; yoanaavoaven'raal kappalin keezhththattil i'ranggipoayp paduththukko'ndu, ayarntha niththiraipa'n'ninaan.

appozhuthu maalumi avanidaththil vanthu: nee niththiraipa'n'nugi'rathu enna? ezhunthirunthu un theavanai noakki vea'ndikko'l; naam azhinthupoagaathapadikkuch suvaami oruvea'lai nammai ninaiththaru'luvaar en'raan.

avarga'l yaarnimiththam intha aabaththu namakku nearittathen'ru naam a'riyumpadikkuch seettuppoaduvoam vaarungga'l en'ru oruvaroadoruvar sollikko'ndu seettuppoattaarga'l; yoanaavin pearukkuch seettu vizhunthathu.

appozhuthu avarga'l avanai noakki: yaarnimiththam intha aabaththu namakku nearittathen'ru nee engga'lukkuch sollavea'ndum; un thozhilenna? nee enggeayirunthu varugi'raay? un theasam ethu? nee enna jaathiyaan en'ru keattaarga'l.
atha'rku avan: naan ebireyan; samuththiraththaiyum boomiyaiyum u'ndaakkina paraloagaththin theavanaagiya karththar idaththil bayabakthiyu'l'lavan en'raan.
avan karththarudaiya samugaththinin'ru vilagi oadippoagi'ravan en'ru thangga'lukku a'riviththathinaal, antha manushar migavum bayanthu, avanai noakki: nee ean ithaich seythaay en'raarga'l.
pinnum samuththiram athigamaayk kontha'liththukko'ndirunthapadiyaal, avarga'l avanai noakki: samuththiram namakku amarumpadi naangga'l unakku enna seyyavea'ndum en'ru keattaarga'l.

atha'rku avan: neengga'l ennai eduththuch samuththiraththilea poattuvidungga'l; appozhuthu samuththiram ungga'lukku amarnthirukkum; ennimiththam inthap periya kontha'lippu ungga'lmeal vanthathenbathai naan a'rivean en'raan.
antha manushar karaisearumpadi veagamaayth tha'nduvaliththaarga'l; aanaalum samuththiram vegu mummuramaayk kontha'liththukko'ndeayirunthapadiyaal avarga'laal koodaama'rpoayit'ru.

appozhuthu avarga'l karththarai noakkik kooppittu: aa karththaavea, intha manushanudaiya jeevanimiththam engga'lai azhiththuppoadaatheayum; kut'ramillaatha iraththappazhiyai engga'lmeal sumaththaatheayum; theavareer karththar; umakkuch siththamaayirukki'rapadi seygi'reer en'ru solli,
yoanaavai eduththuch samuththiraththilea poattuvittaarga'l; samuththiram than mummuraththaivittu amarnthathu.
appozhuthu antha manushar karththarukku migavum bayanthu, karththarukkup baliyittup poruththanaiga'laip pa'n'ninaarga'l.
yoanaavai vizhunggumpadi oru periya meenaik karththar aayaththappaduththiyirunthaar; antha meen vayit'rilea yoanaa iraappagal moon'runaa'l irunthaan.
antha meenin vayit'rilirunthu, yoanaa than theavanaagiya karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ni:
en nerukkaththil naan karththarai noakkik kooppittean; avar enakku uththaravu aru'linaar; naan paathaa'laththin vayit'rilirunthu kookkuralittean, neer en saththaththaik keatteer.
samuththiraththin nadumaiyamaagiya aazhaththilea neer ennaith tha'l'livitteer; neeroattam ennaich soozhnthuko'ndathu; ummudaiya ve'l'langga'lum alaiga'lum ellaam enmeal pura'ndathu.
naan umathu ka'nga'lukku ethirea iraathapadikkuth tha'l'lappattean; aagilum innamum ummudaiya parisuththa aalayaththai noakkuvean en'rean.
tha'n'neerga'l piraa'napariyantham ennai nerukkinathu; aazhi ennaich soozhnthathu; kada'rpaasi en thalaiyaich sut'rikko'ndathu.

parvathangga'lin adivaarangga'l pariyanthamum i'rangginean; boomiyin thaazhppaa'lga'l en'ren'raikkum ennai adaikki'rathaayirunthathu; aanaalum en theavanaagiya karththaavea, neer en piraa'nanai azhivukkuth thappuviththeer.
en aaththumaa ennil thoynthupoagaiyil karththarai ninaiththean; appozhuthu en vi'n'nappam umathu parisuththa aalayaththilea ummidaththil vanthu searnthathu.
poyyaana maayaiyaip pat'rikko'l'lugi'ravarga'l thangga'lukku varum kirubaiyaip poakkadikki'raarga'l.
naanoavenil thuthiyin saththaththoadea umakkup baliyiduvean; naan pa'n'nina poruththanaiyaich seluththuvean; iradchippu karththarudaiyathu en'raan.
karththar meenukkuk katta'laiyittaar, athu yoanaavaik karaiyilea kakkivittathu.
ira'ndaantharam karththarudaiya vaarththai yoanaavukku u'ndaagi, avar:
nee ezhunthu mahaa nagaramaagiya niniveakkup poay, naan unakkuk ka'rpikkum vaarththaiyai atha'rku viroathamaayp pirasanggi en'raar.
yoanaa ezhunthu, karththarudaiya vaarththaiyinpadiyea niniveakkup poanaan; ninivea moon'runaa'l pirayaa'na visthaaramaana mahaa periya nagaramaayirunthathu.
yoanaa nagaraththil piraveasiththu, orunaa'l pirayaa'nampa'n'ni: innum naa'rpathunaa'l u'ndu, appozhuthu ninivea kavizhkkappattuppoam en'ru koo'rinaan.
appozhuthu niniveayilu'l'la janangga'l theavanai visuvaasiththu, ubavaasagnseyyumpadik koo'rinaarga'l; periyoarmuthal si'riyoarmattum irattuduththikko'ndaarga'l.
inthach seythi niniveayin raajaavukku ettinapoathu, avan than singgaasanaththaivittu ezhunthu, thaan uduththiyiruntha uduppaik kazhat'rippoattu, irattai uduththikko'ndu, saambalilea udkaarnthaan.

mealum raajaa, thaanum than pirathaaniga'lum nir'nayampa'n'nina katta'laiyaaga, niniveayilenggum manusharum mirugangga'lum, maaduga'lum aaduga'lum on'rum rusipaaraathirukkavum, meayaamalum tha'n'neer kudiyaamalum irukkavum,

manusharum mirugangga'lum irattinaal moodikko'ndu, theavanai noakki uraththa saththamaayk kooppidavum, avaravar thamtham pollaatha vazhiyaiyum thamtham kaiga'lilu'l'la kodumaiyaiyum vittuth thirumbavungkadavarga'l.
yaarukkuth theriyum; naam azhinthu poagaathapadikku oruvea'lai theavan manasthaabappattu, thammudaiya ukkira koabaththaivittuth thirumbinaalum thirumbuvaar en'ru koo'rachsonnaan.

avarga'l thangga'l pollaatha vazhiyaivittuth thirumbinaarga'len'ru theavan avarga'ludaiya kiriyaiga'laip paarththu, thaam avarga'lukkuch seyvean en'ru solliyiruntha theenggaik ku'riththu manasthaabappattu, athaich seyyaathirunthaar.
yoanaavukku ithu migavum visanamaayirunthathu; avan kadungkoabangko'ndu,

karththarai noakki vi'n'nappampa'n'ni: aa karththaavea, naan en theasaththil irukkumpoathea naan ithaich sollavillaiyaa? ithinimiththamea naan munnamea tharsheesukku oadippoanean; neer irakkamum mana urukkamum neediya saanthamum miguntha kirubaiyumu'l'lavarum, theenggukku manasthaabappadugi'ravarumaana theavanen'ru a'rivean.
ippoathum karththaavea, en piraa'nanai ennaivittu eduththukko'l'lum; naan uyiroadirukki'rathaippaarkkilum saagi'rathu nalamaayirukkum en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar: nee erichchalaayirukki'rathu nallathoa en'raar.

pinbu yoanaa nagaraththilirunthu pu'rappattu, nagaraththukkuk kizhakkeapoay, anggea thanakku oru kudisaiyaip poattu, nagaraththukkuch sambavikkappoagi'rathaith thaan paarkkumattum athin keezh nizhalil udkaarnthirunthaan.

yoanaavudaiya thalaiyinmeal nizhalu'ndaayirukkavum, avanai avanudaiya manamadivukku neenggalaakkavum theavanaagiya karththar oru aama'nakkuch sediyai mu'laikkak katta'laiyittu, athai avanmeal oanggi va'larappa'n'ninaar; antha aama'nakkinmeal yoanaa migavum santhoashappattaan.
ma'runaa'liloa kizhakku ve'lukkum nearaththil theavan oru poochchiyaik katta'laiyittaar; athu aama'nakkuch sediyai ariththuppoattathu; athinaal athu kaaynthupoayit'ru.

sooriyan uthiththapoathu theavan ush'namaana keezhkkaat'raik katta'laiyittaar; appozhuthu veyil yoanaavudaiya thalaiyil padugi'rathinaal avan soarnthupoay, thanakku'l'lea saavai virumbi: naan uyiroadirukki'rathaippaarkkilum saagi'rathu nalamaayirukkum en'raan.
appozhuthu theavan yoanaavai noakki: nee aama'nakkinimiththam erichchalaayirukki'rathu nallathoa en'raar; atha'rku avan: naan mara'napariyanthamum erichchalaayirukki'rathu nallathuthaan en'raan.
atha'rkuk karththar: nee pirayaasappadaathathum, nee va'larkkaathathum, oru iraaththiriyilea mu'laiththathum, oru iraaththiriyilea azhinthupoanathumaana aama'nakkukkaagap parithabikki'raayea.

valathukaikkum idathukaikkum viththiyaasam a'riyaatha iladchaththu irubathinaayirampearukku athigamaana manusharum aneaga mirugajeevanga'lum irukki'ra mahaa nagaramaagiya niniveakkaaga naan parithabiyaamaliruppeanoa en'raar.

yoathaam, aagaas, eseakkiyaa ennum yoothaa raajaakka'ludaiya naadka'lil, moreasaa ooraanaagiya meegaavukku u'ndaanathum, avan samaariyaavukkum erusaleamukkum viroathamaayth tharisiththathumaana karththarudaiya vaarththai.

sagala janangga'lea, kea'lungga'l; boomiyea, athilu'l'lavaiga'lea, sevikodungga'l; karththaraagiya aa'ndavar, thammudaiya parisuththa aalayaththilirukki'ra aa'ndavarea, ungga'lukku viroathamaagach saadchiyaayiruppaar.
ithoa, karththar thamathu sthaanaththilirunthu pu'rappattu varugi'raar; avar i'ranggip boomiyin uyarntha idangga'lai mithippaar.
mezhugu akkinikku munbaaga urugugi'rathupoalavum, malaiga'lilirunthu paayun tha'n'neer tharaiyaip pi'lakki'rathupoalavum, parvathangga'l avar keezhea urugi, pa'l'laththaakkuga'l pi'lanthupoagum.

ithu ellaam yaakkoabudaiya mee'ruthalinimiththamum, israveal vamsaththaarudaiya paavangga'linimiththamum sambavikkum; yaakkoabin mee'ruthalukkuk kaara'namenna? samaariyaa allavoa? yoothaavin meadaiga'lukkuk kaara'namenna? erusaleam allavoa?

aagaiyaal naan samaariyaavai ve'liyaana ma'nmeadum, thiraadchachsedi nadugi'ra nilamumaakki, athin ka'rka'laip pa'l'laththaakkilea pura'ndu vizhappa'n'ni, athin asthibaarangga'laith thi'ranthuvaippean.

athin suroobangga'l ellaam no'rukkappadum; athin pa'naiyangga'l ellaam akkiniyaal eriththuppoadappadum; athin vikkiragangga'lai ellaam paazhaakkuvean; veasippa'naiyaththinaal searkkappattathu, thirumba veasippa'naiyamaayp poagum.
ithinimiththam naan pulambi ala'ruvean; pa'rikoduththavanaagavum amma'namaagavum nadappean; naan oariga'laippoala oo'laiyittu, aanthaiga'laippoala ala'ruvean.
athin kaayam aa'raathathu; athu yoothaamattum vanthathu; en janaththin vaasalaagiya erusaleammattum vanthettinathu.
athaik kaathpatta'naththilea a'riviyaatheayungga'l, azhavea vea'ndaam; bethapraavilea puzhuthiyil pura'lu.
saappeeril kudiyirukki'rava'lea, vedkaththudan amma'namaay appaalea poa; saayanaanil kudiyirukki'rava'l ve'liyea varuvathillai; betheasealin pulambal ungga'lukku adaikkalamaayiraathu.
maaroaththil kudiyirukki'rava'l nanmai varumen'ru ethirpaarththirunthaa'l; aanaalum theemai karththaridaththilirunthu erusaleamin vaasalvaraikkum vanthathu.
laageesil kudiyirukki'rava'lea, veagamaana kuthiraiga'lai irathaththilea poottu; neeyea seeyoan kumaaraththiyin paavaththukkuk kaara'ni; unnidaththil isravealin paathagangga'l kaa'nappattathu.
aagaiyaal moarsheathkaaththinidaththil unakku irukki'rathaik koduththuviduvaay; akseebin veeduga'l isravealin raajaakka'lukku abaththamaayppoagum.
mareashaavil kudiyirukki'rava'lea, unakku innum oru suthantharavaa'liyai varappa'n'nuvean; avan isravealin magimaiyaagiya athullaammattum varuvaan.
unakku arumaiyaana un pi'l'laiga'linimiththam nee un thalaiyaich siraiththu mottaiyittukko'l; kazhugaippoala muzhumottaiyaayiru, avarga'l unnaivittuch si'raippattuppoagi'raarga'l.
akkiramaththai yoasiththu, thangga'l padukkaiga'linmeal pollaappu seyya eththanampa'n'nith thangga'l kaiyil vallamai irukki'rapadiyinaal, vidiya'rkaalamaagi'rapoathu athai nadappiththu,
vayalga'lai ichchiththup pa'riththukko'ndu, veeduga'lai ichchiththu eduththukko'ndu, purushanaiyum avan veettaiyum, manushanaiyum avan suthantharaththaiyum odukkugi'ravarga'lukku aiyoa!

aagaiyaal karththar: naan intha vamsaththaarukku viroathamaayth theemaiyai varuvikka ninaikki'rean; athinin'ru neengga'l kazhuththai neekkamaatteerga'l; neengga'l meattimaiyaay nadappathillai; athu theemaiyaana kaalam.

annaa'lil ungga'lpearil oppuchsolli, naam mut'rilum paazhaanoam; namathu janaththin suthantharaththai maat'rippoattaar; ennamaay athai ennaivittu neekkippoattaar! namathu vayalga'laip pidunggip pagirnthukoduththaarea en'ru thuyaramaana pulambalaayp pulambuvaarga'l.
karththarin sabaiyil suthanthara veethangga'lai a'lanthukodukki'ravarga'l unakku illaathiruppaarga'l.
theerkkatharisanagn sollaathiruppeerga'laaga engi'raarga'l; avarga'l theerkkatharisanagn solluvaarga'l, inthappiragaaramaay avarga'l theerkkatharisanagn sollaavittaal ninthai neenggaathea.
yaakkoabu vamsam en'ru pearpet'ravarga'lea, karththarin aavi ku'rugiyirukki'rathoa? avarudaiya kiriyaiga'l ivaiga'lthaanoa? semmaiyaay nadakki'ravanukku en vaarththaiga'l nanmai seyyaathoa?

en janangga'l poorvamuthal saththuruvaippoal ezhumbinaarga'l. yuththaththilirunthu thirumbivanthu vazhiyil agnchaamal kadanthupoagi'ravarga'ludaiya mealanggiyaiyum vasthiraththaiyum urinthuko'ndeerga'l.

en janaththin sthireega'lai avarga'ludaiya saukkiyamaana veeduga'lilirunthu thuraththivitteerga'l; avarga'ludaiya kuzhanthaiga'lukku iruntha en alanggaaraththai en'raikkum illaathapadikkup pa'riththukko'ndeerga'l.
ezhunthirunthu poangga'l; ithu neengga'l i'laippaa'rum idam alla, ithu theettuppattathu, ithu ungga'lai naasappaduththum, antha naasam migavum kodiyathaayirukkum.

manampoagi'ra poakkinpadipoay, abaththamaanathai uraikki'ra oruvan, thiraadcharasaththaiyum mathubaanaththaiyungku'riththu naan unakkup pirasanggippeanen'raal, avanea intha janaththi'rku eat'ra pirasanggiyaayiruppaan.

yaakkoabin janangga'lea, ungga'lellaaraiyum naan nichchayamaayk koottuvean, isravealil meethiyaanavarga'lai nichchayamaaych searppean; boas'raavin aaduga'laippoal avarga'lai eagakkoottamaakkuvean; than thozhuvaththukku'l'lea searntha manthaikkuch samaanamaay janaththira'linaalea iraichchal u'ndaagum.

thadaiga'lai neekkippoadugi'ravar avarga'lukku munbaaga nadanthupoagi'raar; avarga'l thadaiga'lai neekki, vaasalaal udpiraveasiththuk kadanthupoavaarga'l; avarga'l raajaa avarga'lukku munbaagap poavaar, karththar avarga'l munna'niyil nadanthupoavaar.
naan sonnathu: yaakkoabin thalaivarga'lea, israveal vamsaththu athibathiga'lea, niyaayam innathen'ru a'rivathu ungga'lukku allavoa aduththathu.
aanaalum nanmaiyai ve'ruththu, theemaiyai virumbi, avarga'lmeal irukki'ra avarga'ludaiya thoalaiyum avarga'l elumbuga'lmeal irukki'ra avarga'ludaiya sathaiyaiyum pidunggi,

en janaththin sathaiyaith thin'ru, avarga'lmeal irukki'ra avarga'ludaiya thoalai urinthuko'ndu, avarga'l elumbuga'lai mu'riththu, paanaiyilea poadumva'n'namaagavum i'raichchiyaik kopparaikku'l'lea poadumva'n'namaagavum avaiga'laith thu'ndikki'raarga'l.

appozhuthu avarga'l karththarai noakkik kooppiduvaarga'l; aanaalum avarga'l thangga'l kiriyaiga'lil pollaathavarga'laanapadiyinaal, avar avarga'lukku ma'ruuththaravu kodaamal, thamathu mugaththai akkaalaththilea avarga'lukku ma'raiththukko'l'luvaar.

thangga'l pa'rka'linaal kadikki'ravarga'laayirunthu, samaathaanamen'ru solli, thangga'l vaaykku u'navaik kodaathavanukku viroathamaagach sa'ndaikku aayaththampa'n'ni, en janaththai moasampoakkugi'ra theerkkatharisiga'lukku viroathamaayk karththar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal:
tharisanangkaa'nakkoodaatha iraaththiriyum, ku'risollakkoodaatha anthagaaramum ungga'lukku varum; theerkkatharisiga'linmeal sooriyan asthamiththu, avarga'lmeal pagal kaariru'laayp poagum.
tharisanam paarkki'ravarga'l vedki, ku'risollugi'ravarga'l naa'ni, uththaravukodukki'ra theavan illaathathinaal avarga'l ellaarum thangga'l vaayai mooduvaarga'l.

naanoa, yaakkoabukku avan mee'ruthalaiyum, isravealukku avan paavaththaiyum a'rivikkumpadi, karththarudaiya aavi aru'liya balaththinaalum, niyaayaththinaalum, baraakkiramaththinaalum nirappappattirukki'rean.
niyaayaththai aruvaruththu, semmaiyaanavaiga'laiyellaam koa'nalaakki,
seeyoanai iraththappazhiyinaalum, erusaleamai aniyaayaththinaalum kattuvikki'ra yaakkoabu vamsaththuth thalaivarga'lea, israveal vamsaththu athibathiga'lea, ithaik kea'lungga'l.

athin thalaivarga'l parithaanaththukku niyaayantheerkki'raarga'l; athin aasaariyarga'l koolikku ubatheasikki'raarga'l; athin theerkkatharisiga'l pa'naththukkuk ku'risollugi'raarga'l; aagilum avarga'l karththaraich saarnthuko'ndu: karththar engga'l naduvil illaiyoa? theenggu engga'lmeal varaathu engi'raarga'l.
aagaiyaal ungga'lnimiththam seeyoan vayalve'liyaippoala uzhappattu, erusaleam ma'nmeaduga'laayppoam, aalayaththin parvatham kaattu meaduga'laayppoam.

aanaalum, kadaisi naadka'lil karththarudaiya aalayamaagiya parvatham parvathangga'lin kodumudiyil sthaabikkappattu, malaiga'lukku mealaay uyarththappattirukkum, ellaa jaathiga'lum athinidaththi'rku oadivaruvaarga'l.

thira'laana jaathiga'l pu'rappattuvanthu: naam karththarin parvathaththukkum, yaakkoabin theavanudaiya aalayaththukkum poavoam vaarungga'l; avar thamathu vazhiga'lai namakkup poathippaar, naam avar paathaiga'lil nadappoam enbaarga'l; eanenil seeyoanilirunthu veathamum, erusaleamilirunthu karththarin vasanamum ve'lippadum.

avar thira'laana janangga'lukku'l niyaayantheerththu, thooraththilu'l'la balaththa jaathiga'laik kadinthuko'l'luvaar; appozhuthu avarga'l thangga'l pattayangga'lai ma'nvettiga'laagavum, thangga'l eettiga'lai a'rivaa'lga'laagavum adippaarga'l; oru jaathikku viroathamaay ma'rujaathi pattayam eduppathillai; ini avarga'l yuththaththaik ka'rpathumillai.
avanavan thanthan thiraadchachsediyin nizhalilum, thanthan aththimaraththin nizhalilum bayappaduththuvaar illaamal udkaaruvaan; seanaiga'ludaiya karththarin vaay ithaich sollit'ru.

sagala janangga'lum thangga'l thangga'l theavanudaiya naamaththaip pat'rikko'ndu nadappaarga'l; naangga'lum engga'l theavanaagiya karththarudaiya naamaththaip pat'rikko'ndu en'ren'raikkumu'l'la sathaakaalangga'lilum nadappoam.
karththar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: annaa'lilea naan no'ndiyaanava'laich searththu, tha'l'lu'ndava'laiyum theenggu anubaviththava'laiyum koottikko'ndu,

no'ndiyaanava'lai meethiyaana janamaagavum, thooramaayth tha'l'lu'ndupoanava'laip balaththa jaathiyaagavum vaippean; avarga'lpearil karththar seeyoan parvathaththilea ithumuthal en'ren'raikkum raajaavaayiruppaar.
manthaiyin thurukkamea, seeyoan kumaaraththiyin ara'nea, munthina aa'lugai unnidaththil varum; raajarigam erusaleam kumaaraththiyinidaththil varum.
ippoathum nee saththamittuk katha'ruvaanean? raajaavaanavar unnidaththil illaiyoa? un aaloasanaikkaarar azhinthupoanaarga'loa? pirasavikki'ra sthireekku oththa veathanai unakku u'ndaagum.

seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, pirasava sthireeyaippoala ambaayappattu veathanaippadu; nee ippoathu nagaraththilirunthu pu'rappattu, ve'liga'lil thanggi, baabiloanvaraikkum poavaay, anggea viduvikkappaduvaay; anggea karththar unnai un saththurukka'lin kaikku neenggalaakki meedpaar.
seeyoan theettuppaduvaa'laaga, engga'l ka'n ava'laik kaa'nbathaaga en'ru solli, aneaga jaathiyaar unakku viroathamaagak koodiyirukki'raarga'l.
aanaalum avarga'l karththarudaiya ninaivuga'lai a'riyaamalum, avarudaiya yoasanaiyai u'naraamalum irukki'raarga'l; avar arikkattuga'laippoala avarga'laik ka'laththilea searppaar.

seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, nee ezhunthu poaradi; naan un kombuga'lai irumbum, un ku'lambuga'lai ve'ngalamumaakkuvean; nee aneaga janangga'lai no'rukkippoaduvaay; avarga'l theadich searththathai nee karththarukken'rum, avarga'ludaiya aasthiyaip boomikkellaam aa'ndavaraayirukki'ravarukken'rum niyamippaay.
seanaiga'laiyudaiya nagaramea, ippoathu tha'ndutha'ndaagak koodikko'l; namakku viroathamaaga mut'rikkai poadappadum; isravealudaiya niyaayaathibathiyaik koalinaal kannaththilea adippaarga'l.

eppiraaththaa ennappatta bethleheamea, nee yootheayaavilu'l'la aayirangga'lukku'l'lea si'riyathaayirunthum, isravealai aa'lappoagi'ravar unnidaththilirunthu pu'rappattu ennidaththil varuvaar; avarudaiya pu'rappaduthal anaathinaadka'laagiya poorvaththinudaiyathu.
aanaalum pirasavikki'rava'l pirasavikki'ramattum avarga'lai oppukkoduppaar; appozhuthu avarudaiya sagoathararil meethiyaanavarga'l israveal puththiraroadungkoodath thirumbuvaarga'l.

avar nin'ruko'ndu, karththarudaiya balaththoadum thammudaiya theavanaagiya karththarudaiya naamaththin magaththuvaththoadum meayppaar; aagaiyaal avarga'l nilaiththiruppaarga'l; avar inip boomiyin ellaiga'lpariyanthamum magimaippaduvaar.

ivarea samaathaana kaara'nar; aseeriyan nammudaiya theasaththilea varumpoathum, nammudaiya ara'nmanaiga'lai mithikkumpoathum, eazhu meaypparaiyum manusharil ettu athibathiga'laiyum avanukku viroathamaaga ni'ruththuvean.

ivarga'l aseeriyaa theasaththaiyum, nimroathin theasaththaiyum, athinudaiya vaasalga'lukku udpu'ramaagap pattayaththi'rku iraiyaakkuvaarga'l; aseeriyan nammudaiya theasaththil varumpoathum, nammudaiya ellaiga'lai mithikkumpoathum avanukku nammaith thappuvippaar.

yaakkoabilea meethiyaanavarga'l karththaraalea varugi'ra paniyaippoalavum, manushanukkuk kaaththiraamalum, manupuththirarukkuth thaamathiyaamalum, poo'nduga'lmeal varugi'ra mazhaiga'laippoalavum, aneaga janangga'lin naduvilea iruppaarga'l.

yaakkoabilea meethiyaanavarga'l, singgam kaattumirugangga'lukku'l'lea irukki'ratha'rkuch samaanamaagavum, kadanthupoay mithiththuth thappuvippaar illaamal pee'rippoadugi'ra baalasinggam aattumanthaiga'lukku'l'lea irukki'ratha'rkuch samaanamaagavum jaathiga'lukku'l aneaga janangga'lin naduvilea iruppaarga'l.
unnudaiya kai un viroathiga'linmeal uyarum; un saththurukka'lellaarum sanggarikkappaduvaarga'l.
annaa'lilea naan un kuthiraiga'lai un naduvil iraathapadikkuch sanggariththu, un irathangga'lai azhiththu,
un theasaththup patta'nangga'laich sanggariththu, un ara'nga'laiyellaam nirmoolamaakki,
sooniya viththaiga'l un kaiyil iraathapadikku agat'ruvean; naa'l paarkki'ravarga'l unnidaththil illaama'rpoavaarga'l.
un suroobangga'laiyum un silaiga'laiyum un naduvil iraathapadikku nirmoolamaakkuvean; un kaiyin kiriyaiyai nee inip pa'ninthuko'l'laay.
naan un vikkiragaththoappuga'lai un naduvil iraathapadikkup pidunggi, un patta'nangga'lai azhiththu,
sevikodaatha pu'rajaathiga'lidaththilea koabaththoadum ukkiraththoadum neethiyaich sarikkattuvean en'raar.
karththar sollugi'rathaik kea'lungga'l; nee ezhunthu, parvathangga'lukkumun un vazhakkaich sol; malaiga'l un saththaththaik keadkakkadavathu.
parvathangga'lea, boomiyin u'ruthiyaana asthibaarangga'lea, karththarudaiya vazhakkaik kea'lungga'l; karththarukku avar janaththoadea vazhakku irukki'rathu; isravealoadea avar vazhakkaaduvaar.
en janamea, naan unakku enna seythean? naan ethinaal unnai visanappaduththinean? enakku ethirea uththaravu sol.
naan unnai egipthutheasaththilirunthu varappa'n'ni, adimaiththana veettiliruntha unnai meettukko'ndu, moasea aaroan meeriyaam enbavarga'lai unakku munbaaga anuppinean.

en janamea, moavaabin raajaavaagiya baalaak pa'n'nina yoasanai innathen'rum, beayoarin kumaaranaana bileayaam avanukkup pirathiyuththaramaagach sonnathu innathen'rum, siththeem thodanggi kilgaalmattum nadanthathu innathen'rum, nee karththarudaiya neethiga'lai a'rinthuko'l'lumpadi ninaiththukko'l.

ennaththaikko'ndu naan karththarudaiya sannithiyil vanthu, unnathamaana theavanukku munbaagap pa'ninthuko'lvean? thaganabaliga'laikko'ndum, oru vayathu kan'rukkuttiga'laikko'ndum avar sannithiyil varavea'ndumoa?

aayirangga'laana aattukkadaakka'linpearilum, e'n'neyaay oadugi'ra pathinaayirangga'laana aa'ruga'linpearilum, karththar piriyamaayiruppaaroa? en akkiramaththaip poakka en mutha'rpea'raanavanaiyum, en aaththumaavin paavaththaip poakka en karppakkaniyaiyum kodukkavea'ndumoa?

manushanea, nanmai innathen'ru avar unakku a'riviththirukki'raar; niyaayagnseythu, irakkaththaich sineagiththu, un theavanukku munbaaga manaththaazhmaiyaay nadappathai allaamal vea'rea ennaththaik karththar unnidaththil keadki'raar.
karththarudaiya saththam nagaraththai noakkik kooppidugi'rathu; gnaanamu'l'lavan ummudaiya naamaththai mathippaan; milaat'ri'rkum athai neamiththavarukkum sevikodungga'l.
thunmaarkkanudaiya veettilea thunmaarkkaththinaal sambaathiththa pokkishangga'lum, aruvarukkappadaththakka ku'raintha marakkaalum innum irukki'rathallavoa?
ka'l'laththaraasum ka'l'lap padikka'rka'lu'l'la paiyum irukkumpoathu, avarga'laich suththamu'l'lavarga'len'ru e'n'nuveanoa?
avarga'lil aisuvariyamu'l'lavarga'l kodumaiyaal ni'rainthirukki'raarga'l; avarga'lukku'l vaasamaayirukki'ravarga'l poypeasugi'raarga'l; avarga'l vaayilu'l'la naavu kabadamu'l'lathu.
aagaiyaal naan un paavangga'linimiththam unnai adiththup paazhaakkugi'rathinaal unnaip paladchayamaakkuvean.
nee pusiththum thirupthiyadaiyaathiruppaay; unakku'l'lea soarvu'ndaagum; nee pathanam pa'n'niyum thappuvippathillai; nee thappuvippathaiyum pattayaththukku oppukkoduppean.
nee vithaiththum a'rukkaama'rpoavaay; nee olivappazhangga'laiyum thiraadchappazhangga'laiyum aalaiyaadina poathilum, e'n'ney poosikko'lvathumillai, irasam kudippathumillai.

naan unnaip paazhaagavum un kudiga'lai eesalittu ninthikki'ra ninthaiyaagavum vaikkumpadi, umriyinudaiya katta'laiga'lum aagaab veettaarudaiya ellaach seygaiga'lum kaikko'l'lappattuvarugi'rathu; avarga'ludaiya aaloasanaiga'lilea nadakki'reerga'l; aagaiyaal en janaththin ninthaiyaich sumappeerga'l.

aiyoa! ush'nakaalaththuk kaniga'laich searththu, thiraadchappazhangga'lai a'ruththapinbu varugi'ravanaippoal irukki'rean; pusikki'ratha'rku oru thiraadchakkulaiyum en aaththumaa ichchiththa muthal a'ruppin kaniyum illai.

theasaththil bakthiyu'l'lavan at'ruppoanaan; manusharil semmaiyaanavan illai; avarga'lellaarum iraththagnsinthap pathivirukki'raarga'l; avanavan thanthan sagoatharanai valaiyilea pidikka veattaiyaadugi'raan.

pollaappuch seyya avarga'l ira'ndu kaiga'lum nan'raayk koodum; athibathi kodu engi'raan; niyaayaathibathi kaikkooli keadki'raan; periyavan than thuraasaiyaith therivikki'raan; ivvithamaayp purattugi'raarga'l.

avarga'lil nallavan mudchedikkoththavan, semmaiyaanavan nerignchilaippaarkkilum kadungkoormaiyaanavan; un kaava'rkaarar a'riviththa un tha'ndanaiyin naa'l varugi'rathu; ippozhuthea avarga'lukkuk kalakkam u'ndu.
sineagithanai visuvaasikkavea'ndaam, vazhikaattiyai nambavea'ndaam; un madiyilea paduththukko'l'lugi'rava'lukku munbaaga un vaayaith thi'ravaamal echcharikkaiyaayiru.
magan thagappanaik kanaveenappaduththugi'raan; maga'l than thaaykku viroathamaagavum, marumaga'l than maamikku viroathamaagavum ezhumbugi'raarga'l; manushanudaiya saththurukka'l avan veettaarthaanea.
naanoaven'raal karththarai noakkikko'ndu, en iradchippin theavanukkuk kaaththiruppean; en theavan ennaik keattaru'luvaar.
en saththuruvea, enakku viroathamaaych santhoashappadaathea; naan vizhunthaalum ezhunthiruppean; naan iru'lilea udkaarnthaal, karththar enakku ve'lichchamaayiruppaar.

naan karththarukku viroathamaagap paavagnseythean; avar enakkaaga vazhakkaadi en niyaayaththai visaarikkumattum avarudaiya koabaththaich sumappean; avar ennai ve'lichchaththilea ko'nduvaruvaar, avarudaiya neethiyaip paarppean.

un theavanaagiya karththar enggea en'ru ennoadea sollugi'ra en saththuruvaanava'l athaip paarkkumpoathu vedkam ava'lai moodum; en ka'nga'l ava'laik kaa'num; ini veethiga'lin seat'raippoala mithikkappaduvaa'l.
un mathilga'lai eduppikkum naa'l varugi'rathu; annaa'lilea piramaa'nam veguthooram paravippoam.

annaa'lilea aseeriyaamuthal egipthin patta'nangga'lvaraikkum, egipthumuthal nathivaraikkum, oru samuththiramuthal ma'ru samuththiramvaraikkum, oru parvathamuthal ma'ru parvathamvaraikkumu'l'la janangga'l unnidaththi'rku varuvaarga'l.
aanaalum than kudiga'linimiththamum avarga'l kiriyaiga'ludaiya palanga'linimiththamum theasam paazhaayirukkum.

karmealin naduvilea thaniththu vanavaasamaayirukki'ra umathu suthantharamaana manthaiyaagiya ummudaiya janaththai umathu koalinaal meayththaru'lum; poorvanaadka'lil meaynthathupoalavea avarga'l baasaanilum keeleayaaththilum meayvaarga'laaga.
nee egipthu theasaththilirunthu pu'rappattanaa'lil nadanthathupoalavea unnai athisayangga'laik kaa'nappa'n'nuvean.
pu'rajaathiga'l ka'ndu thangga'ludaiya ellaap baraakkiramaththaiyungku'riththu vedkappaduvaarga'l; kaiyai vaayinmeal vaiththukko'lvaarga'l; avarga'l kaathuga'l sevidaayp poagum.

paambaippoala ma'n'nai nakkuvaarga'l; boomiyin oorvanavat'raip poalath thangga'l ma'raividangga'lilirunthu nadunadunggip pu'rappaduvaarga'l; namathu theavanaagiya karththaridaththi'rkuth thigiloadea searnthu, unakkup bayappaduvaarga'l.

thamathu suthantharaththil meethiyaanavarga'ludaiya akkiramaththaip po'ruththu, mee'ruthalai mannikki'ra theavareerukku oppaana theavan yaar? avar kirubaiseyya virumbugi'rapadiyaal avar en'ren'raikkum koabam vaiyaar.
avar thirumba nammeal irangguvaar; nammudaiya akkiramangga'lai adakki, nammudaiya paavangga'laiyellaam samuththiraththin aazhangga'lil poattuviduvaar.
theavareer poorvanaadka'lmuthal engga'l pithaakka'lukku aa'naiyitta saththiyaththai yaakkoabukkum, kirubaiyai aabirahaamukkum katta'laiyiduveeraaga.
niniveayin baaram. elkoasaanaagiya naagoomin tharisanap pusthagam.

karththar erichchalu'l'lavarum neethiyaich sarikkattugi'ravarumaana theavan; karththar neethiyaich sarikkattugi'ravar, ukkirakoabamu'l'lavar; karththar thammudaiya saththurukka'lukkup pirathipalan a'likki'ravar, avar thammudaiya pagaignarukkaagak koabaththai vaiththuvaikki'ravar.

karththar neediya saanthamum, miguntha vallamaiyumu'l'lavar; avarga'lai aakkinaiyillaamal thappuvikkamaattaar; karththarudaiya vazhi suzhalkaat'rilum perungkaat'rilum irukki'rathu; meagangga'l avarudaiya paathaththoo'laayirukki'rathu.
avar samuththiraththai athatti, athai vat'rippoagappa'n'ni, sagala aa'ruga'laiyum va'radchiyaakkugi'raar; baasaanum karmealum soarnthu, leebanoanin sezhippu vaadippoagum.
avar samugaththil parvathangga'l athirnthu malaiga'l karainthupoagum; avar pirasannaththinaal boomiyum poochchakkaramum athil kudiyirukki'ra anaivaroadum edupattuppoam.
avarudaiya koabaththukku munbaaga ni'rpavan yaar? avarudaiya ukkirakoabaththilea tharippavan yaar? avarudaiya erichchal akkiniyaippoala i'raikkappadugi'rathu; avaraalea kanmalaiga'l pearkkappadum.
karththar nallavar, ikkattunaa'lilea ara'naana koattai; thammai nambugi'ravarga'lai a'rinthirukki'raar.
aanaalum niniveayin sthaanaththai, pura'nduvarugi'ra ve'l'laththinaal sarvasanggaarampa'n'nuvaar; iru'l avar saththurukka'laip pinthodarum.
neengga'l karththarukku viroathamaagach seyya ninaikki'rathenna? avar sarvasanggaarampa'n'nuvaar; idukkam ma'rupadiyum u'ndaagaathu.
avarga'l sannapinnalaayirukki'ra mudchediga'lukku oppaayirukkaiyilum, thangga'l mathubaanaththinaal ve'riko'ndirukkaiyilum, avarga'l muzhuthum kaaynthupoana seththaiyaippoala erinthupoavaarga'l.
karththarukku viroathamaagap pollaatha ninaivuko'ndirukki'ra thuraaloasanaikkaaran oruvan unnidaththilirunthu pu'rappattaan.

karththar sollugi'rathu ennaven'raal: avarga'l sampoora'namadainthu aneagaraayirunthaalum a'ruppu'ndupoavaarga'l; avan ozhinthupoavaan; unnai naan si'rumaippaduththinean, ini unnaich si'rumaippaduththaathiruppean.
ippoathum naan unmeal irukki'ra avan nugaththai mu'riththu, un kattuga'lai a'ruppean.

unnaikku'riththuk karththar katta'laikoduththirukki'raar; ini un pearukku viththuvithaikkappaduvathillai; un theavarga'lin koavilil irukki'ra vettappatta vikkiragaththaiyum, vaarkkappatta vikkiragaththaiyum naan nirmoolampa'n'nuvean; nee kanaveenanaanapadiyaal athai unakkup pireathakkuzhiyaakkuvean.

ithoa, samaathaanaththaik koo'rugi'ra suviseashaganudaiya kaalga'l malaiga'linmeal varugi'rathu; yoothaavea, un pa'ndigaiga'lai aasari; un poruththanaiga'laich seluththu; thushdan ini un vazhiyaayk kadanthuvaruvathillai, avan muzhuvathum sanggarikkappattaan.
sitha'radikki'ravan un mugaththukku munbaaga varugi'raan; ara'naik kaaththukko'l, vazhiyaik kaavalpa'n'nu, araiyaik kettiyaayk kattikko'l, un belanai migavum sthirappaduththu.

ve'rumaiyaakkugi'ravarga'l avarga'lai ve'rumaiyaakki, avarga'ludaiya thiraadchakkodiga'laik keduththuppoattaalum, karththar yaakkoabin magimaiyaith thirumbivarappa'n'nuvathu poal, isravealin magimaiyaiyum thirumbivarappa'n'nuvaar.

avanudaiya baraakkiramasaaliga'lin keadagam iraththamayamaagum; avanudaiya yuththaveerar iraththaambaran thariththukko'ndirukki'raarga'l; avan thannai aayaththampa'n'num naa'lilea irathangga'l juvaalikki'ra kadkangga'lai udaiyathaayirukkum; eettiga'l kulunggum.
irathangga'l therukka'lil kadakadaven'roadi, veethiga'lil idasaari valasaari varum; avaiga'l theevattiga'laippoala vi'langgi, minnalga'laippoala veagamaayp pa'rakkum.
avan than pirabalastharai ninaivukooruvaan; avarga'l thangga'l nadaiga'lil ida'ri, alanggaththukku virainthu oaduvaarga'l; ma'raividam aayaththappaduththappadum.
aa'ruga'lin mathaguga'l thi'rakkappadum, aramanai karainthupoam.
avan si'raippattuppoagath theermaanamaayit'ru; ava'ludaiya thaathimaarga'l thangga'l maarbilea adiththukko'ndu, pu'raakka'laippoalach saththamittuk koodappoavaarga'l.
ninivea poorvakaalamuthal tha'n'neerth thadaagampoal irunthathu; ippoathoa avarga'l oadippoagi'raarga'l; nillungga'l nillungga'l en'raalum, thirumbippaarkki'ravan illai.
ve'l'liyaik ko'l'laiyidungga'l, ponnaiyum ko'l'laiyidungga'l; sambaththukku mudivillai; ichchikkappadaththakka sagalavitha poru'lga'lum irukki'rathu.

ava'l ve'rumaiyum ve'liyum paazhumaavaa'l; manam karainthupoagi'rathu; muzhangkaalga'l tha'l'laadugi'rathu; ellaa iduppuga'lilum miguntha veathanai u'ndu; ellaarudaiya mugangga'lum karugippoagi'rathu.
singgangga'lin vaasasthalam enggea? baalasinggam iraithingi'ra idam enggea? kizhachsinggamaagiya singgamum, singgakkuttiga'lum bayappaduththuvaarillaamal sagncharikki'ra sthaanam enggea?

singgam than kuttiga'lukkuth theavaiyaanathaip pee'ri, than pe'n singgangga'lukku vea'ndiyathaith tho'ndaiyaip pidiththuk kon'ru, iraiga'linaal than kebiga'laiyum, pee'rippoattavaiga'linaal than thaabarangga'laiyum nirappit'ru.

ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaga vanthu, irathangga'laip pugaiyezhumba eriththuppoaduvean; pattayam un baalasinggangga'laip padchikkum; nee iraikkaagap pidikkum veattaiyaith theasaththil at'ruppoagappa'n'nuvean; un sthaanaabathiga'lin saththam inik keadkappaduvathillai en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
iraththappazhiga'lin nagaraththi'rku aiyoa! athu vagnchagaththinaalum kodumaiyinaalum ni'rainthirukki'rathu; ko'l'lai oayaamal nadakki'rathu.
savukkuga'lin oasaiyum, uru'laiga'lin athirchchiyum, kuthiraiga'lin paaychchalum, irathangga'l kadakadaven'ru oadugi'ra saththamum,

veerar kuthirai ea'rugi'rathum, pattayangga'l thulanggugi'rathum, eettiga'l minnugi'rathum, vettu'ndavarga'lin thira'lum, pireathangga'lin earaa'lamum anggea u'ndaayirukkum; pi'nangga'lukkuth thogaiyillai; avarga'l pi'nangga'lil ida'rivizhugi'raarga'l.

than veasiththanangga'linaal jaathiga'laiyum, than sooniyangga'linaal vamsangga'laiyum vi'rki'ra mahaa sooniyakkaariyum roobavathiyumaayirukki'ra veasiyinudaiya thira'laana veasiththanangga'linimiththam,
ithoa, naan unakku viroathamaaga vanthu un vasthiraththu oarangga'lai un mugamattum thookkiyeduththu, jaathiga'lukku un nirvaa'naththaiyum, raajyangga'lukku un maanaththaiyum theriyappa'n'ni,
unmeal theettaanavaiga'lai e'rinthu, unnaik kanaveenappaduththi, unnai veadikkaiyaakkippoaduvean en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
appozhuthu unnaik kaa'ngi'ravanellaam ninivea paazhaayppoayit'ru, atha'rkaagap pulambugi'ravar yaar? aa'ruthal sollugi'ravarga'lai unakku enggea theaduveanen'ru solli, unnaivittoadip poavaan.
nathiga'l maththiyiliruntha noa ammoanaippaarkkilum nee sireashdamoa? athaich sut'rilum tha'n'neer irunthathu; samuththiram athin ara'num, samuththirakkaal athin mathilumaayirunthathu.
eththiyoappiyaavum egipthum e'n'ni'rantha seanaiyaal atha'rkup belanaaga irunthathu; pooththum loobeemum atha'rkuch sagaayamaayirunthathu.

aayinum ava'l kudivilakkappattuch si'raiyiruppilea ko'ndupoagappattaa'l; ava'l kuzhanthaiga'l ellaa veethiga'lin muganaiga'lilum moathiyadikkappattaarga'l; ava'ludaiya kanavaanga'lpearil seettup poattaarga'l; ava'ludaiya periyavarga'l ellaarum sanggiliga'laal kattappattaarga'l.
neeyum ve'riko'ndu o'liththukko'lvaay; neeyum un saththuruvukkuth thappa ara'naana koattaiyaith theaduvaay.
un ara'nga'lellaam muthal pazhukkum pazhangga'lu'l'la aththimarangga'laippoal irukkum; avaiga'l kulukkappattaal avaiga'lin pazham thingi'ravan vaayilea vizhum.
ithoa, un naduvil irukki'ra janangga'l peadiga'l; un theasaththin vaasalga'l un saththuruvukkumun thi'ravu'ndupoagum; akkini un thaazhppaa'lga'laip padchikkum.
mut'rigaikkuth tha'n'neer mo'ndu vai, un ara'nga'laip balappaduththu; seat'rilea poayk ka'lima'n'nai mithi, soo'laiyaik kettippaduththu.

anggea akkini unnaip padchikkum, pattayam unnaich sanggarikkum; athu pachchaikki'liga'laippoal unnaip padchiththuppoadum; unnaip pachchaikki'liga'laththanaiyaakkikko'l, unnai vettukki'liga'laththanaiyaakkikko'l.
un varththagarai vaanaththu nadchaththirangga'lilum athigamaakkinaay; inthap pachchaikki'liga'l paravip pa'ranthupoagum.

un magudavarththanar vettukki'liga'lukkum, un tha'lakarththar perungki'liga'lukkum samaanamaayirukki'raarga'l; avaiga'l ku'lirchchiyaana naa'lil vealiga'lil paa'laiyami'ranggi, sooriyan uthiththamaaththiraththil pa'ranthupoam; pinbu avaiga'l irukkum idam innathen'ru theriyaathu.
aseeriyaa raajaavea, un meaypparga'l u'rangguvaarga'l; un pirabalasthar paduththiruppaarga'l; un janangga'l parvathangga'linmeal sitha'riyirukki'raarga'l, avaiga'laik koottich searppavan illai.
un no'rungguthalukkup parigaaram illai; un kaayam kodiyathu; un seythiyaik keadpavar yaavarum unpearil kaikottuvaarga'l; un pollaappu ennearamum yaarpearileathaan paayaama'rpoayit'ru?
aabakook ennum theerkkatharisi tharisanamaayk ka'nda baaram.
karththaavea, naan ethuvaraikkum ummai noakkik kooppiduvean, neer kea'laamalirukki'reerea! kodumaiyinimiththam naan ethuvaraikkum ummai noakkik kooppiduvean, neer iradchiyaamalirukki'reerea!
neer enakku akkiramaththaik kaa'nbiththu, ennaith theevinaiyaip paarkkappa'n'nugi'rathenna? ko'l'laiyum kodumaiyum enakku ethirea ni'rki'rathu; vazhakkaiyum vaathaiyum ezhuppugi'ravarga'l u'ndu.
aagaiyaal niyaayappiramaa'nam belanat'rathaagi, niyaayam orupoathum sellaama'rpoagi'rathu; thunmaarkkan neethimaanai va'lainthuko'l'lugi'raan; aathalaal niyaayam purattappadugi'rathu.
neengga'l pu'rajaathiga'lai noakkippaarththu, aachchariyappattup piramiyungga'l; vivarikkappattaalum neengga'l visuvaasiyaatha oru kiriyaiyai ungga'l naadka'lil nadappippean.
ithoa, naan kaltheayarennum kodithum veagamumaana jaathiyaarai ezhuppuvean; avarga'l thangga'ludaiyathallaatha vaasasthalangga'laik kattikko'l'lath theasaththin visaalangga'lil nadanthuvaruvaarga'l.
avarga'l kediyum bayanggaramumaanavarga'l; avarga'ludaiya niyaayamum avarga'ludaiya meanmaiyum avarga'laaleayea u'ndaagum.

avarga'ludaiya kuthiraiga'l sivinggiga'lilum veagamum, saayanggaalaththil thirigi'ra oanaayga'lilum theeviramumaayirukkum; avarga'ludaiya kuthiraiveerar paravuvaarga'l; avarga'ludaiya kuthiraiveerar thooraththilirunthu varuvaarga'l; iraikkuth theevirikki'ra kazhuguga'laippoal pa'ranthuvaruvaarga'l.
avarga'lellaarum kodumai seyyavaruvaarga'l; avarga'ludaiya mugangga'l suva'rach seyyum keezhkkaat'raippoalirukkum; avarga'l ma'nalaththanai janangga'laich si'raipidiththuch searppaarga'l.

avarga'l raajaakka'lai aagadiyampa'n'nuvaarga'l; athibathiga'l avarga'lukkup pariyaasamaayiruppaarga'l; avarga'l ara'nga'laiyellaam paarththu nagaiththu, ma'nmeaduga'laik kuviththu avaiga'laip pidippaarga'l.
appozhuthu avanudaiya manammaa'ra, avan than belan than theavanaalea u'ndaanathen'ru solli mignchippoayk kut'ravaa'liyaavaan.

karththaavea, neer poorvakaalamuthal en theavanum, en parisuththarumaanavar allavaa? naangga'l saavathillai; karththaavea, niyaayaththeerppuch seyya avanai vaiththeer; kanmalaiyea, tha'ndanai seyya avanai niyamiththeer.

theemaiyaip paarkkamaattaatha suththakka'n'nanea, aniyaayaththai noakkikko'ndirukkamaatteerea; pinnai thuroagiga'lai neer noakkikko'ndirukki'rathenna? thunmaarkkan thannaip paarkkilum neethimaanai vizhunggumpoathu neer maunamaayirukki'rathenna?
manusharaich samuththiraththu machchangga'lukkum, athigaariyillaatha oorvanavat'ri'rkum samaanamaakkugi'rathenna?
avarga'lellaaraiyum thoo'ndilinaal izhuththukko'l'lugi'raan; avarga'laith than valaiyinaal pidiththu, than pa'riyilea searththukko'l'lugi'raan; athinaal santhoashappattuk ka'likoorugi'raan.
aagaiyaal avaiga'linaal than panggu kozhuppu'l'lathum, than poajanam rusigaramu'l'lathumaayit'ru en'ru solli avan than valaikkup baliyittuth than pa'rikkuth thoobangkaattugi'raan.
itha'rkaaga avan than valaiyai izhuththu athilu'l'lavaiga'laik kottikko'ndirunthu, irakkamillaamal jaathiga'lai eppoathum kon'rupoada vea'ndumoa?
naan en kaavalilea thariththu, ara'nilea nilaiko'ndirunthu, avar enakku enna solluvaaren'rum, avar ennaik ka'ndikkumpoathu naan enna uththaravu solluveanen'rum kavaniththup paarppean en'rean.
appozhuthu karththar enakkup pirathiyuththaramaaga: nee tharisanaththai ezhuthi, athaik kadanthoadugi'ravan vaasikkumpadip palagaiga'lilea theerkkamaaga varai.

ku'riththakaalaththukkuth tharisanam innum vaikkappattirukki'rathu; mudivilea athu vi'langgum, athu poy sollaathu; athu thaamathiththaalum atha'rkuk kaaththiru; athu nichchayamaay varum, athu thaamathippathillai.
ithoa, aganggaariyaayirukki'raanea, avanudaiya aaththumaa avanukku'l semmaiyaanathalla; than visuvaasaththinaalea neethimaan pizhaippaan.

avan mathubaanaththinaal akkiramagnseythu aganggaariyaagi, veettilea thariyaamal, avan than aaththumaavaip paathaa'laththaippoala virivaakkith thirupthiyaagaamal, mara'naththukkuch samaanamaaych sagala jaathiga'laiyum than vasamaagach searththu, sagala janangga'laiyum thannidamaagak koottikko'ndaalum,

ivarga'lellaarum avanpearil oru pazhamozhiyaiyum, avanukku viroathamaana vasaichsollaiyum vasaniththu, thannudaiyathallaathathaith thanakkaagach searththukko'l'lugi'ravanukku aiyoa en'rum, athu enthamattum ni'rkum en'rum, avan thanmeal ka'lima'n sumaiyaiyallavaa sumaththikko'l'lugi'raan en'rum solluvaarga'l.
unnaik kadippavarga'l sadithiyaay ezhumbuvathum, unnai alaikkazhippavarga'l vizhippathumillaiyoa? nee avarga'lukkuch soo'raiyaagaayoa?
nee aneagam jaathiga'laik ko'l'laiyittapadiyinaal janangga'lil meethiyaana yaavarum nee sinthina manusharaththaththinimiththamum nee seytha kodumaiyinimiththamum unnaik ko'l'laiyiduvaarga'l.
theemaiyin vallamaikkuth thappavea'ndumen'ru than koottai uyaraththilea vaikkumpadikku, than veettukkup pollaatha aathaayaththaith theadugi'ravanukku aiyoa!
aneaga janangga'lai vettippoattathinaal un veettukku vedkamu'ndaaga aaloasanaipa'n'ninaay; un aaththumaavukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythaay.
kallu suvarilirunthu kooppidum, uththiram machchilirunthu saadchiyidum.
iraththappazhiga'laalea patta'naththaik katti, aniyaayaththinaalea nagaraththaip balappaduththugi'ravanukku aiyoa!
ithoa, janangga'l akkinikku iraiyaaga uzhaiththu, janangga'l viruthaavaaga i'laiththuppoagi'rathu karththarudaiya seyal allavoa?
samuththiram jalaththinaal ni'rainthirukki'rathupoal, boomi karththarudaiya magimaiyai a'rigi'ra a'rivinaal ni'rainthirukkum.
than thoazharukkuk kudikkakkoduththuth than thuruththiyai avarga'la'ndaiyilea vaiththu, avarga'ludaiya nirvaa'nangga'laip paarkkumpadikku, avarga'lai ve'rikkappa'n'nugi'ravanukku aiyoa!

nee magimaiyinaal alla, ilachchaiyinaal nirappappaduvaay; neeyum kudiththu viruththaseathanamillaathavan en'ru vi'langgu; karththarudaiya valathukaiyil irukki'ra paaththiram unnidaththi'rkuth thirumbum; un magimaiyinmeal ilachchaiyaana vaanthipa'n'nuvaay.

leebanoanukkuch seytha kodumai unnai moodum; sinthina manusharaththaththinimiththamum theasaththi'rkum patta'naththi'rkum athin kudiga'l ellaarukkum seytha kodumaiyinimiththamum mirugangga'l seyyum paazhkkadippu unnaik kalanggappa'n'num.

siththirakkaaranukku avan seytha suroobamum, oomaiyaana theyvangga'lai u'ndupa'n'nith thaan uruvaakkina suroobaththai nambinavanukku vaarkkappattathum poyppoathagam pa'n'nugi'rathumaana vikkiragamum ennaththukku uthavum?

maraththaippaarththu vizhiyen'rum, oomaiyaana kallaippaarththu ezhumbu en'rum sollugi'ravanukku aiyoa! athu poathikkumoa? ithoa, athu ponnum ve'l'liyumaana thagattaal moodappattirukki'rathu; atha'rku'l'lea suvaasam illaiyea?
karththaroaven'raal, thamathu parisuththa aalayaththil irukki'raar; boomiyellaam avarukku munbaaga maunamaayirukkakkadavathu.
aabakook theerkkatharisi sigaayoanil paadina vi'n'nappam.

karththaavea, neer ve'lippaduththinathai naan keattean, enakkup bayamu'ndaayit'ru; karththaavea, varushangga'lin naduvilea ummudaiya kiriyaiyai uyirppiyum, varushangga'lin naduvilea athai vi'langgappa'n'num; koabiththaalum irakkaththai ninaiththaru'lum.
theavan theamaanilirunthum, parisuththar paaraan parvathaththilirunthum vanthaar; (sealaa.) avarudaiya magimai vaanangga'lai moodikko'ndathu; avar thuthiyinaal boomi ni'rainthathu.
avarudaiya piragaasam sooriyanaippoalirunthathu; avarudaiya karaththilirunthu kira'nangga'l veesina; anggea avarudaiya baraakkiramam ma'rainthirunthathu.
avarukku munbaagak ko'l'lainoay sen'rathu; avar adiga'lilirunthu eripanthamaana kaaychchal pu'rappattathu.

avar nin'ru boomiyai a'lanthaar; avar paarththup pu'rajaathiga'laik karaiyappa'n'ninaar; poorva parvathangga'l sitha'radikkappattathu, en'rumu'l'la malaiga'l thaazhnthathu; avarudaiya nadaiga'l niththiya nadaiga'laayirunthathu.
kooshaanin koodaarangga'l varuththaththil agappattirukkakka'ndean; meethiyaan theasaththin thiraiga'l nadunggina.

karththar nathiga'linmeal koabamaayirunthaaroa? theavareer ummudaiya kuthiraiga'linmealum iradchippu'ndaakkugi'ra ummudaiya irathangga'linmealum ea'rivarugi'rapoathu, umathu koabam nathiga'lukkum umathu sinam samuththiraththi'rkum viroathamaayirunthathoa?
koaththirangga'lukku aa'naiyittuk koduththa vaakkinpadiyea ummudaiya vil naa'neat'rappattathaaga vi'langginathu; (sealaa.) neer boomiyaip pi'lanthu aa'ruga'lai u'ndaakkineer.
parvathangga'l ummaik ka'ndu nadunggina; jalam piravaagiththuk kadanthupoayit'ru; aazhi irainthathu, athin kaiga'lai uyara eduththathu.
santhiranum sooriyanum thanthan ma'ndalaththil nin'rana; umathu ambuga'lin joathiyilum, umathu eettiyinudaiya minnal piragaasaththilum nadanthana.
neer koabaththoadea boomiyil nadantheer, ukkiraththoadea jaathiga'laip poaradiththeer.

umathu janaththin iradchippukkaagavum neer abisheagam pa'n'nuviththavanin iradchippukkaagavumea neer pu'rappatteer; kazhuththa'lavaaga asthibaaraththaith thi'rappaakki, thushdanudaiya veettiliruntha thalaivanai vettineer; sealaa.

ennaich sitha'radippatha'rkup perungkaat'raippoal vanthaarga'l; si'rumaiyaanavanai ma'raividaththilea padchippathu avarga'lukkuch santhoashamaayirunthathu; neer avanudaiya eettiga'linaaleayea avanudaiya kiraamaththu athibathiga'lai uruvak kuththineer.
thira'laana tha'n'neer kuviyalaagiya samuththiraththukku'l umathu kuthiraiga'loadea nadanthupoaneer.

naan keattapozhuthu en kudal kuzhambit'ru; anthach saththaththukku en uthaduga'l thudiththathu; en elumbuga'lil ukkal u'ndaayit'ru; en nilaiyilea nadungginean; aanaalum engga'loadea ethirkkum janangga'l varumpoathu, ikkattunaa'lilea naan i'laippaa'ruthal adaivean.

aththimaram thu'lirvidaama'rpoanaalum, thiraadchachsediga'lil pazham u'ndaagaama'rpoanaalum, olivamaraththin palan at'ruppoanaalum, vayalga'l thaaniyaththai vi'laiviyaama'rpoanaalum, kidaiyil aattumanthaiga'l muthalat'ruppoanaalum, thozhuvaththilea maadu illaama'rpoanaalum,
naan karththarukku'l magizhchchiyaayiruppean, en iradchippin theavanukku'l ka'likooruvean.

aa'ndavaraagiya karththar en belan; avar en kaalga'lai maankaalga'laippoalaakki, uyaramaana sthalangga'lil ennai nadakkappa'n'nuvaar. ithu neginoath ennum vaaththiyaththil vaasikka iraagaththalaivanukku oppuvikkappatta sanggeetham.

aamoanin puththiranaagiya yoasiyaa ennum yoothaa raajaavin naadka'lilea, eskiyaavin kumaaranaagiya aamariyaavukkuk kumaaranaana kethaliyaa enbavanudaiya maganaagiya kooshin kumaaran seppaniyaavukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vasanam.
theasaththil u'ndaanathai ellaam mut'rilum vaarikko'l'luvean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.

manusharaiyum mirugajeevanga'laiyum vaarikko'l'luvean; naan aagaayaththup pa'ravaiga'laiyum, samuththiraththu machchangga'laiyum, ida'rugi'ratha'rkeathuvaanavaiga'laiyum thunmaarkkaroadeakooda vaarikko'ndu, theasaththil u'ndaana manusharaich sanggaarampa'n'nuvean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
naan yoothaavinmealum, erusaleamilu'l'la ellaak kudiga'linmealum en kaiyai neetti, baagaalil meethiyaayirukki'rathaiyum, aasaariyarga'loadeakoodak kemmareem enbavarga'lin pearaiyum,
veeduga'linmeal vaanaseanaiyaip pa'nigi'ravarga'laiyum, karththarpearil aa'naiyittu, malkaaminpearilum aa'naiyittup pa'nigi'ravarga'laiyum,
karththarai vittup pinvaanggugi'ravarga'laiyum, karththaraith theadaamalum, avaraikku'riththu visaariyaamalumirukki'ravarga'laiyum, ivvidaththil iraathapadikkuch sanggaarampa'n'nuvean.

karththaraagiya aa'ndavarukku munbaaga maunamaayirungga'l; karththarudaiya naa'l sameebiththirukki'rathu; karththar oru yaagaththai aayaththampa'n'ni, atha'rku virunthaa'liga'laiyum azhaiththirukki'raar.
karththarudaiya yaagaththin naa'lilea naan athibathiga'laiyum raajakumaararaiyum ma'rutheasaththu vasthiram tharikki'ra yaavaraiyum tha'ndippean.
vaasa'rpadiyaith thaa'ndi, kodumaiyinaalum vagnchagaththinaalum thangga'l ejamaanga'lin veeduga'lai nirappugi'ra yaavaraiyum annaa'lilea tha'ndippean.

annaa'lilea meenvaasalilirunthu kookkuralin saththamum, nagaraththin ira'ndaam paagaththilirunthu ala'ruthalum, meaduga'lilirunthu mahaa sanggaaraththin iraichchalum u'ndaagumen'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
maktheashin kudiga'lea ala'rungga'l; varththagarellaarum sanggaaramaanaarga'l; kaasukkaarar yaavarum vettu'ndupoanaarga'l.

akkaalaththilea naan erusaleamai vi'lakkukko'luththich soathiththu, va'ndalpoalak kuzhambiyirukki'ravarga'lum, karththar nanmaiseyvathum illai theemaiseyvathum illaiyen'ru thangga'l iruthayaththil sollugi'ravarga'lumaana manusharaith tha'ndippean.

avarga'ludaiya aasthi ko'l'laiyaagum; avarga'ludaiya veeduga'l paazhaayppoagum; avarga'l veeduga'laik kattiyum, avaiga'lil kudiyirukkamaattaarga'l; avarga'l thiraadchaththoattangga'lai naattiyum, avaiga'lin pazharasaththaik kudippathillai.

karththarudaiya periyanaa'l sameebiththirukki'rathu; athu kittichsearnthu migavum theeviriththuvarugi'rathu; karththarudaiya naa'lengi'ra saththaththukkup baraakkiramasaali muthalaay anggea manangkasanthu ala'ruvaan.
antha naa'l ukkiraththin naa'l; athu ikkattum idukkamumaana naa'l; athu azhivum paazhkkadippumaana naa'l; athu iru'lum anthagaaramumaana naa'l; athu mappum manthaaramumaana naa'l.
athu ara'nippaana nagarangga'lukkum, uyaramaana koththa'langga'lukkum viroathamaaga ekkaa'lam oothugi'rathum aarpparikki'rathumaana naa'l.

manushar karththarukku viroathamaayp paavagnseythapadiyaal, avarga'l kurudaraippoal nadakkumpadi naan avarga'lai varuththappaduththuvean; avarga'l iraththam puzhuthiyaippoal soriyappadum; avarga'l maamsam eruvaippoal kidakkum.

karththarudaiya ukkiraththin naa'lilea avarga'l ve'l'liyum avarga'l ponnum avarga'laith thappuvikkamaattaathu; avarudaiya erichchalin akkiniyinaal theasamellaam azhiyum; theasaththin kudiga'laiyellaam sadithiyaay nirmoolampa'n'nuvaar.

virumbappadaatha jaathiyea, katta'lai pi'rakkumunnum, patharaippoala naa'l pa'ranthupoagumunnum karththarudaiya ukkirakoabam ungga'lmeal i'ranggumunnum, karththarudaiya koabaththin naa'l ungga'lmeal varumunnum,
neengga'l ungga'lai uyththu aaraaynthu soathiyungga'l.

theasaththilu'l'la ellaach si'rumaiyaanavarga'lea, karththarudaiya niyaayaththai nadappikki'ravarga'lea, avaraith theadungga'l; neethiyaith theadungga'l, manaththaazhmaiyaith theadungga'l; appozhuthu oruvea'lai karththarudaiya koabaththinnaa'lilea ma'raikkappaduveerga'l.
kaathsaa kudiyat'ru, askaloan paazhaagum; asthoaththaip pattappagalilea pa'rakkadippaarga'l; ekroan vearoadea pidunggappadum.

samuththirakkarai kudiga'laagiya kireaththiyarukku aiyoa! pelistharin theasamaagiya kaanaanea, karththarudaiya vaarththai unakku viroathamaayirukki'rathu; ini unnil kudiyillaathapadikku unnai azhippean.
samuththirakkarai theasam meayppar thanggum kudilga'lum aattuththoazhangga'lumaagum.

anthath theasam yoothaa vamsaththaaril meethiyaanavarga'lin vasamaagum; avarga'l avvidangga'lil manthai meayppaarga'l; askaloanin veeduga'lilea saayanggaalaththilea paduththukko'lvaarga'l; avarga'ludaiya theavanaagiya karththar avarga'lai visaariththu, avarga'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppuvaar.
moavaab seytha ninthanaiyaiyum, ammoan puththirar en janaththai ninthiththu, avarga'l ellaiyaik kadanthu perumaipaaraattich sonna thoosha'nangga'laiyum keattean.

aagaiyaal moavaab soathoamaippoalum, ammoan puththirarin theasam komoaraavaippoalumaagi, kaagncho'ri padarum idamum, uppuppa'l'lamum, niththiya paazhumaayirukkum; en janaththil meenthavarga'l avarga'laik ko'l'laiyittu, en jaathiyil meethiyaanavarga'l avarga'laich suthanthariththukko'lvaarga'l enbathai en jeevanaikko'ndu sollugi'rean en'ru isravealin theavanaagiya seanaiga'lin karththar uraikki'raar.
avarga'l seanaiga'ludaiya karththarin janaththukku viroathamaayp perumaipaaraatti avarga'lai ninthiththapadiyinaal, ithu avarga'l aganggaaraththukkup bathilaaga avarga'lukkuk kidaikkum.

karththar avarga'lmeal kediyaayiruppaar; boomiyilu'l'la theavarga'laiyellaam melinthupoagappa'n'nuvaar; appozhuthu theevuga'lilu'l'la sagala pu'rajaathiga'lum avaravar thangga'l thangga'l sthaanaththilirunthu avaraip pa'ninthuko'lvaarga'l.
eththiyoappiyaraagiya neengga'lum en pattayaththinaal kolaiseyyappaduveerga'l.
avar thamathu kaiyai vadatheasaththukku viroathamaay neetti, aseeriyaavai azhiththu, niniveayaip paazhum vanaantharaththukkoththa va'radchiyumaana sthalamaakkuvaar.

athin naduvil manthaiga'lum jaathijaathiyaana sagala mirugangga'lum paduththukko'l'lum; athinudaiya sigarangga'linmeal naaraiyum koattaanum iraaththanggum; palaga'niga'lil koovugi'ra saththam pi'rakkum; vaasa'rpadiga'lil paazhkkadippu irukkum; keathurumarangga'lin machchaith thi'rappaakkippoaduvaar.

naanthaan, ennaiththavira vea'roruvarum illai en'ru than iruthayaththil solli, nirvisaaramaay vaazhnthu ka'likoornthiruntha nagaram ithuvea; ithu paazhum mirugajeevanga'lin thaabaramumaayppoayvittathea! athin vazhiyaayppoagi'ravan evanum eesal poattuth than kaiyaik kottuvaan.
idukka'n seythu, ooththaiyum azhukkumaayirukki'ra nagaraththukku aiyoa!
athu saththaththukkuch sevikodukkavillai; athu kadinthuko'l'luthalai eat'rukko'l'lavillai; athu karththarai nambavillai; athu than theavanidaththil searavillai.

atha'rku'l'lea irukki'ra athin athibathiga'l kerchchikki'ra singgangga'l; athin niyaayaathibathiga'l saayanggaalaththil pu'rappadugi'rathum vidiya'rkaalamattum oru elumbaiyum meethiyaaga vaikkaathathumaana oanaayga'l.
athin theerkkatharisiga'l vee'nperumaiyum vagnchagamumu'l'lavarga'l; athin aasaariyarga'l parisuththa sthalaththaip parisuththakkulaichchalaakki, veathaththukku aniyaayagnseythaarga'l.

atha'rku'l irukki'ra karththar neethiyu'l'lavar; avar aniyaayagnseyvathillai; avar ku'raivillaamal kaalaithoa'rum thammudaiya niyaayaththai vi'langgappa'n'nugi'raar; aniyaayakkaaranoa vedkam a'riyaan.

jaathiga'laich sanggariththean; avarga'l thurugangga'l paazhaayina; avarga'ludaiya veethiga'lai oruvarum kadanthupoagaathapadikkup paazhaakkinean; avarga'ludaiya patta'nangga'l manushar illaathapadikkum kudiyillaathapadikkum avaantharaiyaayina.

un vaasasthalam nirmoolamaagaathapadikku nee enakkup bayanthu, kadinthuko'l'luthalai eat'rukko'l en'rean; naan avarga'lai eppadith tha'ndiththaalum, avarga'l athikaalaiyil ezhunthu thangga'l kiriyaiga'laiyellaam keadaakkinaarga'l.

aagaiyaal naan ko'l'laiyaada ezhumbum naa'lmattum enakkuk kaaththirungga'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; en sinamaagiya ukkira koabaththaiyellaam avarga'lmeal soriyumpadi jaathiga'laich searkkavum, raajyangga'laik koottavum naan theermaanampa'n'ninean; boomiyellaam en erichchalin akkiniyinaal azhiyum.
appozhuthu janangga'lellaarum karththarudaiya naamaththaith thozhuthuko'ndu, orumanappattu avarukku aaraathanai seyyumpadikku, naan avarga'l baashaiyaich suththamaana baashaiyaaga maa'rappa'n'nuvean.
eththiyoappiyaavin nathiga'lukku akkaraiyilirunthu ennidaththil vi'n'nappampa'n'nugi'ravarga'laagiya sitha'radikkappattavarga'lin kumaaraththiyaanava'l enakkuk kaa'nikkai ko'nduvaruvaa'l.

enakku viroathamaayth thuroagampa'n'ni, nee seytha un ellaak kiriyaiga'linimiththamum annaa'lilea vedkappadaathiruppaay; appozhuthu naan un perumaiyaikku'riththuk ka'likoornthavarga'lai un naduvilirunthu vilakkividuvean; nee ini en parisuththa parvathaththil aganggaarangko'l'lamaattaay.
un naduvil si'rumaiyum e'limaiyumaana janaththai meethiyaaga vaippean; avarga'l karththarudaiya naamaththinmeal nambikkaiyaayiruppaarga'l.

isravealil meethiyaanavarga'l aniyaayagnseyvathillai; avarga'l poy peasuvathumillai; vagnchaganaavu avarga'l vaayil ka'ndupidikkappaduvathumillai; avarga'l thangga'laip bayappaduththuvaarillaamal pusiththup paduththukko'lvaarga'l.
seeyoan kumaaraththiyea, kembeeriththuppaadu; isravealarea, aarppariyungga'l; erusaleam kumaaraththiyea, nee muzhu iruthayaththoadum magizhnthu ka'likooru.
karththar un aakkinaiga'lai agat'ri, un saththurukka'lai vilakkinaar; isravealin raajaavaagiya karththar un naduvilea irukki'raar; inith theenggaik kaa'naathiruppaay.
annaa'lilea erusaleamaip paarththu, bayappadaathea en'rum, seeyoanaip paarththu, un kaiga'laith tha'laravidaathea en'rum sollappadum.

un theavanaagiya karththar un naduvil irukki'raar; avar vallamaiyu'l'lavar, avar iradchippaar; avar unpearil santhoashamaay magizhnthu, thammudaiya anbinimiththam amarnthiruppaar; avar unpearil kembeeramaayk ka'likooruvaar.
un sabaiyin manusharaayirunthu, pa'ndigai aasarippillaamaiyaal u'ndaana ninthaiyinimiththam sagnchalappattavarga'lai naan eagamaayk koottikko'l'luvean.

ithoa, akkaalaththilea unnaich si'rumaippaduththina yaavaraiyum tha'ndippean; no'ndiyaanavanai iradchiththu, tha'l'lu'ndavanaich searththukko'l'luvean; avarga'l vedkam anubaviththa sagala theasangga'lilum avarga'lukkup pugazhchchiyum keerththiyum u'ndaagach seyvean.

akkaalaththilea ungga'laik koottikko'nduvaruvean; akkaalaththilea ungga'laich searththukko'l'luvean; ungga'l ka'nkaa'na naan ungga'l si'raiyiruppaith thiruppumpoathu, boomiyilu'l'la sagala janangga'lukku'l'lum naan ungga'laik keerththiyum pugazhchchiyumaaga vaippean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.

raajaavaagiya thariyu arasaa'nda ira'ndaam varusham aa'raam maatham muthalaantheathiyilea, karththarudaiya vaarththai aagaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaay seyalththiyealin kumaaranaagiya serubaabeal ennum yoothaavin thalaivanukkum, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaagiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanukkum u'ndaagi, avar sonnathu ennaven'raal:
intha janangga'l karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattugi'ratha'rku eat'rakaalam innum varavillai engi'raarga'l en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
aanaalum aagaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaayk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaagi, avar sollugi'raar:
intha veedu paazhaayk kidakkumpoathu, neengga'l machchuppaavappatta ungga'l veeduga'lil kudiyirukkumpadiyaana kaalam ithuvoa?
ippoathum seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar: ungga'l vazhiga'laich sinthiththuppaarungga'l.

neengga'l thira'laay vithaiththum kognchamaay a'ruththukko'nduvarugi'reerga'l; neengga'l pusiththum thirupthiyaagavillai; kudiththum paripoora'namadaiyavillai; neengga'l vasthiram uduththiyum oruvanukkum ku'lirvidavillai; kooliyaich sambaathikki'ravan poththalaana paiyilea poadugi'ravanaay athaich sambaathikki'raan.
ungga'l vazhiga'laich sinthiththup paarungga'l en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
neengga'l malaiyinmeal ea'rippoay, marangga'lai vettikko'nduvanthu, aalayaththaik kattungga'l; athinpearil naan piriyamaayiruppean, athinaal en magimai vi'langgum en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.

athigamaay varumen'ru neengga'l ethirpaarththirunthum, ithoa, kogncham kidaiththathu; neengga'l a'ruththu veettukkuk ko'nduvanthum, naan athai oothippoadugi'rean; ethinimiththamen'raal, en veedu paazhaaykkidakkumpoathu, neengga'l ellaarum avanavan than than veetti'rku oadippoagi'reerga'lea, ithinimiththamea en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
aathalaal ungga'lmeal irukki'ra vaanam paniyaip peyyaamalum, boomi palanaik kodaamalum poayit'ru.

naan nilaththinmealum, malaiga'linmealum, thaaniyaththinmealum, puthu thiraadcharasaththinmealum, e'n'neyinmealum, boomiyil vi'laigi'ra ellaavat'rinmealum, manusharinmealum, mirugangga'linmealum, kaippaadu anaiththinmealum va'radchiyai varuviththean en'raar.

appozhuthu seyalththiyealin kumaaranaagiya serubaabealum, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaagiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanum, janaththil meethiyaana anaivarum thangga'l theavanaagiya karththarudaiya saththaththukkum, thangga'l theavanaagiya karththar anuppina aagaay ennum theerkkatharisiyinudaiya vaarththaiga'lukkum sevikoduththaarga'l, janangga'l karththarukku munbaagap bayanthirunthaarga'l.
appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothanaagiya aagaay, karththar thoothanuppiya vaarththaiyinpadi janangga'lai noakki: naan ungga'loadea irukki'rean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar en'raan.

pinbu karththar seyalththiyealin kumaaranaagiya serubaabeal ennum yoothaavin thalaivanudaiya aaviyaiyum, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaagiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanudaiya aaviyaiyum, janaththil meethiyaana ellaarudaiya aaviyaiyum ezhuppinaar; avarga'l vanthu, thangga'l theavanaagiya seanaiga'ludaiya karththarin aalayaththilea vealaiseythaarga'l.
thariyu raajaavin ira'ndaam varusham aa'raam maatham irubaththunaalaantheathiyilea ithu nadanthathu.
eazhaam maatham irubaththoaraantheathiyilea aagaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaay, karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaayit'ru; avar:

nee seyalththiyealin kumaaranaagiya serubaabeal ennum yoothaavin thalaivanoadum, yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaagiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanoadum, janaththil meethiyaanavarga'loadum sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal:

intha aalayaththin munthina magimaiyaik ka'ndavarga'lil ungga'lukku'l'lea meenthirukki'ravarga'l yaar? ippozhuthu ithu ungga'lukku eppadik kaa'ngi'rathu? atha'rku ithu ungga'l paarvaiyil on'rumillaathathupoal kaa'ngi'rathallavaa?

aanaalum serubaabealea, nee thidanko'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; yoathsathaakkin kumaaranaagiya yoasuvaa ennum pirathaana aasaariyanea, nee thidanko'l; theasaththin ellaa janangga'lea, neengga'l thidanko'l'lungga'l, vealaiyai nadaththungga'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; naan ungga'ludanea irukki'rean en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
neengga'l egipthilirunthu pu'rappadugi'rapoathu naan ungga'loadea udanpadikkaipa'n'nina vaarththaiyinpadiyea, en aaviyaanavarum ungga'l naduvil nilaiko'ndiruppaar; bayappadaatheayungga'l.
seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar: kognchakkaalaththukku'l'lea innum orutharam naan vaanaththaiyum boomiyaiyum samuththiraththaiyum vettaantharaiyaiyum asaiyappa'n'nuvean.
sagala jaathiga'laiyum asaiyappa'n'nuvean, sagala jaathiga'laalum virumbappattavar varuvaar; intha aalayaththai magimaiyinaal ni'raiyappa'n'nuvean en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.
ve'l'liyum ennudaiyathu, ponnum ennudaiyathu en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.

munthina aalayaththin magimaiyaippaarkkilum, inthap pinthina aalayaththin magimai perithaayirukkum en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar; ivvidaththilea samaathaanaththaik katta'laiyiduvean en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
thariyuvin ira'ndaam varusham onbathaam maatham irubaththunaalaantheathiyilea, aagaay ennum theerkkatharisiyin moolamaayk karththarudaiya vaarththai u'ndaayit'ru; avar:

oruvan than vasthiraththin thonggalilea parisuththa maamsaththaik ko'ndupoagaiyil than vasthiraththin thonggal appaththaiyaagilum, saathaththaiyaagilum, thiraadcharasaththaiyaagilum, e'n'neyaiyaagilum, mat'rentha poajanapathaarththaththaiyaagilum thottaal athu parisuththamaagumoa en'ru nee aasaariyaridaththil veatha niyaayaththaippat'rik kea'l en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar en'raar.
atha'rku aasaariyarga'l pirathiyuththaramaaga: parisuththamaagaathu en'raarga'l.
pi'naththaal theettuppattavan avaiga'lil ethaiyaagilum thottaal, athu theettuppadumoa en'ru aagaay pinnum keattaan; atha'rku aasaariyarga'l pirathiyuththaramaaga: theettuppadum en'raarga'l.

appozhuthu aagaay: appadiyea intha janangga'lum intha jaathiyaarum en samugaththil irukki'raarga'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; avarga'ludaiya kaiga'lin ellaak kiriyaiga'lum appadiyea irukki'rathu; avarga'l anggea ko'nduvanthu padaikki'rathum theettuppattirukki'rathu.
ippoathum karththarudaiya aalayaththaik kattumpadi oru kallinmeal oru kal vaikkappattathu muthal nadanthathai ungga'l manathilea sinthiththuppaarungga'l.

antha naadka'l muthal oruvan irubathu marakkaalaagak ka'nda ambaaraththinidaththil vanthapoathu, paththu marakkaalmaaththiram irunthathu; oruvan aalaiyin thottiyil aimbathu kudam mo'l'la aalaiyinidaththilea vanthapoathu irubathu kudammaaththiram irunthathu.

karukkaayinaalum vishappaniyinaalum kalmazhaiyinaalum ungga'lai ungga'l kaiga'lin vealaiyilellaam adiththean; aanaalum neengga'l ennidaththil manathaith thiruppaamal poaneerga'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.

ippoathum itha'rku munthinakaalaththil nadanthathai ungga'l manathilea sinthiththuppaarungga'l; onbathaam maatham irubaththunaalaantheathiyaagiya innaa'lmuthal karththarudaiya aalayaththin asthibaaram poadappatta annaa'lvaraikkum sen'rakaalaththil nadanthathai ungga'l manathilea sinthiththuppaarungga'l.

ka'lagnchiyaththil innum vithaiththaaniyam u'ndoa? thiraadchachsediyum aththimaramum maatha'lagnsediyum olivamaramum kanikodukkavillaiyea; naan in'rumuthal ungga'lai aaseervathippean en'ru sollugi'raar en'raan.
irubaththunaalaantheathiyaagiya annaa'lilea karththarudaiya vaarththai ira'ndaam visai aagaay enbavanukku u'ndaagi, avar:
nee yoothaavin thalaivanaagiya serubaabealoadea sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, naan vaanaththaiyum boomiyaiyum asaiyappa'n'ni,

raajyangga'lin singgaasanaththaik kavizhththu, jaathiga'ludaiya raajyangga'lin belaththai azhiththu, irathaththaiyum athil ea'riyirukki'ravarga'laiyum kavizhththuppoaduvean; kuthiraiga'loadea avaiga'linmeal ea'riyiruppavarga'lum avaravar thangga'l thangga'l sagoatharanin pattayaththinaalea vizhuvaarga'l.

seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar: seyalththiyealin kumaaranaagiya serubaabeal ennum en oozhiyakkaaranea, unnai naan annaa'lilea searththukko'ndu, unnai muththirai moathiramaaga vaippean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; naan unnaith therinthuko'ndean en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar uraikki'raar en'ru sol en'raar.
thariyu arasaa'nda ira'ndaam varusham ettaam maathaththilea iththoavin maganaana berakiyaavin kumaaranaagiya sagariyaavukku u'ndaana karththarudaiya vaarththai:
karththar ungga'l pithaakka'linmeal kadungkoabamaayirunthaar.

aagaiyaal nee avarga'lai noakki: seanaiga'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: ennidaththil thirumbungga'l en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar; appozhuthu naan ungga'lidaththukkuth thirumbuvean en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar.

ungga'l pithaakka'laippoaliraatheayungga'l; munthina theerkkatharisiga'l avarga'lai noakki: ungga'l pollaatha vazhiga'laiyum ungga'l pollaatha kiriyaiga'laiyum vittuth thirumbungga'l en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar en'ru kooppittaarga'l; aanaalum enakkuch sevikodaamalum ennaik kavaniyaamalum poanaarga'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
ungga'l pithaakka'l enggea? theerkkatharisiga'l en'ren'raikkum uyiroadiruppaarga'loa?

iraama'rpoanaalum, theerkkatharisiga'laagiya en oozhiyakkaararukku naan katta'laiyitta en vaarththaiga'lum en theermaanangga'lum ungga'l pithaakka'lidaththil palikkavillaiyoa? engga'l vazhiga'linpadiyeayum, engga'l kiriyaiga'linpadiyeayum seanaiga'lin karththar engga'lukkuch seyya nir'nayiththapadiyea engga'lukkuch seythaaren'ru avarga'l thirumbavanthu sonnathillaiyoa en'ru sol en'raar.

thariyu arasaa'nda ira'ndaam varusham, seabaath maathamaagiya pathinoaraam maatham irubaththunaalaantheathiyilea, karththarudaiya vaarththai iththoavin maganaana berakiyaavin kumaaran sagariyaa ennum theerkkatharisikku u'ndaayit'ru; avan sonnathu:

ithoa, in'ru raaththiri sivappuk kuthiraiyinmeal ea'riyiruntha oru purushanaik ka'ndean; avar pa'l'laththaakkil irukki'ra miruthuchsediga'lukku'l'lea nin'raar; avarukkup pinnaalea sivappum manggina ni'ramum ve'nmaiyumaana kuthiraiga'l irunthana.
appozhuthu naan: en aa'ndavarea, ivarga'l yaaren'ru keattean; ennoadea peasugi'ra thoothanaanavar: ivarga'l yaaren'ru naan unakkuk kaa'nbippean en'ru sonnaar.
appozhuthu miruthuchsediga'lukku'l'lea nin'ra anthap purushan pirathiyuththaramaaga: ivarga'l boomiyenggum sut'rippaarkkak karththar anuppinavarga'l en'raar.

pinbu avarga'l miruthuchsediga'lukku'l'lea nin'ra karththarudaiya thoothanai noakki: naangga'l boomiyenggum sut'rippaarththoam; ithoa, boomi muzhuvathum amaithalum amarikkaiyumaay irukki'rathu en'raarga'l.

appozhuthu karththarudaiya thoothan ma'rumozhiyaaga: seanaiga'lin karththaavea, intha ezhubathu varushamaay neer koabangko'ndirukki'ra erusaleaminmealum yoothaa patta'nangga'linmealum enthamattum iranggaathiruppeer en'ru solla,
appozhuthu karththar, ennoadea peasina thoothanukku nalvaarththaiga'laiyum aa'ruthalaana vaarththaiga'laiyum pirathiyuththaramaagach sonnaar.
appozhuthu ennoadea peasina thoothan ennai noakki: seanaiga'lin karththar uraikki'rathu ennaven'raal: naan erusaleamukkaagavum seeyoanukkaagavum mahaa vairaakkiyam ko'ndirukki'rean.
naan kognchang koabangko'ndirunthapoathu avarga'l thangga'l keattai athigarikkath theadinapadiyinaal, sugamaay vaazhugi'ra pu'rajaathiga'lpearil naan kadungkoabangko'ndean.

aagaiyaal manaurukkaththoadea erusaleaminidaththil thirumbinean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; en aalayam athilea kattappadum; erusaleaminmeal a'lavunool pidikkappadum en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar en'ru koo'ru en'raar.

innum en patta'nangga'l nanmaiyinaal parambiyirukkum; innum karththar seeyoanaith theat'raravupa'n'nuvaar; innum erusaleamaith therinthuko'l'luvaar en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar en'ru pinnum koo'ru en'raar.
naan en ka'nga'lai ea'reduththup paarththapoathu, ithoa, naalu kombuga'laik ka'ndean.
avaiga'l ennaven'ru ennoadea peasina thoothanaik keattean; atha'rku avar: ivaiga'l yoothaavaiyum isravealaiyum erusaleamaiyum sitha'radiththa kombuga'l en'raar.
pinbu karththar enakku naalu thozhilaa'liga'laik kaa'nbiththaar.

ivarga'l ennaseyya varugi'raarga'len'ru keattean; atha'rku avar: oruvanum than thalaiyai ea'redukkakkoodaathapadi anthak kombuga'l yoothaavaich sitha'radiththathea, avaiga'lukkup bayamu'ruththugi'ratha'rkum, yoothaavin theasaththaip paazhaakkath thangga'l kombai eduththa jaathiga'ludaiya kombuga'lai vizhaththa'l'lugi'ratha'rkum ivarga'l vanthaarga'l en'raar.
naan en ka'nga'lai ea'reduththup paarththapoathu, ithoa, than kaiyilea a'lavunool pidiththiruntha oru purushanaik ka'ndean.
neer evvidaththukkup poagi'reer en'ru keattean; atha'rku avar: erusaleamin agalam ivva'lavu en'rum athin nee'lam ivva'lavu en'rum a'riyumpadi athai a'lakki'ratha'rkup poagi'rean en'raar.
ithoa, ennoadea peasina thoothan pu'rappattapoathu, vea'roru thoothan avaraich santhikkumpadip pu'rappattuvanthaan.

ivanai avar noakki: nee oadi intha vaalibanidaththil sollavea'ndiyathu ennaven'raal, erusaleam than naduvilea koodum manusharin thira'linaalum mirugajeevanga'lin thira'linaalum mathilillaatha patta'nangga'lpoal vaasasthalamaagum.
naan atha'rkuch sut'rilum akkini mathilaayirunthu, athin naduvil magimaiyaaga iruppean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
oahoa, neengga'l ezhumbi vadatheasaththilirunthu oadivaarungga'l en'ru karththar sollugi'raar; aagaayaththu naangu thisaiga'lilum ungga'lai naan sitha'rappa'n'ninean en'ru karththar sollugi'raar.
baabiloan kumaaraththiyinidaththil kudiyirukki'ra seeyoanea, unnai viduviththukko'l.

pi'rpaadu magimaiyu'ndaagum en'ru seanaiga'lin karththar sollugi'raar; ungga'laik ko'l'laiyitta jaathiga'lidaththukku ennai anuppinaar; ungga'laith thodugi'ravan avarudaiya ka'nma'niyaith thodugi'raan.
