naan ettaam naa'lil viruththaseathanamadainthavan, israveal vamsaththaan, benyameen koaththiraththaan, ebireyaril pi'rantha ebireyan, niyaayappiramaa'naththinpadi pariseayan;
bakthivairaakkiyaththinpadi sabaiyaith thunbappaduththinavan, niyaayappiramaa'naththi'rkuriya neethiyinpadi kut'ragnsaattappadaathavan.
aagilum, enakku laabamaayirunthavaiga'levaiga'loa avaiga'laik ki'risthuvukkaaga nashdamen'ru e'n'ninean.
athumaaththiramalla, en karththaraagiya ki'risthu iyeasuvai a'rigi'ra a'rivin meanmaikkaaga ellaavat'raiyum nashdamen'ru e'n'nikko'ndirukki'rean.

naan ki'risthuvai aathaayappaduththikko'l'lumpadikkum, niyaayappiramaa'naththinaal varugi'ra suyaneethiyai udaiyavanaayiraamal, ki'risthuvaip pat'rum visuvaasaththinaal varugi'rathum visuvaasamoolamaayth theavanaal u'ndaayirukki'rathumaana neethiyai udaiyavanaayirunthu, ki'risthuvukku'l irukki'ravanen'ru kaa'nappadumpadikkum,

ippadi naan avaraiyum avarudaiya uyirththezhuthalin vallamaiyaiyum, avarudaiya paaduga'lin aikkiyaththaiyum a'rigi'ratha'rkum, avarudaiya mara'naththi'rkoppaana mara'naththi'rku'l'laagi, eppadiyaayinum naan mariththoarilirunthu uyiroadezhunthiruppatha'rkuth thaguthiyaagumpadikkum,
avarukkaaga ellaavat'raiyum nashdamen'ru vittean; kuppaiyumaaga e'n'nugi'rean.
naan adainthaayit'ru, allathu mut'rum thea'rinavanaanean en'ru e'n'naamal, ki'risthu iyeasuvinaal naan etha'rkaagap pidikkappatteanoa athai naan pidiththukko'l'lumpadi aasaiyaayth thodarugi'rean.
sagoathararea, athaip pidiththukko'ndeanen'ru naan e'n'nugi'rathillai; on'ru seygi'rean, pinnaanavaiga'lai ma'ranthu, munnaanavaiga'lai naadi,
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l theavan azhaiththa parama azhaippin panthayapporu'lukkaaga ilakkai noakkith thodarugi'rean.
aagaiyaal, nammil thea'rinavarga'l yaavarum inthach sinthaiyaayirukkakkadavoam; enthak kaariyaththilaavathu neengga'l vea'rea sinthaiyaayirunthaal, athaiyum theavan ungga'lukku ve'lippaduththuvaar.
aagilum naam ethuvaraiyil thea'riyirukki'roamoa, athumuthal orea ozhunggaay nadanthuko'ndu, orea sinthaiyaayiruppoamaaga.
sagoathararea, neengga'l ennoadeakoodap pinpat'rugi'ravarga'laagi, naangga'l ungga'lukku vazhikaattugi'rapadi nadakki'ravarga'lai maathiriyaaga noakkungga'l.
eanenil, aneagar vea'ruvithamaay nadakki'raarga'l; avarga'l ki'risthuvin siluvaikkup pagaignaren'ru ungga'lukku aneagantharam sonnean, ippozhuthu ka'n'neeroadum sollugi'rean.
avarga'ludaiya mudivu azhivu, avarga'ludaiya theavan vayi'ru, avarga'ludaiya magimai avarga'ludaiya ilachchaiyea, avarga'l boomikkaduththavaiga'laich sinthikki'raarga'l.
nammudaiya kudiyiruppoa paraloagaththilirukki'rathu, anggeayirunthu karththaraayirukki'ra iyeasuki'risthu ennum iradchagar vara ethirpaarththukko'ndirukki'roam.

avar ellaavat'raiyum thamakkuk keezhppaduththikko'l'laththakka thammudaiya vallamaiyaana seyalinpadiyea, nammudaiya a'rpamaana sareeraththaith thammudaiya magimaiyaana sareeraththi'rku oppaaga ma'ruroobappaduththuvaar.
aathalaal, enakkup piriyamum vaagnchaiyumaana sagoathararea, enakkuch santhoashamum kireedamumaanavarga'lea, piriyamaanavarga'lea, inthappadiyea karththarukku'l nilaiththirungga'l.
karththarukku'l orea sinthaiyaayirukka eyoathiyaa'lukkum sinthikeayaa'lukkum buththisollugi'rean.

an'riyum, en uththama koottaa'liyea, avarga'lukku uthaviyaayirukkumpadi unnaiyum vea'ndikko'l'lugi'rean; avarga'l kileamenthoadum mat'ra en udanvealaiyaadka'loadungkoodach suviseasha vishayaththil ennoadeakooda migavum pirayaasappattaarga'l, avarga'ludaiya naamangga'l jeevapusthagaththil irukki'rathu.
karththarukku'l eppozhuthum santhoashamaayirungga'l; santhoashamaayirungga'l en'ru ma'rupadiyum sollugi'rean.
ungga'l saanthaku'nam ellaa manusharukkum therinthiruppathaaga. karththar sameebamaayirukki'raar.
neengga'l on'rukkung kavalaippadaamal, ellaavat'raiyungku'riththu ungga'l vi'n'nappangga'lai sthoaththiraththoadea koodiya jebaththinaalum vea'nduthalinaalum theavanukkuth theriyappaduththungga'l.
appozhuthu, ellaap buththikkum mealaana theavasamaathaanam ungga'l iruthayangga'laiyum ungga'l sinthaiga'laiyum ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laagak kaaththukko'l'lum.

kadaisiyaaga, sagoathararea, u'nmaiyu'l'lavaiga'levaiga'loa, ozhukkamu'l'lavaiga'levaiga'loa, neethiyu'l'lavaiga'levaiga'loa, ka'rpu'l'lavaiga'levaiga'loa, anbu'l'lavaiga'levaiga'loa, na'rkeerththiyu'l'lavaiga'levaiga'loa, pu'n'niyam ethuvoa, pugazh ethuvoa avaiga'laiyea sinthiththukko'ndirungga'l.
neengga'l ennidaththil kat'rum adainthum keattum ka'ndum irukki'ravaiga'levaiga'loa, avaiga'laiyea seyyungga'l; appozhuthu samaathaanaththin theavan ungga'loadiruppaar.

ennai visaarippatha'rku neengga'l ippozhuthu ma'rupadiyum manamalarnthapadiyinaalea karththarukku'l migavum santhoashappattean; ippadich seyya e'n'nangko'ndiruntheerga'l, samayammaaththiram ungga'lukku nearidavillai.
en ku'raichchalinaal naan ippadich sollugi'rathillai; eanenil naan entha nilaimaiyilirunthaalum manarammiyamaayirukkak kat'rukko'ndean.

thaazhnthirukkavum enakkuth theriyum, vaazhnthirukkavum enakkuth theriyum; evvidaththilum ellaavat'rilum thirupthiyaayirukkavum pattiniyaayirukkavum, paripoora'namadaiyavum ku'raivupadavum poathikkappattean.
ennaip belappaduththugi'ra ki'risthuvinaalea ellaavat'raiyugnseyya enakkup belanu'ndu.
aagilum neengga'l en ubaththiravaththil ennoadea udanpattathu nalamaayirukki'rathu.

mealum, pilippiyarea, suviseashaththin aarambaththilea naan makkethoaniyaavilirunthu pu'rappattapoathu, kodukkal vaanggal kaariyaththil neengga'lmaaththiram enakku udanpattatheayallaamal, vea'roru sabaiyum udanpadavillai en'ru neengga'l a'rinthirukki'reerga'l.
naan thesaloanikkeayilirunthapoathum, en ku'raichchalai neekkumpadi neengga'l ira'ndorutharam anuppineerga'l.
ubagaaraththai naan naadaamal, ungga'l ka'nakkukkup palan perugumpadiyea naadugi'rean.

ellaam enakkuk kidaiththathu, paripoora'namum u'ndaayirukki'rathu; ungga'laal anuppappattavaiga'laich sugantha vaasanaiyum theavanukkup piriyamaana ugantha baliyumaaga eppaappiroatheeththuvin kaiyil varappat'rikko'ndapadiyaal naan thirupthiyadainthirukki'rean.
en theavan thammudaiya aisuvariyaththinpadi ungga'l ku'raivaiyellaam ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l magimaiyilea ni'raivaakkuvaar.
nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanaanavarukku en'ren'raikkum magimai u'ndaavathaaga. aamen.
ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laana parisuththavaanga'l yaavarukkum vaazhththuthal sollungga'l. ennoadirukki'ra sagoathararga'l ungga'lukku vaazhththuthal sollugi'raarga'l.
parisuththavaanga'l anaivarum, viseashamaaga iraayanudaiya aramanaiyilu'l'lavarga'lum ungga'lukku vaazhththuthal sollugi'raarga'l.
namathu karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya kirubai ungga'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaga. aamen.
theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaagiya pavulum, sagoatharanaagiya theemoaththeayum,

koloase patta'naththil ki'risthuvukku'l parisuththavaanga'lum visuvaasiga'lumaayirukki'ra sagoathararga'lukku ezhuthugi'rathaavathu: nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanaalum karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungga'lukkuk kirubaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaga.
ki'risthu iyeasuvinmealu'l'la ungga'l visuvaasaththaiyum, parisuththavaanga'lellaarmealumu'l'la ungga'l anbaiyungku'riththu naangga'l kea'lvippattu,
paraloagaththil ungga'lukkaaga vaiththirukki'ra nambikkaiyinimiththam,
nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvin pithaavaagiya theavanukku sthoaththiragnseluththi, eppozhuthum ungga'lukkaaga vea'nduthal seygi'roam.

antha nambikkaiyaikku'riththu, neengga'l munnamea saththiyavasanamaagiya suviseashaththinaalea kea'lvippatteerga'l; anthach suviseasham ulagamenggum parambip palantharugi'rathupoala, ungga'lidaththilum vanthu, neengga'l athaik keattu, theavakirubaiyaich saththiyaththinpadi a'rinthuko'nda naa'lmuthal, athu ungga'lukku'l'lum palantharugi'rathaayirukki'rathu;
athai engga'lukkup piriyamaana udanvealaiyaa'lum, ungga'lukkaagak ki'risthuvin u'nmaiyaana oozhiyakkaaranumaayirukki'ra eppaappiraavinidaththil neengga'l kat'ra'rinthirukki'reerga'l;
aavikku'l'laana ungga'l anbaiyum avanea engga'lukkuth theriyappaduththinaan.

ithinimiththam, naangga'l athaik keatta naa'lmuthal ungga'lukkaaga idaividaamal jebampa'n'nugi'roam; neengga'l ellaa gnaanaththoadum, aavikkuriya viveagaththoadum avarudaiya siththaththai a'rigi'ra a'rivinaalea nirappappadavum,
sagalavitha na'rkiriyaiga'lumaagiya kaniga'laith thanthu, theavanai a'rigi'ra a'rivil viruththiyadainthu, karththarukkup piriyamu'ndaaga avarukkup paaththiraraay nadanthuko'l'lavum,

santhoashaththoadea koodiya ellaap po'rumaiyum neediyasaanthamum u'ndaavatha'rku, magimaiyaana avarudaiya vallamaiyinpadi, ellaa vallamaiyaalum balappaduththappadavum, ungga'lukkaaga vea'nduthalseygi'roam.
o'liyilu'l'la parisuththavaanga'ludaiya suthantharaththil panggadaivatha'rku, nammaith thaguthiyu'l'lavarga'laakkinavarum,
iru'lin athigaaraththinin'ru nammai viduthalaiyaakki, thamathu anbin kumaaranudaiya raajyaththi'rku udpaduththinavarumaayirukki'ra pithaavai sthoaththirikki'roam.
kumaaranaagiya avarukku'l, avarudaiya iraththaththinaalea, paavamannippaagiya meedpu namakku u'ndaayirukki'rathu.
avar atharisanamaana theavanudaiya tha'rsuroobamum, sarva sirushdikkum munthina pea'rumaanavar.

eanen'raal avarukku'l sagalamum sirushdikkappattathu; paraloagaththilu'l'lavaiga'lum booloagaththilu'l'lavaiga'lumaagiya kaa'nappadugi'ravaiga'lum kaa'nappadaathavaiga'lumaana sagala vasthukka'lum, singgaasanangga'laanaalum, karththaththuvangga'laanaalum, thuraiththanangga'laanaalum, athigaarangga'laanaalum, sagalamum avaraikko'ndum avarukken'rum sirushdikkappattathu.
avar ellaavat'ri'rkum munthinavar, ellaam avarukku'l nilaini'rki'rathu.
avarea sabaiyaagiya sareeraththukkuth thalaiyaanavar; ellaavat'rilum muthalvaraayirukkumpadi, avarea aathiyum mariththoarilirunthu ezhuntha mutha'rpea'rumaanavar.
sagala paripoora'namum avarukku'l'lea vaasamaayirukkavum,

avar siluvaiyil sinthina iraththaththinaalea samaathaanaththai u'ndaakki, booloagaththilu'l'lavaiga'l paraloagaththilu'l'lavaiga'l yaavaiyum avar moolamaayth thamakku oppuravaakkikko'l'lavum avarukkup piriyamaayit'ru.

munnea anniyaraayum thurkkiriyaiga'linaal manathilea saththurukka'laayum iruntha ungga'laiyum parisuththaraagavum kut'ramat'ravarga'laagavum ka'ndikkappadaathavarga'laagavum thamakku mun ni'ruththumpadiyaaga avarudaiya maamsa sareeraththil adaintha mara'naththinaalea ippozhuthu oppuravaakkinaar.
neengga'l keatta suviseashaththinaal u'ndaagum nambikkaiyaivittu asaiyaamal, sthiramaayum u'ruthiyaayum visuvaasaththilea nilaiththiruppeerga'laanaal appadiyaagum.
anthach suviseasham vaanaththin keezhirukki'ra sagala sirushdiga'lukkum pirasanggikkappattuvarugi'rathu; atha'rken'rea pavulaagiya naan oozhiyakkaaranaanean.

ippozhuthu naan ungga'lnimiththam anubavikki'ra paaduga'lil santhoashamadainthu, ki'risthuvinudaiya ubaththiravangga'lil ku'raivaanathai avarudaiya sareeramaagiya sabaikkaaga, en maamsaththilea ni'raiveat'rugi'rean.

aathikaalangga'lukkum thalaimu'rai thalaimu'raiga'lukkum ma'raivaayirunthu, ippozhuthu avarudaiya parisuththavaanga'lukku ve'liyaakkappatta iragasiyamaagiya theavavasanaththaip poora'namaayth theriyappaduththugi'ratha'rku,
ungga'lporuttuth theavanaal enakku a'likkappatta uththiyoagaththinpadiyea naan anthach sabaikku oozhiyakkaaranaanean.

pu'rajaathiga'lukku'l'lea vi'langgiya intha iragasiyaththilu'l'la magimaiyin aisuvariyam innathen'ru, theavan thammudaiya parisuththavaanga'lukkuth theriyappaduththach siththamaanaar; ki'risthuvaanavar magimaiyin nambikkaiyaaga ungga'lukku'l iruppathea antha iragasiyam.

entha manushanaiyum ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l thea'rinavanaaga ni'ruththumpadikku, avaraiyea naangga'l a'riviththu, entha manushanukkum buththisolli, entha manushanukkum ellaa gnaanaththoadum ubatheasampa'n'nugi'roam.
atha'rkaaga naan enakku'l'lea vallamaiyaayk kiriyai nadappikki'ra avarudaiya balaththinpadi poaraadip pirayaasappadugi'rean.

ungga'lukkaagavum lavoathikkeayaavilirukki'ravarga'lukkaagavum, sareeraththil en mugaththaik kaa'naathirukki'ra mat'rellaarukkaagavum miguntha poaraattam enakku u'nden'ru neengga'l a'riya virumbugi'rean.

avarga'ludaiya iruthayangga'l theat'rappattu, avarga'l anbinaal i'naikkappattu, pithaavaagiya theavanukkum ki'risthuvukkum uriya iragasiyaththai a'rinthuko'l'lugi'ra u'narvin poora'na nichchayaththinudaiya ellaa aisuvariyaththi'rkum uriyavarga'laagavea'ndumen'rea ippadi virumbugi'rean.
avarukku'l gnaanam a'rivu enbavaiga'laagiya pokkishangga'lellaam adanggiyirukki'rathu.
oruvanum nayavasanippinaalea ungga'lai vagnchiyaathapadikku ithaich sollugi'rean.

sareeraththinpadi naan thooramaayirunthum, aaviyinpadi ungga'ludaneakooda irunthu, ungga'l ozhunggaiyum, ki'risthuvinmealu'l'la ungga'l visuvaasaththin u'ruthiyaiyum paarththuch santhoashappadugi'rean.
aagaiyaal, neengga'l karththaraagiya ki'risthu iyeasuvai eat'rukko'ndapadiyea, avarukku'l vearko'ndavarga'laagavum, avarmeal kattappattavarga'laagavum, avarukku'l nadanthuko'ndu,
neengga'l poathikkappattapadiyea, visuvaasaththil u'ruthippattu, sthoaththiraththoadea athilea peruguveerga'laaga.

laugiga gnaanaththinaalum, maayamaana thanthiraththinaalum, oruvanum ungga'laik ko'l'laiko'ndupoagaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungga'l; athu manusharga'lin paarambariya niyaayaththaiyum ulagavazhipaaduga'laiyum pat'rinatheayallaamal ki'risthuvaip pat'rinathalla.
eanen'raal, theavaththuvaththin paripoora'namellaam sareerappiragaaramaaga avarukku'l vaasamaayirukki'rathu.
mealum sagala thuraiththanangga'lukkum athigaaraththukkum thalaivaraayirukki'ra avarukku'l neengga'l paripoora'namu'l'lavarga'laayirukki'reerga'l.

allaamalum, neengga'l ki'risthuvaippat'rum viruththaseathanaththinaalea maamsaththukkuriya paavasareeraththaik ka'lainthuvittathinaal, kaiyaal seyyappadaatha viruththaseathanaththai avarukku'l pet'reerga'l.

gnaanasnaanaththilea avaroadeakooda adakkampa'n'nappattavarga'laagavum, athilea avarai mariththoarilirunthezhuppina theavanudaiya seyalinmealu'l'la visuvaasaththinaalea avaroadeakooda ezhunthavarga'laagavum irukki'reerga'l.

ungga'l paavangga'linaaleayum, ungga'l maamsa viruththaseathanamillaamaiyinaaleayum mariththavarga'laayiruntha ungga'laiyum avaroadeakooda uyirppiththu, akkiramangga'lellaavat'raiyum ungga'lukku manniththu;
namakku ethiridaiyaagavum katta'laiga'laal namakku viroathamaagavum iruntha kaiyezhuththaik kulaiththu, athai naduviliraathapadikku eduththu, siluvaiyinmeal aa'niyadiththu;
thuraiththanangga'laiyum athigaarangga'laiyum urinthuko'ndu, ve'liyaranggamaana koalamaakki, avaiga'linmeal siluvaiyilea vet'risi'ranthaar.
aagaiyaal, poajanaththaiyum baanaththaiyum ku'riththaavathu, pa'ndigainaa'laiyum maathappi'rappaiyum oayvunaadka'laiyungku'riththaavathu, oruvanum ungga'laik kut'rappaduththaathiruppaanaaga.
avaiga'l varungkaariyangga'lukku nizhalaayirukki'rathu; avaiga'lin poru'l ki'risthuvaippat'rinathu.
ka'nukka'laalum kattuga'laalum uthavipet'ru i'naikkappattu, theavava'larchchiyaay va'larnthea'rugi'ra sareeramuzhuvathaiyum aatharikki'ra thalaiyaip pat'rikko'l'laamal,

maayamaana thaazhmaiyilum, theavathootharga'lukkuch seyyum aaraathanaiyilum viruppamut'ru, kaa'naathavaiga'lilea thu'nivaay nuzhainthu, than maamsasinthaiyinaalea vee'naay i'rumaappukko'ndirukki'ra evanum ungga'l panthayapporu'lai neengga'l izhanthupoagumpadi ungga'lai vagnchiyaathirukkappaarungga'l.
neengga'l ki'risthuvudaneakooda ulagaththin vazhipaaduga'lukku mariththathu'ndaanaal, innum ulaga vazhakkaththinpadi pizhaikki'ravarga'lpoala,
manusharudaiya ka'rpanaiga'linpadiyum poathanaiga'linpadiyum nadanthu: thodaathea, rusipaaraathea, thee'ndaathea engi'ra katta'laiga'lukku udpadugi'rathenna?
ivaiyellaam anubavikki'rathinaal azhinthupoagumea.

ippadippatta poathanaiga'l suya ishdamaana aaraathanaiyaiyum, maayamaana thaazhmaiyaiyum, sareera odukkaththaiyumpat'ri gnaanamengi'ra pearko'ndirunthaalum, ivaiga'l maamsaththaip pea'nugi'ratha'rkea ozhiya mat'ron'ri'rkum pirayoajanappadaathu.
neengga'l ki'risthuvudankooda ezhunthathu'ndaanaal, ki'risthu theavanudaiya valathupaarisaththil veet'rirukkum idaththilu'l'la mealaanavaiga'laith theadungga'l.
boomiyilu'l'lavaiga'laiyalla, mealaanavaiga'laiyea naadungga'l.
eanen'raal, neengga'l mariththeerga'l, ungga'l jeevan ki'risthuvudanea theavanukku'l ma'rainthirukki'rathu.
nammudaiya jeevanaagiya ki'risthu ve'lippadumpoathu, neengga'lum avaroadeakooda magimaiyilea ve'lippaduveerga'l.
aagaiyaal, vibasaaram, asuththam, moagam, thurichchai, vikkiragaaraathanaiyaana poru'laasai aagiya ivaiga'laip boomiyil u'ndupa'n'nugi'ra ungga'l avayavangga'lai azhiththuppoadungga'l.
ivaiga'linporuttea keezhppadiyaamaiyin pi'l'laiga'lmeal theavakoabaakkinai varum.
neengga'lum mu'rkaalaththil avarga'lukku'l'lea sagnchariththapoathu, avaiga'laich seythuko'nduvantheerga'l.
ippozhuthoa koabamum moorkkamum po'raamaiyum, ungga'l vaayil pi'rakkalaagaatha thoosha'namum vambu vaarththaiga'lumaagiya ivaiga'laiyellaam vittuvidungga'l.
oruvarukkoruvar poy sollaathirungga'l; pazhaiya manushanaiyum avan seygaiga'laiyum ka'lainthupoattu,
thannaich sirushdiththavarudaiya saayalukkoppaayp poora'na a'rivadaiyumpadi puthithaakkappatta puthiya manushanaith thariththukko'ndirukki'reerga'lea.

athilea kireakkanen'rum yoothanen'rumillai, viruththaseathanamu'l'lavanen'rum viruththaseathanamillaathavanen'rumillai, pu'rajaathiyaanen'rum pu'ratheasaththaanen'rumillai, adimaiyen'rum suyaatheenanen'rumillai; ki'risthuvea ellaarilum ellaamumaayirukki'raar.

aagaiyaal, neengga'l theavanaal therinthuko'l'lappatta parisuththarum piriyarumaay, urukkamaana irakkaththaiyum, thayavaiyum, manaththaazhmaiyaiyum, saanthaththaiyum, neediya po'rumaiyaiyum thariththukko'ndu;
oruvaraiyoruvar thaanggi, oruvarpearil oruvarukkuk ku'raipaadu u'ndaanaal, ki'risthu ungga'lukku manniththathupoala, oruvarukkoruvar manniyungga'l.
ivai ellaavat'rinmealum, poora'na sa'rku'naththin kattaagiya anbaith thariththukko'l'lungga'l.
theavasamaathaanam ungga'l iruthayangga'lil aa'lakkadavathu, itha'rken'rea neengga'l orea sareeramaaga azhaikkappatteerga'l; nan'riya'rithalu'l'lavarga'laayumirungga'l.

ki'risthuvin vasanam ungga'lukku'l'lea sagala gnaanaththoadum paripoora'namaaga vaasamaayiruppathaaga; sanggeethangga'linaalum keerththanaiga'linaalum gnaanappaattuga'linaalum oruvarukkoruvar poathiththup buththisollikko'ndu, ungga'l iruthayaththilea karththaraip bakthiyudan paadi;

vaarththaiyinaalaavathu kiriyaiyinaalaavathu, neengga'l ethaich seythaalum, athaiyellaam karththaraagiya iyeasuvin naamaththinaalea seythu, avar munnilaiyaagap pithaavaagiya theavanai sthoaththiriyungga'l.
manaiviga'lea, karththarukkea'rkumpadi, ungga'l purusharukkuk keezhppadiyungga'l.
purusharga'lea, ungga'l manaiviga'lil anbukoorungga'l, avarga'lmeal kasanthuko'l'laathirungga'l.
pi'l'laiga'lea, ungga'laip pet'raarukku ellaak kaariyaththileayum keezhppadiyungga'l; ithu karththarukkup piriyamaanathu.
pithaakka'lea, ungga'l pi'l'laiga'l thidanat'ruppoagaathapadi, avarga'lukkuk koabamoottaathirungga'l.

vealaikkaararea, sareeraththinpadi ungga'l ejamaanga'laayirukki'ravarga'lukku ellaak kaariyaththileayum keezhppadinthu, neengga'l manusharukkup piriyamaayirukka virumbugi'ravarga'laagap paarvaikku oozhiyagnseyyaamal, theavanukkup bayappadugi'ravarga'laagak kabadamillaatha iruthayaththoadea oozhiyagnseyyungga'l.
neengga'l karththaraagiya ki'risthuvaich seavikki'rathinaalea, suthantharamaagiya palanaik karththaraalea pe'ruveerga'len'ru a'rinthu,
ethaich seythaalum, athai manusharga'lukken'ru seyyaamal, karththarukken'rea manappoorvamaaych seyyungga'l.
aniyaayagnseygi'ravan thaan seytha aniyaayaththukkeat'ra palanai adaivaan; padchapaathamea illai.
ejamaanga'lea, ungga'lukkum paraloagaththil ejamaan irukki'raaren'ru a'rinthu, vealaikkaararukku neethiyum sevvaiyumaanathaich seyyungga'l.
idaividaamal jebampa'n'nungga'l, sthoaththiraththudan jebaththil vizhiththirungga'l.
ki'risthuvinudaiya iragasiyaththinimiththam kattappattirukki'ra naan antha iragasiyaththaikku'riththup peasavea'ndiyapiragaaramaayp peasi, athai ve'lippaduththuvatha'rku,
thiruvasanam sellumpadiyaana vaasalaith theavan thi'rantharu'lumpadi engga'lukkaagavum vea'ndikko'l'lungga'l.
pu'rambeayirukki'ravarga'lukku munbaaga gnaanamaay nadanthu, kaalaththaip pirayoajanappaduththikko'l'lungga'l.
avanavanukku inninnapadi uththaravu sollavea'ndumen'ru neengga'l a'riyumpadikku, ungga'l vasanam eppozhuthum kirubai porunthinathaayum uppaal saaramea'rinathaayumiruppathaaga.
piriyamaana sagoatharanum, u'nmaiyu'l'la oozhiyakkaaranum, karththarukku'l enakku udanvealaiyaa'lumaayirukki'ra theegikku enbavan en seythiga'laiyellaam ungga'lukku a'rivippaan.
ungga'l seythiga'lai a'riyavum, ungga'l iruthayangga'laith theat'ravum,

avanaiyum, ungga'liloruvanaayirukki'ra u'nmaiyum piriyamumu'l'la sagoatharanaagiya oneasimu enbavanaiyum, ungga'lidaththil anuppiyirukki'rean; avarga'l ivvidaththuch seythiga'laiyellaam ungga'lukku a'rivippaarga'l.

ennoadeakoodak kaavalilirukki'ra aristharkku ungga'lukku vaazhththuthal sollugi'raan; barnabaavukku inaththaanaagiya maa'rkum vaazhththuthal sollugi'raan, ivanaikku'riththuk katta'laipet'reerga'lea; ivan ungga'lidaththil vanthaal ivanai anggigariththukko'l'lungga'l.

yusthu ennappatta iyeasuvum vaazhththuthal sollugi'raan. viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarga'lil ivarga'lmaaththiram theavanudaiya raajyaththinporuttu en udanvealaiyaadka'laayirunthu, enakku aa'ruthal seythuvanthavarga'l.

eppaappiraavum ungga'lukku vaazhththuthal sollugi'raan; ungga'laich searnthavanum ki'risthuvin oozhiyakkaaranumaagiya ivan, neengga'l theavanukkuch siththamaanavaiga'lellaavat'rilum thea'rinavarga'laayum poora'na nichchayamu'l'lavarga'laayum nilaini'rkavea'ndumen'ru, than jebangga'lil ungga'lukkaaga eppozhuthum poaraadugi'raan.
ivan ungga'lukkaagavum, lavoathikkeayarukkaagavum, eraappoaliyarukkaagavum, miguntha jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavanaayirukki'raanenbatha'rku naan saadchiyaayirukki'rean.
piriyamaana vaiththiyanaagiya lookkaavum, theamaavum, ungga'lukku vaazhththuthal sollugi'raarga'l.
lavoathikkeayaavilirukki'ra sagoathararaiyum, nimpaavaiyum, avan veettil koodugi'ra sabaiyaiyum vaazhththungga'l.
intha nirubam ungga'lidaththil vaasikkappattapinbu ithu lavoathikkeayaa sabaiyilum vaasikkappadumpadi seyyungga'l; lavoathikkeayaavilirunthu varum nirubaththai neengga'lum vaasiyungga'l.
arkkippaik ka'ndu: nee karththaridaththil pet'ra oozhiyaththai ni'raiveat'rumpadi kavanamaayiruppaayaagaven'ru sollungga'l.
pavulaagiya naan en kaiyinaal ezhuthi, ungga'lai vaazhththugi'rean. naan kattappattirukki'rathai ninaiththukko'l'lungga'l. kirubai ungga'loadiruppathaaga. aamen.

pavulum, silvaanum, theemoaththeayum, pithaavaagiya theavanukku'l'lum karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvukku'l'lum irukki'ra thesaloanikkeayar sabaikku ezhuthugi'rathaavathu: nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanaalum karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungga'lukkuk kirubaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaga.

theavanukkup piriyamaana sagoathararea, ungga'l visuvaasaththin kiriyaiyaiyum, ungga'l anbin pirayaasaththaiyum, nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvinmealu'l'la ungga'l nambikkaiyin po'rumaiyaiyum, nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanukkumunbaaga naangga'l idaividaamal ninaivukoornthu,
neengga'l therinthuko'l'lappattavarga'len'ru naangga'l a'rinthu,
engga'l jebangga'lil idaividaamal ungga'laikku'riththu vi'n'nappampa'n'ni, ungga'lellaarukkaagavum eppozhuthum theavanai sthoaththirikki'roam.

engga'l suviseasham ungga'lidaththil vasanaththoadeamaaththiramalla, vallamaiyoadum, parisuththa aaviyoadum, muzhu nichchayaththoadum vanthathu; naangga'lum ungga'lukku'l'lea irunthapoathu ungga'lnimiththam eppadippattavarga'laayirunthoamen'ru a'rinthirukki'reerga'lea.
neengga'l miguntha ubaththiravaththilea, parisuththa aaviyin santhoashaththoadea, thiruvasanaththai eat'rukko'ndu, engga'laiyum karththaraiyum pinpat'rugi'ravarga'laagi,
ivvithamaay makkethoaniyaavilum akaayaavilumu'l'la visuvaasiga'l yaavarukkum maathiriga'laaneerga'l.

eppadiyenil, ungga'lidaththilirunthu karththarudaiya vasanam makkethoaniyaavilum akaayaavilum thoniththathumallaamal, naangga'l athaikku'riththu on'rum sollavea'ndiyathaayiraathapadikku, theavanaippat'rina ungga'l visuvaasam enggum pirasiththamaayit'ru.

eanenil, avarga'lthaamea engga'laikku'riththu, ungga'lidaththil naangga'l adaintha piraveasam innathenbathaiyum, jeevanu'l'la meyyaana theavanukku oozhiyagnseyvatha'rku, neengga'l vikkiragangga'laivittuth theavanidaththi'rku mananthirumbinathaiyum,

avar mariththoarilirunthezhuppinavarum, inivarum koabaakkinaiyinin'ru nammai neenggalaakki iradchikki'ravarumaayirukki'ra avarudaiya kumaaranaagiya iyeasu paraloagaththilirunthu varuvathai neengga'l ethirpaarththukko'ndirukki'rathaiyum, a'rivikki'raarga'lea.
sagoathararea, naangga'l ungga'lidaththil piraveasiththathu vee'naayirukkavillaiyen'ru neengga'lea a'rinthirukki'reerga'l.

ungga'lukkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, munnea pilippipatta'naththilea naangga'l paadupattu ninthaiyadainthirunthum, vegu poaraattaththoadea theavanudaiya suviseashaththai ungga'lukkuch sollumpadi, nammudaiya theavanukku'l thairiyangko'ndirunthoam.
engga'l poathagam vagnchagaththinaalum thuraasaiyinaalum u'ndaagavillai, athu kabadamu'l'lathaayumirukkavillai.

suviseashaththai engga'lidaththil oppuvikkaththakkathaay, theavan engga'lai uththamaren're'n'ninapadiyea, naangga'l manusharukku alla, engga'l iruthayangga'laich soathiththa'rigi'ra theavanukkea piriyamu'ndaagap peasugi'roam.
ungga'lukkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, naangga'l orukkaalum ichchagamaana vasanangga'laich sollavumillai, poru'laasaiyu'l'lavarga'laay maayampa'n'navumillai; theavanea saadchi.

naangga'l ki'risthuvin appoasthalaraaga ungga'lukkup baaramaayirukkak koodiyavarga'laanaalum, ungga'lidaththilaavathu, mat'ravarga'lidaththilaavathu, manusharaal varum magimaiyai naangga'l theadavillai.
ungga'lidaththil padchamaay nadanthuko'ndoam; paal kodukki'ra thaayaanava'l than pi'l'laiga'laik kaappaat'rugi'rathupoala,

naangga'l ungga'lmeal vaagnchaiyaayirunthu, theavanudaiya suviseashaththai ungga'lukkuk koduththathumallaamal, neengga'l engga'lukkup piriyamaanavarga'laanapadiyinaalea, engga'l jeevanaiyum ungga'lukkuk kodukka manathaayirunthoam.

sagoathararea, naangga'l patta pirayaasamum varuththamum ungga'lukku gnaabagamaayirukkum; ungga'lil oruvanukkum baaramaayiraathapadikku, iravum pagalum naangga'l vealaiseythu, theavanudaiya suviseashaththai ungga'lidaththil pirasanggiththoam.
visuvaasiga'laagiya ungga'lukku'l'lea naangga'l evva'lavu parisuththamum neethiyum pizhaiyinmaiyumaay nadanthoamenbatha'rku neengga'lum saadchi, theavanum saadchi.
mealum, thammudaiya raajyaththi'rkum magimaikkum ungga'lai azhaiththa theavanukku neengga'l paaththiraraay nadakkavea'ndumen'ru,
thagappan than pi'l'laiga'lukkuch sollugi'rathupoala, naangga'l ungga'lil ovvoruvanukkum buththiyum thea'ruthalum echcharippum sonnathai a'rinthirukki'reerga'l.

aagaiyaal, neengga'l theavavasanaththai engga'laalea kea'lvippattu eat'rukko'ndapoathu, athai manushar vasanamaaga eat'rukko'l'laamal, theavavasanamaagavea eat'rukko'ndathinaalea naangga'l idaividaamal theavanukku sthoaththiragn seluththugi'roam; athu meyyaagavea theavavasananthaan, visuvaasikki'ra ungga'lukku'l'lea athu belanum seygi'rathu.

eppadiyenil, sagoathararea, yootheayaa theasaththil ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l'laana theavanudaiya sabaiga'lai neengga'l pinpat'rinavarga'laagi, avarga'l yootharaalea eppadip paadupattaarga'loa, appadiyea neengga'lum ungga'l suya janangga'laalea paadupatteerga'l.

antha yootharga'l karththaraagiya iyeasuvaiyum, thangga'l theerkkatharisiga'laiyum kolaiseythavarga'lum, engga'laith thunbappaduththinavarga'lum, theavanukkea'rkaathavarga'lum, manushar yaavarukkum viroathiga'lumaayirunthu,

pu'rajaathiyaar iradchikkappaduvatha'rku naangga'l avarga'loadea peasaathapadikkuth thadaipa'n'nugi'raarga'l; ivvithamaay ekkaalaththilum thangga'l paavangga'lai ni'raivaakkugi'raarga'l; avarga'lmeal koabaakkinai poora'namaay vanthirukki'rathu.

sagoathararea, naangga'l iruthayaththinpadi ungga'loadirunthu, sareeraththinpadi kognchakkaalam ungga'laivittup pirinthirunthapadiyinaalea, ungga'l mugaththaip paarkkavea'ndumen'ru miguntha aasaiyoadea athigamaayp pirayaththanampa'n'ninoam.
aagaiyaal, naangga'l ungga'lidaththil vara ira'ndorutharam manathaayirunthoam, pavulaagiya naanea vara manathaayirunthean; saaththaanoa engga'laith thadaipa'n'ninaan.

engga'lukku nambikkaiyum santhoashamum magizhchchiyin kireedamumaayiruppavarga'l yaar? nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthu varumpoathu avarudaiya sannithaanaththilea neengga'lallavaa appadiyiruppeerga'l;
neengga'lea engga'lukku magimaiyum santhoashamumaayirukki'reerga'l.
aagaiyaal, naangga'l inip po'ruththirukkakkoodaamal, aththeanea patta'naththil thaniththuvidappadugi'rathu nanmaiyen'ru ninaiththu,

intha ubaththiravangga'linaalea oruvanum asaikkappadaathapadikku ungga'laith thidappaduththavum, ungga'l visuvaasaththaippat'ri ungga'lukkup buththisollavum, nammudaiya sagoatharanum theava oozhiyakkaaranum ki'risthuvin suviseashaththil engga'l udanvealaiyaa'lumaagiya theemoaththeayuvai anuppinoam.
ippadippatta ubaththiravangga'laich sagikka naam niyamikkappattirukki'roamen'ru neengga'l a'rinthirukki'reerga'lea.
namakku ubaththiravam varumen'ru naangga'l ungga'lidaththilirunthapoathu, ungga'lukku munna'riviththoam; appadiyea vanthu nearittathen'rum a'rinthirukki'reerga'l.

aagaiyaal, naan inip po'ruththirukkakkoodaamal, engga'l vealai vee'naayp poagaththakkathaagach soathanaikkaaran ungga'laich soathanaikkudpaduththinathu'ndoaven'ru, ungga'l visuvaasaththai a'riyumpadikku, avanai anuppinean.

ippozhuthu theemoaththeayu ungga'lidaththilirunthu engga'lidaththil vanthu, ungga'l visuvaasaththaiyum anbaiyum ku'riththum, neengga'l eppozhuthum engga'laip padchamaay ninaiththukko'ndu, naangga'l ungga'laik kaa'na vaagnchaiyaayirukki'rathupoala neengga'lum engga'laik kaa'na vaagnchaiyaayirukki'reerga'lenbathaikku'riththum, engga'lukku na'rseythi sonnathinaalea,
sagoathararea, engga'lukku nearitta ellaa ikkattilum ubaththiravaththilum ungga'l visuvaasaththinaalea ungga'laikku'riththu aa'ruthaladainthoam.
neengga'l karththarukku'l nilaiththirunthaal naangga'l pizhaiththiruppoam.
mealum, nammudaiya theavanukku munbaaga naangga'l ungga'laikku'riththu adainthirukki'ra miguntha santhoashaththi'rkaaga, naangga'l theavanukku evvithamaay sthoaththiram seluththuvoam?
ungga'l mugaththaik ka'ndu, ungga'l visuvaasaththin ku'raivuga'lai ni'raivaakkumporuttu, iravum pagalum migavum vea'ndikko'l'lugi'roamea.
nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanum nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvum ungga'lidaththi'rku engga'lai nearaaga vazhinadaththuvaaraaga.

naangga'l ungga'lidaththil vaiththirukki'ra anbukkoppaay, neengga'lum oruvaridaththil oruvar vaikkum anbilum mat'rellaa manusharidaththil vaikkum anbilum karththar ungga'laip perugavum nilaiththoanggavum seythu,

ivvithamaay nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthu thamathu parisuththavaanga'l anaivaroadungkooda varumpoathu, neengga'l nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanukku munbaagap pizhaiyat'ra parisuththamu'l'lavarga'laayirukkumpadi ungga'l iruthayangga'lai sthirappaduththuvaaraaga.

an'riyum, sagoathararea, neengga'l inninna piragaaramaay nadakkavum, theavanukkup piriyamaayirukkavum vea'ndumen'ru, neengga'l engga'laal keattu eat'rukko'ndapadiyea, athigamathigamaayth thea'rumpadikku, karththaraagiya iyeasuvukku'l ungga'lai vea'ndikko'ndu buththisollugi'roam.
karththaraagiya iyeasuvinaalea naangga'l ungga'lukkuk koduththa katta'laiga'lai a'rinthirukki'reerga'lea.
neengga'l parisuththamu'l'lavarga'laagavea'ndumenbathea theavanudaiya siththamaayirukki'rathu. anthappadi, neengga'l veasimaarkkaththukku vilagiyirunthu,
theavanai a'riyaatha agngnaaniga'laippoala moaga ichchaikkudpadaamal,
ungga'lil avanavan thanthan sareera paa'ndaththaip parisuththamaayum kanamaayum aa'nduko'l'lumpadi a'rinthu:

intha vishayaththil oruvanum mee'raamalum than sagoatharanai vagnchiyaamalum irukkavea'ndum; munnamea naangga'l ungga'lukkuch solli, saadchiyaaga echchariththapadiyea ippadippatta vishayangga'lellaavat'raiyungku'riththuk karththar neethiyaich sarikkattugi'ravaraayirukki'raar.
theavan nammai asuththaththi'rkalla parisuththaththi'rkea azhaiththirukki'raar.
aagaiyaal asattaipa'n'nugi'ravan manusharai alla, thamathu parisuththaaaviyai namakkuth thantharu'lina theavanaiyea asattaipa'n'nugi'raan.
sagoathara sineagaththaikku'riththu naan ungga'lukku ezhuthavea'nduvathillai; neengga'l oruvariloruvar anbaayirukkumpadikkuth theavanaal poathikkappattavarga'laayirukki'reerga'lea.
anthappadi neengga'l makkethoaniyaa naadenggumu'l'la sagoathararellaarukkum seythuvarugi'reerga'l. sagoathararea, anbilea neengga'l innum athigamaayp perugavum;
pu'rambeayirukki'ravarga'laip pat'ri yoakkiyamaay nadanthu, on'rilum ungga'lukkuk ku'raivillaathirukkumpadikku,

naangga'l ungga'lukkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, amaithalu'l'lavarga'laayirukkumpadi naadavum, ungga'l sontha aluvalga'laip paarkkavum, ungga'l sonthak kaiga'linaalea vealaiseyyavum vea'ndumen'ru ungga'lukkup buththisollugi'roam.
an'riyum, sagoathararea, niththiraiyadainthavarga'linimiththam neengga'l nambikkaiyat'ravarga'laana mat'ravarga'laippoalath thukkiththu, a'rivillaathirukka enakku manathillai.
iyeasuvaanavar mariththu pinbu ezhunthirunthaaren'ru visuvaasikki'roamea; appadiyea iyeasuvukku'l niththiraiyadainthavarga'laiyum theavan avaroadeakoodak ko'nduvaruvaar.
karththarudaiya vaarththaiyai munnittu naangga'l ungga'lukkuch sollugi'rathaavathu: karththarudaiya varugaimattum uyiroadirukkum naam niththiraiyadainthavarga'lukku munthikko'lvathillai.

eanenil, karththar thaamea aaravaaraththoadum, pirathaana thoothanudaiya saththaththoadum, theava ekkaa'laththoadum vaanaththilirunthu i'ranggivaruvaar; appozhuthu ki'risthuvukku'l mariththavarga'l muthalaavathu ezhunthiruppaarga'l.
pinbu uyiroadirukkum naamum karththarukku ethirko'ndupoaga, meagangga'lmeal avarga'loadeakooda aagaayaththil eduththukko'l'lappattu, ivvithamaay eppozhuthum karththarudaneakooda iruppoam.
aagaiyaal, intha vaarththaiga'linaalea neengga'l oruvaraiyoruvar theat'rungga'l.
sagoathararea, ivaiga'l nadakkungkaalangga'laiyum samayangga'laiyungku'riththu ungga'lukku ezhuthavea'nduvathillai.
iravilea thirudan varugi'ravithamaayk karththarudaiya naa'l varumen'ru neengga'lea nan'raay a'rinthirukki'reerga'l.
samaathaanamum savukkiyamum u'nden'ru avarga'l sollumpoathu, karppavathiyaanava'lukku veathanai varugi'rathupoala, azhivu sadithiyaay avarga'lmeal varum; avarga'l thappippoavathillai.
sagoathararea, antha naa'l thirudanaippoala ungga'laip pidiththukko'l'laththakkathaaga, neengga'l anthagaaraththilirukki'ravarga'lallavea.
neengga'lellaarum ve'lichchaththin pi'l'laiga'lum, pagalin pi'l'laiga'lumaayirukki'reerga'l; naam iravukkum iru'lukkum u'l'laanavarga'lallavea.
aagaiyaal, mat'ravarga'l thoonggugi'rathupoala naam thoonggaamal, vizhiththukko'ndu the'linthavarga'laayirukkakkadavoam.
thoonggugi'ravarga'l iraaththiriyilea thoongguvaarga'l; ve'riko'l'lugi'ravarga'l iraaththiriyilea ve'riko'l'luvaarga'l.
pagalukkuriyavarga'laagiya naamoa the'linthavarga'laayirunthu, visuvaasam anbu ennum maarkkavasaththaiyum, iradchippin nambikkaiyennum thalaichseeraavaiyum thariththukko'ndirukkakkadavoam.
theavan nammaik koabaakkinaikken'ru niyamikkaamal, nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthumoolamaay iradchippadaivatha'rken'ru niyamiththaar.
naam vizhiththiruppavarga'laanaalum, niththiraiyadainthavarga'laanaalum, thammudaneakooda naam eagamaayp pizhaiththirukkumpadi avar namakkaaga mariththaarea.
aagaiyaal neengga'l seythuvarugi'rapadiyea, oruvaraiyoruvar theat'ri, oruvarukkoruvar bakthiviruththi u'ndaagumpadi seyyungga'l.
an'riyum, sagoathararea, ungga'lukku'l'lea pirayaasappattu, karththarukku'l ungga'lai visaara'naiseygi'ravarga'laayirunthu, ungga'lukkup buththisollugi'ravarga'lai neengga'l mathiththu,
avarga'ludaiya kiriyaiyinimiththam avarga'lai migavum anbaay e'n'nikko'l'lumpadi ungga'lai vea'ndikko'l'lugi'roam. ungga'lukku'l'lea samaathaanamaayirungga'l.

mealum, sagoathararea, naangga'l ungga'lukkup poathikki'rathennaven'raal, ozhunggillaathavarga'lukkup buththisollungga'l, thidanat'ravarga'laith theat'rungga'l, balaveenaraith thaanggungga'l, ellaaridaththilum neediya saanthamaayirungga'l.
oruvanum mat'roruvan seyyum theemaikkuth theemaiseyyaathapadi paarungga'l; ungga'lukku'l'lum mat'ra yaavarukku'l'lum eppozhuthum nanmaiseyya naadungga'l.
eppozhuthum santhoashamaayirungga'l.
idaividaamal jebampa'n'nungga'l.
ellaavat'rileayum sthoaththiragn seyyungga'l; appadich seyvathea ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l ungga'laikku'riththuth theavanudaiya siththamaayirukki'rathu.
aaviyai aviththuppoadaathirungga'l.
theerkkatharisanangga'lai a'rpamaaye'n'naathirungga'l.
ellaavat'raiyum soathiththup paarththu, nalamaanathaip pidiththukko'l'lungga'l.
pollaanggaayth thoan'rugi'ra ellaavat'raiyum vittu vilagungga'l.

samaathaanaththin theavan thaamea ungga'lai mut'rilum parisuththamaakkuvaaraaga. ungga'l aavi aaththumaa sareeram muzhuvathum, nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthu varumpoathu kut'ramat'rathaayirukkumpadi kaakkappaduvathaaga.
ungga'lai azhaikki'ravar u'nmaiyu'l'lavar, avar appadiyea seyvaar.
sagoathararea, engga'lukkaaga vea'ndikko'l'lungga'l.
sagoathararellaaraiyum parisuththa muththaththoadea vaazhththungga'l.
intha nirubam parisuththamaana sagoatharar yaavarukkum vaasikkappadumpadi seyyavea'ndumen'ru karththarpearil aa'naiyittu ungga'lukkuch sollugi'rean.
nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya kirubai ungga'ludaneakooda iruppathaaga. aamen.
pavulum, silvaanum, theemoaththeayum, nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanukku'l'lum, karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvukku'l'lum irukki'ra thesaloanikkeayar sabaikku ezhuthugi'rathaavathu:
nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanaalum karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum ungga'lukkuk kirubaiyum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaga.

sagoathararea, naangga'l eppozhuthum ungga'lukkaagath theavanai sthoaththirikkak kadanaa'liga'laayirukki'roam; ungga'l visuvaasam migavum perugugi'rapadiyinaalum, neengga'lellaarum oruvariloruvar vaiththirukki'ra anbu athigarikki'rapadiyinaalum, appadich seygi'rathu thaguthiyaayirukki'rathu.

neengga'l sagikki'ra sagala thunbangga'lilum ubaththiravangga'lilum po'rumaiyaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum kaa'nbikki'rathinimiththam ungga'laikku'riththu naangga'l theavanudaiya sabaiga'lil meanmaipaaraattugi'roam.

neengga'l theavanudaiya raajyaththinimiththam paadu anubavikki'ravarga'laayirukka, antha raajyaththi'rku neengga'l paaththiraren're'n'nappadumpadikku, theavan niyaayamaana theerppuchseygi'ravarenbatha'rku, athuvea aththaadchiyaayirukki'rathu.

ungga'lai ubaththiravappaduththugi'ravarga'lukku ubaththiravaththaiyum, ubaththiravappadugi'ra ungga'lukku engga'loadeakooda i'laippaa'ruthalaiyum pirathipalanaagak koduppathu theavanukku neethiyaayirukki'rathea.
theavanai a'riyaathavarga'lukkum, nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvin suviseashaththi'rkuk keezhppadiyaathavarga'lukkum neethiyu'l'la aakkinaiyaich seluththumpadikku,
karththaraagiya iyeasu thamathu vallamaiyin thootharoadum, juvaaliththu erigi'ra akkiniyoadum, vaanaththilirunthu ve'lippadumpoathu appadiyaagum.

annaa'lilea thammudaiya parisuththavaanga'lil magimaippadaththakkavaraayum, neengga'l engga'ludaiya saadchiyai visuvaasiththapadiyinaalea ungga'lidaththilum, visuvaasikki'ravarga'lellaaridaththilum aachchariyappadaththakkavaraayum, avar varumpoathu,
avarga'l karththarudaiya sannithaanaththilirunthum, avarudaiya vallamai porunthiya magimaiyilirunthum neenggalaagi, niththiya azhivaagiya tha'ndanaiyai adaivaarga'l.

aagaiyaal, nammudaiya theavanum karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvum a'likkum kirubaiyinpadiyea, nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamam ungga'lidaththilum, neengga'l avaridaththilum magimaippadumporuttaaga;

nammudaiya theavan ungga'laith thamathu azhaippukkup paaththiraraakkavum, thamathu thayaiyu'l'la siththam muzhuvathaiyum visuvaasaththin kiriyaiyaiyum balamaay ungga'lidaththil ni'raiveat'ravum vea'ndumen'ru, eppozhuthum ungga'lukkaaga vea'ndikko'l'lugi'roam.
an'riyum, sagoathararea, nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvin varugaiyaiyum, naam avaridaththilea searkkappaduvathaiyungku'riththu, naangga'l ungga'lai vea'ndikko'l'lugi'rathu ennaven'raal,

oru aaviyinaalaavathu, vaarththaiyinaalaavathu, engga'lidaththilirunthu vanthathaayth thoan'rugi'ra oru nirubaththinaalaavathu, ki'risthuvinudaiya naa'l sameebamaayirukki'rathaagach sollappattaal, udanea sagnchalappadaamalum kalanggaamalum irungga'l.

evvithaththinaalum oruvanum ungga'lai moasampoakkaathapadikku echcharikkaiyaayirungga'l; eanenil visuvaasa thuroagam munthi nearittu, keattin maganaagiya paavamanushan ve'lippattaalozhiya, antha naa'l varaathu.

avan ethirththuni'rki'ravanaayum, theavanennappaduvathethuvoa, aaraathikkappaduvathethuvoa, avaiyellaavat'ri'rkum mealaagath thannai uyarththugi'ravanaayum, theavanudaiya aalayaththil theavanpoala udkaarnthu, thannaiththaan theavanen'ru kaa'nbikki'ravanaayum iruppaan.
naan ungga'lidaththilirunthapoathu ivaiga'laich sonnathu ungga'lukku gnaabagamillaiyaa?
avan than kaalaththilea ve'lippadumpadikku, ippozhuthu avanaith thadaiseygi'rathu innathen'rum a'rinthirukki'reerga'lea.
akkiramaththin iragasiyam ippozhuthea kiriyaiseygi'rathu; aanaalum thadaiseygi'ravan naduvilirunthu neekkappadumunnea athu ve'lippadaathu.
neekkappadumpoathu, antha akkiramakkaaran ve'lippaduvaan; avanaik karththar thammudaiya vaayin suvaasaththinaalea azhiththu, thammudaiya varugaiyin pirasannaththinaalea naasampa'n'nuvaar.
antha akkiramakkaaranudaiya varugai saaththaanudaiya seyalinpadi sagala vallamaiyoadum adaiyaa'langga'loadum poyyaana a'rputhangga'loadum,

kettuppoagi'ravarga'lukku'l'lea aneethiyinaal u'ndaagum sagalavitha vagnchagaththoadum irukkum. iradchikkappadaththakkathaaych saththiyaththinmealu'l'la anbai avarga'l anggigariyaama'rpoanapadiyaal appadi nadakkum.
aagaiyaal saththiyaththai visuvaasiyaamal aneethiyil piriyappadugi'ra yaavarum aakkinaikku'l'laakkappadumpadikku,
avarga'l poyyai visuvaasikkaththakkathaagak kodiya vagnchagaththaith theavan avarga'lukku anuppuvaar.

karththarukkup piriyamaana sagoathararea, neengga'l aaviyinaalea parisuththamaakkappadugi'rathinaalum, saththiyaththai visuvaasikki'rathinaalum iradchippadaiyumpadikku, aathimuthal theavan ungga'laith therinthuko'ndapadiyinaalea, naangga'l ungga'laikku'riththu eppozhuthum theavanai sthoaththirikkak kadanaa'liga'laayirukki'roam.
neengga'l nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvin magimaiyai adaiyumporuttaaga engga'l suviseashaththinaalea antha iradchippukku avar ungga'lai azhaiththaar.
aagaiyaal, sagoathararea, neengga'l nilaiko'ndu, vaarththaiyinaalaavathu nirubaththinaalaavathu naangga'l ungga'lukku ubatheasiththa mu'raimaiga'laik kaikko'l'lungga'l.
nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvum, nammidaththil anbukoornthu niththiya aa'ruthalaiyum nalnambikkaiyaiyum kirubaiyaay namakkuk koduththirukki'ra nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanum,
ungga'l iruthayangga'laith theat'ri, ellaa nalvasanaththilum na'rkiriyaiyilum ungga'lai sthirappaduththuvaaraaga.
kadaisiyaaga, sagoathararea, ungga'lidaththil karththarudaiya vasanam parambi magimaippadugi'rathupoala, evvidaththilum parambi magimaippadumpadikkum,
thurkku'naraagiya pollaatha manushar kaiyinin'ru naangga'l viduvikkappadumpadikkum, engga'lukkaaga vea'ndikko'l'lungga'l; visuvaasam ellaaridaththilumillaiyea.
karththaroa u'nmaiyu'l'lavar, avar ungga'lai sthirappaduththi, theemaiyinin'ru vilakkik kaaththukko'l'luvaar.
mealum, naangga'l katta'laiyidugi'ravaiga'lai neengga'l seythuvarugi'reerga'len'rum, inimealum seyveerga'len'rum, ungga'laikku'riththuk karththarukku'l nambikkaiyaayirukki'roam.
karththar ungga'l iruthayangga'laith theavanaippat'rum anbukkum ki'risthuvin po'rumaikkum nearaay nadaththuvaaraaga.

mealum, sagoathararea, engga'lidaththil eat'rukko'nda mu'raimaiyinpadi nadavaamal, ozhunggat'ru nadakki'ra enthach sagoatharanaiyum neengga'l vittu vilaga vea'ndumen'ru, nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvin naamaththinaalea, ungga'lukkuk katta'laiyidugi'roam.
innavithamaay engga'laip pinpat'ra vea'ndumen'ru neengga'l a'rinthirukki'reerga'lea; naangga'l ungga'lukku'l'lea ozhunggat'ru nadavaamalum,
oruvanidaththilum ilavasamaaych saappidaamalum, ungga'lil oruvanukkum baaramaayiraathapadikku iravum pagalum pirayaasaththoadum varuththaththoadum vealaiseythu saappittoam.

ungga'lmeal baaraththai vaippatha'rkaana athigaaram engga'lukku illaiyenbathinaalea appadich seyyaamal, neengga'l engga'laip pinpat'rumpadikku naangga'l ungga'lukku maathiriyaayirukkavea'ndumen'rea appadich seythoam.
oruvan vealaiseyya manathillaathirunthaal avan saappidavum koodaathen'ru naangga'l ungga'lidaththil irunthapoathu ungga'lukkuk katta'laiyittoamea.
ungga'lil silar yaathoru vealaiyum seyyaamal, vee'n aluva'rkaararaay, ozhunggat'ruth thirigi'raarga'len'ru kea'lvippadugi'roam.

ippadippattavarga'l amaithaloadea vealaiseythu, thangga'l sonthach saappaattaich saappidavea'ndumen'ru, nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalea avarga'lukkuk katta'laiyittup buththisollugi'roam.
sagoathararea, neengga'l nanmai seyvathilea soarnthupoagaamalirungga'l.
mealum, intha nirubaththil solliya engga'l vasanaththukku oruvan keezhppadiyaama'rpoanaal, avanaik ku'riththukko'ndu, avan vedkappadumpadikku avanudanea kalavaathirungga'l.
aanaalum avanaich saththuruvaaga e'n'naamal, sagoatharanaaga e'n'ni, avanukkup buththisollungga'l.
samaathaanaththin karththarthaamea eppozhuthum sagalavithaththilum ungga'lukkuch samaathaanaththaith thantharu'luvaaraaga. karththar ungga'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppaaraaga.
pavulaagiya naan en kaiyezhuththaalea ungga'lai vaazhththugi'rean, nirubangga'lthoa'rum ithuvea adaiyaa'lam; ippadiyea ezhuthugi'rean.
nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvin kirubai ungga'lanaivaroadungkooda iruppathaaga. aamen.
nammudaiya iradchagaraayirukki'ra theavanum, nammudaiya nambikkaiyaayirukki'ra karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvum katta'laiyittapadiyea, iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaayirukki'ra pavul,

visuvaasaththil uththama kumaaranaagiya theemoaththeayuvukku ezhuthugi'rathaavathu: nammudaiya pithaavaagiya theavanaalum nammudaiya karththaraagiya ki'risthu iyeasuvinaalum kirubaiyum irakkamum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaga.

veat'rumaiyaana ubatheasangga'laip poathiyaathapadikkum, visuvaasaththinaal vi'langgum theyveega bakthiviruththikku eathuvaayiraamal, tharkkangga'lukku eathuvaayirukki'ra kattukkathaiga'laiyum mudivillaatha vamsavaralaa'ruga'laiyum kavaniyaathapadikkum, nee silarukkuk katta'laiyidumporuttaaga,
naan makkethoaniyaavukkup poagumpoathu unnai ebeasu patta'naththilirukka vea'ndikko'ndapadiyea seyvaayaaga.
ka'rpanaiyin poru'l ennavenil, suththamaana iruthayaththilum nalmanachsaadchiyilum maayamat'ra visuvaasaththilum pi'rakkum anbea.
ivaiga'laich silar noakkaamal vee'npeachchukku idangkoduththu vilagippoanaarga'l.
thaangga'l sollugi'rathu innathen'rum, thaangga'l saathikki'rathu innathen'rum a'riyaathirunthum, niyaayappiramaa'na poathagaraayirukka virumbugi'raarga'l.
oruvan niyaayappiramaa'naththai niyaayappadi anusariththaal, niyaayappiramaa'nam nallathen'ru a'rinthirukki'roam.

engga'lukkuth therinthirukki'rapadi, niyaayappiramaa'nam neethimaanukku vithikkappadaamal, akkiramakkaararukkum, adanggaathavarga'lukkum, bakthiyillaathavarga'lukkum, paaviga'lukkum, asuththarukkum, seerkettavarga'lukkum, thaaythagappanmaarai adikki'ravarga'lukkum, kolaipaathagarukkum,
veasikka'l'larukkum, aa'npu'narchchikkaararukkum, manusharaith thirudugi'ravarga'lukkum, poyyarukkum, poyyaa'nai idugi'ravarga'lukkum,

niththiyaanantha theavanudaiya magimaiyaana suviseashaththinpadi enakku oppuvikkappattirukki'ra aaroakkiyamaana ubatheasaththi'rku ethiridaiyaayirukki'ra mat'renthach seygaikkum viroathamaay vithikkappattirukki'rathu.
ennaip balappaduththugi'ra nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthu ennai u'nmaiyu'l'lavanen're'n'ni, intha oozhiyaththi'rku ea'rpaduththinapadiyaal, avarai sthoaththirikki'rean.
munnea naan thooshikki'ravanum, thunbappaduththugi'ravanum, kodumai seygi'ravanumaayirunthean; appadiyirunthum, naan a'riyaamal avisuvaasaththinaalea appadich seythapadiyinaal irakkampet'rean.
nammudaiya karththarin kirubai ki'risthu iyeasuvinmealu'l'la visuvaasaththoadum anboadungkooda ennidaththil paripoora'namaayp perugit'ru.
paaviga'lai iradchikka ki'risthu iyeasu ulagaththil vanthaar engi'ra vaarththai u'nmaiyum ellaa anggigarippukkum paaththiramumaanathu; avarga'lil pirathaana paavi naan.

appadiyirunthum, niththiya jeevanai adaiyumpadi inimeal iyeasuki'risthuvinidaththil visuvaasamaayiruppavarga'lukkuth thirushdaantham u'ndaagumporuttup pirathaana paaviyaagiya ennidaththil avar ellaa neediya po'rumaiyaiyum kaa'nbikkumpadikku irakkampet'rean.
niththiyamum azhivillaamaiyum atharisanamumu'l'la raajanumaay, thaam oruvarea gnaanamu'l'la theavanumaayirukki'ravarukku, kanamum magimaiyum sathaakaalangga'lilum u'ndaayiruppathaaga. aamen.

kumaaranaagiya theemoaththeayuvea, unnaikku'riththu mun u'ndaana theerkkatharisanangga'linpadiyea, nee avaiga'lai munnittu nalla poaraattampa'n'numpadi, inthak katta'laiyai unakku oppuvikki'rean; nee visuvaasamum nalmanachsaadchiyum udaiyavanaayiru.
intha nalmanachsaadchiyaich silar tha'l'livittu, visuvaasamaagiya kappalaich seathappaduththinaarga'l.
imeneayum aleksantharum appadippattavarga'l; avarga'l thooshiyaathapadi sidchikkappada avarga'laich saaththaanidaththil oppukkoduththean.
naan pirathaanamaaych sollugi'ra buththiyennavenil, ellaa manusharukkaagavum vi'n'nappangga'laiyum jebangga'laiyum vea'nduthalga'laiyum sthoaththirangga'laiyum pa'n'navea'ndum;
naam ellaap bakthiyoadum nallozhukkaththoadum kalagamillaamal amaithalu'l'la jeevanampa'n'numpadikku, raajaakka'lukkaagavum, athigaaramu'l'la yaavarukkaagavum appadiyea seyyavea'ndum.
nammudaiya iradchagaraagiya theavanukkumunbaaga athu nanmaiyum piriyamumaayirukki'rathu.
ellaa manusharum iradchikkappadavum, saththiyaththai a'rigi'ra a'rivai adaiyavum, avar siththamu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar.
theavan oruvarea, theavanukkum manusharukkum maththiyastharum oruvarea.
ellaaraiyum meedkumporu'laagath thammai oppukkoduththa manushanaagiya ki'risthu iyeasu avarea; itha'rkuriya saadchi eat'ra kaalangga'lil vi'langgivarugi'rathu.

itha'rkaagavea naan pirasanggiyaagavum, appoasthalanaagavum, pu'rajaathiga'lukku visuvaasaththaiyum saththiyaththaiyum vi'langgappa'n'nugi'ra poathaganaagavum niyamikkappattirukki'rean; naan poy sollaamal ki'risthuvukku'l u'nmaiyaich sollugi'rean.
an'riyum, purusharga'l koabamum tharkkamumillaamal parisuththamaana kaiga'lai uyarththi, ellaa idangga'lileayum jebampa'n'navea'ndumen'ru virumbugi'rean.
sthireega'lum mayiraip pinnuthalinaalaavathu, ponninaalaavathu, muththukka'linaalaavathu, vilaiyea'rappet'ra vasthiraththinaalaavathu thangga'lai alanggariyaamal,

thaguthiyaana vasthiraththinaalum, naa'naththinaalum, the'lintha buththiyinaalum, theavabakthiyu'l'lavarga'len'ru sollikko'l'lugi'ra sthireega'lukku eat'rapadiyea na'rkiriyaiga'linaalum, thangga'lai alanggarikkavea'ndum.
sthireeyaanava'l ellaavat'rilum adakkamudaiyava'laayirunthu, amaithaloadu kat'rukko'l'lakkadava'l.
ubatheasampa'n'navum, purushanmeal athigaaragn seluththavum, sthireeyaanava'lukku naan uththaravu kodukki'rathillai; ava'l amaithalaayirukkavea'ndum.
ennaththinaalenil, muthalaavathu aathaam uruvaakkappattaan, pinbu eavaa'l uruvaakkappattaa'l.
mealum, aathaam vagnchikkappadavillai, sthireeyaanava'lea vagnchikkappattu mee'ruthalukku udpattaa'l.
appadiyirunthum, the'lintha buththiyoadu visuvaasaththilum anbilum parisuththaththilum nilaiko'ndirunthaal, pi'l'laippeat'rinaalea iradchikkappaduvaa'l.
ka'nkaa'nippai virumbugi'ravan nalla vealaiyai virumbugi'raan, ithu u'nmaiyaana vaarththai.

aagaiyaal ka'nkaa'niyaanavan kut'ragnsaattappadaathavanum, orea manaiviyai udaiya purushanum, jaakkirathaiyu'l'lavanum, the'lintha buththiyu'l'lavanum, yoakkiyathaiyu'l'lavanum, anniyarai ubasarikki'ravanum, poathagasamarththanumaay irukkavea'ndum.
avan mathubaanappiriyanum, adikki'ravanum, izhivaana aathaayaththai ichchikki'ravanumaayiraamal, po'rumaiyu'l'lavanum, sa'ndaipa'n'naathavanum, pa'na aasaiyillaathavanumaayirunthu,
than sonthak kudumbaththai nan'raay nadaththugi'ravanum, than pi'l'laiga'laich sagala nallozhukkamu'l'lavarga'laagak keezhppadiyappa'n'nugi'ravanumaayirukkavea'ndum.
oruvan than sonthak kudumbaththai nadaththa a'riyaathirunthaal, theavanudaiya sabaiyai eppadi visaarippaan?
avan i'rumaappadainthu, pisaasu adaintha aakkinaiyilea vizhaathapadikku, noothana seeshanaayirukkakkoodaathu.
avan ninthanaiyilum, pisaasin ka'n'niyilum vizhaathapadikku, pu'rambaanavarga'laal na'rsaadchi pet'ravanaayumirukkavea'ndum.
anthappadiyea, uthavikkaararum irunaakku'l'lavarga'laayum, mathubaanappiriyaraayum, izhivaana aathaayaththai ichchikki'ravarga'laayum iraamal, nallozhukkamu'l'lavarga'laayum,
visuvaasaththin iragasiyaththaich suththa manachsaadchiyilea kaaththukko'l'lugi'ravarga'laayum irukkavea'ndum.
mealum, ivarga'l munnathaagach soathikkappadavea'ndum; kut'ragnsaattappadaathavarga'laanaal uthavikkaararaaga oozhiyagnseyyalaam.
anthappadiyea sthireega'lum nallozhukkamu'l'lavarga'lum, avathoo'rupa'n'naathavarga'lum, the'lintha buththiyu'l'lavarga'lum, ellaavat'rileayum u'nmaiyu'l'lavarga'lumaayirukkavea'ndum.
mealum, uthavikkaararaanavarga'l orea manaiviyaiyudaiya purusharumaay, thangga'l pi'l'laiga'laiyum sonthak kudumbangga'laiyum nan'raay nadaththugi'ravarga'lumaayirukkavea'ndum.
ippadi uthavikkaararudaiya oozhiyaththai nan'raaych seygi'ravarga'l thangga'lukku nalla nilaiyaiyum, ki'risthu iyeasuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththil miguntha thairiyaththaiyum adaivaarga'l.
naan unnidaththi'rkuch seekkiramaay varuveanen'ru nambiyirukki'rean.

thaamathippeanaagil, theavanudaiya veettilea nadakkavea'ndiya vagaiyai nee a'riyumpadi ivaiga'lai unakku ezhuthugi'rean; antha veedu jeevanu'l'la theavanudaiya sabaiyaaych saththiyaththukkuth thoo'num aathaaramumaayirukki'rathu.

an'riyum, theavabakthikkuriya iragasiyamaanathu yaavarum oppukko'l'lugi'rapadiyea mahaa meanmaiyu'l'lathu. theavan maamsaththilea ve'lippattaar, aaviyilea neethiyu'l'lavaren'ru vi'langgappattaar, theavathootharga'laal kaa'nappattaar, pu'rajaathiga'lidaththil pirasanggikkappattaar, ulagaththilea visuvaasikkappattaar, magimaiyilea ea'reduththukko'l'lappattaar.

aagilum, aaviyaanavar ve'lippadaiyaaych sollugi'rapadi, pi'rkaalangga'lilea manachsaadchiyil soodu'nda poyyarudaiya maayaththinaalea silar vagnchikki'ra aaviga'lukkum pisaasuga'lin ubatheasangga'lukkum sevikoduththu, visuvaasaththai vittu vilagippoavaarga'l.
vivaagampa'n'naathirukkavum,
visuvaasiga'lum saththiyaththai a'rinthavarga'lum sthoaththiraththoadea anubavikkumpadi theavan padaiththa poajanapathaarththangga'lai vilakkavum vea'ndumen'ru anthap poyyar katta'laiyiduvaarga'l.
theavan padaiththathellaam nallathaayirukki'rathu; sthoaththiraththoadea eat'rukko'l'lappadumaagil on'rum tha'l'lappadaththakkathalla.
athu theavavasanaththinaalum jebaththinaalum parisuththamaakkappadum.

ivaiga'lai nee sagoathararukkup poathiththuvanthaal, visuvaasaththi'rkuriya vaarththaiga'lilum nee anusariththa na'rpoathagaththilum thea'rinavanaagi, iyeasuki'risthuvukku nalla oozhiyakkaaranaayiruppaay.
seerkeadum kizhaviga'l peachchumaayirukki'ra kattukkathaiga'lukku vilagi, theava bakthikkeathuvaaga muya'rchipa'n'nu.
sareeramuya'rchi a'rpa pirayoajanamu'l'lathu; theavabakthiyaanathu intha jeevanukkum itha'rkup pinvarum jeevanukkum vaakkuththaththamu'l'lathaagaiyaal ellaavat'rilum pirayoajanamu'l'lathu.
intha vaarththai u'nmaiyum ellaa anggigarippukkum paaththiramumaayirukki'rathu.
ithinimiththam pirayaasappadugi'roam, ninthaiyum adaigi'roam; eanenil ellaa manusharukkum, viseashamaaga visuvaasiga'lukkum iradchagaraagiya jeevanu'l'la theavanmeal nambikkai vaiththirukki'roam.
ivaiga'lai nee katta'laiyittup poathiththukko'ndiru.
un i'lamaiyaikku'riththu oruvanum unnai asattaipa'n'naathapadikku, nee vaarththaiyilum, nadakkaiyilum, anbilum, aaviyilum, visuvaasaththilum, ka'rpilum, visuvaasiga'lukku maathiriyaayiru.
naan varuma'lavum vaasikki'rathilum buththisollugi'rathilum ubatheasikki'rathilum jaakkirathaiyaayiru.
moopparaagiya sanggaththaar unmeal kaiga'lai vaiththapoathu theerkkatharisanaththinaal unakku a'likkappatta varaththaippat'ri asathiyaayiraathea.
nee thea'rugi'rathu yaavarukkum vi'langgumpadi ivaiga'laiyea sinthiththukko'ndu, ivaiga'lilea nilaiththiru.
unnaikku'riththum ubatheasaththaikku'riththum echcharikkaiyaayiru, ivaiga'lil nilaiko'ndiru, ippadich seyvaayaanaal, unnaiyum un ubatheasaththaik keadpavarga'laiyum iradchiththukko'l'luvaay.
muthirvayathu'l'lavanaik kadinthuko'l'laamal, avanaith thagappanaippoalavum, paaliya purusharaich sagoathararaippoalavum,
muthirvayathu'l'la sthireega'laith thaayga'laippoalavum, paaliya sthireega'lai ellaak ka'rpudan sagoathariga'laippoalavum paaviththu, buththisollu.
uththama vithavaiga'laagiya vithavaiga'laik kanampa'n'nu.

vithavaiyaanava'lukkup pi'l'laiga'laavathu, pearan pearththiga'laavathu irunthaal, ivarga'l muthalaavathu thangga'l sonthak kudumbaththaith theavabakthiyaay visaariththu, pet'raar seytha nanmaiga'lukkup bathil nanmaiga'laich seyyak kat'rukko'l'lakkadavarga'l; athu nanmaiyum theavanukku munbaagap piriyamumaayirukki'rathu.
uththama vithavaiyaayirunthu thanimaiyaayirukki'rava'l theavanidaththil nambikkaiyu'l'lava'laay, iravum pagalum vea'nduthalga'lilum jebangga'lilum nilaiththiruppaa'l.
sugaboagamaay vaazhgi'rava'l uyiroadea seththava'l.
avarga'l kut'ragnsaattappadaathavarga'laayirukkumpadi ivaiga'laik katta'laiyidu.
oruvan than sontha janangga'laiyum, viseashamaagath than veettaaraiyum visaariyaama'rpoanaal, avan visuvaasaththai ma'ruthaliththavanum, avisuvaasiyilum kettavanumaayiruppaan.
a'rubathu vayathukkuk ku'raiyaathava'lum, orea purushanukku manaiviyaayirunthava'lumaagi,

pi'l'laiga'lai va'larththu, anniyarai ubasariththu, parisuththavaanga'ludaiya kaalga'laikkazhuvi, ubaththiravappadugi'ravarga'lukku uthaviseythu, sagalavitha na'rkiriyaiga'laiyum jaakkirathaiyaay nadappiththu, ivvithamaay na'rkiriyaiga'laikku'riththu na'rsaadchi pet'rava'lumaayirunthaal, appadippatta vithavaiyaiyea vithavaiga'l koottaththil searththukko'l'lavea'ndum.
i'lavayathu'l'la vithavaiga'lai athilea searththukko'l'laathea; eanenil, avarga'l ki'risthuvukku viroathamaayk kaamavigaarangko'l'lumpoathu vivaagampa'n'na manathaagi,
muthalil ko'ndiruntha visuvaasaththai viduvathinaalea, aakkinaikkudpaduvaarga'l.

athuvumallaamal, avarga'l soambalu'l'lavarga'laay, veeduveedaayth thiriyappazhaguvaarga'l; soambalu'l'lavarga'laay maaththiramalla, alappugi'ravarga'laayum vee'naluva'rkaariga'laayum thagaatha kaariyangga'laip peasugi'ravarga'laayumiruppaarga'l.
aagaiyaal i'lavayathu'l'la vithavaiga'l vivaagampa'n'navum, pi'l'laiga'laip pe'ravum, veettai nadaththavum, viroathiyaanavan ninthikki'ratha'rku idamu'ndaakkaamalirukkavum vea'ndumen'rirukki'rean.
eanenil itha'rkumunnea silar saaththaanaip pinpat'ri vilagippoanaarga'l.

visuvaasiyaagiya oruvanidaththilaavathu oruththiyidaththilaavathu vithavaiga'lirunthaal, avarga'l ivarga'lukku uthavi seyyakkadavarga'l; sabaiyaanathu uththama vithavaiga'laanavarga'lukku uthaviseyyavea'ndiyathaagaiyaal anthap baaraththai athinmeal vaikkakkoodaathu.
nan'raay visaara'naiseygi'ra moopparga'lai, viseashamaagath thiruvasanaththilum ubatheasaththilum pirayaasappadugi'ravarga'lai, irattippaana kanaththi'rkup paaththiraraaga e'n'navea'ndum.
poaradikki'ra maattai vaaykattaayaaga en'rum, vealaiyaa'l than koolikkup paaththiranaayirukki'raan en'rum, veathavaakkiyam sollugi'rathea.
mooppanaanavanukku viroathamaaga oruvan seyyum piraathai ira'ndu moon'ru saadchiga'l illaamal nee eat'rukko'l'lakkoodaathu.
mat'ravarga'lukkup bayamu'ndaagumpadi, paavagnseythavarga'lai ellaarukkum munbaagak kadinthuko'l.

nee padchapaathaththoadea on'rum seyyaamalum, visaarikkumun niru'nayampa'n'naamalum, ivaiga'laik kaaththu nadakkumpadi, theavanukkum, karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvukkum, therinthuko'l'lappatta thootharukkum munbaaga, u'ruthiyaayk katta'laiyidugi'rean.
oruvanmealum seekkiramaayk kaiga'lai vaiyaathea; mat'ravarga'l seyyum paavangga'lukkum udanpadaathea; unnaich suththavaanaagak kaaththukko'l.
nee inimeal tha'n'neer maaththiram kudiyaamal, un vayit'ri'rkaagavum, unakku adikkadi nearidugi'ra balaveenangga'lukkaagavum, kogncham thiraadcharasamum koottikko'l.
silarudaiya paavangga'l ve'liyaranggamaayirunthu, niyaayaththeerppukku munthikko'l'lum; silarudaiya paavangga'l avarga'laip pinthodarum.
appadiyea silarudaiya na'rkiriyaiga'lum ve'liyaranggamaayirukkum; appadi iraathavaiga'lum ma'rainthirukkamaattaathu.

theavanudaiya naamamum ubatheasamum thooshikkappadaathapadikku, adimaiththana nugaththi'rkudpattirukki'ra vealaikkaarar yaavarum thangga'l ejamaanga'lai ellaak kanaththi'rkum paaththiraren'ru e'n'nikko'l'lakkadavarga'l.

visuvaasiga'laagiya ejamaanga'lai udaiyavarga'l, thangga'l ejamaanga'l sagoathararaayirukki'rathinaalea avarga'lai asattaipa'n'naamal, nalvealaiyin palanaip pet'rukko'l'lugi'ra avarga'l visuvaasiga'lum piriyarumaayirukki'rapadiyaal, avarga'lukku athigamaay oozhiyagnseyyakkadavarga'l; inthappadiyea poathiththup buththisollu.

oruvan nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvin aaroakkiyamaana vasanangga'laiyum, theavabakthikkeat'ra ubatheasangga'laiyum oppukko'l'laamal, veat'rumaiyaana ubatheasangga'laip poathikki'ravanaanaal,

avan i'rumaappu'l'lavanum, on'rum a'riyaathavanum, tharkkangga'laiyum vaakkuvaathangga'laiyumpat'ri noayko'ndavanumaayirukki'raan; avaiga'laalea po'raamaiyum, sa'ndaiyum, thoosha'nangga'lum, pollaatha samsayangga'lumu'ndaagi,

ketta sinthaiyu'l'lavarga'lum saththiyamillaathavarga'lum theavabakthiyai aathaayaththozhilen'ru e'n'nugi'ravarga'lumaayirukki'ra manusharga'laal u'ndaagum maa'rupaadaana tharkkangga'lum pi'rakkum; ippadippattavarga'lai vittu vilagu.
poathumengi'ra manathudanea koodiya theavabakthiyea miguntha aathaayam.
ulagaththilea naam on'rum ko'nduvanthathumillai, ithilirunthu naam on'rum ko'ndupoavathumillai enbathu nichchayam.
u'n'navum udukkavum namakku u'ndaayirunthaal athu poathumen'rirukkak kadavoam.
aisuvariyavaanga'laaga virumbugi'ravarga'l soathanaiyilum ka'n'niyilum, manusharaik keattilum azhivilum amizhththugi'ra mathikeadum seathamumaana palavitha ichchaiga'lilum vizhugi'raarga'l.
pa'na aasai ellaath theemaikkum vearaayirukki'rathu; silar athai ichchiththu, visuvaasaththaivittu vazhuvi, aneaga veathanaiga'laalea thangga'lai uruvak kuththikko'ndirukki'raarga'l.
neeyoa, theavanudaiya manushanea, ivaiga'lai vittoadi, neethiyaiyum theavabakthiyaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum anbaiyum po'rumaiyaiyum saanthaku'naththaiyum adaiyumpadi naadu.
visuvaasaththin nalla poaraattaththaip poaraadu, niththiyajeevanaip pat'rikko'l; atha'rkaagavea nee azhaikkappattaay; aneaga saadchiga'lukku munbaaga nalla a'rikkai pa'n'ninavanumaayirukki'raay.
nammudaiya karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthu pirasannamaagumvaraikkum, nee inthak ka'rpanaiyai maasillaamalum kut'ramillaamalum kaikko'l'lumpadikku,

ellaavat'raiyum uyiroadirukkach seygi'ra theavanudaiya sannithaanaththileayum, ponthiyupilaaththuvin munnin'ru nalla a'rikkaiyaich saadchiyaaga vi'langgappa'n'nina ki'risthu iyeasuvinudaiya sannithaanaththileayum unakkuk katta'laiyidugi'rean.
anthap pirasannamaaguthalaith theavan thammudaiya kaalangga'lil ve'lippaduththuvaar. avarea niththiyaananthamu'l'la eaga sakkaraathibathiyum, raajaathi raajaavum, karththaathi karththaavum,

oruvaraay, saavaamaiyu'l'lavarum, searakkoodaatha o'liyil vaasampa'n'nugi'ravarum, manusharil oruvarum ka'ndiraathavarum, kaa'nakkoodaathavarumaayirukki'ravar; avarukkea kanamum niththiya vallamaiyum u'ndaayiruppathaaga. aamen.

ivvulagaththilea aisuvariyamu'l'lavarga'l i'rumaappaana sinthaiyu'l'lavarga'laayiraamalum, nilaiyat'ra aisuvariyaththinmeal nambikkai vaiyaamalum, naam anubavikki'ratha'rkuch sagalavitha nanmaiga'laiyum namakkuch sampoora'namaayk kodukki'ra jeevanu'l'la theavanmeal nambikkai vaikkavum,
nanmaiseyyavum, na'rkiriyaiga'lil aisuvariyavaanga'laagavum, thaaraa'lamaayk kodukki'ravarga'lum, uthaaraku'namu'l'lavarga'lumaayirukkavum,
niththiya jeevanaip pat'rikko'l'lumpadi varungkaalaththi'rkaagath thangga'lukku nalla aathaaraththaip pokkishamaaga vaikkavum avarga'lukkuk katta'laiyidu.
oa theemoaththeayuvea, unnidaththil oppuvikkappattathai nee kaaththukko'ndu, seerkeadaana vee'npeachchuga'lukkum, gnaanamen'ru poyyaayp pearpet'rirukki'ra ko'lgaiyin vibareethangga'lukkum vilagu.
silar athaip paaraatti, visuvaasaththaivittu vazhuvippoanaarga'l. kirubaiyaanathu unnoadeakooda iruppathaaga. aamen.
ki'risthu iyeasuvinaal u'ndaayirukki'ra jeevanaippat'riya vaakkuththaththaththinpadi, theavanudaiya siththaththinaalea, iyeasuki'risthuvin appoasthalanaayirukki'ra pavul,

piriyamu'l'la kumaaranaagiya theemoaththeayuvukku ezhuthugi'rathaavathu: pithaavaagiya theavanaalum nammudaiya karththaraagiya ki'risthu iyeasuvinaalum kirubaiyum irakkamum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaga.
naan iravum pagalum idaividaamal en jebangga'lil unnai ninaiththu, un ka'n'neerai gnaabagampa'n'ni, santhoashaththaal ni'raiyappadumpadikku unnaik kaa'na vaagnchaiyaayirunthu,
unnilu'l'la maayamat'ra visuvaasaththai ninaivukoorugi'rathinaal, en munnoarga'l mutha'rko'ndu suththa manachsaadchiyoadea aaraathiththuvarum theavanai naan sthoaththirikki'rean.
antha visuvaasam munthi un paattiyaagiya loavisaa'lukku'l'lum un thaayaagiya ainikkeayaa'lukku'l'lum nilaiththirunthathu; athu unakku'l'lum nilaiththirukki'rathen'ru nichchayiththirukki'rean.
ithinimiththamaaga, naan unmeal en kaiga'lai vaiththathinaal unakku u'ndaana theavavaraththai nee analmootti ezhuppividumpadi unakku ninaippoottugi'rean.
theavan namakkup bayamu'l'la aaviyaik kodaamal, balamum anbum the'lintha buththiyu'l'la aaviyaiyea koduththirukki'raar.

aagaiyaal nammudaiya karththaraip pat'riya saadchiyaikku'riththaavathu, avar nimiththam kattappattirukki'ra ennaik ku'riththaavathu, nee vedkappadaamal, theavavallamaikkeat'rapadi suviseashaththi'rkaaga ennoadeakoodath theengganubavi.

avar nammudaiya kiriyaiga'linpadi nammai iradchikkaamal, thammudaiya theermaanaththinpadiyum, aathikaalamuthal ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l namakku aru'lappatta kirubaiyinpadiyum, nammai iradchiththu, parisuththa azhaippinaalea azhaiththaar.

nammudaiya iradchagaraagiya iyeasuki'risthu pirasannamaanathinaalea anthak kirubai ippozhuthu ve'lippaduththappattathu; avar mara'naththaip parigariththu, jeevanaiyum azhiyaamaiyaiyum suviseashaththinaalea ve'liyaranggamaakkinaar.
atha'rku naan pirasanggiyaagavum, appoasthalanaagavum, pu'rajaathiyaarukkup poathaganaagavum niyamikkappattean.

athinimiththam naan inthap paaduga'laiyum anubavikki'rean; aayinum, naan vedkappadugi'rathillai; eanen'raal, naan visuvaasiththirukki'ravar innaar en'ru a'rivean, naan avaridaththil oppukkoduththathai avar annaa'lvaraikkum kaaththukko'l'la vallavaraayirukki'raaren'ru nichchayiththumirukki'rean.
nee ki'risthu iyeasuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththoadum anboadum ennidaththil keattirukki'ra aaroakkiyamaana vasanangga'lin sattaththaik kaikko'ndiru.
unnidaththil oppuvikkappatta antha na'rporu'lai namakku'l'lea vaasampa'n'nugi'ra parisuththa aaviyinaalea kaaththukko'l.
aasiyaanaattilirukki'ra yaavarum, avarga'lil pigellu ermogenea muthalaay ennaivittu vilaginaarga'len'ru a'rinthirukki'raay.
oneasippoaruvin veettaarukkuk karththar irakkang katta'laiyiduvaaraaga; avan aneagantharam ennai i'laippaat'rinaan; en vilanggaikku'riththu avan vedkappadavumillai;
avan roamaavil vanthirunthapoathu athiga jaakkirathaiyaay ennaith theadik ka'ndupidiththaan.
annaa'lilea avan karththaridaththil irakkaththaik ka'ndadaiyumpadi, karththar avanukku anukkiragagnseyvaaraaga; avan ebeasuvilea seytha pa'rpala uthaviga'laiyum nee nan'raay a'rinthirukki'raayea.
aathalaal, en kumaaranea, nee ki'risthu iyeasuvilu'l'la kirubaiyil balappadu.
aneaga saadchiga'lukku munbaaga nee ennidaththil keattavaiga'lai mat'ravarga'lukkup poathikkaththakka u'nmaiyu'l'la manusharga'lidaththil oppuvi.
neeyum iyeasuki'risthuvukku nalla poarchseavaganaayth theengganubavi.
tha'ndil seavagampa'n'nugi'ra evanum, thannaich seavagamezhuthikko'ndavanukku eat'ravanaayirukkumpadi, pizhaippukkaduththa aluvalga'lil sikkikko'l'lamaattaan.
mealum oruvan malyuththampa'n'ninaalum, sattaththinpadi pa'n'naavittaal mudisoottappadaan.
pirayaasappattup payiridugi'ravan palanil munthip panggadaiyavea'ndum.
naan sollugi'ravaiga'laich sinthiththukko'l; karththar ellaak kaariyangga'lilum unakkup buththiyaith thantharu'luvaar.
thaaveethin santhathiyil pi'rantha iyeasuki'risthu, en suviseashaththinpadiyea, mariththoarilirunthezhuppappattavaren'ru ninaiththukko'l.
inthach suviseashaththinimiththam naan paathaganpoalak kattappattu, thunbaththai anubavikki'rean; theavavasanamoa kattappattirukkavillai.
aagaiyaal, therinthuko'l'lappattavarga'l ki'risthu iyeasuvinaal u'ndaana iradchippai niththiya magimaiyoadea pet'rukko'l'lumpadi, sagalaththaiyum avarga'l nimiththamaagach sagikki'rean.
intha vaarththai u'nmaiyu'l'lathu; ennavenil, naam avaroadeakooda mariththoamaanaal, avaroadeakoodap pizhaiththumiruppoam;
avaroadeakoodap paaduga'laich sagiththoamaanaal avaroadeakooda aa'lugaiyum seyvoam; naam avarai ma'ruthaliththaal, avarum nammai ma'ruthalippaar;
naam u'nmaiyillaathavarga'laayirunthaalum, avar u'nmaiyu'l'lavaraayirukki'raar; avar thammaiththaam ma'ruthalikkamaattaar.

ivaiga'lai avarga'lukku ninaippootti, on'rukkum pirayoajanamillaamal, keadki'ravarga'laik kavizhththuppoadugi'ratha'rkeathuvaana vaakkuvaatham seyyaathapadikku, karththarukku munbaaga avarga'lukku echchariththup buththisollu.
nee vedkappadaatha oozhiyakkaaranaayum saththiya vasanaththai nithaanamaayp paguththup poathikki'ravanaayum unnaith theavanukku munbaaga uththamanaaga ni'ruththumpadi jaakkirathaiyaayiru.
seerkeadaana vee'npeachchuga'lukku vilagiyiru; avaiga'laal (ka'l'lappoathagarga'laana) avarga'l athiga avabakthiyu'l'lavarga'laavaarga'l;
avarga'ludaiya vaarththai aripi'lavaiyaippoalap padarum; imeneayum pileaththum appadippattavarga'l;
avarga'l saththiyaththai vittu vilagi, uyirththezhuthal nadanthaayit'ren'ru solli, silarudaiya visuvaasaththaik kavizhththuppoadugi'raarga'l.

aagilum theavanudaiya u'ruthiyaana asthibaaram nilaiththirukki'rathu; karththar thammudaiyavarga'lai a'rivaarenbathum, ki'risthuvin naamaththaich sollugi'ra evanum aniyaayaththaivittu vilagakkadavanenbathum, atha'rku muththiraiyaayirukki'rathu.
oru periya veettilea ponnum ve'l'liyumaana paaththirangga'lumallaamal, maramum ma'n'numaana paaththirangga'lumu'ndu; avaiga'lil sila kanaththi'rkum sila kanaveenaththi'rkumaanavaiga'l.

aagaiyaal oruvan ivaiga'lai vittu, thannaich suththigariththukko'ndaal, avan parisuththamaakkappattathum, ejamaanukku ubayoagamaanathum, entha na'rkiriyaikkum aayaththamaakkappattathumaana kanaththukkuriya paaththiramaayiruppaan.

an'riyum, paaliyaththukkuriya ichchaiga'lukku nee vilagiyoadi, suththa iruthayaththoadea karththaraith thozhuthuko'l'lugi'ravarga'ludanea, neethiyaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum anbaiyum samaathaanaththaiyum adaiyumpadi naadu.
buththiyeenamum ayukthamumaana tharkkangga'l sa'ndaiga'laip pi'rappikkumen'ru a'rinthu, avaiga'lukku vilagiyiru.
karththarudaiya oozhiyakkaaran sa'ndaipa'n'nugi'ravanaayiraamal, ellaaridaththilum saanthamu'l'lavanum, poathagasamarththanum, theemaiyaich sagikki'ravanumaayirukkavea'ndum.
ethirpeasugi'ravarga'l saththiyaththai a'riyumpadi theavan avarga'lukku mananthirumbuthalai aru'laththakkathaagavum,
pisaasaanavanudaiya ichchaiyinpadi seyya avanaal pidipattirukki'ra avarga'l ma'rupadiyum mayakkanthe'linthu avan ka'n'nikku neenggaththakkathaagavum, saanthamaay avarga'lukku ubatheasikkavea'ndum.
mealum, kadaisinaadka'lil kodiya kaalangga'l varumen'ru a'rivaayaaga.

eppadiyenil, manusharga'l tha'rpiriyaraayum, pa'nappiriyaraayum, veembukkaararaayum, aganthaiyu'l'lavarga'laayum, thooshikki'ravarga'laayum, thaaythagappanmaarukkuk keezhppadiyaathavarga'laayum, nan'riya'riyaathavarga'laayum, parisuththamillaathavarga'laayum,
subaava anbillaathavarga'laayum, i'nanggaathavarga'laayum, avathoo'ru seygi'ravarga'laayum, ichchaiyadakkamillaathavarga'laayum, kodumaiyu'l'lavarga'laayum, nalloaraip pagaikki'ravarga'laayum,
thuroagiga'laayum, thu'nigaramu'l'lavarga'laayum, i'rumaappu'l'lavarga'laayum, theavappiriyaraayiraamal sugaboagappiriyaraayum,
theavabakthiyin veashaththaith thariththu athin belanai ma'ruthalikki'ravarga'laayum iruppaarga'l; ippadippattavarga'lai nee vittu vilagu.
paavangga'laal ni'rainthu, pa'rpala ichchaiga'laal izhuppu'ndu,
eppoathum kat'raalum orupoathum saththiyaththai a'rinthu u'naraathavarga'laayirukki'ra pe'npi'l'laiga'ludaiya veeduga'lil ippadippattavarga'l nuzhainthu, avarga'lai vasappaduththikko'l'lugi'raarga'l.

yanneayum yambireayum moaseakku ethirththu nin'rathupoala ivarga'lum saththiyaththukku ethirththu ni'rki'raarga'l; ivarga'l thurpbuththiyu'l'la manusharga'l, visuvaasavishayaththil pareedchaikku nillaathavarga'l.
aanaalum, ivarga'l athigamaayp balappaduvathillai; avviruvarudaiya mathikeadu ellaarukkum ve'lippattathupoala, ivarga'ludaiya mathikeadum ve'lippadum.
neeyoa en poathagaththaiyum nadakkaiyaiyum noakkaththaiyum visuvaasaththaiyum neediya saanthaththaiyum anbaiyum po'rumaiyaiyum,

anthiyoakiyaa, ikkoaniyaa, leesthiraa ennum patta'nangga'lil enakku u'ndaana thunbangga'laiyum paaduga'laiyum nan'raay a'rinthirukki'raay; evva'lavoa thunbangga'laich sagiththean; ivaiyellaavat'rinin'rum karththar ennai neenggalaakkivittaar.
an'riyum ki'risthu iyeasuvukku'l theavabakthiyaay nadakka manathaayirukki'ra yaavarum thunbappaduvaarga'l.
pollaathavarga'lum eththarga'lumaanavarga'l moasampoakkugi'ravarga'laagavum, moasampoagi'ravarga'laagavumirunthu meanmealum keadu'l'lavarga'laavaarga'l.
nee kat'ru nichchayiththukko'ndavaiga'lil nilaiththiru; avaiga'lai innaaridaththil kat'raay en'ru nee a'rinthirukki'rathumallaamal,

ki'risthu iyeasuvaippat'rum visuvaasaththinaalea unnai iradchippukkeat'ra gnaanamu'l'lavanaakkaththakka parisuththa veatha ezhuththukka'lai, nee si'ruvayathumuthal a'rinthavanen'rum unakkuth theriyum.
veathavaakkiyangga'lellaam theavaaaviyinaal aru'lappattirukki'rathu; theavanudaiya manushan thea'rinavanaagavum, entha na'rkiriyaiyugn seyyath thaguthiyu'l'lavanaagavum irukkumpadiyaaga,
avaiga'l ubatheasaththukkum, kadinthuko'l'luthalukkum, seerthiruththalukkum, neethiyaip padippikkuthalukkum pirayoajanamu'l'lavaiga'laayirukki'rathu.

naan theavanukku munbaagavum, uyiroadirukki'ravarga'laiyum mariththavarga'laiyum niyaayantheerkkappoagi'ra karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvukku munbaagavum, avarudaiya pirasannamaaguthalaiyum avarudaiya raajyaththaiyum saadchiyaaga vaiththuk katta'laiyidugi'rathaavathu:
samayam vaayththaalum vaaykkaavittaalum jaakkirathaiyaayth thiruvasanaththaip pirasanggampa'n'nu; ellaa neediya saanthaththoadum ubatheasaththoadum ka'ndanampa'n'ni, kadinthuko'ndu, buththisollu.

eanen'raal, avarga'l aaroakkiyamaana ubatheasaththaip po'rukka manathillaamal, seviththinavu'l'lavarga'laagi, thangga'l suya ichchaiga'lukkeat'ra poathagarga'laith thangga'lukkuth thira'laagach searththukko'ndu,
saththiyaththukkuch seviyai vilakki, kattukkathaiga'lukkuch saaynthupoagungkaalam varum.
neeyoa ellaavat'rilum manaththe'livu'l'lavanaayiru, theengganubavi, suviseashaganudaiya vealaiyaich sey, un oozhiyaththai ni'raiveat'ru.
eanen'raal, naan ippozhuthea baanabaliyaaga vaarkkappattuppoagi'rean; naan theagaththai vittup piriyum kaalam vanthathu.
nalla poaraattaththaip poaraadinean, oattaththai mudiththean, visuvaasaththaik kaaththukko'ndean.

ithumuthal neethiyin kireedam enakkaaga vaikkappattirukki'rathu, neethiyu'l'la niyaayaathibathiyaagiya karththar annaa'lilea athai enakkuth thantharu'luvaar; enakku maaththiramalla, avar pirasannamaaguthalai virumbum yaavarukkum athaith thantharu'luvaar.
nee seekkiramaay ennidaththil varumpadi jaakkirathaippadu.

eanen'raal, theamaa ippirapagnchaththinmeal aasaivaiththu, ennaivittup pirinthu, thesaloanikkea patta'naththukkup poayvittaan; kireskea kalaaththiyaa naatti'rkum, theeththu thalmaaththiyaa naatti'rkum poayvittaarga'l.
lookkaamaaththiram ennoadea irukki'raan. maa'rkuvai unnoadea koottikko'nduvaa; oozhiyaththil avan enakkup pirayoajanamu'l'lavan.
theegikkuvai naan ebeasuvukku anuppinean.
thuroavaa patta'naththilirukki'ra kaarppu enbavan vasaththil naan vaiththuvantha mealanggiyaiyum, pusthagangga'laiyum, viseashamaayth thoa'rsuru'lga'laiyum, nee varugi'rapoathu eduththukko'nduvaa.
kannaanaagiya aleksanthar enakku vegu theemaiseythaan; avanudaiya seygaikkuththakkathaagak karththar avanukkup bathila'lippaaraaga.
neeyum avanaikku'riththu echcharikkaiyaayiru; avan nammudaiya vaarththaiga'lukku migavum ethirththunin'ravan.
naan muthalvisai uththaravusolla ni'rkaiyil oruvanum ennoadeakooda irukkavillai, ellaarum ennaik kaivittaarga'l; anthak kut'ram avarga'lmeal sumaraathiruppathaaga.

karththaroa enakkuth thu'naiyaaga nin'ru, ennaalea pirasanggam ni'raivea'rugi'ratha'rkaagavum, pu'rajaathiyaarellaarum keadki'ratha'rkaagavum, ennaip balappaduththinaar; singgaththin vaayilirunthum naan iradchikkappattean.
karththar ellaath theemaiyinin'rum ennai iradchiththu, thammudaiya parama raajyaththai adaiyumpadi kaappaat'ruvaar; avarukkuch sathaakaalangga'lilum magimai u'ndaavathaaga. aamen.
piriskaa'lukkum aakkillaavukkum, oneasippoaruvin veettaarukkum en vaazhththuthalaich sollu.
erasthu korinthupatta'naththil irunthuvittaan; thuroappeemuvai mileaththuvil viyaathippattavanaaga vittuvanthean.
maarikaalaththukkumun nee vanthu searumpadi jaakkirathaippadu. aibooluvum, putheagnsum, leenuvum, kalavuthiyaa'lum, mat'rellaach sagoathararum unakku vaazhththuthal sollugi'raarga'l.
karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthu un aaviyudaneakooda iruppaaraaga. kirubai ungga'loadiruppathaaga. aamen.
theavanudaiya oozhiyakkaaranum, iyeasuki'risthuvinudaiya appoasthalanumaagiya pavul, pothuvaana visuvaasaththinpadi uththama kumaaranaagiya theeththuvukku ezhuthugi'rathaavathu:
pithaavaagiya theavanaalum, nammudaiya iradchagaraayirukki'ra karththaraagiya iyeasuki'risthuvinaalum, kirubaiyum irakkamum samaathaanamum u'ndaavathaaga.

poyyuraiyaatha theavan aathikaalamuthal niththiya jeevanaikku'riththu vaakkuththaththampa'n'ni, athaikku'riththa nambikkaiyaippat'ri theavabakthikkeathuvaana saththiyaththai a'rigi'ra a'rivum visuvaasamum theavanaal therinthuko'l'lappattavarga'lukku u'ndaagumpadi,
eat'rakaalangga'lilea nammudaiya iradchagaraagiya theavanudaiya katta'laiyinpadi enakku oppuvikkappatta pirasanggaththinaalea thamathu vaarththaiyai ve'lippaduththinaar.
nee ku'raivaayirukki'ravaiga'lai ozhunggupaduththumpadikkum, naan unakkuk katta'laiyittapadiyea, patta'nangga'lthoa'rum moopparai ea'rpaduththumpadikkum, unnaik kireaththaatheevilea vittuvantheanea.

kut'ragnsaattappadaathavanum, orea manaiviyaiyudaiya purushanum, thunmaarkkaren'rum adanggaathavarga'len'rum pearedukkaatha visuvaasamu'l'la pi'l'laiga'lai udaiyavanumaagiya oruvanirunthaal avanaiyea ea'rpaduththalaam.

eanenil, ka'nkaa'niyaanavan theavanudaiya ukkiraa'nakkaaranukkeat'ravithamaay, kut'ragnsaattappadaathavanum, than ishdappadi seyyaathavanum, mu'rkoabamillaathavanum, mathubaanappiriyamillaathavanum, adiyaathavanum, izhivaana aathaayaththai ichchiyaathavanum,
anniyarai ubasarikki'ravanum, nalloarmeal piriyamu'l'lavanum, the'lintha buththiyu'l'lavanum, neethimaanum, parisuththavaanum, ichchaiyadakkamu'l'lavanum,

aaroakkiyamaana ubatheasaththinaalea buththisollavum, ethirpeasugi'ravarga'laik ka'ndanam pa'n'navum vallavanumaayirukkumpadi, thaan poathikkappattatha'rkeat'ra u'nmaiyaana vasanaththai nan'raayp pat'rikko'l'lugi'ravanumaayirukkavea'ndum.
aneagar, viseashamaay viruththaseathanamu'l'lavarga'l, adanggaathavarga'lum, vee'npeachchukkaararum, manathai mayakkugi'ravarga'lumaayirukki'raarga'l.
avarga'ludaiya vaayai adakkavea'ndum; avarga'l izhivaana aathaayaththukkaagath thagaathavaiga'lai ubatheasiththu, muzhukkudumbangga'laiyum kavizhththuppoadugi'raarga'l.
kireaththaatheevaar oayaappoyyar, thushdamirugangga'l, peruvayit'ruch soambea'riga'l en'ru avarga'liloruvanaagiya avarga'l theerkkatharisiyaanavanea solliyirukki'raan.
inthach saadchi u'nmaiyaayirukki'rathu; ithu mugaantharamaaga, avarga'l yootharudaiya kattukkathaiga'lukkum, saththiyaththai vittu vilagugi'ra manusharudaiya ka'rpanaiga'lukkum sevikodaamal,
visuvaasaththilea aaroakkiyamu'l'lavarga'laayirukkumpadi, nee avarga'laik ka'ndippaayk kadinthuko'l.

suththamu'l'lavarga'lukkuch sagalamum suththamaayirukkum; asuththamu'l'lavarga'lukkum avisuvaasamu'l'lavarga'lukkum on'rum suththamaayiraathu; avarga'ludaiya buththiyum manachsaadchiyum asuththamaayirukkum.
